verses.textZh: 第三十年四月五日，我正在迦巴鲁河边的时候，天开了，我就看见神的异象；那时，我是在被掳的人中间。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第三十年四月五日，我正在迦巴鲁河边的时候，天开了，我就看见神的异象；那时，我是在被掳的人中间。
verses.textZhCuv: 当三十年四月初五日，以西结 在迦巴鲁河边被掳的人中，天就开了，得见神的异象。
verses.textEnNiv: In my thirtieth year, in the fourth month on the fifth day, while I was among the exiles by the Kebar River, the heavens were opened and I saw visions of God.
verses.textEnEsv: In the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, on the fifth day of the month, as I was among the exiles by the Chebar canal, the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, on the fifth day of the month, as I was among the captives by the River Chebar, that the heavens were opened and I saw visions of God.
verses.textEnNlt: On July 31 of my thirtieth year, while I was with the Judean exiles beside the Kebar River in Babylon, the heavens were opened and I saw visions of God.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about in the thirtieth year, on the fifth day of the fourth month, while I was by the river Chebar among the exiles, the heavens were opened and I saw visions of God.
verses.textEn: In my thirtieth year, in the fourth month on the fifth day, while I was among the exiles by the Kebar River, the heavens were opened and I saw visions of God.

verses.textZh: 我观望，看见有狂风从北方刮来，并有一块闪耀着火焰的很大的云，云的周围有光芒，在云中的火焰里，好象有发光的金属。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我观望，看见有狂风从北方刮来，并有一块闪耀着火焰的很大的云，云的周围有光芒，在云中的火焰里，好象有发光的金属。
verses.textZhCuv: 正是约雅斤王被掳去第五年四月初五日，
verses.textEnNiv: On the fifth of the month—it was the fifth year of the exile of King Jehoiachin—
verses.textEnEsv: On the fifth day of the month (it was the fifth year of the exile of King Jehoiachin),
verses.textEnNkjv: On the fifth day of the month, which was in the fifth year of King Jehoiachin’s captivity,
verses.textEnNlt: This happened during the fifth year of King Jehoiachin’s captivity.
verses.textEnNasb: (On the fifth of the month in the fifth year of King Jehoiachin’s exile,
verses.textEn: On the fifth of the month—it was the fifth year of the exile of King Jehoiachin—

verses.textZh: 在火中又有四个活物的形状，牠们的样子是这样：牠们都有人的形状。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在火中又有四个活物的形状，牠们的样子是这样：牠们都有人的形状。
verses.textZhCuv: 在迦勒底人之地、迦巴鲁河边，耶和华的话特特临到布西的儿子祭司以西结；耶和华的灵 降在他身上。
verses.textEnNiv: the word of the Lord came to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, by the Kebar River in the land of the Babylonians. There the hand of the Lord was on him.
verses.textEnEsv: the word of the Lord came to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the Chebar canal, and the hand of the Lord was upon him there.
verses.textEnNkjv: the word of the Lord came expressly to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the River Chebar; and the hand of the Lord was upon him there.
verses.textEnNlt: (The Lord gave this message to Ezekiel son of Buzi, a priest, beside the Kebar River in the land of the Babylonians, and he felt the hand of the Lord take hold of him.)
verses.textEnNasb: the word of the Lord came expressly to Ezekiel the priest, son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and there the hand of the Lord came upon him.)
verses.textEn: the word of the Lord came to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, by the Kebar River in the land of the Babylonians. There the hand of the Lord was on him.

verses.textZh: 牠们各有四个脸孔、四个翅膀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠们各有四个脸孔、四个翅膀。
verses.textZhCuv: 我观看，见狂风从北方刮来，随着有一朵包括闪烁火的大云，周围有光辉；从其中的火内发出好像光耀的精金；
verses.textEnNiv: I looked, and I saw a windstorm coming out of the north—an immense cloud with flashing lightning and surrounded by brilliant light. The center of the fire looked like glowing metal,
verses.textEnEsv: As I looked, behold, a stormy wind came out of the north, and a great cloud, with brightness around it, and fire flashing forth continually, and in the midst of the fire, as it were gleaming metal.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I looked, and behold, a whirlwind was coming out of the north, a great cloud with raging fire engulfing itself; and brightness was all around it and radiating out of its midst like the color of amber, out of the midst of the fire.
verses.textEnNlt: As I looked, I saw a great storm coming from the north, driving before it a huge cloud that flashed with lightning and shone with brilliant light. There was fire inside the cloud, and in the middle of the fire glowed something like gleaming amber.
verses.textEnNasb: As I looked, behold, a high wind was coming from the north, a great cloud with fire flashing intermittently and a bright light around it, and in its midst something like gleaming metal in the midst of the fire.
verses.textEn: I looked, and I saw a windstorm coming out of the north—an immense cloud with flashing lightning and surrounded by brilliant light. The center of the fire looked like glowing metal,

verses.textZh: 牠们的腿是直的，脚掌像牛犊的蹄，都很灿烂，像擦亮了的铜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠们的腿是直的，脚掌像牛犊的蹄，都很灿烂，像擦亮了的铜。
verses.textZhCuv: 又从其中显出四个活物的形象来。他们的形状是这样：有人的形象，
verses.textEnNiv: and in the fire was what looked like four living creatures. In appearance their form was human,
verses.textEnEsv: And from the midst of it came the likeness of four living creatures. And this was their appearance: they had a human likeness,
verses.textEnNkjv: Also from within it came the likeness of four living creatures. And this was their appearance: they had the likeness of a man.
verses.textEnNlt: From the center of the cloud came four living beings that looked human,
verses.textEnNasb: And within it there were figures resembling four living beings. And this was their appearance: they had human form.
verses.textEn: and in the fire was what looked like four living creatures. In appearance their form was human,

verses.textZh: 在牠们四边的翅膀下都有人的手。牠们四个活物的脸孔和翅膀是这样的：
verses.textZhCnvs: 在牠们四边的翅膀下都有人的手。牠们四个活物的脸孔和翅膀是这样的：
verses.textZhCuv: 各有四个脸面，四个翅膀。
verses.textEnNiv: but each of them had four faces and four wings.
verses.textEnEsv: but each had four faces, and each of them had four wings.
verses.textEnNkjv: Each one had four faces, and each one had four wings.
verses.textEnNlt: except that each had four faces and four wings.
verses.textEnNasb: Each of them had four faces and four wings.
verses.textEn: but each of them had four faces and four wings.

verses.textZh: 牠们的翅膀互相接触，走动的时候，不必转身，都是朝着脸孔的方向行走。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠们的翅膀互相接触，走动的时候，不必转身，都是朝着脸孔的方向行走。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的腿是直的，脚掌好像牛犊之蹄，都灿烂如光明的铜。
verses.textEnNiv: Their legs were straight; their feet were like those of a calf and gleamed like burnished bronze.
verses.textEnEsv: Their legs were straight, and the soles of their feet were like the sole of a calf’s foot. And they sparkled like burnished bronze.
verses.textEnNkjv: Their legs were straight, and the soles of their feet were like the soles of calves’ feet. They sparkled like the color of burnished bronze.
verses.textEnNlt: Their legs were straight, and their feet had hooves like those of a calf and shone like burnished bronze.
verses.textEnNasb: Their legs were straight and their feet were like a calf’s hoof, and they sparkled like polished bronze.
verses.textEn: Their legs were straight; their feet were like those of a calf and gleamed like burnished bronze.

verses.textZh: 至于牠们脸孔的形状，四个活物都各有一个人的脸孔，在右边各有一个狮子的脸孔，在左边各有一个牛的脸孔，此外各有一个鹰的脸孔；
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于牠们脸孔的形状，四个活物都各有一个人的脸孔，在右边各有一个狮子的脸孔，在左边各有一个牛的脸孔，此外各有一个鹰的脸孔；
verses.textZhCuv: 在四面的翅膀以下有人的手。这四个活物的脸和翅膀乃是这样：
verses.textEnNiv: Under their wings on their four sides they had human hands. All four of them had faces and wings,
verses.textEnEsv: Under their wings on their four sides they had human hands. And the four had their faces and their wings thus:
verses.textEnNkjv: The hands of a man were under their wings on their four sides; and each of the four had faces and wings.
verses.textEnNlt: Under each of their four wings I could see human hands. So each of the four beings had four faces and four wings.
verses.textEnNasb: Under their wings on their four sides were human hands. As for the faces and wings of the four of them,
verses.textEn: Under their wings on their four sides they had human hands. All four of them had faces and wings,

verses.textZh: 牠们的脸孔就是这样。牠们向上展开翅膀，各自用两个翅膀互相接触，用两个翅膀遮蔽身体。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠们的脸孔就是这样。牠们向上展开翅膀，各自用两个翅膀互相接触，用两个翅膀遮蔽身体。
verses.textZhCuv: 翅膀彼此相接，行走并不转身，俱各直往前行。
verses.textEnNiv: and the wings of one touched the wings of another. Each one went straight ahead; they did not turn as they moved.
verses.textEnEsv: their wings touched one another. Each one of them went straight forward, without turning as they went.
verses.textEnNkjv: Their wings touched one another. Thecreatures did not turn when they went, but each one went straight forward.
verses.textEnNlt: The wings of each living being touched the wings of the beings beside it. Each one moved straight forward in any direction without turning around.
verses.textEnNasb: their wings touched one another; their faces did not turn when they moved, each went straight forward.
verses.textEn: and the wings of one touched the wings of another. Each one went straight ahead; they did not turn as they moved.

verses.textZh: 牠们都是朝着脸孔的方向行走。灵往哪里去，牠们就往哪里去。牠们走动的时候，都不必转身。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠们都是朝着脸孔的方向行走。灵往哪里去，牠们就往哪里去。牠们走动的时候，都不必转身。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于脸的形象：前面各有人的脸，右面各有狮子的脸，左面各有牛的脸，后面各有鹰的脸。
verses.textEnNiv: Their faces looked like this: Each of the four had the face of a human being, and on the right side each had the face of a lion, and on the left the face of an ox; each also had the face of an eagle.
verses.textEnEsv: As for the likeness of their faces, each had a human face. The four had the face of a lion on the right side, the four had the face of an ox on the left side, and the four had the face of an eagle.
verses.textEnNkjv: As for the likeness of their faces, each had the face of a man; each of the four had the face of a lion on the right side, each of the four had the face of an ox on the left side, and each of the four had the face of an eagle.
verses.textEnNlt: Each had a human face in the front, the face of a lion on the right side, the face of an ox on the left side, and the face of an eagle at the back.
verses.textEnNasb: As for the form of their faces, each had a human face; all four had the face of a lion on the right and the face of a bull on the left, and all four had the face of an eagle.
verses.textEn: Their faces looked like this: Each of the four had the face of a human being, and on the right side each had the face of a lion, and on the left the face of an ox; each also had the face of an eagle.

verses.textZh: 至于四个活物的形状，样子像烧着的火炭，又像火把。火在四活物中间到处闪耀。这火很明亮，有闪电从火中发出。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于四个活物的形状，样子像烧着的火炭，又像火把。火在四活物中间到处闪耀。这火很明亮，有闪电从火中发出。
verses.textZhCuv: 各展开上边的两个翅膀相接，各以下边的两个翅膀遮体。
verses.textEnNiv: Such were their faces. They each had two wings spreading out upward, each wing touching that of the creature on either side; and each had two other wings covering its body.
verses.textEnEsv: Such were their faces. And their wings were spread out above. Each creature had two wings, each of which touched the wing of another, while two covered their bodies.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus were their faces. Their wings stretched upward; two wings of each one touched one another, and two covered their bodies.
verses.textEnNlt: Each had two pairs of outstretched wings—one pair stretched out to touch the wings of the living beings on either side of it, and the other pair covered its body.
verses.textEnNasb: Such were their faces. Their wings were spread out above; each had two touching another being, and two covering their bodies.
verses.textEn: Such were their faces. They each had two wings spreading out upward, each wing touching that of the creature on either side; and each had two other wings covering its body.

verses.textZh: 四个活物往来奔走，好象闪电。
verses.textZhCnvs: 四个活物往来奔走，好象闪电。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们俱各直往前行。灵往哪里去，他们就往那里去，行走并不转身。
verses.textEnNiv: Each one went straight ahead. Wherever the spirit would go, they would go, without turning as they went.
verses.textEnEsv: And each went straight forward. Wherever the spirit would go, they went, without turning as they went.
verses.textEnNkjv: And each one went straight forward; they went wherever the spirit wanted to go, and they did not turn when they went.
verses.textEnNlt: They went in whatever direction the spirit chose, and they moved straight forward in any direction without turning around.
verses.textEnNasb: And each went straight forward; wherever the spirit was about to go, they would go, without turning as they went.
verses.textEn: Each one went straight ahead. Wherever the spirit would go, they would go, without turning as they went.

verses.textZh: 我观看那些活物的时候，看见四个活物的旁边都有一个触地的轮子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我观看那些活物的时候，看见四个活物的旁边都有一个触地的轮子。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于四活物的形象，就如烧着火炭的形状，又如火把的形状。火在四活物中间上去下来，这火有光辉，从火中发出闪电。
verses.textEnNiv: The appearance of the living creatures was like burning coals of fire or like torches. Fire moved back and forth among the creatures; it was bright, and lightning flashed out of it.
verses.textEnEsv: As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance was like burning coals of fire, like the appearance of torches moving to and fro among the living creatures. And the fire was bright, and out of the fire went forth lightning.
verses.textEnNkjv: As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance was like burning coals of fire, like the appearance of torches going back and forth among the living creatures. The fire was bright, and out of the fire went lightning.
verses.textEnNlt: The living beings looked like bright coals of fire or brilliant torches, and lightning seemed to flash back and forth among them.
verses.textEnNasb: In the midst of the living beings there was something that looked like burning coals of fire, like torches moving among the living beings. The fire was bright, and lightning was flashing from the fire.
verses.textEn: The appearance of the living creatures was like burning coals of fire or like torches. Fire moved back and forth among the creatures; it was bright, and lightning flashed out of it.

verses.textZh: 四个轮子的样子与构造都是一个形状，它们好象闪耀的水苍玉，又好象轮子套着轮子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 四个轮子的样子与构造都是一个形状，它们好象闪耀的水苍玉，又好象轮子套着轮子。
verses.textZhCuv: 这活物往来奔走，好像电光一闪。
verses.textEnNiv: The creatures sped back and forth like flashes of lightning.
verses.textEnEsv: And the living creatures darted to and fro, like the appearance of a flash of lightning.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the living creatures ran back and forth, in appearance like a flash of lightning.
verses.textEnNlt: And the living beings darted to and fro like flashes of lightning.
verses.textEnNasb: And the living beings ran back and forth like bolts of lightning.
verses.textEn: The creatures sped back and forth like flashes of lightning.

verses.textZh: 轮子可以向四方移动，移动的时候，不必转向。
verses.textZhCnvs: 轮子可以向四方移动，移动的时候，不必转向。
verses.textZhCuv: 我正观看活物的时候，见活物的脸旁各有一轮在地上。
verses.textEnNiv: As I looked at the living creatures, I saw a wheel on the ground beside each creature with its four faces.
verses.textEnEsv: Now as I looked at the living creatures, I saw a wheel on the earth beside the living creatures, one for each of the four of them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now as I looked at the living creatures, behold, a wheel was on the earth beside each living creature with its four faces.
verses.textEnNlt: As I looked at these beings, I saw four wheels touching the ground beside them, one wheel belonging to each.
verses.textEnNasb: Now as I looked at the living beings, behold, there was one wheel on the ground beside the living beings, for each of the four of them.
verses.textEn: As I looked at the living creatures, I saw a wheel on the ground beside each creature with its four faces.

verses.textZh: 轮辋很高，十分可畏，四个轮辋都布满了眼睛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 轮辋很高，十分可畏，四个轮辋都布满了眼睛。
verses.textZhCuv: 轮的形状和颜色 好像水苍玉。四轮都是一个样式，形状和作法好像轮中套轮。
verses.textEnNiv: This was the appearance and structure of the wheels: They sparkled like topaz, and all four looked alike. Each appeared to be made like a wheel intersecting a wheel.
verses.textEnEsv: As for the appearance of the wheels and their construction: their appearance was like the gleaming of beryl. And the four had the same likeness, their appearance and construction being as it were a wheel within a wheel.
verses.textEnNkjv: The appearance of the wheels and their workings was like the color of beryl, and all four had the same likeness. The appearance of their workings was, as it were, a wheel in the middle of a wheel.
verses.textEnNlt: The wheels sparkled as if made of beryl. All four wheels looked alike and were made the same; each wheel had a second wheel turning crosswise within it.
verses.textEnNasb: The appearance of the wheels and their workmanship was like sparkling topaz, and all four of them had the same form, their appearance and workmanship being as if one wheel were within another.
verses.textEn: This was the appearance and structure of the wheels: They sparkled like topaz, and all four looked alike. Each appeared to be made like a wheel intersecting a wheel.

verses.textZh: 活物走动的时候，牠们旁边的轮子也随着移动。活物从地上升起的时候，轮子也随着升起。
verses.textZhCnvs: 活物走动的时候，牠们旁边的轮子也随着移动。活物从地上升起的时候，轮子也随着升起。
verses.textZhCuv: 轮行走的时候，向四方都能直行，并不掉转。
verses.textEnNiv: As they moved, they would go in any one of the four directions the creatures faced; the wheels did not change direction as the creatures went.
verses.textEnEsv: When they went, they went in any of their four directions without turning as they went.
verses.textEnNkjv: When they moved, they went toward any one of four directions; they did not turn aside when they went.
verses.textEnNlt: The beings could move in any of the four directions they faced, without turning as they moved.
verses.textEnNasb: Whenever they moved, they moved in any of their four directions without turning as they moved.
verses.textEn: As they moved, they would go in any one of the four directions the creatures faced; the wheels did not change direction as the creatures went.

verses.textZh: 灵往哪里去，活物就往哪里去，轮子也随着牠们升起，因为活物的灵是在轮子里面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 灵往哪里去，活物就往哪里去，轮子也随着牠们升起，因为活物的灵是在轮子里面。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于轮辋，高而可畏；四个轮辋周围满有眼睛。
verses.textEnNiv: Their rims were high and awesome, and all four rims were full of eyes all around.
verses.textEnEsv: And their rims were tall and awesome, and the rims of all four were full of eyes all around.
verses.textEnNkjv: As for their rims, they were so high they were awesome; and their rims were full of eyes, all around the four of them.
verses.textEnNlt: The rims of the four wheels were tall and frightening, and they were covered with eyes all around.
verses.textEnNasb: As for their rims, they were high and awesome, and the rims of all four of them were covered with eyes all around.
verses.textEn: Their rims were high and awesome, and all four rims were full of eyes all around.

verses.textZh: 活物走动，轮子也随着移动；活物站着不动，轮子也不动；活物从地上升起，轮子也随着升起，因为活物的灵是在轮子里面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 活物走动，轮子也随着移动；活物站着不动，轮子也不动；活物从地上升起，轮子也随着升起，因为活物的灵是在轮子里面。
verses.textZhCuv: 活物行走，轮也在旁边行走；活物从地上升，轮也都上升。
verses.textEnNiv: When the living creatures moved, the wheels beside them moved; and when the living creatures rose from the ground, the wheels also rose.
verses.textEnEsv: And when the living creatures went, the wheels went beside them; and when the living creatures rose from the earth, the wheels rose.
verses.textEnNkjv: When the living creatures went, the wheels went beside them; and when the living creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.
verses.textEnNlt: When the living beings moved, the wheels moved with them. When they flew upward, the wheels went up, too.
verses.textEnNasb: Whenever the living beings moved, the wheels moved with them. And whenever the living beings rose from the earth, the wheels rose also.
verses.textEn: When the living creatures moved, the wheels beside them moved; and when the living creatures rose from the ground, the wheels also rose.

verses.textZh: 在活物的头顶上面，有穹苍的形状，好象闪耀的水晶，十分可畏，在活物的头顶上面张开。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在活物的头顶上面，有穹苍的形状，好象闪耀的水晶，十分可畏，在活物的头顶上面张开。
verses.textZhCuv: 灵往哪里去，活物就往那里去；活物上升，轮也在活物旁边上升，因为活物的灵在轮中。
verses.textEnNiv: Wherever the spirit would go, they would go, and the wheels would rise along with them, because the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.
verses.textEnEsv: Wherever the spirit wanted to go, they went, and the wheels rose along with them, for the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.
verses.textEnNkjv: Wherever the spirit wanted to go, they went, because there the spirit went; and the wheels were lifted together with them, for the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.
verses.textEnNlt: The spirit of the living beings was in the wheels. So wherever the spirit went, the wheels and the living beings also went.
verses.textEnNasb: Wherever the spirit was about to go, they would go in that direction . And the wheels rose just as they did; for the spirit of the living beings was in the wheels.
verses.textEn: Wherever the spirit would go, they would go, and the wheels would rise along with them, because the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.

verses.textZh: 在穹苍下面，活物的翅膀伸直张开，互相接触；各自用两个翅膀遮蔽身体。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在穹苍下面，活物的翅膀伸直张开，互相接触；各自用两个翅膀遮蔽身体。
verses.textZhCuv: 那些行走，这些也行走；那些站住，这些也站住；那些从地上升，轮也在旁边上升，因为活物的灵在轮中。
verses.textEnNiv: When the creatures moved, they also moved; when the creatures stood still, they also stood still; and when the creatures rose from the ground, the wheels rose along with them, because the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.
verses.textEnEsv: When those went, these went; and when those stood, these stood; and when those rose from the earth, the wheels rose along with them, for the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.
verses.textEnNkjv: When those went, these went; when those stood, these stood; and when those were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up together with them, for the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.
verses.textEnNlt: When the beings moved, the wheels moved. When the beings stopped, the wheels stopped. When the beings flew upward, the wheels rose up, for the spirit of the living beings was in the wheels.
verses.textEnNasb: Whenever those went, they went; and whenever those stopped, they stopped. And whenever those rose from the earth, the wheels rose just as they did; for the spirit of the living beings was in the wheels.
verses.textEn: When the creatures moved, they also moved; when the creatures stood still, they also stood still; and when the creatures rose from the ground, the wheels rose along with them, because the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.

verses.textZh: 活物走动的时候，我听见牠们翅膀的响声，像洪水的声音，也像全能者的声音，又像军队喧嚷的声音。牠们站着不动的时候，翅膀就垂下来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 活物走动的时候，我听见牠们翅膀的响声，像洪水的声音，也像全能者的声音，又像军队喧嚷的声音。牠们站着不动的时候，翅膀就垂下来。
verses.textZhCuv: 活物的头以上有穹苍的形象，看着像可畏的水晶，铺张在活物的头以上。
verses.textEnNiv: Spread out above the heads of the living creatures was what looked something like a vault, sparkling like crystal, and awesome.
verses.textEnEsv: Over the heads of the living creatures there was the likeness of an expanse, shining like awe-inspiring crystal, spread out above their heads.
verses.textEnNkjv: The likeness of the firmament above the heads of the living creatures was like the color of an awesome crystal, stretched out over their heads.
verses.textEnNlt: Spread out above them was a surface like the sky, glittering like crystal.
verses.textEnNasb: Now over the heads of the living beings there was something like an expanse, like the awesome gleam of crystal, spread out over their heads.
verses.textEn: Spread out above the heads of the living creatures was what looked something like a vault, sparkling like crystal, and awesome.

verses.textZh: 有声音从牠们头顶上面的穹苍发出来；牠们站着不动的时候，翅膀就垂下来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有声音从牠们头顶上面的穹苍发出来；牠们站着不动的时候，翅膀就垂下来。
verses.textZhCuv: 穹苍以下，活物的翅膀直张，彼此相对；每活物有两个翅膀遮体。
verses.textEnNiv: Under the vault their wings were stretched out one toward the other, and each had two wings covering its body.
verses.textEnEsv: And under the expanse their wings were stretched out straight, one toward another. And each creature had two wings covering its body.
verses.textEnNkjv: And under the firmament their wings spreadout straight, one toward another. Each one had two which covered one side, and each one had two which covered the other side of the body.
verses.textEnNlt: Beneath this surface the wings of each living being stretched out to touch the others’ wings, and each had two wings covering its body.
verses.textEnNasb: Under the expanse their wings were stretched out straight, one toward the other; each one also had two wings covering its body on the one side and on the other.
verses.textEn: Under the vault their wings were stretched out one toward the other, and each had two wings covering its body.

verses.textZh: 在牠们头顶的穹苍上面，有宝座的形状，好象蓝宝石的样子。在宝座的形象上面，有一个样子像人的形象。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在牠们头顶的穹苍上面，有宝座的形状，好象蓝宝石的样子。在宝座的形象上面，有一个样子像人的形象。
verses.textZhCuv: 活物行走的时候，我听见翅膀的响声，像大水的声音，像全能者的声音，也像军队哄嚷的声音。活物站住的时候，便将翅膀垂下。
verses.textEnNiv: When the creatures moved, I heard the sound of their wings, like the roar of rushing waters, like the voice of the Almighty, like the tumult of an army. When they stood still, they lowered their wings.
verses.textEnEsv: And when they went, I heard the sound of their wings like the sound of many waters, like the sound of the Almighty, a sound of tumult like the sound of an army. When they stood still, they let down their wings.
verses.textEnNkjv: When they went, I heard the noise of their wings, like the noise of many waters, like the voice of the Almighty, a tumult like the noise of an army; and when they stood still, they let down their wings.
verses.textEnNlt: As they flew, their wings sounded to me like waves crashing against the shore or like the voice of the Almighty or like the shouting of a mighty army. When they stopped, they let down their wings.
verses.textEnNasb: And I also heard the sound of their wings, like the sound of abundant waters as they went, like the voice of the Almighty, a sound of a crowd like the sound of an army camp; whenever they stopped, they let down their wings.
verses.textEn: When the creatures moved, I heard the sound of their wings, like the roar of rushing waters, like the voice of the Almighty, like the tumult of an army. When they stood still, they lowered their wings.

verses.textZh: 我看见在那仿佛是他腰部以上，好象闪耀的金属，又好象有火四面包围。在那仿佛是他腰部以下，我又看见好象有火，光芒环绕着他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我看见在那仿佛是他腰部以上，好象闪耀的金属，又好象有火四面包围。在那仿佛是他腰部以下，我又看见好象有火，光芒环绕着他。
verses.textZhCuv: 在他们头以上的穹苍之上有声音。他们站住的时候，便将翅膀垂下。
verses.textEnNiv: Then there came a voice from above the vault over their heads as they stood with lowered wings.
verses.textEnEsv: And there came a voice from above the expanse over their heads. When they stood still, they let down their wings.
verses.textEnNkjv: A voice came from above the firmament that was over their heads; whenever they stood, they let down their wings.
verses.textEnNlt: As they stood with wings lowered, a voice spoke from beyond the crystal surface above them.
verses.textEnNasb: And a voice came from above the expanse that was over their heads; whenever they stood still, they let down their wings.
verses.textEn: Then there came a voice from above the vault over their heads as they stood with lowered wings.

verses.textZh: 下雨的日子，云中彩虹的样子怎样，环绕他的光芒的样子也怎样。这就是耶和华荣耀的形状的样子。我一看见，就俯伏在地上，跟着听见有说话的声音。
verses.textZhCnvs: 下雨的日子，云中彩虹的样子怎样，环绕他的光芒的样子也怎样。这就是耶和华荣耀的形状的样子。我一看见，就俯伏在地上，跟着听见有说话的声音。
verses.textZhCuv: 在他们头以上的穹苍之上有宝座的形象，仿佛蓝宝石；在宝座形象以上有仿佛人的形状。
verses.textEnNiv: Above the vault over their heads was what looked like a throne of lapis lazuli, and high above on the throne was a figure like that of a man.
verses.textEnEsv: And above the expanse over their heads there was the likeness of a throne, in appearance like sapphire; and seated above the likeness of a throne was a likeness with a human appearance.
verses.textEnNkjv: And above the firmament over their heads was the likeness of a throne, in appearance like a sapphire stone; on the likeness of the throne was a likeness with the appearance of a man high above it.
verses.textEnNlt: Above this surface was something that looked like a throne made of blue lapis lazuli. And on this throne high above was a figure whose appearance resembled a man.
verses.textEnNasb: Now above the expanse that was over their heads there was something resembling a throne, like lapis lazuli in appearance; and on that which resembled a throne, high up, was a figure with the appearance of a man.
verses.textEn: Above the vault over their heads was what looked like a throne of lapis lazuli, and high above on the throne was a figure like that of a man.

verses.textZh: 我见从他腰以上有仿佛光耀的精金，周围都有火的形状，又见从他腰以下有仿佛火的形状，周围也有光辉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我见从他腰以上有仿佛光耀的精金，周围都有火的形状，又见从他腰以下有仿佛火的形状，周围也有光辉。
verses.textZhCuv: 我见从他腰以上有仿佛光耀的精金，周围都有火的形状，又见从他腰以下有仿佛火的形状，周围也有光辉。
verses.textEnNiv: I saw that from what appeared to be his waist up he looked like glowing metal, as if full of fire, and that from there down he looked like fire; and brilliant light surrounded him.
verses.textEnEsv: And upward from what had the appearance of his waist I saw as it were gleaming metal, like the appearance of fire enclosed all around. And downward from what had the appearance of his waist I saw as it were the appearance of fire, and there was brightness around him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also from the appearance of His waist and upward I saw, as it were, the color of amber with the appearance of fire all around within it; and from the appearance of His waist and downward I saw, as it were, the appearance of fire with brightness all around.
verses.textEnNlt: From what appeared to be his waist up, he looked like gleaming amber, flickering like a fire. And from his waist down, he looked like a burning flame, shining with splendor.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I noticed from the appearance of His waist and upward something like gleaming metal that looked like fire all around within it, and from the appearance of His waist and downward I saw something like fire; and there was a radiance around Him.
verses.textEn: I saw that from what appeared to be his waist up he looked like glowing metal, as if full of fire, and that from there down he looked like fire; and brilliant light surrounded him.

verses.textZh: 下雨的日子，云中虹的形状怎样，周围光辉的形状也是怎样。 这就是耶和华荣耀的形象。我一看见就俯伏在地，又听见一位说话的声音。
verses.textZhCnvs: 下雨的日子，云中虹的形状怎样，周围光辉的形状也是怎样。 这就是耶和华荣耀的形象。我一看见就俯伏在地，又听见一位说话的声音。
verses.textZhCuv: 下雨的日子，云中虹的形状怎样，周围光辉的形状也是怎样。 这就是耶和华荣耀的形象。我一看见就俯伏在地，又听见一位说话的声音。
verses.textEnNiv: Like the appearance of a rainbow in the clouds on a rainy day, so was the radiance around him. This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the Lord . When I saw it, I fell facedown, and I heard the voice of one speaking.
verses.textEnEsv: Like the appearance of the bow that is in the cloud on the day of rain, so was the appearance of the brightness all around. Such was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the Lord . And when I saw it, I fell on my face, and I heard the voice of one speaking.
verses.textEnNkjv: Like the appearance of a rainbow in a cloud on a rainy day, so was the appearance of the brightness all around it. This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the Lord. So when I saw it, I fell on my face, and I heard a voice of One speaking.
verses.textEnNlt: All around him was a glowing halo, like a rainbow shining in the clouds on a rainy day. This is what the glory of the Lord looked like to me. When I saw it, I fell face down on the ground, and I heard someone’s voice speaking to me.
verses.textEnNasb: Like the appearance of the rainbow in the clouds on a rainy day, so was the appearance of the surrounding radiance. Such was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the Lord. And when I saw it, I fell on my face and heard a voice speaking.
verses.textEn: Like the appearance of a rainbow in the clouds on a rainy day, so was the radiance around him. This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the Lord . When I saw it, I fell facedown, and I heard the voice of one speaking.

verses.textZh: 他对我说："人子啊！站起来，我要跟你说话。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他对我说："人子啊！站起来，我要跟你说话。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他对我说：「人子啊，你站起来，我要和你说话。」
verses.textEnNiv: He said to me, "Son of man, stand up on your feet and I will speak to you."
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to me, "Son of man, stand on your feet, and I will speak with you."
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said to me, "Son of man, stand on your feet, and I will speak to you."
verses.textEnNlt: "Stand up, son of man," said the voice. "I want to speak with you."
verses.textEnNasb: Then He said to me, "Son of man, stand on your feet, and I will speak with you."
verses.textEn: He said to me, "Son of man, stand up on your feet and I will speak to you."

verses.textZh: 他对我说话的时候，灵就进到我里面，使我站立起来；我又听见对我说话的声音。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他对我说话的时候，灵就进到我里面，使我站立起来；我又听见对我说话的声音。
verses.textZhCuv: 他对我说话的时候，灵就进入我里面，使我站起来，我便听见那位对我说话的声音。
verses.textEnNiv: As he spoke, the Spirit came into me and raised me to my feet, and I heard him speaking to me.
verses.textEnEsv: And as he spoke to me, the Spirit entered into me and set me on my feet, and I heard him speaking to me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Spirit entered me when He spoke to me, and set me on my feet; and I heard Him who spoke to me.
verses.textEnNlt: The Spirit came into me as he spoke, and he set me on my feet. I listened carefully to his words.
verses.textEnNasb: And as He spoke to me the Spirit entered me and set me on my feet; and I heard Him speaking to me.
verses.textEn: As he spoke, the Spirit came into me and raised me to my feet, and I heard him speaking to me.

verses.textZh: 他对我说："人子啊！我差派你到以色列人那里去，就是到那背叛我的叛逆国民那里去！他们和他们的列祖都得罪了我，直到今日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他对我说："人子啊！我差派你到以色列人那里去，就是到那背叛我的叛逆国民那里去！他们和他们的列祖都得罪了我，直到今日。
verses.textZhCuv: 他对我说：「人子啊，我差你往悖逆的国民以色列人那里去。他们是悖逆我的，他们和他们的列祖违背我，直到今日。
verses.textEnNiv: He said: "Son of man, I am sending you to the Israelites, to a rebellious nation that has rebelled against me; they and their ancestors have been in revolt against me to this very day.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to me, "Son of man, I send you to the people of Israel, to nations of rebels, who have rebelled against me. They and their fathers have transgressed against me to this very day.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said to me: "Son of man, I am sending you to the children of Israel, to a rebellious nation that has rebelled against Me; they and their fathers have transgressed against Me to this very day.
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man," he said, "I am sending you to the nation of Israel, a rebellious nation that has rebelled against me. They and their ancestors have been rebelling against me to this very day.
verses.textEnNasb: Then He said to me, "Son of man, I am sending you to the sons of Israel, to a rebellious people who have rebelled against Me; they and their fathers have revolted against Me to this very day.
verses.textEn: He said: "Son of man, I am sending you to the Israelites, to a rebellious nation that has rebelled against me; they and their ancestors have been in revolt against me to this very day.

verses.textZh: 这人民十分顽固，心里刚硬，我差派你到他们那里去。你要对他们说：‘主耶和华这样说。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 这人民十分顽固，心里刚硬，我差派你到他们那里去。你要对他们说：‘主耶和华这样说。’
verses.textZhCuv: 这众子面无羞耻，心里刚硬。我差你往他们那里去，你要对他们说：主耶和华如此说。
verses.textEnNiv: The people to whom I am sending you are obstinate and stubborn. Say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says.’
verses.textEnEsv: The descendants also are impudent and stubborn: I send you to them, and you shall say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord God .’
verses.textEnNkjv: For theyare impudent and stubborn children. I am sending you to them, and you shall say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord God.’
verses.textEnNlt: They are a stubborn and hard-hearted people. But I am sending you to say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says!’
verses.textEnNasb: So I am sending you to those who are impudent and obstinate children, and you shall say to them, ‘This is what the Lord God says:’
verses.textEn: The people to whom I am sending you are obstinate and stubborn. Say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says.’

verses.textZh: 他们或听或不听 ，也必知道在他们中间有一位先知。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们或听或不听 ，也必知道在他们中间有一位先知。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们或听，或不听，（他们是悖逆之家），必知道在他们中间有了先知。
verses.textEnNiv: And whether they listen or fail to listen—for they are a rebellious people—they will know that a prophet has been among them.
verses.textEnEsv: And whether they hear or refuse to hear (for they are a rebellious house) they will know that a prophet has been among them.
verses.textEnNkjv: As for them, whether they hear or whether they refuse—for they are a rebellious house—yet they will know that a prophet has been among them.
verses.textEnNlt: And whether they listen or refuse to listen—for remember, they are rebels—at least they will know they have had a prophet among them.
verses.textEnNasb: As for them, whether they listen or not—for they are a rebellious house—they will know that a prophet has been among them.
verses.textEn: And whether they listen or fail to listen—for they are a rebellious people—they will know that a prophet has been among them.

verses.textZh: "人子啊！至于你，虽然荆棘和蒺藜在你周围，你又住在蝎子群中，你不要怕他们，也不要怕他们讲的话。他们原是叛逆的民族，你总不要怕他们讲的话，在他们面前，也不要惊惶。
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！至于你，虽然荆棘和蒺藜在你周围，你又住在蝎子群中，你不要怕他们，也不要怕他们讲的话。他们原是叛逆的民族，你总不要怕他们讲的话，在他们面前，也不要惊惶。
verses.textZhCuv: 人子啊，虽有荆棘和蒺藜在你那里，你又住在蝎子中间，总不要怕他们，也不要怕他们的话；他们虽是悖逆之家，还不要怕他们的话，也不要因他们的脸色惊惶。
verses.textEnNiv: And you, son of man, do not be afraid of them or their words. Do not be afraid, though briers and thorns are all around you and you live among scorpions. Do not be afraid of what they say or be terrified by them, though they are a rebellious people.
verses.textEnEsv: And you, son of man, be not afraid of them, nor be afraid of their words, though briers and thorns are with you and you sit on scorpions. Be not afraid of their words, nor be dismayed at their looks, for they are a rebellious house.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And you, son of man, do not be afraid of them nor be afraid of their words, though briers and thorns are with you and you dwell among scorpions; do not be afraid of their words or dismayed by their looks, though they are a rebellious house.
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, do not fear them or their words. Don’t be afraid even though their threats surround you like nettles and briers and stinging scorpions. Do not be dismayed by their dark scowls, even though they are rebels.
verses.textEnNasb: And as for you, son of man, you are not to fear them nor fear their words, though thistles and thorns are with you and you sit on scorpions; you are not to fear their words nor be dismayed at their presence, since they are a rebellious house.
verses.textEn: And you, son of man, do not be afraid of them or their words. Do not be afraid, though briers and thorns are all around you and you live among scorpions. Do not be afraid of what they say or be terrified by them, though they are a rebellious people.

verses.textZh: 他们或听或不听，你只要把我的话告诉他们，他们原是叛逆的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们或听或不听，你只要把我的话告诉他们，他们原是叛逆的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们或听，或不听，你只管将我的话告诉他们；他们是极其悖逆的。
verses.textEnNiv: You must speak my words to them, whether they listen or fail to listen, for they are rebellious.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall speak my words to them, whether they hear or refuse to hear, for they are a rebellious house.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall speak My words to them, whether they hear or whether they refuse, for they are rebellious.
verses.textEnNlt: You must give them my messages whether they listen or not. But they won’t listen, for they are completely rebellious!
verses.textEnNasb: But you shall speak My words to them whether they listen or not, for they are rebellious.
verses.textEn: You must speak my words to them, whether they listen or fail to listen, for they are rebellious.

verses.textZh: "人子啊！至于你，你要听我对你讲的话。不要叛逆我，像那叛逆的民族一样。张开你的口，把我赐给你的吃下去！"
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！至于你，你要听我对你讲的话。不要叛逆我，像那叛逆的民族一样。张开你的口，把我赐给你的吃下去！"
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，要听我对你所说的话，不要悖逆像那悖逆之家，你要开口吃我所赐给你的。」
verses.textEnNiv: But you, son of man, listen to what I say to you. Do not rebel like that rebellious people; open your mouth and eat what I give you."
verses.textEnEsv: "But you, son of man, hear what I say to you. Be not rebellious like that rebellious house; open your mouth and eat what I give you."
verses.textEnNkjv: But you, son of man, hear what I say to you. Do not be rebellious like that rebellious house; open your mouth and eat what I give you."
verses.textEnNlt: Son of man, listen to what I say to you. Do not join them in their rebellion. Open your mouth, and eat what I give you."
verses.textEnNasb: "Now you, son of man, listen to what I am speaking to you; do not be rebellious like that rebellious house. Open your mouth wide and eat what I am giving you."
verses.textEn: But you, son of man, listen to what I say to you. Do not rebel like that rebellious people; open your mouth and eat what I give you."

verses.textZh: 我观看，看见一只手向我伸过来，手中有一卷书卷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我观看，看见一只手向我伸过来，手中有一卷书卷。
verses.textZhCuv: 我观看，见有一只手向我伸出来，手中有一书卷。
verses.textEnNiv: Then I looked, and I saw a hand stretched out to me. In it was a scroll,
verses.textEnEsv: And when I looked, behold, a hand was stretched out to me, and behold, a scroll of a book was in it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when I looked, there was a hand stretched out to me; and behold, a scroll of a book was in it.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I looked and saw a hand reaching out to me. It held a scroll,
verses.textEnNasb: Then I looked, and behold, a hand was extended to me; and behold, a scroll was in it.
verses.textEn: Then I looked, and I saw a hand stretched out to me. In it was a scroll,

verses.textZh: 他把书卷在我面前展开，书卷内外都写上字，写的是哀歌、悲叹和灾祸。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把书卷在我面前展开，书卷内外都写上字，写的是哀歌、悲叹和灾祸。
verses.textZhCuv: 他将书卷在我面前展开，内外都写着字，其上所写的有哀号、叹息、悲痛的话。
verses.textEnNiv: which he unrolled before me. On both sides of it were written words of lament and mourning and woe.
verses.textEnEsv: And he spread it before me. And it had writing on the front and on the back, and there were written on it words of lamentation and mourning and woe.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He spread it before me; and therewas writing on the inside and on the outside, and written on it were lamentations and mourning and woe.
verses.textEnNlt: which he unrolled. And I saw that both sides were covered with funeral songs, words of sorrow, and pronouncements of doom.
verses.textEnNasb: When He spread it out before me, it was written on the front and back, and written on it were songs of mourning, sighing, and woe.
verses.textEn: which he unrolled before me. On both sides of it were written words of lament and mourning and woe.

verses.textZh: 他对我说："人子啊，把你得到的吃下去吧！吃下这书卷，然后去向以色列家说话。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他对我说："人子啊，把你得到的吃下去吧！吃下这书卷，然后去向以色列家说话。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他对我说：「人子啊，要吃你所得的，要吃这书卷，好去对以色列家讲说。」
verses.textEnNiv: And he said to me, "Son of man, eat what is before you, eat this scroll; then go and speak to the people of Israel."
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to me, "Son of man, eat whatever you find here. Eat this scroll, and go, speak to the house of Israel."
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover He said to me, "Son of man, eat what you find; eat this scroll, and go, speak to the house of Israel."
verses.textEnNlt: The voice said to me, "Son of man, eat what I am giving you—eat this scroll! Then go and give its message to the people of Israel."
verses.textEnNasb: Then He said to me, "Son of man, eat what you find; eat this scroll, and go, speak to the house of Israel."
verses.textEn: And he said to me, "Son of man, eat what is before you, eat this scroll; then go and speak to the people of Israel."

verses.textZh: 于是我把口张开，他就给我吃下那书卷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是我把口张开，他就给我吃下那书卷。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是我开口，他就使我吃这书卷，
verses.textEnNiv: So I opened my mouth, and he gave me the scroll to eat.
verses.textEnEsv: So I opened my mouth, and he gave me this scroll to eat.
verses.textEnNkjv: So I opened my mouth, and He caused me to eat that scroll.
verses.textEnNlt: So I opened my mouth, and he fed me the scroll.
verses.textEnNasb: So I opened my mouth, and He fed me this scroll.
verses.textEn: So I opened my mouth, and he gave me the scroll to eat.

verses.textZh: 他又对我说："人子啊！把我赐给你的那书卷吃下去，填满你的肚子。"于是我吃了，这书卷在我口里像蜜糖一样甘甜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又对我说："人子啊！把我赐给你的那书卷吃下去，填满你的肚子。"于是我吃了，这书卷在我口里像蜜糖一样甘甜。
verses.textZhCuv: 又对我说：「人子啊，要吃我所赐给你的这书卷，充满你的肚腹。」我就吃了，口中觉得其甜如蜜。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he said to me, "Son of man, eat this scroll I am giving you and fill your stomach with it." So I ate it, and it tasted as sweet as honey in my mouth.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to me, "Son of man, feed your belly with this scroll that I give you and fill your stomach with it." Then I ate it, and it was in my mouth as sweet as honey.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said to me, "Son of man, feed your belly, and fill your stomach with this scroll that I give you." So I ate, and it was in my mouth like honey in sweetness.
verses.textEnNlt: "Fill your stomach with this," he said. And when I ate it, it tasted as sweet as honey in my mouth.
verses.textEnNasb: And He said to me, "Son of man, feed your stomach and fill your body with this scroll which I am giving you." Then I ate it, and it was as sweet as honey in my mouth.
verses.textEn: Then he said to me, "Son of man, eat this scroll I am giving you and fill your stomach with it." So I ate it, and it tasted as sweet as honey in my mouth.

verses.textZh: 他对我说："人子啊，你去！到以色列家那里，把我的话告诉他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他对我说："人子啊，你去！到以色列家那里，把我的话告诉他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 他对我说：「人子啊，你往以色列家那里去，将我的话对他们讲说。
verses.textEnNiv: He then said to me: "Son of man, go now to the people of Israel and speak my words to them.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to me, "Son of man, go to the house of Israel and speak with my words to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He said to me: "Son of man, go to the house of Israel and speak with My words to them.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he said, "Son of man, go to the people of Israel and give them my messages.
verses.textEnNasb: Then He said to me, "Son of man, go to the house of Israel and speak with My words to them.
verses.textEn: He then said to me: "Son of man, go now to the people of Israel and speak my words to them.

verses.textZh: 你受差派不是到一个说话难明、言语难懂的民族那里去，而是到以色列家去；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你受差派不是到一个说话难明、言语难懂的民族那里去，而是到以色列家去；
verses.textZhCuv: 你奉差遣不是往那说话深奥、言语难懂的民那里去，乃是往以色列家去；
verses.textEnNiv: You are not being sent to a people of obscure speech and strange language, but to the people of Israel—
verses.textEnEsv: For you are not sent to a people of foreign speech and a hard language, but to the house of Israel—
verses.textEnNkjv: For you are not sent to a people of unfamiliar speech and of hard language, but to the house of Israel,
verses.textEnNlt: I am not sending you to a foreign people whose language you cannot understand.
verses.textEnNasb: For you are not being sent to a people of unintelligible speech or difficult language, but to the house of Israel,
verses.textEn: You are not being sent to a people of obscure speech and strange language, but to the people of Israel—

verses.textZh: 不是到说话难明、言语难懂的众多民族那里去，他们的话是你听不懂的。但是，如果我差派你到他们那里去，他们必听从你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不是到说话难明、言语难懂的众多民族那里去，他们的话是你听不懂的。但是，如果我差派你到他们那里去，他们必听从你。
verses.textZhCuv: 不是往那说话深奥、言语难懂的多国去，他们的话语是你不懂得的。我若差你往他们那里去，他们必听从你。
verses.textEnNiv: not to many peoples of obscure speech and strange language, whose words you cannot understand. Surely if I had sent you to them, they would have listened to you.
verses.textEnEsv: not to many peoples of foreign speech and a hard language, whose words you cannot understand. Surely, if I sent you to such, they would listen to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: not to many people of unfamiliar speech and of hard language, whose words you cannot understand. Surely, had I sent you to them, they would have listened to you.
verses.textEnNlt: No, I am not sending you to people with strange and difficult speech. If I did, they would listen!
verses.textEnNasb: nor to many peoples of unintelligible speech or difficult language, whose words you cannot understand. But I have sent you to the people who understand you;
verses.textEn: not to many peoples of obscure speech and strange language, whose words you cannot understand. Surely if I had sent you to them, they would have listened to you.

verses.textZh: 以色列家却不肯听从你，因为他们不肯听从我，整个以色列家都是额坚心硬的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列家却不肯听从你，因为他们不肯听从我，整个以色列家都是额坚心硬的。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列家却不肯听从你，因为他们不肯听从我；原来以色列全家是额坚心硬的人。
verses.textEnNiv: But the people of Israel are not willing to listen to you because they are not willing to listen to me, for all the Israelites are hardened and obstinate.
verses.textEnEsv: But the house of Israel will not be willing to listen to you, for they are not willing to listen to me: because all the house of Israel have a hard forehead and a stubborn heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the house of Israel will not listen to you, because they will not listen to Me; for all the house of Israel are impudent and hard-hearted.
verses.textEnNlt: But the people of Israel won’t listen to you any more than they listen to me! For the whole lot of them are hard-hearted and stubborn.
verses.textEnNasb: yet the house of Israel will not be willing to listen to you, since they are not willing to listen to Me. The entire house of Israel certainly is stubborn and obstinate.
verses.textEn: But the people of Israel are not willing to listen to you because they are not willing to listen to me, for all the Israelites are hardened and obstinate.

verses.textZh: 看哪！我要使你的脸像他们的脸一样坚硬，使你的前额像他们的前额一样坚硬。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！我要使你的脸像他们的脸一样坚硬，使你的前额像他们的前额一样坚硬。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，我使你的脸硬过他们的脸，使你的额硬过他们的额。
verses.textEnNiv: But I will make you as unyielding and hardened as they are.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, I have made your face as hard as their faces, and your forehead as hard as their foreheads.
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, I have made your face strong against their faces, and your forehead strong against their foreheads.
verses.textEnNlt: But look, I have made you as obstinate and hard-hearted as they are.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, I have made your face just as hard as their faces, and your forehead just as hard as their foreheads.
verses.textEn: But I will make you as unyielding and hardened as they are.

verses.textZh: 我要使你的额好象最坚硬的宝石，比火石更硬。他们虽然是叛逆的民族，你却不要怕他们，在他们面前，也不要惊惶。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要使你的额好象最坚硬的宝石，比火石更硬。他们虽然是叛逆的民族，你却不要怕他们，在他们面前，也不要惊惶。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我使你的额像金钢钻，比火石更硬。他们虽是悖逆之家，你不要怕他们，也不要因他们的脸色惊惶。」
verses.textEnNiv: I will make your forehead like the hardest stone, harder than flint. Do not be afraid of them or terrified by them, though they are a rebellious people."
verses.textEnEsv: Like emery harder than flint have I made your forehead. Fear them not, nor be dismayed at their looks, for they are a rebellious house."
verses.textEnNkjv: Like adamant stone, harder than flint, I have made your forehead; do not be afraid of them, nor be dismayed at their looks, though they are a rebellious house."
verses.textEnNlt: I have made your forehead as hard as the hardest rock! So don’t be afraid of them or fear their angry looks, even though they are rebels."
verses.textEnNasb: Like emery harder than flint I have made your forehead. Do not be afraid of them or be dismayed before them, since they are a rebellious house."
verses.textEn: I will make your forehead like the hardest stone, harder than flint. Do not be afraid of them or terrified by them, though they are a rebellious people."

verses.textZh: 他又对我说："人子啊！我对你说的一切话，你都要留心听，记在心里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又对我说："人子啊！我对你说的一切话，你都要留心听，记在心里。
verses.textZhCuv: 他又对我说：「人子啊，我对你所说的一切话，要心里领会，耳中听闻。
verses.textEnNiv: And he said to me, "Son of man, listen carefully and take to heart all the words I speak to you.
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, he said to me, "Son of man, all my words that I shall speak to you receive in your heart, and hear with your ears.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover He said to me: "Son of man, receive into your heart all My words that I speak to you, and hear with your ears.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he added, "Son of man, let all my words sink deep into your own heart first. Listen to them carefully for yourself.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, He said to me, "Son of man, take into your heart all My words which I will speak to you and listen closely.
verses.textEn: And he said to me, "Son of man, listen carefully and take to heart all the words I speak to you.

verses.textZh: 你去，到被掳的人民那里，向他们宣讲；他们或听或不听，你只要对他们说：‘主耶和华这样说。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你去，到被掳的人民那里，向他们宣讲；他们或听或不听，你只要对他们说：‘主耶和华这样说。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 你往你本国被掳的子民那里去，他们或听，或不听，你要对他们讲说，告诉他们这是主耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: Go now to your people in exile and speak to them. Say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says,’ whether they listen or fail to listen."
verses.textEnEsv: And go to the exiles, to your people, and speak to them and say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord God ,’ whether they hear or refuse to hear."
verses.textEnNkjv: And go, get to the captives, to the children of your people, and speak to them and tell them, ‘Thus says the Lord God,’ whether they hear, or whether they refuse."
verses.textEnNlt: Then go to your people in exile and say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says!’ Do this whether they listen to you or not."
verses.textEnNasb: Go to the exiles, to the sons of your people, and speak to them and tell them, whether they listen or not, ‘This is what the Lord God says.’ "
verses.textEn: Go now to your people in exile and speak to them. Say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says,’ whether they listen or fail to listen."

verses.textZh: 那时，灵使我升起，我就听见后面有轰轰的响声："耶和华的居所显现出来的荣耀是应当称颂的！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，灵使我升起，我就听见后面有轰轰的响声："耶和华的居所显现出来的荣耀是应当称颂的！"
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，灵将我举起，我就听见在我身后有震动轰轰的声音，说：「从耶和华的所在显出来的荣耀是该称颂的！」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Spirit lifted me up, and I heard behind me a loud rumbling sound as the glory of the Lord rose from the place where it was standing.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Spirit lifted me up, and I heard behind me the voice of a great earthquake: "Blessed be the glory of the Lord from its place!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Spirit lifted me up, and I heard behind me a great thunderous voice: "Blessed is the glory of the Lord from His place!"
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Spirit lifted me up, and I heard a loud rumbling sound behind me. (May the glory of the Lord be praised in his place!)
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Spirit lifted me up, and I heard a great rumbling sound behind me: "Blessed be the glory of the Lord from His place!"
verses.textEn: Then the Spirit lifted me up, and I heard behind me a loud rumbling sound as the glory of the Lord rose from the place where it was standing.

verses.textZh: 我又听见那些活物的翅膀彼此相碰的声音和活物旁边的轮子的声音，以及轰轰的响声。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我又听见那些活物的翅膀彼此相碰的声音和活物旁边的轮子的声音，以及轰轰的响声。
verses.textZhCuv: 我又听见那活物翅膀相碰，与活物旁边轮子旋转震动轰轰的响声。
verses.textEnNiv: It was the sound of the wings of the living creatures brushing against each other and the sound of the wheels beside them, a loud rumbling sound.
verses.textEnEsv: It was the sound of the wings of the living creatures as they touched one another, and the sound of the wheels beside them, and the sound of a great earthquake.
verses.textEnNkjv: I also heard the noise of the wings of the living creatures that touched one another, and the noise of the wheels beside them, and a great thunderous noise.
verses.textEnNlt: It was the sound of the wings of the living beings as they brushed against each other and the rumbling of their wheels beneath them.
verses.textEnNasb: And I heard the sound of the wings of the living beings touching one another and the sound of the wheels beside them, even a great rumbling sound.
verses.textEn: It was the sound of the wings of the living creatures brushing against each other and the sound of the wheels beside them, a loud rumbling sound.

verses.textZh: 灵使我升起，把我提去。那时我心灵忿激、愁苦。耶和华的手强而有力临到我身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 灵使我升起，把我提去。那时我心灵忿激、愁苦。耶和华的手强而有力临到我身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是灵将我举起，带我而去。我心中甚苦，灵性忿激，并且耶和华的灵 在我身上大有能力。
verses.textEnNiv: The Spirit then lifted me up and took me away, and I went in bitterness and in the anger of my spirit, with the strong hand of the Lord on me.
verses.textEnEsv: The Spirit lifted me up and took me away, and I went in bitterness in the heat of my spirit, the hand of the Lord being strong upon me.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Spirit lifted me up and took me away, and I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; but the hand of the Lord was strong upon me.
verses.textEnNlt: The Spirit lifted me up and took me away. I went in bitterness and turmoil, but the Lord ’s hold on me was strong.
verses.textEnNasb: So the Spirit lifted me up and took me away; and I went embittered in the rage of my spirit, and the hand of the Lord was strong on me.
verses.textEn: The Spirit then lifted me up and took me away, and I went in bitterness and in the anger of my spirit, with the strong hand of the Lord on me.

verses.textZh: 于是我来到提勒．亚毕被掳的人那里，他们住在迦巴鲁河边。我在他们居住的地方坐了七天，在他们中间震惊得不知所措。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是我来到提勒．亚毕被掳的人那里，他们住在迦巴鲁河边。我在他们居住的地方坐了七天，在他们中间震惊得不知所措。
verses.textZhCuv: 我就来到提勒‧亚毕，住在迦巴鲁河边被掳的人那里，到他们所住的地方，在他们中间忧忧闷闷地坐了七日。
verses.textEnNiv: I came to the exiles who lived at Tel Aviv near the Kebar River. And there, where they were living, I sat among them for seven days—deeply distressed.
verses.textEnEsv: And I came to the exiles at Tel-abib, who were dwelling by the Chebar canal, and I sat where they were dwelling. And I sat there overwhelmed among them seven days.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I came to the captives at Tel Abib, who dwelt by the River Chebar; and I sat where they sat, and remained there astonished among them seven days.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I came to the colony of Judean exiles in Tel-abib, beside the Kebar River. I was overwhelmed and sat among them for seven days.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I came to the exiles who lived beside the river Chebar at Tel-abib, and I sat there for seven days where they were living, causing consternation among them.
verses.textEn: I came to the exiles who lived at Tel Aviv near the Kebar River. And there, where they were living, I sat among them for seven days—deeply distressed.

verses.textZh: 过了七天，耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 过了七天，耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 过了七日，耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: At the end of seven days the word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: And at the end of seven days, the word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass at the end of seven days that the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: After seven days the Lord gave me a message. He said,
verses.textEnNasb: Now at the end of seven days the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: At the end of seven days the word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: "人子啊，我立了你作以色列家守望的人，所以你要聆听我口中的话，替我警告他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊，我立了你作以色列家守望的人，所以你要聆听我口中的话，替我警告他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，我立你作以色列家守望的人，所以你要听我口中的话，替我警戒他们。
verses.textEnNiv: "Son of man, I have made you a watchman for the people of Israel; so hear the word I speak and give them warning from me.
verses.textEnEsv: "Son of man, I have made you a watchman for the house of Israel. Whenever you hear a word from my mouth, you shall give them warning from me.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Son of man, I have made you a watchman for the house of Israel; therefore hear a word from My mouth, and give them warning from Me:
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, I have appointed you as a watchman for Israel. Whenever you receive a message from me, warn people immediately.
verses.textEnNasb: "Son of man, I have appointed you as a watchman for the house of Israel; whenever you hear a word from My mouth, warn them from Me.
verses.textEn: "Son of man, I have made you a watchman for the people of Israel; so hear the word I speak and give them warning from me.

verses.textZh: 如果我对恶人说：‘你必定死亡！’你却不警告他，也不警戒他离开恶行，好救他的性命，这恶人就必因自己的罪孽死亡。但我要因他的死追究你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果我对恶人说：‘你必定死亡！’你却不警告他，也不警戒他离开恶行，好救他的性命，这恶人就必因自己的罪孽死亡。但我要因他的死追究你。
verses.textZhCuv: 我何时指着恶人说：他必要死；你若不警戒他，也不劝戒他，使他离开恶行，拯救他的性命，这恶人必死在罪孽之中；我却要向你讨他丧命的罪 。
verses.textEnNiv: When I say to a wicked person, ‘You will surely die,’ and you do not warn them or speak out to dissuade them from their evil ways in order to save their life, that wicked person will die for their sin, and I will hold you accountable for their blood.
verses.textEnEsv: If I say to the wicked, ‘You shall surely die,’ and you give him no warning, nor speak to warn the wicked from his wicked way, in order to save his life, that wicked person shall die for his iniquity, but his blood I will require at your hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: When I say to the wicked, ‘You shall surely die,’ and you give him no warning, nor speak to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life, that same wicked man shall die in his iniquity; but his blood I will require at your hand.
verses.textEnNlt: If I warn the wicked, saying, ‘You are under the penalty of death,’ but you fail to deliver the warning, they will die in their sins. And I will hold you responsible for their deaths.
verses.textEnNasb: When I say to the wicked, ‘You will certainly die,’ and you do not warn him or speak out to warn the wicked from his wicked way so that he may live, that wicked person shall die for wrongdoing, but his blood I will require from your hand.
verses.textEn: When I say to a wicked person, ‘You will surely die,’ and you do not warn them or speak out to dissuade them from their evil ways in order to save their life, that wicked person will die for their sin, and I will hold you accountable for their blood.

verses.textZh: 如果你警告恶人，他仍不离开他的罪恶和他的恶行，他就必因自己的罪孽死亡，你却救了自己的性命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你警告恶人，他仍不离开他的罪恶和他的恶行，他就必因自己的罪孽死亡，你却救了自己的性命。
verses.textZhCuv: 倘若你警戒恶人，他仍不转离罪恶，也不离开恶行，他必死在罪孽之中，你却救自己脱离了罪。
verses.textEnNiv: But if you do warn the wicked person and they do not turn from their wickedness or from their evil ways, they will die for their sin; but you will have saved yourself.
verses.textEnEsv: But if you warn the wicked, and he does not turn from his wickedness, or from his wicked way, he shall die for his iniquity, but you will have delivered your soul.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet, if you warn the wicked, and he does not turn from his wickedness, nor from his wicked way, he shall die in his iniquity; but you have delivered your soul.
verses.textEnNlt: If you warn them and they refuse to repent and keep on sinning, they will die in their sins. But you will have saved yourself because you obeyed me.
verses.textEnNasb: However if you have warned the wicked and he does not turn from his wickedness or from his wicked way, he shall die for wrongdoing, but you have saved yourself.
verses.textEn: But if you do warn the wicked person and they do not turn from their wickedness or from their evil ways, they will die for their sin; but you will have saved yourself.

verses.textZh: 如果义人偏离正义，行事邪恶，我必把绊脚石放在他面前，他必定死亡；因为你没有警告他，他必因自己的罪死亡。他素常所行的义，也必不被记念。但我要因他的死追究你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果义人偏离正义，行事邪恶，我必把绊脚石放在他面前，他必定死亡；因为你没有警告他，他必因自己的罪死亡。他素常所行的义，也必不被记念。但我要因他的死追究你。
verses.textZhCuv: 再者，义人何时离义而犯罪，我将绊脚石放在他面前，他就必死；因你没有警戒他，他必死在罪中，他素来所行的义不被记念；我却要向你讨他丧命的罪 。
verses.textEnNiv: "Again, when a righteous person turns from their righteousness and does evil, and I put a stumbling block before them, they will die. Since you did not warn them, they will die for their sin. The righteous things that person did will not be remembered, and I will hold you accountable for their blood.
verses.textEnEsv: Again, if a righteous person turns from his righteousness and commits injustice, and I lay a stumbling block before him, he shall die. Because you have not warned him, he shall die for his sin, and his righteous deeds that he has done shall not be remembered, but his blood I will require at your hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Again, when a righteous man turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity, and I lay a stumbling block before him, he shall die; because you did not give him warning, he shall die in his sin, and his righteousness which he has done shall not be remembered; but his blood I will require at your hand.
verses.textEnNlt: "If righteous people turn away from their righteous behavior and ignore the obstacles I put in their way, they will die. And if you do not warn them, they will die in their sins. None of their righteous acts will be remembered, and I will hold you responsible for their deaths.
verses.textEnNasb: Again, when a righteous person turns away from his righteousness and commits sin, and I place an obstacle before him, he will die; since you have not warned him, he shall die in his sin, and his righteous deeds which he has done shall not be remembered; but his blood I will require from your hand.
verses.textEn: "Again, when a righteous person turns from their righteousness and does evil, and I put a stumbling block before them, they will die. Since you did not warn them, they will die for their sin. The righteous things that person did will not be remembered, and I will hold you accountable for their blood.

verses.textZh: 如果你警告义人不要犯罪，他就不犯罪。他因为接受警告，就必存活，你也救了自己的性命。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你警告义人不要犯罪，他就不犯罪。他因为接受警告，就必存活，你也救了自己的性命。"
verses.textZhCuv: 倘若你警戒义人，使他不犯罪，他就不犯罪；他因受警戒就必存活，你也救自己脱离了罪。」
verses.textEnNiv: But if you do warn the righteous person not to sin and they do not sin, they will surely live because they took warning, and you will have saved yourself."
verses.textEnEsv: But if you warn the righteous person not to sin, and he does not sin, he shall surely live, because he took warning, and you will have delivered your soul."
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless if you warn the righteous man that the righteous should not sin, and he does not sin, he shall surely live because he took warning; also you will have delivered your soul."
verses.textEnNlt: But if you warn righteous people not to sin and they listen to you and do not sin, they will live, and you will have saved yourself, too."
verses.textEnNasb: However, if you have warned the righteous person that the righteous is not to sin, and he does not sin, he shall certainly live because he took warning; and you have saved yourself."
verses.textEn: But if you do warn the righteous person not to sin and they do not sin, they will surely live because they took warning, and you will have saved yourself."

verses.textZh: 耶和华的手在那里临到我身上，他对我说："你起来，出到平原去，在那里我要向你说话。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的手在那里临到我身上，他对我说："你起来，出到平原去，在那里我要向你说话。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的灵 在那里降在我身上。他对我说：「你起来往平原去，我要在那里和你说话。」
verses.textEnNiv: The hand of the Lord was on me there, and he said to me, "Get up and go out to the plain, and there I will speak to you."
verses.textEnEsv: And the hand of the Lord was upon me there. And he said to me, "Arise, go out into the valley, and there I will speak with you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the hand of the Lord was upon me there, and He said to me, "Arise, go out into the plain, and there I shall talk with you."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord took hold of me and said, "Get up and go out into the valley, and I will speak to you there."
verses.textEnNasb: Now the hand of the Lord was on me there, and He said to me, "Get up, go out to the plain, and there I will speak to you."
verses.textEn: The hand of the Lord was on me there, and he said to me, "Get up and go out to the plain, and there I will speak to you."

verses.textZh: 于是，我起来，出到平原去，看见耶和华的荣耀停在那里，这荣耀就像我在迦巴鲁河边看见的一样。于是我俯伏在地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，我起来，出到平原去，看见耶和华的荣耀停在那里，这荣耀就像我在迦巴鲁河边看见的一样。于是我俯伏在地。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是我起来往平原去，不料，耶和华的荣耀正如我在迦巴鲁河边所见的一样，停在那里，我就俯伏于地。
verses.textEnNiv: So I got up and went out to the plain. And the glory of the Lord was standing there, like the glory I had seen by the Kebar River, and I fell facedown.
verses.textEnEsv: So I arose and went out into the valley, and behold, the glory of the Lord stood there, like the glory that I had seen by the Chebar canal, and I fell on my face.
verses.textEnNkjv: So I arose and went out into the plain, and behold, the glory of the Lord stood there, like the glory which I saw by the River Chebar; and I fell on my face.
verses.textEnNlt: So I got up and went, and there I saw the glory of the Lord , just as I had seen in my first vision by the Kebar River. And I fell face down on the ground.
verses.textEnNasb: So I got up and went out to the plain; and behold, the glory of the Lord was standing there, like the glory that I saw by the river Chebar, and I fell on my face.
verses.textEn: So I got up and went out to the plain. And the glory of the Lord was standing there, like the glory I had seen by the Kebar River, and I fell facedown.

verses.textZh: 灵进到我里面，使我站立起来，耶和华对我说："你进去，把自己关在家里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 灵进到我里面，使我站立起来，耶和华对我说："你进去，把自己关在家里。
verses.textZhCuv: 灵就进入我里面，使我站起来。耶和华对我说：「你进房屋去，将门关上。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Spirit came into me and raised me to my feet. He spoke to me and said: "Go, shut yourself inside your house.
verses.textEnEsv: But the Spirit entered into me and set me on my feet, and he spoke with me and said to me, "Go, shut yourself within your house.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Spirit entered me and set me on my feet, and spoke with me and said to me: "Go, shut yourself inside your house.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Spirit came into me and set me on my feet. He spoke to me and said, "Go to your house and shut yourself in.
verses.textEnNasb: But the Spirit entered me and set me up on my feet; and He spoke with me and said to me, "Go, shut yourself inside your house.
verses.textEn: Then the Spirit came into me and raised me to my feet. He spoke to me and said: "Go, shut yourself inside your house.

verses.textZh: 人子啊！人要用绳子把你捆绑起来，使你不能出到他们中间去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人子啊！人要用绳子把你捆绑起来，使你不能出到他们中间去。
verses.textZhCuv: 人子啊，人必用绳索捆绑你，你就不能出去在他们中间来往。
verses.textEnNiv: And you, son of man, they will tie with ropes; you will be bound so that you cannot go out among the people.
verses.textEnEsv: And you, O son of man, behold, cords will be placed upon you, and you shall be bound with them, so that you cannot go out among the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you, O son of man, surely they will put ropes on you and bind you with them, so that you cannot go out among them.
verses.textEnNlt: There, son of man, you will be tied with ropes so you cannot go out among the people.
verses.textEnNasb: And as for you, son of man, they will put ropes around you and bind you with them so that you do not go out among them.
verses.textEn: And you, son of man, they will tie with ropes; you will be bound so that you cannot go out among the people.

verses.textZh: 我要使你的舌头贴住上膛，使你变成哑巴，不能作责备他们的人，因为他们是叛逆的民族。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要使你的舌头贴住上膛，使你变成哑巴，不能作责备他们的人，因为他们是叛逆的民族。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必使你的舌头贴住上膛，以致你哑口，不能作责备他们的人；他们原是悖逆之家。
verses.textEnNiv: I will make your tongue stick to the roof of your mouth so that you will be silent and unable to rebuke them, for they are a rebellious people.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will make your tongue cling to the roof of your mouth, so that you shall be mute and unable to reprove them, for they are a rebellious house.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will make your tongue cling to the roof of your mouth, so that you shall be mute and not be one to rebuke them, for they are a rebellious house.
verses.textEnNlt: And I will make your tongue stick to the roof of your mouth so that you will be speechless and unable to rebuke them, for they are rebels.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, I will make your tongue stick to the roof of your mouth so that you will be unable to speak and will not be a man who reprimands them, since they are a rebellious house.
verses.textEn: I will make your tongue stick to the roof of your mouth so that you will be silent and unable to rebuke them, for they are a rebellious people.

verses.textZh: 但我对你说话的时候，我必开你的口，你就要对他们说：‘主耶和华这样说。’肯听的就让他听，不肯听的，就由他不听吧，因为他们是叛逆的民族。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但我对你说话的时候，我必开你的口，你就要对他们说：‘主耶和华这样说。’肯听的就让他听，不肯听的，就由他不听吧，因为他们是叛逆的民族。"
verses.textZhCuv: 但我对你说话的时候，必使你开口，你就要对他们说：『主耶和华如此说。』听的可以听，不听的任他不听，因为他们是悖逆之家。」
verses.textEnNiv: But when I speak to you, I will open your mouth and you shall say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says.’ Whoever will listen let them listen, and whoever will refuse let them refuse; for they are a rebellious people.
verses.textEnEsv: But when I speak with you, I will open your mouth, and you shall say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord God .’ He who will hear, let him hear; and he who will refuse to hear, let him refuse, for they are a rebellious house.
verses.textEnNkjv: But when I speak with you, I will open your mouth, and you shall say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord God.’ He who hears, let him hear; and he who refuses, let him refuse; for they are a rebellious house.
verses.textEnNlt: But when I give you a message, I will loosen your tongue and let you speak. Then you will say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says!’ Those who choose to listen will listen, but those who refuse will refuse, for they are rebels.
verses.textEnNasb: But when I speak to you, I will open your mouth and you will say to them, ‘This is what the Lord God says:’ The one who hears, let him hear; and the one who refuses, let him refuse; for they are a rebellious house.
verses.textEn: But when I speak to you, I will open your mouth and you shall say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says.’ Whoever will listen let them listen, and whoever will refuse let them refuse; for they are a rebellious people.

verses.textZh: "人子啊！你要拿一块砖头，放在你面前，在上面刻一座城，代表耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！你要拿一块砖头，放在你面前，在上面刻一座城，代表耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，你要拿一块砖，摆在你面前，将一座耶路撒冷城画在其上，
verses.textEnNiv: "Now, son of man, take a block of clay, put it in front of you and draw the city of Jerusalem on it.
verses.textEnEsv: "And you, son of man, take a brick and lay it before you, and engrave on it a city, even Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You also, son of man, take a clay tablet and lay it before you, and portray on it a city, Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: "And now, son of man, take a large clay brick and set it down in front of you. Then draw a map of the city of Jerusalem on it.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now you, son of man, get yourself a brick, place it before you, and inscribe a city on it—Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: "Now, son of man, take a block of clay, put it in front of you and draw the city of Jerusalem on it.

verses.textZh: 然后安放围城设施，建造围城高墙，筑起攻城土垒，摆列兵营，四周架起攻城锤。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后安放围城设施，建造围城高墙，筑起攻城土垒，摆列兵营，四周架起攻城锤。
verses.textZhCuv: 又围困这城，造台筑垒，安营攻击，在四围安设撞锤攻城，
verses.textEnNiv: Then lay siege to it: Erect siege works against it, build a ramp up to it, set up camps against it and put battering rams around it.
verses.textEnEsv: And put siegeworks against it, and build a siege wall against it, and cast up a mound against it. Set camps also against it, and plant battering rams against it all around.
verses.textEnNkjv: Lay siege against it, build a siege wall against it, and heap up a mound against it; set camps against it also, and place battering rams against it all around.
verses.textEnNlt: Show the city under siege. Build a wall around it so no one can escape. Set up the enemy camp, and surround the city with siege ramps and battering rams.
verses.textEnNasb: Then lay siege against it, build a siege wall, pile up an assault ramp, set up camps, and place battering rams against it all around.
verses.textEn: Then lay siege to it: Erect siege works against it, build a ramp up to it, set up camps against it and put battering rams around it.

verses.textZh: 你又要拿一个铁的煎盘，放在你和城的中间当作铁墙。你要面向着城，象征城要被围困，你就是围攻那城的。这要作以色列家的预兆。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你又要拿一个铁的煎盘，放在你和城的中间当作铁墙。你要面向着城，象征城要被围困，你就是围攻那城的。这要作以色列家的预兆。
verses.textZhCuv: 又要拿个铁鏊，放在你和城的中间，作为铁墙。你要对面攻击这城，使城被困；这样，好作以色列家的预兆。
verses.textEnNiv: Then take an iron pan, place it as an iron wall between you and the city and turn your face toward it. It will be under siege, and you shall besiege it. This will be a sign to the people of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: And you, take an iron griddle, and place it as an iron wall between you and the city; and set your face toward it, and let it be in a state of siege, and press the siege against it. This is a sign for the house of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover take for yourself an iron plate, and set it as an iron wall between you and the city. Set your face against it, and it shall be besieged, and you shall lay siege against it. This willbe a sign to the house of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Then take an iron griddle and place it between you and the city. Turn toward the city and demonstrate how harsh the siege will be against Jerusalem. This will be a warning to the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Then get yourself an iron plate and set it up as an iron wall between yourself and the city, and direct your face toward it so that it is under siege, and besiege it. This will be a sign to the house of Israel.
verses.textEn: Then take an iron pan, place it as an iron wall between you and the city and turn your face toward it. It will be under siege, and you shall besiege it. This will be a sign to the people of Israel.

verses.textZh: "你要向左边侧卧，承担以色列家的罪孽。你向左边侧卧多少日子，你担当他们的罪孽也是多少日子。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要向左边侧卧，承担以色列家的罪孽。你向左边侧卧多少日子，你担当他们的罪孽也是多少日子。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要向左侧卧，承当以色列家的罪孽；要按你向左侧卧的日数，担当他们的罪孽。
verses.textEnNiv: "Then lie on your left side and put the sin of the people of Israel upon yourself. You are to bear their sin for the number of days you lie on your side.
verses.textEnEsv: "Then lie on your left side, and place the punishment of the house of Israel upon it. For the number of the days that you lie on it, you shall bear their punishment.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Lie also on your left side, and lay the iniquity of the house of Israel upon it. According to the number of the days that you lie on it, you shall bear their iniquity.
verses.textEnNlt: "Now lie on your left side and place the sins of Israel on yourself. You are to bear their sins for the number of days you lie there on your side.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then you are to lie down on your left side and put the wrongdoing of the house of Israel on it; you shall bear their wrongdoing for the number of days that you lie on it.
verses.textEn: "Then lie on your left side and put the sin of the people of Israel upon yourself. You are to bear their sin for the number of days you lie on your side.

verses.textZh: 我已经给你定了日子的数目，就是三百九十天，等于他们作孽的年数，你要在这些日子担当以色列家的罪孽。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我已经给你定了日子的数目，就是三百九十天，等于他们作孽的年数，你要在这些日子担当以色列家的罪孽。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为我已将他们作孽的年数定为你向左侧卧的日数，就是三百九十日，你要这样担当以色列家的罪孽。
verses.textEnNiv: I have assigned you the same number of days as the years of their sin. So for 390 days you will bear the sin of the people of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: For I assign to you a number of days, 390 days, equal to the number of the years of their punishment. So long shall you bear the punishment of the house of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I have laid on you the years of their iniquity, according to the number of the days, three hundred and ninety days; so you shall bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: I am requiring you to bear Israel’s sins for 390 days—one day for each year of their sin.
verses.textEnNasb: For I have assigned you a number of days corresponding to the years of their wrongdoing, 390 days; so you shall bear the wrongdoing of the house of Israel.
verses.textEn: I have assigned you the same number of days as the years of their sin. So for 390 days you will bear the sin of the people of Israel.

verses.textZh: 这些日子满了以后，你要再向右边侧卧，担当犹大家的罪孽，我已经给你定了四十天，一天等于一年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些日子满了以后，你要再向右边侧卧，担当犹大家的罪孽，我已经给你定了四十天，一天等于一年。
verses.textZhCuv: 再者，你满了这些日子，还要向右侧卧，担当犹大家的罪孽。我给你定规侧卧四十日，一日顶一年。
verses.textEnNiv: "After you have finished this, lie down again, this time on your right side, and bear the sin of the people of Judah. I have assigned you 40 days, a day for each year.
