verses.textEnEsv: And when you have completed these, you shall lie down a second time, but on your right side, and bear the punishment of the house of Judah. Forty days I assign you, a day for each year.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when you have completed them, lie again on your right side; then you shall bear the iniquity of the house of Judah forty days. I have laid on you a day for each year.
verses.textEnNlt: After that, turn over and lie on your right side for 40 days—one day for each year of Judah’s sin.
verses.textEnNasb: When you have completed these days, you shall lie down a second time, but on your right side, and bear the wrongdoing of the house of Judah; I have assigned it to you for forty days, a day for each year.
verses.textEn: "After you have finished this, lie down again, this time on your right side, and bear the sin of the people of Judah. I have assigned you 40 days, a day for each year.

verses.textZh: 你要面向着被围困的耶路撒冷，赤露着膀臂，说预言攻击这城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要面向着被围困的耶路撒冷，赤露着膀臂，说预言攻击这城。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要露出膀臂，面向被困的耶路撒冷，说预言攻击这城。
verses.textEnNiv: Turn your face toward the siege of Jerusalem and with bared arm prophesy against her.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall set your face toward the siege of Jerusalem, with your arm bared, and you shall prophesy against the city.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore you shall set your face toward the siege of Jerusalem; your arm shallbe uncovered, and you shall prophesy against it.
verses.textEnNlt: "Meanwhile, keep staring at the siege of Jerusalem. Lie there with your arm bared and prophesy her destruction.
verses.textEnNasb: Then you shall direct your face toward the siege of Jerusalem with your arm bared, and prophesy against it.
verses.textEn: Turn your face toward the siege of Jerusalem and with bared arm prophesy against her.

verses.textZh: 我要用绳子把你捆绑起来，使你不能转身，直等到你围困城的日子满了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要用绳子把你捆绑起来，使你不能转身，直等到你围困城的日子满了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我用绳索捆绑你，使你不能辗转，直等你满了困城的日子。
verses.textEnNiv: I will tie you up with ropes so that you cannot turn from one side to the other until you have finished the days of your siege.
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, I will place cords upon you, so that you cannot turn from one side to the other, till you have completed the days of your siege.
verses.textEnNkjv: And surely I will restrain you so that you cannot turn from one side to another till you have ended the days of your siege.
verses.textEnNlt: I will tie you up with ropes so you won’t be able to turn from side to side until the days of your siege have been completed.
verses.textEnNasb: Now behold, I will put ropes around you so that you cannot turn from your one side to your other until you have completed the days of your siege.
verses.textEn: I will tie you up with ropes so that you cannot turn from one side to the other until you have finished the days of your siege.

verses.textZh: "你要拿小麦、大麦、豆子、扁豆、粟米和粗麦，放在一个器皿里，给自己做饼。在你侧卧的三百九十天里，你都要吃这些饼。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要拿小麦、大麦、豆子、扁豆、粟米和粗麦，放在一个器皿里，给自己做饼。在你侧卧的三百九十天里，你都要吃这些饼。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你要取小麦、大麦、豆子、红豆、小米、粗麦，装在一个器皿中，用以为自己做饼；要按你侧卧的三百九十日吃这饼。
verses.textEnNiv: "Take wheat and barley, beans and lentils, millet and spelt; put them in a storage jar and use them to make bread for yourself. You are to eat it during the 390 days you lie on your side.
verses.textEnEsv: "And you, take wheat and barley, beans and lentils, millet and emmer, and put them into a single vessel and make your bread from them. During the number of days that you lie on your side, 390 days, you shall eat it.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Also take for yourself wheat, barley, beans, lentils, millet, and spelt; put them into one vessel, and make bread of them for yourself. During the number of days that you lie on your side, three hundred and ninety days, you shall eat it.
verses.textEnNlt: "Now go and get some wheat, barley, beans, lentils, millet, and emmer wheat, and mix them together in a storage jar. Use them to make bread for yourself during the 390 days you will be lying on your side.
verses.textEnNasb: "But as for you, take wheat, barley, beans, lentils, millet, and spelt, and put them in one vessel and make them into bread for yourself; you shall eat it according to the number of the days that you lie on your side, 390 days.
verses.textEn: "Take wheat and barley, beans and lentils, millet and spelt; put them in a storage jar and use them to make bread for yourself. You are to eat it during the 390 days you lie on your side.

verses.textZh: 你所吃的食物要有一定分量，每天二百三十克，要在指定的时候吃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你所吃的食物要有一定分量，每天二百三十克，要在指定的时候吃。
verses.textZhCuv: 你所吃的要按分两吃，每日二十舍客勒，按时而吃。
verses.textEnNiv: Weigh out twenty shekels of food to eat each day and eat it at set times.
verses.textEnEsv: And your food that you eat shall be by weight, twenty shekels a day; from day to day you shall eat it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And your food which you eat shallbe by weight, twenty shekels a day; from time to time you shall eat it.
verses.textEnNlt: Ration this out to yourself, eight ounces of food for each day, and eat it at set times.
verses.textEnNasb: Your food which you eat shall be twenty shekels a day by weight; you shall eat it from time to time.
verses.textEn: Weigh out twenty shekels of food to eat each day and eat it at set times.

verses.textZh: 你喝的水也要有一定分量，每天半公升，要在指定的时候喝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你喝的水也要有一定分量，每天半公升，要在指定的时候喝。
verses.textZhCuv: 你喝水也要按制子，每日喝一欣六分之一，按时而喝。
verses.textEnNiv: Also measure out a sixth of a hin of water and drink it at set times.
verses.textEnEsv: And water you shall drink by measure, the sixth part of a hin; from day to day you shall drink.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall also drink water by measure, one-sixth of a hin; from time to time you shall drink.
verses.textEnNlt: Then measure out a jar of water for each day, and drink it at set times.
verses.textEnNasb: The water you drink shall be a sixth of a hin by measure; you shall drink it from time to time.
verses.textEn: Also measure out a sixth of a hin of water and drink it at set times.

verses.textZh: 你吃这些饼，要像吃烙的大麦饼一样，但要用人粪在众人面前烧烤。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你吃这些饼，要像吃烙的大麦饼一样，但要用人粪在众人面前烧烤。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你吃这饼像吃大麦饼一样，要用人粪在众人眼前烧烤。」
verses.textEnNiv: Eat the food as you would a loaf of barley bread; bake it in the sight of the people, using human excrement for fuel."
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall eat it as a barley cake, baking it in their sight on human dung."
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall eat it as barley cakes; and bake it using fuel of human waste in their sight."
verses.textEnNlt: Prepare and eat this food as you would barley cakes. While all the people are watching, bake it over a fire using dried human dung as fuel and then eat the bread."
verses.textEnNasb: You shall eat it as a barley cake, having baked it in their sight over human dung."
verses.textEn: Eat the food as you would a loaf of barley bread; bake it in the sight of the people, using human excrement for fuel."

verses.textZh: 耶和华说："以色列人在我赶他们去的列国中，也要这样吃不洁净的食物。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说："以色列人在我赶他们去的列国中，也要这样吃不洁净的食物。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「以色列人在我所赶他们到的各国中，也必这样吃不洁净的食物。」
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said, "In this way the people of Israel will eat defiled food among the nations where I will drive them."
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said, "Thus shall the people of Israel eat their bread unclean, among the nations where I will drive them."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said, "So shall the children of Israel eat their defiled bread among the Gentiles, where I will drive them."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said, "This is how Israel will eat defiled bread in the Gentile lands to which I will banish them!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said, "In this way the sons of Israel will eat their bread unclean among the nations where I will scatter them."
verses.textEn: The Lord said, "In this way the people of Israel will eat defiled food among the nations where I will drive them."

verses.textZh: 我说："主耶和华啊！我从来没有玷污过自己。我从小到现在都没有吃过已经死去的，或是野兽撕裂的动物，不洁净的肉从没有进过我的口。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我说："主耶和华啊！我从来没有玷污过自己。我从小到现在都没有吃过已经死去的，或是野兽撕裂的动物，不洁净的肉从没有进过我的口。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我说：「哎！主耶和华啊，我素来未曾被玷污，从幼年到如今没有吃过自死的，或被野兽撕裂的，那可憎的肉也未曾入我的口。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then I said, "Not so, Sovereign Lord ! I have never defiled myself. From my youth until now I have never eaten anything found dead or torn by wild animals. No impure meat has ever entered my mouth."
verses.textEnEsv: Then I said, "Ah, Lord God ! Behold, I have never defiled myself. From my youth up till now I have never eaten what died of itself or was torn by beasts, nor has tainted meat come into my mouth."
verses.textEnNkjv: So I said, "Ah, Lord God! Indeed I have never defiled myself from my youth till now; I have never eaten what died of itself or was torn by beasts, nor has abominable flesh ever come into my mouth."
verses.textEnNlt: Then I said, "O Sovereign Lord , must I be defiled by using human dung? For I have never been defiled before. From the time I was a child until now I have never eaten any animal that died of sickness or was killed by other animals. I have never eaten any meat forbidden by the law."
verses.textEnNasb: But I said, "Oh, Lord God! Behold, I have never been defiled; for from my youth until now I have never eaten what died of itself or was torn by animals, nor has any unclean meat ever entered my mouth!"
verses.textEn: Then I said, "Not so, Sovereign Lord ! I have never defiled myself. From my youth until now I have never eaten anything found dead or torn by wild animals. No impure meat has ever entered my mouth."

verses.textZh: 于是他对我说："你看，我准你用牛粪代替人粪，你可以在牛粪上烤你的饼。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他对我说："你看，我准你用牛粪代替人粪，你可以在牛粪上烤你的饼。"
verses.textZhCuv: 于是他对我说：「看哪，我给你牛粪代替人粪，你要将你的饼烤在其上。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Very well," he said, "I will let you bake your bread over cow dung instead of human excrement."
verses.textEnEsv: Then he said to me, "See, I assign to you cow’s dung instead of human dung, on which you may prepare your bread."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He said to me, "See, I am giving you cow dung instead of human waste, and you shall prepare your bread over it."
verses.textEnNlt: "All right," the Lord said. "You may bake your bread with cow dung instead of human dung."
verses.textEnNasb: Then He said to me, "See, I will give you cow’s dung in place of human dung, so that you may prepare your bread over it."
verses.textEn: "Very well," he said, "I will let you bake your bread over cow dung instead of human excrement."

verses.textZh: 他又对我说："人子啊，我要断绝耶路撒冷的粮食。他们要满心忧虑，吃配给的口粮；十分惊惶，喝配给的水。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又对我说："人子啊，我要断绝耶路撒冷的粮食。他们要满心忧虑，吃配给的口粮；十分惊惶，喝配给的水。
verses.textZhCuv: 他又对我说：「人子啊，我必在耶路撒冷折断他们的杖，就是断绝他们的粮。他们吃饼要按分两，忧虑而吃；喝水也要按制子，惊惶而喝；
verses.textEnNiv: He then said to me: "Son of man, I am about to cut off the food supply in Jerusalem. The people will eat rationed food in anxiety and drink rationed water in despair,
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, he said to me, "Son of man, behold, I will break the supply of bread in Jerusalem. They shall eat bread by weight and with anxiety, and they shall drink water by measure and in dismay.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover He said to me, "Son of man, surely I will cut off the supply of bread in Jerusalem; they shall eat bread by weight and with anxiety, and shall drink water by measure and with dread,
verses.textEnNlt: Then he told me, "Son of man, I will make food very scarce in Jerusalem. It will be weighed out with great care and eaten fearfully. The water will be rationed out drop by drop, and the people will drink it with dismay.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, He said to me, "Son of man, behold, I am going to break the staff of bread in Jerusalem, and they will eat bread by weight and with anxiety, and drink water by measure and in horror,
verses.textEn: He then said to me: "Son of man, I am about to cut off the food supply in Jerusalem. The people will eat rationed food in anxiety and drink rationed water in despair,

verses.textZh: 他们缺粮缺水，各人都必惊惶，因自己的罪孽衰弱而死。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们缺粮缺水，各人都必惊惶，因自己的罪孽衰弱而死。"
verses.textZhCuv: 使他们缺粮缺水，彼此惊惶，因自己的罪孽消灭。」
verses.textEnNiv: for food and water will be scarce. They will be appalled at the sight of each other and will waste away because of their sin.
verses.textEnEsv: I will do this that they may lack bread and water, and look at one another in dismay, and rot away because of their punishment.
verses.textEnNkjv: that they may lack bread and water, and be dismayed with one another, and waste away because of their iniquity.
verses.textEnNlt: Lacking food and water, people will look at one another in terror, and they will waste away under their punishment.
verses.textEnNasb: because bread and water will be scarce; and they will tremble with one another and waste away in their guilt.
verses.textEn: for food and water will be scarce. They will be appalled at the sight of each other and will waste away because of their sin.

verses.textZh: "人子啊！你要拿一把利剑，当作理发匠的剃刀，剃你的头和刮你的胡子，把须发放在天平上称，然后把它们分成几分。
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！你要拿一把利剑，当作理发匠的剃刀，剃你的头和刮你的胡子，把须发放在天平上称，然后把它们分成几分。
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，你要拿一把快刀，当作剃头刀，用这刀剃你的头发和你的胡须，用天平将须发平分。
verses.textEnNiv: "Now, son of man, take a sharp sword and use it as a barber’s razor to shave your head and your beard. Then take a set of scales and divide up the hair.
verses.textEnEsv: "And you, O son of man, take a sharp sword. Use it as a barber’s razor and pass it over your head and your beard. Then take balances for weighing and divide the hair.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And you, son of man, take a sharp sword, take it as a barber’s razor, and pass it over your head and your beard; then take scales to weigh and divide the hair.
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, take a sharp sword and use it as a razor to shave your head and beard. Use a scale to weigh the hair into three equal parts.
verses.textEnNasb: "As for you, son of man, take a sharp sword; take and use it as a barber’s razor on your head and beard. Then take scales for weighing and divide the hair.
verses.textEn: "Now, son of man, take a sharp sword and use it as a barber’s razor to shave your head and your beard. Then take a set of scales and divide up the hair.

verses.textZh: 围困这城的日子满了，你要拿须发的三分之一在城中用火烧掉，又拿三分之一在城的周围用刀剁碎，三分之一撒在风中，我还要拔刀追赶它们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 围困这城的日子满了，你要拿须发的三分之一在城中用火烧掉，又拿三分之一在城的周围用刀剁碎，三分之一撒在风中，我还要拔刀追赶它们。
verses.textZhCuv: 围困城的日子满了，你要将三分之一在城中用火焚烧，将三分之一在城的四围用刀砍碎，将三分之一任风吹散；我也要拔刀追赶。
verses.textEnNiv: When the days of your siege come to an end, burn a third of the hair inside the city. Take a third and strike it with the sword all around the city. And scatter a third to the wind. For I will pursue them with drawn sword.
verses.textEnEsv: A third part you shall burn in the fire in the midst of the city, when the days of the siege are completed. And a third part you shall take and strike with the sword all around the city. And a third part you shall scatter to the wind, and I will unsheathe the sword after them.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall burn with fire one-third in the midst of the city, when the days of the siege are finished; then you shall take one-third and strike around it with the sword, and one-third you shall scatter in the wind: I will draw out a sword after them.
verses.textEnNlt: Place a third of it at the center of your map of Jerusalem. After acting out the siege, burn it there. Scatter another third across your map and chop it with a sword. Scatter the last third to the wind, for I will scatter my people with the sword.
verses.textEnNasb: A third you shall burn in the fire at the center of the city, when the days of the siege are completed. Then you shall take a third and strike it with the sword all around the city, and a third you shall scatter to the wind; for I will unsheathe a sword behind them.
verses.textEn: When the days of your siege come to an end, burn a third of the hair inside the city. Take a third and strike it with the sword all around the city. And scatter a third to the wind. For I will pursue them with drawn sword.

verses.textZh: 你要在这些须发中取几根，用你的衣角把它们包起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要在这些须发中取几根，用你的衣角把它们包起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要从其中取几根包在衣襟里，
verses.textEnNiv: But take a few hairs and tuck them away in the folds of your garment.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall take from these a small number and bind them in the skirts of your robe.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall also take a small number of them and bind them in the edge of your garment.
verses.textEnNlt: Keep just a bit of the hair and tie it up in your robe.
verses.textEnNasb: Take also a few hairs in number from them and bind them in the hems of your robes.
verses.textEn: But take a few hairs and tuck them away in the folds of your garment.

verses.textZh: 再从这几根须发中取一部分投在火里焚烧；火必从那里蔓延到以色列全家。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 再从这几根须发中取一部分投在火里焚烧；火必从那里蔓延到以色列全家。"
verses.textZhCuv: 再从这几根中取些扔在火中焚烧，从里面必有火出来烧入以色列全家。
verses.textEnNiv: Again, take a few of these and throw them into the fire and burn them up. A fire will spread from there to all Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: And of these again you shall take some and cast them into the midst of the fire and burn them in the fire. From there a fire will come out into all the house of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then take some of them again and throw them into the midst of the fire, and burn them in the fire. From there a fire will go out into all the house of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Then take some of these hairs out and throw them into the fire, burning them up. A fire will then spread from this remnant and destroy all of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Take again some of them and throw them into the fire and burn them in the fire; from it a fire will spread to all the house of Israel.
verses.textEn: Again, take a few of these and throw them into the fire and burn them up. A fire will spread from there to all Israel.

verses.textZh: 主耶和华这样说："这就是耶路撒冷！我曾把她安置在列国中间，万邦环绕着她。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主耶和华这样说："这就是耶路撒冷！我曾把她安置在列国中间，万邦环绕着她。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华如此说：这就是耶路撒冷。我曾将她安置在列邦之中；列国都在她的四围。
verses.textEnNiv: "This is what the Sovereign Lord says: This is Jerusalem, which I have set in the center of the nations, with countries all around her.
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord God : This is Jerusalem. I have set her in the center of the nations, with countries all around her.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus says the Lord God: ‘This is Jerusalem; I have set her in the midst of the nations and the countries all around her.
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Sovereign Lord says: This is an illustration of what will happen to Jerusalem. I placed her at the center of the nations,
verses.textEnNasb: "This is what the Lord God says: ‘This is Jerusalem; I have placed her at the center of the nations, with lands around her.
verses.textEn: "This is what the Sovereign Lord says: This is Jerusalem, which I have set in the center of the nations, with countries all around her.

verses.textZh: 但她违背我的典章，行恶胜过列国；触犯我的律例，比环绕着她的万邦更坏。她弃绝我的典章，不遵行我的律例。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但她违背我的典章，行恶胜过列国；触犯我的律例，比环绕着她的万邦更坏。她弃绝我的典章，不遵行我的律例。"
verses.textZhCuv: 她行恶，违背我的典章，过于列国；干犯我的律例，过于四围的列邦，因为她弃掉我的典章。至于我的律例，她并没有遵行。
verses.textEnNiv: Yet in her wickedness she has rebelled against my laws and decrees more than the nations and countries around her. She has rejected my laws and has not followed my decrees.
verses.textEnEsv: And she has rebelled against my rules by doing wickedness more than the nations, and against my statutes more than the countries all around her; for they have rejected my rules and have not walked in my statutes.
verses.textEnNkjv: She has rebelled against My judgments by doing wickedness more than the nations, and against My statutes more than the countries that are all around her; for they have refused My judgments, and they have not walked in My statutes.’
verses.textEnNlt: but she has rebelled against my regulations and decrees and has been even more wicked than the surrounding nations. She has refused to obey the regulations and decrees I gave her to follow.
verses.textEnNasb: But she has rebelled against My ordinances more wickedly than the nations, and against My statutes more than the lands which surround her; for they have rejected My ordinances and have not walked in My statutes.’
verses.textEn: Yet in her wickedness she has rebelled against my laws and decrees more than the nations and countries around her. She has rejected my laws and has not followed my decrees.

verses.textZh: 主耶和华这样说："你们比你们四围的列国更叛逆，不遵行我的律例，不遵守我的典章，连你们四围列国的法规你们也不遵守 。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 主耶和华这样说："你们比你们四围的列国更叛逆，不遵行我的律例，不遵守我的典章，连你们四围列国的法规你们也不遵守 。"
verses.textZhCuv: 所以主耶和华如此说：因为你们纷争过于四围的列国，也不遵行我的律例，不谨守我的典章，并以遵从四围列国的恶规尚不满意，
verses.textEnNiv: "Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: You have been more unruly than the nations around you and have not followed my decrees or kept my laws. You have not even conformed to the standards of the nations around you.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore thus says the Lord God : Because you are more turbulent than the nations that are all around you, and have not walked in my statutes or obeyed my rules, and have not even acted according to the rules of the nations that are all around you,
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore thus says the Lord God: ‘Because you have multiplied disobedience more than the nations that are all around you, have not walked in My statutes nor kept My judgments, nor even done according to the judgments of the nations that are all around you’—
verses.textEnNlt: "Therefore, this is what the Sovereign Lord says: You people have behaved worse than your neighbors and have refused to obey my decrees and regulations. You have not even lived up to the standards of the nations around you.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, this is what the Lord God says: ‘Because you have more turmoil than the nations that surround you and have not walked in My statutes, nor executed My ordinances, nor acted in accordance with the ordinances of the nations around you,’
verses.textEn: "Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: You have been more unruly than the nations around you and have not followed my decrees or kept my laws. You have not even conformed to the standards of the nations around you.

verses.textZh: 所以，主耶和华这样说："看哪！我要敌对你。我要在你中间，在列国的眼前，施行审判。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，主耶和华这样说："看哪！我要敌对你。我要在你中间，在列国的眼前，施行审判。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以主耶和华如此说：看哪，我与你反对，必在列国的眼前，在你中间，施行审判；
verses.textEnNiv: "Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I myself am against you, Jerusalem, and I will inflict punishment on you in the sight of the nations.
verses.textEnEsv: therefore thus says the Lord God : Behold, I, even I, am against you. And I will execute judgments in your midst in the sight of the nations.
verses.textEnNkjv: therefore thus says the Lord God: ‘Indeed I, even I, am against you and will execute judgments in your midst in the sight of the nations.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, I myself, the Sovereign Lord , am now your enemy. I will punish you publicly while all the nations watch.
verses.textEnNasb: therefore, this is what the Lord God says: ‘Behold, I, even I, am against you, and I will execute judgments among you in the sight of the nations.
verses.textEn: "Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I myself am against you, Jerusalem, and I will inflict punishment on you in the sight of the nations.

verses.textZh: 我要因你一切可憎的事在你中间施行我未曾行过，以后也不会这样施行的审判。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要因你一切可憎的事在你中间施行我未曾行过，以后也不会这样施行的审判。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且因你一切可憎的事，我要在你中间行我所未曾行的，以后我也不再照着行。
verses.textEnNiv: Because of all your detestable idols, I will do to you what I have never done before and will never do again.
verses.textEnEsv: And because of all your abominations I will do with you what I have never yet done, and the like of which I will never do again.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will do among you what I have never done, and the like of which I will never do again, because of all your abominations.
verses.textEnNlt: Because of your detestable idols, I will punish you like I have never punished anyone before or ever will again.
verses.textEnNasb: And because of all your abominations I will do among you what I have not done, and the like of which I will never do again.
verses.textEn: Because of all your detestable idols, I will do to you what I have never done before and will never do again.

verses.textZh: 因此，在你中间，父亲要吃儿子，儿子要吃父亲。我要向你施行审判，把你余剩的众人分散到四方去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，在你中间，父亲要吃儿子，儿子要吃父亲。我要向你施行审判，把你余剩的众人分散到四方去。
verses.textZhCuv: 在你中间父亲要吃儿子，儿子要吃父亲。我必向你施行审判，我必将你所剩下的分散四方 。」
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore in your midst parents will eat their children, and children will eat their parents. I will inflict punishment on you and will scatter all your survivors to the winds.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore fathers shall eat their sons in your midst, and sons shall eat their fathers. And I will execute judgments on you, and any of you who survive I will scatter to all the winds.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore fathers shall eat their sons in your midst, and sons shall eat their fathers; and I will execute judgments among you, and all of you who remain I will scatter to all the winds.
verses.textEnNlt: Parents will eat their own children, and children will eat their parents. I will punish you and scatter to the winds the few who survive.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, fathers will eat their sons among you, and sons will eat their fathers; for I will execute judgments on you and scatter all your remnant to every wind.
verses.textEn: Therefore in your midst parents will eat their children, and children will eat their parents. I will inflict punishment on you and will scatter all your survivors to the winds.

verses.textZh: "我指着我的永生起誓 ，你既然用你一切可憎的偶像和一切可厌的事来玷污我的圣所，我必收回对你的恩宠，我的眼必不顾惜你，我也不怜恤你。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我指着我的永生起誓 ，你既然用你一切可憎的偶像和一切可厌的事来玷污我的圣所，我必收回对你的恩宠，我的眼必不顾惜你，我也不怜恤你。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华说：「我指着我的永生起誓，因你用一切可憎的物、可厌的事玷污了我的圣所，故此，我定要使你人数减少，我眼必不顾惜你，也不可怜你。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore as surely as I live, declares the Sovereign Lord , because you have defiled my sanctuary with all your vile images and detestable practices, I myself will shave you; I will not look on you with pity or spare you.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore, as I live, declares the Lord God , surely, because you have defiled my sanctuary with all your detestable things and with all your abominations, therefore I will withdraw. My eye will not spare, and I will have no pity.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Therefore, as I live,’ says the Lord God, ‘surely, because you have defiled My sanctuary with all your detestable things and with all your abominations, therefore I will also diminish you; My eye will not spare, nor will I have any pity.
verses.textEnNlt: "As surely as I live, says the Sovereign Lord , I will cut you off completely. I will show you no pity at all because you have defiled my Temple with your vile images and detestable sins.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore as I live,’ declares the Lord God, ‘Because you have defiled My sanctuary with all your detestable idols and with all your abominations, I definitely will also withdraw and My eye will have no pity, and I also will not spare.
verses.textEn: Therefore as surely as I live, declares the Sovereign Lord , because you have defiled my sanctuary with all your vile images and detestable practices, I myself will shave you; I will not look on you with pity or spare you.

verses.textZh: 你的人民三分之一必在你中间因瘟疫死亡，因饥荒消灭；三分之一必在你周围因刀剑倒毙；三分之一，我要分散到四方去，我还要拔刀追赶他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的人民三分之一必在你中间因瘟疫死亡，因饥荒消灭；三分之一必在你周围因刀剑倒毙；三分之一，我要分散到四方去，我还要拔刀追赶他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的民三分之一必遭瘟疫而死，在你中间必因饥荒消灭；三分之一必在你四围倒在刀下；我必将三分之一分散四方 ，并要拔刀追赶他们。
verses.textEnNiv: A third of your people will die of the plague or perish by famine inside you; a third will fall by the sword outside your walls; and a third I will scatter to the winds and pursue with drawn sword.
verses.textEnEsv: A third part of you shall die of pestilence and be consumed with famine in your midst; a third part shall fall by the sword all around you; and a third part I will scatter to all the winds and will unsheathe the sword after them.
verses.textEnNkjv: One-third of you shall die of the pestilence, and be consumed with famine in your midst; and one-third shall fall by the sword all around you; and I will scatter another third to all the winds, and I will draw out a sword after them.
verses.textEnNlt: A third of your people will die in the city from disease and famine. A third of them will be slaughtered by the enemy outside the city walls. And I will scatter a third to the winds, chasing them with my sword.
verses.textEnNasb: A third of you will die by plague or perish by famine among you, a third will fall by the sword around you, and a third I will scatter to every wind, and I will unsheathe a sword behind them.
verses.textEn: A third of your people will die of the plague or perish by famine inside you; a third will fall by the sword outside your walls; and a third I will scatter to the winds and pursue with drawn sword.

verses.textZh: "这样我的怒气才可以发尽，我向他们所发的烈怒才可以平息，自己才得到舒畅。我向他们所发的烈怒完全发尽的时候，他们就知道我耶和华说过的话是出于嫉恨的心。
verses.textZhCnvs: "这样我的怒气才可以发尽，我向他们所发的烈怒才可以平息，自己才得到舒畅。我向他们所发的烈怒完全发尽的时候，他们就知道我耶和华说过的话是出于嫉恨的心。
verses.textZhCuv: 「我要这样成就怒中所定的；我向他们发的忿怒止息了，自己就得着安慰。我在他们身上成就怒中所定的那时，他们就知道我－耶和华所说的是出于热心；
verses.textEnNiv: "Then my anger will cease and my wrath against them will subside, and I will be avenged. And when I have spent my wrath on them, they will know that I the Lord have spoken in my zeal.
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus shall my anger spend itself, and I will vent my fury upon them and satisfy myself. And they shall know that I am the Lord —that I have spoken in my jealousy— when I spend my fury upon them.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Thus shall My anger be spent, and I will cause My fury to rest upon them, and I will be avenged; and they shall know that I, the Lord, have spoken it in My zeal, when I have spent My fury upon them.
verses.textEnNlt: Then at last my anger will be spent, and I will be satisfied. And when my fury against them has subsided, all Israel will know that I, the Lord , have spoken to them in my jealous anger.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Then My anger will be spent and I will satisfy My wrath on them, and I will be appeased; then they will know that I, the Lord, have spoken in My zeal, when I have spent My wrath upon them.
verses.textEn: "Then my anger will cease and my wrath against them will subside, and I will be avenged. And when I have spent my wrath on them, they will know that I the Lord have spoken in my zeal.

verses.textZh: 我要使你变成荒地，使你在你四围的列国中和在所有路过的人眼前，成为羞辱的对象。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要使你变成荒地，使你在你四围的列国中和在所有路过的人眼前，成为羞辱的对象。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且我必使你在四围的列国中，在经过的众人眼前，成了荒凉和羞辱。
verses.textEnNiv: "I will make you a ruin and a reproach among the nations around you, in the sight of all who pass by.
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, I will make you a desolation and an object of reproach among the nations all around you and in the sight of all who pass by.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover I will make you a waste and a reproach among the nations that are all around you, in the sight of all who pass by.
verses.textEnNlt: "So I will turn you into a ruin, a mockery in the eyes of the surrounding nations and to all who pass by.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, I will make you a site of ruins and a disgrace among the nations that surround you, in the sight of everyone who passes by.
verses.textEn: "I will make you a ruin and a reproach among the nations around you, in the sight of all who pass by.

verses.textZh: 我以怒气、烈怒和忿怒的责备向你施行审判的时候，你就必在你四围的列国中成为羞辱、讥讽和令人惊骇的对象，也成了他们的警戒。这是我耶和华说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我以怒气、烈怒和忿怒的责备向你施行审判的时候，你就必在你四围的列国中成为羞辱、讥讽和令人惊骇的对象，也成了他们的警戒。这是我耶和华说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，我必以怒气和忿怒，并烈怒的责备，向你施行审判。那时，你就在四围的列国中成为羞辱、讥刺、警戒、惊骇。这是我－耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: You will be a reproach and a taunt, a warning and an object of horror to the nations around you when I inflict punishment on you in anger and in wrath and with stinging rebuke. I the Lord have spoken.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall be a reproach and a taunt, a warning and a horror, to the nations all around you, when I execute judgments on you in anger and fury, and with furious rebukes—I am the Lord ; I have spoken—
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘So it shall be a reproach, a taunt, a lesson, and an astonishment to the nations that are all around you, when I execute judgments among you in anger and in fury and in furious rebukes. I, the Lord, have spoken.
verses.textEnNlt: You will become an object of mockery and taunting and horror. You will be a warning to all the nations around you. They will see what happens when the Lord punishes a nation in anger and rebukes it, says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: So it will be a disgrace, an object of abuse, a warning, and an object of horror to the nations that surround you when I execute judgments against you in anger, wrath, and raging reprimands. I, the Lord, have spoken.
verses.textEn: You will be a reproach and a taunt, a warning and an object of horror to the nations around you when I inflict punishment on you in anger and in wrath and with stinging rebuke. I the Lord have spoken.

verses.textZh: 我射出饥荒和毁灭的毒箭的时候，是为了毁灭你们。我要使你们的饥荒加剧，断绝你们粮食的供应。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我射出饥荒和毁灭的毒箭的时候，是为了毁灭你们。我要使你们的饥荒加剧，断绝你们粮食的供应。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，我要将灭人、使人饥荒的恶箭，就是射去灭人的，射在你们身上，并要加增你们的饥荒，断绝你们所倚靠的粮食；
verses.textEnNiv: When I shoot at you with my deadly and destructive arrows of famine, I will shoot to destroy you. I will bring more and more famine upon you and cut off your supply of food.
verses.textEnEsv: when I send against you the deadly arrows of famine, arrows for destruction, which I will send to destroy you, and when I bring more and more famine upon you and break your supply of bread.
verses.textEnNkjv: When I send against them the terrible arrows of famine which shall be for destruction, which I will send to destroy you, I will increase the famine upon you and cut off your supply of bread.
verses.textEnNlt: "I will shower you with the deadly arrows of famine to destroy you. The famine will become more and more severe until every crumb of food is gone.
verses.textEnNasb: When I send against them the deadly arrows of famine which were for the destruction of those whom I will send to destroy you, then I will also intensify the famine upon you and break off your provision of bread.
verses.textEn: When I shoot at you with my deadly and destructive arrows of famine, I will shoot to destroy you. I will bring more and more famine upon you and cut off your supply of food.

verses.textZh: 我要差遣饥荒和恶兽到你们那里去，使你丧掉儿女；在你中间必到处发生瘟疫和流血的事；我也必使刀剑临到你。这是我耶和华说的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要差遣饥荒和恶兽到你们那里去，使你丧掉儿女；在你中间必到处发生瘟疫和流血的事；我也必使刀剑临到你。这是我耶和华说的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又要使饥荒和恶兽到你那里，叫你丧子，瘟疫和流血的事也必盛行在你那里；我也要使刀剑临到你。这是我－耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: I will send famine and wild beasts against you, and they will leave you childless. Plague and bloodshed will sweep through you, and I will bring the sword against you. I the Lord have spoken."
verses.textEnEsv: I will send famine and wild beasts against you, and they will rob you of your children. Pestilence and blood shall pass through you, and I will bring the sword upon you. I am the Lord ; I have spoken."
verses.textEnNkjv: So I will send against you famine and wild beasts, and they will bereave you. Pestilence and blood shall pass through you, and I will bring the sword against you. I, the Lord, have spoken.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: And along with the famine, wild animals will attack you and rob you of your children. Disease and war will stalk your land, and I will bring the sword of the enemy against you. I, the Lord , have spoken!"
verses.textEnNasb: I will send on you famine and vicious animals, and they will bereave you of children; plague and bloodshed also will pass through you, and I will bring the sword on you. I, the Lord, have spoken.’ "
verses.textEn: I will send famine and wild beasts against you, and they will leave you childless. Plague and bloodshed will sweep through you, and I will bring the sword against you. I the Lord have spoken."

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: Again a message came to me from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: Now the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: The word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: "人子啊！你要面向以色列的群山说预言，
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！你要面向以色列的群山说预言，
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，你要面向以色列的众山说预言，
verses.textEnNiv: "Son of man, set your face against the mountains of Israel; prophesy against them
verses.textEnEsv: "Son of man, set your face toward the mountains of Israel, and prophesy against them,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Son of man, set your face toward the mountains of Israel, and prophesy against them,
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, turn and face the mountains of Israel and prophesy against them.
verses.textEnNasb: "Son of man, set your face toward the mountains of Israel, and prophesy against them
verses.textEn: "Son of man, set your face against the mountains of Israel; prophesy against them

verses.textZh: 说：‘以色列的群山，当听主耶和华的话！主耶和华对大山、小山、溪涧和山谷这样说：看哪！我必使刀剑临到你，毁灭你们的邱坛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 说：‘以色列的群山，当听主耶和华的话！主耶和华对大山、小山、溪涧和山谷这样说：看哪！我必使刀剑临到你，毁灭你们的邱坛。
verses.textZhCuv: 说：以色列的众山哪，要听主耶和华的话。主耶和华对大山、小冈、水沟、山谷如此说：我必使刀剑临到你们，也必毁灭你们的邱坛。
verses.textEnNiv: and say: ‘You mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Sovereign Lord . This is what the Sovereign Lord says to the mountains and hills, to the ravines and valleys: I am about to bring a sword against you, and I will destroy your high places.
verses.textEnEsv: and say, You mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord God ! Thus says the Lord God to the mountains and the hills, to the ravines and the valleys: Behold, I, even I, will bring a sword upon you, and I will destroy your high places.
verses.textEnNkjv: and say, ‘O mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord God! Thus says the Lord God to the mountains, to the hills, to the ravines, and to the valleys: "Indeed I, even I, will bring a sword against you, and I will destroy your high places.
verses.textEnNlt: Proclaim this message from the Sovereign Lord against the mountains of Israel. This is what the Sovereign Lord says to the mountains and hills and to the ravines and valleys: I am about to bring war upon you, and I will smash your pagan shrines.
verses.textEnNasb: and say, ‘Mountains of Israel, listen to the word of the Lord God! This is what the Lord God says to the mountains, the hills, the ravines, and the valleys: "Behold, I Myself am going to bring a sword against you, and I will destroy your high places.
verses.textEn: and say: ‘You mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Sovereign Lord . This is what the Sovereign Lord says to the mountains and hills, to the ravines and valleys: I am about to bring a sword against you, and I will destroy your high places.

verses.textZh: 你们的祭坛必然荒废，你们的香坛要被打碎；我要使你们被杀的人倒在你们的偶像面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们的祭坛必然荒废，你们的香坛要被打碎；我要使你们被杀的人倒在你们的偶像面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们的祭坛必然荒凉，你们的日像必被打碎。我要使你们被杀的人倒在你们的偶像面前；
verses.textEnNiv: Your altars will be demolished and your incense altars will be smashed; and I will slay your people in front of your idols.
verses.textEnEsv: Your altars shall become desolate, and your incense altars shall be broken, and I will cast down your slain before your idols.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then your altars shall be desolate, your incense altars shall be broken, and I will cast down your slain men before your idols.
verses.textEnNlt: All your altars will be demolished, and your places of worship will be destroyed. I will kill your people in front of your idols.
verses.textEnNasb: So your altars will become deserted and your incense altars will be smashed; and I will make your slain fall in front of your idols.
verses.textEn: Your altars will be demolished and your incense altars will be smashed; and I will slay your people in front of your idols.

verses.textZh: 我要把以色列人的尸体放在他们的偶像面前，又把你们的骸骨拋散在你们祭坛的周围。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要把以色列人的尸体放在他们的偶像面前，又把你们的骸骨拋散在你们祭坛的周围。
verses.textZhCuv: 我也要将以色列人的尸首放在他们的偶像面前，将你们的骸骨抛散在你们祭坛的四围。
verses.textEnNiv: I will lay the dead bodies of the Israelites in front of their idols, and I will scatter your bones around your altars.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will lay the dead bodies of the people of Israel before their idols, and I will scatter your bones around your altars.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will lay the corpses of the children of Israel before their idols, and I will scatter your bones all around your altars.
verses.textEnNlt: I will lay your corpses in front of your idols and scatter your bones around your altars.
verses.textEnNasb: I will also lay the dead bodies of the sons of Israel in front of their idols; and I will scatter your bones around your altars.
verses.textEn: I will lay the dead bodies of the Israelites in front of their idols, and I will scatter your bones around your altars.

verses.textZh: 在你们居住的一切地方，城镇都必荒凉，邱坛都必荒废，以致你们的祭坛荒废被弃，你们的偶像被打碎、被消灭，你们的香坛要被砍下，你们所制造的要被除灭；
verses.textZhCnvs: 在你们居住的一切地方，城镇都必荒凉，邱坛都必荒废，以致你们的祭坛荒废被弃，你们的偶像被打碎、被消灭，你们的香坛要被砍下，你们所制造的要被除灭；
verses.textZhCuv: 在你们一切的住处，城邑要变为荒场，邱坛必然凄凉，使你们的祭坛荒废，将你们的偶像打碎。你们的日像被砍倒，你们的工作被毁灭。
verses.textEnNiv: Wherever you live, the towns will be laid waste and the high places demolished, so that your altars will be laid waste and devastated, your idols smashed and ruined, your incense altars broken down, and what you have made wiped out.
verses.textEnEsv: Wherever you dwell, the cities shall be waste and the high places ruined, so that your altars will be waste and ruined, your idols broken and destroyed, your incense altars cut down, and your works wiped out.
verses.textEnNkjv: In all your dwelling places the cities shall be laid waste, and the high places shall be desolate, so that your altars may be laid waste and made desolate, your idols may be broken and made to cease, your incense altars may be cut down, and your works may be abolished.
verses.textEnNlt: Wherever you live there will be desolation, and I will destroy your pagan shrines. Your altars will be demolished, your idols will be smashed, your places of worship will be torn down, and all the religious objects you have made will be destroyed.
verses.textEnNasb: Everywhere you live, cities will be in ruins and the high places will be deserted, so that your altars will be in ruins and deserted, your idols will be broken and brought to an end, your incense altars will be cut down, and your works wiped out.
verses.textEn: Wherever you live, the towns will be laid waste and the high places demolished, so that your altars will be laid waste and devastated, your idols smashed and ruined, your incense altars broken down, and what you have made wiped out.

verses.textZh: 被杀的人必倒在你们中间，你们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 被杀的人必倒在你们中间，你们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 被杀的人必倒在你们中间，你们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: Your people will fall slain among you, and you will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And the slain shall fall in your midst, and you shall know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: The slain shall fall in your midst, and you shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: The place will be littered with corpses, and you will know that I alone am the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: The slain will fall among you, and you will know that I am the Lord.
verses.textEn: Your people will fall slain among you, and you will know that I am the Lord .

verses.textZh: "‘但我要保留一些余剩的人，你们分散在各地的时候，你们必有人在列国中从刀剑下逃出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘但我要保留一些余剩的人，你们分散在各地的时候，你们必有人在列国中从刀剑下逃出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们分散在各国的时候，我必在列邦中使你们有剩下脱离刀剑的人。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘But I will spare some, for some of you will escape the sword when you are scattered among the lands and nations.
verses.textEnEsv: "Yet I will leave some of you alive. When you have among the nations some who escape the sword, and when you are scattered through the countries,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Yet I will leave a remnant, so that you may have some who escape the sword among the nations, when you are scattered through the countries.
verses.textEnNlt: "But I will let a few of my people escape destruction, and they will be scattered among the nations of the world.
verses.textEnNasb: "However, I will leave a remnant, in that you will have those who escaped the sword among the nations when you are scattered among the countries.
verses.textEn: " ‘But I will spare some, for some of you will escape the sword when you are scattered among the lands and nations.

verses.textZh: 那时，逃脱的人必在被掳去的列国中想起我怎样为了他们而伤痛，因为他们动了淫乱的心离弃我，他们邪淫的眼恋慕偶像；那时他们必为了自己所行的恶事和他们一切可憎的事厌恶自己。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，逃脱的人必在被掳去的列国中想起我怎样为了他们而伤痛，因为他们动了淫乱的心离弃我，他们邪淫的眼恋慕偶像；那时他们必为了自己所行的恶事和他们一切可憎的事厌恶自己。
verses.textZhCuv: 那脱离刀剑的人必在所掳到的各国中记念我，为他们心中何等伤破，是因他们起淫心，远离我，眼对偶像行邪淫。他们因行一切可憎的恶事，必厌恶自己。
verses.textEnNiv: Then in the nations where they have been carried captive, those who escape will remember me—how I have been grieved by their adulterous hearts, which have turned away from me, and by their eyes, which have lusted after their idols. They will loathe themselves for the evil they have done and for all their detestable practices.
verses.textEnEsv: then those of you who escape will remember me among the nations where they are carried captive, how I have been broken over their whoring heart that has departed from me and over their eyes that go whoring after their idols. And they will be loathsome in their own sight for the evils that they have committed, for all their abominations.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then those of you who escape will remember Me among the nations where they are carried captive, because I was crushed by their adulterous heart which has departed from Me, and by their eyes which play the harlot after their idols; they will loathe themselves for the evils which they committed in all their abominations.
verses.textEnNlt: Then when they are exiled among the nations, they will remember me. They will recognize how hurt I am by their unfaithful hearts and lustful eyes that long for their idols. Then at last they will hate themselves for all their detestable sins.
verses.textEnNasb: Then those of you who escape will remember Me among the nations to which they will be taken captive, how I have been hurt by their adulterous hearts which turned away from Me, and by their eyes which committed infidelity with their idols; and they will loathe themselves in their own sight for the evils which they have committed, for all their abominations.
verses.textEn: Then in the nations where they have been carried captive, those who escape will remember me—how I have been grieved by their adulterous hearts, which have turned away from me, and by their eyes, which have lusted after their idols. They will loathe themselves for the evil they have done and for all their detestable practices.

verses.textZh: 他们必知道我是耶和华，我说要降这灾祸在他们身上的话并不是空话。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们必知道我是耶和华，我说要降这灾祸在他们身上的话并不是空话。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必知道我是耶和华；我说要使这灾祸临到他们身上，并非空话。
verses.textEnNiv: And they will know that I am the Lord ; I did not threaten in vain to bring this calamity on them.
verses.textEnEsv: And they shall know that I am the Lord . I have not said in vain that I would do this evil to them."
verses.textEnNkjv: And they shall know that I am the Lord; I have not said in vain that I would bring this calamity upon them."
verses.textEnNlt: They will know that I alone am the Lord and that I was serious when I said I would bring this calamity on them.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they will know that I am the Lord; I have not said in vain that I would inflict this disaster on them." ’
verses.textEn: And they will know that I am the Lord ; I did not threaten in vain to bring this calamity on them.

verses.textZh: 主耶和华这样说："你要拍手顿足，说：‘哀哉！因以色列家一切可憎的恶事，他们必倒在刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫之下。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 主耶和华这样说："你要拍手顿足，说：‘哀哉！因以色列家一切可憎的恶事，他们必倒在刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫之下。’
verses.textZhCuv: 「主耶和华如此说：你当拍手顿足，说：哀哉！以色列家行这一切可憎的恶事，他们必倒在刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫之下。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Strike your hands together and stamp your feet and cry out "Alas!" because of all the wicked and detestable practices of the people of Israel, for they will fall by the sword, famine and plague.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord God : "Clap your hands and stamp your foot and say, Alas, because of all the evil abominations of the house of Israel, for they shall fall by the sword, by famine, and by pestilence.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Thus says the Lord God: "Pound your fists and stamp your feet, and say, ‘Alas, for all the evil abominations of the house of Israel! For they shall fall by the sword, by famine, and by pestilence.
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Clap your hands in horror, and stamp your feet. Cry out because of all the detestable sins the people of Israel have committed. Now they are going to die from war and famine and disease.
verses.textEnNasb: "This is what the Lord God says: ‘Clap your hands, stamp your foot and say, "Woe, because of all the evil abominations of the house of Israel, which will fall by the sword, famine, and plague!
verses.textEn: " ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Strike your hands together and stamp your feet and cry out "Alas!" because of all the wicked and detestable practices of the people of Israel, for they will fall by the sword, famine and plague.

verses.textZh: 在远处的必因瘟疫死亡，在近处的必倒在刀剑之下，那余下被围困的也必因饥荒死亡。我必这样在他们身上完全发尽我的烈怒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在远处的必因瘟疫死亡，在近处的必倒在刀剑之下，那余下被围困的也必因饥荒死亡。我必这样在他们身上完全发尽我的烈怒。
verses.textZhCuv: 在远处的，必遭瘟疫而死；在近处的，必倒在刀剑之下；那存留被围困的，必因饥荒而死；我必这样在他们身上成就我怒中所定的。
verses.textEnNiv: One who is far away will die of the plague, and one who is near will fall by the sword, and anyone who survives and is spared will die of famine. So will I pour out my wrath on them.
verses.textEnEsv: He who is far off shall die of pestilence, and he who is near shall fall by the sword, and he who is left and is preserved shall die of famine. Thus I will spend my fury upon them.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who is far off shall die by the pestilence, he who is near shall fall by the sword, and he who remains and is besieged shall die by the famine. Thus will I spend My fury upon them.
verses.textEnNlt: Disease will strike down those who are far away in exile. War will destroy those who are nearby. And anyone who survives will be killed by famine. So at last I will spend my fury on them.
verses.textEnNasb: Anyone who is far away will die by the plague, anyone who is near will fall by the sword, and anyone who remains and is spared from these will die by the famine. So I will expend My wrath on them.
verses.textEn: One who is far away will die of the plague, and one who is near will fall by the sword, and anyone who survives and is spared will die of famine. So will I pour out my wrath on them.

verses.textZh: 他们被杀的人倒在他们偶像的中间，在他们祭坛的周围，就是在各高冈各山顶上，在每一棵翠绿的树下和茂盛的橡树下，就是他们献馨香的祭给一切偶像的地方。那时，他们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们被杀的人倒在他们偶像的中间，在他们祭坛的周围，就是在各高冈各山顶上，在每一棵翠绿的树下和茂盛的橡树下，就是他们献馨香的祭给一切偶像的地方。那时，他们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们被杀的人倒在他们祭坛四围的偶像中，就是各高冈、各山顶、各青翠树下、各茂密的橡树下，乃是他们献馨香的祭牲给一切偶像的地方。那时，他们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: And they will know that I am the Lord , when their people lie slain among their idols around their altars, on every high hill and on all the mountaintops, under every spreading tree and every leafy oak—places where they offered fragrant incense to all their idols.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall know that I am the Lord , when their slain lie among their idols around their altars, on every high hill, on all the mountaintops, under every green tree, and under every leafy oak, wherever they offered pleasing aroma to all their idols.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then you shall know that I am the Lord, when their slain are among their idols all around their altars, on every high hill, on all the mountaintops, under every green tree, and under every thick oak, wherever they offered sweet incense to all their idols.
verses.textEnNlt: They will know that I am the Lord when their dead lie scattered among their idols and altars on every hill and mountain and under every green tree and every great shade tree—the places where they offered sacrifices to their idols.
verses.textEnNasb: Then you will know that I am the Lord, when their dead are among their idols around their altars, on every high hill, on all the tops of the mountains, under every leafy tree and under every massive oak with thick branches—the places where they offered a soothing aroma to all their idols.
verses.textEn: And they will know that I am the Lord , when their people lie slain among their idols around their altars, on every high hill and on all the mountaintops, under every spreading tree and every leafy oak—places where they offered fragrant incense to all their idols.

verses.textZh: 我必伸手攻击他们，使他们一切居住的地方，从旷野到第伯拉他，都变成非常荒凉，他们就知道我是耶和华。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必伸手攻击他们，使他们一切居住的地方，从旷野到第伯拉他，都变成非常荒凉，他们就知道我是耶和华。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我必伸手攻击他们，使他们的地从旷野到第伯拉他一切住处极其荒凉，他们就知道我是耶和华。」
verses.textEnNiv: And I will stretch out my hand against them and make the land a desolate waste from the desert to Diblah —wherever they live. Then they will know that I am the Lord .’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And I will stretch out my hand against them and make the land desolate and waste, in all their dwelling places, from the wilderness to Riblah. Then they will know that I am the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: So I will stretch out My hand against them and make the land desolate, yes, more desolate than the wilderness toward Diblah, in all their dwelling places. Then they shall know that I am the Lord.’ " ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: I will crush them and make their cities desolate from the wilderness in the south to Riblah in the north. Then they will know that I am the Lord ."
verses.textEnNasb: So through all their dwelling places I will stretch out My hand against them and make the land more desolate and waste than the wilderness toward Diblah; so they will know that I am the Lord." ’ "
verses.textEn: And I will stretch out my hand against them and make the land a desolate waste from the desert to Diblah —wherever they live. Then they will know that I am the Lord .’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then this message came to me from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: The word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: "人子啊！主耶和华对以色列地这样说： ‘终局到了！终局临到这地的四境了！
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！主耶和华对以色列地这样说： ‘终局到了！终局临到这地的四境了！
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，主耶和华对以色列地如此说：结局到了，结局到了地的四境！
verses.textEnNiv: "Son of man, this is what the Sovereign Lord says to the land of Israel: " ‘The end! The end has come upon the four corners of the land!
verses.textEnEsv: "And you, O son of man, thus says the Lord God to the land of Israel: An end! The end has come upon the four corners of the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And you, son of man, thus says the Lord God to the land of Israel: ‘An end! The end has come upon the four corners of the land.
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, this is what the Sovereign Lord says to Israel: "The end is here! Wherever you look— east, west, north, or south— your land is finished.
verses.textEnNasb: "And you, son of man, this is what the Lord God says to the land of Israel: ‘An end! The end is coming on the four corners of the land.
verses.textEn: "Son of man, this is what the Sovereign Lord says to the land of Israel: " ‘The end! The end has come upon the four corners of the land!

verses.textZh: 现在终局已经临到你了。 我要发怒攻击你， 按着你的行为审判你，照着你一切可憎的事报应你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在终局已经临到你了。 我要发怒攻击你， 按着你的行为审判你，照着你一切可憎的事报应你。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在你的结局已经临到，我必使我的怒气归与你，也必按你的行为审判你，照你一切可憎的事刑罚你。
verses.textEnNiv: The end is now upon you, and I will unleash my anger against you. I will judge you according to your conduct and repay you for all your detestable practices.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the end is upon you, and I will send my anger upon you; I will judge you according to your ways, and I will punish you for all your abominations.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the end hascome upon you, And I will send My anger against you; I will judge you according to your ways, And I will repay you for all your abominations.
verses.textEnNlt: No hope remains, for I will unleash my anger against you. I will call you to account for all your detestable sins.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the end is upon you, for I will send My anger against you; I will judge you according to your ways and bring all your abominations upon you.
verses.textEn: The end is now upon you, and I will unleash my anger against you. I will judge you according to your conduct and repay you for all your detestable practices.

verses.textZh: 我的眼必不顾惜你，我也不怜恤你， 我却要按着你的行为，照着你中间可憎的事报应你， 你们就知道我是耶和华。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的眼必不顾惜你，我也不怜恤你， 我却要按着你的行为，照着你中间可憎的事报应你， 你们就知道我是耶和华。’
verses.textZhCuv: 我眼必不顾惜你，也不可怜你，却要按你所行的报应你，照你中间可憎的事刑罚你。你就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: I will not look on you with pity; I will not spare you. I will surely repay you for your conduct and for the detestable practices among you. " ‘Then you will know that I am the Lord .’
verses.textEnEsv: And my eye will not spare you, nor will I have pity, but I will punish you for your ways, while your abominations are in your midst. Then you will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: My eye will not spare you, Nor will I have pity; But I will repay your ways, And your abominations will be in your midst; Then you shall know that I am the Lord!’
verses.textEnNlt: I will turn my eyes away and show no pity. I will repay you for all your detestable sins. Then you will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: And My eye will have no pity on you, nor will I spare you, but I will bring your ways upon you, and your abominations will be among you; then you will know that I am the Lord!’
verses.textEn: I will not look on you with pity; I will not spare you. I will surely repay you for your conduct and for the detestable practices among you. " ‘Then you will know that I am the Lord .’

verses.textZh: 主耶和华这样说： ‘看哪，灾祸，独特的灾祸，临到了！
verses.textZhCnvs: 主耶和华这样说： ‘看哪，灾祸，独特的灾祸，临到了！
verses.textZhCuv: 「主耶和华如此说：有一灾，独有一灾；看哪，临近了！
verses.textEnNiv: "This is what the Sovereign Lord says: " ‘Disaster! Unheard-of disaster! See, it comes!
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord God : Disaster after disaster! Behold, it comes.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus says the Lord God: ‘A disaster, a singular disaster; Behold, it has come!
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Disaster after disaster is coming your way!
verses.textEnNasb: "This is what the Lord God says: ‘A disaster, a unique disaster, behold, it is coming!
verses.textEn: "This is what the Sovereign Lord says: " ‘Disaster! Unheard-of disaster! See, it comes!

verses.textZh: 终局到了，终局临到了，它已经起来跟你作对。 看哪，它临到了！
verses.textZhCnvs: 终局到了，终局临到了，它已经起来跟你作对。 看哪，它临到了！
verses.textZhCuv: 结局来了，结局来了，向你兴起。看哪，来到了！
verses.textEnNiv: The end has come! The end has come! It has roused itself against you. See, it comes!
verses.textEnEsv: An end has come; the end has come; it has awakened against you. Behold, it comes.
verses.textEnNkjv: An end has come, The end has come; It has dawned for you; Behold, it has come!
verses.textEnNlt: The end has come. It has finally arrived. Your final doom is waiting!
verses.textEnNasb: An end is coming; the end has come! It has awakened against you; behold, it has come!
verses.textEn: The end has come! The end has come! It has roused itself against you. See, it comes!

verses.textZh: 这地的居民哪，灾害临到你了！ 时候到了，日子近了， 是混乱喧嚷的日子，不是山上欢呼的日子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这地的居民哪，灾害临到你了！ 时候到了，日子近了， 是混乱喧嚷的日子，不是山上欢呼的日子。
verses.textZhCuv: 境内的居民哪，所定的灾临到你，时候到了，日子近了，乃是哄嚷并非在山上欢呼的日子。
verses.textEnNiv: Doom has come upon you, upon you who dwell in the land. The time has come! The day is near! There is panic, not joy, on the mountains.
verses.textEnEsv: Your doom has come to you, O inhabitant of the land. The time has come; the day is near, a day of tumult, and not of joyful shouting on the mountains.
verses.textEnNkjv: Doom has come to you, you who dwell in the land; The time has come, A day of trouble is near, And not of rejoicing in the mountains.
verses.textEnNlt: O people of Israel, the day of your destruction is dawning. The time has come; the day of trouble is near. Shouts of anguish will be heard on the mountains, not shouts of joy.
verses.textEnNasb: Your doom has come to you, you inhabitant of the land. The time has come, the day is near—panic rather than joyful shouting on the mountains.
verses.textEn: Doom has come upon you, upon you who dwell in the land. The time has come! The day is near! There is panic, not joy, on the mountains.

verses.textZh: 现在我快要把我的烈怒倒在你身上， 向你完全发尽我的怒气。 我要按着你的行为审判你， 照着你一切可憎的事报应你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在我快要把我的烈怒倒在你身上， 向你完全发尽我的怒气。 我要按着你的行为审判你， 照着你一切可憎的事报应你。
verses.textZhCuv: 我快要将我的忿怒倾在你身上，向你成就我怒中所定的，按你的行为审判你，照你一切可憎的事刑罚你。
verses.textEnNiv: I am about to pour out my wrath on you and spend my anger against you. I will judge you according to your conduct and repay you for all your detestable practices.
verses.textEnEsv: Now I will soon pour out my wrath upon you, and spend my anger against you, and judge you according to your ways, and I will punish you for all your abominations.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now upon you I will soon pour out My fury, And spend My anger upon you; I will judge you according to your ways, And I will repay you for all your abominations.
verses.textEnNlt: Soon I will pour out my fury on you and unleash my anger against you. I will call you to account for all your detestable sins.
verses.textEnNasb: Now I will shortly pour out My wrath on you and expend My anger against you; I will judge you according to your ways and bring on you all your abominations.
verses.textEn: I am about to pour out my wrath on you and spend my anger against you. I will judge you according to your conduct and repay you for all your detestable practices.

verses.textZh: 我的眼必不顾惜，我也不怜恤。我却要按着你的行为， 照着你中间可憎的事报应你， 你们就知道击打你们的是我耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的眼必不顾惜，我也不怜恤。我却要按着你的行为， 照着你中间可憎的事报应你， 你们就知道击打你们的是我耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 我眼必不顾惜你，也不可怜你，必按你所行的报应你，照你中间可憎的事刑罚你。你就知道击打你的是我耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: I will not look on you with pity; I will not spare you. I will repay you for your conduct and for the detestable practices among you. " ‘Then you will know that it is I the Lord who strikes you.
verses.textEnEsv: And my eye will not spare, nor will I have pity. I will punish you according to your ways, while your abominations are in your midst. Then you will know that I am the Lord , who strikes.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘My eye will not spare, Nor will I have pity; I will repay you according to your ways, And your abominations will be in your midst. Then you shall know that I am the Lord who strikes.
verses.textEnNlt: I will turn my eyes away and show no pity. I will repay you for all your detestable sins. Then you will know that it is I, the Lord , who is striking the blow.
verses.textEnNasb: My eye will have no pity nor will I spare you. I will repay you according to your ways, while your abominations are in your midst; then you will know that I, the Lord, am striking.
verses.textEn: I will not look on you with pity; I will not spare you. I will repay you for your conduct and for the detestable practices among you. " ‘Then you will know that it is I the Lord who strikes you.

verses.textZh: "‘看哪，这日子到了！ 灾害已经发出， 杖已经开花， 狂傲已经发芽。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘看哪，这日子到了！ 灾害已经发出， 杖已经开花， 狂傲已经发芽。
verses.textZhCuv: 「看哪，看哪，日子快到了；所定的灾已经发出！杖已经开花，骄傲已经发芽。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘See, the day! See, it comes! Doom has burst forth, the rod has budded, arrogance has blossomed!
verses.textEnEsv: "Behold, the day! Behold, it comes! Your doom has come; the rod has blossomed; pride has budded.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Behold, the day! Behold, it has come! Doom has gone out; The rod has blossomed, Pride has budded.
verses.textEnNlt: "The day of judgment is here; your destruction awaits! The people’s wickedness and pride have blossomed to full flower.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Behold, the day! Behold, it is coming! Your doom has gone forth; the rod has budded, arrogance has blossomed.
verses.textEn: " ‘See, the day! See, it comes! Doom has burst forth, the rod has budded, arrogance has blossomed!

verses.textZh: 强暴兴起，成了惩罚邪恶的杖， 他们无一存留，他们的群众都不在了。 他们的财富没有了，他们中间也没有尊荣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 强暴兴起，成了惩罚邪恶的杖， 他们无一存留，他们的群众都不在了。 他们的财富没有了，他们中间也没有尊荣。
verses.textZhCuv: 强暴兴起，成了罚恶的杖。以色列人，或是他们的群众，或是他们的财宝，无一存留；他们中间也没有得尊荣的。
verses.textEnNiv: Violence has arisen, a rod to punish the wicked. None of the people will be left, none of that crowd— none of their wealth, nothing of value.
verses.textEnEsv: Violence has grown up into a rod of wickedness. None of them shall remain, nor their abundance, nor their wealth; neither shall there be preeminence among them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Violence has risen up into a rod of wickedness; None of them shallremain, None of their multitude, None of them; Nor shalltherebe wailing for them.
verses.textEnNlt: Their violence has grown into a rod that will beat them for their wickedness. None of these proud and wicked people will survive. All their wealth and prestige will be swept away.
verses.textEnNasb: Violence has grown into a rod of wickedness. None of them shall remain, none of their people, none of their wealth, nor anything eminent among them.
verses.textEn: Violence has arisen, a rod to punish the wicked. None of the people will be left, none of that crowd— none of their wealth, nothing of value.

verses.textZh: 时候到了，日子近了， 买的不必欢喜，卖的不用忧愁； 因为烈怒要临到众人身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 时候到了，日子近了， 买的不必欢喜，卖的不用忧愁； 因为烈怒要临到众人身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 时候到了，日子近了，买主不可欢喜，卖主不可愁烦，因为烈怒已经临到他们众人身上。
verses.textEnNiv: The time has come! The day has arrived! Let not the buyer rejoice nor the seller grieve, for my wrath is on the whole crowd.
verses.textEnEsv: The time has come; the day has arrived. Let not the buyer rejoice, nor the seller mourn, for wrath is upon all their multitude.
verses.textEnNkjv: The time has come, The day draws near. ‘Let not the buyer rejoice, Nor the seller mourn, For wrath is on their whole multitude.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, the time has come; the day is here! Buyers should not rejoice over bargains, nor sellers grieve over losses, for all of them will fall under my terrible anger.
verses.textEnNasb: The time has come, the day has arrived. Let neither the buyer rejoice nor the seller mourn; for wrath is against all their multitude.
verses.textEn: The time has come! The day has arrived! Let not the buyer rejoice nor the seller grieve, for my wrath is on the whole crowd.

verses.textZh: 卖的人虽然还活着， 却不能得回所卖的。 因为这个关乎众人的异象必不更改。 因为罪孽的缘故，没有人能保全自己的性命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 卖的人虽然还活着， 却不能得回所卖的。 因为这个关乎众人的异象必不更改。 因为罪孽的缘故，没有人能保全自己的性命。
verses.textZhCuv: 卖主虽然存活，却不能归回再得所卖的，因为这异象关乎他们众人。谁都不得归回，也没有人在他的罪孽中坚立自己。」
verses.textEnNiv: The seller will not recover the property that was sold— as long as both buyer and seller live. For the vision concerning the whole crowd will not be reversed. Because of their sins, not one of them will preserve their life.
verses.textEnEsv: For the seller shall not return to what he has sold, while they live. For the vision concerns all their multitude; it shall not turn back; and because of his iniquity, none can maintain his life.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the seller shall not return to what has been sold, Though he may still be alive; For the vision concerns the whole multitude, And it shall not turn back; No one will strengthen himself Who lives in iniquity.
verses.textEnNlt: Even if the merchants survive, they will never return to their business. For what God has said applies to everyone— it will not be changed! Not one person whose life is twisted by sin will ever recover.
verses.textEnNasb: Indeed, the seller will not regain what he sold as long as they both live; for the vision regarding all their multitude will not be averted, nor will any of them maintain his life by his wrongdoing.
verses.textEn: The seller will not recover the property that was sold— as long as both buyer and seller live. For the vision concerning the whole crowd will not be reversed. Because of their sins, not one of them will preserve their life.

verses.textZh: "‘他们吹了号角，准备了一切， 却没有人出去作战； 因为我的烈怒要临到众人身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘他们吹了号角，准备了一切， 却没有人出去作战； 因为我的烈怒要临到众人身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 「他们已经吹角，预备齐全，却无一人出战，因为我的烈怒临到他们众人身上。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘They have blown the trumpet, they have made all things ready, but no one will go into battle, for my wrath is on the whole crowd.
verses.textEnEsv: "They have blown the trumpet and made everything ready, but none goes to battle, for my wrath is upon all their multitude.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘They have blown the trumpet and made everyone ready, But no one goes to battle; For My wrath is on all their multitude.
verses.textEnNlt: "The trumpet calls Israel’s army to mobilize, but no one listens, for my fury is against them all.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘They have blown the trumpet and made everything ready, but no one is going to the battle, for My wrath is against all their multitude.
verses.textEn: " ‘They have blown the trumpet, they have made all things ready, but no one will go into battle, for my wrath is on the whole crowd.

verses.textZh: 城外有刀剑，城内有瘟疫和饥荒； 在田野的必死在刀下，在城里的必被饥荒和瘟疫吞灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 城外有刀剑，城内有瘟疫和饥荒； 在田野的必死在刀下，在城里的必被饥荒和瘟疫吞灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 在外有刀剑；在内有瘟疫、饥荒。在田野的，必遭刀剑而死；在城中的，必有饥荒、瘟疫吞灭他。
verses.textEnNiv: Outside is the sword; inside are plague and famine. Those in the country will die by the sword; those in the city will be devoured by famine and plague.
verses.textEnEsv: The sword is without; pestilence and famine are within. He who is in the field dies by the sword, and him who is in the city famine and pestilence devour.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sword is outside, And the pestilence and famine within. Whoever is in the field Will die by the sword; And whoever is in the city, Famine and pestilence will devour him.
verses.textEnNlt: There is war outside the city and disease and famine within. Those outside the city walls will be killed by enemy swords. Those inside the city will die of famine and disease.
verses.textEnNasb: The sword is outside the city and the plague and the famine are within. Anyone who is in the field will die by the sword, while famine and the plague will consume those in the city.
verses.textEn: Outside is the sword; inside are plague and famine. Those in the country will die by the sword; those in the city will be devoured by famine and plague.

verses.textZh: 他们中间逃脱的，必因自己的罪孽在山上发出哀声， 像谷中的鸽子哀鸣一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们中间逃脱的，必因自己的罪孽在山上发出哀声， 像谷中的鸽子哀鸣一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 其中所逃脱的就必逃脱，各人因自己的罪孽在山上发出悲声，好像谷中的鸽子哀鸣。
verses.textEnNiv: The fugitives who escape will flee to the mountains. Like doves of the valleys, they will all moan, each for their own sins.
verses.textEnEsv: And if any survivors escape, they will be on the mountains, like doves of the valleys, all of them moaning, each one over his iniquity.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Those who survive will escape and be on the mountains Like doves of the valleys, All of them mourning, Each for his iniquity.
verses.textEnNlt: The survivors who escape to the mountains will moan like doves, weeping for their sins.
verses.textEnNasb: Even when their survivors escape, they will be on the mountains like doves of the valleys, all of them moaning, each over his own wrongdoing.
verses.textEn: The fugitives who escape will flee to the mountains. Like doves of the valleys, they will all moan, each for their own sins.

verses.textZh: 他们的手都发软，他们的膝像水一般软弱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的手都发软，他们的膝像水一般软弱。
verses.textZhCuv: 手都发软，膝弱如水。
verses.textEnNiv: Every hand will go limp; every leg will be wet with urine.
verses.textEnEsv: All hands are feeble, and all knees turn to water.
verses.textEnNkjv: Every hand will be feeble, And every knee will be as weak as water.
verses.textEnNlt: Their hands will hang limp, their knees will be weak as water.
verses.textEnNasb: All hands will hang limp, and all knees will drip with water.
verses.textEn: Every hand will go limp; every leg will be wet with urine.

verses.textZh: 他们必用麻布束腰，战兢把他们遮盖， 各人的脸上满是羞愧，各人的头上都光秃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们必用麻布束腰，战兢把他们遮盖， 各人的脸上满是羞愧，各人的头上都光秃。
verses.textZhCuv: 要用麻布束腰，被战兢所盖；各人脸上羞愧，头上光秃。
verses.textEnNiv: They will put on sackcloth and be clothed with terror. Every face will be covered with shame, and every head will be shaved.
verses.textEnEsv: They put on sackcloth, and horror covers them. Shame is on all faces, and baldness on all their heads.
verses.textEnNkjv: They will also be girded with sackcloth; Horror will cover them; Shame willbe on every face, Baldness on all their heads.
verses.textEnNlt: They will dress themselves in burlap; horror and shame will cover them. They will shave their heads in sorrow and remorse.
verses.textEnNasb: They will put on sackcloth and shuddering will overwhelm them; and shame will be on all faces, and a bald patch on all their heads.
verses.textEn: They will put on sackcloth and be clothed with terror. Every face will be covered with shame, and every head will be shaved.

verses.textZh: 他们要把自己的银子拋在街上， 把自己的金子当作污秽之物。 在耶和华发怒的日子，他们的金银不能拯救他们， 不能满足他们的心，也不能填满他们的肚腹， 因为这些金银都成了叫他们落在罪孽里的绊脚石。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们要把自己的银子拋在街上， 把自己的金子当作污秽之物。 在耶和华发怒的日子，他们的金银不能拯救他们， 不能满足他们的心，也不能填满他们的肚腹， 因为这些金银都成了叫他们落在罪孽里的绊脚石。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们要将银子抛在街上，金子看如污秽之物。当耶和华发怒的日子，他们的金银不能救他们，不能使心里知足，也不能使肚腹饱满，因为这金银作了他们罪孽的绊脚石。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘They will throw their silver into the streets, and their gold will be treated as a thing unclean. Their silver and gold will not be able to deliver them in the day of the Lord ’s wrath. It will not satisfy their hunger or fill their stomachs, for it has caused them to stumble into sin.
verses.textEnEsv: They cast their silver into the streets, and their gold is like an unclean thing. Their silver and gold are not able to deliver them in the day of the wrath of the Lord . They cannot satisfy their hunger or fill their stomachs with it. For it was the stumbling block of their iniquity.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘They will throw their silver into the streets, And their gold will be like refuse; Their silver and their gold will not be able to deliver them In the day of the wrath of the Lord; They will not satisfy their souls, Nor fill their stomachs, Because it became their stumbling block of iniquity.
verses.textEnNlt: "They will throw their money in the streets, tossing it out like worthless trash. Their silver and gold won’t save them on that day of the Lord ’s anger. It will neither satisfy nor feed them, for their greed can only trip them up.
verses.textEnNasb: They will fling their silver into the streets, and their gold will become an abhorrent thing; their silver and their gold will not be able to save them on the day of the wrath of the Lord. They cannot satisfy their appetite, nor can they fill their stomachs, because their wrongdoing has become a cause of stumbling.
verses.textEn: " ‘They will throw their silver into the streets, and their gold will be treated as a thing unclean. Their silver and gold will not be able to deliver them in the day of the Lord ’s wrath. It will not satisfy their hunger or fill their stomachs, for it has caused them to stumble into sin.

verses.textZh: 他们以美丽的饰物为夸耀， 又用这些来铸造可憎可厌的偶像， 因此我要使它们成为污秽之物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们以美丽的饰物为夸耀， 又用这些来铸造可憎可厌的偶像， 因此我要使它们成为污秽之物。
verses.textZhCuv: 论到耶和华妆饰华美的殿，他建立得威严，他们却在其中制造可憎可厌的偶像，所以这殿我使他们看如污秽之物。
verses.textEnNiv: They took pride in their beautiful jewelry and used it to make their detestable idols. They made it into vile images; therefore I will make it a thing unclean for them.
verses.textEnEsv: His beautiful ornament they used for pride, and they made their abominable images and their detestable things of it. Therefore I make it an unclean thing to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘As for the beauty of his ornaments, He set it in majesty; But they made from it The images of their abominations— Their detestable things; Therefore I have made it Like refuse to them.
verses.textEnNlt: They were proud of their beautiful jewelry and used it to make detestable idols and vile images. Therefore, I will make all their wealth disgusting to them.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, they transformed the splendor of His jewels into pride, and they made the images of their abominations and their detestable things with it; therefore I will make it an abhorrent thing to them.
verses.textEn: They took pride in their beautiful jewelry and used it to make their detestable idols. They made it into vile images; therefore I will make it a thing unclean for them.

verses.textZh: 我要把它们交在外族人的手里作掠物， 给地上的恶人作战利品，他们必亵渎这些东西。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要把它们交在外族人的手里作掠物， 给地上的恶人作战利品，他们必亵渎这些东西。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必将这殿交付外邦人为掠物，交付地上的恶人为掳物；他们也必亵渎这殿。
verses.textEnNiv: I will give their wealth as plunder to foreigners and as loot to the wicked of the earth, who will defile it.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will give it into the hands of foreigners for prey, and to the wicked of the earth for spoil, and they shall profane it.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will give it as plunder Into the hands of strangers, And to the wicked of the earth as spoil; And they shall defile it.
verses.textEnNlt: I will give it as plunder to foreigners, to the most wicked of nations, and they will defile it.
verses.textEnNasb: And I will hand it over to the foreigners as plunder, and to the wicked of the earth as spoils; and they will profane it.
verses.textEn: I will give their wealth as plunder to foreigners and as loot to the wicked of the earth, who will defile it.

verses.textZh: 我必转脸不看他们，让他们亵渎我的圣所。 强盗要进那里去，亵渎那地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必转脸不看他们，让他们亵渎我的圣所。 强盗要进那里去，亵渎那地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必转脸不顾以色列人，他们亵渎我隐密之所，强盗也必进去亵渎。
verses.textEnNiv: I will turn my face away from the people, and robbers will desecrate the place I treasure. They will enter it and will defile it.
verses.textEnEsv: I will turn my face from them, and they shall profane my treasured place. Robbers shall enter and profane it.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will turn My face from them, And they will defile My secret place; For robbers shall enter it and defile it.
verses.textEnNlt: I will turn my eyes from them as these robbers invade and defile my treasured land.
verses.textEnNasb: I will also turn My face away from them, and they will profane My treasure; then robbers will enter and profane it.
verses.textEn: I will turn my face away from the people, and robbers will desecrate the place I treasure. They will enter it and will defile it.

verses.textZh: 你要制造锁炼， 因为这地满了血腥 ，这城满了强暴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要制造锁炼， 因为这地满了血腥 ，这城满了强暴。
verses.textZhCuv: 「要制造锁链；因为这地遍满流血的罪，城邑充满强暴的事。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Prepare chains! For the land is full of bloodshed, and the city is full of violence.
verses.textEnEsv: "Forge a chain! For the land is full of bloody crimes and the city is full of violence.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Make a chain, For the land is filled with crimes of blood, And the city is full of violence.
verses.textEnNlt: "Prepare chains for my people, for the land is bloodied by terrible crimes. Jerusalem is filled with violence.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Make the chain, for the land is full of bloody crimes, and the city is full of violence.
verses.textEn: " ‘Prepare chains! For the land is full of bloodshed, and the city is full of violence.

verses.textZh: 我要使列国中最凶恶的人来占领他们的房屋； 我要止息强盛者的骄傲，他们的圣所都被亵渎。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要使列国中最凶恶的人来占领他们的房屋； 我要止息强盛者的骄傲，他们的圣所都被亵渎。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，我必使列国中最恶的人来占据他们的房屋；我必使强暴人的骄傲止息，他们的圣所都要被亵渎。
verses.textEnNiv: I will bring the most wicked of nations to take possession of their houses. I will put an end to the pride of the mighty, and their sanctuaries will be desecrated.
verses.textEnEsv: I will bring the worst of the nations to take possession of their houses. I will put an end to the pride of the strong, and their holy places shall be profaned.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I will bring the worst of the Gentiles, And they will possess their houses; I will cause the pomp of the strong to cease, And their holy places shall be defiled.
