verses.textEnNlt: I will bring the most ruthless of nations to occupy their homes. I will break down their proud fortresses and defile their sanctuaries.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, I will bring the worst of the nations, and they will take possession of their houses. I will also put an end to the pride of the strong ones, and their holy places will be profaned.
verses.textEn: I will bring the most wicked of nations to take possession of their houses. I will put an end to the pride of the mighty, and their sanctuaries will be desecrated.

verses.textZh: 惊恐临到，他们就求平安，却得不着。
verses.textZhCnvs: 惊恐临到，他们就求平安，却得不着。
verses.textZhCuv: 毁灭临近了；他们要求平安，却无平安可得。
verses.textEnNiv: When terror comes, they will seek peace in vain.
verses.textEnEsv: When anguish comes, they will seek peace, but there shall be none.
verses.textEnNkjv: Destruction comes; They will seek peace, but thereshallbe none.
verses.textEnNlt: Terror and trembling will overcome my people. They will look for peace but not find it.
verses.textEnNasb: When anguish comes, they will seek peace, but there will be none.
verses.textEn: When terror comes, they will seek peace in vain.

verses.textZh: 灾祸加上灾祸，坏消息加上坏消息，不绝而来， 他们要向先知求异象， 但是，祭司的教训、长老的指导，都必断绝，
verses.textZhCnvs: 灾祸加上灾祸，坏消息加上坏消息，不绝而来， 他们要向先知求异象， 但是，祭司的教训、长老的指导，都必断绝，
verses.textZhCuv: 灾害加上灾害，风声接连风声；他们必向先知求异象，但祭司讲的律法、长老设的谋略都必断绝。
verses.textEnNiv: Calamity upon calamity will come, and rumor upon rumor. They will go searching for a vision from the prophet, priestly instruction in the law will cease, the counsel of the elders will come to an end.
verses.textEnEsv: Disaster comes upon disaster; rumor follows rumor. They seek a vision from the prophet, while the law perishes from the priest and counsel from the elders.
verses.textEnNkjv: Disaster will come upon disaster, And rumor will be upon rumor. Then they will seek a vision from a prophet; But the law will perish from the priest, And counsel from the elders.
verses.textEnNlt: Calamity will follow calamity; rumor will follow rumor. They will look in vain for a vision from the prophets. They will receive no teaching from the priests and no counsel from the leaders.
verses.textEnNasb: Disaster will come upon disaster and rumor will be added to rumor; then they will seek a vision from a prophet, but the Law will be lost from the priest, and counsel from the elders.
verses.textEn: Calamity upon calamity will come, and rumor upon rumor. They will go searching for a vision from the prophet, priestly instruction in the law will cease, the counsel of the elders will come to an end.

verses.textZh: 君王要悲哀，官长要把凄凉当作衣服穿上， 那地人民的手都要发颤。 我要按着他们的行为待他们，按着他们审判的法则审判他们，他们就知道我是耶和华。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 君王要悲哀，官长要把凄凉当作衣服穿上， 那地人民的手都要发颤。 我要按着他们的行为待他们，按着他们审判的法则审判他们，他们就知道我是耶和华。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 君要悲哀，王要披凄凉为衣，国民的手都发颤。我必照他们的行为待他们，按他们应得的审判他们，他们就知道我是耶和华。」
verses.textEnNiv: The king will mourn, the prince will be clothed with despair, and the hands of the people of the land will tremble. I will deal with them according to their conduct, and by their own standards I will judge them. " ‘Then they will know that I am the Lord .’ "
verses.textEnEsv: The king mourns, the prince is wrapped in despair, and the hands of the people of the land are paralyzed by terror. According to their way I will do to them, and according to their judgments I will judge them, and they shall know that I am the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘The king will mourn, The prince will be clothed with desolation, And the hands of the common people will tremble. I will do to them according to their way, And according to what they deserve I will judge them; Then they shall know that I am the Lord!’ "
verses.textEnNlt: The king and the prince will stand helpless, weeping in despair, and the people’s hands will tremble with fear. I will bring on them the evil they have done to others, and they will receive the punishment they so richly deserve. Then they will know that I am the Lord ."
verses.textEnNasb: The king will mourn, the prince will be clothed in horror, and the hands of the people of the land will tremble. I will deal with them because of their conduct, and by their judgments I will judge them. And they will know that I am the Lord.’ "
verses.textEn: The king will mourn, the prince will be clothed with despair, and the hands of the people of the land will tremble. I will deal with them according to their conduct, and by their own standards I will judge them. " ‘Then they will know that I am the Lord .’ "

verses.textZh: 第六年六月五日，我坐在家中，犹大的众长老也坐在我面前，在那里主耶和华的灵降在我身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第六年六月五日，我坐在家中，犹大的众长老也坐在我面前，在那里主耶和华的灵降在我身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 第六年六月初五日，我坐在家中；犹大的众长老坐在我面前。在那里主耶和华的灵 降在我身上。
verses.textEnNiv: In the sixth year, in the sixth month on the fifth day, while I was sitting in my house and the elders of Judah were sitting before me, the hand of the Sovereign Lord came on me there.
verses.textEnEsv: In the sixth year, in the sixth month, on the fifth day of the month, as I sat in my house, with the elders of Judah sitting before me, the hand of the Lord God fell upon me there.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass in the sixth year, in the sixth month, on the fifth day of the month, as I sat in my house with the elders of Judah sitting before me, that the hand of the Lord God fell upon me there.
verses.textEnNlt: Then on September 17, during the sixth year of King Jehoiachin’s captivity, while the leaders of Judah were in my home, the Sovereign Lord took hold of me.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about in the sixth year, on the fifth day of the sixth month, as I was sitting in my house with the elders of Judah sitting before me, that the hand of the Lord God fell upon me there.
verses.textEn: In the sixth year, in the sixth month on the fifth day, while I was sitting in my house and the elders of Judah were sitting before me, the hand of the Sovereign Lord came on me there.

verses.textZh: 我观看，见有一形状好象人 的样子，在那仿佛是他腰部以下，有火的样子，在那仿佛是他腰部的以上有光辉的样子，好象闪耀的金属。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我观看，见有一形状好象人 的样子，在那仿佛是他腰部以下，有火的样子，在那仿佛是他腰部的以上有光辉的样子，好象闪耀的金属。
verses.textZhCuv: 我观看，见有形象仿佛火的形状，从他腰以下的形状有火，从他腰以上有光辉的形状，仿佛光耀的精金。
verses.textEnNiv: I looked, and I saw a figure like that of a man. From what appeared to be his waist down he was like fire, and from there up his appearance was as bright as glowing metal.
verses.textEnEsv: Then I looked, and behold, a form that had the appearance of a man. Below what appeared to be his waist was fire, and above his waist was something like the appearance of brightness, like gleaming metal.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I looked, and there was a likeness, like the appearance of fire—from the appearance of His waist and downward, fire; and from His waist and upward, like the appearance of brightness, like the color of amber.
verses.textEnNlt: I saw a figure that appeared to be a man. From what appeared to be his waist down, he looked like a burning flame. From the waist up he looked like gleaming amber.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I looked, and behold, something like the appearance of a man; from His waist and downward there was the appearance of fire, and from His waist and upward like the appearance of a glow, like gleaming metal.
verses.textEn: I looked, and I saw a figure like that of a man. From what appeared to be his waist down he was like fire, and from there up his appearance was as bright as glowing metal.

verses.textZh: 他伸出一只形状像手的东西，抓住我的一绺头发；灵就把我提到天地之间，在神的异象中，他把我带往耶路撒冷，到圣殿北门内院的入口处，在那里有令神愤恨的偶像的座位，就是触动神愤恨的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他伸出一只形状像手的东西，抓住我的一绺头发；灵就把我提到天地之间，在神的异象中，他把我带往耶路撒冷，到圣殿北门内院的入口处，在那里有令神愤恨的偶像的座位，就是触动神愤恨的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他伸出仿佛一只手的样式，抓住我的一绺头发，灵就将我举到天地中间，在神的异象中，带我到耶路撒冷朝北的内院门口，在那里有触动主怒偶像的坐位，就是惹动忌邪的。
verses.textEnNiv: He stretched out what looked like a hand and took me by the hair of my head. The Spirit lifted me up between earth and heaven and in visions of God he took me to Jerusalem, to the entrance of the north gate of the inner court, where the idol that provokes to jealousy stood.
verses.textEnEsv: He put out the form of a hand and took me by a lock of my head, and the Spirit lifted me up between earth and heaven and brought me in visions of God to Jerusalem, to the entrance of the gateway of the inner court that faces north, where was the seat of the image of jealousy, which provokes to jealousy.
verses.textEnNkjv: He stretched out the form of a hand, and took me by a lock of my hair; and the Spirit lifted me up between earth and heaven, and brought me in visions of God to Jerusalem, to the door of the north gate of the inner court, where the seat of the image of jealousy was, which provokes to jealousy.
verses.textEnNlt: He reached out what seemed to be a hand and took me by the hair. Then the Spirit lifted me up into the sky and transported me to Jerusalem in a vision from God. I was taken to the north gate of the inner courtyard of the Temple, where there is a large idol that has made the Lord very jealous.
verses.textEnNasb: And He extended the form of a hand and took me by the hair of my head; and the Spirit lifted me up between earth and heaven and brought me in the visions of God to Jerusalem, to the entrance of the north gate of the inner courtyard, where the seat of the idol of jealousy, which provokes to jealousy, was located.
verses.textEn: He stretched out what looked like a hand and took me by the hair of my head. The Spirit lifted me up between earth and heaven and in visions of God he took me to Jerusalem, to the entrance of the north gate of the inner court, where the idol that provokes to jealousy stood.

verses.textZh: 不料，在那里有以色列神的荣耀，形状与我在平原所见的一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不料，在那里有以色列神的荣耀，形状与我在平原所见的一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 谁知，在那里有以色列神的荣耀，形状与我在平原所见的一样。
verses.textEnNiv: And there before me was the glory of the God of Israel, as in the vision I had seen in the plain.
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, the glory of the God of Israel was there, like the vision that I saw in the valley.
verses.textEnNkjv: And behold, the glory of the God of Israel was there, like the vision that I saw in the plain.
verses.textEnNlt: Suddenly, the glory of the God of Israel was there, just as I had seen it before in the valley.
verses.textEnNasb: And behold, the glory of the God of Israel was there, like the appearance which I saw in the plain.
verses.textEn: And there before me was the glory of the God of Israel, as in the vision I had seen in the plain.

verses.textZh: 他对我说："人子啊！举目向北观看。"我就举目向北观看，见祭坛门的北面，在入口的地方，有令神愤恨的偶像。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他对我说："人子啊！举目向北观看。"我就举目向北观看，见祭坛门的北面，在入口的地方，有令神愤恨的偶像。
verses.textZhCuv: 神对我说：「人子啊，你举目向北观看。」我就举目向北观看，见祭坛门的北边，在门口有这惹忌邪的偶像；
verses.textEnNiv: Then he said to me, "Son of man, look toward the north." So I looked, and in the entrance north of the gate of the altar I saw this idol of jealousy.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he said to me, "Son of man, lift up your eyes now toward the north." So I lifted up my eyes toward the north, and behold, north of the altar gate, in the entrance, was this image of jealousy.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He said to me, "Son of man, lift your eyes now toward the north." So I lifted my eyes toward the north, and there, north of the altar gate, was this image of jealousy in the entrance.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to me, "Son of man, look toward the north." So I looked, and there to the north, beside the entrance to the gate near the altar, stood the idol that had made the Lord so jealous.
verses.textEnNasb: Then He said to me, "Son of man, raise your eyes now toward the north." So I raised my eyes toward the north, and behold, to the north of the altar gate was this idol of jealousy at the entrance.
verses.textEn: Then he said to me, "Son of man, look toward the north." So I looked, and in the entrance north of the gate of the altar I saw this idol of jealousy.

verses.textZh: 他又对我说："人子啊！以色列家在这里所行的，就是他们行这极其可憎的事，使我远离我的圣所，你看见了吗？但你还要看见更加可憎的事。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又对我说："人子啊！以色列家在这里所行的，就是他们行这极其可憎的事，使我远离我的圣所，你看见了吗？但你还要看见更加可憎的事。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又对我说：「人子啊，以色列家所行的，就是在此行这大可憎的事，使我远离我的圣所，你看见了吗？你还要看见另有大可憎的事。」
verses.textEnNiv: And he said to me, "Son of man, do you see what they are doing—the utterly detestable things the Israelites are doing here, things that will drive me far from my sanctuary? But you will see things that are even more detestable."
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to me, "Son of man, do you see what they are doing, the great abominations that the house of Israel are committing here, to drive me far from my sanctuary? But you will see still greater abominations."
verses.textEnNkjv: Furthermore He said to me, "Son of man, do you see what they are doing, the great abominations that the house of Israel commits here, to make Me go far away from My sanctuary? Now turn again, you will see greater abominations."
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man," he said, "do you see what they are doing? Do you see the detestable sins the people of Israel are committing to drive me from my Temple? But come, and you will see even more detestable sins than these!"
verses.textEnNasb: And He said to me, "Son of man, do you see what they are doing, the great abominations which the house of Israel are committing here, so that I would be far from My sanctuary? But yet you will see still greater abominations!"
verses.textEn: And he said to me, "Son of man, do you see what they are doing—the utterly detestable things the Israelites are doing here, things that will drive me far from my sanctuary? But you will see things that are even more detestable."

verses.textZh: 他领我到院子的门口；我观看，见墙上有一个洞。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他领我到院子的门口；我观看，见墙上有一个洞。
verses.textZhCuv: 他领我到院门口。我观看，见墙上有个窟窿。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he brought me to the entrance to the court. I looked, and I saw a hole in the wall.
verses.textEnEsv: And he brought me to the entrance of the court, and when I looked, behold, there was a hole in the wall.
verses.textEnNkjv: So He brought me to the door of the court; and when I looked, there was a hole in the wall.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he brought me to the door of the Temple courtyard, where I could see a hole in the wall.
verses.textEnNasb: Then He brought me to the entrance of the courtyard, and when I looked, behold, a hole in the wall.
verses.textEn: Then he brought me to the entrance to the court. I looked, and I saw a hole in the wall.

verses.textZh: 他对我说："人子啊，挖墙吧！"我就挖墙，不料，见有一道门。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他对我说："人子啊，挖墙吧！"我就挖墙，不料，见有一道门。
verses.textZhCuv: 他对我说：「人子啊，你要挖墙。」我一挖墙，见有一门。
verses.textEnNiv: He said to me, "Son of man, now dig into the wall." So I dug into the wall and saw a doorway there.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he said to me, "Son of man, dig in the wall." So I dug in the wall, and behold, there was an entrance.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He said to me, "Son of man, dig into the wall"; and when I dug into the wall, there was a door.
verses.textEnNlt: He said to me, "Now, son of man, dig into the wall." So I dug into the wall and found a hidden doorway.
verses.textEnNasb: And He said to me, "Son of man, now dig through the wall." So I dug through the wall, and behold, an entrance.
verses.textEn: He said to me, "Son of man, now dig into the wall." So I dug into the wall and saw a doorway there.

verses.textZh: 他对我说："你进去，看看他们在这里所行可憎的恶事。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他对我说："你进去，看看他们在这里所行可憎的恶事。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他说：「你进去，看他们在这里所行可憎的恶事。」
verses.textEnNiv: And he said to me, "Go in and see the wicked and detestable things they are doing here."
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to me, "Go in, and see the vile abominations that they are committing here."
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said to me, "Go in, and see the wicked abominations which they are doing there."
verses.textEnNlt: "Go in," he said, "and see the wicked and detestable sins they are committing in there!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then He said to me, "Go in and see the wicked abominations that they are committing here."
verses.textEn: And he said to me, "Go in and see the wicked and detestable things they are doing here."

verses.textZh: 于是我进去观看，见四围的墙上刻着各种形状的爬行的动物，和可憎恶的走兽，以及以色列家所有的偶像。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是我进去观看，见四围的墙上刻着各种形状的爬行的动物，和可憎恶的走兽，以及以色列家所有的偶像。
verses.textZhCuv: 我进去一看，谁知，在四面墙上画着各样爬物和可憎的走兽，并以色列家一切的偶像。
verses.textEnNiv: So I went in and looked, and I saw portrayed all over the walls all kinds of crawling things and unclean animals and all the idols of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: So I went in and saw. And there, engraved on the wall all around, was every form of creeping things and loathsome beasts, and all the idols of the house of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: So I went in and saw, and there—every sort of creeping thing, abominable beasts, and all the idols of the house of Israel, portrayed all around on the walls.
verses.textEnNlt: So I went in and saw the walls covered with engravings of all kinds of crawling animals and detestable creatures. I also saw the various idols worshiped by the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: So I entered and looked, and behold, every form of crawling things and animals and detestable things, with all the idols of the house of Israel, were carved on the wall all around.
verses.textEn: So I went in and looked, and I saw portrayed all over the walls all kinds of crawling things and unclean animals and all the idols of Israel.

verses.textZh: 站在这些像面前的有以色列家的七十个长老，沙番的儿子雅撒尼亚也站在他们中间；各人手里拿着自己的香炉，香的烟往上升。
verses.textZhCnvs: 站在这些像面前的有以色列家的七十个长老，沙番的儿子雅撒尼亚也站在他们中间；各人手里拿着自己的香炉，香的烟往上升。
verses.textZhCuv: 在这些像前有以色列家的七十个长老站立，沙番的儿子雅撒尼亚也站在其中。各人手拿香炉，烟云的香气上腾。
verses.textEnNiv: In front of them stood seventy elders of Israel, and Jaazaniah son of Shaphan was standing among them. Each had a censer in his hand, and a fragrant cloud of incense was rising.
verses.textEnEsv: And before them stood seventy men of the elders of the house of Israel, with Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan standing among them. Each had his censer in his hand, and the smoke of the cloud of incense went up.
verses.textEnNkjv: And there stood before them seventy men of the elders of the house of Israel, and in their midst stood Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan. Each man had a censer in his hand, and a thick cloud of incense went up.
verses.textEnNlt: Seventy leaders of Israel were standing there with Jaazaniah son of Shaphan in the center. Each of them held an incense burner, from which a cloud of incense rose above their heads.
verses.textEnNasb: And standing in front of them were seventy elders of the house of Israel, with Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan standing among them, each man with his censer in his hand; and the fragrance of the cloud of incense was rising.
verses.textEn: In front of them stood seventy elders of Israel, and Jaazaniah son of Shaphan was standing among them. Each had a censer in his hand, and a fragrant cloud of incense was rising.

verses.textZh: 他对我说："人子啊！以色列家的众长老各在自己偶像的房间里暗中所行的，你看见了吗？他们说：‘耶和华看不见我们，耶和华已经离开这地了。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他对我说："人子啊！以色列家的众长老各在自己偶像的房间里暗中所行的，你看见了吗？他们说：‘耶和华看不见我们，耶和华已经离开这地了。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 他对我说：「人子啊，以色列家的长老暗中在各人画像屋里所行的，你看见了吗？他们常说：『耶和华看不见我们；耶和华已经离弃这地。』」
verses.textEnNiv: He said to me, "Son of man, have you seen what the elders of Israel are doing in the darkness, each at the shrine of his own idol? They say, ‘The Lord does not see us; the Lord has forsaken the land.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Then he said to me, "Son of man, have you seen what the elders of the house of Israel are doing in the dark, each in his room of pictures? For they say, ‘The Lord does not see us, the Lord has forsaken the land.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He said to me, "Son of man, have you seen what the elders of the house of Israel do in the dark, every man in the room of his idols? For they say, ‘The Lord does not see us, the Lord has forsaken the land.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to me, "Son of man, have you seen what the leaders of Israel are doing with their idols in dark rooms? They are saying, ‘The Lord doesn’t see us; he has deserted our land!’"
verses.textEnNasb: Then He said to me, "Do you see, son of man, what the elders of the house of Israel are doing in the dark, each man in the rooms of his carved images? For they say, ‘The Lord does not see us; the Lord has abandoned the land.’ "
verses.textEn: He said to me, "Son of man, have you seen what the elders of Israel are doing in the darkness, each at the shrine of his own idol? They say, ‘The Lord does not see us; the Lord has forsaken the land.’ "

verses.textZh: 他又对我说："你还要看见他们行更加可憎的事。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又对我说："你还要看见他们行更加可憎的事。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他又说：「你还要看见他们另外行大可憎的事。」
verses.textEnNiv: Again, he said, "You will see them doing things that are even more detestable."
verses.textEnEsv: He said also to me, "You will see still greater abominations that they commit."
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said to me, "Turn again, and you will see greater abominations that they are doing."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord added, "Come, and I will show you even more detestable sins than these!"
verses.textEnNasb: And He said to me, "Yet you will see still greater abominations which they are committing!"
verses.textEn: Again, he said, "You will see them doing things that are even more detestable."

verses.textZh: 他领我到耶和华殿朝北的门口，在那里有些妇女坐着，为搭模斯哭泣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他领我到耶和华殿朝北的门口，在那里有些妇女坐着，为搭模斯哭泣。
verses.textZhCuv: 他领我到耶和华殿外院朝北的门口。谁知，在那里有妇女坐着，为搭模斯哭泣。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he brought me to the entrance of the north gate of the house of the Lord , and I saw women sitting there, mourning the god Tammuz.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he brought me to the entrance of the north gate of the house of the Lord , and behold, there sat women weeping for Tammuz.
verses.textEnNkjv: So He brought me to the door of the north gate of the Lord’s house; and to my dismay, women were sitting there weeping for Tammuz.
verses.textEnNlt: He brought me to the north gate of the Lord ’s Temple, and some women were sitting there, weeping for the god Tammuz.
verses.textEnNasb: Then He brought me to the entrance of the gate of the Lord’s house which was toward the north; and behold, women were sitting there weeping for Tammuz.
verses.textEn: Then he brought me to the entrance of the north gate of the house of the Lord , and I saw women sitting there, mourning the god Tammuz.

verses.textZh: 他对我说："人子啊，你看见了吗？你还要看见比这些更可憎的事。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他对我说："人子啊，你看见了吗？你还要看见比这些更可憎的事。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他对我说：「人子啊，你看见了吗？你还要看见比这更可憎的事。」
verses.textEnNiv: He said to me, "Do you see this, son of man? You will see things that are even more detestable than this."
verses.textEnEsv: Then he said to me, "Have you seen this, O son of man? You will see still greater abominations than these."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He said to me, "Have you seen this, O son of man? Turn again, you will see greater abominations than these."
verses.textEnNlt: "Have you seen this?" he asked. "But I will show you even more detestable sins than these!"
verses.textEnNasb: And He said to me, "Do you see this, son of man? Yet you will see still greater abominations than these!"
verses.textEn: He said to me, "Do you see this, son of man? You will see things that are even more detestable than this."

verses.textZh: 他又领我到耶和华殿的内院，在耶和华殿的门口，就是在走廊和祭坛中间，约有二十五个人，背向耶和华的殿，面向着东方；他们正在朝着东面叩拜太阳。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又领我到耶和华殿的内院，在耶和华殿的门口，就是在走廊和祭坛中间，约有二十五个人，背向耶和华的殿，面向着东方；他们正在朝着东面叩拜太阳。
verses.textZhCuv: 他又领我到耶和华殿的内院。谁知，在耶和华的殿门口、廊子和祭坛中间，约有二十五个人背向耶和华的殿，面向东方拜日头。
verses.textEnNiv: He then brought me into the inner court of the house of the Lord , and there at the entrance to the temple, between the portico and the altar, were about twenty-five men. With their backs toward the temple of the Lord and their faces toward the east, they were bowing down to the sun in the east.
verses.textEnEsv: And he brought me into the inner court of the house of the Lord . And behold, at the entrance of the temple of the Lord , between the porch and the altar, were about twenty-five men, with their backs to the temple of the Lord , and their faces toward the east, worshiping the sun toward the east.
verses.textEnNkjv: So He brought me into the inner court of the Lord’s house; and there, at the door of the temple of the Lord, between the porch and the altar, were about twenty-five men with their backs toward the temple of the Lord and their faces toward the east, and they were worshiping the sun toward the east.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he brought me into the inner courtyard of the Lord ’s Temple. At the entrance to the sanctuary, between the entry room and the bronze altar, there were about twenty-five men with their backs to the sanctuary of the Lord . They were facing east, bowing low to the ground, worshiping the sun!
verses.textEnNasb: Then He brought me into the inner courtyard of the Lord’s house. And behold, at the entrance to the temple of the Lord, between the porch and the altar, were about twenty-five men with their backs to the temple of the Lord while their faces were toward the east; and they were prostrating themselves eastward toward the sun.
verses.textEn: He then brought me into the inner court of the house of the Lord , and there at the entrance to the temple, between the portico and the altar, were about twenty-five men. With their backs toward the temple of the Lord and their faces toward the east, they were bowing down to the sun in the east.

verses.textZh: 他对我说："人子啊，你看见了吗？犹大家在这里行这可憎的事，还算小事吗？他们使这地充满了强暴，再三惹我发怒；看哪！他们把树枝拿到自己的鼻前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他对我说："人子啊，你看见了吗？犹大家在这里行这可憎的事，还算小事吗？他们使这地充满了强暴，再三惹我发怒；看哪！他们把树枝拿到自己的鼻前。
verses.textZhCuv: 他对我说：「人子啊，你看见了吗？犹大家在此行这可憎的事还算为小吗？他们在这地遍行强暴，再三惹我发怒，他们手拿枝条举向鼻前。
verses.textEnNiv: He said to me, "Have you seen this, son of man? Is it a trivial matter for the people of Judah to do the detestable things they are doing here? Must they also fill the land with violence and continually arouse my anger? Look at them putting the branch to their nose!
verses.textEnEsv: Then he said to me, "Have you seen this, O son of man? Is it too light a thing for the house of Judah to commit the abominations that they commit here, that they should fill the land with violence and provoke me still further to anger? Behold, they put the branch to their nose.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said to me, "Have you seen this, O son of man? Is it a trivial thing to the house of Judah to commit the abominations which they commit here? For they have filled the land with violence; then they have returned to provoke Me to anger. Indeed they put the branch to their nose.
verses.textEnNlt: "Have you seen this, son of man?" he asked. "Is it nothing to the people of Judah that they commit these detestable sins, leading the whole nation into violence, thumbing their noses at me, and provoking my anger?
verses.textEnNasb: And He said to me, "Do you see this, son of man? Is it a trivial thing for the house of Judah to commit the abominations which they have committed here, that they have filled the land with violence and provoked Me to anger repeatedly? Yet behold, they are putting the twig to their nose!
verses.textEn: He said to me, "Have you seen this, son of man? Is it a trivial matter for the people of Judah to do the detestable things they are doing here? Must they also fill the land with violence and continually arouse my anger? Look at them putting the branch to their nose!

verses.textZh: 因此我要以烈怒待他们；我的眼必不顾惜，我也不怜恤；他们虽然在我耳中大声呼求，我还是不听他们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此我要以烈怒待他们；我的眼必不顾惜，我也不怜恤；他们虽然在我耳中大声呼求，我还是不听他们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，我也要以忿怒行事，我眼必不顾惜，也不可怜他们；他们虽向我耳中大声呼求，我还是不听。」
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore I will deal with them in anger; I will not look on them with pity or spare them. Although they shout in my ears, I will not listen to them."
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore I will act in wrath. My eye will not spare, nor will I have pity. And though they cry in my ears with a loud voice, I will not hear them."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I also will act in fury. My eye will not spare nor will I have pity; and though they cry in My ears with a loud voice, I will not hear them."
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, I will respond in fury. I will neither pity nor spare them. And though they cry for mercy, I will not listen."
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, I indeed will deal in wrath. My eye will have no pity nor will I spare; and though they cry out in My ears with a loud voice, yet I will not listen to them."
verses.textEn: Therefore I will deal with them in anger; I will not look on them with pity or spare them. Although they shout in my ears, I will not listen to them."

verses.textZh: 我听见他大声呼叫说："惩罚这城的啊！你们要近前来，各人手里拿着灭命的武器。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我听见他大声呼叫说："惩罚这城的啊！你们要近前来，各人手里拿着灭命的武器。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他向我耳中大声喊叫说：「要使那监管这城的人手中各拿灭命的兵器前来。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then I heard him call out in a loud voice, "Bring near those who are appointed to execute judgment on the city, each with a weapon in his hand."
verses.textEnEsv: Then he cried in my ears with a loud voice, saying, "Bring near the executioners of the city, each with his destroying weapon in his hand."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He called out in my hearing with a loud voice, saying, "Let those who have charge over the city draw near, each with a deadly weapon in his hand."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord thundered, "Bring on the men appointed to punish the city! Tell them to bring their weapons with them!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then He cried out in my presence with a loud voice, saying, "Come forward, you executioners of the city, each with his weapon of destruction in his hand."
verses.textEn: Then I heard him call out in a loud voice, "Bring near those who are appointed to execute judgment on the city, each with a weapon in his hand."

verses.textZh: 忽然，有六个人从朝北的上门那边走来，各人手里拿着杀人的武器；他们中间有一个人身穿细麻布衣服，腰间带着墨盒子；他们进来，站在铜祭坛旁边。
verses.textZhCnvs: 忽然，有六个人从朝北的上门那边走来，各人手里拿着杀人的武器；他们中间有一个人身穿细麻布衣服，腰间带着墨盒子；他们进来，站在铜祭坛旁边。
verses.textZhCuv: 忽然有六个人从朝北的上门而来，各人手拿杀人的兵器；内中有一人身穿细麻衣，腰间带着墨盒子。他们进来，站在铜祭坛旁。
verses.textEnNiv: And I saw six men coming from the direction of the upper gate, which faces north, each with a deadly weapon in his hand. With them was a man clothed in linen who had a writing kit at his side. They came in and stood beside the bronze altar.
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, six men came from the direction of the upper gate, which faces north, each with his weapon for slaughter in his hand, and with them was a man clothed in linen, with a writing case at his waist. And they went in and stood beside the bronze altar.
verses.textEnNkjv: And suddenly six men came from the direction of the upper gate, which faces north, each with his battle-ax in his hand. One man among them was clothed with linen and had a writer’s inkhorn at his side. They went in and stood beside the bronze altar.
verses.textEnNlt: Six men soon appeared from the upper gate that faces north, each carrying a deadly weapon in his hand. With them was a man dressed in linen, who carried a writer’s case at his side. They all went into the Temple courtyard and stood beside the bronze altar.
verses.textEnNasb: And behold, six men came from the direction of the upper gate which faces north, each with his smashing weapon in his hand; and among them was one man clothed in linen with a scribe’s kit at his waist. And they came in and stood beside the bronze altar.
verses.textEn: And I saw six men coming from the direction of the upper gate, which faces north, each with a deadly weapon in his hand. With them was a man clothed in linen who had a writing kit at his side. They came in and stood beside the bronze altar.

verses.textZh: 以色列神的荣耀本来是在基路伯上面的，现在从那里移到殿的门槛；耶和华把那身穿细麻布衣服，腰间带着墨盒子的人召来，
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列神的荣耀本来是在基路伯上面的，现在从那里移到殿的门槛；耶和华把那身穿细麻布衣服，腰间带着墨盒子的人召来，
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列神的荣耀本在基路伯上，现今从那里升到殿的门槛。神将那身穿细麻衣、腰间带着墨盒子的人召来。
verses.textEnNiv: Now the glory of the God of Israel went up from above the cherubim, where it had been, and moved to the threshold of the temple. Then the Lord called to the man clothed in linen who had the writing kit at his side
verses.textEnEsv: Now the glory of the God of Israel had gone up from the cherub on which it rested to the threshold of the house. And he called to the man clothed in linen, who had the writing case at his waist.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the glory of the God of Israel had gone up from the cherub, where it had been, to the threshold of the temple. And He called to the man clothed with linen, who had the writer’s inkhorn at his side;
verses.textEnNlt: Then the glory of the God of Israel rose up from between the cherubim, where it had rested, and moved to the entrance of the Temple. And the Lord called to the man dressed in linen who was carrying the writer’s case.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the glory of the God of Israel ascended from the cherub on which it had been, to the threshold of the temple. And He called to the man clothed in linen at whose waist was the scribe’s kit.
verses.textEn: Now the glory of the God of Israel went up from above the cherubim, where it had been, and moved to the threshold of the temple. Then the Lord called to the man clothed in linen who had the writing kit at his side

verses.textZh: 对他说："你要走遍耶路撒冷全城，那些因城中所行的一切可憎的事而叹息悲哀的人，你要在他们的额上画个记号。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 对他说："你要走遍耶路撒冷全城，那些因城中所行的一切可憎的事而叹息悲哀的人，你要在他们的额上画个记号。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对他说：「你去走遍耶路撒冷全城，那些因城中所行可憎之事叹息哀哭的人，画记号在额上。」
verses.textEnNiv: and said to him, "Go throughout the city of Jerusalem and put a mark on the foreheads of those who grieve and lament over all the detestable things that are done in it."
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to him, "Pass through the city, through Jerusalem, and put a mark on the foreheads of the men who sigh and groan over all the abominations that are committed in it."
verses.textEnNkjv: and the Lord said to him, "Go through the midst of the city, through the midst of Jerusalem, and put a mark on the foreheads of the men who sigh and cry over all the abominations that are done within it."
verses.textEnNlt: He said to him, "Walk through the streets of Jerusalem and put a mark on the foreheads of all who weep and sigh because of the detestable sins being committed in their city."
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord said to him, "Go through the midst of the city, through the midst of Jerusalem, and make a mark on the foreheads of the people who groan and sigh over all the abominations which are being committed in its midst."
verses.textEn: and said to him, "Go throughout the city of Jerusalem and put a mark on the foreheads of those who grieve and lament over all the detestable things that are done in it."

verses.textZh: 我又听见他对其余的人说："你们要跟随他走遍那城，进行杀戮；你们的眼不要顾惜，你们也不要怜恤。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我又听见他对其余的人说："你们要跟随他走遍那城，进行杀戮；你们的眼不要顾惜，你们也不要怜恤。
verses.textZhCuv: 我耳中听见他对其余的人说：「要跟随他走遍全城，以行击杀。你们的眼不要顾惜，也不要可怜他们。
verses.textEnNiv: As I listened, he said to the others, "Follow him through the city and kill, without showing pity or compassion.
verses.textEnEsv: And to the others he said in my hearing, "Pass through the city after him, and strike. Your eye shall not spare, and you shall show no pity.
verses.textEnNkjv: To the others He said in my hearing, "Go after him through the city and kill; do not let your eye spare, nor have any pity.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I heard the Lord say to the other men, "Follow him through the city and kill everyone whose forehead is not marked. Show no mercy; have no pity!
verses.textEnNasb: But to the others He said in my presence, "Go through the city after him and strike; do not let your eye have pity and do not spare.
verses.textEn: As I listened, he said to the others, "Follow him through the city and kill, without showing pity or compassion.

verses.textZh: 你们要从我的圣所开始，把老年人、少年人、少女、孩童和妇女都杀尽灭绝，只是那些额上有记号的人，你们都不可伤害。"于是他们从殿前那些长老开始杀戮。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要从我的圣所开始，把老年人、少年人、少女、孩童和妇女都杀尽灭绝，只是那些额上有记号的人，你们都不可伤害。"于是他们从殿前那些长老开始杀戮。
verses.textZhCuv: 要将年老的、年少的，并处女、婴孩，和妇女，从圣所起全都杀尽，只是凡有记号的人不要挨近他。」于是他们从殿前的长老杀起。
verses.textEnNiv: Slaughter the old men, the young men and women, the mothers and children, but do not touch anyone who has the mark. Begin at my sanctuary." So they began with the old men who were in front of the temple.
verses.textEnEsv: Kill old men outright, young men and maidens, little children and women, but touch no one on whom is the mark. And begin at my sanctuary." So they began with the elders who were before the house.
verses.textEnNkjv: Utterly slay old and young men, maidens and little children and women; but do not come near anyone on whom is the mark; and begin at My sanctuary." So they began with the elders who were before the temple.
verses.textEnNlt: Kill them all—old and young, girls and women and little children. But do not touch anyone with the mark. Begin right here at the Temple." So they began by killing the seventy leaders.
verses.textEnNasb: Utterly kill old men, young men, female virgins, little children, and women, but do not touch any person on whom is the mark; and you shall start from My sanctuary." So they started with the elders who were before the temple.
verses.textEn: Slaughter the old men, the young men and women, the mothers and children, but do not touch anyone who has the mark. Begin at my sanctuary." So they began with the old men who were in front of the temple.

verses.textZh: 他又对他们说："你们要玷污这殿，使这些院子充满被杀的人；你们出去吧！"于是他们出去，在城中进行杀戮。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又对他们说："你们要玷污这殿，使这些院子充满被杀的人；你们出去吧！"于是他们出去，在城中进行杀戮。
verses.textZhCuv: 他对他们说：「要污秽这殿，使院中充满被杀的人。你们出去吧！」他们就出去，在城中击杀。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he said to them, "Defile the temple and fill the courts with the slain. Go!" So they went out and began killing throughout the city.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he said to them, "Defile the house, and fill the courts with the slain. Go out." So they went out and struck in the city.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He said to them, "Defile the temple, and fill the courts with the slain. Go out!" And they went out and killed in the city.
verses.textEnNlt: "Defile the Temple!" the Lord commanded. "Fill its courtyards with corpses. Go!" So they went and began killing throughout the city.
verses.textEnNasb: He also said to them, "Defile the temple and fill the courtyards with the dead. Go out!" So they went out and struck and killed the people in the city.
verses.textEn: Then he said to them, "Defile the temple and fill the courts with the slain. Go!" So they went out and began killing throughout the city.

verses.textZh: 他们杀戮的时候，只留下我一个人，我就脸伏在地，呼叫说："哎，主耶和华啊！难道你要向耶路撒冷倾倒你的烈怒，使所有以色列余剩的人都灭绝么？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们杀戮的时候，只留下我一个人，我就脸伏在地，呼叫说："哎，主耶和华啊！难道你要向耶路撒冷倾倒你的烈怒，使所有以色列余剩的人都灭绝么？"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们击杀的时候，我被留下，我就俯伏在地，说：「哎！主耶和华啊，你将忿怒倾在耶路撒冷，岂要将以色列所剩下的人都灭绝吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: While they were killing and I was left alone, I fell facedown, crying out, "Alas, Sovereign Lord ! Are you going to destroy the entire remnant of Israel in this outpouring of your wrath on Jerusalem?"
verses.textEnEsv: And while they were striking, and I was left alone, I fell upon my face, and cried, "Ah, Lord God ! Will you destroy all the remnant of Israel in the outpouring of your wrath on Jerusalem?"
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, that while they were killing them, I was left alone; and I fell on my face and cried out, and said, "Ah, Lord God! Will You destroy all the remnant of Israel in pouring out Your fury on Jerusalem?"
verses.textEnNlt: While they were out killing, I was all alone. I fell face down on the ground and cried out, "O Sovereign Lord ! Will your fury against Jerusalem wipe out everyone left in Israel?"
verses.textEnNasb: And as they were striking the people and I alone was left, I fell on my face and cried out, saying, "Oh, Lord God! Are You going to destroy the entire remnant of Israel by pouring out Your wrath on Jerusalem?"
verses.textEn: While they were killing and I was left alone, I fell facedown, crying out, "Alas, Sovereign Lord ! Are you going to destroy the entire remnant of Israel in this outpouring of your wrath on Jerusalem?"

verses.textZh: 他对我说："以色列家和犹大家罪大恶极，地上充满血腥，城内充满不义，因为他们说：‘耶和华已经离开这地，他看不见我们了！’
verses.textZhCnvs: 他对我说："以色列家和犹大家罪大恶极，地上充满血腥，城内充满不义，因为他们说：‘耶和华已经离开这地，他看不见我们了！’
verses.textZhCuv: 他对我说：「以色列家和犹大家的罪孽极其重大。遍地有流血的事，满城有冤屈，因为他们说：『耶和华已经离弃这地，他看不见我们。』
verses.textEnNiv: He answered me, "The sin of the people of Israel and Judah is exceedingly great; the land is full of bloodshed and the city is full of injustice. They say, ‘The Lord has forsaken the land; the Lord does not see.’
verses.textEnEsv: Then he said to me, "The guilt of the house of Israel and Judah is exceedingly great. The land is full of blood, and the city full of injustice. For they say, ‘The Lord has forsaken the land, and the Lord does not see.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He said to me, "The iniquity of the house of Israel and Judah is exceedingly great, and the land is full of bloodshed, and the city full of perversity; for they say, ‘The Lord has forsaken the land, and the Lord does not see!’
verses.textEnNlt: Then he said to me, "The sins of the people of Israel and Judah are very, very great. The entire land is full of murder; the city is filled with injustice. They are saying, ‘The Lord doesn’t see it! The Lord has abandoned the land!’
verses.textEnNasb: Then He said to me, "The guilt of the house of Israel and Judah is very, very great, and the land is filled with blood, and the city is full of perversion; for they say, ‘The Lord has abandoned the land, and the Lord does not see!’
verses.textEn: He answered me, "The sin of the people of Israel and Judah is exceedingly great; the land is full of bloodshed and the city is full of injustice. They say, ‘The Lord has forsaken the land; the Lord does not see.’

verses.textZh: 因此，我的眼必不顾惜，我也必不怜恤；我要把他们所行的报应在他们的头上。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，我的眼必不顾惜，我也必不怜恤；我要把他们所行的报应在他们的头上。"
verses.textZhCuv: 故此，我眼必不顾惜，也不可怜他们，要照他们所行的报应在他们头上。」
verses.textEnNiv: So I will not look on them with pity or spare them, but I will bring down on their own heads what they have done."
verses.textEnEsv: As for me, my eye will not spare, nor will I have pity; I will bring their deeds upon their heads."
verses.textEnNkjv: And as for Me also, My eye will neither spare, nor will I have pity, but I will recompense their deeds on their own head."
verses.textEnNlt: So I will not spare them or have any pity on them. I will fully repay them for all they have done."
verses.textEnNasb: But as for Me, My eye will have no pity nor will I spare, but I will bring their conduct upon their heads."
verses.textEn: So I will not look on them with pity or spare them, but I will bring down on their own heads what they have done."

verses.textZh: 那身穿细麻布衣服，腰间带着墨盒子的人回报这事，说："我已经照着你所吩咐我的行了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那身穿细麻布衣服，腰间带着墨盒子的人回报这事，说："我已经照着你所吩咐我的行了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 那穿细麻衣、腰间带着墨盒子的人将这事回复说：「我已经照你所吩咐的行了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the man in linen with the writing kit at his side brought back word, saying, "I have done as you commanded."
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, the man clothed in linen, with the writing case at his waist, brought back word, saying, "I have done as you commanded me."
verses.textEnNkjv: Just then, the man clothed with linen, who had the inkhorn at his side, reported back and said, "I have done as You commanded me."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the man in linen clothing, who carried the writer’s case, reported back and said, "I have done as you commanded."
verses.textEnNasb: Then behold, the man clothed in linen, at whose waist was the scribe’s kit, reported, saying, "I have done just as You have commanded me."
verses.textEn: Then the man in linen with the writing kit at his side brought back word, saying, "I have done as you commanded."

verses.textZh: 我观看，见基路伯头顶以上的穹苍，有好象蓝宝石宝座的形状，显现出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我观看，见基路伯头顶以上的穹苍，有好象蓝宝石宝座的形状，显现出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 我观看，见基路伯头上的穹苍之中，显出蓝宝石的形状，仿佛宝座的形象。
verses.textEnNiv: I looked, and I saw the likeness of a throne of lapis lazuli above the vault that was over the heads of the cherubim.
verses.textEnEsv: Then I looked, and behold, on the expanse that was over the heads of the cherubim there appeared above them something like a sapphire, in appearance like a throne.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I looked, and there in the firmament that was above the head of the cherubim, there appeared something like a sapphire stone, having the appearance of the likeness of a throne.
verses.textEnNlt: In my vision I saw what appeared to be a throne of blue lapis lazuli above the crystal surface over the heads of the cherubim.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I looked, and behold, in the expanse that was over the heads of the cherubim something like a sapphire stone, in appearance resembling a throne, appeared above them.
verses.textEn: I looked, and I saw the likeness of a throne of lapis lazuli above the vault that was over the heads of the cherubim.

verses.textZh: 主对那身穿细麻布衣服的人说："你进到基路伯以下的轮子之间那里去；从基路伯之间，用两手捧满火炭，然后把它们撒在城上。"他就在我眼前进去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主对那身穿细麻布衣服的人说："你进到基路伯以下的轮子之间那里去；从基路伯之间，用两手捧满火炭，然后把它们撒在城上。"他就在我眼前进去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 主对那穿细麻衣的人说：「你进去，在旋转的轮内基路伯以下，从基路伯中间将火炭取满两手，撒在城上。」 我就见他进去。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to the man clothed in linen, "Go in among the wheels beneath the cherubim. Fill your hands with burning coals from among the cherubim and scatter them over the city." And as I watched, he went in.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to the man clothed in linen, "Go in among the whirling wheels underneath the cherubim. Fill your hands with burning coals from between the cherubim, and scatter them over the city." And he went in before my eyes.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He spoke to the man clothed with linen, and said, "Go in among the wheels, under the cherub, fill your hands with coals of fire from among the cherubim, and scatter them over the city." And he went in as I watched.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord spoke to the man in linen clothing and said, "Go between the whirling wheels beneath the cherubim, and take a handful of burning coals and scatter them over the city." He did this as I watched.
verses.textEnNasb: And He spoke to the man clothed in linen and said, "Enter between the whirling wheels under the cherubim and fill your hands with coals of fire from between the cherubim, and scatter them over the city." And he entered in my sight.
verses.textEn: The Lord said to the man clothed in linen, "Go in among the wheels beneath the cherubim. Fill your hands with burning coals from among the cherubim and scatter them over the city." And as I watched, he went in.

verses.textZh: 那人进去的时候，基路伯站在殿的右边，云彩充满了内院。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那人进去的时候，基路伯站在殿的右边，云彩充满了内院。
verses.textZhCuv: 那人进去的时候，基路伯站在殿的右边，云彩充满了内院。
verses.textEnNiv: Now the cherubim were standing on the south side of the temple when the man went in, and a cloud filled the inner court.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the cherubim were standing on the south side of the house, when the man went in, and a cloud filled the inner court.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the cherubim were standing on the south side of the temple when the man went in, and the cloud filled the inner court.
verses.textEnNlt: The cherubim were standing at the south end of the Temple when the man went in, and the cloud of glory filled the inner courtyard.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the cherubim were standing on the right side of the temple when the man entered, and the cloud filled the inner courtyard.
verses.textEn: Now the cherubim were standing on the south side of the temple when the man went in, and a cloud filled the inner court.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的荣耀从基路伯上面升到殿的门槛那里；殿里充满了云彩，院子也充满了耶和华荣耀的光辉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的荣耀从基路伯上面升到殿的门槛那里；殿里充满了云彩，院子也充满了耶和华荣耀的光辉。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的荣耀从基路伯那里上升，停在门槛以上；殿内满了云彩，院宇也被耶和华荣耀的光辉充满。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the glory of the Lord rose from above the cherubim and moved to the threshold of the temple. The cloud filled the temple, and the court was full of the radiance of the glory of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And the glory of the Lord went up from the cherub to the threshold of the house, and the house was filled with the cloud, and the court was filled with the brightness of the glory of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the glory of the Lord went up from the cherub, andpaused over the threshold of the temple; and the house was filled with the cloud, and the court was full of the brightness of the Lord’s glory.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the glory of the Lord rose up from above the cherubim and went over to the entrance of the Temple. The Temple was filled with this cloud of glory, and the courtyard glowed brightly with the glory of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Then the glory of the Lord went up from the cherub to the threshold of the temple, and the temple was filled with the cloud, and the courtyard was filled with the brightness of the glory of the Lord.
verses.textEn: Then the glory of the Lord rose from above the cherubim and moved to the threshold of the temple. The cloud filled the temple, and the court was full of the radiance of the glory of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 基路伯的翅膀发出的声音在外院也可以听到，好象全能的神说话的声音。
verses.textZhCnvs: 基路伯的翅膀发出的声音在外院也可以听到，好象全能的神说话的声音。
verses.textZhCuv: 基路伯翅膀的响声听到外院，好像全能神说话的声音。
verses.textEnNiv: The sound of the wings of the cherubim could be heard as far away as the outer court, like the voice of God Almighty when he speaks.
verses.textEnEsv: And the sound of the wings of the cherubim was heard as far as the outer court, like the voice of God Almighty when he speaks.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the sound of the wings of the cherubim was heard even in the outer court, like the voice of Almighty God when He speaks.
verses.textEnNlt: The moving wings of the cherubim sounded like the voice of God Almighty and could be heard even in the outer courtyard.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, the sound of the wings of the cherubim was heard as far as the outer courtyard, like the voice of God Almighty when He speaks.
verses.textEn: The sound of the wings of the cherubim could be heard as far away as the outer court, like the voice of God Almighty when he speaks.

verses.textZh: 他吩咐那身穿细麻布衣服的人说："你要从轮子之间，就是从基路伯之间取火。"那人就进去，站在一个轮子的旁边。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他吩咐那身穿细麻布衣服的人说："你要从轮子之间，就是从基路伯之间取火。"那人就进去，站在一个轮子的旁边。
verses.textZhCuv: 他吩咐那穿细麻衣的人说：「要从旋转的轮内基路伯中间取火。」那人就进去站在一个轮子旁边。
verses.textEnNiv: When the Lord commanded the man in linen, "Take fire from among the wheels, from among the cherubim," the man went in and stood beside a wheel.
verses.textEnEsv: And when he commanded the man clothed in linen, "Take fire from between the whirling wheels, from between the cherubim," he went in and stood beside a wheel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then it happened, when He commanded the man clothed in linen, saying, "Take fire from among the wheels, from among the cherubim," that he went in and stood beside the wheels.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord said to the man in linen clothing, "Go between the cherubim and take some burning coals from between the wheels." So the man went in and stood beside one of the wheels.
verses.textEnNasb: And it came about when He commanded the man clothed in linen, saying, "Take fire from between the whirling wheels, from between the cherubim," he entered and stood beside a wheel.
verses.textEn: When the Lord commanded the man in linen, "Take fire from among the wheels, from among the cherubim," the man went in and stood beside a wheel.

verses.textZh: 有一个基路伯从众基路伯之间，伸手到他们中间的火那里去，取了些火，放在那身穿细麻布衣服的人手中；那人拿了火，就出去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个基路伯从众基路伯之间，伸手到他们中间的火那里去，取了些火，放在那身穿细麻布衣服的人手中；那人拿了火，就出去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个基路伯从基路伯中伸手到基路伯中间的火那里，取些放在那穿细麻衣的人两手中，那人就拿出去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then one of the cherubim reached out his hand to the fire that was among them. He took up some of it and put it into the hands of the man in linen, who took it and went out.
verses.textEnEsv: And a cherub stretched out his hand from between the cherubim to the fire that was between the cherubim, and took some of it and put it into the hands of the man clothed in linen, who took it and went out.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the cherub stretched out his hand from among the cherubim to the fire that was among the cherubim, and took someofit and put it into the hands of the man clothed with linen, who took it and went out.
verses.textEnNlt: Then one of the cherubim reached out his hand and took some live coals from the fire burning among them. He put the coals into the hands of the man in linen clothing, and the man took them and went out.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the cherub reached out with his hand from between the cherubim to the fire which was between the cherubim, took some coals and put them into the hands of the one clothed in linen; and he took them and went out.
verses.textEn: Then one of the cherubim reached out his hand to the fire that was among them. He took up some of it and put it into the hands of the man in linen, who took it and went out.

verses.textZh: 在那些基路伯的翅膀下面，可以看见人手的形状。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那些基路伯的翅膀下面，可以看见人手的形状。
verses.textZhCuv: 在基路伯翅膀之下，显出有人手的样式。
verses.textEnNiv: (Under the wings of the cherubim could be seen what looked like human hands.)
verses.textEnEsv: The cherubim appeared to have the form of a human hand under their wings.
verses.textEnNkjv: The cherubim appeared to have the form of a man’s hand under their wings.
verses.textEnNlt: (All the cherubim had what looked like human hands under their wings.)
verses.textEnNasb: The cherubim appeared to have something like a human hand under their wings.
verses.textEn: (Under the wings of the cherubim could be seen what looked like human hands.)

verses.textZh: 我观看，见众基路伯旁边有四个轮子；每一个基路伯旁边都有一个轮子；轮子的样子好象闪耀的水苍玉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我观看，见众基路伯旁边有四个轮子；每一个基路伯旁边都有一个轮子；轮子的样子好象闪耀的水苍玉。
verses.textZhCuv: 我又观看，见基路伯旁边有四个轮子。这基路伯旁有一个轮子，那基路伯旁有一个轮子，每基路伯都是如此；轮子的颜色 仿佛水苍玉。
verses.textEnNiv: I looked, and I saw beside the cherubim four wheels, one beside each of the cherubim; the wheels sparkled like topaz.
verses.textEnEsv: And I looked, and behold, there were four wheels beside the cherubim, one beside each cherub, and the appearance of the wheels was like sparkling beryl.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when I looked, there were four wheels by the cherubim, one wheel by one cherub and another wheel by each other cherub; the wheels appeared tohave the color of a beryl stone.
verses.textEnNlt: I looked, and each of the four cherubim had a wheel beside him, and the wheels sparkled like beryl.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I looked, and behold, four wheels beside the cherubim, one wheel beside each cherub; and the appearance of the wheels was like the gleam of a Tarshish stone.
verses.textEn: I looked, and I saw beside the cherubim four wheels, one beside each of the cherubim; the wheels sparkled like topaz.

verses.textZh: 四个轮子的样子，都是一个形状，好象轮子套着轮子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 四个轮子的样子，都是一个形状，好象轮子套着轮子。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于四轮的形状，都是一个样式，仿佛轮中套轮。
verses.textEnNiv: As for their appearance, the four of them looked alike; each was like a wheel intersecting a wheel.
verses.textEnEsv: And as for their appearance, the four had the same likeness, as if a wheel were within a wheel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Asfor their appearance, all four looked alike—as it were, a wheel in the middle of a wheel.
verses.textEnNlt: All four wheels looked alike and were made the same; each wheel had a second wheel turning crosswise within it.
verses.textEnNasb: And as for their appearance, all four of them had the same likeness, as if one wheel were within another wheel.
verses.textEn: As for their appearance, the four of them looked alike; each was like a wheel intersecting a wheel.

verses.textZh: 轮子可以向四方移动，移动的时候，不必转向；基路伯头向哪一个方向走，它们就跟着移动；移动的时候，不必转向。
verses.textZhCnvs: 轮子可以向四方移动，移动的时候，不必转向；基路伯头向哪一个方向走，它们就跟着移动；移动的时候，不必转向。
verses.textZhCuv: 轮行走的时候，向四方都能直行，并不掉转。头向何方，他们也随向何方，行走的时候并不掉转。
verses.textEnNiv: As they moved, they would go in any one of the four directions the cherubim faced; the wheels did not turn about as the cherubim went. The cherubim went in whatever direction the head faced, without turning as they went.
verses.textEnEsv: When they went, they went in any of their four directions without turning as they went, but in whatever direction the front wheel faced, the others followed without turning as they went.
verses.textEnNkjv: When they went, they went toward anyof their four directions; they did not turn aside when they went, but followed in the direction the head was facing. They did not turn aside when they went.
verses.textEnNlt: The cherubim could move in any of the four directions they faced, without turning as they moved. They went straight in the direction they faced, never turning aside.
verses.textEnNasb: When they moved, they went in any of their four directions without turning as they went; but they followed in the direction which they faced, without turning as they went.
verses.textEn: As they moved, they would go in any one of the four directions the cherubim faced; the wheels did not turn about as the cherubim went. The cherubim went in whatever direction the head faced, without turning as they went.

verses.textZh: 基路伯的全身、背、手和翅膀，以及那些轮子，都布满了眼睛；四个基路伯的轮子都是这样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 基路伯的全身、背、手和翅膀，以及那些轮子，都布满了眼睛；四个基路伯的轮子都是这样。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们全身，连背带手和翅膀，并轮周围都满了眼睛。这四个基路伯的轮子都是如此。
verses.textEnNiv: Their entire bodies, including their backs, their hands and their wings, were completely full of eyes, as were their four wheels.
verses.textEnEsv: And their whole body, their rims, and their spokes, their wings, and the wheels were full of eyes all around—the wheels that the four of them had.
verses.textEnNkjv: And their whole body, with their back, their hands, their wings, and the wheels that the four had, were full of eyes all around.
verses.textEnNlt: Both the cherubim and the wheels were covered with eyes. The cherubim had eyes all over their bodies, including their hands, their backs, and their wings.
verses.textEnNasb: And their whole body, their backs, their hands, their wings and the wheels were covered with eyes all around, the wheels belonging to all four of them.
verses.textEn: Their entire bodies, including their backs, their hands and their wings, were completely full of eyes, as were their four wheels.

verses.textZh: 至于那些轮子，我听见它们称为"旋转的轮子"。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于那些轮子，我听见它们称为"旋转的轮子"。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于这些轮子，我耳中听见说是旋转的。
verses.textEnNiv: I heard the wheels being called "the whirling wheels."
verses.textEnEsv: As for the wheels, they were called in my hearing "the whirling wheels."
verses.textEnNkjv: As for the wheels, they were called in my hearing, "Wheel."
verses.textEnNlt: I heard someone refer to the wheels as "the whirling wheels."
verses.textEnNasb: The wheels were called, as I heard, the whirling wheels.
verses.textEn: I heard the wheels being called "the whirling wheels."

verses.textZh: 每一个基路伯各有四个脸孔：第一是基路伯的脸孔，第二是人的脸孔，第三是狮子的脸孔，第四是鹰的脸孔。
verses.textZhCnvs: 每一个基路伯各有四个脸孔：第一是基路伯的脸孔，第二是人的脸孔，第三是狮子的脸孔，第四是鹰的脸孔。
verses.textZhCuv: 基路伯各有四脸：第一是基路伯的脸，第二是人的脸，第三是狮子的脸，第四是鹰的脸。
verses.textEnNiv: Each of the cherubim had four faces: One face was that of a cherub, the second the face of a human being, the third the face of a lion, and the fourth the face of an eagle.
verses.textEnEsv: And every one had four faces: the first face was the face of the cherub, and the second face was a human face, and the third the face of a lion, and the fourth the face of an eagle.
verses.textEnNkjv: Each one had four faces: the first face was the face of a cherub, the second face the face of a man, the third the face of a lion, and the fourth the face of an eagle.
verses.textEnNlt: Each of the four cherubim had four faces: the first was the face of an ox, the second was a human face, the third was the face of a lion, and the fourth was the face of an eagle.
verses.textEnNasb: And each one had four faces. The first face was the face of a cherub, the second face was the face of a human, the third, the face of a lion, and the fourth, the face of an eagle.
verses.textEn: Each of the cherubim had four faces: One face was that of a cherub, the second the face of a human being, the third the face of a lion, and the fourth the face of an eagle.

verses.textZh: 后来基路伯也升起 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来基路伯也升起 。
verses.textZhCuv: 基路伯升上去了；这是我在迦巴鲁河边所见的活物。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the cherubim rose upward. These were the living creatures I had seen by the Kebar River.
verses.textEnEsv: And the cherubim mounted up. These were the living creatures that I saw by the Chebar canal.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the cherubim were lifted up. This was the living creature I saw by the River Chebar.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the cherubim rose upward. These were the same living beings I had seen beside the Kebar River.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the cherubim rose up. They are the living beings that I saw by the river Chebar.
verses.textEn: Then the cherubim rose upward. These were the living creatures I had seen by the Kebar River.

verses.textZh: 基路伯移动的时候，轮子也在他们旁边移动；基路伯展开翅膀飞离地面的时候，轮子也不离开他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 基路伯移动的时候，轮子也在他们旁边移动；基路伯展开翅膀飞离地面的时候，轮子也不离开他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 基路伯行走，轮也在旁边行走。基路伯展开翅膀，离地上升，轮也不转离他们旁边。
verses.textEnNiv: When the cherubim moved, the wheels beside them moved; and when the cherubim spread their wings to rise from the ground, the wheels did not leave their side.
verses.textEnEsv: And when the cherubim went, the wheels went beside them. And when the cherubim lifted up their wings to mount up from the earth, the wheels did not turn from beside them.
verses.textEnNkjv: When the cherubim went, the wheels went beside them; and when the cherubim lifted their wings to mount up from the earth, the same wheels also did not turn from beside them.
verses.textEnNlt: When the cherubim moved, the wheels moved with them. When they lifted their wings to fly, the wheels stayed beside them.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when the cherubim moved, the wheels would move beside them; also when the cherubim lifted up their wings to rise from the ground, the wheels themselves would not turn away from beside them.
verses.textEn: When the cherubim moved, the wheels beside them moved; and when the cherubim spread their wings to rise from the ground, the wheels did not leave their side.

verses.textZh: 他们站着不动，轮子也不动；他们升起的时候，轮子也与他们一同上升，因为活物的灵是在轮子里面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们站着不动，轮子也不动；他们升起的时候，轮子也与他们一同上升，因为活物的灵是在轮子里面。
verses.textZhCuv: 那些站住，这些也站住；那些上升，这些也一同上升，因为活物的灵在轮中。
verses.textEnNiv: When the cherubim stood still, they also stood still; and when the cherubim rose, they rose with them, because the spirit of the living creatures was in them.
verses.textEnEsv: When they stood still, these stood still, and when they mounted up, these mounted up with them, for the spirit of the living creatures was in them.
verses.textEnNkjv: When thecherubim stood still, thewheels stood still, and when one was lifted up, theother lifted itself up, for the spirit of the living creature was in them.
verses.textEnNlt: When the cherubim stopped, the wheels stopped. When they flew upward, the wheels rose up, for the spirit of the living beings was in the wheels.
verses.textEnNasb: When the cherubim stood still, the wheels would stand still; and when they rose up, the wheels would rise with them, because the spirit of the living beings was in them.
verses.textEn: When the cherubim stood still, they also stood still; and when the cherubim rose, they rose with them, because the spirit of the living creatures was in them.

verses.textZh: 以后，耶和华的荣耀离开殿的门槛，停在基路伯上面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以后，耶和华的荣耀离开殿的门槛，停在基路伯上面。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的荣耀从殿的门槛那里出去，停在基路伯以上。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the glory of the Lord departed from over the threshold of the temple and stopped above the cherubim.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the glory of the Lord went out from the threshold of the house, and stood over the cherubim.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the glory of the Lord departed from the threshold of the temple and stood over the cherubim.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the glory of the Lord moved out from the entrance of the Temple and hovered above the cherubim.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the glory of the Lord departed from the threshold of the temple and stood over the cherubim.
verses.textEn: Then the glory of the Lord departed from over the threshold of the temple and stopped above the cherubim.

verses.textZh: 基路伯离开的时候，他们在我眼前展开翅膀，飞离地面，轮子也与他们一起；他们停在耶和华殿的东门口，在他们上面有以色列神的荣耀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 基路伯离开的时候，他们在我眼前展开翅膀，飞离地面，轮子也与他们一起；他们停在耶和华殿的东门口，在他们上面有以色列神的荣耀。
verses.textZhCuv: 基路伯出去的时候，就展开翅膀，在我眼前离地上升。轮也在他们的旁边，都停在耶和华殿的东门口。在他们以上有以色列神的荣耀。
verses.textEnNiv: While I watched, the cherubim spread their wings and rose from the ground, and as they went, the wheels went with them. They stopped at the entrance of the east gate of the Lord ’s house, and the glory of the God of Israel was above them.
verses.textEnEsv: And the cherubim lifted up their wings and mounted up from the earth before my eyes as they went out, with the wheels beside them. And they stood at the entrance of the east gate of the house of the Lord , and the glory of the God of Israel was over them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the cherubim lifted their wings and mounted up from the earth in my sight. When they went out, the wheels were beside them; and they stood at the door of the east gate of the Lord’s house, and the glory of the God of Israel was above them.
verses.textEnNlt: And as I watched, the cherubim flew with their wheels to the east gate of the Lord ’s Temple. And the glory of the God of Israel hovered above them.
verses.textEnNasb: When the cherubim departed, they lifted their wings and rose up from the ground in my sight with the wheels beside them; and they stood still at the entrance of the east gate of the Lord’s house, and the glory of the God of Israel hovered over them.
verses.textEn: While I watched, the cherubim spread their wings and rose from the ground, and as they went, the wheels went with them. They stopped at the entrance of the east gate of the Lord ’s house, and the glory of the God of Israel was above them.

verses.textZh: 这些是我在迦巴鲁河边所看见、在以色列神荣耀下面的活物，我就知道他们是基路伯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些是我在迦巴鲁河边所看见、在以色列神荣耀下面的活物，我就知道他们是基路伯。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是我在迦巴鲁河边所见、以色列神荣耀以下的活物，我就知道他们是基路伯。
verses.textEnNiv: These were the living creatures I had seen beneath the God of Israel by the Kebar River, and I realized that they were cherubim.
verses.textEnEsv: These were the living creatures that I saw underneath the God of Israel by the Chebar canal; and I knew that they were cherubim.
verses.textEnNkjv: This is the living creature I saw under the God of Israel by the River Chebar, and I knew they were cherubim.
verses.textEnNlt: These were the same living beings I had seen beneath the God of Israel when I was by the Kebar River. I knew they were cherubim,
verses.textEnNasb: These are the living beings that I saw beneath the God of Israel by the river Chebar; so I knew that they were cherubim.
verses.textEn: These were the living creatures I had seen beneath the God of Israel by the Kebar River, and I realized that they were cherubim.

verses.textZh: 四个基路伯各有四个脸孔，四个翅膀；在翅膀下面有人手的形状。
verses.textZhCnvs: 四个基路伯各有四个脸孔，四个翅膀；在翅膀下面有人手的形状。
verses.textZhCuv: 各有四个脸面，四个翅膀，翅膀以下有人手的样式。
verses.textEnNiv: Each had four faces and four wings, and under their wings was what looked like human hands.
verses.textEnEsv: Each had four faces, and each four wings, and underneath their wings the likeness of human hands.
verses.textEnNkjv: Each one had four faces and each one four wings, and the likeness of the hands of a man was under their wings.
verses.textEnNlt: for each had four faces and four wings and what looked like human hands under their wings.
verses.textEnNasb: Each one had four faces and each one four wings, and beneath their wings was the form of human hands.
verses.textEn: Each had four faces and four wings, and under their wings was what looked like human hands.

verses.textZh: 至于他们脸孔的形状，就像我从前在迦巴鲁河边所看见的一样。他们每个都是朝着脸孔的方向行走。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于他们脸孔的形状，就像我从前在迦巴鲁河边所看见的一样。他们每个都是朝着脸孔的方向行走。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于他们脸的模样，并身体的形象，是我从前在迦巴鲁河边所看见的。他们俱各直往前行。
verses.textEnNiv: Their faces had the same appearance as those I had seen by the Kebar River. Each one went straight ahead.
verses.textEnEsv: And as for the likeness of their faces, they were the same faces whose appearance I had seen by the Chebar canal. Each one of them went straight forward.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the likeness of their faces was the same as the faces which I had seen by the River Chebar, their appearance and their persons. They each went straight forward.
verses.textEnNlt: And their faces were just like the faces of the beings I had seen at the Kebar, and they traveled straight ahead, just as the others had.
verses.textEnNasb: As for the likeness of their faces, they were the same faces whose appearance I had seen by the river Chebar. Each one went straight ahead.
verses.textEn: Their faces had the same appearance as those I had seen by the Kebar River. Each one went straight ahead.

verses.textZh: 灵把我提起来，带到耶和华殿朝东的东门；在门口那里有二十五个人；我看见他们中间有人民的领袖押朔的儿子雅撒尼亚和比拿雅的儿子毘拉提。
verses.textZhCnvs: 灵把我提起来，带到耶和华殿朝东的东门；在门口那里有二十五个人；我看见他们中间有人民的领袖押朔的儿子雅撒尼亚和比拿雅的儿子毘拉提。
verses.textZhCuv: 灵将我举起，带到耶和华殿向东的东门。谁知，在门口有二十五个人，我见其中有民间的首领押朔的儿子雅撒尼亚和比拿雅的儿子毗拉提。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the gate of the house of the Lord that faces east. There at the entrance of the gate were twenty-five men, and I saw among them Jaazaniah son of Azzur and Pelatiah son of Benaiah, leaders of the people.
verses.textEnEsv: The Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the east gate of the house of the Lord , which faces east. And behold, at the entrance of the gateway there were twenty-five men. And I saw among them Jaazaniah the son of Azzur, and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, princes of the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the East Gate of the Lord’s house, which faces eastward; and there at the door of the gate were twenty-five men, among whom I saw Jaazaniah the son of Azzur, and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, princes of the people.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Spirit lifted me and brought me to the east gateway of the Lord ’s Temple, where I saw twenty-five prominent men of the city. Among them were Jaazaniah son of Azzur and Pelatiah son of Benaiah, who were leaders among the people.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the east gate of the Lord’s house which faced eastward. And behold, there were twenty-five men at the entrance of the gate, and among them I saw Jaazaniah son of Azzur and Pelatiah son of Benaiah, leaders of the people.
verses.textEn: Then the Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the gate of the house of the Lord that faces east. There at the entrance of the gate were twenty-five men, and I saw among them Jaazaniah son of Azzur and Pelatiah son of Benaiah, leaders of the people.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对我说："人子啊！这些就是图谋罪孽，在这城里设恶谋的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对我说："人子啊！这些就是图谋罪孽，在这城里设恶谋的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对我说：「人子啊，这就是图谋罪孽的人，在这城中给人设恶谋。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to me, "Son of man, these are the men who are plotting evil and giving wicked advice in this city.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to me, "Son of man, these are the men who devise iniquity and who give wicked counsel in this city;
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said to me: "Son of man, these are the men who devise iniquity and give wicked counsel in this city,
verses.textEnNlt: The Spirit said to me, "Son of man, these are the men who are planning evil and giving wicked counsel in this city.
verses.textEnNasb: Then He said to me, "Son of man, these are the men who devise wrongdoing and give evil advice in this city,
verses.textEn: The Lord said to me, "Son of man, these are the men who are plotting evil and giving wicked advice in this city.

verses.textZh: 他们说：‘建造房屋的时候还没有到；这城是锅，我们是肉。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们说：‘建造房屋的时候还没有到；这城是锅，我们是肉。’
verses.textZhCuv: 他们说：『盖房屋的时候尚未临近；这城是锅，我们是肉。』
verses.textEnNiv: They say, ‘Haven’t our houses been recently rebuilt? This city is a pot, and we are the meat in it.’
verses.textEnEsv: who say, ‘The time is not near to build houses. This city is the cauldron, and we are the meat.’
verses.textEnNkjv: who say, ‘Thetimeis not near to build houses; this cityis the caldron, and we are the meat.’
verses.textEnNlt: They say to the people, ‘Is it not a good time to build houses? This city is like an iron pot. We are safe inside it like meat in a pot. ’
verses.textEnNasb: who say, ‘The time is not near to build houses. This city is the pot and we are the meat.’
verses.textEn: They say, ‘Haven’t our houses been recently rebuilt? This city is a pot, and we are the meat in it.’

verses.textZh: 因此，人子啊！你要说预言，要说预言攻击他们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，人子啊！你要说预言，要说预言攻击他们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 人子啊，因此你当说预言，说预言攻击他们。」
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore prophesy against them; prophesy, son of man."
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore prophesy against them; prophesy, O son of man."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore prophesy against them, prophesy, O son of man!"
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, son of man, prophesy against them loudly and clearly."
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, prophesy against them, prophesy, son of man!"
verses.textEn: Therefore prophesy against them; prophesy, son of man."

verses.textZh: 耶和华的灵降在我身上，他对我说："你要说：‘耶和华这样说：以色列家啊！你们口里所说、心中所想的，我都知道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的灵降在我身上，他对我说："你要说：‘耶和华这样说：以色列家啊！你们口里所说、心中所想的，我都知道。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的灵降在我身上，对我说：「你当说，耶和华如此说：以色列家啊，你们口中所说的，心里所想的，我都知道。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Spirit of the Lord came on me, and he told me to say: "This is what the Lord says: That is what you are saying, you leaders in Israel, but I know what is going through your mind.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Spirit of the Lord fell upon me, and he said to me, "Say, Thus says the Lord : So you think, O house of Israel. For I know the things that come into your mind.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Spirit of the Lord fell upon me, and said to me, "Speak! ‘Thus says the Lord: "Thus you have said, O house of Israel; for I know the things that come into your mind.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Spirit of the Lord came upon me, and he told me to say, "This is what the Lord says to the people of Israel: I know what you are saying, for I know every thought that comes into your minds.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Spirit of the Lord fell upon me, and He said to me, "Say, ‘This is what the Lord says: "This is how you think, house of Israel, for I know your thoughts.
verses.textEn: Then the Spirit of the Lord came on me, and he told me to say: "This is what the Lord says: That is what you are saying, you leaders in Israel, but I know what is going through your mind.

verses.textZh: 你们在这城里杀了许多人，使街道满了死人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们在这城里杀了许多人，使街道满了死人。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们在这城中杀人增多，使被杀的人充满街道。
verses.textEnNiv: You have killed many people in this city and filled its streets with the dead.
verses.textEnEsv: You have multiplied your slain in this city and have filled its streets with the slain.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have multiplied your slain in this city, and you have filled its streets with the slain."
verses.textEnNlt: You have murdered many in this city and filled its streets with the dead.
verses.textEnNasb: You have multiplied your slain in this city, and filled its streets with them."
verses.textEn: You have killed many people in this city and filled its streets with the dead.

verses.textZh: 因此，主耶和华这样说：你们弃置在城中的死人就是肉，这城就是锅；至于你们，却要从城中被赶出去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，主耶和华这样说：你们弃置在城中的死人就是肉，这城就是锅；至于你们，却要从城中被赶出去。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以主耶和华如此说：你们杀在城中的人就是肉，这城就是锅；你们却要从其中被带出去。
verses.textEnNiv: "Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: The bodies you have thrown there are the meat and this city is the pot, but I will drive you out of it.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore thus says the Lord God : Your slain whom you have laid in the midst of it, they are the meat, and this city is the cauldron, but you shall be brought out of the midst of it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore thus says the Lord God: "Your slain whom you have laid in its midst, they are the meat, and this cityis the caldron; but I shall bring you out of the midst of it.
verses.textEnNlt: "Therefore, this is what the Sovereign Lord says: This city is an iron pot all right, but the pieces of meat are the victims of your injustice. As for you, I will soon drag you from this pot.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, this is what the Lord God says: "Your slain whom you have laid in the midst of the city are the meat and this city is the pot; but I will bring you out of it.
verses.textEn: "Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: The bodies you have thrown there are the meat and this city is the pot, but I will drive you out of it.

verses.textZh: 你们惧怕刀剑，我就使刀剑临到你们，这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们惧怕刀剑，我就使刀剑临到你们，这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们怕刀剑，我必使刀剑临到你们。这是主耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: You fear the sword, and the sword is what I will bring against you, declares the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: You have feared the sword, and I will bring the sword upon you, declares the Lord God .
verses.textEnNkjv: You have feared the sword; and I will bring a sword upon you," says the Lord God.
verses.textEnNlt: I will bring on you the sword of war you so greatly fear, says the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: You have feared a sword; so I will bring a sword upon you," the Lord God declares.
verses.textEn: You fear the sword, and the sword is what I will bring against you, declares the Sovereign Lord .

verses.textZh: 我要把你们从城中赶出去，交在外族人的手里；我要向你们施行审判。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要把你们从城中赶出去，交在外族人的手里；我要向你们施行审判。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必从这城中带出你们去，交在外邦人的手中，且要在你们中间施行审判。
verses.textEnNiv: I will drive you out of the city and deliver you into the hands of foreigners and inflict punishment on you.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will bring you out of the midst of it, and give you into the hands of foreigners, and execute judgments upon you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And I will bring you out of its midst, and deliver you into the hands of strangers, and execute judgments on you.
verses.textEnNlt: I will drive you out of Jerusalem and hand you over to foreigners, who will carry out my judgments against you.
verses.textEnNasb: "And I will bring you out of the midst of the city, and hand you over to strangers, and execute judgments against you.
verses.textEn: I will drive you out of the city and deliver you into the hands of foreigners and inflict punishment on you.

verses.textZh: 你们必倒在刀下，我必审判你们，直到以色列的边境；你们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们必倒在刀下，我必审判你们，直到以色列的边境；你们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们必倒在刀下；我必在以色列的境界审判你们，你们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: You will fall by the sword, and I will execute judgment on you at the borders of Israel. Then you will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: You shall fall by the sword. I will judge you at the border of Israel, and you shall know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall fall by the sword. I will judge you at the border of Israel. Then you shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: You will be slaughtered all the way to the borders of Israel. I will execute judgment on you, and you will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: You will fall by the sword. I will judge you to the border of Israel; so you shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.textEn: You will fall by the sword, and I will execute judgment on you at the borders of Israel. Then you will know that I am the Lord .

verses.textZh: 这城必不作你们的锅，你们也必不作其中的肉。我必审判你们直到以色列的边境；
verses.textZhCnvs: 这城必不作你们的锅，你们也必不作其中的肉。我必审判你们直到以色列的边境；
verses.textZhCuv: 这城必不作你们的锅，你们也不作其中的肉。我必在以色列的境界审判你们，
verses.textEnNiv: This city will not be a pot for you, nor will you be the meat in it; I will execute judgment on you at the borders of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: This city shall not be your cauldron, nor shall you be the meat in the midst of it. I will judge you at the border of Israel,
verses.textEnNkjv: This city shall not be your caldron, nor shall you be the meat in its midst. I will judge you at the border of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: No, this city will not be an iron pot for you, and you will not be like meat safe inside it. I will judge you even to the borders of Israel,
verses.textEnNasb: This city will not be a pot for you, nor will you be meat in the midst of it; I will judge you to the border of Israel.
verses.textEn: This city will not be a pot for you, nor will you be the meat in it; I will execute judgment on you at the borders of Israel.

verses.textZh: 你们就知道我是耶和华。这是因为你们没有遵行我的律例，也没有遵守我的典章，却效法你们周围列国的习俗去行。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们就知道我是耶和华。这是因为你们没有遵行我的律例，也没有遵守我的典章，却效法你们周围列国的习俗去行。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们就知道我是耶和华；因为你们没有遵行我的律例，也没有顺从我的典章，却随从你们四围列国的恶规。」
