verses.textEnNiv: And you will know that I am the Lord , for you have not followed my decrees or kept my laws but have conformed to the standards of the nations around you."
verses.textEnEsv: and you shall know that I am the Lord . For you have not walked in my statutes, nor obeyed my rules, but have acted according to the rules of the nations that are around you."
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall know that I am the Lord; for you have not walked in My statutes nor executed My judgments, but have done according to the customs of the Gentiles which are all around you." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: and you will know that I am the Lord . For you have refused to obey my decrees and regulations; instead, you have copied the standards of the nations around you."
verses.textEnNasb: So you will know that I am the Lord; for you have not walked in My statutes, nor have you executed My ordinances, but you have acted in accordance with the ordinances of the nations around you." ’ "
verses.textEn: And you will know that I am the Lord , for you have not followed my decrees or kept my laws but have conformed to the standards of the nations around you."

verses.textZh: 我正在说预言的时候，比拿雅的儿子毘拉提死了。于是我脸伏在地，大声呼叫，说："哎，主耶和华啊！难道你要把以色列余剩的人都尽行毁灭吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我正在说预言的时候，比拿雅的儿子毘拉提死了。于是我脸伏在地，大声呼叫，说："哎，主耶和华啊！难道你要把以色列余剩的人都尽行毁灭吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 我正说预言的时候，比拿雅的儿子毗拉提死了。于是我俯伏在地，大声呼叫说：「哎！主耶和华啊，你要将以色列剩下的人灭绝净尽吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: Now as I was prophesying, Pelatiah son of Benaiah died. Then I fell facedown and cried out in a loud voice, "Alas, Sovereign Lord ! Will you completely destroy the remnant of Israel?"
verses.textEnEsv: And it came to pass, while I was prophesying, that Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died. Then I fell down on my face and cried out with a loud voice and said, "Ah, Lord God ! Will you make a full end of the remnant of Israel?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened, while I was prophesying, that Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died. Then I fell on my face and cried with a loud voice, and said, "Ah, Lord God! Will You make a complete end of the remnant of Israel?"
verses.textEnNlt: While I was still prophesying, Pelatiah son of Benaiah suddenly died. Then I fell face down on the ground and cried out, "O Sovereign Lord , are you going to kill everyone in Israel?"
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about, as I prophesied, that Pelatiah son of Benaiah died. Then I fell on my face and cried out with a loud voice, and said, "Oh, Lord God! Will You bring the remnant of Israel to a complete destruction?"
verses.textEn: Now as I was prophesying, Pelatiah son of Benaiah died. Then I fell facedown and cried out in a loud voice, "Alas, Sovereign Lord ! Will you completely destroy the remnant of Israel?"

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: And the word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnNkjv: Again the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then this message came to me from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: Then the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: The word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: "人子啊！论到你的兄弟、你的亲属、与你一同被掳的人 和以色列全家，耶路撒冷的居民曾经这样说：‘他们远离了耶和华，这地是赐给我们作产业的。’
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！论到你的兄弟、你的亲属、与你一同被掳的人 和以色列全家，耶路撒冷的居民曾经这样说：‘他们远离了耶和华，这地是赐给我们作产业的。’
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，耶路撒冷的居民对你的弟兄、你的本族、你的亲属、以色列全家，就是对大众说：『你们远离耶和华吧！这地是赐给我们为业的。』
verses.textEnNiv: "Son of man, the people of Jerusalem have said of your fellow exiles and all the other Israelites, ‘They are far away from the Lord ; this land was given to us as our possession.’
verses.textEnEsv: "Son of man, your brothers, even your brothers, your kinsmen, the whole house of Israel, all of them, are those of whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, ‘Go far from the Lord ; to us this land is given for a possession.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "Son of man, your brethren, your relatives, your countrymen, and all the house of Israel in its entirety, are those about whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, ‘Get far away from the Lord; this land has been given to us as a possession.’
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, the people still left in Jerusalem are talking about you and your relatives and all the people of Israel who are in exile. They are saying, ‘Those people are far away from the Lord , so now he has given their land to us!’
verses.textEnNasb: "Son of man, your brothers, your relatives, your fellow exiles, and the entire house of Israel, all of them, are those to whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, ‘Keep far from the Lord; this land has been given to us as a possession.’
verses.textEn: "Son of man, the people of Jerusalem have said of your fellow exiles and all the other Israelites, ‘They are far away from the Lord ; this land was given to us as our possession.’

verses.textZh: 因此你要说：‘主耶和华这样说：我虽然把他们远远地迁到列国之中，使他们分散在各地，我还要在他们所到的各地暂作他们的圣所。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此你要说：‘主耶和华这样说：我虽然把他们远远地迁到列国之中，使他们分散在各地，我还要在他们所到的各地暂作他们的圣所。’
verses.textZhCuv: 所以你当说：『耶和华如此说：我虽将以色列全家远远迁移到列国中，将他们分散在列邦内，我还要在他们所到的列邦，暂作他们的圣所。』
verses.textEnNiv: "Therefore say: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Although I sent them far away among the nations and scattered them among the countries, yet for a little while I have been a sanctuary for them in the countries where they have gone.’
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore say, ‘Thus says the Lord God : Though I removed them far off among the nations, and though I scattered them among the countries, yet I have been a sanctuary to them for a while in the countries where they have gone.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore say, ‘Thus says the Lord God: "Although I have cast them far off among the Gentiles, and although I have scattered them among the countries, yet I shall be a little sanctuary for them in the countries where they have gone." ’
verses.textEnNlt: "Therefore, tell the exiles, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Although I have scattered you in the countries of the world, I will be a sanctuary to you during your time in exile.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore say, ‘This is what the Lord God says: "Though I had removed them far away among the nations, and though I had scattered them among the countries, yet I was a sanctuary for them for a little while in the countries where they had gone." ’
verses.textEn: "Therefore say: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Although I sent them far away among the nations and scattered them among the countries, yet for a little while I have been a sanctuary for them in the countries where they have gone.’

verses.textZh: 因此你要说：‘主耶和华这样说：我要从万族中招聚你们，从你们被分散到的各地聚集你们，把以色列地赐给你们。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此你要说：‘主耶和华这样说：我要从万族中招聚你们，从你们被分散到的各地聚集你们，把以色列地赐给你们。’
verses.textZhCuv: 你当说：『主耶和华如此说：我必从万民中招聚你们，从分散的列国内聚集你们，又要将以色列地赐给你们。』
verses.textEnNiv: "Therefore say: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I will gather you from the nations and bring you back from the countries where you have been scattered, and I will give you back the land of Israel again.’
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore say, ‘Thus says the Lord God : I will gather you from the peoples and assemble you out of the countries where you have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore say, ‘Thus says the Lord God: "I will gather you from the peoples, assemble you from the countries where you have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel." ’
verses.textEnNlt: I, the Sovereign Lord , will gather you back from the nations where you have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel once again.’
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore say, ‘This is what the Lord God says: "I will gather you from the peoples and assemble you from the countries among which you have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel." ’
verses.textEn: "Therefore say: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I will gather you from the nations and bring you back from the countries where you have been scattered, and I will give you back the land of Israel again.’

verses.textZh: 他们必回到那里，也必除掉那里所有可厌的偶像和所有可憎之物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们必回到那里，也必除掉那里所有可厌的偶像和所有可憎之物。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必到那里，也必从其中除掉一切可憎可厌的物。
verses.textEnNiv: "They will return to it and remove all its vile images and detestable idols.
verses.textEnEsv: And when they come there, they will remove from it all its detestable things and all its abominations.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they will go there, and they will take away all its detestable things and all its abominations from there.
verses.textEnNlt: "When the people return to their homeland, they will remove every trace of their vile images and detestable idols.
verses.textEnNasb: When they come there, they will remove all its detestable things and all its abominations from it.
verses.textEn: "They will return to it and remove all its vile images and detestable idols.

verses.textZh: "我要把一颗心赐给他们，把新的灵放在他们里面；我要从他们肉体中除掉石心，赐给他们肉心，
verses.textZhCnvs: "我要把一颗心赐给他们，把新的灵放在他们里面；我要从他们肉体中除掉石心，赐给他们肉心，
verses.textZhCuv: 我要使他们有合一的心，也要将新灵放在他们里面，又从他们肉体中除掉石心，赐给他们肉心，
verses.textEnNiv: I will give them an undivided heart and put a new spirit in them; I will remove from them their heart of stone and give them a heart of flesh.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will give them one heart, and a new spirit I will put within them. I will remove the heart of stone from their flesh and give them a heart of flesh,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit within them, and take the stony heart out of their flesh, and give them a heart of flesh,
verses.textEnNlt: And I will give them singleness of heart and put a new spirit within them. I will take away their stony, stubborn heart and give them a tender, responsive heart,
verses.textEnNasb: And I will give them one heart, and put a new spirit within them. And I will remove the heart of stone from their flesh and give them a heart of flesh,
verses.textEn: I will give them an undivided heart and put a new spirit in them; I will remove from them their heart of stone and give them a heart of flesh.

verses.textZh: 使他们遵从我的律例，谨守遵行我的典章，这样，他们就必作我的子民，我必作他们的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 使他们遵从我的律例，谨守遵行我的典章，这样，他们就必作我的子民，我必作他们的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 使他们顺从我的律例，谨守遵行我的典章。他们要作我的子民，我要作他们的神。
verses.textEnNiv: Then they will follow my decrees and be careful to keep my laws. They will be my people, and I will be their God.
verses.textEnEsv: that they may walk in my statutes and keep my rules and obey them. And they shall be my people, and I will be their God.
verses.textEnNkjv: that they may walk in My statutes and keep My judgments and do them; and they shall be My people, and I will be their God.
verses.textEnNlt: so they will obey my decrees and regulations. Then they will truly be my people, and I will be their God.
verses.textEnNasb: so that they may walk in My statutes, and keep My ordinances and do them. Then they will be My people, and I shall be their God.
verses.textEn: Then they will follow my decrees and be careful to keep my laws. They will be my people, and I will be their God.

verses.textZh: 至于那些心中随从可厌的偶像和可憎之物的人，我要把他们所行的，报应在他们的头上。"这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于那些心中随从可厌的偶像和可憎之物的人，我要把他们所行的，报应在他们的头上。"这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于那些心中随从可憎可厌之物的，我必照他们所行的报应在他们头上。这是主耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: But as for those whose hearts are devoted to their vile images and detestable idols, I will bring down on their own heads what they have done, declares the Sovereign Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: But as for those whose heart goes after their detestable things and their abominations, I will bring their deeds upon their own heads, declares the Lord God ."
verses.textEnNkjv: But asforthose whose hearts follow the desire for their detestable things and their abominations, I will recompense their deeds on their own heads," says the Lord God.
verses.textEnNlt: But as for those who long for vile images and detestable idols, I will repay them fully for their sins. I, the Sovereign Lord , have spoken!"
verses.textEnNasb: But as for those whose hearts go after their detestable things and abominations, I will bring their conduct down on their heads," declares the Lord God.
verses.textEn: But as for those whose hearts are devoted to their vile images and detestable idols, I will bring down on their own heads what they have done, declares the Sovereign Lord ."

verses.textZh: 以后，基路伯展开翅膀，轮子都在他们旁边；在他们以上有以色列神的荣耀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以后，基路伯展开翅膀，轮子都在他们旁边；在他们以上有以色列神的荣耀。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，基路伯展开翅膀，轮子都在他们旁边；在他们以上有以色列神的荣耀。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the cherubim, with the wheels beside them, spread their wings, and the glory of the God of Israel was above them.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the cherubim lifted up their wings, with the wheels beside them, and the glory of the God of Israel was over them.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the cherubim lifted up their wings, with the wheels beside them, and the glory of the God of Israel was high above them.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the cherubim lifted their wings and rose into the air with their wheels beside them, and the glory of the God of Israel hovered above them.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the cherubim lifted up their wings with the wheels beside them, and the glory of the God of Israel hovered over them.
verses.textEn: Then the cherubim, with the wheels beside them, spread their wings, and the glory of the God of Israel was above them.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的荣耀从城中升起，停在城东的那座山上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的荣耀从城中升起，停在城东的那座山上。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的荣耀从城中上升，停在城东的那座山上。
verses.textEnNiv: The glory of the Lord went up from within the city and stopped above the mountain east of it.
verses.textEnEsv: And the glory of the Lord went up from the midst of the city and stood on the mountain that is on the east side of the city.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the glory of the Lord went up from the midst of the city and stood on the mountain, which is on the east side of the city.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the glory of the Lord went up from the city and stopped above the mountain to the east.
verses.textEnNasb: The glory of the Lord went up from the midst of the city and stood over the mountain which is east of the city.
verses.textEn: The glory of the Lord went up from within the city and stopped above the mountain east of it.

verses.textZh: 灵把我提起来，在异象中借着神的灵，领我到迦勒底被掳的人那里去；我看见的异象就离开我上升去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 灵把我提起来，在异象中借着神的灵，领我到迦勒底被掳的人那里去；我看见的异象就离开我上升去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 灵将我举起，在异象中藉着神的灵将我带进迦勒底地，到被掳的人那里；我所见的异象就离我上升去了。
verses.textEnNiv: The Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the exiles in Babylonia in the vision given by the Spirit of God. Then the vision I had seen went up from me,
verses.textEnEsv: And the Spirit lifted me up and brought me in the vision by the Spirit of God into Chaldea, to the exiles. Then the vision that I had seen went up from me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Spirit took me up and brought me in a vision by the Spirit of God into Chaldea, to those in captivity. And the vision that I had seen went up from me.
verses.textEnNlt: Afterward the Spirit of God carried me back again to Babylonia, to the people in exile there. And so ended the vision of my visit to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Spirit lifted me up and brought me in a vision by the Spirit of God to Chaldea, to the exiles. Then the vision that I had seen left me.
verses.textEn: The Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the exiles in Babylonia in the vision given by the Spirit of God. Then the vision I had seen went up from me,

verses.textZh: 我就把耶和华指示我的一切事都说给被掳的人听。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我就把耶和华指示我的一切事都说给被掳的人听。
verses.textZhCuv: 我便将耶和华所指示我的一切事都说给被掳的人听。
verses.textEnNiv: and I told the exiles everything the Lord had shown me.
verses.textEnEsv: And I told the exiles all the things that the Lord had shown me.
verses.textEnNkjv: So I spoke to those in captivity of all the things the Lord had shown me.
verses.textEnNlt: And I told the exiles everything the Lord had shown me.
verses.textEnNasb: And I told the exiles all the things that the Lord had shown me.
verses.textEn: and I told the exiles everything the Lord had shown me.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: Again a message came to me from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: Then the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: The word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: "人子啊！你是住在叛逆的民族之中；他们有眼睛可以看，却看不见；他们有耳朵可以听，却听不见，因为他们是叛逆的民族。
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！你是住在叛逆的民族之中；他们有眼睛可以看，却看不见；他们有耳朵可以听，却听不见，因为他们是叛逆的民族。
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，你住在悖逆的家中。他们有眼睛看不见，有耳朵听不见，因为他们是悖逆之家。
verses.textEnNiv: "Son of man, you are living among a rebellious people. They have eyes to see but do not see and ears to hear but do not hear, for they are a rebellious people.
verses.textEnEsv: "Son of man, you dwell in the midst of a rebellious house, who have eyes to see, but see not, who have ears to hear, but hear not, for they are a rebellious house.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Son of man, you dwell in the midst of a rebellious house, which has eyes to see but does not see, and ears to hear but does not hear; for they are a rebellious house.
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, you live among rebels who have eyes but refuse to see. They have ears but refuse to hear. For they are a rebellious people.
verses.textEnNasb: "Son of man, you live in the midst of the rebellious house, who have eyes to see but do not see, ears to hear but do not hear; for they are a rebellious house.
verses.textEn: "Son of man, you are living among a rebellious people. They have eyes to see but do not see and ears to hear but do not hear, for they are a rebellious people.

verses.textZh: 因此，人子啊！你要为自己预备被掳时所需的东西，在日间当着他们眼前离去，从你所住的地方移居别处；他们虽然是叛逆的民族，或者他们可以看得明白。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，人子啊！你要为自己预备被掳时所需的东西，在日间当着他们眼前离去，从你所住的地方移居别处；他们虽然是叛逆的民族，或者他们可以看得明白。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以人子啊，你要预备掳去使用的物件，在白日当他们眼前从你所住的地方移到别处去；他们虽是悖逆之家，或者可以揣摩思想。
verses.textEnNiv: "Therefore, son of man, pack your belongings for exile and in the daytime, as they watch, set out and go from where you are to another place. Perhaps they will understand, though they are a rebellious people.
verses.textEnEsv: As for you, son of man, prepare for yourself an exile’s baggage, and go into exile by day in their sight. You shall go like an exile from your place to another place in their sight. Perhaps they will understand, though they are a rebellious house.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore, son of man, prepare your belongings for captivity, and go into captivity by day in their sight. You shall go from your place into captivity to another place in their sight. It may be that they will consider, though they are a rebellious house.
verses.textEnNlt: "So now, son of man, pretend you are being sent into exile. Pack the few items an exile could carry, and leave your home to go somewhere else. Do this right in front of the people so they can see you. For perhaps they will pay attention to this, even though they are such rebels.
verses.textEnNasb: So as for you, son of man, prepare for yourself baggage for exile and go into exile by day in their sight; that is, go into exile from your place to another place in their sight. Perhaps they will understand, though they are a rebellious house.
verses.textEn: "Therefore, son of man, pack your belongings for exile and in the daytime, as they watch, set out and go from where you are to another place. Perhaps they will understand, though they are a rebellious people.

verses.textZh: 你要在日间当着他们眼前，把你的东西 搬出来，到了晚上，你要当着他们眼前出去，像被掳的人出去一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要在日间当着他们眼前，把你的东西 搬出来，到了晚上，你要当着他们眼前出去，像被掳的人出去一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要在白日当他们眼前带出你的物件去，好像预备掳去使用的物件。到了晚上，你要在他们眼前亲自出去，像被掳的人出去一样。
verses.textEnNiv: During the daytime, while they watch, bring out your belongings packed for exile. Then in the evening, while they are watching, go out like those who go into exile.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall bring out your baggage by day in their sight, as baggage for exile, and you shall go out yourself at evening in their sight, as those do who must go into exile.
verses.textEnNkjv: By day you shall bring out your belongings in their sight, as though going into captivity; and at evening you shall go in their sight, like those who go into captivity.
verses.textEnNlt: Bring your baggage outside during the day so they can watch you. Then in the evening, as they are watching, leave your house as captives do when they begin a long march to distant lands.
verses.textEnNasb: Bring your baggage out by day in their sight, as baggage for exile. Then you shall go out at evening in their sight, as those who are going into exile.
verses.textEn: During the daytime, while they watch, bring out your belongings packed for exile. Then in the evening, while they are watching, go out like those who go into exile.

verses.textZh: 你要当着他们眼前把墙挖穿，把你的东西从那里带出去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要当着他们眼前把墙挖穿，把你的东西从那里带出去。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要在他们眼前挖通了墙，从其中将物件带出去。
verses.textEnNiv: While they watch, dig through the wall and take your belongings out through it.
verses.textEnEsv: In their sight dig through the wall, and bring your baggage out through it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Dig through the wall in their sight, and carry yourbelongings out through it.
verses.textEnNlt: Dig a hole through the wall while they are watching and go out through it.
verses.textEnNasb: Dig a hole through the wall in their sight and go out through it.
verses.textEn: While they watch, dig through the wall and take your belongings out through it.

verses.textZh: 到了天黑，你要当着他们眼前把这些东西扛在肩头上带出去；你要蒙住你的脸，使你看不见这地，因为我已经立你作以色列家的一个兆头。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了天黑，你要当着他们眼前把这些东西扛在肩头上带出去；你要蒙住你的脸，使你看不见这地，因为我已经立你作以色列家的一个兆头。"
verses.textZhCuv: 到天黑时，你要当他们眼前搭在肩头上带出去，并要蒙住脸看不见地，因为我立你作以色列家的预兆。」
verses.textEnNiv: Put them on your shoulder as they are watching and carry them out at dusk. Cover your face so that you cannot see the land, for I have made you a sign to the Israelites."
verses.textEnEsv: In their sight you shall lift the baggage upon your shoulder and carry it out at dusk. You shall cover your face that you may not see the land, for I have made you a sign for the house of Israel."
verses.textEnNkjv: In their sight you shall bear them on your shoulders and carry them out at twilight; you shall cover your face, so that you cannot see the ground, for I have made you a sign to the house of Israel."
verses.textEnNlt: As they watch, lift your pack to your shoulders and walk away into the night. Cover your face so you cannot see the land you are leaving. For I have made you a sign for the people of Israel."
verses.textEnNasb: Load the baggage on your shoulder in their sight and carry it out in the dark. You shall cover your face so that you cannot see the land, for I have set you as a sign to the house of Israel."
verses.textEn: Put them on your shoulder as they are watching and carry them out at dusk. Cover your face so that you cannot see the land, for I have made you a sign to the Israelites."

verses.textZh: 于是我照着所吩咐的去行，在日间我把我的东西 搬出来；到了晚上，我用手把墙挖穿；天黑的时候，我就当着他们眼前把这些东西扛在肩头上带出去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是我照着所吩咐的去行，在日间我把我的东西 搬出来；到了晚上，我用手把墙挖穿；天黑的时候，我就当着他们眼前把这些东西扛在肩头上带出去。
verses.textZhCuv: 我就照着所吩咐的去行，白日带出我的物件，好像预备掳去使用的物件。到了晚上，我用手挖通了墙。天黑的时候，就当他们眼前搭在肩头上带出去。
verses.textEnNiv: So I did as I was commanded. During the day I brought out my things packed for exile. Then in the evening I dug through the wall with my hands. I took my belongings out at dusk, carrying them on my shoulders while they watched.
verses.textEnEsv: And I did as I was commanded. I brought out my baggage by day, as baggage for exile, and in the evening I dug through the wall with my own hands. I brought out my baggage at dusk, carrying it on my shoulder in their sight.
verses.textEnNkjv: So I did as I was commanded. I brought out my belongings by day, as though going into captivity, and at evening I dug through the wall with my hand. I brought them out at twilight, and I bore them on my shoulder in their sight.
verses.textEnNlt: So I did as I was told. In broad daylight I brought my pack outside, filled with the things I might carry into exile. Then in the evening while the people looked on, I dug through the wall with my hands and went out into the night with my pack on my shoulder.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I did so, just as I had been commanded. By day I brought out my baggage like the baggage of an exile. Then in the evening I dug through the wall with my hands; I went out in the dark and carried the baggage on my shoulder in their sight.
verses.textEn: So I did as I was commanded. During the day I brought out my things packed for exile. Then in the evening I dug through the wall with my hands. I took my belongings out at dusk, carrying them on my shoulders while they watched.

verses.textZh: 到了早晨，耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了早晨，耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 次日早晨，耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: In the morning the word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: In the morning the word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnNkjv: And in the morning the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: The next morning this message came to me from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: And in the morning the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: In the morning the word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: "人子啊！以色列家，就是叛逆的民族，不是问你：‘你在作甚么呢？’
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！以色列家，就是叛逆的民族，不是问你：‘你在作甚么呢？’
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，以色列家，就是那悖逆之家，岂不是问你说：『你做什么呢？』
verses.textEnNiv: "Son of man, did not the Israelites, that rebellious people, ask you, ‘What are you doing?’
verses.textEnEsv: "Son of man, has not the house of Israel, the rebellious house, said to you, ‘What are you doing?’
verses.textEnNkjv: "Son of man, has not the house of Israel, the rebellious house, said to you, ‘What are you doing?’
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, these rebels, the people of Israel, have asked you what all this means.
verses.textEnNasb: "Son of man, has the house of Israel, the rebellious house, not said to you, ‘What are you doing?’
verses.textEn: "Son of man, did not the Israelites, that rebellious people, ask you, ‘What are you doing?’

verses.textZh: 你要对他们说：‘主耶和华这样说：这默示 是关乎耶路撒冷的君王，和在它中间的以色列全家。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要对他们说：‘主耶和华这样说：这默示 是关乎耶路撒冷的君王，和在它中间的以色列全家。’
verses.textZhCuv: 你要对他们说：『主耶和华如此说：这是关乎耶路撒冷的君王和他周围以色列全家的预表 。』
verses.textEnNiv: "Say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: This prophecy concerns the prince in Jerusalem and all the Israelites who are there.’
verses.textEnEsv: Say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord God : This oracle concerns the prince in Jerusalem and all the house of Israel who are in it.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord God: "This burden concerns the prince in Jerusalem and all the house of Israel who are among them." ’
verses.textEnNlt: Say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: These actions contain a message for King Zedekiah in Jerusalem and for all the people of Israel.’
verses.textEnNasb: Say to them, ‘This is what the Lord God says: "This pronouncement concerns the prince in Jerusalem as well as all the house of Israel who are in it." ’
verses.textEn: "Say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: This prophecy concerns the prince in Jerusalem and all the Israelites who are there.’

verses.textZh: 你要说：‘我作你们的一个兆头，我怎样行，他们的遭遇也必怎样；他们必被掳去。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要说：‘我作你们的一个兆头，我怎样行，他们的遭遇也必怎样；他们必被掳去。’
verses.textZhCuv: 你要说：『我作你们的预兆：我怎样行，他们所遭遇的也必怎样，他们必被掳去。』
verses.textEnNiv: Say to them, ‘I am a sign to you.’ "As I have done, so it will be done to them. They will go into exile as captives.
verses.textEnEsv: Say, ‘I am a sign for you: as I have done, so shall it be done to them. They shall go into exile, into captivity.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Say, ‘I am a sign to you. As I have done, so shall it be done to them; they shall be carried away into captivity.’
verses.textEnNlt: Explain that your actions are a sign to show what will soon happen to them, for they will be driven into exile as captives.
verses.textEnNasb: Say, ‘I am a sign to you. Just as I have done, so it will be done to them; they will go into exile, into captivity.’
verses.textEn: Say to them, ‘I am a sign to you.’ "As I have done, so it will be done to them. They will go into exile as captives.

verses.textZh: 他们中间的君王必在天黑的时候，把东西扛在肩头上，从他们挖穿的墙带出去；他必蒙住自己的脸，不能看见这地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们中间的君王必在天黑的时候，把东西扛在肩头上，从他们挖穿的墙带出去；他必蒙住自己的脸，不能看见这地。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们中间的君王也必在天黑的时候将物件搭在肩头上带出去。他们要挖通了墙，从其中带出去。他必蒙住脸，眼看不见地。
verses.textEnNiv: "The prince among them will put his things on his shoulder at dusk and leave, and a hole will be dug in the wall for him to go through. He will cover his face so that he cannot see the land.
verses.textEnEsv: And the prince who is among them shall lift his baggage upon his shoulder at dusk, and shall go out. They shall dig through the wall to bring him out through it. He shall cover his face, that he may not see the land with his eyes.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the prince who is among them shall bear hisbelongings on his shoulder at twilight and go out. They shall dig through the wall to carry them out through it. He shall cover his face, so that he cannot see the ground with his eyes.
verses.textEnNlt: "Even Zedekiah will leave Jerusalem at night through a hole in the wall, taking only what he can carry with him. He will cover his face, and his eyes will not see the land he is leaving.
verses.textEnNasb: The prince who is among them will load his baggage on his shoulder in the dark and go out. They will dig a hole through the wall to bring it out through it. He will cover his face so that he cannot see the land with his eyes.
verses.textEn: "The prince among them will put his things on his shoulder at dusk and leave, and a hole will be dug in the wall for him to go through. He will cover his face so that he cannot see the land.

verses.textZh: 我要把我的网撒在他身上，他必被我的网罗网住；我要把他带到巴比伦，就是迦勒底人之地；他不会看见那地，却要死在那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要把我的网撒在他身上，他必被我的网罗网住；我要把他带到巴比伦，就是迦勒底人之地；他不会看见那地，却要死在那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必将我的网撒在他身上，他必在我的网罗中缠住。我必带他到迦勒底人之地的巴比伦；他虽死在那里，却看不见那地。
verses.textEnNiv: I will spread my net for him, and he will be caught in my snare; I will bring him to Babylonia, the land of the Chaldeans, but he will not see it, and there he will die.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will spread my net over him, and he shall be taken in my snare. And I will bring him to Babylon, the land of the Chaldeans, yet he shall not see it, and he shall die there.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will also spread My net over him, and he shall be caught in My snare. I will bring him to Babylon, to the land of the Chaldeans; yet he shall not see it, though he shall die there.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I will throw my net over him and capture him in my snare. I will bring him to Babylon, the land of the Babylonians, though he will never see it, and he will die there.
verses.textEnNasb: I will also spread My net over him, and he will be caught in My net. And I will bring him to Babylon in the land of the Chaldeans; yet he will not see it, though he will die there.
verses.textEn: I will spread my net for him, and he will be caught in my snare; I will bring him to Babylonia, the land of the Chaldeans, but he will not see it, and there he will die.

verses.textZh: 我要把他周围所有的人，就是所有帮助他的和他所有的军队，分散到四方去，也要拔出刀来追赶他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要把他周围所有的人，就是所有帮助他的和他所有的军队，分散到四方去，也要拔出刀来追赶他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 周围一切帮助他的和他所有的军队，我必分散四方 ，也要拔刀追赶他们。
verses.textEnNiv: I will scatter to the winds all those around him—his staff and all his troops—and I will pursue them with drawn sword.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will scatter toward every wind all who are around him, his helpers and all his troops, and I will unsheathe the sword after them.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will scatter to every wind all who are around him to help him, and all his troops; and I will draw out the sword after them.
verses.textEnNlt: I will scatter his servants and warriors to the four winds and send the sword after them.
verses.textEnNasb: And I will scatter to every wind all who are around him, his helpers and all his troops; and I will draw out a sword after them.
verses.textEn: I will scatter to the winds all those around him—his staff and all his troops—and I will pursue them with drawn sword.

verses.textZh: 我使他们四散到列邦中，分散在各地的时候，他们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我使他们四散到列邦中，分散在各地的时候，他们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 我将他们四散在列国、分散在列邦的时候，他们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: "They will know that I am the Lord , when I disperse them among the nations and scatter them through the countries.
verses.textEnEsv: And they shall know that I am the Lord , when I disperse them among the nations and scatter them among the countries.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then they shall know that I am the Lord, when I scatter them among the nations and disperse them throughout the countries.
verses.textEnNlt: And when I scatter them among the nations, they will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: So they will know that I am the Lord, when I disperse them among the nations and scatter them among the countries.
verses.textEn: "They will know that I am the Lord , when I disperse them among the nations and scatter them through the countries.

verses.textZh: 然而我却要留下他们少数的人，免受刀剑、饥荒和瘟疫之害，好使他们在所到的列国中，述说他们一切可憎恶的事，他们就知道我是耶和华。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而我却要留下他们少数的人，免受刀剑、饥荒和瘟疫之害，好使他们在所到的列国中，述说他们一切可憎恶的事，他们就知道我是耶和华。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我却要留下他们几个人得免刀剑、饥荒、瘟疫，使他们在所到的各国中述说他们一切可憎的事，人就知道我是耶和华。」
verses.textEnNiv: But I will spare a few of them from the sword, famine and plague, so that in the nations where they go they may acknowledge all their detestable practices. Then they will know that I am the Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: But I will let a few of them escape from the sword, from famine and pestilence, that they may declare all their abominations among the nations where they go, and may know that I am the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: But I will spare a few of their men from the sword, from famine, and from pestilence, that they may declare all their abominations among the Gentiles wherever they go. Then they shall know that I am the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: But I will spare a few of them from death by war, famine, or disease, so they can confess all their detestable sins to their captors. Then they will know that I am the Lord ."
verses.textEnNasb: But I will spare a few of them from the sword, the famine, and plague so that they may tell of all their abominations among the nations where they go, and may know that I am the Lord."
verses.textEn: But I will spare a few of them from the sword, famine and plague, so that in the nations where they go they may acknowledge all their detestable practices. Then they will know that I am the Lord ."

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: And the word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then this message came to me from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: The word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: "人子啊！你要战战兢兢地吃你的饭，满心忧虑地喝你的水。
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！你要战战兢兢地吃你的饭，满心忧虑地喝你的水。
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，你吃饭必胆战，喝水必惶惶忧虑。
verses.textEnNiv: "Son of man, tremble as you eat your food, and shudder in fear as you drink your water.
verses.textEnEsv: "Son of man, eat your bread with quaking, and drink water with trembling and with anxiety.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Son of man, eat your bread with quaking, and drink your water with trembling and anxiety.
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, tremble as you eat your food. Shake with fear as you drink your water.
verses.textEnNasb: "Son of man, eat your bread with trembling, and drink your water with quivering and anxiety.
verses.textEn: "Son of man, tremble as you eat your food, and shudder in fear as you drink your water.

verses.textZh: 你要对这地的人民说：‘论到耶路撒冷的居民和以色列地，主耶和华这样说：他们要满心忧虑地吃他们的饭，十分惊惶地喝他们的水；因为所有居民的强暴，这地必全然荒凉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要对这地的人民说：‘论到耶路撒冷的居民和以色列地，主耶和华这样说：他们要满心忧虑地吃他们的饭，十分惊惶地喝他们的水；因为所有居民的强暴，这地必全然荒凉。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要对这地的百姓说：主耶和华论耶路撒冷和以色列地的居民如此说，他们吃饭必忧虑，喝水必惊惶。因其中居住的众人所行强暴的事，这地必然荒废，一无所存。
verses.textEnNiv: Say to the people of the land: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says about those living in Jerusalem and in the land of Israel: They will eat their food in anxiety and drink their water in despair, for their land will be stripped of everything in it because of the violence of all who live there.
verses.textEnEsv: And say to the people of the land, Thus says the Lord God concerning the inhabitants of Jerusalem in the land of Israel: They shall eat their bread with anxiety, and drink water in dismay. In this way her land will be stripped of all it contains, on account of the violence of all those who dwell in it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And say to the people of the land, ‘Thus says the Lord God to the inhabitants of Jerusalem and to the land of Israel: "They shall eat their bread with anxiety, and drink their water with dread, so that her land may be emptied of all who are in it, because of the violence of all those who dwell in it.
verses.textEnNlt: Tell the people, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says concerning those living in Israel and Jerusalem: They will eat their food with trembling and sip their water in despair, for their land will be stripped bare because of their violence.
verses.textEnNasb: Then say to the people of the land, ‘This is what the Lord God says concerning the inhabitants of Jerusalem in the land of Israel: "They will eat their bread with anxiety and drink their water with horror, because their land will be stripped of its fullness on account of the violence of all who live in it.
verses.textEn: Say to the people of the land: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says about those living in Jerusalem and in the land of Israel: They will eat their food in anxiety and drink their water in despair, for their land will be stripped of everything in it because of the violence of all who live there.

verses.textZh: 有人居住的城市必成为荒场，这地必然荒凉，你们就知道我是耶和华。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人居住的城市必成为荒场，这地必然荒凉，你们就知道我是耶和华。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 有居民的城邑必变为荒场，地也必变为荒废；你们就知道我是耶和华。」
verses.textEnNiv: The inhabited towns will be laid waste and the land will be desolate. Then you will know that I am the Lord .’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And the inhabited cities shall be laid waste, and the land shall become a desolation; and you shall know that I am the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the cities that are inhabited shall be laid waste, and the land shall become desolate; and you shall know that I am the Lord." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: The cities will be destroyed and the farmland made desolate. Then you will know that I am the Lord .’"
verses.textEnNasb: The inhabited cities will be in ruins, and the land will be a desolation. So you will know that I am the Lord." ’ "
verses.textEn: The inhabited towns will be laid waste and the land will be desolate. Then you will know that I am the Lord .’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: And the word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnNkjv: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Again a message came to me from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: Then the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: The word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: "人子啊！你们在以色列地怎么有这一句俗语说：‘日子一天一天过去，所有异象都落空了’呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！你们在以色列地怎么有这一句俗语说：‘日子一天一天过去，所有异象都落空了’呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，在你们以色列地怎么有这俗语，说『日子迟延，一切异象都落了空』呢？
verses.textEnNiv: "Son of man, what is this proverb you have in the land of Israel: ‘The days go by and every vision comes to nothing’?
verses.textEnEsv: "Son of man, what is this proverb that you have about the land of Israel, saying, ‘The days grow long, and every vision comes to nothing’?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Son of man, what is this proverb that you people have about the land of Israel, which says, ‘The days are prolonged, and every vision fails’?
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, you’ve heard that proverb they quote in Israel: ‘Time passes, and prophecies come to nothing.’
verses.textEnNasb: "Son of man, what is this proverb you people have about the land of Israel, saying, ‘The days are long, and every vision fails’?
verses.textEn: "Son of man, what is this proverb you have in the land of Israel: ‘The days go by and every vision comes to nothing’?

verses.textZh: 因此，你要对他们说：主耶和华这样说：‘我必使这一句俗语不再流行，在以色列中，人必不再引用这句俗语。’你却要对他们说：‘日子临近了，所有异象都必应验。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，你要对他们说：主耶和华这样说：‘我必使这一句俗语不再流行，在以色列中，人必不再引用这句俗语。’你却要对他们说：‘日子临近了，所有异象都必应验。’
verses.textZhCuv: 你要告诉他们说：『主耶和华如此说：我必使这俗语止息，以色列中不再用这俗语。』你却要对他们说：『日子临近，一切的异象必都应验。』
verses.textEnNiv: Say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I am going to put an end to this proverb, and they will no longer quote it in Israel.’ Say to them, ‘The days are near when every vision will be fulfilled.
verses.textEnEsv: Tell them therefore, ‘Thus says the Lord God : I will put an end to this proverb, and they shall no more use it as a proverb in Israel.’ But say to them, The days are near, and the fulfillment of every vision.
verses.textEnNkjv: Tell them therefore, ‘Thus says the Lord God: "I will lay this proverb to rest, and they shall no more use it as a proverb in Israel." ’ But say to them, ‘ "The days are at hand, and the fulfillment of every vision.
verses.textEnNlt: Tell the people, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I will put an end to this proverb, and you will soon stop quoting it.’ Now give them this new proverb to replace the old one: ‘The time has come for every prophecy to be fulfilled!’
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore say to them, ‘This is what the Lord God says: "I will put an end to this proverb so that they will no longer use it as a proverb in Israel." But tell them, "The days are approaching as well as the fulfillment of every vision.
verses.textEn: Say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I am going to put an end to this proverb, and they will no longer quote it in Israel.’ Say to them, ‘The days are near when every vision will be fulfilled.

verses.textZh: 从此，在以色列家中必不再有虚假的异象和奉承的占卜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从此，在以色列家中必不再有虚假的异象和奉承的占卜。
verses.textZhCuv: 从此，在以色列家中必不再有虚假的异象和奉承的占卜。
verses.textEnNiv: For there will be no more false visions or flattering divinations among the people of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: For there shall be no more any false vision or flattering divination within the house of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: For no more shall there be any false vision or flattering divination within the house of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: "There will be no more false visions and flattering predictions in Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: For there will no longer be any false vision or deceptive divination within the house of Israel.
verses.textEn: For there will be no more false visions or flattering divinations among the people of Israel.

verses.textZh: 我耶和华所说的，是我要说的话，我所说的必定成就，不再耽延。叛逆的民族啊！我所说的话必在你们还活着的日子成就。这是主耶和华的宣告。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我耶和华所说的，是我要说的话，我所说的必定成就，不再耽延。叛逆的民族啊！我所说的话必在你们还活着的日子成就。这是主耶和华的宣告。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我－耶和华说话，所说的必定成就，不再耽延。你们这悖逆之家，我所说的话必趁你们在世的日子成就。这是主耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: But I the Lord will speak what I will, and it shall be fulfilled without delay. For in your days, you rebellious people, I will fulfill whatever I say, declares the Sovereign Lord .’ "
verses.textEnEsv: For I am the Lord ; I will speak the word that I will speak, and it will be performed. It will no longer be delayed, but in your days, O rebellious house, I will speak the word and perform it, declares the Lord God ."
verses.textEnNkjv: For I am the Lord. I speak, and the word which I speak will come to pass; it will no more be postponed; for in your days, O rebellious house, I will say the word and perform it," says the Lord God.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: For I am the Lord ! If I say it, it will happen. There will be no more delays, you rebels of Israel. I will fulfill my threat of destruction in your own lifetime. I, the Sovereign Lord , have spoken!"
verses.textEnNasb: For I the Lord will speak whatever word I speak, and it will be performed. It will no longer be delayed, for in your days, you rebellious house, I will speak the word and perform it," declares the Lord God.’ "
verses.textEn: But I the Lord will speak what I will, and it shall be fulfilled without delay. For in your days, you rebellious people, I will fulfill whatever I say, declares the Sovereign Lord .’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: And the word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnNkjv: Again the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then this message came to me from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: Furthermore, the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: The word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: "人子啊！以色列家说：‘这人所见的异象是关乎许多年日以后的事，他所说的预言是指着遥远的将来。’
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！以色列家说：‘这人所见的异象是关乎许多年日以后的事，他所说的预言是指着遥远的将来。’
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，以色列家的人说：『他所见的异象是关乎后来许多的日子，所说的预言是指着极远的时候。』
verses.textEnNiv: "Son of man, the Israelites are saying, ‘The vision he sees is for many years from now, and he prophesies about the distant future.’
verses.textEnEsv: "Son of man, behold, they of the house of Israel say, ‘The vision that he sees is for many days from now, and he prophesies of times far off.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "Son of man, look, the house of Israel is saying, ‘The vision that he sees is for many days fromnow, and he prophesies of times far off.’
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, the people of Israel are saying, ‘He’s talking about the distant future. His visions won’t come true for a long, long time.’
verses.textEnNasb: "Son of man, behold, the house of Israel is saying, ‘The vision that he sees is for many years from now, and he prophesies of times far off.’
verses.textEn: "Son of man, the Israelites are saying, ‘The vision he sees is for many years from now, and he prophesies about the distant future.’

verses.textZh: 因此，你要对他们说：‘主耶和华这样说：我所有的话，必没有一句再耽延；我所说的，都必成就。这是主耶和华的宣告。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，你要对他们说：‘主耶和华这样说：我所有的话，必没有一句再耽延；我所说的，都必成就。这是主耶和华的宣告。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 所以你要对他们说：『主耶和华如此说：我的话没有一句再耽延的，我所说的必定成就。这是主耶和华说的。』」
verses.textEnNiv: "Therefore say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: None of my words will be delayed any longer; whatever I say will be fulfilled, declares the Sovereign Lord .’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore say to them, Thus says the Lord God : None of my words will be delayed any longer, but the word that I speak will be performed, declares the Lord God ."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord God: "None of My words will be postponed any more, but the word which I speak will be done," says the Lord God.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, tell them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: No more delay! I will now do everything I have threatened. I, the Sovereign Lord , have spoken!’"
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore say to them, ‘This is what the Lord God says: "None of My words will be delayed any longer. Whatever word I speak will be performed," ’ " declares the Lord God.
verses.textEn: "Therefore say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: None of my words will be delayed any longer; whatever I say will be fulfilled, declares the Sovereign Lord .’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnNkjv: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then this message came to me from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: Then the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: The word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: "人子啊！你要说预言攻击那些在以色列中说预言的先知，对那些随着自己心意说预言的人说：‘你们要听耶和华的话。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！你要说预言攻击那些在以色列中说预言的先知，对那些随着自己心意说预言的人说：‘你们要听耶和华的话。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，你要说预言攻击以色列中说预言的先知，对那些本己心发预言的说：『你们当听耶和华的话。』」
verses.textEnNiv: "Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel who are now prophesying. Say to those who prophesy out of their own imagination: ‘Hear the word of the Lord !
verses.textEnEsv: "Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel, who are prophesying, and say to those who prophesy from their own hearts: ‘Hear the word of the Lord !’
verses.textEnNkjv: "Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel who prophesy, and say to those who prophesy out of their own heart, ‘Hear the word of the Lord!’ "
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, prophesy against the false prophets of Israel who are inventing their own prophecies. Say to them, ‘Listen to the word of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel who prophesy, and say to those who prophesy from their own inspiration, ‘Listen to the word of the Lord!
verses.textEn: "Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel who are now prophesying. Say to those who prophesy out of their own imagination: ‘Hear the word of the Lord !

verses.textZh: 主耶和华这样说："愚顽的先知有祸了，他们只是随从自己的灵说预言，却没有看见过甚么异象。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主耶和华这样说："愚顽的先知有祸了，他们只是随从自己的灵说预言，却没有看见过甚么异象。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华如此说：「愚顽的先知有祸了，他们随从自己的心意，却一无所见。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Woe to the foolish prophets who follow their own spirit and have seen nothing!
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord God , Woe to the foolish prophets who follow their own spirit, and have seen nothing!
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord God: "Woe to the foolish prophets, who follow their own spirit and have seen nothing!
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Sovereign Lord says: What sorrow awaits the false prophets who are following their own imaginations and have seen nothing at all!’
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord God says: "Woe to the foolish prophets who are following their own spirit and have seen nothing!
verses.textEn: This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Woe to the foolish prophets who follow their own spirit and have seen nothing!

verses.textZh: 以色列啊！你的先知好象废墟中的狐狸。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列啊！你的先知好象废墟中的狐狸。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列啊，你的先知好像荒场中的狐狸，
verses.textEnNiv: Your prophets, Israel, are like jackals among ruins.
verses.textEnEsv: Your prophets have been like jackals among ruins, O Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: O Israel, your prophets are like foxes in the deserts.
verses.textEnNlt: "O people of Israel, these prophets of yours are like jackals digging in the ruins.
verses.textEnNasb: Israel, your prophets have been like jackals among ruins.
verses.textEn: Your prophets, Israel, are like jackals among ruins.

verses.textZh: 他们没有上去堵塞破口，也没有为以色列家重修墙垣，使它在耶和华的日子，在战争中可以站立得住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们没有上去堵塞破口，也没有为以色列家重修墙垣，使它在耶和华的日子，在战争中可以站立得住。
verses.textZhCuv: 没有上去堵挡破口，也没有为以色列家重修墙垣，使他们当耶和华的日子在阵上站立得住。
verses.textEnNiv: You have not gone up to the breaches in the wall to repair it for the people of Israel so that it will stand firm in the battle on the day of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: You have not gone up into the breaches, or built up a wall for the house of Israel, that it might stand in battle in the day of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: You have not gone up into the gaps to build a wall for the house of Israel to stand in battle on the day of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: They have done nothing to repair the breaks in the walls around the nation. They have not helped it to stand firm in battle on the day of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: You have not gone up into the breaches, nor did you build up a stone wall around the house of Israel to stand in the battle on the day of the Lord.
verses.textEn: You have not gone up to the breaches in the wall to repair it for the people of Israel so that it will stand firm in the battle on the day of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 他们所见的是虚假的异象，是骗人的占卜；他们说：‘这是耶和华的宣告。’其实耶和华并没有差遣他们，他们却希望自己的话能够应验。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们所见的是虚假的异象，是骗人的占卜；他们说：‘这是耶和华的宣告。’其实耶和华并没有差遣他们，他们却希望自己的话能够应验。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些人所见的是虚假，是谎诈的占卜。他们说是耶和华说的，其实耶和华并没有差遣他们，他们倒使人指望那话必然立定。
verses.textEnNiv: Their visions are false and their divinations a lie. Even though the Lord has not sent them, they say, "The Lord declares," and expect him to fulfill their words.
verses.textEnEsv: They have seen false visions and lying divinations. They say, ‘Declares the Lord ,’ when the Lord has not sent them, and yet they expect him to fulfill their word.
verses.textEnNkjv: They have envisioned futility and false divination, saying, ‘Thus says the Lord!’ But the Lord has not sent them; yet they hope that the word may be confirmed.
verses.textEnNlt: Instead, they have told lies and made false predictions. They say, ‘This message is from the Lord ,’ even though the Lord never sent them. And yet they expect him to fulfill their prophecies!
verses.textEnNasb: They see deceit and lying divination, those who are saying, ‘The Lord declares,’ when the Lord has not sent them; yet they wait for the fulfillment of their word!
verses.textEn: Their visions are false and their divinations a lie. Even though the Lord has not sent them, they say, "The Lord declares," and expect him to fulfill their words.

verses.textZh: 你们不是见了虚假的异象，不是说了骗人的占卜吗？你们还说：‘这是耶和华的宣告。’其实我并没有说过。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们不是见了虚假的异象，不是说了骗人的占卜吗？你们还说：‘这是耶和华的宣告。’其实我并没有说过。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们岂不是见了虚假的异象吗？岂不是说了谎诈的占卜吗？你们说，这是耶和华说的，其实我没有说。」
verses.textEnNiv: Have you not seen false visions and uttered lying divinations when you say, "The Lord declares," though I have not spoken?
verses.textEnEsv: Have you not seen a false vision and uttered a lying divination, whenever you have said, ‘Declares the Lord ,’ although I have not spoken?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Have you not seen a futile vision, and have you not spoken false divination? You say, ‘The Lord says,’ but I have not spoken."
verses.textEnNlt: Can your visions be anything but false if you claim, ‘This message is from the Lord ,’ when I have not even spoken to you?
verses.textEnNasb: Did you not see a false vision and tell a lying divination when you said, ‘The Lord declares,’ but it is not I who have spoken?" ’ "
verses.textEn: Have you not seen false visions and uttered lying divinations when you say, "The Lord declares," though I have not spoken?

verses.textZh: 因此，主耶和华这样说："因为你们所说的是虚假，所见的是欺诈，因此我就攻击你们。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，主耶和华这样说："因为你们所说的是虚假，所见的是欺诈，因此我就攻击你们。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以主耶和华如此说：「因你们说的是虚假，见的是谎诈，我就与你们反对。这是主耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: Because of your false words and lying visions, I am against you, declares the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore thus says the Lord God : "Because you have uttered falsehood and seen lying visions, therefore behold, I am against you, declares the Lord God .
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore thus says the Lord God: "Because you have spoken nonsense and envisioned lies, therefore I am indeed against you," says the Lord God.
verses.textEnNlt: "Therefore, this is what the Sovereign Lord says: Because what you say is false and your visions are a lie, I will stand against you, says the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, this is what the Lord God says: "Because you have spoken deceit and have seen a lie, therefore behold, I am against you," declares the Lord God.
verses.textEn: " ‘Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: Because of your false words and lying visions, I am against you, declares the Sovereign Lord .

verses.textZh: 我的手必攻击那些看见虚假异象、以占卜骗人的先知，他们必不得列在我子民的会中，不得被记录在以色列家的名册上，也不得进入以色列地；你们就知道我是主耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的手必攻击那些看见虚假异象、以占卜骗人的先知，他们必不得列在我子民的会中，不得被记录在以色列家的名册上，也不得进入以色列地；你们就知道我是主耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的手必攻击那见虚假异象、用谎诈占卜的先知，他们必不列在我百姓的会中，不录在以色列家的册上，也不进入以色列地；你们就知道我是主耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: My hand will be against the prophets who see false visions and utter lying divinations. They will not belong to the council of my people or be listed in the records of Israel, nor will they enter the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: My hand will be against the prophets who see false visions and who give lying divinations. They shall not be in the council of my people, nor be enrolled in the register of the house of Israel, nor shall they enter the land of Israel. And you shall know that I am the Lord God .
verses.textEnNkjv: "My hand will be against the prophets who envision futility and who divine lies; they shall not be in the assembly of My people, nor be written in the record of the house of Israel, nor shall they enter into the land of Israel. Then you shall know that I am the Lord God.
verses.textEnNlt: I will raise my fist against all the prophets who see false visions and make lying predictions, and they will be banished from the community of Israel. I will blot their names from Israel’s record books, and they will never again set foot in their own land. Then you will know that I am the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "So My hand will be against the prophets who see false visions and utter lying divinations. They will have no place in the council of My people, nor will they be written down in the register of the house of Israel, nor will they enter the land of Israel, so that you may know that I am the Lord God.
verses.textEn: My hand will be against the prophets who see false visions and utter lying divinations. They will not belong to the council of my people or be listed in the records of Israel, nor will they enter the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am the Sovereign Lord .

verses.textZh: 因为他们迷惑了我的子民，说：‘平安了。’其实没有平安。有人筑起薄墙的时候，他们就用灰泥粉刷那墙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们迷惑了我的子民，说：‘平安了。’其实没有平安。有人筑起薄墙的时候，他们就用灰泥粉刷那墙。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他们诱惑我的百姓，说：『平安！』其实没有平安，就像有人立起墙壁，他们倒用未泡透的灰抹上。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Because they lead my people astray, saying, "Peace," when there is no peace, and because, when a flimsy wall is built, they cover it with whitewash,
verses.textEnEsv: Precisely because they have misled my people, saying, ‘Peace,’ when there is no peace, and because, when the people build a wall, these prophets smear it with whitewash,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Because, indeed, because they have seduced My people, saying, ‘Peace!’ when thereis no peace—and one builds a wall, and they plaster it with untempered mortar—
verses.textEnNlt: "This will happen because these evil prophets deceive my people by saying, ‘All is peaceful’ when there is no peace at all! It’s as if the people have built a flimsy wall, and these prophets are trying to reinforce it by covering it with whitewash!
verses.textEnNasb: It is definitely because they have misled My people by saying, ‘Peace!’ when there is no peace. And when anyone builds a wall, behold, they plaster it over with whitewash;
verses.textEn: " ‘Because they lead my people astray, saying, "Peace," when there is no peace, and because, when a flimsy wall is built, they cover it with whitewash,

verses.textZh: 所以你要对那些用灰泥粉刷那墙的人说：‘那墙要倒塌，必有暴雨漫过。大冰雹啊！你们要降下，狂风也必暴刮。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以你要对那些用灰泥粉刷那墙的人说：‘那墙要倒塌，必有暴雨漫过。大冰雹啊！你们要降下，狂风也必暴刮。’
verses.textZhCuv: 所以你要对那些抹上未泡透灰的人说：『墙要倒塌，必有暴雨漫过。大冰雹啊，你们要降下，狂风也要吹裂这墙。』
verses.textEnNiv: therefore tell those who cover it with whitewash that it is going to fall. Rain will come in torrents, and I will send hailstones hurtling down, and violent winds will burst forth.
verses.textEnEsv: say to those who smear it with whitewash that it shall fall! There will be a deluge of rain, and you, O great hailstones, will fall, and a stormy wind break out.
verses.textEnNkjv: say to those who plaster it with untempered mortar, that it will fall. There will be flooding rain, and you, O great hailstones, shall fall; and a stormy wind shall tear it down.
verses.textEnNlt: Tell these whitewashers that their wall will soon fall down. A heavy rainstorm will undermine it; great hailstones and mighty winds will knock it down.
verses.textEnNasb: so tell those who plaster it over with whitewash, that it will fall. A flooding rain will come, and you, hailstones, will fall, and a violent wind will break out.
verses.textEn: therefore tell those who cover it with whitewash that it is going to fall. Rain will come in torrents, and I will send hailstones hurtling down, and violent winds will burst forth.

verses.textZh: 那墙倒塌以后，人岂不会问你们：‘你们所粉刷的在哪里呢？’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那墙倒塌以后，人岂不会问你们：‘你们所粉刷的在哪里呢？’"
verses.textZhCuv: 这墙倒塌之后，人岂不问你们说：『你们抹上未泡透的灰在哪里呢？』」
verses.textEnNiv: When the wall collapses, will people not ask you, "Where is the whitewash you covered it with?"
verses.textEnEsv: And when the wall falls, will it not be said to you, ‘Where is the coating with which you smeared it?’
verses.textEnNkjv: Surely, when the wall has fallen, will it not be said to you, ‘Where is the mortar with which you plastered it?’ "
verses.textEnNlt: And when the wall falls, the people will cry out, ‘What happened to your whitewash?’
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, when the wall has fallen, will you not be asked, ‘Where is the plaster with which you plastered it?’ "
verses.textEn: When the wall collapses, will people not ask you, "Where is the whitewash you covered it with?"

verses.textZh: 因此，主耶和华这样说："我要在我的烈怒中使狂风暴刮；在我的忿怒中有暴雨漫过；在烈怒中有大冰雹降下毁灭这墙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，主耶和华这样说："我要在我的烈怒中使狂风暴刮；在我的忿怒中有暴雨漫过；在烈怒中有大冰雹降下毁灭这墙。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以主耶和华如此说：「我要发怒，使狂风吹裂这墙，在怒中使暴雨漫过，又发怒降下大冰雹，毁灭这墙。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: In my wrath I will unleash a violent wind, and in my anger hailstones and torrents of rain will fall with destructive fury.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore thus says the Lord God : I will make a stormy wind break out in my wrath, and there shall be a deluge of rain in my anger, and great hailstones in wrath to make a full end.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore thus says the Lord God: "I will cause a stormy wind to break forth in My fury; and there shall be a flooding rain in My anger, and great hailstones in fury to consume it.
verses.textEnNlt: "Therefore, this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I will sweep away your whitewashed wall with a storm of indignation, with a great flood of anger, and with hailstones of fury.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, this is what the Lord God says: "I will make a violent wind break out in My wrath. There will also be in My anger a flooding rain and hailstones to consume it in wrath.
verses.textEn: " ‘Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: In my wrath I will unleash a violent wind, and in my anger hailstones and torrents of rain will fall with destructive fury.

verses.textZh: 我要拆毁你们用灰泥粉刷的墙。使它倾倒在地，以致根基露出来；墙必倒塌，你们必在其中灭亡；你们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要拆毁你们用灰泥粉刷的墙。使它倾倒在地，以致根基露出来；墙必倒塌，你们必在其中灭亡；你们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要这样拆毁你们那未泡透灰所抹的墙，拆平到地，以致根基露出，墙必倒塌，你们也必在其中灭亡；你们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: I will tear down the wall you have covered with whitewash and will level it to the ground so that its foundation will be laid bare. When it falls, you will be destroyed in it; and you will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And I will break down the wall that you have smeared with whitewash, and bring it down to the ground, so that its foundation will be laid bare. When it falls, you shall perish in the midst of it, and you shall know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: So I will break down the wall you have plastered with untempered mortar, and bring it down to the ground, so that its foundation will be uncovered; it will fall, and you shall be consumed in the midst of it. Then you shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: I will break down your wall right to its foundation, and when it falls, it will crush you. Then you will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: So I will tear down the wall which you plastered over with whitewash and hurl it down to the ground, so that its foundation is exposed; and when it falls, you will perish in its midst. And you will know that I am the Lord.
verses.textEn: I will tear down the wall you have covered with whitewash and will level it to the ground so that its foundation will be laid bare. When it falls, you will be destroyed in it; and you will know that I am the Lord .

verses.textZh: 我必这样向墙，和向那些用灰泥粉刷这墙的人发尽我的烈怒。我要对他们说：‘墙没有了！粉刷那墙的人也没有了！’
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必这样向墙，和向那些用灰泥粉刷这墙的人发尽我的烈怒。我要对他们说：‘墙没有了！粉刷那墙的人也没有了！’
verses.textZhCuv: 我要这样向墙和用未泡透灰抹墙的人成就我怒中所定的，并要对你们说：『墙和抹墙的人都没有了。』
verses.textEnNiv: So I will pour out my wrath against the wall and against those who covered it with whitewash. I will say to you, "The wall is gone and so are those who whitewashed it,
verses.textEnEsv: Thus will I spend my wrath upon the wall and upon those who have smeared it with whitewash, and I will say to you, The wall is no more, nor those who smeared it,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus will I accomplish My wrath on the wall and on those who have plastered it with untempered mortar; and I will say to you, ‘The wall is no more, nor those who plastered it,
verses.textEnNlt: At last my anger against the wall and those who covered it with whitewash will be satisfied. Then I will say to you: ‘The wall and those who whitewashed it are both gone.
verses.textEnNasb: So I will expend My wrath on the wall and on those who have plastered it over with whitewash; and I will say to you, ‘The wall is gone and those who plastered it are gone,
verses.textEn: So I will pour out my wrath against the wall and against those who covered it with whitewash. I will say to you, "The wall is gone and so are those who whitewashed it,

verses.textZh: 粉刷那墙的人，就是以色列的众先知；他们指着耶路撒冷说预言，在没有平安的时候，为这城见平安的异象。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 粉刷那墙的人，就是以色列的众先知；他们指着耶路撒冷说预言，在没有平安的时候，为这城见平安的异象。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 这抹墙的就是以色列的先知，他们指着耶路撒冷说预言，为这城见了平安的异象，其实没有平安。这是主耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: those prophets of Israel who prophesied to Jerusalem and saw visions of peace for her when there was no peace, declares the Sovereign Lord ." ’
verses.textEnEsv: the prophets of Israel who prophesied concerning Jerusalem and saw visions of peace for her, when there was no peace, declares the Lord God .
verses.textEnNkjv: thatis, the prophets of Israel who prophesy concerning Jerusalem, and who see visions of peace for her when thereis no peace,’ " says the Lord God.
verses.textEnNlt: They were lying prophets who claimed peace would come to Jerusalem when there was no peace. I, the Sovereign Lord , have spoken!’
verses.textEnNasb: along with the prophets of Israel who prophesy to Jerusalem, and who see a vision of peace for her when there is no peace,’ declares the Lord God.
verses.textEn: those prophets of Israel who prophesied to Jerusalem and saw visions of peace for her when there was no peace, declares the Sovereign Lord ." ’

verses.textZh: "人子啊！你要面向民中那些随着自己心意说预言的女子，说预言攻击她们。你要说：
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！你要面向民中那些随着自己心意说预言的女子，说预言攻击她们。你要说：
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，你要面向本民中、从己心发预言的女子说预言，攻击她们，
verses.textEnNiv: "Now, son of man, set your face against the daughters of your people who prophesy out of their own imagination. Prophesy against them
verses.textEnEsv: "And you, son of man, set your face against the daughters of your people, who prophesy out of their own hearts. Prophesy against them
verses.textEnNkjv: "Likewise, son of man, set your face against the daughters of your people, who prophesy out of their own heart; prophesy against them,
verses.textEnNlt: "Now, son of man, speak out against the women who prophesy from their own imaginations.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now you, son of man, set your face against the daughters of your people who are talking like prophets from their own imagination. Prophesy against them
verses.textEn: "Now, son of man, set your face against the daughters of your people who prophesy out of their own imagination. Prophesy against them

verses.textZh: ‘主耶和华这样说：这些女子有祸了，她们替众人的手腕缝制符咒的带子，又替众人制造不同长度的头巾，为要猎取人的性命。难道你们猎取我子民的性命，就能保全自己的性命吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘主耶和华这样说：这些女子有祸了，她们替众人的手腕缝制符咒的带子，又替众人制造不同长度的头巾，为要猎取人的性命。难道你们猎取我子民的性命，就能保全自己的性命吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 说主耶和华如此说：『这些妇女有祸了！她们为众人的膀臂缝靠枕，给高矮之人做下垂的头巾，为要猎取人的性命。难道你们要猎取我百姓的性命，为利己将人救活吗？
verses.textEnNiv: and say, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Woe to the women who sew magic charms on all their wrists and make veils of various lengths for their heads in order to ensnare people. Will you ensnare the lives of my people but preserve your own?
verses.textEnEsv: and say, Thus says the Lord God : Woe to the women who sew magic bands upon all wrists, and make veils for the heads of persons of every stature, in the hunt for souls! Will you hunt down souls belonging to my people and keep your own souls alive?
verses.textEnNkjv: and say, ‘Thus says the Lord God: "Woe to the women who sew magic charms on their sleeves and make veils for the heads of people of every height to hunt souls! Will you hunt the souls of My people, and keep yourselves alive?
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Sovereign Lord says: What sorrow awaits you women who are ensnaring the souls of my people, young and old alike. You tie magic charms on their wrists and furnish them with magic veils. Do you think you can trap others without bringing destruction on yourselves?
verses.textEnNasb: and say, ‘This is what the Lord God says: "Woe to the women who sew magic bands on all wrists and make veils for the heads of persons of every stature to capture souls! Will you capture the souls of My people, but keep the souls of others alive for yourselves?
verses.textEn: and say, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Woe to the women who sew magic charms on all their wrists and make veils of various lengths for their heads in order to ensnare people. Will you ensnare the lives of my people but preserve your own?

verses.textZh: 你们为了几把大麦，为了几块饼，就在我的子民中间亵渎我；你们向我那些愿听谎言的子民说谎，不该死的人，你们杀死了；不该活的人，你们却保全他们的性命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们为了几把大麦，为了几块饼，就在我的子民中间亵渎我；你们向我那些愿听谎言的子民说谎，不该死的人，你们杀死了；不该活的人，你们却保全他们的性命。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们为两把大麦，为几块饼，在我民中亵渎我，对肯听谎言的民说谎，杀死不该死的人，救活不该活的人。』」
verses.textEnNiv: You have profaned me among my people for a few handfuls of barley and scraps of bread. By lying to my people, who listen to lies, you have killed those who should not have died and have spared those who should not live.
verses.textEnEsv: You have profaned me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread, putting to death souls who should not die and keeping alive souls who should not live, by your lying to my people, who listen to lies.
verses.textEnNkjv: And will you profane Me among My people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread, killing people who should not die, and keeping people alive who should not live, by your lying to My people who listen to lies?"
verses.textEnNlt: You bring shame on me among my people for a few handfuls of barley or a piece of bread. By lying to my people who love to listen to lies, you kill those who should not die, and you promise life to those who should not live.
verses.textEnNasb: For handfuls of barley and pieces of bread, you have profaned Me to My people, to put to death some who should not die, and to keep others alive who should not live, by your lying to My people who listen to lies." ’ "
verses.textEn: You have profaned me among my people for a few handfuls of barley and scraps of bread. By lying to my people, who listen to lies, you have killed those who should not have died and have spared those who should not live.

verses.textZh: "‘因此，主耶和华这样说：我要与你们符咒的带子作对。你们用它们来猎取人的性命，好象猎取飞鸟一样。我必把它们从你们的膀臂上扯下来，释放那些被你们像飞鸟一样猎取的性命。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘因此，主耶和华这样说：我要与你们符咒的带子作对。你们用它们来猎取人的性命，好象猎取飞鸟一样。我必把它们从你们的膀臂上扯下来，释放那些被你们像飞鸟一样猎取的性命。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以主耶和华如此说：「看哪，我与你们的靠枕反对，就是你们用以猎取人、使人的性命如鸟飞的。我要将靠枕从你们的膀臂上扯去，释放你们猎取如鸟飞的人。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I am against your magic charms with which you ensnare people like birds and I will tear them from your arms; I will set free the people that you ensnare like birds.
verses.textEnEsv: "Therefore thus says the Lord God : Behold, I am against your magic bands with which you hunt the souls like birds, and I will tear them from your arms, and I will let the souls whom you hunt go free, the souls like birds.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Therefore thus says the Lord God: "Behold, I am against your magic charms by which you hunt souls there like birds. I will tear them from your arms, and let the souls go, the souls you hunt like birds.
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I am against all your magic charms, which you use to ensnare my people like birds. I will tear them from your arms, setting my people free like birds set free from a cage.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, this is what the Lord God says: "Behold, I am against your magic bands by which you capture souls there as birds, and I will tear them from your arms; and I will let them go, those souls whom you capture as birds.
verses.textEn: " ‘Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I am against your magic charms with which you ensnare people like birds and I will tear them from your arms; I will set free the people that you ensnare like birds.

verses.textZh: 我必扯下你们的头巾，救我的子民脱离你们的手，使他们不再被你们的手猎取；你们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必扯下你们的头巾，救我的子民脱离你们的手，使他们不再被你们的手猎取；你们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 我也必撕裂你们下垂的头巾，救我百姓脱离你们的手，不再被猎取，落在你们手中。你们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: I will tear off your veils and save my people from your hands, and they will no longer fall prey to your power. Then you will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Your veils also I will tear off and deliver my people out of your hand, and they shall be no more in your hand as prey, and you shall know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: I will also tear off your veils and deliver My people out of your hand, and they shall no longer be as prey in your hand. Then you shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: I will tear off the magic veils and save my people from your grasp. They will no longer be your victims. Then you will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: I will also tear off your veils and save My people from your hands, and they will no longer be in your hands as prey; and you will know that I am the Lord.
verses.textEn: I will tear off your veils and save my people from your hands, and they will no longer fall prey to your power. Then you will know that I am the Lord .

verses.textZh: 我没有使义人灰心，你们却用谎言使他们灰心，又坚固恶人的手，使他们不转离恶道而得拯救。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我没有使义人灰心，你们却用谎言使他们灰心，又坚固恶人的手，使他们不转离恶道而得拯救。
verses.textZhCuv: 我不使义人伤心，你们却以谎话使他伤心，又坚固恶人的手，使他不回头离开恶道得以救活。
verses.textEnNiv: Because you disheartened the righteous with your lies, when I had brought them no grief, and because you encouraged the wicked not to turn from their evil ways and so save their lives,
verses.textEnEsv: Because you have disheartened the righteous falsely, although I have not grieved him, and you have encouraged the wicked, that he should not turn from his evil way to save his life,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Because with lies you have made the heart of the righteous sad, whom I have not made sad; and you have strengthened the hands of the wicked, so that he does not turn from his wicked way to save his life.
verses.textEnNlt: You have discouraged the righteous with your lies, but I didn’t want them to be sad. And you have encouraged the wicked by promising them life, even though they continue in their sins.
verses.textEnNasb: Because you disheartened the righteous with falsehood when I did not cause him pain, but you have encouraged the wicked not to turn from his wicked way to keep him alive,
verses.textEn: Because you disheartened the righteous with your lies, when I had brought them no grief, and because you encouraged the wicked not to turn from their evil ways and so save their lives,

verses.textZh: 因此，你们不得再见虚假的异象，也不得再行占卜的事；我要救我的子民脱离你们的手。你们就知道我是耶和华。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，你们不得再见虚假的异象，也不得再行占卜的事；我要救我的子民脱离你们的手。你们就知道我是耶和华。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们就不再见虚假的异象，也不再行占卜的事；我必救我的百姓脱离你们的手；你们就知道我是耶和华。」
verses.textEnNiv: therefore you will no longer see false visions or practice divination. I will save my people from your hands. And then you will know that I am the Lord .’ "
verses.textEnEsv: therefore you shall no more see false visions nor practice divination. I will deliver my people out of your hand. And you shall know that I am the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore you shall no longer envision futility nor practice divination; for I will deliver My people out of your hand, and you shall know that I am the Lord." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Because of all this, you will no longer talk of seeing visions that you never saw, nor will you make predictions. For I will rescue my people from your grasp. Then you will know that I am the Lord ."
verses.textEnNasb: therefore you women will no longer see deceitful visions or practice divination, and I will save My people from your hands. So you will know that I am the Lord."
verses.textEn: therefore you will no longer see false visions or practice divination. I will save my people from your hands. And then you will know that I am the Lord .’ "

verses.textZh: 有几个以色列的长老来见我，在我面前坐下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有几个以色列的长老来见我，在我面前坐下。
verses.textZhCuv: 有几个以色列长老到我这里来，坐在我面前。
verses.textEnNiv: Some of the elders of Israel came to me and sat down in front of me.
verses.textEnEsv: Then certain of the elders of Israel came to me and sat before me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now some of the elders of Israel came to me and sat before me.
verses.textEnNlt: Then some of the leaders of Israel visited me, and while they were sitting with me,
verses.textEnNasb: Then some elders of Israel came to me and sat down before me.
verses.textEn: Some of the elders of Israel came to me and sat down in front of me.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话就临到我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话就临到我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话就临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then the word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: And the word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnNkjv: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: this message came to me from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: Then the word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: "人子啊！这些人已经把他们的偶像接到心里去，把那陷他们在罪孽中的绊脚石放在自己面前，我怎能让他们向我求问呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！这些人已经把他们的偶像接到心里去，把那陷他们在罪孽中的绊脚石放在自己面前，我怎能让他们向我求问呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，这些人已将他们的假神接到心里，把陷于罪的绊脚石放在面前，我岂能丝毫被他们求问吗？
verses.textEnNiv: "Son of man, these men have set up idols in their hearts and put wicked stumbling blocks before their faces. Should I let them inquire of me at all?
verses.textEnEsv: "Son of man, these men have taken their idols into their hearts, and set the stumbling block of their iniquity before their faces. Should I indeed let myself be consulted by them?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Son of man, these men have set up their idols in their hearts, and put before them that which causes them to stumble into iniquity. Should I let Myself be inquired of at all by them?
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, these leaders have set up idols in their hearts. They have embraced things that will make them fall into sin. Why should I listen to their requests?
verses.textEnNasb: "Son of man, these men have set up their idols in their hearts and have put in front of their faces the stumbling block of their wrongdoing. Should I let Myself be consulted by them at all?
verses.textEn: "Son of man, these men have set up idols in their hearts and put wicked stumbling blocks before their faces. Should I let them inquire of me at all?

verses.textZh: 因此，你要告诉他们，对他们说：‘主耶和华这样说：以色列家的人中，凡把他的偶像接到心里去，把那陷自己在罪孽中的绊脚石放在自己面前，却又来见先知的，我耶和华必按他拜众多偶像的罪报应他，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，你要告诉他们，对他们说：‘主耶和华这样说：以色列家的人中，凡把他的偶像接到心里去，把那陷自己在罪孽中的绊脚石放在自己面前，却又来见先知的，我耶和华必按他拜众多偶像的罪报应他，
verses.textZhCuv: 所以你要告诉他们：『主耶和华如此说：以色列家的人中，凡将他的假神接到心里，把陷于罪的绊脚石放在面前，又就了先知来的，我－耶和华在他所求的事上，必按他众多的假神回答他 ，
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore speak to them and tell them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: When any of the Israelites set up idols in their hearts and put a wicked stumbling block before their faces and then go to a prophet, I the Lord will answer them myself in keeping with their great idolatry.
