verses.textEnEsv: Therefore speak to them and say to them, Thus says the Lord God : Any one of the house of Israel who takes his idols into his heart and sets the stumbling block of his iniquity before his face, and yet comes to the prophet, I the Lord will answer him as he comes with the multitude of his idols,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore speak to them, and say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord God: "Everyone of the house of Israel who sets up his idols in his heart, and puts before him what causes him to stumble into iniquity, and then comes to the prophet, I the Lord will answer him who comes, according to the multitude of his idols,
verses.textEnNlt: Tell them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: The people of Israel have set up idols in their hearts and fallen into sin, and then they go to a prophet asking for a message. So I, the Lord , will give them the kind of answer their great idolatry deserves.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore speak to them and tell them, ‘This is what the Lord God says: "Anyone of the house of Israel who sets up his idols in his heart, puts in front of his face the stumbling block of his wrongdoing, and then comes to the prophet, I the Lord will let Myself answer him in the matter in view of the multitude of his idols,
verses.textEn: Therefore speak to them and tell them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: When any of the Israelites set up idols in their hearts and put a wicked stumbling block before their faces and then go to a prophet, I the Lord will answer them myself in keeping with their great idolatry.

verses.textZh: 好夺回以色列家的心。他们众人因自己的偶像，与我疏远。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 好夺回以色列家的心。他们众人因自己的偶像，与我疏远。’
verses.textZhCuv: 好在以色列家的心事上捉住他们，因为他们都藉着假神与我生疏。』
verses.textEnNiv: I will do this to recapture the hearts of the people of Israel, who have all deserted me for their idols.’
verses.textEnEsv: that I may lay hold of the hearts of the house of Israel, who are all estranged from me through their idols.
verses.textEnNkjv: that I may seize the house of Israel by their heart, because they are all estranged from Me by their idols." ’
verses.textEnNlt: I will do this to capture the minds and hearts of all my people who have turned from me to worship their detestable idols.’
verses.textEnNasb: in order to take hold of the hearts of the house of Israel who have turned away from Me due to all their idols." ’
verses.textEn: I will do this to recapture the hearts of the people of Israel, who have all deserted me for their idols.’

verses.textZh: "因此，你要对以色列家说：‘主耶和华这样说：回转吧！转离你们的偶像！转脸离弃你们一切可憎之物吧！
verses.textZhCnvs: "因此，你要对以色列家说：‘主耶和华这样说：回转吧！转离你们的偶像！转脸离弃你们一切可憎之物吧！
verses.textZhCuv: 「所以你要告诉以色列家说：『主耶和华如此说：回头吧！离开你们的偶像，转脸莫从你们一切可憎的事。』
verses.textEnNiv: "Therefore say to the people of Israel, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Repent! Turn from your idols and renounce all your detestable practices!
verses.textEnEsv: "Therefore say to the house of Israel, Thus says the Lord God : Repent and turn away from your idols, and turn away your faces from all your abominations.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore say to the house of Israel, ‘Thus says the Lord God: "Repent, turn away from your idols, and turn your faces away from all your abominations.
verses.textEnNlt: "Therefore, tell the people of Israel, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Repent and turn away from your idols, and stop all your detestable sins.
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore say to the house of Israel, ‘This is what the Lord God says: "Repent and turn away from your idols, and turn your faces away from all your abominations.
verses.textEn: "Therefore say to the people of Israel, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Repent! Turn from your idols and renounce all your detestable practices!

verses.textZh: 因为以色列家的人中，或是在以色列寄居的外族人中，凡与我疏远，把他们的偶像接到心里去，把那陷自己在罪孽中的绊脚石放在自己面前，却又来见先知，要为自己求问我的，我耶和华必亲自报应他；
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为以色列家的人中，或是在以色列寄居的外族人中，凡与我疏远，把他们的偶像接到心里去，把那陷自己在罪孽中的绊脚石放在自己面前，却又来见先知，要为自己求问我的，我耶和华必亲自报应他；
verses.textZhCuv: 因为以色列家的人，或在以色列中寄居的外人，凡与我隔绝，将他的假神接到心里，把陷于罪的绊脚石放在面前，又就了先知来要为自己的事求问我的，我－耶和华必亲自回答他。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘When any of the Israelites or any foreigner residing in Israel separate themselves from me and set up idols in their hearts and put a wicked stumbling block before their faces and then go to a prophet to inquire of me, I the Lord will answer them myself.
verses.textEnEsv: For any one of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who sojourn in Israel, who separates himself from me, taking his idols into his heart and putting the stumbling block of his iniquity before his face, and yet comes to a prophet to consult me through him, I the Lord will answer him myself.
verses.textEnNkjv: For anyone of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who dwell in Israel, who separates himself from Me and sets up his idols in his heart and puts before him what causes him to stumble into iniquity, then comes to a prophet to inquire of him concerning Me, I the Lord will answer him by Myself.
verses.textEnNlt: I, the Lord , will answer all those, both Israelites and foreigners, who reject me and set up idols in their hearts and so fall into sin, and who then come to a prophet asking for my advice.
verses.textEnNasb: For anyone of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who reside in Israel, who deserts Me, sets up his idols in his heart, puts in front of his face the stumbling block of his wrongdoing, and then comes to the prophet to request something of Me for himself, I the Lord will let Myself answer him Myself.
verses.textEn: " ‘When any of the Israelites or any foreigner residing in Israel separate themselves from me and set up idols in their hearts and put a wicked stumbling block before their faces and then go to a prophet to inquire of me, I the Lord will answer them myself.

verses.textZh: 我必向那人变脸，使他成为别人的鉴戒和讥笑的对象；我要把他从我子民中剪除；你们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必向那人变脸，使他成为别人的鉴戒和讥笑的对象；我要把他从我子民中剪除；你们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必向那人变脸，使他作了警戒，笑谈，令人惊骇，并且我要将他从我民中剪除；你们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: I will set my face against them and make them an example and a byword. I will remove them from my people. Then you will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And I will set my face against that man; I will make him a sign and a byword and cut him off from the midst of my people, and you shall know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: I will set My face against that man and make him a sign and a proverb, and I will cut him off from the midst of My people. Then you shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: I will turn against such people and make a terrible example of them, eliminating them from among my people. Then you will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: I will set My face against that person and make him a sign and a proverb, and I will eliminate him from among My people. So you will know that I am the Lord.
verses.textEn: I will set my face against them and make them an example and a byword. I will remove them from my people. Then you will know that I am the Lord .

verses.textZh: 如果有先知被欺骗说一句话，是我耶和华任那先知受欺骗的；我必伸手攻击他，把他从我子民以色列中除灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果有先知被欺骗说一句话，是我耶和华任那先知受欺骗的；我必伸手攻击他，把他从我子民以色列中除灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 先知若被迷惑说一句预言，是我－耶和华任那先知受迷惑，我也必向他伸手，将他从我民以色列中除灭。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘And if the prophet is enticed to utter a prophecy, I the Lord have enticed that prophet, and I will stretch out my hand against him and destroy him from among my people Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: And if the prophet is deceived and speaks a word, I, the Lord , have deceived that prophet, and I will stretch out my hand against him and will destroy him from the midst of my people Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And if the prophet is induced to speak anything, I the Lord have induced that prophet, and I will stretch out My hand against him and destroy him from among My people Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: "‘And if a prophet is deceived into giving a message, it is because I, the Lord , have deceived that prophet. I will lift my fist against such prophets and cut them off from the community of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: "But if the prophet is persuaded so that he speaks a word, it is I, the Lord, who have persuaded that prophet; and I will stretch out My hand against him and eliminate him from among My people Israel.
verses.textEn: " ‘And if the prophet is enticed to utter a prophecy, I the Lord have enticed that prophet, and I will stretch out my hand against him and destroy him from among my people Israel.

verses.textZh: 他们必担当自己的罪孽；求问的人的罪孽怎样，先知的罪孽也必怎样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们必担当自己的罪孽；求问的人的罪孽怎样，先知的罪孽也必怎样。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必担当自己的罪孽。先知的罪孽和求问之人的罪孽都是一样，
verses.textEnNiv: They will bear their guilt—the prophet will be as guilty as the one who consults him.
verses.textEnEsv: And they shall bear their punishment —the punishment of the prophet and the punishment of the inquirer shall be alike—
verses.textEnNkjv: And they shall bear their iniquity; the punishment of the prophet shall be the same as the punishment of the one who inquired,
verses.textEnNlt: False prophets and those who seek their guidance will all be punished for their sins.
verses.textEnNasb: And they will bear the punishment for their wrongdoing; as the wrongdoing of the inquirer is, so the wrongdoing of the prophet will be,
verses.textEn: They will bear their guilt—the prophet will be as guilty as the one who consults him.

verses.textZh: 这样，以色列家必不再走迷路离开我，也不再因他们的一切过犯玷污自己；他们要作我的子民，我要作他们的神。这是主耶和华的宣告。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，以色列家必不再走迷路离开我，也不再因他们的一切过犯玷污自己；他们要作我的子民，我要作他们的神。这是主耶和华的宣告。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 好使以色列家不再走迷离开我，不再因各样的罪过玷污自己，只要作我的子民，我作他们的神。这是主耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the people of Israel will no longer stray from me, nor will they defile themselves anymore with all their sins. They will be my people, and I will be their God, declares the Sovereign Lord .’ "
verses.textEnEsv: that the house of Israel may no more go astray from me, nor defile themselves anymore with all their transgressions, but that they may be my people and I may be their God, declares the Lord God ."
verses.textEnNkjv: that the house of Israel may no longer stray from Me, nor be profaned anymore with all their transgressions, but that they may be My people and I may be their God," says the Lord God.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: In this way, the people of Israel will learn not to stray from me, polluting themselves with sin. They will be my people, and I will be their God. I, the Sovereign Lord , have spoken!’"
verses.textEnNasb: in order that the house of Israel may no longer stray from Me and no longer defile themselves with all their offenses. So they will be My people, and I shall be their God," ’ declares the Lord God."
verses.textEn: Then the people of Israel will no longer stray from me, nor will they defile themselves anymore with all their sins. They will be my people, and I will be their God, declares the Sovereign Lord .’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: And the word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnNkjv: The word of the Lord came again to me, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: Then this message came to me from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: Then the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: The word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: "人子啊！如果一国行了不忠的事得罪我，我就必伸手攻击那国，断绝那地的粮食，使饥荒临到那地，使人和牲畜都从那地剪除，
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！如果一国行了不忠的事得罪我，我就必伸手攻击那国，断绝那地的粮食，使饥荒临到那地，使人和牲畜都从那地剪除，
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，若有一国犯罪干犯我，我也向他伸手折断他们的杖，就是断绝他们的粮，使饥荒临到那地，将人与牲畜从其中剪除；
verses.textEnNiv: "Son of man, if a country sins against me by being unfaithful and I stretch out my hand against it to cut off its food supply and send famine upon it and kill its people and their animals,
verses.textEnEsv: "Son of man, when a land sins against me by acting faithlessly, and I stretch out my hand against it and break its supply of bread and send famine upon it, and cut off from it man and beast,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Son of man, when a land sins against Me by persistent unfaithfulness, I will stretch out My hand against it; I will cut off its supply of bread, send famine on it, and cut off man and beast from it.
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, suppose the people of a country were to sin against me, and I lifted my fist to crush them, cutting off their food supply and sending a famine to destroy both people and animals.
verses.textEnNasb: "Son of man, if a country sins against Me by being unfaithful, and I stretch out My hand against it, destroy its supply of bread, send famine against it, and eliminate from it both human and animal life,
verses.textEn: "Son of man, if a country sins against me by being unfaithful and I stretch out my hand against it to cut off its food supply and send famine upon it and kill its people and their animals,

verses.textZh: 即使有挪亚、但以理和约伯这三个人，他们也只能因自己的义救自己的性命。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 即使有挪亚、但以理和约伯这三个人，他们也只能因自己的义救自己的性命。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 其中虽有挪亚、但以理、约伯这三人，他们只能因他们的义救自己的性命。这是主耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: even if these three men—Noah, Daniel and Job—were in it, they could save only themselves by their righteousness, declares the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: even if these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, they would deliver but their own lives by their righteousness, declares the Lord God .
verses.textEnNkjv: Even if these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, they would deliver only themselves by their righteousness," says the Lord God.
verses.textEnNlt: Even if Noah, Daniel, and Job were there, their righteousness would save no one but themselves, says the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: even though these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in its midst, by their own righteousness they could only save themselves," declares the Lord God.
verses.textEn: even if these three men—Noah, Daniel and Job—were in it, they could save only themselves by their righteousness, declares the Sovereign Lord .

verses.textZh: 如果我使猛兽经过那地，蹂躏那地，使它荒凉，以致因为这些兽的缘故，没有人敢经过；
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果我使猛兽经过那地，蹂躏那地，使它荒凉，以致因为这些兽的缘故，没有人敢经过；
verses.textZhCuv: 我若使恶兽经过糟践那地，使地荒凉，以致因这些兽，人都不得经过；
verses.textEnNiv: "Or if I send wild beasts through that country and they leave it childless and it becomes desolate so that no one can pass through it because of the beasts,
verses.textEnEsv: "If I cause wild beasts to pass through the land, and they ravage it, and it be made desolate, so that no one may pass through because of the beasts,
verses.textEnNkjv: "If I cause wild beasts to pass through the land, and they empty it, and make it so desolate that no man may pass through because of the beasts,
verses.textEnNlt: "Or suppose I were to send wild animals to invade the country, kill the people, and make the land too desolate and dangerous to pass through.
verses.textEnNasb: "If I were to cause vicious animals to pass through the land and they depopulated it, and it became desolate so that no one would pass through it because of the animals,
verses.textEn: "Or if I send wild beasts through that country and they leave it childless and it becomes desolate so that no one can pass through it because of the beasts,

verses.textZh: 即使有这三个人在其中，我指着我的永生起誓，他们只能救自己，连儿女也不能救，那地却仍然荒凉。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 即使有这三个人在其中，我指着我的永生起誓，他们只能救自己，连儿女也不能救，那地却仍然荒凉。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 虽有这三人在其中，主耶和华说：我指着我的永生起誓，他们连儿带女都不能得救，只能自己得救，那地仍然荒凉。
verses.textEnNiv: as surely as I live, declares the Sovereign Lord , even if these three men were in it, they could not save their own sons or daughters. They alone would be saved, but the land would be desolate.
verses.textEnEsv: even if these three men were in it, as I live, declares the Lord God , they would deliver neither sons nor daughters. They alone would be delivered, but the land would be desolate.
verses.textEnNkjv: even though these three men were in it, as I live," says the Lord God, "they would deliver neither sons nor daughters; only they would be delivered, and the land would be desolate.
verses.textEnNlt: As surely as I live, says the Sovereign Lord , even if those three men were there, they wouldn’t be able to save their own sons or daughters. They alone would be saved, but the land would be made desolate.
verses.textEnNasb: though these three men were in its midst, as I live," declares the Lord God, "they could not save either their sons or their daughters. They alone would be saved, but the country would be desolate.
verses.textEn: as surely as I live, declares the Sovereign Lord , even if these three men were in it, they could not save their own sons or daughters. They alone would be saved, but the land would be desolate.

verses.textZh: 如果我使刀剑临到那地，说：‘愿刀剑经过那地，好让我把人和牲畜从那地剪除。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果我使刀剑临到那地，说：‘愿刀剑经过那地，好让我把人和牲畜从那地剪除。’
verses.textZhCuv: 或者我使刀剑临到那地，说：刀剑哪，要经过那地，以致我将人与牲畜从其中剪除；
verses.textEnNiv: "Or if I bring a sword against that country and say, ‘Let the sword pass throughout the land,’ and I kill its people and their animals,
verses.textEnEsv: "Or if I bring a sword upon that land and say, Let a sword pass through the land, and I cut off from it man and beast,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Or if I bring a sword on that land, and say, ‘Sword, go through the land,’ and I cut off man and beast from it,
verses.textEnNlt: "Or suppose I were to bring war against the land, and I sent enemy armies to destroy both people and animals.
verses.textEnNasb: Or if I were to bring a sword on that country and say, ‘A sword is to pass through the country,’ and I eliminated human and animal life from it,
verses.textEn: "Or if I bring a sword against that country and say, ‘Let the sword pass throughout the land,’ and I kill its people and their animals,

verses.textZh: 即使有这三个人在其中，主耶和华说：我指着我的永生起誓，他们只能救自己，连儿女也不能救。
verses.textZhCnvs: 即使有这三个人在其中，主耶和华说：我指着我的永生起誓，他们只能救自己，连儿女也不能救。
verses.textZhCuv: 虽有这三人在其中，主耶和华说：我指着我的永生起誓，他们连儿带女都不能得救，只能自己得救。
verses.textEnNiv: as surely as I live, declares the Sovereign Lord , even if these three men were in it, they could not save their own sons or daughters. They alone would be saved.
verses.textEnEsv: though these three men were in it, as I live, declares the Lord God , they would deliver neither sons nor daughters, but they alone would be delivered.
verses.textEnNkjv: even though these three men were in it, as I live," says the Lord God, "they would deliver neither sons nor daughters, but only they themselves would be delivered.
verses.textEnNlt: As surely as I live, says the Sovereign Lord , even if those three men were there, they wouldn’t be able to save their own sons or daughters. They alone would be saved.
verses.textEnNasb: even though these three men were in its midst, as I live," declares the Lord God, "they could not save either their sons or their daughters, but they alone would be saved.
verses.textEn: as surely as I live, declares the Sovereign Lord , even if these three men were in it, they could not save their own sons or daughters. They alone would be saved.

verses.textZh: 如果我使瘟疫流行那地，借着流血的事把我的烈怒倾倒在那地上，使人和牲畜都从那地剪除；
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果我使瘟疫流行那地，借着流血的事把我的烈怒倾倒在那地上，使人和牲畜都从那地剪除；
verses.textZhCuv: 或者我叫瘟疫流行那地，使我灭命 的忿怒倾在其上，好将人与牲畜从其中剪除；
verses.textEnNiv: "Or if I send a plague into that land and pour out my wrath on it through bloodshed, killing its people and their animals,
verses.textEnEsv: "Or if I send a pestilence into that land and pour out my wrath upon it with blood, to cut off from it man and beast,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Or if I send a pestilence into that land and pour out My fury on it in blood, and cut off from it man and beast,
verses.textEnNlt: "Or suppose I were to pour out my fury by sending an epidemic into the land, and the disease killed people and animals alike.
verses.textEnNasb: Or if I were to send a plague against that country and pour out My wrath on it in blood to eliminate man and animal from it,
verses.textEn: "Or if I send a plague into that land and pour out my wrath on it through bloodshed, killing its people and their animals,

verses.textZhCnvs: 即使当中有挪亚、但以理和约伯，我指着我的永生起誓，他们只能因自己的义救自己的性命，连儿女也不能救。这是主耶和华的宣告。"
verses.textZhCuv: 虽有挪亚、但以理、约伯在其中，主耶和华说：我指着我的永生起誓，他们连儿带女都不能救，只能因他们的义救自己的性命。」

verses.textEnEsv: even if Noah, Daniel, and Job were in it, as I live, declares the Lord God , they would deliver neither son nor daughter. They would deliver but their own lives by their righteousness.

verses.textZh: 主耶和华这样说："我打发刀剑、饥荒、猛兽和瘟疫这四样可怕的刑罚临到耶路撒冷，要把人和牲畜从那里剪除的时候，那情况岂不更严重吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 主耶和华这样说："我打发刀剑、饥荒、猛兽和瘟疫这四样可怕的刑罚临到耶路撒冷，要把人和牲畜从那里剪除的时候，那情况岂不更严重吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华如此说：「我将这四样大灾－就是刀剑、饥荒、恶兽、瘟疫降在耶路撒冷，将人与牲畜从其中剪除，岂不更重吗？
verses.textEnNiv: "For this is what the Sovereign Lord says: How much worse will it be when I send against Jerusalem my four dreadful judgments—sword and famine and wild beasts and plague—to kill its men and their animals!
verses.textEnEsv: "For thus says the Lord God : How much more when I send upon Jerusalem my four disastrous acts of judgment, sword, famine, wild beasts, and pestilence, to cut off from it man and beast!
verses.textEnNkjv: For thus says the Lord God: "How much more it shall be when I send My four severe judgments on Jerusalem—the sword and famine and wild beasts and pestilence—to cut off man and beast from it?
verses.textEnNlt: "Now this is what the Sovereign Lord says: How terrible it will be when all four of these dreadful punishments fall upon Jerusalem—war, famine, wild animals, and disease—destroying all her people and animals.
verses.textEnNasb: For this is what the Lord God says: "How much more when I send My four severe judgments against Jerusalem: sword, famine, vicious animals, and plague to eliminate human and animal life from it!
verses.textEn: "For this is what the Sovereign Lord says: How much worse will it be when I send against Jerusalem my four dreadful judgments—sword and famine and wild beasts and plague—to kill its men and their animals!

verses.textZh: 其中将有剩下逃脱的人，连同儿女被带出来，他们来到你们那里，你们看见他们的所行所为，就会因我降给耶路撒冷的一切灾祸，得了安慰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 其中将有剩下逃脱的人，连同儿女被带出来，他们来到你们那里，你们看见他们的所行所为，就会因我降给耶路撒冷的一切灾祸，得了安慰。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而其中必有剩下的人，他们连儿带女必带到你们这里来，你们看见他们所行所为的，要因我降给耶路撒冷的一切灾祸，便得了安慰。
verses.textEnNiv: Yet there will be some survivors—sons and daughters who will be brought out of it. They will come to you, and when you see their conduct and their actions, you will be consoled regarding the disaster I have brought on Jerusalem—every disaster I have brought on it.
verses.textEnEsv: But behold, some survivors will be left in it, sons and daughters who will be brought out; behold, when they come out to you, and you see their ways and their deeds, you will be consoled for the disaster that I have brought upon Jerusalem, for all that I have brought upon it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet behold, there shall be left in it a remnant who will be brought out, both sons and daughters; surely they will come out to you, and you will see their ways and their doings. Then you will be comforted concerning the disaster that I have brought upon Jerusalem, all that I have brought upon it.
verses.textEnNlt: Yet there will be survivors, and they will come here to join you as exiles in Babylon. You will see with your own eyes how wicked they are, and then you will feel better about what I have done to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet, behold, survivors will be left in it who will be brought out, both sons and daughters. Behold, they are going to come out to you, and you will see their conduct and actions; then you will be comforted for the disaster which I have brought against Jerusalem for everything which I have brought upon it.
verses.textEn: Yet there will be some survivors—sons and daughters who will be brought out of it. They will come to you, and when you see their conduct and their actions, you will be consoled regarding the disaster I have brought on Jerusalem—every disaster I have brought on it.

verses.textZh: 你们看见了他们的所行所为，就必得安慰，因为你们知道我在耶路撒冷所行的一切，并不是无缘无故的。这是耶和华的宣告。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们看见了他们的所行所为，就必得安慰，因为你们知道我在耶路撒冷所行的一切，并不是无缘无故的。这是耶和华的宣告。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们看见他们所行所为的，得了安慰，就知道我在耶路撒冷中所行的并非无故。这是主耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: You will be consoled when you see their conduct and their actions, for you will know that I have done nothing in it without cause, declares the Sovereign Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: They will console you, when you see their ways and their deeds, and you shall know that I have not done without cause all that I have done in it, declares the Lord God ."
verses.textEnNkjv: And they will comfort you, when you see their ways and their doings; and you shall know that I have done nothing without cause that I have done in it," says the Lord God.
verses.textEnNlt: When you meet them and see their behavior, you will understand that these things are not being done to Israel without cause. I, the Sovereign Lord , have spoken!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then they will comfort you when you see their conduct and actions, for you will know that I have not done without reason whatever I did to it," declares the Lord God.
verses.textEn: You will be consoled when you see their conduct and their actions, for you will know that I have done nothing in it without cause, declares the Sovereign Lord ."

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: And the word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: Then this message came to me from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: Then the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: The word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: "人子啊！葡萄树的木料怎能胜过树林中的枝子呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！葡萄树的木料怎能胜过树林中的枝子呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，葡萄树比别样树有什么强处？葡萄枝比众树枝有什么好处？
verses.textEnNiv: "Son of man, how is the wood of a vine different from that of a branch from any of the trees in the forest?
verses.textEnEsv: "Son of man, how does the wood of the vine surpass any wood, the vine branch that is among the trees of the forest?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Son of man, how is the wood of the vine better than any other wood, the vine branch which is among the trees of the forest?
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, how does a grapevine compare to a tree? Is a vine’s wood as useful as the wood of a tree?
verses.textEnNasb: "Son of man, how is the wood of the vine better than any wood of a branch which is among the trees of the forest?
verses.textEn: "Son of man, how is the wood of a vine different from that of a branch from any of the trees in the forest?

verses.textZh: 人可以从葡萄树上取木料制造物件吗？可以从葡萄树上取木料做钉子挂器皿吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 人可以从葡萄树上取木料制造物件吗？可以从葡萄树上取木料做钉子挂器皿吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 其上可以取木料做什么工用，可以取来做钉子挂什么器皿吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Is wood ever taken from it to make anything useful? Do they make pegs from it to hang things on?
verses.textEnEsv: Is wood taken from it to make anything? Do people take a peg from it to hang any vessel on it?
verses.textEnNkjv: Is wood taken from it to make any object? Or can men make a peg from it to hang any vessel on?
verses.textEnNlt: Can its wood be used for making things, like pegs to hang up pots and pans?
verses.textEnNasb: Can wood be taken from it to make anything, or can even a peg be taken from it on which to hang any utensil?
verses.textEn: Is wood ever taken from it to make anything useful? Do they make pegs from it to hang things on?

verses.textZh: 看哪！已经拋在火里当作燃料，火既烧毁了两端，连中间也烧焦了，它还可以用来制造物件吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！已经拋在火里当作燃料，火既烧毁了两端，连中间也烧焦了，它还可以用来制造物件吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，已经抛在火中当作柴烧，火既烧了两头，中间也被烧了，还有益于工用吗？
verses.textEnNiv: And after it is thrown on the fire as fuel and the fire burns both ends and chars the middle, is it then useful for anything?
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, it is given to the fire for fuel. When the fire has consumed both ends of it, and the middle of it is charred, is it useful for anything?
verses.textEnNkjv: Instead, it is thrown into the fire for fuel; the fire devours both ends of it, and its middle is burned. Is it useful for any work?
verses.textEnNlt: No, it can only be used for fuel, and even as fuel, it burns too quickly.
verses.textEnNasb: If it has been put into the fire for fuel, and the fire has consumed both of its ends and its middle part has been charred, is it then good for anything?
verses.textEn: And after it is thrown on the fire as fuel and the fire burns both ends and chars the middle, is it then useful for anything?

verses.textZh: 看哪！它完整的时候，尚且不能用来制造物件，何况它被火烧毁和烧焦了，它还能用来做甚么呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！它完整的时候，尚且不能用来制造物件，何况它被火烧毁和烧焦了，它还能用来做甚么呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 完全的时候尚且不合乎什么工用，何况被火烧坏，还能合乎什么工用吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: If it was not useful for anything when it was whole, how much less can it be made into something useful when the fire has burned it and it is charred?
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, when it was whole, it was used for nothing. How much less, when the fire has consumed it and it is charred, can it ever be used for anything!
verses.textEnNkjv: Indeed, when it was whole, no object could be made from it. How much less will it be useful for any work when the fire has devoured it, and it is burned?
verses.textEnNlt: Vines are useless both before and after being put into the fire!
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, while it is intact, it is not made into anything. How much less, when the fire has consumed it and it is charred, can it still be made into anything!
verses.textEn: If it was not useful for anything when it was whole, how much less can it be made into something useful when the fire has burned it and it is charred?

verses.textZh: 因此，主耶和华这样说："我怎样把树林中的葡萄树拋在火里当作燃料，也必照样对待耶路撒冷的居民。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，主耶和华这样说："我怎样把树林中的葡萄树拋在火里当作燃料，也必照样对待耶路撒冷的居民。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，主耶和华如此说：「众树以内的葡萄树，我怎样使它在火中当柴，也必照样待耶路撒冷的居民。
verses.textEnNiv: "Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: As I have given the wood of the vine among the trees of the forest as fuel for the fire, so will I treat the people living in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore thus says the Lord God : Like the wood of the vine among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so have I given up the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore thus says the Lord God: ‘Like the wood of the vine among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so I will give up the inhabitants of Jerusalem;
verses.textEnNlt: "And this is what the Sovereign Lord says: The people of Jerusalem are like grapevines growing among the trees of the forest. Since they are useless, I have thrown them on the fire to be burned.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, this is what the Lord God says: ‘As the wood of the vine among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so have I given up the inhabitants of Jerusalem;
verses.textEn: "Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: As I have given the wood of the vine among the trees of the forest as fuel for the fire, so will I treat the people living in Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 我必变脸攻击他们；他们虽然从火里逃出来，火仍要吞灭他们；我变脸攻击他们的时候，你们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必变脸攻击他们；他们虽然从火里逃出来，火仍要吞灭他们；我变脸攻击他们的时候，你们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必向他们变脸；他们虽从火中出来，火却要烧灭他们。我向他们变脸的时候，你们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: I will set my face against them. Although they have come out of the fire, the fire will yet consume them. And when I set my face against them, you will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And I will set my face against them. Though they escape from the fire, the fire shall yet consume them, and you will know that I am the Lord , when I set my face against them.
verses.textEnNkjv: and I will set My face against them. They will go out from one fire, but another fire shall devour them. Then you shall know that I am the Lord, when I set My face against them.
verses.textEnNlt: And I will see to it that if they escape from one fire, they will fall into another. When I turn against them, you will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: and I set My face against them. Though they have come out of the fire, yet the fire will consume them. Then you will know that I am the Lord, when I set My face against them.
verses.textEn: I will set my face against them. Although they have come out of the fire, the fire will yet consume them. And when I set my face against them, you will know that I am the Lord .

verses.textZh: 我必使这地荒凉，因为他们行了不忠的事。这是主耶和华的宣告。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必使这地荒凉，因为他们行了不忠的事。这是主耶和华的宣告。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我必使地土荒凉，因为他们行事干犯我。这是主耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: I will make the land desolate because they have been unfaithful, declares the Sovereign Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: And I will make the land desolate, because they have acted faithlessly, declares the Lord God ."
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus I will make the land desolate, because they have persisted in unfaithfulness,’ says the Lord God."
verses.textEnNlt: And I will make the land desolate because my people have been unfaithful to me. I, the Sovereign Lord , have spoken!"
verses.textEnNasb: So I will make the land desolate, because they have acted unfaithfully,’ " declares the Lord God.
verses.textEn: I will make the land desolate because they have been unfaithful, declares the Sovereign Lord ."

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: Again the word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnNkjv: Again the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then another message came to me from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: Then the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: The word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: "人子啊！你要使耶路撒冷知道她那些可憎之事；
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！你要使耶路撒冷知道她那些可憎之事；
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，你要使耶路撒冷知道她那些可憎的事，
verses.textEnNiv: "Son of man, confront Jerusalem with her detestable practices
verses.textEnEsv: "Son of man, make known to Jerusalem her abominations,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Son of man, cause Jerusalem to know her abominations,
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, confront Jerusalem with her detestable sins.
verses.textEnNasb: "Son of man, make known to Jerusalem her abominations,
verses.textEn: "Son of man, confront Jerusalem with her detestable practices

verses.textZh: 你要说：‘主耶和华对耶路撒冷这样说：你的根源和出生地是在迦南地；你的父亲是亚摩利人，你的母亲是赫人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要说：‘主耶和华对耶路撒冷这样说：你的根源和出生地是在迦南地；你的父亲是亚摩利人，你的母亲是赫人。
verses.textZhCuv: 说主耶和华对耶路撒冷如此说：你根本，你出世，是在迦南地；你父亲是亚摩利人，你母亲是赫人。
verses.textEnNiv: and say, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says to Jerusalem: Your ancestry and birth were in the land of the Canaanites; your father was an Amorite and your mother a Hittite.
verses.textEnEsv: and say, Thus says the Lord God to Jerusalem: Your origin and your birth are of the land of the Canaanites; your father was an Amorite and your mother a Hittite.
verses.textEnNkjv: and say, ‘Thus says the Lord God to Jerusalem: "Your birth and your nativity are from the land of Canaan; your father was an Amorite and your mother a Hittite.
verses.textEnNlt: Give her this message from the Sovereign Lord : You are nothing but a Canaanite! Your father was an Amorite and your mother a Hittite.
verses.textEnNasb: and say, ‘This is what the Lord God says to Jerusalem: "Your origin and your birth are from the land of the Canaanite; your father was an Amorite and your mother a Hittite.
verses.textEn: and say, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says to Jerusalem: Your ancestry and birth were in the land of the Canaanites; your father was an Amorite and your mother a Hittite.

verses.textZh: 论到你出生的景况：在你生下来的日子，没有人替你断脐带，没有人用水洗你，使你洁净，没有人撒盐在你身上，也没有人用布包裹你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 论到你出生的景况：在你生下来的日子，没有人替你断脐带，没有人用水洗你，使你洁净，没有人撒盐在你身上，也没有人用布包裹你。
verses.textZhCuv: 论到你出世的景况，在你初生的日子没有为你断脐带，也没有用水洗你，使你洁净，丝毫没有撒盐在你身上，也没有用布裹你。
verses.textEnNiv: On the day you were born your cord was not cut, nor were you washed with water to make you clean, nor were you rubbed with salt or wrapped in cloths.
verses.textEnEsv: And as for your birth, on the day you were born your cord was not cut, nor were you washed with water to cleanse you, nor rubbed with salt, nor wrapped in swaddling cloths.
verses.textEnNkjv: Asfor your nativity, on the day you were born your navel cord was not cut, nor were you washed in water to cleanse you; you were not rubbed with salt nor wrapped in swaddling cloths.
verses.textEnNlt: On the day you were born, no one cared about you. Your umbilical cord was not cut, and you were never washed, rubbed with salt, and wrapped in cloth.
verses.textEnNasb: As for your birth, on the day you were born your navel cord was not cut, nor were you washed with water for cleansing; you were not rubbed with salt or even wrapped in cloths.
verses.textEn: On the day you were born your cord was not cut, nor were you washed with water to make you clean, nor were you rubbed with salt or wrapped in cloths.

verses.textZh: 没有人顾惜可怜你，愿意为你作上述任何一件事；你却被人拋弃在田野，因为你出生的时候，你是被人厌恶的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 没有人顾惜可怜你，愿意为你作上述任何一件事；你却被人拋弃在田野，因为你出生的时候，你是被人厌恶的。
verses.textZhCuv: 谁的眼也不可怜你，为你做一件这样的事怜恤你；但你初生的日子扔在田野，是因你被厌恶。
verses.textEnNiv: No one looked on you with pity or had compassion enough to do any of these things for you. Rather, you were thrown out into the open field, for on the day you were born you were despised.
verses.textEnEsv: No eye pitied you, to do any of these things to you out of compassion for you, but you were cast out on the open field, for you were abhorred, on the day that you were born.
verses.textEnNkjv: No eye pitied you, to do any of these things for you, to have compassion on you; but you were thrown out into the open field, when you yourself were loathed on the day you were born.
verses.textEnNlt: No one had the slightest interest in you; no one pitied you or cared for you. On the day you were born, you were unwanted, dumped in a field and left to die.
verses.textEnNasb: No eye looked with pity on you to do any of these things for you, to have compassion on you. Rather you were thrown out into the open field, for you were abhorred on the day you were born.
verses.textEn: No one looked on you with pity or had compassion enough to do any of these things for you. Rather, you were thrown out into the open field, for on the day you were born you were despised.

verses.textZh: "‘但我从你身旁经过，见你在血中挣扎。那时，你躺在血中，我对你说：要活下去 。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘但我从你身旁经过，见你在血中挣扎。那时，你躺在血中，我对你说：要活下去 。
verses.textZhCuv: 「我从你旁边经过，见你滚在血中，就对你说：你虽在血中，仍可存活；你虽在血中，仍可存活。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Then I passed by and saw you kicking about in your blood, and as you lay there in your blood I said to you, "Live!"
verses.textEnEsv: "And when I passed by you and saw you wallowing in your blood, I said to you in your blood, ‘Live!’ I said to you in your blood, ‘Live!’
verses.textEnNkjv: "And when I passed by you and saw you struggling in your own blood, I said to you in your blood, ‘Live!’ Yes, I said to you in your blood, ‘Live!’
verses.textEnNlt: "But I came by and saw you there, helplessly kicking about in your own blood. As you lay there, I said, ‘Live!’
verses.textEnNasb: "When I passed by you and saw you squirming in your blood, I said to you while you were in your blood, ‘Live!’ Yes, I said to you while you were in your blood, ‘Live!’
verses.textEn: " ‘Then I passed by and saw you kicking about in your blood, and as you lay there in your blood I said to you, "Live!"

verses.textZh: 我使你生长起来，像田间的植物。于是你生长起来，渐渐长大，好象最美丽的珠宝，你的两乳长成，头发秀长；但你仍是赤身露体。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我使你生长起来，像田间的植物。于是你生长起来，渐渐长大，好象最美丽的珠宝，你的两乳长成，头发秀长；但你仍是赤身露体。
verses.textZhCuv: 我使你生长好像田间所长的，你就渐渐长大，以致极其俊美，两乳成形，头发长成，你却仍然赤身露体。
verses.textEnNiv: I made you grow like a plant of the field. You grew and developed and entered puberty. Your breasts had formed and your hair had grown, yet you were stark naked.
verses.textEnEsv: I made you flourish like a plant of the field. And you grew up and became tall and arrived at full adornment. Your breasts were formed, and your hair had grown; yet you were naked and bare.
verses.textEnNkjv: I made you thrive like a plant in the field; and you grew, matured, and became very beautiful. Your breasts were formed, your hair grew, but you were naked and bare.
verses.textEnNlt: And I helped you to thrive like a plant in the field. You grew up and became a beautiful jewel. Your breasts became full, and your body hair grew, but you were still naked.
verses.textEnNasb: I made you very numerous, like plants of the field. Then you grew up, became tall and reached the age for fine jewelry; your breasts were formed and your hair had grown. Yet you were naked and bare.
verses.textEn: I made you grow like a plant of the field. You grew and developed and entered puberty. Your breasts had formed and your hair had grown, yet you were stark naked.

verses.textZh: 我又从你身旁经过，见你已经到了谈情说爱的时候，我就用我的衣襟搭在你身上，遮盖你赤裸的身体；我又向你起誓，与你立约，于是你就属于我了。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我又从你身旁经过，见你已经到了谈情说爱的时候，我就用我的衣襟搭在你身上，遮盖你赤裸的身体；我又向你起誓，与你立约，于是你就属于我了。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 「我从你旁边经过，看见你的时候正动爱情，便用衣襟搭在你身上，遮盖你的赤体；又向你起誓，与你结盟，你就归于我。这是主耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Later I passed by, and when I looked at you and saw that you were old enough for love, I spread the corner of my garment over you and covered your naked body. I gave you my solemn oath and entered into a covenant with you, declares the Sovereign Lord , and you became mine.
verses.textEnEsv: "When I passed by you again and saw you, behold, you were at the age for love, and I spread the corner of my garment over you and covered your nakedness; I made my vow to you and entered into a covenant with you, declares the Lord God , and you became mine.
verses.textEnNkjv: "When I passed by you again and looked upon you, indeed your time was the time of love; so I spread My wing over you and covered your nakedness. Yes, I swore an oath to you and entered into a covenant with you, and you became Mine," says the Lord God.
verses.textEnNlt: And when I passed by again, I saw that you were old enough for love. So I wrapped my cloak around you to cover your nakedness and declared my marriage vows. I made a covenant with you, says the Sovereign Lord , and you became mine.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then I passed by you and saw you, and behold, you were at the time for love; so I spread My garment over you and covered your nakedness. I also swore an oath to you and entered into a covenant with you so that you became Mine," declares the Lord God.
verses.textEn: " ‘Later I passed by, and when I looked at you and saw that you were old enough for love, I spread the corner of my garment over you and covered your naked body. I gave you my solemn oath and entered into a covenant with you, declares the Sovereign Lord , and you became mine.

verses.textZh: 那时我用水洗你，洗净你身上的血，又用油抹你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时我用水洗你，洗净你身上的血，又用油抹你。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时我用水洗你，洗净你身上的血，又用油抹你。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘I bathed you with water and washed the blood from you and put ointments on you.
verses.textEnEsv: Then I bathed you with water and washed off your blood from you and anointed you with oil.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then I washed you in water; yes, I thoroughly washed off your blood, and I anointed you with oil.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then I bathed you and washed off your blood, and I rubbed fragrant oils into your skin.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then I bathed you with water, washed off your blood from you, and anointed you with oil.
verses.textEn: " ‘I bathed you with water and washed the blood from you and put ointments on you.

verses.textZh: 我使你身穿刺绣的衣裳，脚穿海狗皮鞋；用细麻布给你裹头；又用丝绸给你披在身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我使你身穿刺绣的衣裳，脚穿海狗皮鞋；用细麻布给你裹头；又用丝绸给你披在身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 我也使你身穿绣花衣服，脚穿海狗皮鞋，并用细麻布给你束腰，用丝绸为衣披在你身上，
verses.textEnNiv: I clothed you with an embroidered dress and put sandals of fine leather on you. I dressed you in fine linen and covered you with costly garments.
verses.textEnEsv: I clothed you also with embroidered cloth and shod you with fine leather. I wrapped you in fine linen and covered you with silk.
verses.textEnNkjv: I clothed you in embroidered cloth and gave you sandals of badger skin; I clothed you with fine linen and covered you with silk.
verses.textEnNlt: I gave you expensive clothing of fine linen and silk, beautifully embroidered, and sandals made of fine goatskin leather.
verses.textEnNasb: I also clothed you with colorfully woven cloth and put sandals of fine leather on your feet; and I wrapped you with fine linen and covered you with silk.
verses.textEn: I clothed you with an embroidered dress and put sandals of fine leather on you. I dressed you in fine linen and covered you with costly garments.

verses.textZh: 我用珠宝给你打扮，把手环戴在你手上，把项链戴在你颈上，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我用珠宝给你打扮，把手环戴在你手上，把项链戴在你颈上，
verses.textZhCuv: 又用妆饰打扮你，将镯子戴在你手上，将金链戴在你项上。
verses.textEnNiv: I adorned you with jewelry: I put bracelets on your arms and a necklace around your neck,
verses.textEnEsv: And I adorned you with ornaments and put bracelets on your wrists and a chain on your neck.
verses.textEnNkjv: I adorned you with ornaments, put bracelets on your wrists, and a chain on your neck.
verses.textEnNlt: I gave you lovely jewelry, bracelets, beautiful necklaces,
verses.textEnNasb: I adorned you with jewelry, put bracelets on your wrists, and a necklace around your neck.
verses.textEn: I adorned you with jewelry: I put bracelets on your arms and a necklace around your neck,

verses.textZh: 又把鼻环戴在你鼻子上，把耳环戴在你耳朵上，把美丽的冠冕戴在你头上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又把鼻环戴在你鼻子上，把耳环戴在你耳朵上，把美丽的冠冕戴在你头上。
verses.textZhCuv: 我也将环子戴在你鼻子上，将耳环戴在你耳朵上，将华冠戴在你头上。
verses.textEnNiv: and I put a ring on your nose, earrings on your ears and a beautiful crown on your head.
verses.textEnEsv: And I put a ring on your nose and earrings in your ears and a beautiful crown on your head.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I put a jewel in your nose, earrings in your ears, and a beautiful crown on your head.
verses.textEnNlt: a ring for your nose, earrings for your ears, and a lovely crown for your head.
verses.textEnNasb: I also put a ring in your nose, earrings in your ears, and a beautiful crown on your head.
verses.textEn: and I put a ring on your nose, earrings on your ears and a beautiful crown on your head.

verses.textZh: 这样你就有了金银的装饰，你穿的是细麻、丝绸和刺绣的衣服；你吃的是细面、蜂蜜和油；你实在非常美丽，配登王后的位。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样你就有了金银的装饰，你穿的是细麻、丝绸和刺绣的衣服；你吃的是细面、蜂蜜和油；你实在非常美丽，配登王后的位。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，你就有金银的妆饰，穿的是细麻衣和丝绸，并绣花衣；吃的是细面、蜂蜜，并油。你也极其美貌，发达到王后的尊荣。
verses.textEnNiv: So you were adorned with gold and silver; your clothes were of fine linen and costly fabric and embroidered cloth. Your food was honey, olive oil and the finest flour. You became very beautiful and rose to be a queen.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus you were adorned with gold and silver, and your clothing was of fine linen and silk and embroidered cloth. You ate fine flour and honey and oil. You grew exceedingly beautiful and advanced to royalty.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus you were adorned with gold and silver, and your clothing wasof fine linen, silk, and embroidered cloth. You ate pastryof fine flour, honey, and oil. You were exceedingly beautiful, and succeeded to royalty.
verses.textEnNlt: And so you were adorned with gold and silver. Your clothes were made of fine linen and costly fabric and were beautifully embroidered. You ate the finest foods—choice flour, honey, and olive oil—and became more beautiful than ever. You looked like a queen, and so you were!
verses.textEnNasb: So you were adorned with gold and silver, and your dress was of fine linen, silk, and colorfully woven cloth. You ate fine flour, honey, and oil; so you were exceedingly beautiful and advanced to royalty.
verses.textEn: So you were adorned with gold and silver; your clothes were of fine linen and costly fabric and embroidered cloth. Your food was honey, olive oil and the finest flour. You became very beautiful and rose to be a queen.

verses.textZh: 你的名声因你的美丽传遍列国，你全然美丽，是因为我加在你身上的荣美。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的名声因你的美丽传遍列国，你全然美丽，是因为我加在你身上的荣美。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 你美貌的名声传在列邦中，你十分美貌，是因我加在你身上的威荣。这是主耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: And your fame spread among the nations on account of your beauty, because the splendor I had given you made your beauty perfect, declares the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And your renown went forth among the nations because of your beauty, for it was perfect through the splendor that I had bestowed on you, declares the Lord God .
verses.textEnNkjv: Your fame went out among the nations because of your beauty, for it was perfect through My splendor which I had bestowed on you," says the Lord God.
verses.textEnNlt: Your fame soon spread throughout the world because of your beauty. I dressed you in my splendor and perfected your beauty, says the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Then your fame spread among the nations on account of your beauty, for it was perfect because of My splendor which I bestowed on you," declares the Lord God.
verses.textEn: And your fame spread among the nations on account of your beauty, because the splendor I had given you made your beauty perfect, declares the Sovereign Lord .

verses.textZh: "‘可是你倚仗你的美丽，又凭着你的名声去行淫；你向每一个过路的人纵情淫乱 。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘可是你倚仗你的美丽，又凭着你的名声去行淫；你向每一个过路的人纵情淫乱 。
verses.textZhCuv: 「只是你仗着自己的美貌，又因你的名声就行邪淫。你纵情淫乱，使过路的任意而行。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘But you trusted in your beauty and used your fame to become a prostitute. You lavished your favors on anyone who passed by and your beauty became his.
verses.textEnEsv: "But you trusted in your beauty and played the whore because of your renown and lavished your whorings on any passerby; your beauty became his.
verses.textEnNkjv: "But you trusted in your own beauty, played the harlot because of your fame, and poured out your harlotry on everyone passing by who wouldhave it.
verses.textEnNlt: "But you thought your fame and beauty were your own. So you gave yourself as a prostitute to every man who came along. Your beauty was theirs for the asking.
verses.textEnNasb: "But you trusted in your beauty and became unfaithful because of your fame, and you poured out your obscene practices on every passer-by to whom it might be tempting.
verses.textEn: " ‘But you trusted in your beauty and used your fame to become a prostitute. You lavished your favors on anyone who passed by and your beauty became his.

verses.textZh: 你拿了你的一些衣服，为自己建造色彩缤纷的邱坛，又在那里行淫。这样的事不应发生，将来也不会再出现。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你拿了你的一些衣服，为自己建造色彩缤纷的邱坛，又在那里行淫。这样的事不应发生，将来也不会再出现。
verses.textZhCuv: 你用衣服为自己在高处结彩，在其上行邪淫。这样的事将来必没有，也必不再行了。
verses.textEnNiv: You took some of your garments to make gaudy high places, where you carried on your prostitution. You went to him, and he possessed your beauty.
verses.textEnEsv: You took some of your garments and made for yourself colorful shrines, and on them played the whore. The like has never been, nor ever shall be.
verses.textEnNkjv: You took some of your garments and adorned multicolored high places for yourself, and played the harlot on them. Such things should not happen, nor be.
verses.textEnNlt: You used the lovely things I gave you to make shrines for idols, where you played the prostitute. Unbelievable! How could such a thing ever happen?
verses.textEnNasb: You took some of your clothes, made for yourself high places of various colors, and committed prostitution on them, which should not come about nor happen.
verses.textEn: You took some of your garments to make gaudy high places, where you carried on your prostitution. You went to him, and he possessed your beauty.

verses.textZh: 你又拿了我送给你那些美丽的金器银器，为自己铸造男人的像，与那些像行淫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你又拿了我送给你那些美丽的金器银器，为自己铸造男人的像，与那些像行淫。
verses.textZhCuv: 你又将我所给你那华美的金银、宝器为自己制造人像，与他行邪淫；
verses.textEnNiv: You also took the fine jewelry I gave you, the jewelry made of my gold and silver, and you made for yourself male idols and engaged in prostitution with them.
verses.textEnEsv: You also took your beautiful jewels of my gold and of my silver, which I had given you, and made for yourself images of men, and with them played the whore.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have also taken your beautiful jewelry from My gold and My silver, which I had given you, and made for yourself male images and played the harlot with them.
verses.textEnNlt: You took the very jewels and gold and silver ornaments I had given you and made statues of men and worshiped them. This is adultery against me!
verses.textEnNasb: You also took your beautiful jewels made of My gold and of My silver, which I had given you, and made for yourself male images so that you might commit prostitution with them.
verses.textEn: You also took the fine jewelry I gave you, the jewelry made of my gold and silver, and you made for yourself male idols and engaged in prostitution with them.

verses.textZh: 你又拿你的刺绣衣服，盖在它们身上，并且把我的油和香料都摆在它们面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你又拿你的刺绣衣服，盖在它们身上，并且把我的油和香料都摆在它们面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 又用你的绣花衣服给他披上，并将我的膏油和香料摆在他跟前；
verses.textEnNiv: And you took your embroidered clothes to put on them, and you offered my oil and incense before them.
verses.textEnEsv: And you took your embroidered garments to cover them, and set my oil and my incense before them.
verses.textEnNkjv: You took your embroidered garments and covered them, and you set My oil and My incense before them.
verses.textEnNlt: You used the beautifully embroidered clothes I gave you to dress your idols. Then you used my special oil and my incense to worship them.
verses.textEnNasb: Then you took your colorfully woven cloth and covered them, and offered My oil and My incense before them.
verses.textEn: And you took your embroidered clothes to put on them, and you offered my oil and incense before them.

verses.textZh: 你把我赐给你的食物，就是我给你吃的细面、油和蜂蜜，都摆在它们面前作馨香的祭物。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你把我赐给你的食物，就是我给你吃的细面、油和蜂蜜，都摆在它们面前作馨香的祭物。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 又将我赐给你的食物，就是我赐给你吃的细面、油，和蜂蜜，都摆在他跟前为馨香的供物。这是主耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: Also the food I provided for you—the flour, olive oil and honey I gave you to eat—you offered as fragrant incense before them. That is what happened, declares the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Also my bread that I gave you— I fed you with fine flour and oil and honey—you set before them for a pleasing aroma; and so it was, declares the Lord God .
verses.textEnNkjv: Also My food which I gave you—the pastry of fine flour, oil, and honey which I fed you—you set it before them as sweet incense; and so it was," says the Lord God.
verses.textEnNlt: Imagine it! You set before them as a sacrifice the choice flour, olive oil, and honey I had given you, says the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Also My bread which I gave you, fine flour, oil, and honey with which I fed you, you would offer before them for a soothing aroma; so it happened," declares the Lord God.
verses.textEn: Also the food I provided for you—the flour, olive oil and honey I gave you to eat—you offered as fragrant incense before them. That is what happened, declares the Sovereign Lord .

verses.textZh: 你更把你的儿女，就是你给我所生的儿女，献给它们作食物；你所行的淫乱还算是小事吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你更把你的儿女，就是你给我所生的儿女，献给它们作食物；你所行的淫乱还算是小事吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 并且你将给我所生的儿女焚献给他。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘And you took your sons and daughters whom you bore to me and sacrificed them as food to the idols. Was your prostitution not enough?
verses.textEnEsv: And you took your sons and your daughters, whom you had borne to me, and these you sacrificed to them to be devoured. Were your whorings so small a matter
verses.textEnNkjv: "Moreover you took your sons and your daughters, whom you bore to Me, and these you sacrificed to them to be devoured. Were your acts of harlotry a small matter,
verses.textEnNlt: "Then you took your sons and daughters—the children you had borne to me—and sacrificed them to your gods. Was your prostitution not enough?
verses.textEnNasb: "Furthermore, you took your sons and daughters whom you had borne to Me and sacrificed them to idols to be devoured. Were your obscene practices a trivial matter?
verses.textEn: " ‘And you took your sons and daughters whom you bore to me and sacrificed them as food to the idols. Was your prostitution not enough?

verses.textZh: 你竟宰杀了我的儿女，使他们经火，献给它们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你竟宰杀了我的儿女，使他们经火，献给它们。
verses.textZhCuv: 你行淫乱岂是小事，竟将我的儿女杀了，使他们经火归与他吗？
verses.textEnNiv: You slaughtered my children and sacrificed them to the idols.
verses.textEnEsv: that you slaughtered my children and delivered them up as an offering by fire to them?
verses.textEnNkjv: that you have slain My children and offered them up to them by causing them to pass through the fire?
verses.textEnNlt: Must you also slaughter my children by sacrificing them to idols?
verses.textEnNasb: You slaughtered My children and offered them to idols by making them pass through the fire.
verses.textEn: You slaughtered my children and sacrificed them to the idols.

verses.textZh: 你行这一切可憎和淫乱的事，并没有想过你年幼的日子，那时你赤身露体，在血中挣扎。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你行这一切可憎和淫乱的事，并没有想过你年幼的日子，那时你赤身露体，在血中挣扎。
verses.textZhCuv: 你行这一切可憎和淫乱的事，并未追念你幼年赤身露体滚在血中的日子。」
verses.textEnNiv: In all your detestable practices and your prostitution you did not remember the days of your youth, when you were naked and bare, kicking about in your blood.
verses.textEnEsv: And in all your abominations and your whorings you did not remember the days of your youth, when you were naked and bare, wallowing in your blood.
verses.textEnNkjv: And in all your abominations and acts of harlotry you did not remember the days of your youth, when you were naked and bare, struggling in your blood.
verses.textEnNlt: In all your years of adultery and detestable sin, you have not once remembered the days long ago when you lay naked in a field, kicking about in your own blood.
verses.textEnNasb: And besides all your abominations and obscene practices, you did not remember the days of your youth, when you were naked and bare and squirming in your blood.
verses.textEn: In all your detestable practices and your prostitution you did not remember the days of your youth, when you were naked and bare, kicking about in your blood.

verses.textZh: "‘你有祸了，有祸了！这是主耶和华的宣告。你行了这一切恶事以后，
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘你有祸了，有祸了！这是主耶和华的宣告。你行了这一切恶事以后，
verses.textZhCuv: 「你行这一切恶事之后（主耶和华说：你有祸了！有祸了！）
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Woe! Woe to you, declares the Sovereign Lord . In addition to all your other wickedness,
verses.textEnEsv: "And after all your wickedness (woe, woe to you! declares the Lord God ),
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then it was so, after all your wickedness—‘Woe, woe to you!’ says the Lord God—
verses.textEnNlt: "What sorrow awaits you, says the Sovereign Lord . In addition to all your other wickedness,
verses.textEnNasb: "Then it came about after all your wickedness (‘Woe, woe to you!’ declares the Lord God),
verses.textEn: " ‘Woe! Woe to you, declares the Sovereign Lord . In addition to all your other wickedness,

verses.textZh: 你又为自己建造高冈，在各广场上筑起高坛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你又为自己建造高冈，在各广场上筑起高坛。
verses.textZhCuv: 又为自己建造圆顶花楼，在各街上做了高台。
verses.textEnNiv: you built a mound for yourself and made a lofty shrine in every public square.
verses.textEnEsv: you built yourself a vaulted chamber and made yourself a lofty place in every square.
verses.textEnNkjv: that you also built for yourself a shrine, and made a high place for yourself in every street.
verses.textEnNlt: you built a pagan shrine and put altars to idols in every town square.
verses.textEnNasb: that you built yourself a shrine and made yourself a high place in every public square.
verses.textEn: you built a mound for yourself and made a lofty shrine in every public square.

verses.textZh: 你在各路口建造高坛，使你的美丽变为可憎的，又向每一个过路的人张开两腿，多行淫乱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你在各路口建造高坛，使你的美丽变为可憎的，又向每一个过路的人张开两腿，多行淫乱。
verses.textZhCuv: 你在一切市口上建造高台，使你的美貌变为可憎的，又与一切过路的多行淫乱。
verses.textEnNiv: At every street corner you built your lofty shrines and degraded your beauty, spreading your legs with increasing promiscuity to anyone who passed by.
verses.textEnEsv: At the head of every street you built your lofty place and made your beauty an abomination, offering yourself to any passerby and multiplying your whoring.
verses.textEnNkjv: You built your high places at the head of every road, and made your beauty to be abhorred. You offered yourself to everyone who passed by, and multiplied your acts of harlotry.
verses.textEnNlt: On every street corner you defiled your beauty, offering your body to every passerby in an endless stream of prostitution.
verses.textEnNasb: You built yourself a high place at the beginning of every street and made your beauty abominable, and you spread your legs to every passer-by and multiplied your obscene practice.
verses.textEn: At every street corner you built your lofty shrines and degraded your beauty, spreading your legs with increasing promiscuity to anyone who passed by.

verses.textZh: 你也与放纵情欲的邻居埃及人行淫，多行淫乱，惹我发怒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你也与放纵情欲的邻居埃及人行淫，多行淫乱，惹我发怒。
verses.textZhCuv: 你也和你邻邦放纵情欲的埃及人行淫，加增你的淫乱，惹我发怒。
verses.textEnNiv: You engaged in prostitution with the Egyptians, your neighbors with large genitals, and aroused my anger with your increasing promiscuity.
verses.textEnEsv: You also played the whore with the Egyptians, your lustful neighbors, multiplying your whoring, to provoke me to anger.
verses.textEnNkjv: You also committed harlotry with the Egyptians, your very fleshly neighbors, and increased your acts of harlotry to provoke Me to anger.
verses.textEnNlt: Then you added lustful Egypt to your lovers, provoking my anger with your increasing promiscuity.
verses.textEnNasb: You also committed prostitution with the Egyptians, your lustful neighbors, and multiplied your obscene practice to provoke Me to anger.
verses.textEn: You engaged in prostitution with the Egyptians, your neighbors with large genitals, and aroused my anger with your increasing promiscuity.

verses.textZh: 因此，我伸手攻击你，减少你的粮食 ，又把你交给那些恨你的非利士女子，使她们任意待你；她们对你邪荡的行为也感到羞愧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，我伸手攻击你，减少你的粮食 ，又把你交给那些恨你的非利士女子，使她们任意待你；她们对你邪荡的行为也感到羞愧。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此我伸手攻击你，减少你应用的粮食，又将你交给恨你的非利士众女 ，使她们任意待你。她们见你的淫行，为你羞耻。
verses.textEnNiv: So I stretched out my hand against you and reduced your territory; I gave you over to the greed of your enemies, the daughters of the Philistines, who were shocked by your lewd conduct.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, therefore, I stretched out my hand against you and diminished your allotted portion and delivered you to the greed of your enemies, the daughters of the Philistines, who were ashamed of your lewd behavior.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Behold, therefore, I stretched out My hand against you, diminished your allotment, and gave you up to the will of those who hate you, the daughters of the Philistines, who were ashamed of your lewd behavior.
verses.textEnNlt: That is why I struck you with my fist and reduced your boundaries. I handed you over to your enemies, the Philistines, and even they were shocked by your lewd conduct.
verses.textEnNasb: So behold, I have stretched out My hand against you and cut back your rations. And I turned you over to the desire of those who hate you, the daughters of the Philistines, who are ashamed of your outrageous conduct.
verses.textEn: So I stretched out my hand against you and reduced your territory; I gave you over to the greed of your enemies, the daughters of the Philistines, who were shocked by your lewd conduct.

verses.textZh: 可是，因为你还不满足，又与亚述人行淫；你与他们行淫之后，还是不满足。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是，因为你还不满足，又与亚述人行淫；你与他们行淫之后，还是不满足。
verses.textZhCuv: 你因贪色无厌，又与亚述人行淫，与他们行淫之后，仍不满意，
verses.textEnNiv: You engaged in prostitution with the Assyrians too, because you were insatiable; and even after that, you still were not satisfied.
verses.textEnEsv: You played the whore also with the Assyrians, because you were not satisfied; yes, you played the whore with them, and still you were not satisfied.
verses.textEnNkjv: You also played the harlot with the Assyrians, because you were insatiable; indeed you played the harlot with them and still were not satisfied.
verses.textEnNlt: You have prostituted yourself with the Assyrians, too. It seems you can never find enough new lovers! And after your prostitution there, you still were not satisfied.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, you committed prostitution with the Assyrians because you were not satisfied; you committed prostitution with them and still were not satisfied.
verses.textEn: You engaged in prostitution with the Assyrians too, because you were insatiable; and even after that, you still were not satisfied.

verses.textZh: 于是你增多你的淫乱，与贸易之地迦勒底行淫，你还是不满足。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是你增多你的淫乱，与贸易之地迦勒底行淫，你还是不满足。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且多行淫乱，直到那贸易之地，就是迦勒底，你仍不满意。
verses.textEnNiv: Then you increased your promiscuity to include Babylonia, a land of merchants, but even with this you were not satisfied.
verses.textEnEsv: You multiplied your whoring also with the trading land of Chaldea, and even with this you were not satisfied.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover you multiplied your acts of harlotry as far as the land of the trader, Chaldea; and even then you were not satisfied.
verses.textEnNlt: You added to your lovers by embracing Babylonia, the land of merchants, but you still weren’t satisfied.
verses.textEnNasb: You also multiplied your obscene practice with the land of merchants, Chaldea; yet even with this you were not satisfied." ’ "
verses.textEn: Then you increased your promiscuity to include Babylonia, a land of merchants, but even with this you were not satisfied.

verses.textZh: "‘你行的这一切事，简直是任性无耻的妓女所为，可见你的意志是多么的薄弱。这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘你行的这一切事，简直是任性无耻的妓女所为，可见你的意志是多么的薄弱。这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 「主耶和华说：你行这一切事，都是不知羞耻妓女所行的，可见你的心是何等懦弱！
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘I am filled with fury against you, declares the Sovereign Lord , when you do all these things, acting like a brazen prostitute!
verses.textEnEsv: "How sick is your heart, declares the Lord God , because you did all these things, the deeds of a brazen prostitute,
verses.textEnNkjv: "How degenerate is your heart!" says the Lord God, "seeing you do all these things, the deeds of a brazen harlot.
verses.textEnNlt: "What a sick heart you have, says the Sovereign Lord , to do such things as these, acting like a shameless prostitute.
verses.textEnNasb: "How feverish is your heart," declares the Lord God, "while you do all these things, the action of a bold prostitute!
verses.textEn: " ‘I am filled with fury against you, declares the Sovereign Lord , when you do all these things, acting like a brazen prostitute!

verses.textZh: 你在各路口建造你的高冈，又在各广场上筑起你的高坛；然而你并不像一个妓女，因为你藐视卖淫所得的赏赐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你在各路口建造你的高冈，又在各广场上筑起你的高坛；然而你并不像一个妓女，因为你藐视卖淫所得的赏赐。
verses.textZhCuv: 因你在一切市口上建造圆顶花楼，在各街上做了高台，你却藐视赏赐，不像妓女。
verses.textEnNiv: When you built your mounds at every street corner and made your lofty shrines in every public square, you were unlike a prostitute, because you scorned payment.
verses.textEnEsv: building your vaulted chamber at the head of every street, and making your lofty place in every square. Yet you were not like a prostitute, because you scorned payment.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You erected your shrine at the head of every road, and built your high place in every street. Yet you were not like a harlot, because you scorned payment.
verses.textEnNlt: You build your pagan shrines on every street corner and your altars to idols in every square. In fact, you have been worse than a prostitute, so eager for sin that you have not even demanded payment.
verses.textEnNasb: When you built your shrine at the beginning of every street and made your high place in every public square, in spurning a prostitute’s fee, you were not like a prostitute.
verses.textEn: When you built your mounds at every street corner and made your lofty shrines in every public square, you were unlike a prostitute, because you scorned payment.

verses.textZh: 你这淫乱的妻子啊！你竟接外人而不接自己的丈夫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你这淫乱的妻子啊！你竟接外人而不接自己的丈夫。
verses.textZhCuv: 哎！你这行淫的妻啊，宁肯接外人，不接丈夫。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘You adulterous wife! You prefer strangers to your own husband!
verses.textEnEsv: Adulterous wife, who receives strangers instead of her husband!
verses.textEnNkjv: Youare an adulterous wife, who takes strangers instead of her husband.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, you are an adulterous wife who takes in strangers instead of her own husband.
verses.textEnNasb: You adulteress wife, who takes strangers instead of her husband!
verses.textEn: " ‘You adulterous wife! You prefer strangers to your own husband!

verses.textZh: 人都把礼物送给妓女，你却把你的礼物送给你所有的爱人，贿赂他们从四面来与你行淫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人都把礼物送给妓女，你却把你的礼物送给你所有的爱人，贿赂他们从四面来与你行淫。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡妓女是得人赠送，你反倒赠送你所爱的人，贿赂他们从四围来与你行淫。
verses.textEnNiv: All prostitutes receive gifts, but you give gifts to all your lovers, bribing them to come to you from everywhere for your illicit favors.
verses.textEnEsv: Men give gifts to all prostitutes, but you gave your gifts to all your lovers, bribing them to come to you from every side with your whorings.
verses.textEnNkjv: Men make payment to all harlots, but you made your payments to all your lovers, and hired them to come to you from all around for your harlotry.
verses.textEnNlt: Prostitutes charge for their services—but not you! You give gifts to your lovers, bribing them to come and have sex with you.
verses.textEnNasb: Men give gifts to all prostitutes, but you give your gifts to all your lovers and lavish favors on them so that they will come to you from every direction for your obscene practices.
verses.textEn: All prostitutes receive gifts, but you give gifts to all your lovers, bribing them to come to you from everywhere for your illicit favors.

verses.textZh: 你的淫行与别的妇女不同，因为不是人把礼物送给你，要求与你行淫，是你把礼物送给人，所以你是不同的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的淫行与别的妇女不同，因为不是人把礼物送给你，要求与你行淫，是你把礼物送给人，所以你是不同的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你行淫与别的妇女相反，因为不是人从你行淫；你既赠送人，人并不赠送你；所以你与别的妇女相反。」
verses.textEnNiv: So in your prostitution you are the opposite of others; no one runs after you for your favors. You are the very opposite, for you give payment and none is given to you.
verses.textEnEsv: So you were different from other women in your whorings. No one solicited you to play the whore, and you gave payment, while no payment was given to you; therefore you were different.
verses.textEnNkjv: You are the opposite of other women in your harlotry, because no one solicited you to be a harlot. In that you gave payment but no payment was given you, therefore you are the opposite."
verses.textEnNlt: So you are the opposite of other prostitutes. You pay your lovers instead of their paying you!
verses.textEnNasb: So it is the opposite for you from those women in your obscene practices, in that you are not approached for prostitution, and in the fact that you pay a prostitute’s fee, and no fee is paid to you; so you are the opposite."
verses.textEn: So in your prostitution you are the opposite of others; no one runs after you for your favors. You are the very opposite, for you give payment and none is given to you.

verses.textZh: "‘因此，你这妓女啊，要听耶和华的话！
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘因此，你这妓女啊，要听耶和华的话！
verses.textZhCuv: 「你这妓女啊，要听耶和华的话。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Therefore, you prostitute, hear the word of the Lord !
verses.textEnEsv: "Therefore, O prostitute, hear the word of the Lord :
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Now then, O harlot, hear the word of the Lord!
verses.textEnNlt: "Therefore, you prostitute, listen to this message from the Lord !
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, you prostitute, hear the word of the Lord.
verses.textEn: " ‘Therefore, you prostitute, hear the word of the Lord !

verses.textZh: 主耶和华这样说：因为你的情欲倾注出来，你与你的爱人行淫，露出你的下体，又因为你拜一切可憎的偶像，流儿女的血，把血献给偶像，
verses.textZhCnvs: 主耶和华这样说：因为你的情欲倾注出来，你与你的爱人行淫，露出你的下体，又因为你拜一切可憎的偶像，流儿女的血，把血献给偶像，
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华如此说：因你的污秽倾泄了，你与你所爱的行淫露出下体，又因你拜一切可憎的偶像，流儿女的血献给他，
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Because you poured out your lust and exposed your naked body in your promiscuity with your lovers, and because of all your detestable idols, and because you gave them your children’s blood,
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord God , Because your lust was poured out and your nakedness uncovered in your whorings with your lovers, and with all your abominable idols, and because of the blood of your children that you gave to them,
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord God: "Because your filthiness was poured out and your nakedness uncovered in your harlotry with your lovers, and with all your abominable idols, and because of the blood of your children which you gave to them,
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Because you have poured out your lust and exposed yourself in prostitution to all your lovers, and because you have worshiped detestable idols, and because you have slaughtered your children as sacrifices to your gods,
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord God says: "Because your lewdness was poured out and your nakedness uncovered through your obscene practices with your lovers and with all your detestable idols, and because of the blood of your sons that you gave to idols,
verses.textEn: This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Because you poured out your lust and exposed your naked body in your promiscuity with your lovers, and because of all your detestable idols, and because you gave them your children’s blood,

verses.textZh: 所以我要把所有与你欢合的爱人，就是所有你所爱的和你所恨的，都聚集起来；我要把他们从四围聚集起来攻击你；我要在他们面前露出你的下体，使他们看见你全身赤裸。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以我要把所有与你欢合的爱人，就是所有你所爱的和你所恨的，都聚集起来；我要把他们从四围聚集起来攻击你；我要在他们面前露出你的下体，使他们看见你全身赤裸。
verses.textZhCuv: 我就要将你一切相欢相爱的和你一切所恨的都聚集来，从四围攻击你；又将你的下体露出，使他们看尽了。
verses.textEnNiv: therefore I am going to gather all your lovers, with whom you found pleasure, those you loved as well as those you hated. I will gather them against you from all around and will strip you in front of them, and they will see you stark naked.
verses.textEnEsv: therefore, behold, I will gather all your lovers with whom you took pleasure, all those you loved and all those you hated. I will gather them against you from every side and will uncover your nakedness to them, that they may see all your nakedness.
verses.textEnNkjv: surely, therefore, I will gather all your lovers with whom you took pleasure, all those you loved, and all those you hated; I will gather them from all around against you and will uncover your nakedness to them, that they may see all your nakedness.
verses.textEnNlt: this is what I am going to do. I will gather together all your allies—the lovers with whom you have sinned, both those you loved and those you hated—and I will strip you naked in front of them so they can stare at you.
verses.textEnNasb: therefore, behold, I am going to gather all your lovers whom you pleased, all those whom you loved as well as all those whom you hated. So I will gather them against you from every direction and expose your nakedness to them so that they may see all your nakedness.
verses.textEn: therefore I am going to gather all your lovers, with whom you found pleasure, those you loved as well as those you hated. I will gather them against you from all around and will strip you in front of them, and they will see you stark naked.

verses.textZh: 我要审判你，像审判行奸淫和流人血的妇人一样；我要因我的烈怒和妒忿，使流人血的罪归在你身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要审判你，像审判行奸淫和流人血的妇人一样；我要因我的烈怒和妒忿，使流人血的罪归在你身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 我也要审判你，好像官长审判淫妇和流人血的妇女一样。我因忿怒忌恨，使流血的罪归到你身上。
verses.textEnNiv: I will sentence you to the punishment of women who commit adultery and who shed blood; I will bring on you the blood vengeance of my wrath and jealous anger.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will judge you as women who commit adultery and shed blood are judged, and bring upon you the blood of wrath and jealousy.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will judge you as women who break wedlock or shed blood are judged; I will bring blood upon you in fury and jealousy.
verses.textEnNlt: I will punish you for your murder and adultery. I will cover you with blood in my jealous fury.
verses.textEnNasb: So I will judge you as women who commit adultery or shed blood are judged; and I will bring on you the blood of wrath and jealousy.
verses.textEn: I will sentence you to the punishment of women who commit adultery and who shed blood; I will bring on you the blood vengeance of my wrath and jealous anger.

verses.textZh: 我要把你交在他们手里，他们要拆毁你的高冈，破坏你的高坛，剥去你的衣服，夺去你美丽的珠宝，只留下你赤露的身躯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要把你交在他们手里，他们要拆毁你的高冈，破坏你的高坛，剥去你的衣服，夺去你美丽的珠宝，只留下你赤露的身躯。
verses.textZhCuv: 我又要将你交在他们手中；他们必拆毁你的圆顶花楼，毁坏你的高台，剥去你的衣服，夺取你的华美宝器，留下你赤身露体。
verses.textEnNiv: Then I will deliver you into the hands of your lovers, and they will tear down your mounds and destroy your lofty shrines. They will strip you of your clothes and take your fine jewelry and leave you stark naked.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will give you into their hands, and they shall throw down your vaulted chamber and break down your lofty places. They shall strip you of your clothes and take your beautiful jewels and leave you naked and bare.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will also give you into their hand, and they shall throw down your shrines and break down your high places. They shall also strip you of your clothes, take your beautiful jewelry, and leave you naked and bare.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I will give you to these many nations who are your lovers, and they will destroy you. They will knock down your pagan shrines and the altars to your idols. They will strip you and take your beautiful jewels, leaving you stark naked.
verses.textEnNasb: I will also hand you over to your lovers, and they will tear down your shrines, demolish your high places, strip you of your clothing, take away your jewels, and will leave you naked and bare.
verses.textEn: Then I will deliver you into the hands of your lovers, and they will tear down your mounds and destroy your lofty shrines. They will strip you of your clothes and take your fine jewelry and leave you stark naked.

verses.textZh: 他们必带一大群人上来攻击你，用石头打死你，用他们的刀把你砍碎。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们必带一大群人上来攻击你，用石头打死你，用他们的刀把你砍碎。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们也必带多人来攻击你，用石头打死你，用刀剑刺透你，
verses.textEnNiv: They will bring a mob against you, who will stone you and hack you to pieces with their swords.
verses.textEnEsv: They shall bring up a crowd against you, and they shall stone you and cut you to pieces with their swords.
verses.textEnNkjv: "They shall also bring up an assembly against you, and they shall stone you with stones and thrust you through with their swords.
verses.textEnNlt: They will band together in a mob to stone you and cut you up with swords.
verses.textEnNasb: They will incite a crowd against you, and they will stone you and cut you to pieces with their swords.
verses.textEn: They will bring a mob against you, who will stone you and hack you to pieces with their swords.

verses.textZh: 他们也要用火烧你的房屋，在许多妇人面前向你施行审判。我必止住你的淫行，也必使你不再把诱人行淫的礼物送给人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们也要用火烧你的房屋，在许多妇人面前向你施行审判。我必止住你的淫行，也必使你不再把诱人行淫的礼物送给人。
verses.textZhCuv: 用火焚烧你的房屋，在许多妇人眼前向你施行审判。我必使你不再行淫，也不再赠送与人。
verses.textEnNiv: They will burn down your houses and inflict punishment on you in the sight of many women. I will put a stop to your prostitution, and you will no longer pay your lovers.
verses.textEnEsv: And they shall burn your houses and execute judgments upon you in the sight of many women. I will make you stop playing the whore, and you shall also give payment no more.
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall burn your houses with fire, and execute judgments on you in the sight of many women; and I will make you cease playing the harlot, and you shall no longer hire lovers.
verses.textEnNlt: They will burn your homes and punish you in front of many women. I will stop your prostitution and end your payments to your many lovers.
verses.textEnNasb: And they will burn your houses with fire and execute judgments against you in the sight of many women. Then I will put an end to your prostitution, and you will also no longer pay your lovers.
verses.textEn: They will burn down your houses and inflict punishment on you in the sight of many women. I will put a stop to your prostitution, and you will no longer pay your lovers.

verses.textZh: 这样我向你发的烈怒就可以平息，我的妒忿也可以离开你；我可以安静，不再恼怒了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样我向你发的烈怒就可以平息，我的妒忿也可以离开你；我可以安静，不再恼怒了。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，我就止息向你发的忿怒，我的忌恨也要离开你，我要安静不再恼怒。
verses.textEnNiv: Then my wrath against you will subside and my jealous anger will turn away from you; I will be calm and no longer angry.
verses.textEnEsv: So will I satisfy my wrath on you, and my jealousy shall depart from you. I will be calm and will no more be angry.
verses.textEnNkjv: So I will lay to rest My fury toward you, and My jealousy shall depart from you. I will be quiet, and be angry no more.
