verses.textEnNlt: "Then at last my fury against you will be spent, and my jealous anger will subside. I will be calm and will not be angry with you anymore.
verses.textEnNasb: So I will satisfy My fury against you and My jealousy will leave you, and I will be pacified and no longer be angry.
verses.textEn: Then my wrath against you will subside and my jealous anger will turn away from you; I will be calm and no longer angry.

verses.textZh: 因为你不追念你年幼的日子，反而在这一切事上惹我发怒；看哪！我必照着你所行的报应在你头上，这是主耶和华的宣告。在你一切可憎的事以外，你岂不是还行了这淫乱的丑事吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你不追念你年幼的日子，反而在这一切事上惹我发怒；看哪！我必照着你所行的报应在你头上，这是主耶和华的宣告。在你一切可憎的事以外，你岂不是还行了这淫乱的丑事吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 因你不追念你幼年的日子，在这一切的事上向我发烈怒，所以我必照你所行的报应在你头上，你就不再贪淫，行那一切可憎的事。这是主耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Because you did not remember the days of your youth but enraged me with all these things, I will surely bring down on your head what you have done, declares the Sovereign Lord . Did you not add lewdness to all your other detestable practices?
verses.textEnEsv: Because you have not remembered the days of your youth, but have enraged me with all these things, therefore, behold, I have returned your deeds upon your head, declares the Lord God . Have you not committed lewdness in addition to all your abominations?
verses.textEnNkjv: Because you did not remember the days of your youth, but agitated Me with all these things, surely I will also recompense your deeds on yourown head," says the Lord God. "And you shall not commit lewdness in addition to all your abominations.
verses.textEnNlt: But first, because you have not remembered your youth but have angered me by doing all these evil things, I will fully repay you for all of your sins, says the Sovereign Lord . For you have added lewd acts to all your detestable sins.
verses.textEnNasb: Since you have not remembered the days of your youth but have caused Me unrest by all these things, behold, I in turn will bring your conduct down on your own head," declares the Lord God, "so that you will not commit this outrageous sin in addition to all your other abominations.
verses.textEn: " ‘Because you did not remember the days of your youth but enraged me with all these things, I will surely bring down on your head what you have done, declares the Sovereign Lord . Did you not add lewdness to all your other detestable practices?

verses.textZh: "‘凡引用俗语的，必用这俗语指着你说：有其母，必有其女。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘凡引用俗语的，必用这俗语指着你说：有其母，必有其女。
verses.textZhCuv: 「凡说俗语的必用俗语攻击你，说：『母亲怎样，女儿也怎样。』
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Everyone who quotes proverbs will quote this proverb about you: "Like mother, like daughter."
verses.textEnEsv: "Behold, everyone who uses proverbs will use this proverb about you: ‘Like mother, like daughter.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "Indeed everyone who quotes proverbs will use this proverb against you: ‘Like mother, like daughter!’
verses.textEnNlt: Everyone who makes up proverbs will say of you, ‘Like mother, like daughter.’
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, everyone who quotes proverbs will quote this proverb about you, saying, ‘Like mother, like daughter.’
verses.textEn: " ‘Everyone who quotes proverbs will quote this proverb about you: "Like mother, like daughter."

verses.textZh: 你实在是你母亲的女儿，她厌弃自己的丈夫和儿女；你实在是你姊妹的姊妹，她们厌弃她们的丈夫和儿女；你们的母亲是赫人，你们的父亲是亚摩利人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你实在是你母亲的女儿，她厌弃自己的丈夫和儿女；你实在是你姊妹的姊妹，她们厌弃她们的丈夫和儿女；你们的母亲是赫人，你们的父亲是亚摩利人。
verses.textZhCuv: 你正是你母亲的女儿，厌弃丈夫和儿女；你正是你姊妹的姊妹，厌弃丈夫和儿女。你母亲是赫人，你父亲是亚摩利人。
verses.textEnNiv: You are a true daughter of your mother, who despised her husband and her children; and you are a true sister of your sisters, who despised their husbands and their children. Your mother was a Hittite and your father an Amorite.
verses.textEnEsv: You are the daughter of your mother, who loathed her husband and her children; and you are the sister of your sisters, who loathed their husbands and their children. Your mother was a Hittite and your father an Amorite.
verses.textEnNkjv: You are your mother’s daughter, loathing husband and children; and you are the sister of your sisters, who loathed their husbands and children; your mother was a Hittite and your father an Amorite.
verses.textEnNlt: For your mother loathed her husband and her children, and so do you. And you are exactly like your sisters, for they despised their husbands and their children. Truly your mother was a Hittite and your father an Amorite.
verses.textEnNasb: You are the daughter of your mother, who loathed her husband and children. You are also the sister of your sisters, who loathed their husbands and children. Your mother was a Hittite and your father an Amorite.
verses.textEn: You are a true daughter of your mother, who despised her husband and her children; and you are a true sister of your sisters, who despised their husbands and their children. Your mother was a Hittite and your father an Amorite.

verses.textZh: 你的姊姊是撒玛利亚，她和她的女儿们住在你的北面；你的妹妹是所多玛，她和她的女儿们住在你的南面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的姊姊是撒玛利亚，她和她的女儿们住在你的北面；你的妹妹是所多玛，她和她的女儿们住在你的南面。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的姊姊是撒马利亚，她和她的众女住在你左边；你的妹妹是所多玛，她和她的众女住在你右边。
verses.textEnNiv: Your older sister was Samaria, who lived to the north of you with her daughters; and your younger sister, who lived to the south of you with her daughters, was Sodom.
verses.textEnEsv: And your elder sister is Samaria, who lived with her daughters to the north of you; and your younger sister, who lived to the south of you, is Sodom with her daughters.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Your elder sister is Samaria, who dwells with her daughters to the north of you; and your younger sister, who dwells to the south of you, is Sodom and her daughters.
verses.textEnNlt: "Your older sister was Samaria, who lived with her daughters in the north. Your younger sister was Sodom, who lived with her daughters in the south.
verses.textEnNasb: Now your older sister is Samaria, who lives north of you with her daughters; and your younger sister, who lives south of you, is Sodom with her daughters.
verses.textEn: Your older sister was Samaria, who lived to the north of you with her daughters; and your younger sister, who lived to the south of you with her daughters, was Sodom.

verses.textZh: 你不但行她们所行的，作她们所作的可憎之事，而且你还以那些事为小，你一切所行的比她们更坏。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你不但行她们所行的，作她们所作的可憎之事，而且你还以那些事为小，你一切所行的比她们更坏。
verses.textZhCuv: 你没有效法她们的行为，也没有照她们可憎的事去做，你以那为小事，你一切所行的倒比她们更坏。
verses.textEnNiv: You not only followed their ways and copied their detestable practices, but in all your ways you soon became more depraved than they.
verses.textEnEsv: Not only did you walk in their ways and do according to their abominations; within a very little time you were more corrupt than they in all your ways.
verses.textEnNkjv: You did not walk in their ways nor act according to their abominations; but, as ifthatwere too little, you became more corrupt than they in all your ways.
verses.textEnNlt: But you have not merely sinned as they did. You quickly surpassed them in corruption.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet you have not merely walked in their ways and committed their abominations; but, as if that were too little, you also acted more corruptly in all your conduct than they.
verses.textEn: You not only followed their ways and copied their detestable practices, but in all your ways you soon became more depraved than they.

verses.textZh: 我指着我的永生起誓，你的妹妹所多玛和她的女儿们，都没有行过像你和你女儿们所行的事。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我指着我的永生起誓，你的妹妹所多玛和她的女儿们，都没有行过像你和你女儿们所行的事。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华说：我指着我的永生起誓，你妹妹所多玛与她的众女尚未行你和你众女所行的事。
verses.textEnNiv: As surely as I live, declares the Sovereign Lord , your sister Sodom and her daughters never did what you and your daughters have done.
verses.textEnEsv: As I live, declares the Lord God , your sister Sodom and her daughters have not done as you and your daughters have done.
verses.textEnNkjv: "As I live," says the Lord God, "neither your sister Sodom nor her daughters have done as you and your daughters have done.
verses.textEnNlt: As surely as I live, says the Sovereign Lord , Sodom and her daughters were never as wicked as you and your daughters.
verses.textEnNasb: As I live," declares the Lord God, "Sodom, your sister and her daughters have not done as you and your daughters have done!
verses.textEn: As surely as I live, declares the Sovereign Lord , your sister Sodom and her daughters never did what you and your daughters have done.

verses.textZh: 你妹妹所多玛的罪孽是这样：她和她的女儿们都骄傲自大，粮食丰足，生活安逸，却没有帮助困苦和贫穷的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你妹妹所多玛的罪孽是这样：她和她的女儿们都骄傲自大，粮食丰足，生活安逸，却没有帮助困苦和贫穷的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，你妹妹所多玛的罪孽是这样：她和她的众女都心骄气傲，粮食饱足，大享安逸，并没有扶助困苦和穷乏人的手。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Now this was the sin of your sister Sodom: She and her daughters were arrogant, overfed and unconcerned; they did not help the poor and needy.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, this was the guilt of your sister Sodom: she and her daughters had pride, excess of food, and prosperous ease, but did not aid the poor and needy.
verses.textEnNkjv: Look, this was the iniquity of your sister Sodom: She and her daughter had pride, fullness of food, and abundance of idleness; neither did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.
verses.textEnNlt: Sodom’s sins were pride, gluttony, and laziness, while the poor and needy suffered outside her door.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, this was the guilt of your sister Sodom: she and her daughters had arrogance, plenty of food, and carefree ease, but she did not help the poor and needy.
verses.textEn: " ‘Now this was the sin of your sister Sodom: She and her daughters were arrogant, overfed and unconcerned; they did not help the poor and needy.

verses.textZh: 她们自高自傲，在我面前行了可憎的事；我看见了，就把她们除掉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她们自高自傲，在我面前行了可憎的事；我看见了，就把她们除掉。
verses.textZhCuv: 她们狂傲，在我面前行可憎的事，我看见便将她们除掉。
verses.textEnNiv: They were haughty and did detestable things before me. Therefore I did away with them as you have seen.
verses.textEnEsv: They were haughty and did an abomination before me. So I removed them, when I saw it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they were haughty and committed abomination before Me; therefore I took them away as I saw fit.
verses.textEnNlt: She was proud and committed detestable sins, so I wiped her out, as you have seen.
verses.textEnNasb: So they were haughty and committed abominations before Me. Therefore I removed them when I saw it.
verses.textEn: They were haughty and did detestable things before me. Therefore I did away with them as you have seen.

verses.textZh: 撒玛利亚所犯的罪还不及你所犯的一半；你所行的可憎之事比她更多，以致你的姊妹因你所行的一切可憎之事而显为义。
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒玛利亚所犯的罪还不及你所犯的一半；你所行的可憎之事比她更多，以致你的姊妹因你所行的一切可憎之事而显为义。
verses.textZhCuv: 撒马利亚没有犯你一半的罪，你行可憎的事比她更多，使你的姊妹因你所行一切可憎的事，倒显为义。
verses.textEnNiv: Samaria did not commit half the sins you did. You have done more detestable things than they, and have made your sisters seem righteous by all these things you have done.
verses.textEnEsv: Samaria has not committed half your sins. You have committed more abominations than they, and have made your sisters appear righteous by all the abominations that you have committed.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Samaria did not commit half of your sins; but you have multiplied your abominations more than they, and have justified your sisters by all the abominations which you have done.
verses.textEnNlt: "Even Samaria did not commit half your sins. You have done far more detestable things than your sisters ever did. They seem righteous compared to you.
verses.textEnNasb: Furthermore, Samaria did not commit half of your sins, for you have multiplied your abominations more than they. So you have made your sisters appear innocent by all your abominations which you have committed.
verses.textEn: Samaria did not commit half the sins you did. You have done more detestable things than they, and have made your sisters seem righteous by all these things you have done.

verses.textZh: 你既然使你的姊妹较显为义，你就要承担自己的耻辱；因为你所犯的罪比她们所犯的更可憎，她们比你更显为义。你使你的姊妹较显为义，所以你就要惭愧，承担自己的耻辱了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你既然使你的姊妹较显为义，你就要承担自己的耻辱；因为你所犯的罪比她们所犯的更可憎，她们比你更显为义。你使你的姊妹较显为义，所以你就要惭愧，承担自己的耻辱了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你既断定你姊妹为义 ，就要担当自己的羞辱；因你所犯的罪比她们更为可憎，她们就比你更显为义；你既使你的姊妹显为义，你就要抱愧担当自己的羞辱。」
verses.textEnNiv: Bear your disgrace, for you have furnished some justification for your sisters. Because your sins were more vile than theirs, they appear more righteous than you. So then, be ashamed and bear your disgrace, for you have made your sisters appear righteous.
verses.textEnEsv: Bear your disgrace, you also, for you have intervened on behalf of your sisters. Because of your sins in which you acted more abominably than they, they are more in the right than you. So be ashamed, you also, and bear your disgrace, for you have made your sisters appear righteous.
verses.textEnNkjv: You who judged your sisters, bear your own shame also, because the sins which you committed were more abominable than theirs; they are more righteous than you. Yes, be disgraced also, and bear your own shame, because you justified your sisters.
verses.textEnNlt: Shame on you! Your sins are so terrible that you make your sisters seem righteous, even virtuous.
verses.textEnNasb: Also, bear your disgrace in that you have made judgment favorable for your sisters. Because of your sins in which you acted more abominably than they, they are more in the right than you. Yes, be also ashamed and bear your disgrace, in that you made your sisters appear innocent.
verses.textEn: Bear your disgrace, for you have furnished some justification for your sisters. Because your sins were more vile than theirs, they appear more righteous than you. So then, be ashamed and bear your disgrace, for you have made your sisters appear righteous.

verses.textZh: "‘我要使所多玛和她的女儿们，撒玛利亚和她的女儿们从苦境中转回，我也要使你们跟她们一起转回，
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘我要使所多玛和她的女儿们，撒玛利亚和她的女儿们从苦境中转回，我也要使你们跟她们一起转回，
verses.textZhCuv: 「我必叫她们被掳的归回，就是叫所多玛和她的众女，撒马利亚和她的众女，并你们中间被掳的，都要归回，
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘However, I will restore the fortunes of Sodom and her daughters and of Samaria and her daughters, and your fortunes along with them,
verses.textEnEsv: "I will restore their fortunes, both the fortunes of Sodom and her daughters, and the fortunes of Samaria and her daughters, and I will restore your own fortunes in their midst,
verses.textEnNkjv: "When I bring back their captives, the captives of Sodom and her daughters, and the captives of Samaria and her daughters, then Iwillalsobringback the captives of your captivity among them,
verses.textEnNlt: "But someday I will restore the fortunes of Sodom and Samaria, and I will restore you, too.
verses.textEnNasb: "Nevertheless, I will restore their fortunes, the fortunes of Sodom and her daughters, the fortunes of Samaria and her daughters, and along with them your own fortunes,
verses.textEn: " ‘However, I will restore the fortunes of Sodom and her daughters and of Samaria and her daughters, and your fortunes along with them,

verses.textZh: 好使你担当自己的耻辱，并且因你一切所行的使她们得了安慰，你就自觉惭愧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 好使你担当自己的耻辱，并且因你一切所行的使她们得了安慰，你就自觉惭愧。
verses.textZhCuv: 好使你担当自己的羞辱，并因你一切所行的使她们得安慰，你就抱愧。
verses.textEnNiv: so that you may bear your disgrace and be ashamed of all you have done in giving them comfort.
verses.textEnEsv: that you may bear your disgrace and be ashamed of all that you have done, becoming a consolation to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: that you may bear your own shame and be disgraced by all that you did when you comforted them.
verses.textEnNlt: Then you will be truly ashamed of everything you have done, for your sins make them feel good in comparison.
verses.textEnNasb: so that you will bear your disgrace and feel ashamed for all that you have done when you become a consolation to them.
verses.textEn: so that you may bear your disgrace and be ashamed of all you have done in giving them comfort.

verses.textZh: 你的妹妹所多玛和她的女儿们必回复原来的状况；撒玛利亚和她的女儿们必回复原来的状况；你和你的女儿们也必回复原来的状况。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的妹妹所多玛和她的女儿们必回复原来的状况；撒玛利亚和她的女儿们必回复原来的状况；你和你的女儿们也必回复原来的状况。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的妹妹所多玛和她的众女必归回原位；撒马利亚和她的众女，你和你的众女，也必归回原位。
verses.textEnNiv: And your sisters, Sodom with her daughters and Samaria with her daughters, will return to what they were before; and you and your daughters will return to what you were before.
verses.textEnEsv: As for your sisters, Sodom and her daughters shall return to their former state, and Samaria and her daughters shall return to their former state, and you and your daughters shall return to your former state.
verses.textEnNkjv: When your sisters, Sodom and her daughters, return to their former state, and Samaria and her daughters return to their former state, then you and your daughters will return to your former state.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, your sisters, Sodom and Samaria, and all their people will be restored, and at that time you also will be restored.
verses.textEnNasb: Your sisters, Sodom with her daughters and Samaria with her daughters, will return to their former state, and you with your daughters will also return to your former state.
verses.textEn: And your sisters, Sodom with her daughters and Samaria with her daughters, will return to what they were before; and you and your daughters will return to what you were before.

verses.textZh: 在你骄傲自大的日子，你妹妹所多玛在你口中不是成了笑柄吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 在你骄傲自大的日子，你妹妹所多玛在你口中不是成了笑柄吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：你贪淫和可憎的事，你已经担当了。」
verses.textEnNiv: You would not even mention your sister Sodom in the day of your pride,
verses.textEnEsv: Was not your sister Sodom a byword in your mouth in the day of your pride,
verses.textEnNkjv: For your sister Sodom was not a byword in your mouth in the days of your pride,
verses.textEnNlt: In your proud days you held Sodom in contempt.
verses.textEnNasb: As the name of your sister Sodom was not heard from your lips in your day of pride,
verses.textEn: You would not even mention your sister Sodom in the day of your pride,

verses.textZh: 那时你的恶行还没有显露出来，现在你却成了以东的女儿们和以东四围的众人，以及非利士的女儿们讥笑的对象。你周围的人都轻视你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时你的恶行还没有显露出来，现在你却成了以东的女儿们和以东四围的众人，以及非利士的女儿们讥笑的对象。你周围的人都轻视你。
verses.textZhCuv: 「主耶和华如此说：你这轻看誓言、背弃盟约的，我必照你所行的待你。
verses.textEnNiv: before your wickedness was uncovered. Even so, you are now scorned by the daughters of Edom and all her neighbors and the daughters of the Philistines—all those around you who despise you.
verses.textEnEsv: before your wickedness was uncovered? Now you have become an object of reproach for the daughters of Syria and all those around her, and for the daughters of the Philistines, those all around who despise you.
verses.textEnNkjv: before your wickedness was uncovered. It was like the time of the reproach of the daughters of Syria and all those around her, and of the daughters of the Philistines, who despise you everywhere.
verses.textEnNlt: But now your greater wickedness has been exposed to all the world, and you are the one who is scorned—by Edom and all her neighbors and by Philistia.
verses.textEnNasb: before your wickedness was uncovered, so now you have become the disgrace of the daughters of Edom and of all who are around her, of the daughters of the Philistines—those surrounding you who despise you.
verses.textEn: before your wickedness was uncovered. Even so, you are now scorned by the daughters of Edom and all her neighbors and the daughters of the Philistines—all those around you who despise you.

verses.textZh: 你要承担你那些淫乱和可憎之事的后果。这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要承担你那些淫乱和可憎之事的后果。这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而我要追念在你幼年时与你所立的约，也要与你立定永约。
verses.textEnNiv: You will bear the consequences of your lewdness and your detestable practices, declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: You bear the penalty of your lewdness and your abominations, declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: You have paid for your lewdness and your abominations," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: This is your punishment for all your lewdness and detestable sins, says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: You have suffered the penalty of your outrageous sin and abominations," the Lord declares.
verses.textEn: You will bear the consequences of your lewdness and your detestable practices, declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: 主耶和华这样说：你这藐视誓言、背弃盟约的，我必照着你所行的报应你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主耶和华这样说：你这藐视誓言、背弃盟约的，我必照着你所行的报应你。
verses.textZhCuv: 你接待你姊姊和你妹妹的时候，你要追念你所行的，自觉惭愧；并且我要将她们赐你为女儿，却不是按着前约。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I will deal with you as you deserve, because you have despised my oath by breaking the covenant.
verses.textEnEsv: "For thus says the Lord God : I will deal with you as you have done, you who have despised the oath in breaking the covenant,
verses.textEnNkjv: For thus says the Lord God: "I will deal with you as you have done, who despised the oath by breaking the covenant.
verses.textEnNlt: "Now this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I will give you what you deserve, for you have taken your solemn vows lightly by breaking your covenant.
verses.textEnNasb: For this is what the Lord God says: "I will also do with you as you have done, you who have despised the oath by breaking the covenant.
verses.textEn: " ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I will deal with you as you deserve, because you have despised my oath by breaking the covenant.

verses.textZh: "‘但我仍要记念在你年幼的时候与你所立的约，也要与你坚立永远的约。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘但我仍要记念在你年幼的时候与你所立的约，也要与你坚立永远的约。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要坚定与你所立的约（你就知道我是耶和华），
verses.textEnNiv: Yet I will remember the covenant I made with you in the days of your youth, and I will establish an everlasting covenant with you.
verses.textEnEsv: yet I will remember my covenant with you in the days of your youth, and I will establish for you an everlasting covenant.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Nevertheless I will remember My covenant with you in the days of your youth, and I will establish an everlasting covenant with you.
verses.textEnNlt: Yet I will remember the covenant I made with you when you were young, and I will establish an everlasting covenant with you.

verses.textEn: Yet I will remember the covenant I made with you in the days of your youth, and I will establish an everlasting covenant with you.

verses.textZh: 你接纳你姊姊和你妹妹回来的时候，你就会想起你所行的，并要自觉惭愧；我要把她们赐给你作女儿，但这并不是出于我与你所立的约。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你接纳你姊姊和你妹妹回来的时候，你就会想起你所行的，并要自觉惭愧；我要把她们赐给你作女儿，但这并不是出于我与你所立的约。
verses.textZhCuv: 好使你在我赦免你一切所行的时候，心里追念，自觉抱愧，又因你的羞辱就不再开口。这是主耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then you will remember your ways and be ashamed when you receive your sisters, both those who are older than you and those who are younger. I will give them to you as daughters, but not on the basis of my covenant with you.
verses.textEnEsv: Then you will remember your ways and be ashamed when you take your sisters, both your elder and your younger, and I give them to you as daughters, but not on account of the covenant with you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then you will remember your ways and be ashamed, when you receive your older and your younger sisters; for I will give them to you for daughters, but not because of My covenant with you.
verses.textEnNlt: Then you will remember with shame all the evil you have done. I will make your sisters, Samaria and Sodom, to be your daughters, even though they are not part of our covenant.
verses.textEnNasb: Then you will remember your ways and be ashamed when you receive your sisters, both your older and your younger; and I will give them to you as daughters, but not because of your covenant.
verses.textEn: Then you will remember your ways and be ashamed when you receive your sisters, both those who are older than you and those who are younger. I will give them to you as daughters, but not on the basis of my covenant with you.

verses.textEn: So I will establish my covenant with you, and you will know that I am the Lord .

verses.textZhCnvs: 好使你在我赦免你所行的一切时，就会回想，自觉惭愧，并且因你所受的羞辱不再开口。这是主耶和华的宣告。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 好使你在我赦免你所行的一切时，就会回想，自觉惭愧，并且因你所受的羞辱不再开口。这是主耶和华的宣告。’"
verses.textEnNiv: Then, when I make atonement for you for all you have done, you will remember and be ashamed and never again open your mouth because of your humiliation, declares the Sovereign Lord .’ "
verses.textEnEsv: that you may remember and be confounded, and never open your mouth again because of your shame, when I atone for you for all that you have done, declares the Lord God ."
verses.textEnNkjv: that you may remember and be ashamed, and never open your mouth anymore because of your shame, when I provide you an atonement for all you have done," says the Lord God.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: You will remember your sins and cover your mouth in silent shame when I forgive you of all that you have done. I, the Sovereign Lord , have spoken!"
verses.textEnNasb: so that you may remember and be ashamed, and not open your mouth again because of your disgrace, when I have forgiven you for all that you have done," the Lord God declares.
verses.textEn: Then, when I make atonement for you for all you have done, you will remember and be ashamed and never again open your mouth because of your humiliation, declares the Sovereign Lord .’ "

verses.textZh: 说：‘主耶和华这样说：有一只大鹰，翅膀大，翎毛长，羽毛丰富，彩色缤纷，来到黎巴嫩，把香柏树的树梢取去；
verses.textZhCnvs: 说：‘主耶和华这样说：有一只大鹰，翅膀大，翎毛长，羽毛丰富，彩色缤纷，来到黎巴嫩，把香柏树的树梢取去；
verses.textZhCuv: 说主耶和华如此说：有一大鹰，翅膀大，翎毛长，羽毛丰满，彩色俱备，来到黎巴嫩，将香柏树梢拧去，
verses.textEnNiv: Say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: A great eagle with powerful wings, long feathers and full plumage of varied colors came to Lebanon. Taking hold of the top of a cedar,
verses.textEnEsv: say, Thus says the Lord God : A great eagle with great wings and long pinions, rich in plumage of many colors, came to Lebanon and took the top of the cedar.
verses.textEnNkjv: and say, ‘Thus says the Lord God: "A great eagle with large wings and long pinions, Full of feathers of various colors, Came to Lebanon And took from the cedar the highest branch.
verses.textEnNlt: Give them this message from the Sovereign Lord : "A great eagle with broad wings and long feathers, covered with many-colored plumage, came to Lebanon. He seized the top of a cedar tree
verses.textEnNasb: saying, ‘This is what the Lord God says: "A great eagle with great wings, long pinions, and a full plumage of many colors came to Lebanon and took away the top of the cedar.
verses.textEn: Say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: A great eagle with powerful wings, long feathers and full plumage of varied colors came to Lebanon. Taking hold of the top of a cedar,

verses.textZh: 牠啄断树顶的嫩枝，把它带到贸易之地，栽种在商人的城里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠啄断树顶的嫩枝，把它带到贸易之地，栽种在商人的城里。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是折去香柏树尽尖的嫩枝，叼到贸易之地，放在买卖城中；
verses.textEnNiv: he broke off its topmost shoot and carried it away to a land of merchants, where he planted it in a city of traders.
verses.textEnEsv: He broke off the topmost of its young twigs and carried it to a land of trade and set it in a city of merchants.
verses.textEnNkjv: He cropped off its topmost young twig And carried it to a land of trade; He set it in a city of merchants.
verses.textEnNlt: and plucked off its highest branch. He carried it away to a city filled with merchants. He planted it in a city of traders.
verses.textEnNasb: He broke off the topmost of its young twigs and brought it to a land of merchants; he set it in a city of traders.
verses.textEn: he broke off its topmost shoot and carried it away to a land of merchants, where he planted it in a city of traders.

verses.textZh: 牠又把以色列地的种子取去，栽种在肥沃的地土、水流的旁边，好象栽种柳树一样；

verses.textZhCuv: 又将以色列地的枝子栽于肥田里，插在大水旁，如插柳树，
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘He took one of the seedlings of the land and put it in fertile soil. He planted it like a willow by abundant water,
verses.textEnEsv: Then he took of the seed of the land and planted it in fertile soil. He placed it beside abundant waters. He set it like a willow twig,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he took some of the seed of the land And planted it in a fertile field; He placed it by abundant waters And set it like a willow tree.
verses.textEnNlt: He also took a seedling from the land and planted it in fertile soil. He placed it beside a broad river, where it could grow like a willow tree.
verses.textEnNasb: He also took from the seed of the land and planted it in fertile soil, a meadow beside abundant waters; he set it like a willow.
verses.textEn: " ‘He took one of the seedlings of the land and put it in fertile soil. He planted it like a willow by abundant water,

verses.textZh: 它生长起来，成了一棵矮小而蔓延的葡萄树；树上的枝子向着那鹰，树根在牠以下。这样，它就成了一棵葡萄树，生出枝子，长出嫩芽。
verses.textZhCnvs: 它生长起来，成了一棵矮小而蔓延的葡萄树；树上的枝子向着那鹰，树根在牠以下。这样，它就成了一棵葡萄树，生出枝子，长出嫩芽。
verses.textZhCuv: 就渐渐生长，成为蔓延矮小的葡萄树。其枝转向那鹰，其根在鹰以下，于是成了葡萄树，生出枝子，发出小枝。
verses.textEnNiv: and it sprouted and became a low, spreading vine. Its branches turned toward him, but its roots remained under it. So it became a vine and produced branches and put out leafy boughs.
verses.textEnEsv: and it sprouted and became a low spreading vine, and its branches turned toward him, and its roots remained where it stood. So it became a vine and produced branches and put out boughs.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it grew and became a spreading vine of low stature; Its branches turned toward him, But its roots were under it. So it became a vine, Brought forth branches, And put forth shoots.
verses.textEnNlt: It took root there and grew into a low, spreading vine. Its branches turned up toward the eagle, and its roots grew down into the ground. It produced strong branches and put out shoots.
verses.textEnNasb: Then it sprouted and became a low, spreading vine with its branches turned toward him, but its roots remained under it. So it became a vine and produced shoots and sent out branches.
verses.textEn: and it sprouted and became a low, spreading vine. Its branches turned toward him, but its roots remained under it. So it became a vine and produced branches and put out leafy boughs.

verses.textZh: "‘另有一只大鹰，翅膀大，羽毛多；这葡萄树从它栽种的苗床上，把树根向这鹰弯过去，又向这鹰长出枝子，好得牠的浇灌。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘另有一只大鹰，翅膀大，羽毛多；这葡萄树从它栽种的苗床上，把树根向这鹰弯过去，又向这鹰长出枝子，好得牠的浇灌。
verses.textZhCuv: 「又有一大鹰，翅膀大，羽毛多。这葡萄树从栽种的畦中向这鹰弯过根来，发出枝子，好得它的浇灌。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘But there was another great eagle with powerful wings and full plumage. The vine now sent out its roots toward him from the plot where it was planted and stretched out its branches to him for water.
verses.textEnEsv: "And there was another great eagle with great wings and much plumage, and behold, this vine bent its roots toward him and shot forth its branches toward him from the bed where it was planted, that he might water it.
verses.textEnNkjv: "But there was another great eagle with large wings and many feathers; And behold, this vine bent its roots toward him, And stretched its branches toward him, From the garden terrace where it had been planted, That he might water it.
verses.textEnNlt: But then another great eagle came with broad wings and full plumage. So the vine now sent its roots and branches toward him for water,
verses.textEnNasb: "But there was another great eagle with great wings and much plumage; and behold, this vine turned its roots toward him and sent out its branches toward him from the beds where it was planted, so that he might water it.
verses.textEn: " ‘But there was another great eagle with powerful wings and full plumage. The vine now sent out its roots toward him from the plot where it was planted and stretched out its branches to him for water.

verses.textZh: 其实，这树早已栽种在肥沃的地土、水流的旁边，可以长枝子、结果子，成为佳美的葡萄树。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 其实，这树早已栽种在肥沃的地土、水流的旁边，可以长枝子、结果子，成为佳美的葡萄树。’
verses.textZhCuv: 这树栽于肥田多水的旁边，好生枝子，结果子，成为佳美的葡萄树。
verses.textEnNiv: It had been planted in good soil by abundant water so that it would produce branches, bear fruit and become a splendid vine.’
verses.textEnEsv: It had been planted on good soil by abundant waters, that it might produce branches and bear fruit and become a noble vine.
verses.textEnNkjv: It was planted in good soil by many waters, To bring forth branches, bear fruit, And become a majestic vine." ’
verses.textEnNlt: even though it was already planted in good soil and had plenty of water so it could grow into a splendid vine and produce rich leaves and luscious fruit.
verses.textEnNasb: It was planted in good soil beside abundant waters, so that it would produce branches and bear fruit, and become a splendid vine." ’
verses.textEn: It had been planted in good soil by abundant water so that it would produce branches, bear fruit and become a splendid vine.’

verses.textZh: 你要说：‘主耶和华这样说：这葡萄树怎能茂盛呢？鹰不是要拔出它的根来，啄光它的果子，使它和它长出的一切嫩叶都枯干吗？其实，要把它连根拔起，并不需要很多人或很大的气力。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要说：‘主耶和华这样说：这葡萄树怎能茂盛呢？鹰不是要拔出它的根来，啄光它的果子，使它和它长出的一切嫩叶都枯干吗？其实，要把它连根拔起，并不需要很多人或很大的气力。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要说，主耶和华如此说：这葡萄树岂能发旺呢？鹰岂不拔出它的根来，芟除它的果子，使它枯干，使它发的嫩叶都枯干了吗？也不用大力和多民，就拔出它的根来。
verses.textEnNiv: "Say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Will it thrive? Will it not be uprooted and stripped of its fruit so that it withers? All its new growth will wither. It will not take a strong arm or many people to pull it up by the roots.
verses.textEnEsv: "Say, Thus says the Lord God : Will it thrive? Will he not pull up its roots and cut off its fruit, so that it withers, so that all its fresh sprouting leaves wither? It will not take a strong arm or many people to pull it from its roots.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Say, ‘Thus says the Lord God: "Will it thrive? Will he not pull up its roots, Cut off its fruit, And leave it to wither? All of its spring leaves will wither, And no great power or many people Will be needed to pluck it up by its roots.
verses.textEnNlt: "So now the Sovereign Lord asks: Will this vine grow and prosper? No! I will pull it up, roots and all! I will cut off its fruit and let its leaves wither and die. I will pull it up easily without a strong arm or a large army.
verses.textEnNasb: Say, ‘This is what the Lord God says: "Will it thrive? Will he not pull up its roots and cut off its fruit, so that it withers—so that all its sprouting shoots wither? And neither by great strength nor by many people can it be raised from its roots again.
verses.textEn: "Say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Will it thrive? Will it not be uprooted and stripped of its fruit so that it withers? All its new growth will wither. It will not take a strong arm or many people to pull it up by the roots.

verses.textZh: 看哪！葡萄树被栽种了，但它能发旺吗？东风吹袭它的时候，它不是必然枯干吗？它必在生长的苗床上枯干。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！葡萄树被栽种了，但它能发旺吗？东风吹袭它的时候，它不是必然枯干吗？它必在生长的苗床上枯干。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 葡萄树虽然栽种，岂能发旺呢？一经东风，岂不全然枯干吗？必在生长的畦中枯干了。」
verses.textEnNiv: It has been planted, but will it thrive? Will it not wither completely when the east wind strikes it—wither away in the plot where it grew?’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, it is planted; will it thrive? Will it not utterly wither when the east wind strikes it—wither away on the bed where it sprouted?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, itis planted, Will it thrive? Will it not utterly wither when the east wind touches it? It will wither in the garden terrace where it grew." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: But when the vine is transplanted, will it thrive? No, it will wither away when the east wind blows against it. It will die in the same good soil where it had grown so well."
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, though it is planted, will it thrive? Will it not completely wither as soon as the east wind strikes it—wither on the beds where it grew?" ’ "
verses.textEn: It has been planted, but will it thrive? Will it not wither completely when the east wind strikes it—wither away in the plot where it grew?’ "

verses.textZh: "你要对那叛逆的民族说：‘你们不知道这些事是甚么意思吗？’你要告诉他们：‘看哪！巴比伦王曾到耶路撒冷来，把其中的王和众领袖掳去，带他们到巴比伦那里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要对那叛逆的民族说：‘你们不知道这些事是甚么意思吗？’你要告诉他们：‘看哪！巴比伦王曾到耶路撒冷来，把其中的王和众领袖掳去，带他们到巴比伦那里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你对那悖逆之家说：你们不知道这些事是什么意思吗？你要告诉他们说，巴比伦王曾到耶路撒冷，将其中的君王和首领带到巴比伦自己那里去。
verses.textEnNiv: "Say to this rebellious people, ‘Do you not know what these things mean?’ Say to them: ‘The king of Babylon went to Jerusalem and carried off her king and her nobles, bringing them back with him to Babylon.
verses.textEnEsv: "Say now to the rebellious house, Do you not know what these things mean? Tell them, behold, the king of Babylon came to Jerusalem, and took her king and her princes and brought them to him to Babylon.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Say now to the rebellious house: ‘Do you not know what these thingsmean?’ Tell them, ‘Indeed the king of Babylon went to Jerusalem and took its king and princes, and led them with him to Babylon.
verses.textEnNlt: "Say to these rebels of Israel: Don’t you understand the meaning of this riddle of the eagles? The king of Babylon came to Jerusalem, took away her king and princes, and brought them to Babylon.
verses.textEnNasb: "Say now to the rebellious house, ‘Do you not know what these things mean?’ Say, ‘Behold, the king of Babylon came to Jerusalem, took its king and leaders, and brought them to him in Babylon.
verses.textEn: "Say to this rebellious people, ‘Do you not know what these things mean?’ Say to them: ‘The king of Babylon went to Jerusalem and carried off her king and her nobles, bringing them back with him to Babylon.

verses.textZh: 他从以色列王室后裔中选出一人，与他立约，叫他起誓，并且把国中那些有势力的人掳去，

verses.textEnEsv: that the kingdom might be humble and not lift itself up, and keep his covenant that it might stand.
verses.textEnNkjv: that the kingdom might be brought low and not lift itself up, but that by keeping his covenant it might stand.

verses.textEn: so that the kingdom would be brought low, unable to rise again, surviving only by keeping his treaty.

verses.textZh: 可是这人背叛了巴比伦王，差遣使者到埃及去，要得战马和大军。他能亨通吗？行这样事的人，怎能逃脱呢？他破坏条约，怎能逃脱呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是这人背叛了巴比伦王，差遣使者到埃及去，要得战马和大军。他能亨通吗？行这样事的人，怎能逃脱呢？他破坏条约，怎能逃脱呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 他却背叛巴比伦王，打发使者往埃及去，要他们给他马匹和多民。他岂能亨通呢？行这样事的人岂能逃脱呢？他背约岂能逃脱呢？
verses.textEnNiv: But the king rebelled against him by sending his envoys to Egypt to get horses and a large army. Will he succeed? Will he who does such things escape? Will he break the treaty and yet escape?
verses.textEnEsv: But he rebelled against him by sending his ambassadors to Egypt, that they might give him horses and a large army. Will he thrive? Can one escape who does such things? Can he break the covenant and yet escape?
verses.textEnNkjv: But he rebelled against him by sending his ambassadors to Egypt, that they might give him horses and many people. Will he prosper? Will he who does such things escape? Can he break a covenant and still be delivered?
verses.textEnNlt: "Nevertheless, this man of Israel’s royal family rebelled against Babylon, sending ambassadors to Egypt to request a great army and many horses. Can Israel break her sworn treaties like that and get away with it?
verses.textEnNasb: But he revolted against him by sending his messengers to Egypt so that they might give him horses and many troops. Will he succeed? Will he who does these things escape? Can he indeed break the covenant and escape?
verses.textEn: But the king rebelled against him by sending his envoys to Egypt to get horses and a large army. Will he succeed? Will he who does such things escape? Will he break the treaty and yet escape?

verses.textZh: 我指着我的永生起誓：他藐视了自己所起的誓，背弃了与王所立的约，因此他必死在巴比伦，就是那立他作王的巴比伦王的国家。这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我指着我的永生起誓：他藐视了自己所起的誓，背弃了与王所立的约，因此他必死在巴比伦，就是那立他作王的巴比伦王的国家。这是耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 他轻看向王所起的誓，背弃王与他所立的约。主耶和华说：我指着我的永生起誓，他定要死在立他作王、巴比伦王的京都。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘As surely as I live, declares the Sovereign Lord , he shall die in Babylon, in the land of the king who put him on the throne, whose oath he despised and whose treaty he broke.
verses.textEnEsv: "As I live, declares the Lord God , surely in the place where the king dwells who made him king, whose oath he despised, and whose covenant with him he broke, in Babylon he shall die.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘As I live,’ says the Lord God, ‘surely in the place where the king dwells who made him king, whose oath he despised and whose covenant he broke—with him in the midst of Babylon he shall die.
verses.textEnNlt: No! For as surely as I live, says the Sovereign Lord , the king of Israel will die in Babylon, the land of the king who put him in power and whose treaty he disregarded and broke.
verses.textEnNasb: As I live,’ declares the Lord God, ‘In the country of the king who put him on the throne, whose oath he despised and whose covenant he broke, in Babylon he shall certainly die.
verses.textEn: " ‘As surely as I live, declares the Sovereign Lord , he shall die in Babylon, in the land of the king who put him on the throne, whose oath he despised and whose treaty he broke.

verses.textZh: 敌人建造围城的高墙，筑起攻城土垒要剪除多人的时候，法老率领大军和大队人马，还是不能帮助他作战。
verses.textZhCnvs: 敌人建造围城的高墙，筑起攻城土垒要剪除多人的时候，法老率领大军和大队人马，还是不能帮助他作战。
verses.textZhCuv: 敌人筑垒造台，与他打仗的时候，为要剪除多人，法老虽领大军队和大群众，还是不能帮助他。
verses.textEnNiv: Pharaoh with his mighty army and great horde will be of no help to him in war, when ramps are built and siege works erected to destroy many lives.
verses.textEnEsv: Pharaoh with his mighty army and great company will not help him in war, when mounds are cast up and siege walls built to cut off many lives.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nor will Pharaoh with his mighty army and great company do anything in the war, when they heap up a siege mound and build a wall to cut off many persons.
verses.textEnNlt: Pharaoh and all his mighty army will fail to help Israel when the king of Babylon lays siege to Jerusalem again and destroys many lives.
verses.textEnNasb: Pharaoh with his mighty army and great contingent will not help him in the war, when they pile up assault ramps and build siege walls to eliminate many lives.
verses.textEn: Pharaoh with his mighty army and great horde will be of no help to him in war, when ramps are built and siege works erected to destroy many lives.

verses.textZh: 他藐视誓言，背弃条约；他已宣誓效忠，却又行了这一切事，所以他必不能逃脱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他藐视誓言，背弃条约；他已宣誓效忠，却又行了这一切事，所以他必不能逃脱。
verses.textZhCuv: 他轻看誓言，背弃盟约，已经投降，却又做这一切的事，他必不能逃脱。」
verses.textEnNiv: He despised the oath by breaking the covenant. Because he had given his hand in pledge and yet did all these things, he shall not escape.
verses.textEnEsv: He despised the oath in breaking the covenant, and behold, he gave his hand and did all these things; he shall not escape.
verses.textEnNkjv: Since he despised the oath by breaking the covenant, and in fact gave his hand and still did all these things, he shall not escape.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: For the king of Israel disregarded his treaty and broke it after swearing to obey; therefore, he will not escape.
verses.textEnNasb: Now he despised the oath by breaking the covenant, and behold, he pledged his allegiance, yet did all these things; he shall not escape.’ "
verses.textEn: He despised the oath by breaking the covenant. Because he had given his hand in pledge and yet did all these things, he shall not escape.

verses.textZh: 因此主耶和华这样说：我指着我的永生起誓：他既然藐视我的誓言，背弃我的约，我必使这罪归到他的头上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此主耶和华这样说：我指着我的永生起誓：他既然藐视我的誓言，背弃我的约，我必使这罪归到他的头上。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以主耶和华如此说：「我指着我的永生起誓，他既轻看指我所起的誓，背弃指我所立的约，我必要使这罪归在他头上。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: As surely as I live, I will repay him for despising my oath and breaking my covenant.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore thus says the Lord God : As I live, surely it is my oath that he despised, and my covenant that he broke. I will return it upon his head.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore thus says the Lord God: "As I live, surely My oath which he despised, and My covenant which he broke, I will recompense on his own head.
verses.textEnNlt: "So this is what the Sovereign Lord says: As surely as I live, I will punish him for breaking my covenant and disregarding the solemn oath he made in my name.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, this is what the Lord God says: "As I live, My oath which he despised and My covenant which he broke, I will certainly inflict on his head.
verses.textEn: " ‘Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: As surely as I live, I will repay him for despising my oath and breaking my covenant.

verses.textZh: 我要把我的网撒在他身上，他必在我的网罗中被捕获；我要把他带到巴比伦去，并且要在那里因他对我不忠的罪审判他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要把我的网撒在他身上，他必在我的网罗中被捕获；我要把他带到巴比伦去，并且要在那里因他对我不忠的罪审判他。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必将我的网撒在他身上，他必在我的网罗中缠住。我必带他到巴比伦，并要在那里因他干犯我的罪刑罚他。
verses.textEnNiv: I will spread my net for him, and he will be caught in my snare. I will bring him to Babylon and execute judgment on him there because he was unfaithful to me.
verses.textEnEsv: I will spread my net over him, and he shall be taken in my snare, and I will bring him to Babylon and enter into judgment with him there for the treachery he has committed against me.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will spread My net over him, and he shall be taken in My snare. I will bring him to Babylon and try him there for the treason which he committed against Me.
verses.textEnNlt: I will throw my net over him and capture him in my snare. I will bring him to Babylon and put him on trial for this treason against me.
verses.textEnNasb: And I will spread My net over him, and he will be caught in My net. Then I will bring him to Babylon and enter into judgment with him there regarding the unfaithful act which he has committed against Me.
verses.textEn: I will spread my net for him, and he will be caught in my snare. I will bring him to Babylon and execute judgment on him there because he was unfaithful to me.

verses.textZh: 他军中所有的精兵 ，都必倒在刀下；剩下的也必分散到四方；你们就知道说这话的是我耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他军中所有的精兵 ，都必倒在刀下；剩下的也必分散到四方；你们就知道说这话的是我耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的一切军队，凡逃跑的，都必倒在刀下；所剩下的，也必分散四方 。你们就知道说这话的是我－耶和华。」
verses.textEnNiv: All his choice troops will fall by the sword, and the survivors will be scattered to the winds. Then you will know that I the Lord have spoken.
verses.textEnEsv: And all the pick of his troops shall fall by the sword, and the survivors shall be scattered to every wind, and you shall know that I am the Lord ; I have spoken."
verses.textEnNkjv: All his fugitives with all his troops shall fall by the sword, and those who remain shall be scattered to every wind; and you shall know that I, the Lord, have spoken."
verses.textEnNlt: And all his best warriors will be killed in battle, and those who survive will be scattered to the four winds. Then you will know that I, the Lord , have spoken.
verses.textEnNasb: All the choice men in all his troops will fall by the sword, and the survivors will be scattered to every wind; and you will know that I, the Lord, have spoken."
verses.textEn: All his choice troops will fall by the sword, and the survivors will be scattered to the winds. Then you will know that I the Lord have spoken.

verses.textZh: "‘主耶和华这样说：我要从高大香柏树的树梢上取去一根树枝，把它栽上；我要从树顶的嫩枝中折下一根枝子，把它栽种在高耸的山上；
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘主耶和华这样说：我要从高大香柏树的树梢上取去一根树枝，把它栽上；我要从树顶的嫩枝中折下一根枝子，把它栽种在高耸的山上；
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华如此说：「我要将香柏树梢拧去栽上，就是从尽尖的嫩枝中折一嫩枝，栽于极高的山上；
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I myself will take a shoot from the very top of a cedar and plant it; I will break off a tender sprig from its topmost shoots and plant it on a high and lofty mountain.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord God : "I myself will take a sprig from the lofty top of the cedar and will set it out. I will break off from the topmost of its young twigs a tender one, and I myself will plant it on a high and lofty mountain.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord God: "I will take also one of the highest branches of the high cedar and set it out. I will crop off from the topmost of its young twigs a tender one, and will plant it on a high and prominent mountain.
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I will take a branch from the top of a tall cedar, and I will plant it on the top of Israel’s highest mountain.
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord God says: "I will also take a sprig from the lofty top of the cedar and set it out; I will break off from the topmost of its young twigs a tender one, and I will plant it on a high and lofty mountain.
verses.textEn: " ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I myself will take a shoot from the very top of a cedar and plant it; I will break off a tender sprig from its topmost shoots and plant it on a high and lofty mountain.

verses.textZh: 我要把它栽种在以色列的高山上，它要长出枝子，结出果子，成为佳美的香柏树；各种各类的飞鸟都必在树下栖宿，就是栖宿在枝子的荫下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要把它栽种在以色列的高山上，它要长出枝子，结出果子，成为佳美的香柏树；各种各类的飞鸟都必在树下栖宿，就是栖宿在枝子的荫下。
verses.textZhCuv: 在以色列高处的山栽上。它就生枝子，结果子，成为佳美的香柏树，各类飞鸟都必宿在其下，就是宿在枝子的荫下。
verses.textEnNiv: On the mountain heights of Israel I will plant it; it will produce branches and bear fruit and become a splendid cedar. Birds of every kind will nest in it; they will find shelter in the shade of its branches.
verses.textEnEsv: On the mountain height of Israel will I plant it, that it may bear branches and produce fruit and become a noble cedar. And under it will dwell every kind of bird; in the shade of its branches birds of every sort will nest.
verses.textEnNkjv: On the mountain height of Israel I will plant it; and it will bring forth boughs, and bear fruit, and be a majestic cedar. Under it will dwell birds of every sort; in the shadow of its branches they will dwell.
verses.textEnNlt: It will become a majestic cedar, sending forth its branches and producing seed. Birds of every sort will nest in it, finding shelter in the shade of its branches.
verses.textEnNasb: On the high mountain of Israel I will plant it, so that it may bring forth branches and bear fruit, and become a stately cedar. And birds of every kind will nest under it; they will nest in the shade of its branches.
verses.textEn: On the mountain heights of Israel I will plant it; it will produce branches and bear fruit and become a splendid cedar. Birds of every kind will nest in it; they will find shelter in the shade of its branches.

verses.textZh: 田野所有的树木都必知道我耶和华使高大的树矮小，矮小的树高大；使青绿的树枯干，枯干的树茂盛。我耶和华怎样说了，就必怎样行。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 田野所有的树木都必知道我耶和华使高大的树矮小，矮小的树高大；使青绿的树枯干，枯干的树茂盛。我耶和华怎样说了，就必怎样行。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 田野的树木都必知道我－耶和华使高树矮小，矮树高大；青树枯干，枯树发旺。我－耶和华如此说，也如此行了。」
verses.textEnNiv: All the trees of the forest will know that I the Lord bring down the tall tree and make the low tree grow tall. I dry up the green tree and make the dry tree flourish. " ‘I the Lord have spoken, and I will do it.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And all the trees of the field shall know that I am the Lord ; I bring low the high tree, and make high the low tree, dry up the green tree, and make the dry tree flourish. I am the Lord ; I have spoken, and I will do it."
verses.textEnNkjv: And all the trees of the field shall know that I, the Lord, have brought down the high tree and exalted the low tree, dried up the green tree and made the dry tree flourish; I, the Lord, have spoken and have done it."
verses.textEnNlt: And all the trees will know that it is I, the Lord , who cuts the tall tree down and makes the short tree grow tall. It is I who makes the green tree wither and gives the dead tree new life. I, the Lord , have spoken, and I will do what I said!"
verses.textEnNasb: All the trees of the field will know that I am the Lord; I bring down the high tree, exalt the low tree, dry up the green tree, and make the dry tree flourish. I am the Lord; I have spoken, and I will perform it."
verses.textEn: All the trees of the forest will know that I the Lord bring down the tall tree and make the low tree grow tall. I dry up the green tree and make the dry tree flourish. " ‘I the Lord have spoken, and I will do it.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnNkjv: The word of the Lord came to me again, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then another message came to me from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: Then the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: The word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: "论到以色列地，你们为甚么引用这俗语说‘父亲吃了酸葡萄，儿子的牙酸倒了’呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: "论到以色列地，你们为甚么引用这俗语说‘父亲吃了酸葡萄，儿子的牙酸倒了’呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们在以色列地怎么用这俗语说『父亲吃了酸葡萄，儿子的牙酸倒了』呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: "What do you people mean by quoting this proverb about the land of Israel: " ‘The parents eat sour grapes, and the children’s teeth are set on edge’?
verses.textEnEsv: "What do you mean by repeating this proverb concerning the land of Israel, ‘The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children’s teeth are set on edge’?
verses.textEnNkjv: "What do you mean when you use this proverb concerning the land of Israel, saying: ‘The fathers have eaten sour grapes, And the children’s teeth are set on edge’?
verses.textEnNlt: "Why do you quote this proverb concerning the land of Israel: ‘The parents have eaten sour grapes, but their children’s mouths pucker at the taste’?
verses.textEnNasb: "What do you people mean by using this proverb about the land of Israel, saying, ‘The fathers eat sour grapes, But it is the children’s teeth that have become blunt’?
verses.textEn: "What do you people mean by quoting this proverb about the land of Israel: " ‘The parents eat sour grapes, and the children’s teeth are set on edge’?

verses.textZh: 我指着我的永生起誓：你们在以色列中必不再引用这俗语了。这是主耶和华的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我指着我的永生起誓：你们在以色列中必不再引用这俗语了。这是主耶和华的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华说：「我指着我的永生起誓，你们在以色列中，必不再有用这俗语的因由。
verses.textEnNiv: "As surely as I live, declares the Sovereign Lord , you will no longer quote this proverb in Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: As I live, declares the Lord God , this proverb shall no more be used by you in Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: "As I live," says the Lord God, "you shall no longer use this proverb in Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: As surely as I live, says the Sovereign Lord , you will not quote this proverb anymore in Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: As I live," declares the Lord God, "you certainly are not going to use this proverb in Israel anymore.
verses.textEn: "As surely as I live, declares the Sovereign Lord , you will no longer quote this proverb in Israel.

verses.textZh: 看哪！所有的人都是属我的，作父亲的怎样属我，作儿子的也怎样属我，唯独犯罪的，才会灭亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！所有的人都是属我的，作父亲的怎样属我，作儿子的也怎样属我，唯独犯罪的，才会灭亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，世人都是属我的；为父的怎样属我，为子的也照样属我；犯罪的，他必死亡。
verses.textEnNiv: For everyone belongs to me, the parent as well as the child—both alike belong to me. The one who sins is the one who will die.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, all souls are mine; the soul of the father as well as the soul of the son is mine: the soul who sins shall die.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Behold, all souls are Mine; The soul of the father As well as the soul of the son is Mine; The soul who sins shall die.
verses.textEnNlt: For all people are mine to judge—both parents and children alike. And this is my rule: The person who sins is the one who will die.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, all souls are Mine; the soul of the father as well as the soul of the son is Mine. The soul who sins will die.
verses.textEn: For everyone belongs to me, the parent as well as the child—both alike belong to me. The one who sins is the one who will die.

verses.textZh: "人若是公义，又行公道和正直的事：
verses.textZhCnvs: "人若是公义，又行公道和正直的事：
verses.textZhCuv: 「人若是公义，且行正直与合理的事：
verses.textEnNiv: "Suppose there is a righteous man who does what is just and right.
verses.textEnEsv: "If a man is righteous and does what is just and right—
verses.textEnNkjv: But if a man is just And does what is lawful and right;
verses.textEnNlt: "Suppose a certain man is righteous and does what is just and right.
verses.textEnNasb: "But if a man is righteous and practices justice and righteousness,
verses.textEn: "Suppose there is a righteous man who does what is just and right.

verses.textZh: 他不在山上吃祭肉，眼目也不仰望以色列家的偶像，不玷污邻舍的妻子，不亲近在经期中的妇人；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他不在山上吃祭肉，眼目也不仰望以色列家的偶像，不玷污邻舍的妻子，不亲近在经期中的妇人；
verses.textZhCuv: 未曾在山上吃过祭偶像之物，未曾仰望以色列家的偶像，未曾玷污邻舍的妻，未曾在妇人的经期内亲近她，
verses.textEnNiv: He does not eat at the mountain shrines or look to the idols of Israel. He does not defile his neighbor’s wife or have sexual relations with a woman during her period.
verses.textEnEsv: if he does not eat upon the mountains or lift up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, does not defile his neighbor’s wife or approach a woman in her time of menstrual impurity,
verses.textEnNkjv: If he has not eaten on the mountains, Nor lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, Nor defiled his neighbor’s wife, Nor approached a woman during her impurity;
verses.textEnNlt: He does not feast in the mountains before Israel’s idols or worship them. He does not commit adultery or have intercourse with a woman during her menstrual period.
verses.textEnNasb: if he does not eat at the mountain shrines or raise his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, or defile his neighbor’s wife or approach a woman during her menstrual period—
verses.textEn: He does not eat at the mountain shrines or look to the idols of Israel. He does not defile his neighbor’s wife or have sexual relations with a woman during her period.

verses.textZh: 不欺压任何人，把欠债人的抵押归还；他不抢夺人的物件，却把自己的食物给饥饿的人，把衣服给赤身的人穿著；
verses.textZhCnvs: 不欺压任何人，把欠债人的抵押归还；他不抢夺人的物件，却把自己的食物给饥饿的人，把衣服给赤身的人穿著；
verses.textZhCuv: 未曾亏负人，乃将欠债之人的当头还给他；未曾抢夺人的物件，却将食物给饥饿的人吃，将衣服给赤身的人穿；
verses.textEnNiv: He does not oppress anyone, but returns what he took in pledge for a loan. He does not commit robbery but gives his food to the hungry and provides clothing for the naked.
verses.textEnEsv: does not oppress anyone, but restores to the debtor his pledge, commits no robbery, gives his bread to the hungry and covers the naked with a garment,
verses.textEnNkjv: If he has not oppressed anyone, But has restored to the debtor his pledge; Has robbed no one by violence, But has given his bread to the hungry And covered the naked with clothing;
verses.textEnNlt: He is a merciful creditor, not keeping the items given as security by poor debtors. He does not rob the poor but instead gives food to the hungry and provides clothes for the needy.
verses.textEnNasb: and if a man does not oppress anyone, but restores to the debtor his pledge, does not commit robbery, but gives his bread to the hungry and covers the naked with clothing,
verses.textEn: He does not oppress anyone, but returns what he took in pledge for a loan. He does not commit robbery but gives his food to the hungry and provides clothing for the naked.

verses.textZh: 他借东西给人不取利息，也不多要，他使自己的手远离罪恶，在人与人之间施行诚实的判断；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他借东西给人不取利息，也不多要，他使自己的手远离罪恶，在人与人之间施行诚实的判断；
verses.textZhCuv: 未曾向借钱的弟兄取利，也未曾向借粮的弟兄多要，缩手不作罪孽，在两人之间，按至理判断；
verses.textEnNiv: He does not lend to them at interest or take a profit from them. He withholds his hand from doing wrong and judges fairly between two parties.
verses.textEnEsv: does not lend at interest or take any profit, withholds his hand from injustice, executes true justice between man and man,
verses.textEnNkjv: If he has not exacted usury Nor taken any increase, But has withdrawn his hand from iniquity And executed true judgment between man and man;
verses.textEnNlt: He grants loans without interest, stays away from injustice, is honest and fair when judging others,
verses.textEnNasb: and if he does not lend money at interest or take interest, if he keeps his hand from injustice and executes true justice between one person and another,
verses.textEn: He does not lend to them at interest or take a profit from them. He withholds his hand from doing wrong and judges fairly between two parties.

verses.textZh: 他遵行我的律例，谨守我的典章，行事诚实，这人是个义人，他必定存活。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他遵行我的律例，谨守我的典章，行事诚实，这人是个义人，他必定存活。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 遵行我的律例，谨守我的典章，按诚实行事－这人是公义的，必定存活。这是主耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: He follows my decrees and faithfully keeps my laws. That man is righteous; he will surely live, declares the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: walks in my statutes, and keeps my rules by acting faithfully—he is righteous; he shall surely live, declares the Lord God .
verses.textEnNkjv: If he has walked in My statutes And kept My judgments faithfully— He is just; He shall surely live!" Says the Lord God.
verses.textEnNlt: and faithfully obeys my decrees and regulations. Anyone who does these things is just and will surely live, says the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: if he walks in My statutes and keeps My ordinances so as to deal faithfully—he is righteous and will certainly live," declares the Lord God.
verses.textEn: He follows my decrees and faithfully keeps my laws. That man is righteous; he will surely live, declares the Sovereign Lord .

verses.textZh: "他若是生一个儿子，是个强暴的人，流人的血，又向兄弟行上述任何一件恶事
verses.textZhCnvs: "他若是生一个儿子，是个强暴的人，流人的血，又向兄弟行上述任何一件恶事
verses.textZhCuv: 亏负困苦和穷乏的人，抢夺人的物，未曾将当头还给人，仰望偶像，并行可憎的事，
verses.textEnNiv: "Suppose he has a violent son, who sheds blood or does any of these other things
verses.textEnEsv: "If he fathers a son who is violent, a shedder of blood, who does any of these things
verses.textEnNkjv: "If he begets a son whois a robber Or a shedder of blood, Who does any of these things
verses.textEnNlt: "But suppose that man has a son who grows up to be a robber or murderer and refuses to do what is right.
verses.textEnNasb: "However, he may father a violent son who sheds blood, and does any one of these things to a brother
verses.textEn: "Suppose he has a violent son, who sheds blood or does any of these other things

verses.textZh: ：他在山上吃祭肉，又玷污邻舍的妻子；
verses.textZhCnvs: ：他在山上吃祭肉，又玷污邻舍的妻子；
verses.textZhCuv: 向借钱的弟兄取利，向借粮的弟兄多要－这人岂能存活呢？他必不能存活。他行这一切可憎的事，必要死亡，他的罪 必归到他身上。
verses.textEnNiv: (though the father has done none of them): "He eats at the mountain shrines. He defiles his neighbor’s wife.
verses.textEnEsv: (though he himself did none of these things), who even eats upon the mountains, defiles his neighbor’s wife,
verses.textEnNkjv: And does none of those duties, But has eaten on the mountains Or defiled his neighbor’s wife;
verses.textEnNlt: And that son does all the evil things his father would never do—he worships idols on the mountains, commits adultery,
verses.textEnNasb: (though he himself did not do any of these things), that is, he even eats at the mountain shrines, and defiles his neighbor’s wife,
verses.textEn: (though the father has done none of them): "He eats at the mountain shrines. He defiles his neighbor’s wife.

verses.textZh: 他欺压困苦和贫穷的人，抢夺人的物件，没有把抵押品归还，眼目仰望偶像，并行可憎的事；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他欺压困苦和贫穷的人，抢夺人的物件，没有把抵押品归还，眼目仰望偶像，并行可憎的事；
verses.textZhCuv: 「他若生一个儿子，见父亲所犯的一切罪便惧怕 ，不照样去做；
verses.textEnNiv: He oppresses the poor and needy. He commits robbery. He does not return what he took in pledge. He looks to the idols. He does detestable things.
verses.textEnEsv: oppresses the poor and needy, commits robbery, does not restore the pledge, lifts up his eyes to the idols, commits abomination,
verses.textEnNkjv: If he has oppressed the poor and needy, Robbed by violence, Not restored the pledge, Lifted his eyes to the idols, Or committed abomination;
verses.textEnNlt: oppresses the poor and helpless, steals from debtors by refusing to let them redeem their security, worships idols, commits detestable sins,
verses.textEnNasb: oppresses the poor and needy, commits robbery, does not restore a pledge, but raises his eyes to the idols and commits abomination,
verses.textEn: He oppresses the poor and needy. He commits robbery. He does not return what he took in pledge. He looks to the idols. He does detestable things.

verses.textZh: 他借东西给人要收利息，也向人多要，这样的人能存活吗？他必不能存活；他行了这一切可憎的事，必要灭亡；他的罪 要归到他身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他借东西给人要收利息，也向人多要，这样的人能存活吗？他必不能存活；他行了这一切可憎的事，必要灭亡；他的罪 要归到他身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 未曾在山上吃过祭偶像之物，未曾仰望以色列家的偶像，未曾玷污邻舍的妻，
verses.textEnNiv: He lends at interest and takes a profit. Will such a man live? He will not! Because he has done all these detestable things, he is to be put to death; his blood will be on his own head.
verses.textEnEsv: lends at interest, and takes profit; shall he then live? He shall not live. He has done all these abominations; he shall surely die; his blood shall be upon himself.
verses.textEnNkjv: If he has exacted usury Or taken increase— Shall he then live? He shall not live! If he has done any of these abominations, He shall surely die; His blood shall be upon him.
verses.textEnNlt: and lends money at excessive interest. Should such a sinful person live? No! He must die and must take full blame.
verses.textEnNasb: lends money at interest and takes interest; will he live? He will not live! He has committed all these abominations, he shall certainly be put to death; his blood will be on himself.
verses.textEn: He lends at interest and takes a profit. Will such a man live? He will not! Because he has done all these detestable things, he is to be put to death; his blood will be on his own head.

verses.textZh: "他若生一个儿子，这儿子看见他父亲所犯的一切罪，他虽然看见了，却不照样去作：
verses.textZhCnvs: "他若生一个儿子，这儿子看见他父亲所犯的一切罪，他虽然看见了，却不照样去作：
verses.textZhCuv: 未曾亏负人，未曾取人的当头，未曾抢夺人的物件，却将食物给饥饿的人吃，将衣服给赤身的人穿，
verses.textEnNiv: "But suppose this son has a son who sees all the sins his father commits, and though he sees them, he does not do such things:
verses.textEnEsv: "Now suppose this man fathers a son who sees all the sins that his father has done; he sees, and does not do likewise:
verses.textEnNkjv: "If, however, he begets a son Who sees all the sins which his father has done, And considers but does not do likewise;
verses.textEnNlt: "But suppose that sinful son, in turn, has a son who sees his father’s wickedness and decides against that kind of life.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now behold, he has fathered a son who saw all his father’s sins which he committed, but he has seen them and does not do likewise.
verses.textEn: "But suppose this son has a son who sees all the sins his father commits, and though he sees them, he does not do such things:

verses.textZh: 他不在山上吃祭肉，眼目不仰望以色列家的偶像，不玷污邻舍的妻子；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他不在山上吃祭肉，眼目不仰望以色列家的偶像，不玷污邻舍的妻子；
verses.textZhCuv: 缩手不害贫穷人，未曾向借钱的弟兄取利，也未曾向借粮的弟兄多要；他顺从我的典章，遵行我的律例，就不因父亲的罪孽死亡，定要存活。
verses.textEnNiv: "He does not eat at the mountain shrines or look to the idols of Israel. He does not defile his neighbor’s wife.
verses.textEnEsv: he does not eat upon the mountains or lift up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, does not defile his neighbor’s wife,
verses.textEnNkjv: Who has not eaten on the mountains, Nor lifted his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, Nor defiled his neighbor’s wife;
verses.textEnNlt: This son refuses to worship idols on the mountains and does not commit adultery.
verses.textEnNasb: He does not eat at the mountain shrines or raise his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel; he has not defiled his neighbor’s wife,
verses.textEn: "He does not eat at the mountain shrines or look to the idols of Israel. He does not defile his neighbor’s wife.

verses.textZh: 不欺压任何人，不索取抵押品，不抢夺人的物件，却把自己的食物给饥饿的人，把衣服给赤身的人穿著；
verses.textZhCnvs: 不欺压任何人，不索取抵押品，不抢夺人的物件，却把自己的食物给饥饿的人，把衣服给赤身的人穿著；
verses.textZhCuv: 至于他父亲；因为欺人太甚，抢夺弟兄，在本国的民中行不善，他必因自己的罪孽死亡。
verses.textEnNiv: He does not oppress anyone or require a pledge for a loan. He does not commit robbery but gives his food to the hungry and provides clothing for the naked.
verses.textEnEsv: does not oppress anyone, exacts no pledge, commits no robbery, but gives his bread to the hungry and covers the naked with a garment,
verses.textEnNkjv: Has not oppressed anyone, Nor withheld a pledge, Nor robbed by violence, But has given his bread to the hungry And covered the naked with clothing;
verses.textEnNlt: He does not exploit the poor, but instead is fair to debtors and does not rob them. He gives food to the hungry and provides clothes for the needy.
verses.textEnNasb: nor oppressed anyone, nor retained a pledge, nor committed robbery; instead, he gives his bread to the hungry and covers the naked with clothing,
verses.textEn: He does not oppress anyone or require a pledge for a loan. He does not commit robbery but gives his food to the hungry and provides clothing for the naked.

verses.textZh: 他不伸手欺压困苦人，借东西给人不取利息，也不多要；他遵守我的典章，遵行我的律例，这人就必不因他父亲的罪孽而灭亡；他必要存活。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他不伸手欺压困苦人，借东西给人不取利息，也不多要；他遵守我的典章，遵行我的律例，这人就必不因他父亲的罪孽而灭亡；他必要存活。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们还说：『儿子为何不担当父亲的罪孽呢？』儿子行正直与合理的事，谨守遵行我的一切律例，他必定存活。
verses.textEnNiv: He withholds his hand from mistreating the poor and takes no interest or profit from them. He keeps my laws and follows my decrees. He will not die for his father’s sin; he will surely live.
verses.textEnEsv: withholds his hand from iniquity, takes no interest or profit, obeys my rules, and walks in my statutes; he shall not die for his father’s iniquity; he shall surely live.
verses.textEnNkjv: Who has withdrawn his hand from the poor And not received usury or increase, But has executed My judgments And walked in My statutes— He shall not die for the iniquity of his father; He shall surely live!
verses.textEnNlt: He helps the poor, does not lend money at interest, and obeys all my regulations and decrees. Such a person will not die because of his father’s sins; he will surely live.
verses.textEnNasb: he keeps his hand from the poor, does not take any kind of interest on loans, but executes My ordinances, and walks in My statutes; he will not die for his father’s guilt, he will certainly live.
verses.textEn: He withholds his hand from mistreating the poor and takes no interest or profit from them. He keeps my laws and follows my decrees. He will not die for his father’s sin; he will surely live.

verses.textZh: 至于他的父亲，因为他勒索，抢夺兄弟的物件，在自己的同胞中行不善的事，所以他必因自己的罪孽而灭亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于他的父亲，因为他勒索，抢夺兄弟的物件，在自己的同胞中行不善的事，所以他必因自己的罪孽而灭亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有犯罪的，他必死亡。儿子必不担当父亲的罪孽，父亲也不担当儿子的罪孽。义人的善果必归自己，恶人的恶报也必归自己。
verses.textEnNiv: But his father will die for his own sin, because he practiced extortion, robbed his brother and did what was wrong among his people.
verses.textEnEsv: As for his father, because he practiced extortion, robbed his brother, and did what is not good among his people, behold, he shall die for his iniquity.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Asfor his father, Because he cruelly oppressed, Robbed his brother by violence, And did what is not good among his people, Behold, he shall die for his iniquity.
verses.textEnNlt: But the father will die for his many sins—for being cruel, robbing people, and doing what was clearly wrong among his people.
verses.textEnNasb: As for his father, because he practiced extortion, robbed his brother, and did what was not good among his people, behold, he will die for his guilt.
verses.textEn: But his father will die for his own sin, because he practiced extortion, robbed his brother and did what was wrong among his people.

verses.textZh: "你们还问：‘儿子为甚么不担当父亲的罪孽呢？’儿子若行正直和公义的事，谨守遵行我的一切律例，就必存活。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们还问：‘儿子为甚么不担当父亲的罪孽呢？’儿子若行正直和公义的事，谨守遵行我的一切律例，就必存活。
verses.textZhCuv: 「恶人若回头离开所做的一切罪恶，谨守我一切的律例，行正直与合理的事，他必定存活，不致死亡。
verses.textEnNiv: "Yet you ask, ‘Why does the son not share the guilt of his father?’ Since the son has done what is just and right and has been careful to keep all my decrees, he will surely live.
verses.textEnEsv: "Yet you say, ‘Why should not the son suffer for the iniquity of the father?’ When the son has done what is just and right, and has been careful to observe all my statutes, he shall surely live.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Yet you say, ‘Why should the son not bear the guilt of the father?’ Because the son has done what is lawful and right, and has kept all My statutes and observed them, he shall surely live.
verses.textEnNlt: "‘What?’ you ask. ‘Doesn’t the child pay for the parent’s sins?’ No! For if the child does what is just and right and keeps my decrees, that child will surely live.
verses.textEnNasb: "Yet you say, ‘Why should the son not suffer the punishment for the father’s guilt?’ When the son has practiced justice and righteousness and has kept all My statutes and done them, he shall certainly live.
verses.textEn: "Yet you ask, ‘Why does the son not share the guilt of his father?’ Since the son has done what is just and right and has been careful to keep all my decrees, he will surely live.

verses.textZh: 唯独犯罪的，才会灭亡；儿子必不担当父亲的罪孽，父亲也必不担当儿子的罪孽；义人的义必归他自己，恶人的恶也必归他自己。
verses.textZhCnvs: 唯独犯罪的，才会灭亡；儿子必不担当父亲的罪孽，父亲也必不担当儿子的罪孽；义人的义必归他自己，恶人的恶也必归他自己。
verses.textZhCuv: 他所犯的一切罪过都不被记念，因所行的义，他必存活。
verses.textEnNiv: The one who sins is the one who will die. The child will not share the guilt of the parent, nor will the parent share the guilt of the child. The righteousness of the righteous will be credited to them, and the wickedness of the wicked will be charged against them.
verses.textEnEsv: The soul who sins shall die. The son shall not suffer for the iniquity of the father, nor the father suffer for the iniquity of the son. The righteousness of the righteous shall be upon himself, and the wickedness of the wicked shall be upon himself.
verses.textEnNkjv: The soul who sins shall die. The son shall not bear the guilt of the father, nor the father bear the guilt of the son. The righteousness of the righteous shall be upon himself, and the wickedness of the wicked shall be upon himself.
verses.textEnNlt: The person who sins is the one who will die. The child will not be punished for the parent’s sins, and the parent will not be punished for the child’s sins. Righteous people will be rewarded for their own righteous behavior, and wicked people will be punished for their own wickedness.
verses.textEnNasb: The person who sins will die. A son will not suffer the punishment for the father’s guilt, nor will a father suffer the punishment for the son’s guilt; the righteousness of the righteous will be upon himself, and the wickedness of the wicked will be upon himself.
verses.textEn: The one who sins is the one who will die. The child will not share the guilt of the parent, nor will the parent share the guilt of the child. The righteousness of the righteous will be credited to them, and the wickedness of the wicked will be charged against them.

verses.textZh: "恶人若回转，离开他所犯的一切罪，谨守我的一切律例，行正直和公义的事，就必存活，不致灭亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: "恶人若回转，离开他所犯的一切罪，谨守我的一切律例，行正直和公义的事，就必存活，不致灭亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华说：恶人死亡，岂是我喜悦的吗？不是喜悦他回头离开所行的道存活吗？
verses.textEnNiv: "But if a wicked person turns away from all the sins they have committed and keeps all my decrees and does what is just and right, that person will surely live; they will not die.
verses.textEnEsv: "But if a wicked person turns away from all his sins that he has committed and keeps all my statutes and does what is just and right, he shall surely live; he shall not die.
verses.textEnNkjv: "But if a wicked man turns from all his sins which he has committed, keeps all My statutes, and does what is lawful and right, he shall surely live; he shall not die.
verses.textEnNlt: But if wicked people turn away from all their sins and begin to obey my decrees and do what is just and right, they will surely live and not die.
verses.textEnNasb: "But if the wicked person turns from all his sins which he has committed and keeps all My statutes and practices justice and righteousness, he shall certainly live; he shall not die.
verses.textEn: "But if a wicked person turns away from all the sins they have committed and keeps all my decrees and does what is just and right, that person will surely live; they will not die.

verses.textZh: 他所犯的一切罪过都不会被记念，作控诉他的理由；他必因自己所行的义而存活。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他所犯的一切罪过都不会被记念，作控诉他的理由；他必因自己所行的义而存活。
verses.textZhCuv: 义人若转离义行而作罪孽，照着恶人所行一切可憎的事而行，他岂能存活吗？他所行的一切义都不被记念；他必因所犯的罪、所行的恶死亡。
verses.textEnNiv: None of the offenses they have committed will be remembered against them. Because of the righteous things they have done, they will live.
verses.textEnEsv: None of the transgressions that he has committed shall be remembered against him; for the righteousness that he has done he shall live.
verses.textEnNkjv: None of the transgressions which he has committed shall be remembered against him; because of the righteousness which he has done, he shall live.
verses.textEnNlt: All their past sins will be forgotten, and they will live because of the righteous things they have done.
verses.textEnNasb: All his offenses which he has committed will not be remembered against him; because of his righteousness which he has practiced, he will live.
verses.textEn: None of the offenses they have committed will be remembered against them. Because of the righteous things they have done, they will live.

verses.textZh: 难道我喜悦恶人死亡吗？我不是喜悦他回转离开他所行的而存活吗？这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 难道我喜悦恶人死亡吗？我不是喜悦他回转离开他所行的而存活吗？这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们还说：『主的道不公平！』以色列家啊，你们当听，我的道岂不公平吗？你们的道岂不是不公平吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Do I take any pleasure in the death of the wicked? declares the Sovereign Lord . Rather, am I not pleased when they turn from their ways and live?
verses.textEnEsv: Have I any pleasure in the death of the wicked, declares the Lord God , and not rather that he should turn from his way and live?
verses.textEnNkjv: Do I have any pleasure at all that the wicked should die?" says the Lord God, "and not that he should turn from his ways and live?
verses.textEnNlt: "Do you think that I like to see wicked people die? says the Sovereign Lord . Of course not! I want them to turn from their wicked ways and live.
verses.textEnNasb: Do I take any pleasure in the death of the wicked," declares the Lord God, " rather than that he would turn from his ways and live?
verses.textEn: Do I take any pleasure in the death of the wicked? declares the Sovereign Lord . Rather, am I not pleased when they turn from their ways and live?

verses.textZh: "义人若转离他的义去行恶，照着恶人所行一切可憎的事而行，他能存活吗？他所行的一切义都不会被记念；他必因他所行不忠的事和他所犯的罪而灭亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: "义人若转离他的义去行恶，照着恶人所行一切可憎的事而行，他能存活吗？他所行的一切义都不会被记念；他必因他所行不忠的事和他所犯的罪而灭亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 义人若转离义行而作罪孽死亡，他是因所作的罪孽死亡。
verses.textEnNiv: "But if a righteous person turns from their righteousness and commits sin and does the same detestable things the wicked person does, will they live? None of the righteous things that person has done will be remembered. Because of the unfaithfulness they are guilty of and because of the sins they have committed, they will die.
verses.textEnEsv: But when a righteous person turns away from his righteousness and does injustice and does the same abominations that the wicked person does, shall he live? None of the righteous deeds that he has done shall be remembered; for the treachery of which he is guilty and the sin he has committed, for them he shall die.
verses.textEnNkjv: "But when a righteous man turns away from his righteousness and commits iniquity, and does according to all the abominations that the wicked man does, shall he live? All the righteousness which he has done shall not be remembered; because of the unfaithfulness of which he is guilty and the sin which he has committed, because of them he shall die.
verses.textEnNlt: However, if righteous people turn from their righteous behavior and start doing sinful things and act like other sinners, should they be allowed to live? No, of course not! All their righteous acts will be forgotten, and they will die for their sins.
verses.textEnNasb: "But when a righteous person turns away from his righteousness, commits injustice and does according to all the abominations that the wicked person does, will he live? All his righteous deeds which he has done will not be remembered for his treachery which he has committed and his sin which he has committed; for them he will die.
verses.textEn: "But if a righteous person turns from their righteousness and commits sin and does the same detestable things the wicked person does, will they live? None of the righteous things that person has done will be remembered. Because of the unfaithfulness they are guilty of and because of the sins they have committed, they will die.

verses.textZh: "你们还说：‘主所行的不公平。’以色列家啊，你们要听！我所行的哪里不公平呢？岂不是你们所行的不公平吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们还说：‘主所行的不公平。’以色列家啊，你们要听！我所行的哪里不公平呢？岂不是你们所行的不公平吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 再者，恶人若回头离开所行的恶，行正直与合理的事，他必将性命救活了。
verses.textEnNiv: "Yet you say, ‘The way of the Lord is not just.’ Hear, you Israelites: Is my way unjust? Is it not your ways that are unjust?
verses.textEnEsv: "Yet you say, ‘The way of the Lord is not just.’ Hear now, O house of Israel: Is my way not just? Is it not your ways that are not just?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Yet you say, ‘The way of the Lord is not fair.’ Hear now, O house of Israel, is it not My way which is fair, and your ways which are not fair?
verses.textEnNlt: "Yet you say, ‘The Lord isn’t doing what’s right!’ Listen to me, O people of Israel. Am I the one not doing what’s right, or is it you?
verses.textEnNasb: Yet you say, ‘The way of the Lord is not right.’ Hear now, house of Israel! Is My way not right? Is it not your ways that are not right?
