verses.textEn: "Yet you say, ‘The way of the Lord is not just.’ Hear, you Israelites: Is my way unjust? Is it not your ways that are unjust?

verses.textZh: 义人若转离他的义去行恶，他就必因此灭亡；他必因着他所行的不义灭亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 义人若转离他的义去行恶，他就必因此灭亡；他必因着他所行的不义灭亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他思量，回头离开所犯的一切罪过，必定存活，不致死亡。
verses.textEnNiv: If a righteous person turns from their righteousness and commits sin, they will die for it; because of the sin they have committed they will die.
verses.textEnEsv: When a righteous person turns away from his righteousness and does injustice, he shall die for it; for the injustice that he has done he shall die.
verses.textEnNkjv: When a righteous man turns away from his righteousness, commits iniquity, and dies in it, it is because of the iniquity which he has done that he dies.
verses.textEnNlt: When righteous people turn from their righteous behavior and start doing sinful things, they will die for it. Yes, they will die because of their sinful deeds.
verses.textEnNasb: When a righteous person turns away from his righteousness, commits injustice and dies because of it, for his injustice which he has committed he dies.
verses.textEn: If a righteous person turns from their righteousness and commits sin, they will die for it; because of the sin they have committed they will die.

verses.textZh: 还有，恶人若回转离开他所行的恶，行正直公义的事，他就可以使自己的性命存活。
verses.textZhCnvs: 还有，恶人若回转离开他所行的恶，行正直公义的事，他就可以使自己的性命存活。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列家还说：『主的道不公平！』以色列家啊，我的道岂不公平吗？你们的道岂不是不公平吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: But if a wicked person turns away from the wickedness they have committed and does what is just and right, they will save their life.
verses.textEnEsv: Again, when a wicked person turns away from the wickedness he has committed and does what is just and right, he shall save his life.
verses.textEnNkjv: Again, when a wicked man turns away from the wickedness which he committed, and does what is lawful and right, he preserves himself alive.
verses.textEnNlt: And if wicked people turn from their wickedness, obey the law, and do what is just and right, they will save their lives.
verses.textEnNasb: But when a wicked person turns away from his wickedness which he has committed and practices justice and righteousness, he will save his life.
verses.textEn: But if a wicked person turns away from the wickedness they have committed and does what is just and right, they will save their life.

verses.textZh: 因为他思量了，就转离他所犯的一切罪过，所以他必然存活，不致灭亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他思量了，就转离他所犯的一切罪过，所以他必然存活，不致灭亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以主耶和华说：「以色列家啊，我必按你们各人所行的审判你们。你们当回头离开所犯的一切罪过。这样，罪孽必不使你们败亡。
verses.textEnNiv: Because they consider all the offenses they have committed and turn away from them, that person will surely live; they will not die.
verses.textEnEsv: Because he considered and turned away from all the transgressions that he had committed, he shall surely live; he shall not die.
verses.textEnNkjv: Because he considers and turns away from all the transgressions which he committed, he shall surely live; he shall not die.
verses.textEnNlt: They will live because they thought it over and decided to turn from their sins. Such people will not die.
verses.textEnNasb: Since he understood and turned away from all his offenses which he had committed, he shall certainly live; he shall not die.
verses.textEn: Because they consider all the offenses they have committed and turn away from them, that person will surely live; they will not die.

verses.textZh: 但以色列家还说：‘主所行的不公平。’以色列家啊，我所行的哪里不公平呢？岂不是你们所行的不公平吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 但以色列家还说：‘主所行的不公平。’以色列家啊，我所行的哪里不公平呢？岂不是你们所行的不公平吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要将所犯的一切罪过尽行抛弃，自做一个新心和新灵。以色列家啊，你们何必死亡呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Yet the Israelites say, ‘The way of the Lord is not just.’ Are my ways unjust, people of Israel? Is it not your ways that are unjust?
verses.textEnEsv: Yet the house of Israel says, ‘The way of the Lord is not just.’ O house of Israel, are my ways not just? Is it not your ways that are not just?
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet the house of Israel says, ‘The way of the Lord is not fair.’ O house of Israel, is it not My ways which are fair, and your ways which are not fair?
verses.textEnNlt: And yet the people of Israel keep saying, ‘The Lord isn’t doing what’s right!’ O people of Israel, it is you who are not doing what’s right, not I.
verses.textEnNasb: But the house of Israel says, ‘The way of the Lord is not right.’ Are My ways not right, house of Israel? Is it not your ways that are not right?
verses.textEn: Yet the Israelites say, ‘The way of the Lord is not just.’ Are my ways unjust, people of Israel? Is it not your ways that are unjust?

verses.textZh: "因此，以色列家啊，我必照着你们各人所行的审判你们。你们回转吧！离开你们的一切罪过吧！免得罪孽成为你们的绊脚石。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: "因此，以色列家啊，我必照着你们各人所行的审判你们。你们回转吧！离开你们的一切罪过吧！免得罪孽成为你们的绊脚石。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华说：我不喜悦那死人之死，所以你们当回头而存活。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Therefore, you Israelites, I will judge each of you according to your own ways, declares the Sovereign Lord . Repent! Turn away from all your offenses; then sin will not be your downfall.
verses.textEnEsv: "Therefore I will judge you, O house of Israel, every one according to his ways, declares the Lord God . Repent and turn from all your transgressions, lest iniquity be your ruin.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore I will judge you, O house of Israel, every one according to his ways," says the Lord God. "Repent, and turn from all your transgressions, so that iniquity will not be your ruin.
verses.textEnNlt: "Therefore, I will judge each of you, O people of Israel, according to your actions, says the Sovereign Lord . Repent, and turn from your sins. Don’t let them destroy you!
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore I will judge you, house of Israel, each according to his conduct," declares the Lord God. "Repent and turn away from all your offenses, so that wrongdoing does not become a stumbling block to you.
verses.textEn: "Therefore, you Israelites, I will judge each of you according to your own ways, declares the Sovereign Lord . Repent! Turn away from all your offenses; then sin will not be your downfall.

verses.textZh: 你们要把你们所犯的一切罪过弃掉，为自己造一个新的心和新的灵。以色列家啊，你们为甚么要灭亡呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要把你们所犯的一切罪过弃掉，为自己造一个新的心和新的灵。以色列家啊，你们为甚么要灭亡呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要把你们所犯的一切罪过弃掉，为自己造一个新的心和新的灵。以色列家啊，你们为甚么要灭亡呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Rid yourselves of all the offenses you have committed, and get a new heart and a new spirit. Why will you die, people of Israel?
verses.textEnEsv: Cast away from you all the transgressions that you have committed, and make yourselves a new heart and a new spirit! Why will you die, O house of Israel?
verses.textEnNkjv: Cast away from you all the transgressions which you have committed, and get yourselves a new heart and a new spirit. For why should you die, O house of Israel?
verses.textEnNlt: Put all your rebellion behind you, and find yourselves a new heart and a new spirit. For why should you die, O people of Israel?
verses.textEnNasb: Hurl away from you all your offenses which you have committed and make yourselves a new heart and a new spirit! For why should you die, house of Israel?
verses.textEn: Rid yourselves of all the offenses you have committed, and get a new heart and a new spirit. Why will you die, people of Israel?

verses.textZh: "我不喜悦任何人灭亡，所以你们要回转，得以存活。这是主耶和华的宣告。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "我不喜悦任何人灭亡，所以你们要回转，得以存活。这是主耶和华的宣告。"
verses.textZhCuv: "我不喜悦任何人灭亡，所以你们要回转，得以存活。这是主耶和华的宣告。"
verses.textEnNiv: For I take no pleasure in the death of anyone, declares the Sovereign Lord . Repent and live!
verses.textEnEsv: For I have no pleasure in the death of anyone, declares the Lord God ; so turn, and live."
verses.textEnNkjv: For I have no pleasure in the death of one who dies," says the Lord God. "Therefore turn and live!"
verses.textEnNlt: I don’t want you to die, says the Sovereign Lord . Turn back and live!
verses.textEnNasb: For I take no pleasure in the death of anyone who dies," declares the Lord God. "Therefore, repent and live!"
verses.textEn: For I take no pleasure in the death of anyone, declares the Sovereign Lord . Repent and live!

verses.textZh: "你当为以色列的众领袖作一首哀歌，
verses.textZhCnvs: "你当为以色列的众领袖作一首哀歌，
verses.textZhCuv: 你当为以色列的王作起哀歌，
verses.textEnNiv: "Take up a lament concerning the princes of Israel
verses.textEnEsv: And you, take up a lamentation for the princes of Israel,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Moreover take up a lamentation for the princes of Israel,
verses.textEnNlt: "Sing this funeral song for the princes of Israel:
verses.textEnNasb: "As for you, take up a song of mourning for the leaders of Israel
verses.textEn: "Take up a lament concerning the princes of Israel

verses.textZh: 说： ‘你的母亲是甚么？ 是狮子群中的母狮， 牠卧在少壮狮子群中， 养育牠的小狮子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 说： ‘你的母亲是甚么？ 是狮子群中的母狮， 牠卧在少壮狮子群中， 养育牠的小狮子。
verses.textZhCuv: 说： 你的母亲是什么呢？ 是个母狮子，蹲伏在狮子中间， 在少壮狮子中养育小狮子。
verses.textEnNiv: and say: " ‘What a lioness was your mother among the lions! She lay down among them and reared her cubs.
verses.textEnEsv: and say: What was your mother? A lioness! Among lions she crouched; in the midst of young lions she reared her cubs.
verses.textEnNkjv: and say: ‘What is your mother? A lioness: She lay down among the lions; Among the young lions she nourished her cubs.
verses.textEnNlt: "What is your mother? A lioness among lions! She lay down among the young lions and reared her cubs.
verses.textEnNasb: and say, ‘ What was your mother? A lioness among lions! She lay down among young lions, She raised her cubs.
verses.textEn: and say: " ‘What a lioness was your mother among the lions! She lay down among them and reared her cubs.

verses.textZh: 牠养大其中一只小狮子， 这幼狮成了一只少壮的狮子， 学会了撕碎猎物， 把人吃掉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠养大其中一只小狮子， 这幼狮成了一只少壮的狮子， 学会了撕碎猎物， 把人吃掉。
verses.textZhCuv: 在它小狮子中养大一个， 成了少壮狮子， 学会抓食而吃人。
verses.textEnNiv: She brought up one of her cubs, and he became a strong lion. He learned to tear the prey and he became a man-eater.
verses.textEnEsv: And she brought up one of her cubs; he became a young lion, and he learned to catch prey; he devoured men.
verses.textEnNkjv: She brought up one of her cubs, And he became a young lion; He learned to catch prey, And he devoured men.
verses.textEnNlt: She raised one of her cubs to become a strong young lion. He learned to hunt and devour prey, and he became a man-eater.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘When she brought up one of her cubs, He became a young lion, And he learned to tear his prey; He devoured people.
verses.textEn: She brought up one of her cubs, and he became a strong lion. He learned to tear the prey and he became a man-eater.

verses.textZh: 列国听见了， 就把牠困在他们的坑中； 他们用钩子 把牠带到埃及地去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 列国听见了， 就把牠困在他们的坑中； 他们用钩子 把牠带到埃及地去。
verses.textZhCuv: 列国听见了就把它捉在他们的坑中， 用钩子拉到埃及地去。
verses.textEnNiv: The nations heard about him, and he was trapped in their pit. They led him with hooks to the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: The nations heard about him; he was caught in their pit, and they brought him with hooks to the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: The nations also heard of him; He was trapped in their pit, And they brought him with chains to the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the nations heard about him, and he was trapped in their pit. They led him away with hooks to the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Then nations heard about him; He was caught in their trap, And they brought him with hooks To the land of Egypt.
verses.textEn: The nations heard about him, and he was trapped in their pit. They led him with hooks to the land of Egypt.

verses.textZh: 母狮见自己所等候的落空了， 所希望的幻灭了， 就从牠的小狮子中另取出一只， 使牠成为少壮的狮子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 母狮见自己所等候的落空了， 所希望的幻灭了， 就从牠的小狮子中另取出一只， 使牠成为少壮的狮子。
verses.textZhCuv: 母狮见自己等候失了指望， 就从它小狮子中又将一个养为少壮狮子。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘When she saw her hope unfulfilled, her expectation gone, she took another of her cubs and made him a strong lion.
verses.textEnEsv: When she saw that she waited in vain, that her hope was lost, she took another of her cubs and made him a young lion.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘When she saw that she waited, that her hope was lost, She took another of her cubs and made him a young lion.
verses.textEnNlt: "When the lioness saw that her hopes for him were gone, she took another of her cubs and taught him to be a strong young lion.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘When she saw, as she waited, That her hope was lost, She took another of her cubs And made him a young lion.
verses.textEn: " ‘When she saw her hope unfulfilled, her expectation gone, she took another of her cubs and made him a strong lion.

verses.textZh: 牠在狮子群中行走； 牠已成了一只少壮的狮子， 牠学会了撕碎猎物， 把人吃掉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠在狮子群中行走； 牠已成了一只少壮的狮子， 牠学会了撕碎猎物， 把人吃掉。
verses.textZhCuv: 它在众狮子中走来走去， 成了少壮狮子， 学会抓食而吃人。
verses.textEnNiv: He prowled among the lions, for he was now a strong lion. He learned to tear the prey and he became a man-eater.
verses.textEnEsv: He prowled among the lions; he became a young lion, and he learned to catch prey; he devoured men,
verses.textEnNkjv: He roved among the lions, And became a young lion; He learned to catch prey; He devoured men.
verses.textEnNlt: He prowled among the other lions and stood out among them in his strength. He learned to hunt and devour prey, and he, too, became a man-eater.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘And he walked about among the lions, He became a young lion; He learned to tear his prey; He devoured people.
verses.textEn: He prowled among the lions, for he was now a strong lion. He learned to tear the prey and he became a man-eater.

verses.textZh: 牠拆毁了他们的城堡， 使他们的城市荒凉； 因牠吼叫的声音， 地和其中所充满的都惊恐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠拆毁了他们的城堡， 使他们的城市荒凉； 因牠吼叫的声音， 地和其中所充满的都惊恐。
verses.textZhCuv: 它知道列国的宫殿， 又使他们的城邑变为荒场； 因它咆哮的声音， 遍地和其中所有的就都荒废。
verses.textEnNiv: He broke down their strongholds and devastated their towns. The land and all who were in it were terrified by his roaring.
verses.textEnEsv: and seized their widows. He laid waste their cities, and the land was appalled and all who were in it at the sound of his roaring.
verses.textEnNkjv: He knew their desolate places, And laid waste their cities; The land with its fullness was desolated By the noise of his roaring.
verses.textEnNlt: He demolished fortresses and destroyed their towns and cities. Their farms were desolated, and their crops were destroyed. The land and its people trembled in fear when they heard him roar.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘He destroyed their palaces And laid waste their cities; And the land and its fullness were appalled Because of the sound of his roaring.
verses.textEn: He broke down their strongholds and devastated their towns. The land and all who were in it were terrified by his roaring.

verses.textZh: 于是四围的列国 从各地来攻击牠， 把他们的网撒在牠身上， 把牠困在他们的坑中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是四围的列国 从各地来攻击牠， 把他们的网撒在牠身上， 把牠困在他们的坑中。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是四围邦国各省的人来攻击它， 将网撒在它身上， 捉在他们的坑中。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the nations came against him, those from regions round about. They spread their net for him, and he was trapped in their pit.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the nations set against him from provinces on every side; they spread their net over him; he was taken in their pit.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the nations set against him from the provinces on every side, And spread their net over him; He was trapped in their pit.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the armies of the nations attacked him, surrounding him from every direction. They threw a net over him and captured him in their pit.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Then nations set against him On every side from their provinces, And they spread their net over him; He was caught in their trap.
verses.textEn: Then the nations came against him, those from regions round about. They spread their net for him, and he was trapped in their pit.

verses.textZh: 他们把牠放进笼里， 用钩子带到巴比伦王那里， 囚在狱中， 使牠的声音在以色列众山上不再听见。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们把牠放进笼里， 用钩子带到巴比伦王那里， 囚在狱中， 使牠的声音在以色列众山上不再听见。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们用钩子钩住它，将它放在笼中， 带到巴比伦王那里， 将它放入坚固之所， 使它的声音在以色列山上不再听见。
verses.textEnNiv: With hooks they pulled him into a cage and brought him to the king of Babylon. They put him in prison, so his roar was heard no longer on the mountains of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: With hooks they put him in a cage and brought him to the king of Babylon; they brought him into custody, that his voice should no more be heard on the mountains of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: They put him in a cage with chains, And brought him to the king of Babylon; They brought him in nets, That his voice should no longer be heard on the mountains of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: With hooks, they dragged him into a cage and brought him before the king of Babylon. They held him in captivity, so his voice could never again be heard on the mountains of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘They put him in a wooden collar with hooks And brought him to the king of Babylon; They brought him in hunting nets So that his voice would no longer be heard On the mountains of Israel.
verses.textEn: With hooks they pulled him into a cage and brought him to the king of Babylon. They put him in prison, so his roar was heard no longer on the mountains of Israel.

verses.textZh: "‘你的母亲像葡萄园里 的一棵葡萄树， 栽种在水边； 因为水源充足， 结果累累、枝叶茂盛。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘你的母亲像葡萄园里 的一棵葡萄树， 栽种在水边； 因为水源充足， 结果累累、枝叶茂盛。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的母亲先前如葡萄树， 极其茂盛 ，栽于水旁。 因为水多， 就多结果子，满生枝子；
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Your mother was like a vine in your vineyard planted by the water; it was fruitful and full of branches because of abundant water.
verses.textEnEsv: Your mother was like a vine in a vineyard planted by the water, fruitful and full of branches by reason of abundant water.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Your mother was like a vine in your bloodline, Planted by the waters, Fruitful and full of branches Because of many waters.
verses.textEnNlt: "Your mother was like a vine planted by the water’s edge. It had lush, green foliage because of the abundant water.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Your mother was like a vine in your vineyard, Planted by the waters; It was fruitful and thick with branches Because of abundant waters.
verses.textEn: " ‘Your mother was like a vine in your vineyard planted by the water; it was fruitful and full of branches because of abundant water.

verses.textZh: 它有粗壮的树枝可作掌权者的杖； 它树身高大，超乎其他茂密枝叶之上； 因为它树身高大，枝子众多，远远就可以看见。
verses.textZhCnvs: 它有粗壮的树枝可作掌权者的杖； 它树身高大，超乎其他茂密枝叶之上； 因为它树身高大，枝子众多，远远就可以看见。
verses.textZhCuv: 生出坚固的枝干，可作掌权者的杖。 这枝干高举在茂密的枝中， 而且它生长高大，枝子繁多， 远远可见。
verses.textEnNiv: Its branches were strong, fit for a ruler’s scepter. It towered high above the thick foliage, conspicuous for its height and for its many branches.
verses.textEnEsv: Its strong stems became rulers’ scepters; it towered aloft among the thick boughs; it was seen in its height with the mass of its branches.
verses.textEnNkjv: She had strong branches for scepters of rulers. She towered in stature above the thick branches, And was seen in her height amid the dense foliage.
verses.textEnNlt: Its branches became strong— strong enough to be a ruler’s scepter. It grew very tall, towering above all others. It stood out because of its height and its many lush branches.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘And it had strong stems fit for scepters of rulers, And its height was raised above the clouds So that it was seen in its height with the mass of its branches.
verses.textEn: Its branches were strong, fit for a ruler’s scepter. It towered high above the thick foliage, conspicuous for its height and for its many branches.

verses.textZh: 但这葡萄树因神的烈怒被拔起， 摔在地上； 东风使它的果子枯干散掉， 粗壮的树枝枯槁， 被火吞灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但这葡萄树因神的烈怒被拔起， 摔在地上； 东风使它的果子枯干散掉， 粗壮的树枝枯槁， 被火吞灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 但这葡萄树因忿怒被拔出摔在地上； 东风吹干其上的果子， 坚固的枝干折断枯干， 被火烧毁了；
verses.textEnNiv: But it was uprooted in fury and thrown to the ground. The east wind made it shrivel, it was stripped of its fruit; its strong branches withered and fire consumed them.
verses.textEnEsv: But the vine was plucked up in fury, cast down to the ground; the east wind dried up its fruit; they were stripped off and withered. As for its strong stem, fire consumed it.
verses.textEnNkjv: But she was plucked up in fury, She was cast down to the ground, And the east wind dried her fruit. Her strong branches were broken and withered; The fire consumed them.
verses.textEnNlt: But the vine was uprooted in fury and thrown down to the ground. The desert wind dried up its fruit and tore off its strong branches, so that it withered and was destroyed by fire.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘But it was uprooted in fury; It was thrown down to the ground; And the east wind dried up its fruit. Its strong stem was torn out So that it withered; The fire consumed it.
verses.textEn: But it was uprooted in fury and thrown to the ground. The east wind made it shrivel, it was stripped of its fruit; its strong branches withered and fire consumed them.

verses.textZh: 现在它被栽种在旷野， 在干旱无水之地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在它被栽种在旷野， 在干旱无水之地。
verses.textZhCuv: 如今栽于旷野干旱无水之地。
verses.textEnNiv: Now it is planted in the desert, in a dry and thirsty land.
verses.textEnEsv: Now it is planted in the wilderness, in a dry and thirsty land.
verses.textEnNkjv: And now she is planted in the wilderness, In a dry and thirsty land.
verses.textEnNlt: Now the vine is transplanted to the wilderness, where the ground is hard and dry.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘And now it is planted in the wilderness, In a dry and thirsty land.
verses.textEn: Now it is planted in the desert, in a dry and thirsty land.

verses.textZh: 有火从树枝中的一根发出， 吞灭树的果子， 以致树上再没有粗壮的树枝， 可以作掌权者的杖。’ 这是一首哀歌，是一首流行的哀歌。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有火从树枝中的一根发出， 吞灭树的果子， 以致树上再没有粗壮的树枝， 可以作掌权者的杖。’ 这是一首哀歌，是一首流行的哀歌。"
verses.textZhCuv: 火也从它枝干中发出， 烧灭果子， 以致没有坚固的枝干可做掌权者的杖。 这是哀歌，也必用以作哀歌。
verses.textEnNiv: Fire spread from one of its main branches and consumed its fruit. No strong branch is left on it fit for a ruler’s scepter.’ "This is a lament and is to be used as a lament."
verses.textEnEsv: And fire has gone out from the stem of its shoots, has consumed its fruit, so that there remains in it no strong stem, no scepter for ruling. This is a lamentation and has become a lamentation.
verses.textEnNkjv: Fire has come out from a rod of her branches And devoured her fruit, So that she has no strong branch— a scepter for ruling.’ " This is a lamentation, and has become a lamentation.
verses.textEnNlt: A fire has burst out from its branches and devoured its fruit. Its remaining limbs are not strong enough to be a ruler’s scepter. "This is a funeral song, and it will be used in a funeral."
verses.textEnNasb: ‘And fire has gone out from its stem; It has consumed its shoots and fruit, So that there is no strong stem in it, A scepter to rule.’ " This is a song of mourning, and has become a song of mourning.
verses.textEn: Fire spread from one of its main branches and consumed its fruit. No strong branch is left on it fit for a ruler’s scepter.’ "This is a lament and is to be used as a lament."

verses.textZh: 第七年五月十日，有几个以色列的长老来求问耶和华，他们坐在我的面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第七年五月十日，有几个以色列的长老来求问耶和华，他们坐在我的面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 第七年五月初十日，有以色列的几个长老来求问耶和华，坐在我面前。
verses.textEnNiv: In the seventh year, in the fifth month on the tenth day, some of the elders of Israel came to inquire of the Lord , and they sat down in front of me.
verses.textEnEsv: In the seventh year, in the fifth month, on the tenth day of the month, certain of the elders of Israel came to inquire of the Lord , and sat before me.
verses.textEnNkjv: It came to pass in the seventh year, in the fifth month, on the tenth day of the month, that certain of the elders of Israel came to inquire of the Lord, and sat before me.
verses.textEnNlt: On August 14, during the seventh year of King Jehoiachin’s captivity, some of the leaders of Israel came to request a message from the Lord . They sat down in front of me to wait for his reply.
verses.textEnNasb: Now in the seventh year, in the fifth month, on the tenth of the month, men from the elders of Israel came to inquire of the Lord, and they sat before me.
verses.textEn: In the seventh year, in the fifth month on the tenth day, some of the elders of Israel came to inquire of the Lord , and they sat down in front of me.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then the word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: And the word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then this message came to me from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: Then the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: Then the word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: "人子啊！你要告诉以色列的长老，对他们说：‘主耶和华这样说：你们来求问我吗？我指着我的永生起誓，我必不让你们求问我。这是主耶和华的宣告。’
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！你要告诉以色列的长老，对他们说：‘主耶和华这样说：你们来求问我吗？我指着我的永生起誓，我必不让你们求问我。这是主耶和华的宣告。’
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，你要告诉以色列的长老说，主耶和华如此说：你们来是求问我吗？主耶和华说：我指着我的永生起誓，我必不被你们求问。
verses.textEnNiv: "Son of man, speak to the elders of Israel and say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Have you come to inquire of me? As surely as I live, I will not let you inquire of me, declares the Sovereign Lord .’
verses.textEnEsv: "Son of man, speak to the elders of Israel, and say to them, Thus says the Lord God , Is it to inquire of me that you come? As I live, declares the Lord God , I will not be inquired of by you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Son of man, speak to the elders of Israel, and say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord God: "Have you come to inquire of Me? As I live," says the Lord God, "I will not be inquired of by you." ’
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, tell the leaders of Israel, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: How dare you come to ask me for a message? As surely as I live, says the Sovereign Lord , I will tell you nothing!’
verses.textEnNasb: "Son of man, speak to the elders of Israel and say to them, ‘This is what the Lord God says: "Do you yourselves come to inquire of Me? As I live," declares the Lord God, "I certainly will not be inquired of by you." ’
verses.textEn: "Son of man, speak to the elders of Israel and say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Have you come to inquire of me? As surely as I live, I will not let you inquire of me, declares the Sovereign Lord .’

verses.textZh: 人子啊，你要审问他们吗？要审问他们吗？你要使他们知道他们列祖那些可憎的事，
verses.textZhCnvs: 人子啊，你要审问他们吗？要审问他们吗？你要使他们知道他们列祖那些可憎的事，
verses.textZhCuv: 人子啊，你要审问审问他们吗？你当使他们知道他们列祖那些可憎的事，
verses.textEnNiv: "Will you judge them? Will you judge them, son of man? Then confront them with the detestable practices of their ancestors
verses.textEnEsv: Will you judge them, son of man, will you judge them? Let them know the abominations of their fathers,
verses.textEnNkjv: Will you judge them, son of man, will you judge them? Then make known to them the abominations of their fathers.
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, bring charges against them and condemn them. Make them realize how detestable the sins of their ancestors really were.
verses.textEnNasb: Will you judge them, will you judge them, son of man? Make known to them the abominations of their fathers;
verses.textEn: "Will you judge them? Will you judge them, son of man? Then confront them with the detestable practices of their ancestors

verses.textZh: 对他们说：‘主耶和华这样说：在我拣选以色列的日子，我向雅各家的后裔举手起誓，又在埃及地向他们显现。我向他们举手起誓说：我是耶和华你们的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 对他们说：‘主耶和华这样说：在我拣选以色列的日子，我向雅各家的后裔举手起誓，又在埃及地向他们显现。我向他们举手起誓说：我是耶和华你们的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 对他们说，主耶和华如此说：当日我拣选以色列，向雅各家的后裔起誓，在埃及地将自己向他们显现，说：我是耶和华－你们的神。
verses.textEnNiv: and say to them: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: On the day I chose Israel, I swore with uplifted hand to the descendants of Jacob and revealed myself to them in Egypt. With uplifted hand I said to them, "I am the Lord your God."
verses.textEnEsv: and say to them, Thus says the Lord God : On the day when I chose Israel, I swore to the offspring of the house of Jacob, making myself known to them in the land of Egypt; I swore to them, saying, I am the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord God: "On the day when I chose Israel and raised My hand in an oath to the descendants of the house of Jacob, and made Myself known to them in the land of Egypt, I raised My hand in an oath to them, saying, ‘I am the Lord your God.’
verses.textEnNlt: Give them this message from the Sovereign Lord : When I chose Israel—when I revealed myself to the descendants of Jacob in Egypt—I took a solemn oath that I, the Lord , would be their God.
verses.textEnNasb: and say to them, ‘This is what the Lord God says: "On the day when I chose Israel and swore to the descendants of the house of Jacob and made Myself known to them in the land of Egypt, when I swore to them, saying, I am the Lord your God,
verses.textEn: and say to them: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: On the day I chose Israel, I swore with uplifted hand to the descendants of Jacob and revealed myself to them in Egypt. With uplifted hand I said to them, "I am the Lord your God."

verses.textZh: 那日，我向他们举手起誓，要把他们从埃及地领出来，到我为他们所选定的流奶与蜜之地，就是万邦中最荣美的地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那日，我向他们举手起誓，要把他们从埃及地领出来，到我为他们所选定的流奶与蜜之地，就是万邦中最荣美的地。
verses.textZhCuv: 那日我向他们起誓，必领他们出埃及地，到我为他们察看的流奶与蜜之地；那地在万国中是有荣耀的。
verses.textEnNiv: On that day I swore to them that I would bring them out of Egypt into a land I had searched out for them, a land flowing with milk and honey, the most beautiful of all lands.
verses.textEnEsv: On that day I swore to them that I would bring them out of the land of Egypt into a land that I had searched out for them, a land flowing with milk and honey, the most glorious of all lands.
verses.textEnNkjv: On that day I raised My hand in an oath to them, to bring them out of the land of Egypt into a land that I had searched out for them, ‘flowing with milk and honey,’ the glory of all lands.
verses.textEnNlt: I took a solemn oath that day that I would bring them out of Egypt to a land I had discovered and explored for them—a good land, a land flowing with milk and honey, the best of all lands anywhere.
verses.textEnNasb: on that day I swore to them, to bring them out from the land of Egypt into a land that I had selected for them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all the lands.
verses.textEn: On that day I swore to them that I would bring them out of Egypt into a land I had searched out for them, a land flowing with milk and honey, the most beautiful of all lands.

verses.textZh: 我对他们说：你们各人要拋弃你们眼中那些可憎的像，不可因埃及的偶像玷污自己：我是耶和华你们的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我对他们说：你们各人要拋弃你们眼中那些可憎的像，不可因埃及的偶像玷污自己：我是耶和华你们的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 我对他们说，你们各人要抛弃眼所喜爱那可憎之物，不可因埃及的偶像玷污自己。我是耶和华－你们的神。
verses.textEnNiv: And I said to them, "Each of you, get rid of the vile images you have set your eyes on, and do not defile yourselves with the idols of Egypt. I am the Lord your God."
verses.textEnEsv: And I said to them, ‘Cast away the detestable things your eyes feast on, every one of you, and do not defile yourselves with the idols of Egypt; I am the Lord your God.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I said to them, ‘Each of you, throw away the abominations which are before his eyes, and do not defile yourselves with the idols of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.’
verses.textEnNlt: Then I said to them, ‘Each of you, get rid of the vile images you are so obsessed with. Do not defile yourselves with the idols of Egypt, for I am the Lord your God.’
verses.textEnNasb: And I said to them, ‘Throw away, each of you, the detestable things of his eyes, and do not defile yourselves with the idols of Egypt; I am the Lord your God.’
verses.textEn: And I said to them, "Each of you, get rid of the vile images you have set your eyes on, and do not defile yourselves with the idols of Egypt. I am the Lord your God."

verses.textZh: 但是他们背叛了我，不肯听从我；他们各人没有拋弃他们眼中那些可憎的像，没有离弃埃及的偶像。 "‘那时我说，我要把我的烈怒倾倒在他们身上，在埃及地向他们完全发尽我的怒气。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是他们背叛了我，不肯听从我；他们各人没有拋弃他们眼中那些可憎的像，没有离弃埃及的偶像。 "‘那时我说，我要把我的烈怒倾倒在他们身上，在埃及地向他们完全发尽我的怒气。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们却悖逆我，不肯听从我，不抛弃他们眼所喜爱那可憎之物，不离弃埃及的偶像。 「我就说，我要将我的忿怒倾在他们身上，在埃及地向他们成就我怒中所定的。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘But they rebelled against me and would not listen to me; they did not get rid of the vile images they had set their eyes on, nor did they forsake the idols of Egypt. So I said I would pour out my wrath on them and spend my anger against them in Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: But they rebelled against me and were not willing to listen to me. None of them cast away the detestable things their eyes feasted on, nor did they forsake the idols of Egypt. "Then I said I would pour out my wrath upon them and spend my anger against them in the midst of the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: But they rebelled against Me and would not obey Me. They did not all cast away the abominations which were before their eyes, nor did they forsake the idols of Egypt. Then I said, ‘I will pour out My fury on them and fulfill My anger against them in the midst of the land of Egypt.’
verses.textEnNlt: "But they rebelled against me and would not listen. They did not get rid of the vile images they were obsessed with, or forsake the idols of Egypt. Then I threatened to pour out my fury on them to satisfy my anger while they were still in Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: But they rebelled against Me and were not willing to listen to Me; they did not throw away, each of them, the detestable things of their eyes, nor did they abandon the idols of Egypt. "Then I resolved to pour out My wrath on them, to use up My anger against them in the midst of the land of Egypt.
verses.textEn: " ‘But they rebelled against me and would not listen to me; they did not get rid of the vile images they had set their eyes on, nor did they forsake the idols of Egypt. So I said I would pour out my wrath on them and spend my anger against them in Egypt.

verses.textZh: 然而我为了我名的缘故没有这样作，免得我的名在他们寄居的列国的人眼中被亵渎，我把他们从埃及地领出来，在列国的人眼前向他们显现。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而我为了我名的缘故没有这样作，免得我的名在他们寄居的列国的人眼中被亵渎，我把他们从埃及地领出来，在列国的人眼前向他们显现。
verses.textZhCuv: 我却为我名的缘故没有这样行，免得我名在他们所住的列国人眼前被亵渎；我领他们出埃及地，在这列国人的眼前将自己向他们显现。
verses.textEnNiv: But for the sake of my name, I brought them out of Egypt. I did it to keep my name from being profaned in the eyes of the nations among whom they lived and in whose sight I had revealed myself to the Israelites.
verses.textEnEsv: But I acted for the sake of my name, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations among whom they lived, in whose sight I made myself known to them in bringing them out of the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: But I acted for My name’s sake, that it should not be profaned before the Gentiles among whom they were, in whose sight I had made Myself known to them, to bring them out of the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: But I didn’t do it, for I acted to protect the honor of my name. I would not allow shame to be brought on my name among the surrounding nations who saw me reveal myself by bringing the Israelites out of Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: But I acted for the sake of My name, that it would not be defiled in the sight of the nations among whom they lived, in whose sight I made Myself known to them by bringing them out of the land of Egypt.
verses.textEn: But for the sake of my name, I brought them out of Egypt. I did it to keep my name from being profaned in the eyes of the nations among whom they lived and in whose sight I had revealed myself to the Israelites.

verses.textZh: "‘这样我把他们从埃及地领了出来，带到旷野。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘这样我把他们从埃及地领了出来，带到旷野。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，我就使他们出埃及地，领他们到旷野，
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore I led them out of Egypt and brought them into the wilderness.
verses.textEnEsv: So I led them out of the land of Egypt and brought them into the wilderness.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore I made them go out of the land of Egypt and brought them into the wilderness.
verses.textEnNlt: So I brought them out of Egypt and led them into the wilderness.
verses.textEnNasb: So I took them out of the land of Egypt and brought them into the wilderness.
verses.textEn: Therefore I led them out of Egypt and brought them into the wilderness.

verses.textZh: 我把我的律例赐给他们，把我的典章指示他们；人如果遵行，就必因此活着。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我把我的律例赐给他们，把我的典章指示他们；人如果遵行，就必因此活着。
verses.textZhCuv: 将我的律例赐给他们，将我的典章指示他们；人若遵行就必因此活着。
verses.textEnNiv: I gave them my decrees and made known to them my laws, by which the person who obeys them will live.
verses.textEnEsv: I gave them my statutes and made known to them my rules, by which, if a person does them, he shall live.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I gave them My statutes and showed them My judgments, ‘which, if a man does, he shall live by them.’
verses.textEnNlt: There I gave them my decrees and regulations so they could find life by keeping them.
verses.textEnNasb: I gave them My statutes and informed them of My ordinances, which, if a person follows them, then he will live by them.
verses.textEn: I gave them my decrees and made known to them my laws, by which the person who obeys them will live.

verses.textZh: 我又把我的安息日赐给他们，作我与他们之间的凭据，使他们知道我是使他们分别为圣的耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我又把我的安息日赐给他们，作我与他们之间的凭据，使他们知道我是使他们分别为圣的耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 又将我的安息日赐给他们，好在我与他们中间为证据，使他们知道我－耶和华是叫他们成为圣的。
verses.textEnNiv: Also I gave them my Sabbaths as a sign between us, so they would know that I the Lord made them holy.
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, I gave them my Sabbaths, as a sign between me and them, that they might know that I am the Lord who sanctifies them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover I also gave them My Sabbaths, to be a sign between them and Me, that they might know that I am the Lord who sanctifies them.
verses.textEnNlt: And I gave them my Sabbath days of rest as a sign between them and me. It was to remind them that I am the Lord , who had set them apart to be holy.
verses.textEnNasb: Also I gave them My Sabbaths to be a sign between Me and them, so that they might know that I am the Lord who sanctifies them.
verses.textEn: Also I gave them my Sabbaths as a sign between us, so they would know that I the Lord made them holy.

verses.textZh: 可是以色列家在旷野背叛了我，没有遵行我的律例，弃绝了我的典章 ，大大亵渎了我的安息日，那时我说我要把我的烈怒倒在他们身上，在旷野把他们灭绝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是以色列家在旷野背叛了我，没有遵行我的律例，弃绝了我的典章 ，大大亵渎了我的安息日，那时我说我要把我的烈怒倒在他们身上，在旷野把他们灭绝。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列家却在旷野悖逆我，不顺从我的律例，厌弃我的典章（人若遵行就必因此活着），大大干犯我的安息日。 「我就说，要在旷野将我的忿怒倾在他们身上，灭绝他们。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Yet the people of Israel rebelled against me in the wilderness. They did not follow my decrees but rejected my laws—by which the person who obeys them will live—and they utterly desecrated my Sabbaths. So I said I would pour out my wrath on them and destroy them in the wilderness.
verses.textEnEsv: But the house of Israel rebelled against me in the wilderness. They did not walk in my statutes but rejected my rules, by which, if a person does them, he shall live; and my Sabbaths they greatly profaned. "Then I said I would pour out my wrath upon them in the wilderness, to make a full end of them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet the house of Israel rebelled against Me in the wilderness; they did not walk in My statutes; they despised My judgments, ‘which, if a man does, he shall live by them’; and they greatly defiled My Sabbaths. Then I said I would pour out My fury on them in the wilderness, to consume them.
verses.textEnNlt: "But the people of Israel rebelled against me, and they refused to obey my decrees there in the wilderness. They wouldn’t obey my regulations even though obedience would have given them life. They also violated my Sabbath days. So I threatened to pour out my fury on them, and I made plans to utterly consume them in the wilderness.
verses.textEnNasb: But the house of Israel rebelled against Me in the wilderness. They did not walk in My statutes and they rejected My ordinances, which, if a person follows them, then he will live by them; and they greatly profaned My Sabbaths. Then I resolved to pour out My wrath on them in the wilderness, to annihilate them.
verses.textEn: " ‘Yet the people of Israel rebelled against me in the wilderness. They did not follow my decrees but rejected my laws—by which the person who obeys them will live—and they utterly desecrated my Sabbaths. So I said I would pour out my wrath on them and destroy them in the wilderness.

verses.textZh: 然而我为了我名的缘故没有这样作，免得我的名在列国的人眼中被亵渎；我曾在他们眼前把以色列人领出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而我为了我名的缘故没有这样作，免得我的名在列国的人眼中被亵渎；我曾在他们眼前把以色列人领出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 我却为我名的缘故，没有这样行，免得我的名在我领他们出埃及的列国人眼前被亵渎。
verses.textEnNiv: But for the sake of my name I did what would keep it from being profaned in the eyes of the nations in whose sight I had brought them out.
verses.textEnEsv: But I acted for the sake of my name, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations, in whose sight I had brought them out.
verses.textEnNkjv: But I acted for My name’s sake, that it should not be profaned before the Gentiles, in whose sight I had brought them out.
verses.textEnNlt: But again I held back in order to protect the honor of my name before the nations who had seen my power in bringing Israel out of Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: But I acted for the sake of My name, so that it would not be defiled before the eyes of the nations, before whose eyes I had brought them out.
verses.textEn: But for the sake of my name I did what would keep it from being profaned in the eyes of the nations in whose sight I had brought them out.

verses.textZh: 我在旷野也曾经向他们举手起誓，必不领他们到我赐给他们的流奶与蜜之地，就是万邦中最荣美的地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我在旷野也曾经向他们举手起誓，必不领他们到我赐给他们的流奶与蜜之地，就是万邦中最荣美的地。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且我在旷野向他们起誓，必不领他们进入我所赐给他们流奶与蜜之地（那地在万国中是有荣耀的）；
verses.textEnNiv: Also with uplifted hand I swore to them in the wilderness that I would not bring them into the land I had given them—a land flowing with milk and honey, the most beautiful of all lands—
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, I swore to them in the wilderness that I would not bring them into the land that I had given them, a land flowing with milk and honey, the most glorious of all lands,
verses.textEnNkjv: So I also raised My hand in an oath to them in the wilderness, that I would not bring them into the land which I had given them, ‘flowing with milk and honey,’ the glory of all lands,
verses.textEnNlt: But I took a solemn oath against them in the wilderness. I swore I would not bring them into the land I had given them, a land flowing with milk and honey, the most beautiful place on earth.
verses.textEnNasb: Also I swore to them in the wilderness that I would not bring them into the land which I had given them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all the lands,
verses.textEn: Also with uplifted hand I swore to them in the wilderness that I would not bring them into the land I had given them—a land flowing with milk and honey, the most beautiful of all lands—

verses.textZh: 因为他们弃绝了我的典章，没有遵行我的律例，亵渎了我的安息日；他们的心随从自己的偶像。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们弃绝了我的典章，没有遵行我的律例，亵渎了我的安息日；他们的心随从自己的偶像。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他们厌弃我的典章，不顺从我的律例，干犯我的安息日，他们的心随从自己的偶像。
verses.textEnNiv: because they rejected my laws and did not follow my decrees and desecrated my Sabbaths. For their hearts were devoted to their idols.
verses.textEnEsv: because they rejected my rules and did not walk in my statutes, and profaned my Sabbaths; for their heart went after their idols.
verses.textEnNkjv: because they despised My judgments and did not walk in My statutes, but profaned My Sabbaths; for their heart went after their idols.
verses.textEnNlt: For they had rejected my regulations, refused to follow my decrees, and violated my Sabbath days. Their hearts were given to their idols.
verses.textEnNasb: because they rejected My ordinances, and as for My statutes, they did not walk in them; they also profaned My Sabbaths, because their heart continually followed their idols.
verses.textEn: because they rejected my laws and did not follow my decrees and desecrated my Sabbaths. For their hearts were devoted to their idols.

verses.textZh: 虽然这样，我的眼还是顾惜他们，不毁灭他们；我没有在旷野把他们灭绝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 虽然这样，我的眼还是顾惜他们，不毁灭他们；我没有在旷野把他们灭绝。
verses.textZhCuv: 虽然如此，我眼仍顾惜他们，不毁灭他们，不在旷野将他们灭绝净尽。
verses.textEnNiv: Yet I looked on them with pity and did not destroy them or put an end to them in the wilderness.
verses.textEnEsv: Nevertheless, my eye spared them, and I did not destroy them or make a full end of them in the wilderness.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless My eye spared them from destruction. I did not make an end of them in the wilderness.
verses.textEnNlt: Nevertheless, I took pity on them and held back from destroying them in the wilderness.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet My eye spared them rather than destroying them, and I did not bring about their annihilation in the wilderness.
verses.textEn: Yet I looked on them with pity and did not destroy them or put an end to them in the wilderness.

verses.textZh: "‘我在旷野对他们的儿女说：不要遵行你们祖先的律例，不要谨守他们的典章，也不要因他们的偶像玷污自己。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘我在旷野对他们的儿女说：不要遵行你们祖先的律例，不要谨守他们的典章，也不要因他们的偶像玷污自己。
verses.textZhCuv: 「我在旷野对他们的儿女说：不要遵行你们父亲的律例，不要谨守他们的恶规，也不要因他们的偶像玷污自己。
verses.textEnNiv: I said to their children in the wilderness, "Do not follow the statutes of your parents or keep their laws or defile yourselves with their idols.
verses.textEnEsv: "And I said to their children in the wilderness, ‘Do not walk in the statutes of your fathers, nor keep their rules, nor defile yourselves with their idols.
verses.textEnNkjv: "But I said to their children in the wilderness, ‘Do not walk in the statutes of your fathers, nor observe their judgments, nor defile yourselves with their idols.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then I warned their children not to follow in their parents’ footsteps, defiling themselves with their idols.
verses.textEnNasb: "Instead, I said to their children in the wilderness, ‘Do not walk in the statutes of your fathers or keep their ordinances or defile yourselves with their idols.
verses.textEn: I said to their children in the wilderness, "Do not follow the statutes of your parents or keep their laws or defile yourselves with their idols.

verses.textZh: 我是耶和华你们的神；你们要遵行我的律例，谨守我的典章，把它们实行出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我是耶和华你们的神；你们要遵行我的律例，谨守我的典章，把它们实行出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 我是耶和华－你们的神，你们要顺从我的律例，谨守遵行我的典章，
verses.textEnNiv: I am the Lord your God; follow my decrees and be careful to keep my laws.
verses.textEnEsv: I am the Lord your God; walk in my statutes, and be careful to obey my rules,
verses.textEnNkjv: I am the Lord your God: Walk in My statutes, keep My judgments, and do them;
verses.textEnNlt: ‘I am the Lord your God,’ I told them. ‘Follow my decrees, pay attention to my regulations,
verses.textEnNasb: I am the Lord your God; walk in My statutes and keep My ordinances and follow them.
verses.textEn: I am the Lord your God; follow my decrees and be careful to keep my laws.

verses.textZh: 你们要把我的安息日分别为圣，作我与你们之间的凭据，使你们知道我是耶和华你们的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要把我的安息日分别为圣，作我与你们之间的凭据，使你们知道我是耶和华你们的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 且以我的安息日为圣。这日在我与你们中间为证据，使你们知道我是耶和华－你们的神。
verses.textEnNiv: Keep my Sabbaths holy, that they may be a sign between us. Then you will know that I am the Lord your God."
verses.textEnEsv: and keep my Sabbaths holy that they may be a sign between me and you, that you may know that I am the Lord your God.’
verses.textEnNkjv: hallow My Sabbaths, and they will be a sign between Me and you, that you may know that I am the Lord your God.’
verses.textEnNlt: and keep my Sabbath days holy, for they are a sign to remind you that I am the Lord your God.’
verses.textEnNasb: Sanctify My Sabbaths; and they shall be a sign between Me and you, so that you may know that I am the Lord your God.’
verses.textEn: Keep my Sabbaths holy, that they may be a sign between us. Then you will know that I am the Lord your God."

verses.textZh: 可是他们的儿女背叛了我，没有遵行我的律例，也没有谨守实行我的典章 ，亵渎了我的安息日；那时我说我要把我的烈怒倒在他们身上，在旷野向他们发尽我的怒气。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是他们的儿女背叛了我，没有遵行我的律例，也没有谨守实行我的典章 ，亵渎了我的安息日；那时我说我要把我的烈怒倒在他们身上，在旷野向他们发尽我的怒气。
verses.textZhCuv: 只是他们的儿女悖逆我，不顺从我的律例，也不谨守遵行我的典章（人若遵行就必因此活着），干犯我的安息日。 「我就说，要将我的忿怒倾在他们身上，在旷野向他们成就我怒中所定的。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘But the children rebelled against me: They did not follow my decrees, they were not careful to keep my laws, of which I said, "The person who obeys them will live by them," and they desecrated my Sabbaths. So I said I would pour out my wrath on them and spend my anger against them in the wilderness.
verses.textEnEsv: But the children rebelled against me. They did not walk in my statutes and were not careful to obey my rules, by which, if a person does them, he shall live; they profaned my Sabbaths. "Then I said I would pour out my wrath upon them and spend my anger against them in the wilderness.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Notwithstanding, the children rebelled against Me; they did not walk in My statutes, and were not careful to observe My judgments, ‘which, if a man does, he shall live by them’; but they profaned My Sabbaths. Then I said I would pour out My fury on them and fulfill My anger against them in the wilderness.
verses.textEnNlt: "But their children, too, rebelled against me. They refused to keep my decrees and follow my regulations, even though obedience would have given them life. And they also violated my Sabbath days. So again I threatened to pour out my fury on them in the wilderness.
verses.textEnNasb: But the children rebelled against Me; they did not walk in My statutes, nor were they careful to follow My ordinances which, if a person follows them, then he will live by them; they profaned My Sabbaths. So I resolved to pour out My wrath on them, to use up My anger against them in the wilderness.
verses.textEn: " ‘But the children rebelled against me: They did not follow my decrees, they were not careful to keep my laws, of which I said, "The person who obeys them will live by them," and they desecrated my Sabbaths. So I said I would pour out my wrath on them and spend my anger against them in the wilderness.

verses.textZh: 然而我为了我名的缘故缩手，没有这样作，免得我名在列国的人眼中被亵渎；我曾在他们眼前把以色列人领出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而我为了我名的缘故缩手，没有这样作，免得我名在列国的人眼中被亵渎；我曾在他们眼前把以色列人领出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 虽然如此，我却为我名的缘故缩手没有这样行，免得我的名在我领他们出埃及的列国人眼前被亵渎。
verses.textEnNiv: But I withheld my hand, and for the sake of my name I did what would keep it from being profaned in the eyes of the nations in whose sight I had brought them out.
verses.textEnEsv: But I withheld my hand and acted for the sake of my name, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the nations, in whose sight I had brought them out.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless I withdrew My hand and acted for My name’s sake, that it should not be profaned in the sight of the Gentiles, in whose sight I had brought them out.
verses.textEnNlt: Nevertheless, I withdrew my judgment against them to protect the honor of my name before the nations that had seen my power in bringing them out of Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: But I withdrew My hand and acted for the sake of My name, so that it would not be defiled in the sight of the nations in whose sight I had brought them out.
verses.textEn: But I withheld my hand, and for the sake of my name I did what would keep it from being profaned in the eyes of the nations in whose sight I had brought them out.

verses.textZh: 我在旷野也曾经向他们举手起誓，要把他们分散在列国，四散在万邦；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我在旷野也曾经向他们举手起誓，要把他们分散在列国，四散在万邦；
verses.textZhCuv: 并且我在旷野向他们起誓，必将他们分散在列国，四散在列邦；

verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, I swore to them in the wilderness that I would scatter them among the nations and disperse them through the countries,
verses.textEnNkjv: Also I raised My hand in an oath to those in the wilderness, that I would scatter them among the Gentiles and disperse them throughout the countries,
verses.textEnNlt: But I took a solemn oath against them in the wilderness. I swore I would scatter them among all the nations
verses.textEnNasb: Also I swore to them in the wilderness that I would scatter them among the nations and disperse them among the lands,
verses.textEn: Also with uplifted hand I swore to them in the wilderness that I would disperse them among the nations and scatter them through the countries,

verses.textZh: 因为他们没有遵守我的典章，弃绝了我的律例，亵渎了我的安息日，他们的眼目注视着他们祖先的偶像。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们没有遵守我的典章，弃绝了我的律例，亵渎了我的安息日，他们的眼目注视着他们祖先的偶像。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他们不遵行我的典章，竟厌弃我的律例，干犯我的安息日，眼目仰望他们父亲的偶像。
verses.textEnNiv: because they had not obeyed my laws but had rejected my decrees and desecrated my Sabbaths, and their eyes lusted after their parents’ idols.
verses.textEnEsv: because they had not obeyed my rules, but had rejected my statutes and profaned my Sabbaths, and their eyes were set on their fathers’ idols.
verses.textEnNkjv: because they had not executed My judgments, but had despised My statutes, profaned My Sabbaths, and their eyes were fixed on their fathers’ idols.
verses.textEnNlt: because they did not obey my regulations. They scorned my decrees by violating my Sabbath days and longing for the idols of their ancestors.
verses.textEnNasb: because they had not complied with My ordinances, but had rejected My statutes and had profaned My Sabbaths, and their eyes were on the idols of their fathers.
verses.textEn: because they had not obeyed my laws but had rejected my decrees and desecrated my Sabbaths, and their eyes lusted after their parents’ idols.

verses.textZh: 因此，我也把不好的律例和不能藉以存活的典章赐给他们；
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，我也把不好的律例和不能藉以存活的典章赐给他们；
verses.textZhCuv: 我也任他们遵行不美的律例，谨守不能使人活着的恶规。
verses.textEnNiv: So I gave them other statutes that were not good and laws through which they could not live;
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, I gave them statutes that were not good and rules by which they could not have life,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore I also gave them up to statutes thatwere not good, and judgments by which they could not live;
verses.textEnNlt: I gave them over to worthless decrees and regulations that would not lead to life.
verses.textEnNasb: I also gave them statutes that were not good, and ordinances by which they could not live;
verses.textEn: So I gave them other statutes that were not good and laws through which they could not live;

verses.textZh: 他们使所有头生的都经火作供物，所以我让他们玷污自己，好叫他们惊惶，知道我是耶和华。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们使所有头生的都经火作供物，所以我让他们玷污自己，好叫他们惊惶，知道我是耶和华。’
verses.textZhCuv: 因他们将一切头生的经火，我就任凭他们在这供献的事上玷污自己，好叫他们凄凉，使他们知道我是耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: I defiled them through their gifts—the sacrifice of every firstborn—that I might fill them with horror so they would know that I am the Lord .’
verses.textEnEsv: and I defiled them through their very gifts in their offering up all their firstborn, that I might devastate them. I did it that they might know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: and I pronounced them unclean because of their ritual gifts, in that they caused all their firstborn to pass through thefire, that I might make them desolate and that they might know that I am the Lord." ’
verses.textEnNlt: I let them pollute themselves with the very gifts I had given them, and I allowed them to give their firstborn children as offerings to their gods—so I might devastate them and remind them that I alone am the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: and I pronounced them unclean because of their gifts, in that they made all their firstborn pass through the fire so that I might make them desolate, in order that they might know that I am the Lord." ’
verses.textEn: I defiled them through their gifts—the sacrifice of every firstborn—that I might fill them with horror so they would know that I am the Lord .’

verses.textZh: "因此，人子啊！你要告诉以色列家，对他们说：‘主耶和华这样说：你们的列祖在对我不忠的这事上亵渎了我。
verses.textZhCnvs: "因此，人子啊！你要告诉以色列家，对他们说：‘主耶和华这样说：你们的列祖在对我不忠的这事上亵渎了我。
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，你要告诉以色列家说，主耶和华如此说：你们的列祖在得罪我的事上亵渎我；
verses.textEnNiv: "Therefore, son of man, speak to the people of Israel and say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: In this also your ancestors blasphemed me by being unfaithful to me:
verses.textEnEsv: "Therefore, son of man, speak to the house of Israel and say to them, Thus says the Lord God : In this also your fathers blasphemed me, by dealing treacherously with me.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore, son of man, speak to the house of Israel, and say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord God: "In this too your fathers have blasphemed Me, by being unfaithful to Me.
verses.textEnNlt: "Therefore, son of man, give the people of Israel this message from the Sovereign Lord : Your ancestors continued to blaspheme and betray me,
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore speak to the house of Israel, son of man, and say to them, ‘This is what the Lord God says: "Again, in this your fathers have blasphemed Me by being disloyal to Me.
verses.textEn: "Therefore, son of man, speak to the people of Israel and say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: In this also your ancestors blasphemed me by being unfaithful to me:

verses.textZh: 我领他们到了我曾经举手起誓要赐给他们的那地，他们看见各高山和茂盛的树林，就在那里献祭，在那里奉上惹我发怒的供物，也在那里献上馨香的祭，并且在那里浇上他们的奠祭。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 我领他们到了我曾经举手起誓要赐给他们的那地，他们看见各高山和茂盛的树林，就在那里献祭，在那里奉上惹我发怒的供物，也在那里献上馨香的祭，并且在那里浇上他们的奠祭。’
verses.textZhCuv: 因为我领他们到了我起誓应许赐给他们的地，他们看见各高山、各茂密树，就在那里献祭，奉上惹我发怒的供物，也在那里焚烧馨香的祭牲，并浇上奠祭。
verses.textEnNiv: When I brought them into the land I had sworn to give them and they saw any high hill or any leafy tree, there they offered their sacrifices, made offerings that aroused my anger, presented their fragrant incense and poured out their drink offerings.
verses.textEnEsv: For when I had brought them into the land that I swore to give them, then wherever they saw any high hill or any leafy tree, there they offered their sacrifices and there they presented the provocation of their offering; there they sent up their pleasing aromas, and there they poured out their drink offerings.
verses.textEnNkjv: When I brought them into the land concerning which I had raised My hand in an oath to give them, and they saw all the high hills and all the thick trees, there they offered their sacrifices and provoked Me with their offerings. There they also sent up their sweet aroma and poured out their drink offerings.
verses.textEnNlt: for when I brought them into the land I had promised them, they offered sacrifices on every high hill and under every green tree they saw! They roused my fury as they offered up sacrifices to their gods. They brought their perfumes and incense and poured out their liquid offerings to them.
verses.textEnNasb: When I had brought them into the land which I swore to give to them, then they saw every high hill and every tree thick with branches, and there they offered their sacrifices and there they presented the provocation of their offering. There also they made their soothing aroma and there they poured out their drink offerings.
verses.textEn: When I brought them into the land I had sworn to give them and they saw any high hill or any leafy tree, there they offered their sacrifices, made offerings that aroused my anger, presented their fragrant incense and poured out their drink offerings.

verses.textZh: 我问他们：‘你们所去的那高处是甚么地方？’于是那高处的名字叫巴麻，直到今日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我问他们：‘你们所去的那高处是甚么地方？’于是那高处的名字叫巴麻，直到今日。
verses.textZhCuv: 我就对他们说：你们所上的那高处叫什么呢？（那高处的名字叫巴麻直到今日。）
verses.textEnNiv: Then I said to them: What is this high place you go to?’ " (It is called Bamah to this day.)
verses.textEnEsv: (I said to them, ‘What is the high place to which you go?’ So its name is called Bamah to this day.)
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I said to them, ‘What is this high place to which you go?’ So its name is called Bamah to this day." ’
verses.textEnNlt: I said to them, ‘What is this high place where you are going?’ (This kind of pagan shrine has been called Bamah—‘high place’—ever since.)
verses.textEnNasb: Then I said to them, ‘What is the high place to which you go?’ So its name is called Bamah to this day." ’
verses.textEn: Then I said to them: What is this high place you go to?’ " (It is called Bamah to this day.)

verses.textZh: 因此，你要对以色列家说：‘主耶和华这样说：你们还照着你们祖先所行的玷污自己吗？仍随着他们可憎的偶像行邪淫吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，你要对以色列家说：‘主耶和华这样说：你们还照着你们祖先所行的玷污自己吗？仍随着他们可憎的偶像行邪淫吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 所以你要对以色列家说，主耶和华如此说：你们仍照你们列祖所行的玷污自己吗？仍照他们可憎的事行邪淫吗？
verses.textEnNiv: "Therefore say to the Israelites: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Will you defile yourselves the way your ancestors did and lust after their vile images?
verses.textEnEsv: "Therefore say to the house of Israel, Thus says the Lord God : Will you defile yourselves after the manner of your fathers and go whoring after their detestable things?
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore say to the house of Israel, ‘Thus says the Lord God: "Are you defiling yourselves in the manner of your fathers, and committing harlotry according to their abominations?
verses.textEnNlt: "Therefore, give the people of Israel this message from the Sovereign Lord : Do you plan to pollute yourselves just as your ancestors did? Do you intend to keep prostituting yourselves by worshiping vile images?
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, say to the house of Israel, ‘This is what the Lord God says: "Will you defile yourselves in the way of your fathers and adulterously pursue their detestable things?
verses.textEn: "Therefore say to the Israelites: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Will you defile yourselves the way your ancestors did and lust after their vile images?

verses.textZh: 你们奉上供物，使你们的儿子经火，用你们的一切偶像玷污自己，直到今日。以色列家啊，我怎能让你们向我求问呢？主耶和华说：我指着我的永生起誓：我决不让你们向我求问。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们奉上供物，使你们的儿子经火，用你们的一切偶像玷污自己，直到今日。以色列家啊，我怎能让你们向我求问呢？主耶和华说：我指着我的永生起誓：我决不让你们向我求问。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们奉上供物使你们儿子经火的时候，仍将一切偶像玷污自己，直到今日吗？以色列家啊，我岂被你们求问吗？主耶和华说：我指着我的永生起誓，我必不被你们求问。
verses.textEnNiv: When you offer your gifts—the sacrifice of your children in the fire—you continue to defile yourselves with all your idols to this day. Am I to let you inquire of me, you Israelites? As surely as I live, declares the Sovereign Lord , I will not let you inquire of me.
verses.textEnEsv: When you present your gifts and offer up your children in fire, you defile yourselves with all your idols to this day. And shall I be inquired of by you, O house of Israel? As I live, declares the Lord God , I will not be inquired of by you.
verses.textEnNkjv: For when you offer your gifts and make your sons pass through the fire, you defile yourselves with all your idols, even to this day. So shall I be inquired of by you, O house of Israel? As I live," says the Lord God, "I will not be inquired of by you.
verses.textEnNlt: For when you offer gifts to them and give your little children to be burned as sacrifices, you continue to pollute yourselves with idols to this day. Should I allow you to ask for a message from me, O people of Israel? As surely as I live, says the Sovereign Lord , I will tell you nothing.
verses.textEnNasb: And when you offer your gifts, when you make your sons pass through the fire, you are defiling yourselves with all your idols to this day. So shall I be inquired of by you, house of Israel? As I live," declares the Lord God, "I certainly will not be inquired of by you.
verses.textEn: When you offer your gifts—the sacrifice of your children in the fire—you continue to defile yourselves with all your idols to this day. Am I to let you inquire of me, you Israelites? As surely as I live, declares the Sovereign Lord , I will not let you inquire of me.

verses.textZh: 你们说：我们要像列国的人，像列邦的各族一样去事奉木头和石头。你们心里所起的这意念，必不能成就。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们说：我们要像列国的人，像列邦的各族一样去事奉木头和石头。你们心里所起的这意念，必不能成就。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们说：我们要像外邦人和列国的宗族一样，去事奉木头与石头。你们所起的这心意万不能成就。」
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘You say, "We want to be like the nations, like the peoples of the world, who serve wood and stone." But what you have in mind will never happen.
verses.textEnEsv: "What is in your mind shall never happen—the thought, ‘Let us be like the nations, like the tribes of the countries, and worship wood and stone.’
verses.textEnNkjv: What you have in your mind shall never be, when you say, ‘We will be like the Gentiles, like the families in other countries, serving wood and stone.’
verses.textEnNlt: "You say, ‘We want to be like the nations all around us, who serve idols of wood and stone.’ But what you have in mind will never happen.
verses.textEnNasb: And whatever comes into your mind certainly will not come about, when you say: ‘We will be like the nations, like the families of the lands, serving wood and stone.’
verses.textEn: " ‘You say, "We want to be like the nations, like the peoples of the world, who serve wood and stone." But what you have in mind will never happen.

verses.textZh: "‘我指着我的永生起誓：我必用大能的手，伸出来的膀臂，以及倒出来的烈怒，统治你们。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘我指着我的永生起誓：我必用大能的手，伸出来的膀臂，以及倒出来的烈怒，统治你们。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华说：「我指着我的永生起誓，我总要作王，用大能的手和伸出来的膀臂，并倾出来的忿怒，治理你们。
verses.textEnNiv: As surely as I live, declares the Sovereign Lord , I will reign over you with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm and with outpoured wrath.
verses.textEnEsv: "As I live, declares the Lord God , surely with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm and with wrath poured out I will be king over you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "As I live," says the Lord God, "surely with a mighty hand, with an outstretched arm, and with fury poured out, I will rule over you.
verses.textEnNlt: As surely as I live, says the Sovereign Lord , I will rule over you with an iron fist in great anger and with awesome power.
verses.textEnNasb: "As I live," declares the Lord God, "with a mighty hand and with an outstretched arm and with wrath poured out, I assuredly shall be king over you.
verses.textEn: As surely as I live, declares the Sovereign Lord , I will reign over you with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm and with outpoured wrath.

verses.textZh: 我必用大能的手，伸出来的膀臂，以及倒出来的烈怒，把你们从万族中领出来，从你们所分散到的列邦招聚你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必用大能的手，伸出来的膀臂，以及倒出来的烈怒，把你们从万族中领出来，从你们所分散到的列邦招聚你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必用大能的手和伸出来的膀臂，并倾出来的忿怒，将你们从万民中领出来，从分散的列国内聚集你们。
verses.textEnNiv: I will bring you from the nations and gather you from the countries where you have been scattered—with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm and with outpoured wrath.
verses.textEnEsv: I will bring you out from the peoples and gather you out of the countries where you are scattered, with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm, and with wrath poured out.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will bring you out from the peoples and gather you out of the countries where you are scattered, with a mighty hand, with an outstretched arm, and with fury poured out.
verses.textEnNlt: And in anger I will reach out with my strong hand and powerful arm, and I will bring you back from the lands where you are scattered.
verses.textEnNasb: I will bring you out from the peoples and gather you from the lands where you are scattered, with a mighty hand and with an outstretched arm and with wrath poured out;
verses.textEn: I will bring you from the nations and gather you from the countries where you have been scattered—with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm and with outpoured wrath.

verses.textZh: 我要把你们带到万族的旷野，在那里当面审判你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要把你们带到万族的旷野，在那里当面审判你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必带你们到外邦人的旷野，在那里当面刑罚你们。
verses.textEnNiv: I will bring you into the wilderness of the nations and there, face to face, I will execute judgment upon you.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will bring you into the wilderness of the peoples, and there I will enter into judgment with you face to face.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will bring you into the wilderness of the peoples, and there I will plead My case with you face to face.
verses.textEnNlt: I will bring you into the wilderness of the nations, and there I will judge you face to face.
verses.textEnNasb: and I will bring you into the wilderness of the peoples, and there I will enter into judgment with you face to face.
verses.textEn: I will bring you into the wilderness of the nations and there, face to face, I will execute judgment upon you.

verses.textZh: 我怎样在埃及地的旷野审判你们的祖先，也必怎样审判你们。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我怎样在埃及地的旷野审判你们的祖先，也必怎样审判你们。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 我怎样在埃及地的旷野刑罚你们的列祖，也必照样刑罚你们。这是主耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: As I judged your ancestors in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so I will judge you, declares the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: As I entered into judgment with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so I will enter into judgment with you, declares the Lord God .
verses.textEnNkjv: Just as I pleaded My case with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so I will plead My case with you," says the Lord God.
verses.textEnNlt: I will judge you there just as I did your ancestors in the wilderness after bringing them out of Egypt, says the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Just as I entered into judgment with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so I will enter into judgment with you," declares the Lord God.
verses.textEn: As I judged your ancestors in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so I will judge you, declares the Sovereign Lord .

verses.textZh: 我必使你们从牧人的杖下经过，使你们进入盟约的约束。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必使你们从牧人的杖下经过，使你们进入盟约的约束。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必使你们从杖下经过，使你们被约拘束。
verses.textEnNiv: I will take note of you as you pass under my rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant.
verses.textEnEsv: I will make you pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I will make you pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant;
verses.textEnNlt: I will examine you carefully and hold you to the terms of the covenant.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will make you pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant;
verses.textEn: I will take note of you as you pass under my rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant.

verses.textZh: 我必从你们中间除净那些背叛和得罪我的人，我虽把他们从寄居之地领出来，可是他们不得进入以色列地；这样，你们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必从你们中间除净那些背叛和得罪我的人，我虽把他们从寄居之地领出来，可是他们不得进入以色列地；这样，你们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必从你们中间除净叛逆和得罪我的人，将他们从所寄居的地方领出来，他们却不得入以色列地。你们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: I will purge you of those who revolt and rebel against me. Although I will bring them out of the land where they are living, yet they will not enter the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: I will purge out the rebels from among you, and those who transgress against me. I will bring them out of the land where they sojourn, but they shall not enter the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: I will purge the rebels from among you, and those who transgress against Me; I will bring them out of the country where they dwell, but they shall not enter the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: I will purge you of all those who rebel and revolt against me. I will bring them out of the countries where they are in exile, but they will never enter the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: and I will purge from you the rebels and those who revolt against Me; I will bring them out of the land where they reside, but they will not enter the land of Israel. So you will know that I am the Lord.
verses.textEn: I will purge you of those who revolt and rebel against me. Although I will bring them out of the land where they are living, yet they will not enter the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am the Lord .

verses.textZh: 以色列家啊，至于你们，主耶和华这样说：你们各人去事奉自己的偶像吧！只是将来你们必要听从我，不可再以你们的供物和偶像亵渎我的圣名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列家啊，至于你们，主耶和华这样说：你们各人去事奉自己的偶像吧！只是将来你们必要听从我，不可再以你们的供物和偶像亵渎我的圣名。
verses.textZhCuv: 「以色列家啊，至于你们，主耶和华如此说：从此以后若不听从我，就任凭你们去事奉偶像，只是不可再因你们的供物和偶像亵渎我的圣名。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘As for you, people of Israel, this is what the Sovereign Lord says: Go and serve your idols, every one of you! But afterward you will surely listen to me and no longer profane my holy name with your gifts and idols.
verses.textEnEsv: "As for you, O house of Israel, thus says the Lord God : Go serve every one of you his idols, now and hereafter, if you will not listen to me; but my holy name you shall no more profane with your gifts and your idols.
verses.textEnNkjv: "As for you, O house of Israel," thus says the Lord God: "Go, serve every one of you his idols—and hereafter—if you will not obey Me; but profane My holy name no more with your gifts and your idols.
verses.textEnNlt: "As for you, O people of Israel, this is what the Sovereign Lord says: Go right ahead and worship your idols, but sooner or later you will obey me and will stop bringing shame on my holy name by worshiping idols.
verses.textEnNasb: "As for you, house of Israel," this is what the Lord God says: "Go, serve, everyone of you his idols; but later you will certainly listen to Me, and My holy name you will no longer defile with your gifts and your idols.
verses.textEn: " ‘As for you, people of Israel, this is what the Sovereign Lord says: Go and serve your idols, every one of you! But afterward you will surely listen to me and no longer profane my holy name with your gifts and idols.

verses.textZh: 在我的圣山，就是在以色列的高山，以色列全家所有的人都要在那地事奉我；我要在那里悦纳他们；在那里向你们要举祭和初熟的土产，以及一切圣物。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在我的圣山，就是在以色列的高山，以色列全家所有的人都要在那地事奉我；我要在那里悦纳他们；在那里向你们要举祭和初熟的土产，以及一切圣物。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 「主耶和华说：在我的圣山，就是以色列高处的山，所有以色列的全家都要事奉我。我要在那里悦纳你们，向你们要供物和初熟的土产，并一切的圣物。
verses.textEnNiv: For on my holy mountain, the high mountain of Israel, declares the Sovereign Lord , there in the land all the people of Israel will serve me, and there I will accept them. There I will require your offerings and your choice gifts, along with all your holy sacrifices.
verses.textEnEsv: "For on my holy mountain, the mountain height of Israel, declares the Lord God , there all the house of Israel, all of them, shall serve me in the land. There I will accept them, and there I will require your contributions and the choicest of your gifts, with all your sacred offerings.
verses.textEnNkjv: For on My holy mountain, on the mountain height of Israel," says the Lord God, "there all the house of Israel, all of them in the land, shall serve Me; there I will accept them, and there I will require your offerings and the firstfruits of your sacrifices, together with all your holy things.
verses.textEnNlt: For on my holy mountain, the great mountain of Israel, says the Sovereign Lord , the people of Israel will someday worship me, and I will accept them. There I will require that you bring me all your offerings and choice gifts and sacrifices.
verses.textEnNasb: For on My holy mountain, on the high mountain of Israel," declares the Lord God, "there the entire house of Israel, all of them, will serve Me in the land; there I will accept them and there I will demand your contributions and the choicest of your gifts, with all your holy things.
verses.textEn: For on my holy mountain, the high mountain of Israel, declares the Sovereign Lord , there in the land all the people of Israel will serve me, and there I will accept them. There I will require your offerings and your choice gifts, along with all your holy sacrifices.

verses.textZh: 我从万族中把你们领出来，从你们所分散到的列邦召集你们的时候，我必悦纳你们，好象悦纳馨香的祭一样。我要在列国的人眼前，在你们中间显为圣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我从万族中把你们领出来，从你们所分散到的列邦召集你们的时候，我必悦纳你们，好象悦纳馨香的祭一样。我要在列国的人眼前，在你们中间显为圣。
verses.textZhCuv: 我从万民中领你们出来，从分散的列国内聚集你们，那时我必悦纳你们好像馨香之祭，要在外邦人眼前在你们身上显为圣。
verses.textEnNiv: I will accept you as fragrant incense when I bring you out from the nations and gather you from the countries where you have been scattered, and I will be proved holy through you in the sight of the nations.
verses.textEnEsv: As a pleasing aroma I will accept you, when I bring you out from the peoples and gather you out of the countries where you have been scattered. And I will manifest my holiness among you in the sight of the nations.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will accept you as a sweet aroma when I bring you out from the peoples and gather you out of the countries where you have been scattered; and I will be hallowed in you before the Gentiles.
verses.textEnNlt: When I bring you home from exile, you will be like a pleasing sacrifice to me. And I will display my holiness through you as all the nations watch.
verses.textEnNasb: As a soothing aroma I will accept you when I bring you out from the peoples and gather you from the lands where you are scattered; and I will show Myself to be holy among you in the sight of the nations.
verses.textEn: I will accept you as fragrant incense when I bring you out from the nations and gather you from the countries where you have been scattered, and I will be proved holy through you in the sight of the nations.

verses.textZh: 我领你们进入以色列地，就是进入我曾经举手起誓要赐给你们祖先的地以后，你们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我领你们进入以色列地，就是进入我曾经举手起誓要赐给你们祖先的地以后，你们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 我领你们进入以色列地，就是我起誓应许赐给你们列祖之地，那时你们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: Then you will know that I am the Lord , when I bring you into the land of Israel, the land I had sworn with uplifted hand to give to your ancestors.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall know that I am the Lord , when I bring you into the land of Israel, the country that I swore to give to your fathers.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then you shall know that I am the Lord, when I bring you into the land of Israel, into the country for which I raised My hand in an oath to give to your fathers.
verses.textEnNlt: Then when I have brought you home to the land I promised with a solemn oath to give to your ancestors, you will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: And you will know that I am the Lord, when I bring you into the land of Israel, into the land which I swore to give to your forefathers.
verses.textEn: Then you will know that I am the Lord , when I bring you into the land of Israel, the land I had sworn with uplifted hand to give to your ancestors.

verses.textZh: 在那里你们要想起你们玷污自己的所作所为，又要为了自己所行的一切恶事而厌恶自己。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那里你们要想起你们玷污自己的所作所为，又要为了自己所行的一切恶事而厌恶自己。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们在那里要追念玷污自己的行动作为，又要因所做的一切恶事厌恶自己。
verses.textEnNiv: There you will remember your conduct and all the actions by which you have defiled yourselves, and you will loathe yourselves for all the evil you have done.
verses.textEnEsv: And there you shall remember your ways and all your deeds with which you have defiled yourselves, and you shall loathe yourselves for all the evils that you have committed.
verses.textEnNkjv: And there you shall remember your ways and all your doings with which you were defiled; and you shall loathe yourselves in your own sight because of all the evils that you have committed.
verses.textEnNlt: You will look back on all the ways you defiled yourselves and will hate yourselves because of the evil you have done.
verses.textEnNasb: And there you will remember your ways and all your deeds by which you have defiled yourselves; and you will loathe yourselves in your own sight for all the evil things that you have done.
verses.textEn: There you will remember your conduct and all the actions by which you have defiled yourselves, and you will loathe yourselves for all the evil you have done.

verses.textZh: 以色列家啊！为了我名的缘故，我没有照着你们的恶行和败坏的行为待你们，这样，你们就知道我是耶和华。这是主耶和华的宣告。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列家啊！为了我名的缘故，我没有照着你们的恶行和败坏的行为待你们，这样，你们就知道我是耶和华。这是主耶和华的宣告。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华说：以色列家啊，我为我名的缘故，不照着你们的恶行和你们的坏事待你们；你们就知道我是耶和华。」
verses.textEnNiv: You will know that I am the Lord , when I deal with you for my name’s sake and not according to your evil ways and your corrupt practices, you people of Israel, declares the Sovereign Lord .’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall know that I am the Lord , when I deal with you for my name’s sake, not according to your evil ways, nor according to your corrupt deeds, O house of Israel, declares the Lord God ."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then you shall know that I am the Lord, when I have dealt with you for My name’s sake, not according to your wicked ways nor according to your corrupt doings, O house of Israel," says the Lord God.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: You will know that I am the Lord , O people of Israel, when I have honored my name by treating you mercifully in spite of your wickedness. I, the Sovereign Lord , have spoken!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then you will know that I am the Lord, when I have dealt with you in behalf of My name, not according to your evil ways or according to your corrupt deeds, house of Israel," declares the Lord God.’ "
verses.textEn: You will know that I am the Lord , when I deal with you for my name’s sake and not according to your evil ways and your corrupt practices, you people of Israel, declares the Sovereign Lord .’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: And the word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnNkjv: Furthermore the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then this message came to me from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: Now the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: The word of the Lord came to me:
