verses.textZh: "人子啊！你要面向南方，向南面发言，说预言攻击南地田野的树林，
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！你要面向南方，向南面发言，说预言攻击南地田野的树林，
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，你要面向南方，向南滴下预言攻击南方田野的树林。
verses.textEnNiv: "Son of man, set your face toward the south; preach against the south and prophesy against the forest of the southland.
verses.textEnEsv: "Son of man, set your face toward the southland; preach against the south, and prophesy against the forest land in the Negeb.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Son of man, set your face toward the south; preach against the south and prophesy against the forest land, the South,
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, turn and face the south and speak out against it; prophesy against the brushlands of the Negev.
verses.textEnNasb: "Son of man, set your face toward the south, and speak prophetically against the south and prophesy against the forest land of the Negev,
verses.textEn: "Son of man, set your face toward the south; preach against the south and prophesy against the forest of the southland.

verses.textZh: 对南地的树林说：‘你要听耶和华的话，主耶和华这样说：看哪！我要在你中间点起火来，吞灭你中间所有青绿和枯干的树；猛烈的火焰必不熄灭；从南到北遍地都要烧焦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 对南地的树林说：‘你要听耶和华的话，主耶和华这样说：看哪！我要在你中间点起火来，吞灭你中间所有青绿和枯干的树；猛烈的火焰必不熄灭；从南到北遍地都要烧焦。
verses.textZhCuv: 对南方的树林说，要听耶和华的话。主耶和华如此说：我必使火在你中间着起，烧灭你中间的一切青树和枯树，猛烈的火焰必不熄灭。从南到北，人的脸面都被烧焦。
verses.textEnNiv: Say to the southern forest: ‘Hear the word of the Lord . This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I am about to set fire to you, and it will consume all your trees, both green and dry. The blazing flame will not be quenched, and every face from south to north will be scorched by it.
verses.textEnEsv: Say to the forest of the Negeb, Hear the word of the Lord : Thus says the Lord God , Behold, I will kindle a fire in you, and it shall devour every green tree in you and every dry tree. The blazing flame shall not be quenched, and all faces from south to north shall be scorched by it.
verses.textEnNkjv: and say to the forest of the South, ‘Hear the word of the Lord! Thus says the Lord God: "Behold, I will kindle a fire in you, and it shall devour every green tree and every dry tree in you; the blazing flame shall not be quenched, and all faces from the south to the north shall be scorched by it.
verses.textEnNlt: Tell the southern wilderness, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Hear the word of the Lord ! I will set you on fire, and every tree, both green and dry, will be burned. The terrible flames will not be quenched and will scorch everything from south to north.
verses.textEnNasb: and say to the forest of the Negev, ‘Hear the word of the Lord: this is what the Lord God says: "Behold, I am going to kindle a fire in you, and it will consume every green tree in you, as well as every dry tree; the blazing flame will not go out and the entire surface from south to north will be scorched by it.
verses.textEn: Say to the southern forest: ‘Hear the word of the Lord . This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I am about to set fire to you, and it will consume all your trees, both green and dry. The blazing flame will not be quenched, and every face from south to north will be scorched by it.

verses.textZh: 所有的人都必看见是我耶和华使这火燃起来；这火必不熄灭。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有的人都必看见是我耶和华使这火燃起来；这火必不熄灭。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 凡有血气的都必知道是我－耶和华使火着起，这火必不熄灭。」
verses.textEnNiv: Everyone will see that I the Lord have kindled it; it will not be quenched.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: All flesh shall see that I the Lord have kindled it; it shall not be quenched."
verses.textEnNkjv: All flesh shall see that I, the Lord, have kindled it; it shall not be quenched." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: And everyone in the world will see that I, the Lord , have set this fire. It will not be put out.’"
verses.textEnNasb: And all mankind will see that I, the Lord, have kindled it; it will not go out." ’ "
verses.textEn: Everyone will see that I the Lord have kindled it; it will not be quenched.’ "

verses.textZh: 于是我说："啊，主耶和华啊！人都指着我说：‘这人不是在说比喻吗？’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是我说："啊，主耶和华啊！人都指着我说：‘这人不是在说比喻吗？’"
verses.textZhCuv: 于是我说：「哎！主耶和华啊，人都指着我说：他岂不是说比喻的吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: Then I said, "Sovereign Lord , they are saying of me, ‘Isn’t he just telling parables?’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Then I said, "Ah, Lord God ! They are saying of me, ‘Is he not a maker of parables?’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I said, "Ah, Lord God! They say of me, ‘Does he not speak parables?’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Then I said, "O Sovereign Lord , they are saying of me, ‘He only talks in riddles!’"
verses.textEnNasb: Then I said, "Oh, Lord God! They are saying of me, ‘Is he not just speaking in riddles?’ "
verses.textEn: Then I said, "Sovereign Lord , they are saying of me, ‘Isn’t he just telling parables?’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnNkjv: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then this message came to me from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: The word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: "人子啊！你要面向耶路撒冷，向圣所发言，说预言攻击以色列地，
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！你要面向耶路撒冷，向圣所发言，说预言攻击以色列地，
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，你要面向耶路撒冷和圣所滴下预言，攻击以色列地。
verses.textEnNiv: "Son of man, set your face against Jerusalem and preach against the sanctuary. Prophesy against the land of Israel
verses.textEnEsv: "Son of man, set your face toward Jerusalem and preach against the sanctuaries. Prophesy against the land of Israel
verses.textEnNkjv: "Son of man, set your face toward Jerusalem, preach against the holy places, and prophesy against the land of Israel;
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, turn and face Jerusalem and prophesy against Israel and her sanctuaries.
verses.textEnNasb: "Son of man, set your face against Jerusalem, and speak prophetically against the sanctuaries and prophesy against the land of Israel;
verses.textEn: "Son of man, set your face against Jerusalem and preach against the sanctuary. Prophesy against the land of Israel

verses.textZh: 你要对以色列地说：‘耶和华这样说：看哪！我要攻击你；我要拔刀出鞘，把义人和恶人都从你那里剪除。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要对以色列地说：‘耶和华这样说：看哪！我要攻击你；我要拔刀出鞘，把义人和恶人都从你那里剪除。
verses.textZhCuv: 对以色列地说，耶和华如此说：我与你为敌，并要拔刀出鞘，从你中间将义人和恶人一并剪除。
verses.textEnNiv: and say to her: ‘This is what the Lord says: I am against you. I will draw my sword from its sheath and cut off from you both the righteous and the wicked.
verses.textEnEsv: and say to the land of Israel, Thus says the Lord : Behold, I am against you and will draw my sword from its sheath and will cut off from you both righteous and wicked.
verses.textEnNkjv: and say to the land of Israel, ‘Thus says the Lord: "Behold, I am against you, and I will draw My sword out of its sheath and cut off both righteous and wicked from you.
verses.textEnNlt: Tell her, ‘This is what the Lord says: I am your enemy, O Israel, and I am about to unsheath my sword to destroy your people—the righteous and the wicked alike.
verses.textEnNasb: and say to the land of Israel, ‘This is what the Lord says: "Behold, I am against you; and I will draw My sword from its sheath and cut off from you the righteous and the wicked.
verses.textEn: and say to her: ‘This is what the Lord says: I am against you. I will draw my sword from its sheath and cut off from you both the righteous and the wicked.

verses.textZh: 我既然要把义人和恶人都从你那里剪除，所以我的刀必要出鞘，从南到北攻击所有的人；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我既然要把义人和恶人都从你那里剪除，所以我的刀必要出鞘，从南到北攻击所有的人；
verses.textZhCuv: 我既要从你中间剪除义人和恶人，所以我的刀要出鞘，自南至北攻击一切有血气的；
verses.textEnNiv: Because I am going to cut off the righteous and the wicked, my sword will be unsheathed against everyone from south to north.
verses.textEnEsv: Because I will cut off from you both righteous and wicked, therefore my sword shall be drawn from its sheath against all flesh from south to north.
verses.textEnNkjv: Because I will cut off both righteous and wicked from you, therefore My sword shall go out of its sheath against all flesh from south to north,
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, I will cut off both the righteous and the wicked! I will draw my sword against everyone in the land from south to north.
verses.textEnNasb: Because I will cut off from you the righteous and the wicked, therefore My sword will go out from its sheath against humanity from south to north.
verses.textEn: Because I am going to cut off the righteous and the wicked, my sword will be unsheathed against everyone from south to north.

verses.textZh: 所有的人就知道我耶和华已经拔刀出鞘，刀必不再入鞘了。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有的人就知道我耶和华已经拔刀出鞘，刀必不再入鞘了。’
verses.textZhCuv: 一切有血气的就知道我－耶和华已经拔刀出鞘，必不再入鞘。
verses.textEnNiv: Then all people will know that I the Lord have drawn my sword from its sheath; it will not return again.’
verses.textEnEsv: And all flesh shall know that I am the Lord . I have drawn my sword from its sheath; it shall not be sheathed again.
verses.textEnNkjv: that all flesh may know that I, the Lord, have drawn My sword out of its sheath; it shall not return anymore." ’
verses.textEnNlt: Everyone in the world will know that I am the Lord . My sword is in my hand, and it will not return to its sheath until its work is finished.’
verses.textEnNasb: So humanity will know that I, the Lord, have drawn My sword from its sheath. It will not return to its sheath again." ’
verses.textEn: Then all people will know that I the Lord have drawn my sword from its sheath; it will not return again.’

verses.textZh: 人子啊！至于你，你要叹息，在他们眼前弯着腰，苦苦叹息。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人子啊！至于你，你要叹息，在他们眼前弯着腰，苦苦叹息。
verses.textZhCuv: 人子啊，你要叹息，在他们眼前弯着腰，苦苦地叹息。
verses.textEnNiv: "Therefore groan, son of man! Groan before them with broken heart and bitter grief.
verses.textEnEsv: "As for you, son of man, groan; with breaking heart and bitter grief, groan before their eyes.
verses.textEnNkjv: Sigh therefore, son of man, with a breaking heart, and sigh with bitterness before their eyes.
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, groan before the people! Groan before them with bitter anguish and a broken heart.
verses.textEnNasb: As for you, son of man, groan with a breaking heart and bitter grief; you shall groan in their sight.
verses.textEn: "Therefore groan, son of man! Groan before them with broken heart and bitter grief.

verses.textZh: 他们如果问你：‘你为甚么叹息呢？’你就要回答：‘是因为那将要来到的消息；人人都必心慌意乱，手都发软，精神衰颓，他们的膝都像水一般的柔弱。看哪！它要来到了。这事一定要成就。这是主耶和华的宣告。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们如果问你：‘你为甚么叹息呢？’你就要回答：‘是因为那将要来到的消息；人人都必心慌意乱，手都发软，精神衰颓，他们的膝都像水一般的柔弱。看哪！它要来到了。这事一定要成就。这是主耶和华的宣告。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们问你说：『为何叹息呢？』你就说：『因为有风声、灾祸要来。人心都必消化，手都发软，精神衰败，膝弱如水。看哪，这灾祸临近，必然成就。这是主耶和华说的。』」
verses.textEnNiv: And when they ask you, ‘Why are you groaning?’ you shall say, ‘Because of the news that is coming. Every heart will melt with fear and every hand go limp; every spirit will become faint and every leg will be wet with urine.’ It is coming! It will surely take place, declares the Sovereign Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: And when they say to you, ‘Why do you groan?’ you shall say, ‘Because of the news that it is coming. Every heart will melt, and all hands will be feeble; every spirit will faint, and all knees will be weak as water. Behold, it is coming, and it will be fulfilled,’" declares the Lord God .
verses.textEnNkjv: And it shall be when they say to you, ‘Why are you sighing?’ that you shall answer, ‘Because of the news; when it comes, every heart will melt, all hands will be feeble, every spirit will faint, and all knees will be weak as water. Behold, it is coming and shall be brought to pass,’ says the Lord God."
verses.textEnNlt: When they ask why you are groaning, tell them, ‘I groan because of the terrifying news I have heard. When it comes true, the boldest heart will melt with fear; all strength will disappear. Every spirit will faint; strong knees will become as weak as water. And the Sovereign Lord says: It is coming! It’s on its way!’"
verses.textEnNasb: And when they say to you, ‘Why are you groaning?’ you shall say, ‘Because of the news, for it is coming; and every heart will melt, all hands will go limp, every spirit will be disheartened, and all knees will drip with water. Behold, it is coming and it will happen,’ declares the Lord God."
verses.textEn: And when they ask you, ‘Why are you groaning?’ you shall say, ‘Because of the news that is coming. Every heart will melt with fear and every hand go limp; every spirit will become faint and every leg will be wet with urine.’ It is coming! It will surely take place, declares the Sovereign Lord ."

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: And the word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnNkjv: Again the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to me,
verses.textEnNasb: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: The word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: "人子啊！你要预言，说：‘主耶和华这样说： 有一把刀，有一把磨利了的刀， 是擦亮了的刀；
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！你要预言，说：‘主耶和华这样说： 有一把刀，有一把磨利了的刀， 是擦亮了的刀；
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，你要预言。耶和华吩咐我如此说： 有刀、有刀， 是磨快擦亮的；
verses.textEnNiv: "Son of man, prophesy and say, ‘This is what the Lord says: " ‘A sword, a sword, sharpened and polished—
verses.textEnEsv: "Son of man, prophesy and say, Thus says the Lord, say: "A sword, a sword is sharpened and also polished,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Son of man, prophesy and say, ‘Thus says the Lord!’ Say: ‘A sword, a sword is sharpened And also polished!
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, give the people this message from the Lord: "A sword, a sword is being sharpened and polished.
verses.textEnNasb: "Son of man, prophesy and say, ‘This is what the Lord says:’ Say, ‘A sword, a sword sharpened And also polished!
verses.textEn: "Son of man, prophesy and say, ‘This is what the Lord says: " ‘A sword, a sword, sharpened and polished—

verses.textZh: 磨利，是为要大行杀戮， 擦亮，是为要闪烁发光！ 我们怎能快乐呢？我的儿子藐视管教的杖和一切劝告 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 磨利，是为要大行杀戮， 擦亮，是为要闪烁发光！ 我们怎能快乐呢？我的儿子藐视管教的杖和一切劝告 。
verses.textZhCuv: 磨快为要行杀戮， 擦亮为要像闪电。 我们岂可快乐吗？罚我子的杖藐视各树。
verses.textEnNiv: sharpened for the slaughter, polished to flash like lightning! " ‘Shall we rejoice in the scepter of my royal son? The sword despises every such stick.
verses.textEnEsv: sharpened for slaughter, polished to flash like lightning! (Or shall we rejoice? You have despised the rod, my son, with everything of wood.)
verses.textEnNkjv: Sharpened to make a dreadful slaughter, Polished to flash like lightning! Should we then make mirth? It despises the scepter of My son, Asitdoes all wood.
verses.textEnNlt: It is sharpened for terrible slaughter and polished to flash like lightning! Now will you laugh? Those far stronger than you have fallen beneath its power!
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Sharpened to make a slaughter, Polished to flash like lightning!’ Or shall we rejoice, the rod of My son despising every tree?
verses.textEn: sharpened for the slaughter, polished to flash like lightning! " ‘Shall we rejoice in the scepter of my royal son? The sword despises every such stick.

verses.textZh: 这刀已经交给人擦亮，可以握在手中使用；这刀已经磨利擦亮了，可以交在行杀戮的人手中。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 这刀已经交给人擦亮，可以握在手中使用；这刀已经磨利擦亮了，可以交在行杀戮的人手中。’
verses.textZhCuv: 这刀已经交给人擦亮，为要应手使用。这刀已经磨快擦亮，好交在行杀戮的人手中。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘The sword is appointed to be polished, to be grasped with the hand; it is sharpened and polished, made ready for the hand of the slayer.
verses.textEnEsv: So the sword is given to be polished, that it may be grasped in the hand. It is sharpened and polished to be given into the hand of the slayer.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He has given it to be polished, That it may be handled; This sword is sharpened, and it is polished To be given into the hand of the slayer.’
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, the sword is now being sharpened and polished; it is being prepared for the executioner.
verses.textEnNasb: And it is given to be polished, so that it may be handled; the sword is sharpened and polished, to hand it over to the slaughterer.
verses.textEn: " ‘The sword is appointed to be polished, to be grasped with the hand; it is sharpened and polished, made ready for the hand of the slayer.

verses.textZh: 人子啊！你要呼喊、哀号。因为这刀要临到我的子民，以及以色列所有的领袖；他们与我的子民都要交在刀下；所以你要拍腿悲叹，
verses.textZhCnvs: 人子啊！你要呼喊、哀号。因为这刀要临到我的子民，以及以色列所有的领袖；他们与我的子民都要交在刀下；所以你要拍腿悲叹，
verses.textZhCuv: 人子啊，你要呼喊哀号，因为这刀临到我的百姓和以色列一切的首领。他们和我的百姓都交在刀下，所以你要拍腿叹息。
verses.textEnNiv: Cry out and wail, son of man, for it is against my people; it is against all the princes of Israel. They are thrown to the sword along with my people. Therefore beat your breast.
verses.textEnEsv: Cry out and wail, son of man, for it is against my people. It is against all the princes of Israel. They are delivered over to the sword with my people. Strike therefore upon your thigh.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Cry and wail, son of man; For it will be against My people, Against all the princes of Israel. Terrors including the sword will be against My people; Therefore strike your thigh.
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, cry out and wail; pound your thighs in anguish, for that sword will slaughter my people and their leaders— everyone will die!
verses.textEnNasb: Cry out and wail, son of man; for it is against My people, it is against all the officials of Israel. They are turned over to the sword with My people, therefore slap your thigh.
verses.textEn: Cry out and wail, son of man, for it is against my people; it is against all the princes of Israel. They are thrown to the sword along with my people. Therefore beat your breast.

verses.textZh: 因为考验必要来到，你为甚么要藐视那管教的杖呢？这事必不得成功。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为考验必要来到，你为甚么要藐视那管教的杖呢？这事必不得成功。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 有试验的事；若那藐视的杖归于无有，怎么样呢？这是主耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Testing will surely come. And what if even the scepter, which the sword despises, does not continue? declares the Sovereign Lord .’
verses.textEnEsv: For it will not be a testing—what could it do if you despise the rod?" declares the Lord God .
verses.textEnNkjv: "Because itis a testing, And what if thesword despises even the scepter? Thescepter shall be no more," says the Lord God.
verses.textEnNlt: It will put them all to the test. What chance do they have? says the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: For there is a testing; and what if even the rod which despises will cease to be?" declares the Lord God.
verses.textEn: " ‘Testing will surely come. And what if even the scepter, which the sword despises, does not continue? declares the Sovereign Lord .’

verses.textZh: "人子啊！至于你，你要拍手说预言，要接二连三地使用这杀人的刀，就是导致极大死伤的刀，把它们围困，
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！至于你，你要拍手说预言，要接二连三地使用这杀人的刀，就是导致极大死伤的刀，把它们围困，
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，你要拍掌预言。我－耶和华要使这刀，就是致死伤的刀，一连三次加倍刺人，进入他们的内屋，使大人受死伤的就是这刀。
verses.textEnNiv: "So then, son of man, prophesy and strike your hands together. Let the sword strike twice, even three times. It is a sword for slaughter— a sword for great slaughter, closing in on them from every side.
verses.textEnEsv: "As for you, son of man, prophesy. Clap your hands and let the sword come down twice, yes, three times, the sword for those to be slain. It is the sword for the great slaughter, which surrounds them,
verses.textEnNkjv: "You therefore, son of man, prophesy, And strike your hands together. The third time let the sword do double damage. It is the sword that slays, The sword that slays the great men, That enters their private chambers.
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, prophesy to them and clap your hands. Then take the sword and brandish it twice, even three times, to symbolize the great massacre, the great massacre facing them on every side.
verses.textEnNasb: "You therefore, son of man, prophesy and clap your hands; and let the sword be doubled the third time, the sword for the slain. It is the sword for the great one slain, which surrounds them,
verses.textEn: "So then, son of man, prophesy and strike your hands together. Let the sword strike twice, even three times. It is a sword for slaughter— a sword for great slaughter, closing in on them from every side.

verses.textZh: 好使他们心慌意乱，多人跌倒，我在他们所有的城门那里布下了杀戮 的人；啊！这刀做得闪烁发光，磨得尖利，可以杀戮。
verses.textZhCnvs: 好使他们心慌意乱，多人跌倒，我在他们所有的城门那里布下了杀戮 的人；啊！这刀做得闪烁发光，磨得尖利，可以杀戮。
verses.textZhCuv: 我设立这恐吓人的刀，攻击他们的一切城门，使他们的心消化，加增他们跌倒的事。哎！这刀造得像闪电，磨得尖利，要行杀戮。
verses.textEnNiv: So that hearts may melt with fear and the fallen be many, I have stationed the sword for slaughter at all their gates. Look! It is forged to strike like lightning, it is grasped for slaughter.
verses.textEnEsv: that their hearts may melt, and many stumble. At all their gates I have given the glittering sword. Ah, it is made like lightning; it is taken up for slaughter.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have set the point of the sword against all their gates, That the heart may melt and many may stumble. Ah! Itis made bright; Itis grasped for slaughter:
verses.textEnNlt: Let their hearts melt with terror, for the sword glitters at every gate. It flashes like lightning and is polished for slaughter!
verses.textEnNasb: so that their hearts will waver, and many fall at all their gates. I have granted the slaughter of the sword. Oh! It is made for striking like lightning, it is sharpened in readiness for slaughter.
verses.textEn: So that hearts may melt with fear and the fallen be many, I have stationed the sword for slaughter at all their gates. Look! It is forged to strike like lightning, it is grasped for slaughter.

verses.textZh: 刀啊，向右边斩吧！向左边刺吧！无论你面向哪一方，就向哪一方杀戮吧！
verses.textZhCnvs: 刀啊，向右边斩吧！向左边刺吧！无论你面向哪一方，就向哪一方杀戮吧！
verses.textZhCuv: 刀啊，你归在右边，摆在左边；你面向哪方，就向那方杀戮。
verses.textEnNiv: Slash to the right, you sword, then to the left, wherever your blade is turned.
verses.textEnEsv: Cut sharply to the right; set yourself to the left, wherever your face is directed.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Swords at the ready! Thrust right! Set your blade! Thrust left— Wherever your edge is ordered!
verses.textEnNlt: O sword, slash to the right, then slash to the left, wherever you will, wherever you want.
verses.textEnNasb: Prove yourself sharp, go to the right; set yourself; go to the left, wherever your edge is ordered.
verses.textEn: Slash to the right, you sword, then to the left, wherever your blade is turned.

verses.textZh: 我也要拍手，并且要使我的烈怒止息；这是我耶和华说的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我也要拍手，并且要使我的烈怒止息；这是我耶和华说的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我也要拍掌，并要使我的忿怒止息。这是我－耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: I too will strike my hands together, and my wrath will subside. I the Lord have spoken."
verses.textEnEsv: I also will clap my hands, and I will satisfy my fury; I the Lord have spoken."
verses.textEnNkjv: "I also will beat My fists together, And I will cause My fury to rest; I, the Lord, have spoken."
verses.textEnNlt: I, too, will clap my hands, and I will satisfy my fury. I, the Lord , have spoken!"
verses.textEnNasb: I will also clap My hands, and I will satisfy My wrath; I, the Lord, have spoken."
verses.textEn: I too will strike my hands together, and my wrath will subside. I the Lord have spoken."

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: The word of the Lord came to me again:
verses.textEnNkjv: The word of the Lord came to me again, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: Then this message came to me from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: The word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: "人子啊！至于你，你要定出两条路，给巴比伦王的刀前来；这两条路都从同一个地方出来；你要在通往城去的路口上做一个路标。
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！至于你，你要定出两条路，给巴比伦王的刀前来；这两条路都从同一个地方出来；你要在通往城去的路口上做一个路标。
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，你要定出两条路，好使巴比伦王的刀来。这两条路必从一地分出来，又要在通城的路口上画出一只手来。
verses.textEnNiv: "Son of man, mark out two roads for the sword of the king of Babylon to take, both starting from the same country. Make a signpost where the road branches off to the city.
verses.textEnEsv: "As for you, son of man, mark two ways for the sword of the king of Babylon to come. Both of them shall come from the same land. And make a signpost; make it at the head of the way to a city.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And son of man, appoint for yourself two ways for the sword of the king of Babylon to go; both of them shall go from the same land. Make a sign; put it at the head of the road to the city.
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, make a map and trace two routes on it for the sword of Babylon’s king to follow. Put a signpost on the road that comes out of Babylon where the road forks into two—
verses.textEnNasb: "Now as for you, son of man, make two ways for the sword of the king of Babylon to come; both of them will go out of one land. And make a signpost; make it at the head of the way to the city.
verses.textEn: "Son of man, mark out two roads for the sword of the king of Babylon to take, both starting from the same country. Make a signpost where the road branches off to the city.

verses.textZh: 你要定出一条路，使刀临到亚扪的拉巴，又要定出另一条路，使刀临到犹大，攻击坚固城耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要定出一条路，使刀临到亚扪的拉巴，又要定出另一条路，使刀临到犹大，攻击坚固城耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要定出一条路，使刀来到亚扪人的拉巴；又要定出一条路，使刀来到犹大的坚固城耶路撒冷。
verses.textEnNiv: Mark out one road for the sword to come against Rabbah of the Ammonites and another against Judah and fortified Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: Mark a way for the sword to come to Rabbah of the Ammonites and to Judah, into Jerusalem the fortified.
verses.textEnNkjv: Appoint a road for the sword to go to Rabbah of the Ammonites, and to Judah, into fortified Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: one road going to Ammon and its capital, Rabbah, and the other to Judah and fortified Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall mark a way for the sword to come to Rabbah of the sons of Ammon, and to Judah into fortified Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: Mark out one road for the sword to come against Rabbah of the Ammonites and another against Judah and fortified Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 因为巴比伦王站在分叉路口，在两条路口上占卜、摇签、求问神像，察看动物的肝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为巴比伦王站在分叉路口，在两条路口上占卜、摇签、求问神像，察看动物的肝。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为巴比伦王站在岔路那里，在两条路口上要占卜。他摇签 求问神像，察看牺牲的肝；
verses.textEnNiv: For the king of Babylon will stop at the fork in the road, at the junction of the two roads, to seek an omen: He will cast lots with arrows, he will consult his idols, he will examine the liver.
verses.textEnEsv: For the king of Babylon stands at the parting of the way, at the head of the two ways, to use divination. He shakes the arrows; he consults the teraphim; he looks at the liver.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the king of Babylon stands at the parting of the road, at the fork of the two roads, to use divination: he shakes the arrows, he consults the images, he looks at the liver.
verses.textEnNlt: The king of Babylon now stands at the fork, uncertain whether to attack Jerusalem or Rabbah. He calls his magicians to look for omens. They cast lots by shaking arrows from the quiver. They inspect the livers of animal sacrifices.
verses.textEnNasb: For the king of Babylon stands at the parting of the way, at the head of the two ways, to use divination; he shakes the arrows, he consults the household idols, he looks at the liver.
verses.textEn: For the king of Babylon will stop at the fork in the road, at the junction of the two roads, to seek an omen: He will cast lots with arrows, he will consult his idols, he will examine the liver.

verses.textZh: 他右手中拿着耶路撒冷的签，要在那里架起攻城锤，下令屠杀，扬声吶喊；架起攻城锤，攻打城门；筑起土垒，建造围城的高墙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他右手中拿着耶路撒冷的签，要在那里架起攻城锤，下令屠杀，扬声吶喊；架起攻城锤，攻打城门；筑起土垒，建造围城的高墙。
verses.textZhCuv: 在右手中拿着为耶路撒冷占卜的签，使他安设撞城锤，张口叫杀，扬声呐喊，筑垒造台，以撞城锤，攻打城门。
verses.textEnNiv: Into his right hand will come the lot for Jerusalem, where he is to set up battering rams, to give the command to slaughter, to sound the battle cry, to set battering rams against the gates, to build a ramp and to erect siege works.
verses.textEnEsv: Into his right hand comes the divination for Jerusalem, to set battering rams, to open the mouth with murder, to lift up the voice with shouting, to set battering rams against the gates, to cast up mounds, to build siege towers.
verses.textEnNkjv: In his right hand is the divination for Jerusalem: to set up battering rams, to call for a slaughter, to lift the voice with shouting, to set battering rams against the gates, to heap up a siege mound, and to build a wall.
verses.textEnNlt: The omen in his right hand says, ‘Jerusalem!’ With battering rams his soldiers will go against the gates, shouting for the kill. They will put up siege towers and build ramps against the walls.
verses.textEnNasb: Into his right hand came the divination, ‘Jerusalem,’ to set up battering rams, to open the mouth for slaughter, to raise the voice with a battle cry, to set up battering rams against the gates, to pile up assault ramps, to build a siege wall.
verses.textEn: Into his right hand will come the lot for Jerusalem, where he is to set up battering rams, to give the command to slaughter, to sound the battle cry, to set battering rams against the gates, to build a ramp and to erect siege works.

verses.textZh: 在那些曾经向巴比伦起誓效忠的犹大人看来，这是虚假的占卜，但巴比伦王要使他们想起自己的罪孽，把他们掳去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那些曾经向巴比伦起誓效忠的犹大人看来，这是虚假的占卜，但巴比伦王要使他们想起自己的罪孽，把他们掳去。
verses.textZhCuv: 据那些曾起誓的犹大人看来，这是虚假的占卜；但巴比伦王要使他们想起罪孽，以致将他们捉住。」
verses.textEnNiv: It will seem like a false omen to those who have sworn allegiance to him, but he will remind them of their guilt and take them captive.
verses.textEnEsv: But to them it will seem like a false divination. They have sworn solemn oaths, but he brings their guilt to remembrance, that they may be taken.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it will be to them like a false divination in the eyes of those who have sworn oaths with them; but he will bring their iniquity to remembrance, that they may be taken.
verses.textEnNlt: The people of Jerusalem will think it is a false omen, because of their treaty with the Babylonians. But the king of Babylon will remind the people of their rebellion. Then he will attack and capture them.
verses.textEnNasb: And it will be to them like a false divination in their eyes; they have sworn solemn oaths. But he makes guilt known, so that they may be seized.
verses.textEn: It will seem like a false omen to those who have sworn allegiance to him, but he will remind them of their guilt and take them captive.

verses.textZh: 因此，主耶和华这样说：‘你们的过犯显露，你们的罪在你们的一切行为上给人看见；以致你们的罪孽被想起。你们既被想起，就要被人用手掳去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，主耶和华这样说：‘你们的过犯显露，你们的罪在你们的一切行为上给人看见；以致你们的罪孽被想起。你们既被想起，就要被人用手掳去。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华如此说：「因你们的过犯显露，使你们的罪孽被记念，以致你们的罪恶在行为上都彰显出来；又因你们被记念，就被捉住。
verses.textEnNiv: "Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: ‘Because you people have brought to mind your guilt by your open rebellion, revealing your sins in all that you do—because you have done this, you will be taken captive.
verses.textEnEsv: "Therefore thus says the Lord God : Because you have made your guilt to be remembered, in that your transgressions are uncovered, so that in all your deeds your sins appear—because you have come to remembrance, you shall be taken in hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore thus says the Lord God: ‘Because you have made your iniquity to be remembered, in that your transgressions are uncovered, so that in all your doings your sins appear—because you have come to remembrance, you shall be taken in hand.
verses.textEnNlt: "Therefore, this is what the Sovereign Lord says: Again and again you remind me of your sin and your guilt. You don’t even try to hide it! In everything you do, your sins are obvious for all to see. So now the time of your punishment has come!
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore, this is what the Lord God says: ‘Because you have made your guilt known, in that your offenses are uncovered, so that in all your deeds your sins are seen—because you have come to mind, you will be seized by the hand.
verses.textEn: "Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: ‘Because you people have brought to mind your guilt by your open rebellion, revealing your sins in all that you do—because you have done this, you will be taken captive.

verses.textZh: 你这该死、邪恶的以色列王啊！你的日子到了，最后惩罚的时刻到了。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 你这该死、邪恶的以色列王啊！你的日子到了，最后惩罚的时刻到了。’
verses.textZhCuv: 你这受死伤行恶的以色列王啊，罪孽的尽头到了，受报的日子已到。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘You profane and wicked prince of Israel, whose day has come, whose time of punishment has reached its climax,
verses.textEnEsv: And you, O profane wicked one, prince of Israel, whose day has come, the time of your final punishment,
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Now to you, O profane, wicked prince of Israel, whose day has come, whose iniquity shall end,
verses.textEnNlt: "O you corrupt and wicked prince of Israel, your final day of reckoning is here!
verses.textEnNasb: And you, slain, wicked one, the prince of Israel, whose day has come, in the time of the punishment of the end,’
verses.textEn: " ‘You profane and wicked prince of Israel, whose day has come, whose time of punishment has reached its climax,

verses.textZh: 主耶和华这样说：‘你当除去头巾，脱下冠冕！现在情形不同了，卑微的要升高，位高的要降卑！
verses.textZhCnvs: 主耶和华这样说：‘你当除去头巾，脱下冠冕！现在情形不同了，卑微的要升高，位高的要降卑！
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华如此说：当除掉冠，摘下冕，景况必不再像先前；要使卑者升为高，使高者降为卑。
verses.textEnNiv: this is what the Sovereign Lord says: Take off the turban, remove the crown. It will not be as it was: The lowly will be exalted and the exalted will be brought low.
verses.textEnEsv: thus says the Lord God : Remove the turban and take off the crown. Things shall not remain as they are. Exalt that which is low, and bring low that which is exalted.
verses.textEnNkjv: thus says the Lord God: "Remove the turban, and take off the crown; Nothing shallremain the same. Exalt the humble, and humble the exalted.
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Sovereign Lord says: "Take off your jeweled crown, for the old order changes. Now the lowly will be exalted, and the mighty will be brought down.
verses.textEnNasb: this is what the Lord God says: ‘Remove the turban and take off the crown; this will no longer be the same. Exalt that which is low, and humble that which is high.
verses.textEn: this is what the Sovereign Lord says: Take off the turban, remove the crown. It will not be as it was: The lowly will be exalted and the exalted will be brought low.

verses.textZh: 倾覆，倾覆，我要倾覆这国，这国不再存在，直等到那统治的人来到，我就把国赐给他。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 倾覆，倾覆，我要倾覆这国，这国不再存在，直等到那统治的人来到，我就把国赐给他。’
verses.textZhCuv: 我要将这国倾覆，倾覆，而又倾覆；这国也必不再有，直等到那应得的人来到，我就赐给他。」
verses.textEnNiv: A ruin! A ruin! I will make it a ruin! The crown will not be restored until he to whom it rightfully belongs shall come; to him I will give it.’
verses.textEnEsv: A ruin, ruin, ruin I will make it. This also shall not be, until he comes, the one to whom judgment belongs, and I will give it to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Overthrown, overthrown, I will make it overthrown! It shall be no longer, Until He comes whose right it is, And I will give it to Him." ’
verses.textEnNlt: Destruction! Destruction! I will surely destroy the kingdom. And it will not be restored until the one appears who has the right to judge it. Then I will hand it over to him.
verses.textEnNasb: Ruins, ruins, ruins, I will make it! This also will be no longer until He comes whose right it is, and I will give it to Him.’
verses.textEn: A ruin! A ruin! I will make it a ruin! The crown will not be restored until he to whom it rightfully belongs shall come; to him I will give it.’

verses.textZh: "人子啊！你要说预言：论到亚扪人和他们的侮辱，主耶和华这样说：‘你要说：有一把刀，有一把刀拔出来，是为要杀戮；擦亮，是为要毁灭，为要闪烁发光。
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！你要说预言：论到亚扪人和他们的侮辱，主耶和华这样说：‘你要说：有一把刀，有一把刀拔出来，是为要杀戮；擦亮，是为要毁灭，为要闪烁发光。
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，要发预言说：主耶和华论到亚扪人和他们的凌辱，吩咐我如此说：有刀，有拔出来的刀，已经擦亮，为行杀戮，使他像闪电以行吞灭。
verses.textEnNiv: "And you, son of man, prophesy and say, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says about the Ammonites and their insults: " ‘A sword, a sword, drawn for the slaughter, polished to consume and to flash like lightning!
verses.textEnEsv: "And you, son of man, prophesy, and say, Thus says the Lord God concerning the Ammonites and concerning their reproach; say, A sword, a sword is drawn for the slaughter. It is polished to consume and to flash like lightning—
verses.textEnNkjv: "And you, son of man, prophesy and say, ‘Thus says the Lord God concerning the Ammonites and concerning their reproach,’ and say: ‘A sword, a sword is drawn, Polished for slaughter, For consuming, for flashing—
verses.textEnNlt: "And now, son of man, prophesy concerning the Ammonites and their mockery. Give them this message from the Sovereign Lord : "A sword, a sword is drawn for your slaughter. It is polished to destroy, flashing like lightning!
verses.textEnNasb: "And you, son of man, prophesy and say, ‘This is what the Lord God says concerning the sons of Ammon and their taunting,’ and say: ‘A sword, a sword is drawn, sharpened for the slaughter, to make it consume, so that it may be like lightning—
verses.textEn: "And you, son of man, prophesy and say, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says about the Ammonites and their insults: " ‘A sword, a sword, drawn for the slaughter, polished to consume and to flash like lightning!

verses.textZh: 人为你所见的异象是虚假的，为你所占的卜是虚谎的，使你倒在该死的恶人的颈项上；他们受惩罚的日子到了，最后惩罚的时刻到了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人为你所见的异象是虚假的，为你所占的卜是虚谎的，使你倒在该死的恶人的颈项上；他们受惩罚的日子到了，最后惩罚的时刻到了。
verses.textZhCuv: 人为你见虚假的异象，行谎诈的占卜，使你倒在受死伤之恶人的颈项上。他们罪孽到了尽头，受报的日子已到。
verses.textEnNiv: Despite false visions concerning you and lying divinations about you, it will be laid on the necks of the wicked who are to be slain, whose day has come, whose time of punishment has reached its climax.
verses.textEnEsv: while they see for you false visions, while they divine lies for you—to place you on the necks of the profane wicked, whose day has come, the time of their final punishment.
verses.textEnNkjv: While they see false visions for you, While they divine a lie to you, To bring you on the necks of the wicked, the slain Whose day has come, Whose iniquity shall end.
verses.textEnNlt: Your prophets have given false visions, and your fortune-tellers have told lies. The sword will fall on the necks of the wicked for whom the day of final reckoning has come.
verses.textEnNasb: while they see false visions for you, while they divine lies for you—to place you on the necks of the wicked who are killed, whose day has come, in the time of the punishment of the end.
verses.textEn: Despite false visions concerning you and lying divinations about you, it will be laid on the necks of the wicked who are to be slain, whose day has come, whose time of punishment has reached its climax.

verses.textZh: 收刀入鞘吧！我必在你被造之地，根源之处，审判你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 收刀入鞘吧！我必在你被造之地，根源之处，审判你。
verses.textZhCuv: 你将刀收入鞘吧！在你受造之处、生长之地，我必刑罚你。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Let the sword return to its sheath. In the place where you were created, in the land of your ancestry, I will judge you.
verses.textEnEsv: Return it to its sheath. In the place where you were created, in the land of your origin, I will judge you.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Return it to its sheath. I will judge you In the place where you were created, In the land of your nativity.
verses.textEnNlt: "Now return the sword to its sheath, for in your own country, the land of your birth, I will pass judgment upon you.
verses.textEnNasb: Return it to its sheath. In the place where you were created, in the land of your origin, I will judge you.
verses.textEn: " ‘Let the sword return to its sheath. In the place where you were created, in the land of your ancestry, I will judge you.

verses.textZh: 我必把我的忿怒倒在你身上，把我的怒火喷在你身上，又把你交在那些惯于毁灭的野蛮人手中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必把我的忿怒倒在你身上，把我的怒火喷在你身上，又把你交在那些惯于毁灭的野蛮人手中。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必将我的恼恨倒在你身上，将我烈怒的火喷在你身上；又将你交在善于杀灭的畜类人手中。
verses.textEnNiv: I will pour out my wrath on you and breathe out my fiery anger against you; I will deliver you into the hands of brutal men, men skilled in destruction.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will pour out my indignation upon you; I will blow upon you with the fire of my wrath, and I will deliver you into the hands of brutish men, skillful to destroy.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will pour out My indignation on you; I will blow against you with the fire of My wrath, And deliver you into the hands of brutal men whoare skillful to destroy.
verses.textEnNlt: I will pour out my fury on you and blow on you with the fire of my anger. I will hand you over to cruel men who are skilled in destruction.
verses.textEnNasb: I will pour out My indignation on you; I will blow on you with the fire of My wrath, and I will hand you over to brutal men, craftsmen of destruction.
verses.textEn: I will pour out my wrath on you and breathe out my fiery anger against you; I will deliver you into the hands of brutal men, men skilled in destruction.

verses.textZh: 你必当作燃料被火焚烧；你的血要流在你的国中；你必不再被记念，因为这是我耶和华说的。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你必当作燃料被火焚烧；你的血要流在你的国中；你必不再被记念，因为这是我耶和华说的。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 你必当柴被火焚烧；你的血必流在国中。你必不再被记念，因为这是我－耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: You will be fuel for the fire, your blood will be shed in your land, you will be remembered no more; for I the Lord have spoken.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: You shall be fuel for the fire. Your blood shall be in the midst of the land. You shall be no more remembered, for I the Lord have spoken."
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall be fuel for the fire; Your blood shall be in the midst of the land. You shall not be remembered, For I the Lord have spoken.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: You will be fuel for the fire, and your blood will be spilled in your own land. You will be utterly wiped out, your memory lost to history, for I, the Lord , have spoken!"
verses.textEnNasb: You will be fuel for the fire; your blood will be in the midst of the land. You will not be remembered, for I, the Lord, have spoken.’ "
verses.textEn: You will be fuel for the fire, your blood will be shed in your land, you will be remembered no more; for I the Lord have spoken.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Now this message came to me from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: Then the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: The word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: "人子啊，你要审判吗？你要审判这流人血的城吗？你要使这城知道它一切可憎的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊，你要审判吗？你要审判这流人血的城吗？你要使这城知道它一切可憎的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，你要审问审问这流人血的城吗？当使她知道她一切可憎的事。
verses.textEnNiv: "Son of man, will you judge her? Will you judge this city of bloodshed? Then confront her with all her detestable practices
verses.textEnEsv: "And you, son of man, will you judge, will you judge the bloody city? Then declare to her all her abominations.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now, son of man, will you judge, will you judge the bloody city? Yes, show her all her abominations!
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, are you ready to judge Jerusalem? Are you ready to judge this city of murderers? Publicly denounce her detestable sins,
verses.textEnNasb: "And you, son of man, will you judge, will you judge the bloody city? Then inform her of all her abominations.
verses.textEn: "Son of man, will you judge her? Will you judge this city of bloodshed? Then confront her with all her detestable practices

verses.textZh: 你要说：‘主耶和华这样说：这城中有流人血的事，它制造偶像，玷污自己，以致它受审判的时候来到。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要说：‘主耶和华这样说：这城中有流人血的事，它制造偶像，玷污自己，以致它受审判的时候来到。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要说，主耶和华如此说：哎！这城有流人血的事在其中，叫她受报的日期来到，又做偶像玷污自己，陷害自己。
verses.textEnNiv: and say: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: You city that brings on herself doom by shedding blood in her midst and defiles herself by making idols,
verses.textEnEsv: You shall say, Thus says the Lord God : A city that sheds blood in her midst, so that her time may come, and that makes idols to defile herself!
verses.textEnNkjv: Then say, ‘Thus says the Lord God: "The city sheds blood in her own midst, that her time may come; and she makes idols within herself to defile herself.
verses.textEnNlt: and give her this message from the Sovereign Lord : O city of murderers, doomed and damned—city of idols, filthy and foul—
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall say, ‘This is what the Lord God says: "A city shedding blood in her midst, so that her time is coming; and a city that makes idols, contrary to her own good, for defilement!
verses.textEn: and say: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: You city that brings on herself doom by shedding blood in her midst and defiles herself by making idols,

verses.textZh: 因你流了人的血，你就有罪了；因你做了偶像，你就玷污了自己；这样，你使你受罚的日子临近，遭报的年日来到，我使你成为列国辱骂、列邦讥笑的对象。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因你流了人的血，你就有罪了；因你做了偶像，你就玷污了自己；这样，你使你受罚的日子临近，遭报的年日来到，我使你成为列国辱骂、列邦讥笑的对象。
verses.textZhCuv: 你因流了人的血，就为有罪；你做了偶像，就玷污自己，使你受报之日临近，报应之年来到。所以我叫你受列国的凌辱和列邦的讥诮。
verses.textEnNiv: you have become guilty because of the blood you have shed and have become defiled by the idols you have made. You have brought your days to a close, and the end of your years has come. Therefore I will make you an object of scorn to the nations and a laughingstock to all the countries.
verses.textEnEsv: You have become guilty by the blood that you have shed, and defiled by the idols that you have made, and you have brought your days near, the appointed time of your years has come. Therefore I have made you a reproach to the nations, and a mockery to all the countries.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have become guilty by the blood which you have shed, and have defiled yourself with the idols which you have made. You have caused your days to draw near, and have come to theendof your years; therefore I have made you a reproach to the nations, and a mockery to all countries.
verses.textEnNlt: you are guilty because of the blood you have shed. You are defiled because of the idols you have made. Your day of destruction has come! You have reached the end of your years. I will make you an object of mockery throughout the world.
verses.textEnNasb: You have become guilty by the blood which you have shed, and you have become defiled by your idols which you have made. So you have brought your days closer and have come to your years; therefore I have made you a disgrace to the nations, and an object of mocking to all the lands.
verses.textEn: you have become guilty because of the blood you have shed and have become defiled by the idols you have made. You have brought your days to a close, and the end of your years has come. Therefore I will make you an object of scorn to the nations and a laughingstock to all the countries.

verses.textZh: 你这混乱喧嚷、名被玷污的城啊！那些离你近的和离你远的，都必讥笑你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你这混乱喧嚷、名被玷污的城啊！那些离你近的和离你远的，都必讥笑你。
verses.textZhCuv: 你这名臭、多乱的城啊，那些离你近、离你远的都必讥诮你。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who are near and those who are far away will mock you, you infamous city, full of turmoil.
verses.textEnEsv: Those who are near and those who are far from you will mock you; your name is defiled; you are full of tumult.
verses.textEnNkjv: Those near and those far from you will mock you as infamous and full of tumult.
verses.textEnNlt: O infamous city, filled with confusion, you will be mocked by people far and near.
verses.textEnNasb: Those who are near and those who are far from you will make fun of you, you of ill repute, full of turmoil.
verses.textEn: Those who are near and those who are far away will mock you, you infamous city, full of turmoil.

verses.textZh: 看哪！以色列的领袖们恃着自己的能力，在你里面流人的血。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！以色列的领袖们恃着自己的能力，在你里面流人的血。
verses.textZhCuv: 「看哪，以色列的首领各逞其能，在你中间流人之血。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘See how each of the princes of Israel who are in you uses his power to shed blood.
verses.textEnEsv: "Behold, the princes of Israel in you, every one according to his power, have been bent on shedding blood.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Look, the princes of Israel: each one has used his power to shed blood in you.
verses.textEnNlt: "Every leader in Israel who lives within your walls is bent on murder.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, the rulers of Israel, each according to his power, have been among you for the purpose of shedding blood.
verses.textEn: " ‘See how each of the princes of Israel who are in you uses his power to shed blood.

verses.textZh: 在你里面轻视父母的；在你中间有压迫寄居的和欺负孤儿寡妇的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在你里面轻视父母的；在你中间有压迫寄居的和欺负孤儿寡妇的。
verses.textZhCuv: 在你中间有轻慢父母的，有欺压寄居的，有亏负孤儿寡妇的。
verses.textEnNiv: In you they have treated father and mother with contempt; in you they have oppressed the foreigner and mistreated the fatherless and the widow.
verses.textEnEsv: Father and mother are treated with contempt in you; the sojourner suffers extortion in your midst; the fatherless and the widow are wronged in you.
verses.textEnNkjv: In you they have made light of father and mother; in your midst they have oppressed the stranger; in you they have mistreated the fatherless and the widow.
verses.textEnNlt: Fathers and mothers are treated with contempt. Foreigners are forced to pay for protection. Orphans and widows are wronged and oppressed among you.
verses.textEnNasb: They have treated father and mother with contempt among you. They have oppressed the stranger in your midst; they have oppressed the orphan and the widow among you.
verses.textEn: In you they have treated father and mother with contempt; in you they have oppressed the foreigner and mistreated the fatherless and the widow.

verses.textZh: 你藐视了我的圣物，亵渎了我的安息日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你藐视了我的圣物，亵渎了我的安息日。
verses.textZhCuv: 你藐视了我的圣物，干犯了我的安息日。
verses.textEnNiv: You have despised my holy things and desecrated my Sabbaths.
verses.textEnEsv: You have despised my holy things and profaned my Sabbaths.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have despised My holy things and profaned My Sabbaths.
verses.textEnNlt: You despise my holy things and violate my Sabbath days of rest.
verses.textEnNasb: You have despised My holy things and profaned My Sabbaths.
verses.textEn: You have despised my holy things and desecrated my Sabbaths.

verses.textZh: 在你里面有好谗谤的人，他们要流人的血；在你的山上吃祭肉；又在你中间行淫乱的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在你里面有好谗谤的人，他们要流人的血；在你的山上吃祭肉；又在你中间行淫乱的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 在你中间有谗谤人、流人血的；有在山上吃过祭偶像之物的，有行淫乱的。
verses.textEnNiv: In you are slanderers who are bent on shedding blood; in you are those who eat at the mountain shrines and commit lewd acts.
verses.textEnEsv: There are men in you who slander to shed blood, and people in you who eat on the mountains; they commit lewdness in your midst.
verses.textEnNkjv: In you are men who slander to cause bloodshed; in you are those who eat on the mountains; in your midst they commit lewdness.
verses.textEnNlt: People accuse others falsely and send them to their death. You are filled with idol worshipers and people who do obscene things.
verses.textEnNasb: Slanderous men have been among you for the purpose of shedding blood, and among you they have eaten at the mountain shrines. In your midst they have committed outrageous sin.
verses.textEn: In you are slanderers who are bent on shedding blood; in you are those who eat at the mountain shrines and commit lewd acts.

verses.textZh: 在你里面有暴露父亲下体的；有污辱在经期中不洁的妇人的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在你里面有暴露父亲下体的；有污辱在经期中不洁的妇人的。
verses.textZhCuv: 在你中间有露继母下体羞辱父亲的，有玷辱月经不洁净之妇人的。
verses.textEnNiv: In you are those who dishonor their father’s bed; in you are those who violate women during their period, when they are ceremonially unclean.
verses.textEnEsv: In you men uncover their fathers’ nakedness; in you they violate women who are unclean in their menstrual impurity.
verses.textEnNkjv: In you men uncover their fathers’ nakedness; in you they violate women who are set apart during their impurity.
verses.textEnNlt: Men sleep with their fathers’ wives and force themselves on women who are menstruating.
verses.textEnNasb: Among you they have uncovered their fathers’ nakedness; among you they have abused her who was unclean in her menstruation.
verses.textEn: In you are those who dishonor their father’s bed; in you are those who violate women during their period, when they are ceremonially unclean.

verses.textZh: 在你里面，这人与邻舍的妻子行可憎的事；那人行淫乱，玷污自己的儿媳；还有人污辱自己的同胞姊妹。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在你里面，这人与邻舍的妻子行可憎的事；那人行淫乱，玷污自己的儿媳；还有人污辱自己的同胞姊妹。
verses.textZhCuv: 这人与邻舍的妻行可憎的事；那人贪淫玷污儿妇；还有玷辱同父之姊妹的。
verses.textEnNiv: In you one man commits a detestable offense with his neighbor’s wife, another shamefully defiles his daughter-in-law, and another violates his sister, his own father’s daughter.
verses.textEnEsv: One commits abomination with his neighbor’s wife; another lewdly defiles his daughter-in-law; another in you violates his sister, his father’s daughter.
verses.textEnNkjv: One commits abomination with his neighbor’s wife; another lewdly defiles his daughter-in-law; and another in you violates his sister, his father’s daughter.
verses.textEnNlt: Within your walls live men who commit adultery with their neighbors’ wives, who defile their daughters-in-law, or who rape their own sisters.
verses.textEnNasb: And one has committed abomination with his neighbor’s wife, another has outrageously defiled his daughter-in-law, and another among you has sexually abused his sister, his father’s daughter.
verses.textEn: In you one man commits a detestable offense with his neighbor’s wife, another shamefully defiles his daughter-in-law, and another violates his sister, his own father’s daughter.

verses.textZh: 在你里面有接受贿赂而流人血的；你借钱给人，收取利息，并且多要；你用欺压手段向你的邻舍榨取不义之财；你更忘记了我。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在你里面有接受贿赂而流人血的；你借钱给人，收取利息，并且多要；你用欺压手段向你的邻舍榨取不义之财；你更忘记了我。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 在你中间有为流人血受贿赂的；有向借钱的弟兄取利，向借粮的弟兄多要的。且因贪得无厌，欺压邻舍夺取财物，竟忘了我。这是主耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: In you are people who accept bribes to shed blood; you take interest and make a profit from the poor. You extort unjust gain from your neighbors. And you have forgotten me, declares the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: In you they take bribes to shed blood; you take interest and profit and make gain of your neighbors by extortion; but me you have forgotten, declares the Lord God .
verses.textEnNkjv: In you they take bribes to shed blood; you take usury and increase; you have made profit from your neighbors by extortion, and have forgotten Me," says the Lord God.
verses.textEnNlt: There are hired murderers, loan racketeers, and extortioners everywhere. They never even think of me and my commands, says the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Among you they have taken bribes to shed blood; you have taken interest, you have injured your neighbors by oppression, and you have forgotten Me," declares the Lord God.
verses.textEn: In you are people who accept bribes to shed blood; you take interest and make a profit from the poor. You extort unjust gain from your neighbors. And you have forgotten me, declares the Sovereign Lord .

verses.textZh: "‘看哪！因你所得的不义之财，又因在你中间所流的血，我就拍掌。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘看哪！因你所得的不义之财，又因在你中间所流的血，我就拍掌。
verses.textZhCuv: 「看哪，我因你所得不义之财和你中间所流的血，就拍掌叹息。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘I will surely strike my hands together at the unjust gain you have made and at the blood you have shed in your midst.
verses.textEnEsv: "Behold, I strike my hand at the dishonest gain that you have made, and at the blood that has been in your midst.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Behold, therefore, I beat My fists at the dishonest profit which you have made, and at the bloodshed which has been in your midst.
verses.textEnNlt: "But now I clap my hands in indignation over your dishonest gain and bloodshed.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, then, I strike with My hand your profit which you have made and the bloodshed which is among you.
verses.textEn: " ‘I will surely strike my hands together at the unjust gain you have made and at the blood you have shed in your midst.

verses.textZh: 到了我惩治你的日子，你的心还能受得住吗？你的手还有力吗？我耶和华说了，就必实行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了我惩治你的日子，你的心还能受得住吗？你的手还有力吗？我耶和华说了，就必实行。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了我惩罚你的日子，你的心还能忍受吗？你的手还能有力吗？我－耶和华说了这话，就必照着行。
verses.textEnNiv: Will your courage endure or your hands be strong in the day I deal with you? I the Lord have spoken, and I will do it.
verses.textEnEsv: Can your courage endure, or can your hands be strong, in the days that I shall deal with you? I the Lord have spoken, and I will do it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Can your heart endure, or can your hands remain strong, in the days when I shall deal with you? I, the Lord, have spoken, and will do it.
verses.textEnNlt: How strong and courageous will you be in my day of reckoning? I, the Lord , have spoken, and I will do what I said.
verses.textEnNasb: Can your heart endure, or can your hands be strong for the days that I will deal with you? I, the Lord, have spoken and will act.
verses.textEn: Will your courage endure or your hands be strong in the day I deal with you? I the Lord have spoken, and I will do it.

verses.textZh: 我要把你分散在列国，四散在万邦；我要从你中间消除你的污秽。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要把你分散在列国，四散在万邦；我要从你中间消除你的污秽。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必将你分散在列国，四散在列邦。我也必从你中间除掉你的污秽。
verses.textEnNiv: I will disperse you among the nations and scatter you through the countries; and I will put an end to your uncleanness.
verses.textEnEsv: I will scatter you among the nations and disperse you through the countries, and I will consume your uncleanness out of you.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will scatter you among the nations, disperse you throughout the countries, and remove your filthiness completely from you.
verses.textEnNlt: I will scatter you among the nations and purge you of your wickedness.
verses.textEnNasb: And I will scatter you among the nations and disperse you among the lands, and I will eliminate your uncleanness from you.
verses.textEn: I will disperse you among the nations and scatter you through the countries; and I will put an end to your uncleanness.

verses.textZh: 你在列国眼前被玷污的时候，你就知道我是耶和华。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你在列国眼前被玷污的时候，你就知道我是耶和华。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 你必在列国人的眼前因自己所行的被亵渎，你就知道我是耶和华。」
verses.textEnNiv: When you have been defiled in the eyes of the nations, you will know that I am the Lord .’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall be profaned by your own doing in the sight of the nations, and you shall know that I am the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall defile yourself in the sight of the nations; then you shall know that I am the Lord." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: And when I have been dishonored among the nations because of you, you will know that I am the Lord ."
verses.textEnNasb: Then you will defile yourself in the sight of the nations, and you will know that I am the Lord." ’ "
verses.textEn: When you have been defiled in the eyes of the nations, you will know that I am the Lord .’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then the word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: And the word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnNkjv: The word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then this message came to me from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: Then the word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: "人子啊！以色列家在我看来已成了渣滓；他们都是炉中的铜、锡、铁和铅；就是银的渣滓。
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！以色列家在我看来已成了渣滓；他们都是炉中的铜、锡、铁和铅；就是银的渣滓。
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，以色列家在我看为渣滓。他们都是炉中的铜、锡、铁、铅，都是银渣滓。
verses.textEnNiv: "Son of man, the people of Israel have become dross to me; all of them are the copper, tin, iron and lead left inside a furnace. They are but the dross of silver.
verses.textEnEsv: "Son of man, the house of Israel has become dross to me; all of them are bronze and tin and iron and lead in the furnace; they are dross of silver.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Son of man, the house of Israel has become dross to Me; they are all bronze, tin, iron, and lead, in the midst of a furnace; they have become dross from silver.
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, the people of Israel are the worthless slag that remains after silver is smelted. They are the dross that is left over—a useless mixture of copper, tin, iron, and lead.
verses.textEnNasb: "Son of man, the house of Israel has become waste metal to Me; all of them are bronze, tin, iron, and lead in the smelting furnace; they are the waste metal of silver.
verses.textEn: "Son of man, the people of Israel have become dross to me; all of them are the copper, tin, iron and lead left inside a furnace. They are but the dross of silver.

verses.textZh: 因此，主耶和华这样说：‘你们既然都成了渣滓，所以，我要把你们集合在耶路撒冷城中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，主耶和华这样说：‘你们既然都成了渣滓，所以，我要把你们集合在耶路撒冷城中。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以主耶和华如此说：因你们都成为渣滓，我必聚集你们在耶路撒冷中。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: ‘Because you have all become dross, I will gather you into Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore thus says the Lord God : Because you have all become dross, therefore, behold, I will gather you into the midst of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore thus says the Lord God: ‘Because you have all become dross, therefore behold, I will gather you into the midst of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: So tell them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Because you are all worthless slag, I will bring you to my crucible in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, this is what the Lord God says: ‘Because all of you have become waste metal, therefore, behold, I am going to gather you into the midst of Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: ‘Because you have all become dross, I will gather you into Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 人怎样把银、铜、铁、铅、锡，集合在炉中，吹火使它们熔化，我也照样在我的怒气、我的烈怒中，把你们集合起来，放在城中，使你们熔化。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人怎样把银、铜、铁、铅、锡，集合在炉中，吹火使它们熔化，我也照样在我的怒气、我的烈怒中，把你们集合起来，放在城中，使你们熔化。
verses.textZhCuv: 人怎样将银、铜、铁、铅、锡聚在炉中，吹火熔化；照样，我也要发怒气和忿怒，将你们聚集放在城中，熔化你们。
verses.textEnNiv: As silver, copper, iron, lead and tin are gathered into a furnace to be melted with a fiery blast, so will I gather you in my anger and my wrath and put you inside the city and melt you.
verses.textEnEsv: As one gathers silver and bronze and iron and lead and tin into a furnace, to blow the fire on it in order to melt it, so I will gather you in my anger and in my wrath, and I will put you in and melt you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Asmen gather silver, bronze, iron, lead, and tin into the midst of a furnace, to blow fire on it, to melt it; so I will gather you in My anger and in My fury, and I will leave youthere and melt you.
verses.textEnNlt: Just as silver, copper, iron, lead, and tin are melted down in a furnace, I will melt you down in the heat of my fury.
verses.textEnNasb: As they gather silver, bronze, iron, lead, and tin into the smelting furnace to blow fire on it in order to melt it, so I will gather you in My anger and in My wrath, and I will place you there and melt you.
verses.textEn: As silver, copper, iron, lead and tin are gathered into a furnace to be melted with a fiery blast, so will I gather you in my anger and my wrath and put you inside the city and melt you.

verses.textZh: 我必集合你们，把我烈怒的火吹在你们身上，你们就必在城中熔化。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必集合你们，把我烈怒的火吹在你们身上，你们就必在城中熔化。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必聚集你们，把我烈怒的火吹在你们身上，你们就在其中熔化。
verses.textEnNiv: I will gather you and I will blow on you with my fiery wrath, and you will be melted inside her.
verses.textEnEsv: I will gather you and blow on you with the fire of my wrath, and you shall be melted in the midst of it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yes, I will gather you and blow on you with the fire of My wrath, and you shall be melted in its midst.
verses.textEnNlt: I will gather you together and blow the fire of my anger upon you,
verses.textEnNasb: And I will gather you and blow on you with the fire of My wrath, and you will be melted in the midst of it.
verses.textEn: I will gather you and I will blow on you with my fiery wrath, and you will be melted inside her.

verses.textZh: 银子怎样在炉中熔化，你们也必照样在城中熔化；你们就知道我耶和华把我的烈怒倒在你身上。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 银子怎样在炉中熔化，你们也必照样在城中熔化；你们就知道我耶和华把我的烈怒倒在你身上。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 银子怎样熔化在炉中，你们也必照样熔化在城中，你们就知道我－耶和华是将忿怒倒在你们身上了。」
verses.textEnNiv: As silver is melted in a furnace, so you will be melted inside her, and you will know that I the Lord have poured out my wrath on you.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: As silver is melted in a furnace, so you shall be melted in the midst of it, and you shall know that I am the Lord ; I have poured out my wrath upon you."
verses.textEnNkjv: As silver is melted in the midst of a furnace, so shall you be melted in its midst; then you shall know that I, the Lord, have poured out My fury on you.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: and you will melt like silver in fierce heat. Then you will know that I, the Lord , have poured out my fury on you.’"
verses.textEnNasb: As silver is melted in the furnace, so you will be melted in the midst of it; and you will know that I, the Lord, have poured out My wrath on you.’ "
verses.textEn: As silver is melted in a furnace, so you will be melted inside her, and you will know that I the Lord have poured out my wrath on you.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: Again the word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: And the word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnNkjv: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Again a message came to me from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: Again the word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: "人子啊！你要对这地说：‘在忿怒的日子，你是没有雨水 ，没有甘霖之地’。
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！你要对这地说：‘在忿怒的日子，你是没有雨水 ，没有甘霖之地’。
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，你要对这地说：你是未得洁净之地，在恼恨的日子也没有雨下在你以上。
verses.textEnNiv: "Son of man, say to the land, ‘You are a land that has not been cleansed or rained on in the day of wrath.’
verses.textEnEsv: "Son of man, say to her, You are a land that is not cleansed or rained upon in the day of indignation.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Son of man, say to her: ‘You are a land that is not cleansed or rained on in the day of indignation.’
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, give the people of Israel this message: In the day of my indignation, you will be like a polluted land, a land without rain.
verses.textEnNasb: "Son of man, say to her, ‘You are a land that is not clean or rained on in the day of indignation.’
verses.textEn: "Son of man, say to the land, ‘You are a land that has not been cleansed or rained on in the day of wrath.’

verses.textZh: 其中的先知叛逆，像吼叫的狮子撕碎猎物；他们把人吞吃，抢夺财物和珍宝，使其中寡妇的数目增多。
verses.textZhCnvs: 其中的先知叛逆，像吼叫的狮子撕碎猎物；他们把人吞吃，抢夺财物和珍宝，使其中寡妇的数目增多。
verses.textZhCuv: 其中的先知同谋背叛，如咆哮的狮子抓撕掠物。他们吞灭人民，抢夺财宝，使这地多有寡妇。
verses.textEnNiv: There is a conspiracy of her princes within her like a roaring lion tearing its prey; they devour people, take treasures and precious things and make many widows within her.
verses.textEnEsv: The conspiracy of her prophets in her midst is like a roaring lion tearing the prey; they have devoured human lives; they have taken treasure and precious things; they have made many widows in her midst.
verses.textEnNkjv: The conspiracy of her prophets in her midst is like a roaring lion tearing the prey; they have devoured people; they have taken treasure and precious things; they have made many widows in her midst.
verses.textEnNlt: Your princes plot conspiracies just as lions stalk their prey. They devour innocent people, seizing treasures and extorting wealth. They make many widows in the land.
verses.textEnNasb: There is a conspiracy of her prophets in her midst like a roaring lion tearing the prey. They have devoured lives; they have taken treasure and precious things; they have made many widows in the midst of her.
verses.textEn: There is a conspiracy of her princes within her like a roaring lion tearing its prey; they devour people, take treasures and precious things and make many widows within her.

verses.textZh: 这地的祭司违反我的律法，亵渎我的圣物；他们不分别圣俗，也不教导人分辨甚么是洁净的和不洁净的，又掩目不理我的安息日，以致我在他们中间被亵渎。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这地的祭司违反我的律法，亵渎我的圣物；他们不分别圣俗，也不教导人分辨甚么是洁净的和不洁净的，又掩目不理我的安息日，以致我在他们中间被亵渎。
verses.textZhCuv: 其中的祭司强解我的律法，亵渎我的圣物，不分别圣的和俗的，也不使人分辨洁净的和不洁净的，又遮眼不顾我的安息日；我也在他们中间被亵慢。
verses.textEnNiv: Her priests do violence to my law and profane my holy things; they do not distinguish between the holy and the common; they teach that there is no difference between the unclean and the clean; and they shut their eyes to the keeping of my Sabbaths, so that I am profaned among them.
verses.textEnEsv: Her priests have done violence to my law and have profaned my holy things. They have made no distinction between the holy and the common, neither have they taught the difference between the unclean and the clean, and they have disregarded my Sabbaths, so that I am profaned among them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Her priests have violated My law and profaned My holy things; they have not distinguished between the holy and unholy, nor have they made known thedifference between the unclean and the clean; and they have hidden their eyes from My Sabbaths, so that I am profaned among them.
verses.textEnNlt: Your priests have violated my instructions and defiled my holy things. They make no distinction between what is holy and what is not. And they do not teach my people the difference between what is ceremonially clean and unclean. They disregard my Sabbath days so that I am dishonored among them.
verses.textEnNasb: Her priests have done violence to My Law and have profaned My holy things; they have made no distinction between the holy and the common, and they have not taught the difference between the unclean and the clean; and they have closed their eyes from My Sabbaths, and I am defiled among them.
verses.textEn: Her priests do violence to my law and profane my holy things; they do not distinguish between the holy and the common; they teach that there is no difference between the unclean and the clean; and they shut their eyes to the keeping of my Sabbaths, so that I am profaned among them.

verses.textZh: 其中的官长好象撕碎猎物的豺狼，流人的血，灭人的命，为要得不义之财。
verses.textZhCnvs: 其中的官长好象撕碎猎物的豺狼，流人的血，灭人的命，为要得不义之财。
verses.textZhCuv: 其中的首领仿佛豺狼抓撕掠物，杀人流血，伤害人命，要得不义之财。
verses.textEnNiv: Her officials within her are like wolves tearing their prey; they shed blood and kill people to make unjust gain.
verses.textEnEsv: Her princes in her midst are like wolves tearing the prey, shedding blood, destroying lives to get dishonest gain.
verses.textEnNkjv: Her princes in her midst are like wolves tearing the prey, to shed blood, to destroy people, and to get dishonest gain.
verses.textEnNlt: Your leaders are like wolves who tear apart their victims. They actually destroy people’s lives for money!
verses.textEnNasb: Her leaders within her are like wolves tearing the prey, by shedding blood and destroying lives in order to make dishonest profit.
verses.textEn: Her officials within her are like wolves tearing their prey; they shed blood and kill people to make unjust gain.

verses.textZh: 这地的先知用灰泥给他们粉刷墙壁，为他们见虚假的异象，行骗人的占卜，说：‘主耶和华这样说’，其实当时耶和华并没有说话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这地的先知用灰泥给他们粉刷墙壁，为他们见虚假的异象，行骗人的占卜，说：‘主耶和华这样说’，其实当时耶和华并没有说话。
verses.textZhCuv: 其中的先知为百姓用未泡透的灰抹墙，就是为他们见虚假的异象，用谎诈的占卜，说：『主耶和华如此说』，其实耶和华没有说。
verses.textEnNiv: Her prophets whitewash these deeds for them by false visions and lying divinations. They say, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says’—when the Lord has not spoken.
verses.textEnEsv: And her prophets have smeared whitewash for them, seeing false visions and divining lies for them, saying, ‘Thus says the Lord God ,’ when the Lord has not spoken.
verses.textEnNkjv: Her prophets plastered them with untempered mortar, seeing false visions, and divining lies for them, saying, ‘Thus says the Lord God,’ when the Lord had not spoken.
verses.textEnNlt: And your prophets cover up for them by announcing false visions and making lying predictions. They say, ‘My message is from the Sovereign Lord ,’ when the Lord hasn’t spoken a single word to them.
verses.textEnNasb: And her prophets have coated with whitewash for them, seeing false visions and divining lies for them, saying, ‘This is what the Lord God says,’ when the Lord has not spoken.
verses.textEn: Her prophets whitewash these deeds for them by false visions and lying divinations. They say, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says’—when the Lord has not spoken.

verses.textZh: 这地的人民常常欺压人，惯行抢掠，亏待困苦穷乏的人，毫无公理地去欺压寄居的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这地的人民常常欺压人，惯行抢掠，亏待困苦穷乏的人，毫无公理地去欺压寄居的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 国内众民一味地欺压，惯行抢夺，亏负困苦穷乏的，背理欺压寄居的。
verses.textEnNiv: The people of the land practice extortion and commit robbery; they oppress the poor and needy and mistreat the foreigner, denying them justice.
verses.textEnEsv: The people of the land have practiced extortion and committed robbery. They have oppressed the poor and needy, and have extorted from the sojourner without justice.
verses.textEnNkjv: The people of the land have used oppressions, committed robbery, and mistreated the poor and needy; and they wrongfully oppress the stranger.
verses.textEnNlt: Even common people oppress the poor, rob the needy, and deprive foreigners of justice.
verses.textEnNasb: The people of the land have practiced extortion and committed robbery, and they have oppressed the poor and needy, and have oppressed the stranger without justice.
verses.textEn: The people of the land practice extortion and commit robbery; they oppress the poor and needy and mistreat the foreigner, denying them justice.

verses.textZh: 我在他们中间寻找一人重修墙垣，在我面前为这地站在破口之处，使我不毁灭这地，我却找不到一个。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我在他们中间寻找一人重修墙垣，在我面前为这地站在破口之处，使我不毁灭这地，我却找不到一个。
verses.textZhCuv: 我在他们中间寻找一人重修墙垣，在我面前为这国站在破口防堵，使我不灭绝这国，却找不着一个。
verses.textEnNiv: "I looked for someone among them who would build up the wall and stand before me in the gap on behalf of the land so I would not have to destroy it, but I found no one.
verses.textEnEsv: And I sought for a man among them who should build up the wall and stand in the breach before me for the land, that I should not destroy it, but I found none.
verses.textEnNkjv: So I sought for a man among them who would make a wall, and stand in the gap before Me on behalf of the land, that I should not destroy it; but I found no one.
verses.textEnNlt: "I looked for someone who might rebuild the wall of righteousness that guards the land. I searched for someone to stand in the gap in the wall so I wouldn’t have to destroy the land, but I found no one.
verses.textEnNasb: I searched for a man among them who would build up a wall and stand in the gap before Me for the land, so that I would not destroy it; but I found no one.
verses.textEn: "I looked for someone among them who would build up the wall and stand before me in the gap on behalf of the land so I would not have to destroy it, but I found no one.

verses.textZh: 所以我把我的忿怒倒在他们身上，用我烈怒之火消灭他们，把他们所行的报应在他们的头上。这是主耶和华的宣告。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以我把我的忿怒倒在他们身上，用我烈怒之火消灭他们，把他们所行的报应在他们的头上。这是主耶和华的宣告。"
verses.textZhCuv: 所以我将恼恨倒在他们身上，用烈怒的火灭了他们，照他们所行的报应在他们头上。这是主耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: So I will pour out my wrath on them and consume them with my fiery anger, bringing down on their own heads all they have done, declares the Sovereign Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore I have poured out my indignation upon them. I have consumed them with the fire of my wrath. I have returned their way upon their heads, declares the Lord God ."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I have poured out My indignation on them; I have consumed them with the fire of My wrath; and I have recompensed their deeds on their own heads," says the Lord God.
verses.textEnNlt: So now I will pour out my fury on them, consuming them with the fire of my anger. I will heap on their heads the full penalty for all their sins. I, the Sovereign Lord , have spoken!"
verses.textEnNasb: So I have poured out My indignation on them; I have consumed them with the fire of My wrath; I have brought their way upon their heads," declares the Lord God.
verses.textEn: So I will pour out my wrath on them and consume them with my fiery anger, bringing down on their own heads all they have done, declares the Sovereign Lord ."

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnNkjv: The word of the Lord came again to me, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: This message came to me from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: The word of the Lord came to me again, saying,
verses.textEn: The word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: "人子啊！有两个女人，都是同一个母亲生的。
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！有两个女人，都是同一个母亲生的。
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，有两个女子，是一母所生，
verses.textEnNiv: "Son of man, there were two women, daughters of the same mother.
verses.textEnEsv: "Son of man, there were two women, the daughters of one mother.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Son of man, there were two women, The daughters of one mother.
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, once there were two sisters who were daughters of the same mother.
verses.textEnNasb: "Son of man, there were two women, the daughters of one mother;
verses.textEn: "Son of man, there were two women, daughters of the same mother.

verses.textZh: 她们在埃及行邪淫，在幼年的时候行了邪淫，在那里她们的胸被人抚摩；在那里她们处女的乳房被人抚弄。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她们在埃及行邪淫，在幼年的时候行了邪淫，在那里她们的胸被人抚摩；在那里她们处女的乳房被人抚弄。
verses.textZhCuv: 她们在埃及行邪淫，在幼年时行邪淫。她们在那里作处女的时候，有人拥抱她们的怀，抚摸她们的乳。
verses.textEnNiv: They became prostitutes in Egypt, engaging in prostitution from their youth. In that land their breasts were fondled and their virgin bosoms caressed.
verses.textEnEsv: They played the whore in Egypt; they played the whore in their youth; there their breasts were pressed and their virgin bosoms handled.
verses.textEnNkjv: They committed harlotry in Egypt, They committed harlotry in their youth; Their breasts were there embraced, Their virgin bosom was there pressed.
verses.textEnNlt: They became prostitutes in Egypt. Even as young girls, they allowed men to fondle their breasts.
verses.textEnNasb: and they prostituted themselves in Egypt. They prostituted themselves in their youth; there their breasts were squeezed and there their virgin breasts were handled.
verses.textEn: They became prostitutes in Egypt, engaging in prostitution from their youth. In that land their breasts were fondled and their virgin bosoms caressed.

verses.textZh: 姊姊的名字是阿荷拉，妹妹的名字是阿荷利巴；她们都嫁了给我，并且生了儿女。论到她们的名字，阿荷拉就是撒玛利亚，阿荷利巴就是耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 姊姊的名字是阿荷拉，妹妹的名字是阿荷利巴；她们都嫁了给我，并且生了儿女。论到她们的名字，阿荷拉就是撒玛利亚，阿荷利巴就是耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCuv: 她们的名字，姊姊名叫阿荷拉，妹妹名叫阿荷利巴。她们都归于我，生了儿女。论到她们的名字，阿荷拉就是撒马利亚，阿荷利巴就是耶路撒冷。
verses.textEnNiv: The older was named Oholah, and her sister was Oholibah. They were mine and gave birth to sons and daughters. Oholah is Samaria, and Oholibah is Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: Oholah was the name of the elder and Oholibah the name of her sister. They became mine, and they bore sons and daughters. As for their names, Oholah is Samaria, and Oholibah is Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: Their names: Oholah the elder and Oholibah her sister; They were Mine, And they bore sons and daughters. Asfor their names, Samaria is Oholah, and Jerusalem is Oholibah.
verses.textEnNlt: The older girl was named Oholah, and her sister was Oholibah. I married them, and they bore me sons and daughters. I am speaking of Samaria and Jerusalem, for Oholah is Samaria and Oholibah is Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: Their names were Oholah the elder and Oholibah her sister. And they became Mine, and they gave birth to sons and daughters. And as for their names, Samaria is Oholah and Jerusalem is Oholibah.
verses.textEn: The older was named Oholah, and her sister was Oholibah. They were mine and gave birth to sons and daughters. Oholah is Samaria, and Oholibah is Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: "阿荷拉嫁了我以后仍行邪淫，恋慕她的爱人，就是亚述的战士。
verses.textZhCnvs: "阿荷拉嫁了我以后仍行邪淫，恋慕她的爱人，就是亚述的战士。

verses.textEnNlt: "Then Oholah lusted after other lovers instead of me, and she gave her love to the Assyrian officers.

verses.textZh: 他们穿著紫色衣服，是作总督和省长的；他们都是英俊的年轻人，是骑着马的骑兵。

verses.textZhCuv: 这些人都穿蓝衣，作省长、副省长，都骑着马，是可爱的少年人。
verses.textEnNiv: clothed in blue, governors and commanders, all of them handsome young men, and mounted horsemen.

verses.textEnNkjv: Whowere clothed in purple, Captains and rulers, All of them desirable young men, Horsemen riding on horses.

verses.textEn: clothed in blue, governors and commanders, all of them handsome young men, and mounted horsemen.

verses.textZh: 阿荷拉与这些亚述人中最美的男子行邪淫；她因自己所恋慕的每一个人和这些人的偶像玷污了自己。
