verses.textZhCuv: 阿荷拉就与亚述人中最美的男子放纵淫行，她因所恋爱之人的一切偶像，玷污自己。
verses.textEnNiv: She gave herself as a prostitute to all the elite of the Assyrians and defiled herself with all the idols of everyone she lusted after.
verses.textEnEsv: She bestowed her whoring upon them, the choicest men of Assyria all of them, and she defiled herself with all the idols of everyone after whom she lusted.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus she committed her harlotry with them, All of them choice men of Assyria; And with all for whom she lusted, With all their idols, she defiled herself.
verses.textEnNlt: And so she prostituted herself with the most desirable men of Assyria, worshiping their idols and defiling herself.
verses.textEnNasb: She bestowed her obscene practices on them, all of whom were the choicest men of Assyria; and with all whom she lusted after, with all their idols she defiled herself.
verses.textEn: She gave herself as a prostitute to all the elite of the Assyrians and defiled herself with all the idols of everyone she lusted after.

verses.textZh: 她没有离弃在埃及时的淫乱；那时她年幼，人与她同睡，抚弄她处女的乳房，把他们的情欲发泄在她身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她没有离弃在埃及时的淫乱；那时她年幼，人与她同睡，抚弄她处女的乳房，把他们的情欲发泄在她身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 自从在埃及的时候，她就没有离开淫乱，因为她年幼作处女的时候，埃及人与她行淫，抚摸她的乳，纵欲与她行淫。
verses.textEnNiv: She did not give up the prostitution she began in Egypt, when during her youth men slept with her, caressed her virgin bosom and poured out their lust on her.
verses.textEnEsv: She did not give up her whoring that she had begun in Egypt; for in her youth men had lain with her and handled her virgin bosom and poured out their whoring lust upon her.
verses.textEnNkjv: She has never given up her harlotry brought from Egypt, For in her youth they had lain with her, Pressed her virgin bosom, And poured out their immorality upon her.
verses.textEnNlt: For when she left Egypt, she did not leave her spirit of prostitution behind. She was still as lewd as in her youth, when the Egyptians slept with her, fondled her breasts, and used her as a prostitute.
verses.textEnNasb: She did not abandon her obscene practices from the time in Egypt; for in her youth men had slept with her, and they handled her virgin breasts and poured out their obscene practice on her.
verses.textEn: She did not give up the prostitution she began in Egypt, when during her youth men slept with her, caressed her virgin bosom and poured out their lust on her.

verses.textZh: 这些人露出她的下体，掳去她的儿女，用刀杀了她，使她在妇女中有了臭名，因为他们向她施行惩罚。

verses.textEnNiv: They stripped her naked, took away her sons and daughters and killed her with the sword. She became a byword among women, and punishment was inflicted on her.
verses.textEnEsv: These uncovered her nakedness; they seized her sons and her daughters; and as for her, they killed her with the sword; and she became a byword among women, when judgment had been executed on her.
verses.textEnNkjv: They uncovered her nakedness, Took away her sons and daughters, And slew her with the sword; She became a byword among women, For they had executed judgment on her.
verses.textEnNlt: They stripped her, took away her children as their slaves, and then killed her. After she received her punishment, her reputation was known to every woman in the land.
verses.textEnNasb: They uncovered her nakedness; they took her sons and her daughters, but they killed her with the sword. So she became a subject of gossip among women, and they executed judgments on her.
verses.textEn: They stripped her naked, took away her sons and daughters and killed her with the sword. She became a byword among women, and punishment was inflicted on her.

verses.textZh: "她妹妹阿荷利巴虽然看见了，却在自己情欲的事情上比姊姊更腐败，她的淫乱比姊姊的淫乱更甚。

verses.textEn: "Her sister Oholibah saw this, yet in her lust and prostitution she was more depraved than her sister.

verses.textEnNiv: She too lusted after the Assyrians—governors and commanders, warriors in full dress, mounted horsemen, all handsome young men.

verses.textEnNkjv: "She lusted for the neighboring Assyrians, Captains and rulers, Clothed most gorgeously, Horsemen riding on horses, All of them desirable young men.
verses.textEnNlt: She fawned over all the Assyrian officers—those captains and commanders in handsome uniforms, those charioteers driving their horses—all of them attractive young men.
verses.textEnNasb: She lusted after the Assyrians, governors and officials, the ones near, opulently dressed, horsemen riding on horses, all of them handsome young men.
verses.textEn: She too lusted after the Assyrians—governors and commanders, warriors in full dress, mounted horsemen, all handsome young men.

verses.textEn: I saw that she too defiled herself; both of them went the same way.

verses.textEnNlt: And so, Oholibah, you relived your former days as a young girl in Egypt, when you first allowed your breasts to be fondled.
verses.textEnNasb: So you longed for the outrageous sin of your youth, when the Egyptians handled your breasts because of the breasts of your youth.
verses.textEn: So you longed for the lewdness of your youth, when in Egypt your bosom was caressed and your young breasts fondled.

verses.textZh: "因此，阿荷利巴啊！主耶和华这样说：‘看哪！我必激动你的爱人攻击你，就是你心所疏远的人；我必带他们来从四面攻击你。
verses.textZhCnvs: "因此，阿荷利巴啊！主耶和华这样说：‘看哪！我必激动你的爱人攻击你，就是你心所疏远的人；我必带他们来从四面攻击你。
verses.textZhCuv: 阿荷利巴啊，主耶和华如此说：「我必激动你先爱而后生疏的人来攻击你。我必使他们来，在你四围攻击你。
verses.textEnNiv: "Therefore, Oholibah, this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I will stir up your lovers against you, those you turned away from in disgust, and I will bring them against you from every side—
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore, O Oholibah, thus says the Lord God : "Behold, I will stir up against you your lovers from whom you turned in disgust, and I will bring them against you from every side:
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore, Oholibah, thus says the Lord God: ‘Behold, I will stir up your lovers against you, From whom you have alienated yourself, And I will bring them against you from every side:
verses.textEnNlt: "Therefore, Oholibah, this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I will send your lovers against you from every direction—those very nations from which you turned away in disgust.
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore, Oholibah, this is what the Lord God says: ‘Behold I am going to incite your lovers against you, from whom you turned away in disgust, and I will bring them against you from every side:
verses.textEn: "Therefore, Oholibah, this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I will stir up your lovers against you, those you turned away from in disgust, and I will bring them against you from every side—

verses.textZh: 他们就是巴比伦人、迦勒底人、比割人、书亚人、哥亚人，与他们一起的还有亚述人，他们都是英俊的年轻人，是作总督和省长的，作长官和战士的，全部都是骑马的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就是巴比伦人、迦勒底人、比割人、书亚人、哥亚人，与他们一起的还有亚述人，他们都是英俊的年轻人，是作总督和省长的，作长官和战士的，全部都是骑马的。
verses.textZhCuv: 所来的就是巴比伦人、迦勒底的众人、比割人、书亚人、哥亚人，同着他们的还有亚述众人，乃是作省长、副省长、作军长有名声的，都骑着马，是可爱的少年人。
verses.textEnNiv: the Babylonians and all the Chaldeans, the men of Pekod and Shoa and Koa, and all the Assyrians with them, handsome young men, all of them governors and commanders, chariot officers and men of high rank, all mounted on horses.
verses.textEnEsv: the Babylonians and all the Chaldeans, Pekod and Shoa and Koa, and all the Assyrians with them, desirable young men, governors and commanders all of them, officers and men of renown, all of them riding on horses.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Babylonians, All the Chaldeans, Pekod, Shoa, Koa, All the Assyrians with them, All of them desirable young men, Governors and rulers, Captains and men of renown, All of them riding on horses.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Babylonians will come with all the Chaldeans from Pekod and Shoa and Koa. And all the Assyrians will come with them—handsome young captains, commanders, chariot officers, and other high-ranking officers, all riding their horses.
verses.textEnNasb: the Babylonians and all the Chaldeans, Pekod and Shoa and Koa, and all the Assyrians with them; handsome young men, governors and officials all of them, officers and men of renown, all of them riding on horses.
verses.textEn: the Babylonians and all the Chaldeans, the men of Pekod and Shoa and Koa, and all the Assyrians with them, handsome young men, all of them governors and commanders, chariot officers and men of high rank, all mounted on horses.

verses.textZh: 他们必带着兵器、马车、战车和大队人来攻击你；他们要拿着大小盾牌，戴着头盔，从四面摆阵攻击你；我要把审判的事交给他们，他们必按着自己的惯例来审判你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们必带着兵器、马车、战车和大队人来攻击你；他们要拿着大小盾牌，戴着头盔，从四面摆阵攻击你；我要把审判的事交给他们，他们必按着自己的惯例来审判你。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必带兵器、战车、辎重车，率领大众来攻击你。他们要拿大小盾牌，顶盔摆阵，在你四围攻击你。我要将审判的事交给他们，他们必按着自己的条例审判你。
verses.textEnNiv: They will come against you with weapons, chariots and wagons and with a throng of people; they will take up positions against you on every side with large and small shields and with helmets. I will turn you over to them for punishment, and they will punish you according to their standards.
verses.textEnEsv: And they shall come against you from the north with chariots and wagons and a host of peoples. They shall set themselves against you on every side with buckler, shield, and helmet; and I will commit the judgment to them, and they shall judge you according to their judgments.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they shall come against you With chariots, wagons, and war-horses, With a horde of people. They shall array against you Buckler, shield, and helmet all around. ‘I will delegate judgment to them, And they shall judge you according to their judgments.
verses.textEnNlt: They will all come against you from the north with chariots, wagons, and a great army prepared for attack. They will take up positions on every side, surrounding you with men armed with shields and helmets. And I will hand you over to them for punishment so they can do with you as they please.
verses.textEnNasb: And they will come against you with weapons, chariots, and wagons, and with a contingent of peoples. They will attack you on every side with shield, buckler, and helmet; and I will commit the judgment to them, and they will judge you according to their customs.
verses.textEn: They will come against you with weapons, chariots and wagons and with a throng of people; they will take up positions against you on every side with large and small shields and with helmets. I will turn you over to them for punishment, and they will punish you according to their standards.

verses.textZh: 我必向你发泄我的妒忿，他们必以烈怒待你；割去你的鼻子和耳朵；你余下的人必倒在刀下；他们要掳去你的儿女；你余下的人必被火吞吃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必向你发泄我的妒忿，他们必以烈怒待你；割去你的鼻子和耳朵；你余下的人必倒在刀下；他们要掳去你的儿女；你余下的人必被火吞吃。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必以忌恨攻击你；他们必以忿怒办你。他们必割去你的鼻子和耳朵；你遗留 的人必倒在刀下。他们必掳去你的儿女；你所遗留的必被火焚烧。
verses.textEnNiv: I will direct my jealous anger against you, and they will deal with you in fury. They will cut off your noses and your ears, and those of you who are left will fall by the sword. They will take away your sons and daughters, and those of you who are left will be consumed by fire.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will direct my jealousy against you, that they may deal with you in fury. They shall cut off your nose and your ears, and your survivors shall fall by the sword. They shall seize your sons and your daughters, and your survivors shall be devoured by fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will set My jealousy against you, And they shall deal furiously with you; They shall remove your nose and your ears, And your remnant shall fall by the sword; They shall take your sons and your daughters, And your remnant shall be devoured by fire.
verses.textEnNlt: I will turn my jealous anger against you, and they will deal harshly with you. They will cut off your nose and ears, and any survivors will then be slaughtered by the sword. Your children will be taken away as captives, and everything that is left will be burned.
verses.textEnNasb: I will set My jealousy against you, so that they may deal with you in wrath. They will remove your nose and your ears; and your survivors will fall by the sword. They will take your sons and your daughters; and your survivors will be consumed by the fire.
verses.textEn: I will direct my jealous anger against you, and they will deal with you in fury. They will cut off your noses and your ears, and those of you who are left will fall by the sword. They will take away your sons and daughters, and those of you who are left will be consumed by fire.

verses.textZh: 他们必剥去你的衣服，夺去你华丽的饰物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们必剥去你的衣服，夺去你华丽的饰物。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必剥去你的衣服，夺取你华美的宝器。
verses.textEnNiv: They will also strip you of your clothes and take your fine jewelry.
verses.textEnEsv: They shall also strip you of your clothes and take away your beautiful jewels.
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall also strip you of your clothes And take away your beautiful jewelry.
verses.textEnNlt: They will strip you of your beautiful clothes and jewels.
verses.textEnNasb: They will also strip you of your clothes and take away your beautiful jewelry.
verses.textEn: They will also strip you of your clothes and take your fine jewelry.

verses.textZh: 这样，我必使你的淫荡和你从埃及地沾染的淫乱离开你，你的眼必不仰望他们，你也必不再怀念埃及。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，我必使你的淫荡和你从埃及地沾染的淫乱离开你，你的眼必不仰望他们，你也必不再怀念埃及。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，我必使你的淫行和你从埃及地染来的淫乱止息了，使你不再仰望亚述，也不再追念埃及。
verses.textEnNiv: So I will put a stop to the lewdness and prostitution you began in Egypt. You will not look on these things with longing or remember Egypt anymore.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus I will put an end to your lewdness and your whoring begun in the land of Egypt, so that you shall not lift up your eyes to them or remember Egypt anymore.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Thus I will make you cease your lewdness and your harlotry Brought from the land of Egypt, So that you will not lift your eyes to them, Nor remember Egypt anymore.’
verses.textEnNlt: In this way, I will put a stop to the lewdness and prostitution you brought from Egypt. You will never again cast longing eyes on those things or fondly remember your time in Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: So I will remove from you your outrageous sin and your prostitution that you brought from the land of Egypt, so that you will not raise your eyes to them or remember Egypt anymore.’
verses.textEn: So I will put a stop to the lewdness and prostitution you began in Egypt. You will not look on these things with longing or remember Egypt anymore.

verses.textZh: 因为主耶和华这样说：看哪！我必把你交在你所恨的人手里，就是交在你的心所疏远的人手里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为主耶和华这样说：看哪！我必把你交在你所恨的人手里，就是交在你的心所疏远的人手里。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华如此说：我必将你交在你所恨恶的人手中，就是你心与他生疏的人手中。
verses.textEnNiv: "For this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I am about to deliver you into the hands of those you hate, to those you turned away from in disgust.
verses.textEnEsv: "For thus says the Lord God : Behold, I will deliver you into the hands of those whom you hate, into the hands of those from whom you turned in disgust,
verses.textEnNkjv: "For thus says the Lord God: ‘Surely I will deliver you into the hand of those you hate, into the hand ofthose from whom you alienated yourself.
verses.textEnNlt: "For this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I will surely hand you over to your enemies, to those you loathe, those you rejected.
verses.textEnNasb: For this is what the Lord God says: ‘Behold, I am going to hand you over to those whom you hate, to those from whom you turned away in disgust.
verses.textEn: "For this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I am about to deliver you into the hands of those you hate, to those you turned away from in disgust.

verses.textZh: 他们必以憎恨待你，夺去你一切劳碌得来的，留下你赤身露体；你行淫的下体、你的淫荡和淫乱，都必显露出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们必以憎恨待你，夺去你一切劳碌得来的，留下你赤身露体；你行淫的下体、你的淫荡和淫乱，都必显露出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必以恨恶办你，夺取你一切劳碌得来的，留下你赤身露体。你淫乱的下体，连你的淫行，带你的淫乱，都被显露。
verses.textEnNiv: They will deal with you in hatred and take away everything you have worked for. They will leave you stark naked, and the shame of your prostitution will be exposed. Your lewdness and promiscuity
verses.textEnEsv: and they shall deal with you in hatred and take away all the fruit of your labor and leave you naked and bare, and the nakedness of your whoring shall be uncovered. Your lewdness and your whoring
verses.textEnNkjv: They will deal hatefully with you, take away all you have worked for, and leave you naked and bare. The nakedness of your harlotry shall be uncovered, both your lewdness and your harlotry.
verses.textEnNlt: They will treat you with hatred and rob you of all you own, leaving you stark naked. The shame of your prostitution will be exposed to all the world.
verses.textEnNasb: They will deal with you in hatred, take all your property, and leave you naked and bare. And the nakedness of your prostitution will be exposed, both your outrageous sin and your obscene practices.
verses.textEn: They will deal with you in hatred and take away everything you have worked for. They will leave you stark naked, and the shame of your prostitution will be exposed. Your lewdness and promiscuity

verses.textZh: 这些事要行在你身上，因为你随从列国行淫，被他们的偶像玷污了自己。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些事要行在你身上，因为你随从列国行淫，被他们的偶像玷污了自己。
verses.textZhCuv: 人必向你行这些事；因为你随从外邦人行邪淫，被他们的偶像玷污了。
verses.textEnNiv: have brought this on you, because you lusted after the nations and defiled yourself with their idols.
verses.textEnEsv: have brought this upon you, because you played the whore with the nations and defiled yourself with their idols.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will do these things to you because you have gone as a harlot after the Gentiles, because you have become defiled by their idols.
verses.textEnNlt: You brought all this on yourself by prostituting yourself to other nations, defiling yourself with all their idols.
verses.textEnNasb: These things will be done to you because you have adulterously pursued the nations, because you have defiled yourself with their idols.
verses.textEn: have brought this on you, because you lusted after the nations and defiled yourself with their idols.

verses.textZh: 你走了你姊姊所走的路，所以我必把她的杯交在你手里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你走了你姊姊所走的路，所以我必把她的杯交在你手里。
verses.textZhCuv: 你走了你姊姊所走的路，所以我必将她的杯交在你手中。」
verses.textEnNiv: You have gone the way of your sister; so I will put her cup into your hand.
verses.textEnEsv: You have gone the way of your sister; therefore I will give her cup into your hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have walked in the way of your sister; therefore I will put her cup in your hand.’
verses.textEnNlt: Because you have followed in your sister’s footsteps, I will force you to drink the same cup of terror she drank.
verses.textEnNasb: You have walked in the way of your sister; therefore I will put her cup in your hand.’
verses.textEn: You have gone the way of your sister; so I will put her cup into your hand.

verses.textZh: 主耶和华这样说： 你必喝你姊姊所喝的杯， 那杯又深又阔， 容量甚大， 必使你成为嗤笑和讥讽的对象。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主耶和华这样说： 你必喝你姊姊所喝的杯， 那杯又深又阔， 容量甚大， 必使你成为嗤笑和讥讽的对象。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华如此说： 你必喝你姊姊所喝的杯； 那杯又深又广，盛得甚多， 使你被人嗤笑讥刺。
verses.textEnNiv: "This is what the Sovereign Lord says: "You will drink your sister’s cup, a cup large and deep; it will bring scorn and derision, for it holds so much.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord God : "You shall drink your sister’s cup that is deep and large; you shall be laughed at and held in derision, for it contains much;
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus says the Lord God: ‘You shall drink of your sister’s cup, The deep and wide one; You shall be laughed to scorn And held in derision; It contains much.
verses.textEnNlt: "Yes, this is what the Sovereign Lord says: "You will drink from your sister’s cup of terror, a cup that is large and deep. It is filled to the brim with scorn and derision.
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord God says: ‘You will drink your sister’s cup, Which is deep and wide. You will be laughed at and held in derision; Because it contains much.
verses.textEn: "This is what the Sovereign Lord says: "You will drink your sister’s cup, a cup large and deep; it will bring scorn and derision, for it holds so much.

verses.textZh: 你必酩酊大醉，充满愁苦， 那是惊慌和荒凉的杯， 就是你姊姊撒玛利亚的杯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你必酩酊大醉，充满愁苦， 那是惊慌和荒凉的杯， 就是你姊姊撒玛利亚的杯。
verses.textZhCuv: 你必酩酊大醉，满有愁苦， 喝干你姊姊撒马利亚的杯， 就是令人惊骇凄凉的杯。
verses.textEnNiv: You will be filled with drunkenness and sorrow, the cup of ruin and desolation, the cup of your sister Samaria.
verses.textEnEsv: you will be filled with drunkenness and sorrow. A cup of horror and desolation, the cup of your sister Samaria;
verses.textEnNkjv: You will be filled with drunkenness and sorrow, The cup of horror and desolation, The cup of your sister Samaria.
verses.textEnNlt: Drunkenness and anguish will fill you, for your cup is filled to the brim with distress and desolation, the same cup your sister Samaria drank.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘You will be filled with drunkenness and grief, A cup of horror and desolation, The cup of your sister Samaria.
verses.textEn: You will be filled with drunkenness and sorrow, the cup of ruin and desolation, the cup of your sister Samaria.

verses.textZh: 你要喝这杯，并且喝尽； 然后把这杯摔成碎块， 又抓伤自己的胸。 因为这是我曾说过的。’这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要喝这杯，并且喝尽； 然后把这杯摔成碎块， 又抓伤自己的胸。 因为这是我曾说过的。’这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 你必喝这杯，以致喝尽。 杯破又啃杯片， 撕裂自己的乳； 因为这事我曾说过。 这是主耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: You will drink it and drain it dry and chew on its pieces— and you will tear your breasts. I have spoken, declares the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: you shall drink it and drain it out, and gnaw its shards, and tear your breasts; for I have spoken, declares the Lord God .
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall drink and drain it, You shall break its shards, And tear at your own breasts; For I have spoken,’ Says the Lord God.
verses.textEnNlt: You will drain that cup of terror to the very bottom. Then you will smash it to pieces and beat your breast in anguish. I, the Sovereign Lord , have spoken!
verses.textEnNasb: ‘And you will drink it and drain it. Then you will gnaw on its fragments And tear your breasts; for I have spoken,’ declares the Lord God.
verses.textEn: You will drink it and drain it dry and chew on its pieces— and you will tear your breasts. I have spoken, declares the Sovereign Lord .

verses.textZh: 因此，主耶和华这样说：‘因为你忘记了我，把我丢在背后，所以你要担当你淫荡和淫乱的后果。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，主耶和华这样说：‘因为你忘记了我，把我丢在背后，所以你要担当你淫荡和淫乱的后果。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华如此说：「因你忘记我，将我丢在背后，所以你要担当你淫行和淫乱的报应。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: Since you have forgotten me and turned your back on me, you must bear the consequences of your lewdness and prostitution."
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore thus says the Lord God : Because you have forgotten me and cast me behind your back, you yourself must bear the consequences of your lewdness and whoring."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore thus says the Lord God: ‘Because you have forgotten Me and cast Me behind your back, Therefore you shall bear the penalty Of your lewdness and your harlotry.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: "And because you have forgotten me and turned your back on me, this is what the Sovereign Lord says: You must bear the consequences of all your lewdness and prostitution."
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, this is what the Lord God says: ‘Because you have forgotten Me and discarded Me behind your back, suffer on your own part the punishment for your outrageous sin and your obscene practices.’ "
verses.textEn: "Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: Since you have forgotten me and turned your back on me, you must bear the consequences of your lewdness and prostitution."

verses.textZh: 耶和华又对我说："人子啊，你要审判阿荷拉和阿荷利巴吗？你要把她们可憎的事向她们说明，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华又对我说："人子啊，你要审判阿荷拉和阿荷利巴吗？你要把她们可憎的事向她们说明，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华又对我说：「人子啊，你要审问阿荷拉与阿荷利巴吗？当指出她们所行可憎的事。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to me: "Son of man, will you judge Oholah and Oholibah? Then confront them with their detestable practices,
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord said to me: "Son of man, will you judge Oholah and Oholibah? Declare to them their abominations.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord also said to me: "Son of man, will you judge Oholah and Oholibah? Then declare to them their abominations.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord said to me, "Son of man, you must accuse Oholah and Oholibah of all their detestable sins.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, the Lord said to me, "Son of man, will you judge Oholah and Oholibah? Then declare to them their abominations.
verses.textEn: The Lord said to me: "Son of man, will you judge Oholah and Oholibah? Then confront them with their detestable practices,

verses.textZh: 因为她们行了奸淫，手中染血，与自己的偶像行奸淫，他们甚至使自己给我所生的儿女经火，献给偶像作食物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为她们行了奸淫，手中染血，与自己的偶像行奸淫，他们甚至使自己给我所生的儿女经火，献给偶像作食物。
verses.textZhCuv: 她们行淫，手中有杀人的血，又与偶像行淫，并使她们为我所生的儿女经火烧给偶像。
verses.textEnNiv: for they have committed adultery and blood is on their hands. They committed adultery with their idols; they even sacrificed their children, whom they bore to me, as food for them.
verses.textEnEsv: For they have committed adultery, and blood is on their hands. With their idols they have committed adultery, and they have even offered up to them for food the children whom they had borne to me.
verses.textEnNkjv: For they have committed adultery, and blood is on their hands. They have committed adultery with their idols, and even sacrificed their sons whom they bore to Me, passing them through thefire, to devour them.
verses.textEnNlt: They have committed both adultery and murder—adultery by worshiping idols and murder by burning as sacrifices the children they bore to me.
verses.textEnNasb: For they have committed adultery, and blood is on their hands. So they have committed adultery with their idols, and even made their sons, whom they bore to Me, pass through the fire to them as food.
verses.textEn: for they have committed adultery and blood is on their hands. They committed adultery with their idols; they even sacrificed their children, whom they bore to me, as food for them.

verses.textZh: 此外，同一天，她们还向我作了这事，就是玷污我的圣所，又亵渎我的安息日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 此外，同一天，她们还向我作了这事，就是玷污我的圣所，又亵渎我的安息日。
verses.textZhCuv: 此外，她们还有向我所行的，就是同日玷污我的圣所，干犯我的安息日。
verses.textEnNiv: They have also done this to me: At that same time they defiled my sanctuary and desecrated my Sabbaths.
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, this they have done to me: they have defiled my sanctuary on the same day and profaned my Sabbaths.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover they have done this to Me: They have defiled My sanctuary on the same day and profaned My Sabbaths.
verses.textEnNlt: Furthermore, they have defiled my Temple and violated my Sabbath day!
verses.textEnNasb: Again, they have done this to Me: they have defiled My sanctuary on the same day, and have profaned My Sabbaths.
verses.textEn: They have also done this to me: At that same time they defiled my sanctuary and desecrated my Sabbaths.

verses.textZh: 她们宰杀了自己的儿女献给偶像，同一天又进了我的圣所，把圣所亵渎。这就是她们在我殿中所行的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她们宰杀了自己的儿女献给偶像，同一天又进了我的圣所，把圣所亵渎。这就是她们在我殿中所行的。
verses.textZhCuv: 她们杀了儿女献与偶像，当天又入我的圣所，将圣所亵渎了。她们在我殿中所行的乃是如此。
verses.textEnNiv: On the very day they sacrificed their children to their idols, they entered my sanctuary and desecrated it. That is what they did in my house.
verses.textEnEsv: For when they had slaughtered their children in sacrifice to their idols, on the same day they came into my sanctuary to profane it. And behold, this is what they did in my house.
verses.textEnNkjv: For after they had slain their children for their idols, on the same day they came into My sanctuary to profane it; and indeed thus they have done in the midst of My house.
verses.textEnNlt: On the very day that they sacrificed their children to their idols, they boldly came into my Temple to worship! They came in and defiled my house.
verses.textEnNasb: For when they slaughtered their children for their idols, they entered My sanctuary on the same day to profane it; and behold, this is what they did within My house.
verses.textEn: On the very day they sacrificed their children to their idols, they entered my sanctuary and desecrated it. That is what they did in my house.

verses.textZh: 况且你们打发使者去请人从远方来；使者到了他们那里，他们就来了。为了他们，你们洗澡、替眼部化妆、佩戴珠宝，
verses.textZhCnvs: 况且你们打发使者去请人从远方来；使者到了他们那里，他们就来了。为了他们，你们洗澡、替眼部化妆、佩戴珠宝，
verses.textZhCuv: 「况且你们二妇打发使者去请远方人。使者到他们那里，他们就来了。你们为他们沐浴己身，粉饰眼目，佩戴妆饰，
verses.textEnNiv: "They even sent messengers for men who came from far away, and when they arrived you bathed yourself for them, applied eye makeup and put on your jewelry.
verses.textEnEsv: They even sent for men to come from afar, to whom a messenger was sent; and behold, they came. For them you bathed yourself, painted your eyes, and adorned yourself with ornaments.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Furthermore you sent for men to come from afar, to whom a messenger was sent; and there they came. And you washed yourself for them, painted your eyes, and adorned yourself with ornaments.
verses.textEnNlt: "You sisters sent messengers to distant lands to get men. Then when they arrived, you bathed yourselves, painted your eyelids, and put on your finest jewels for them.
verses.textEnNasb: "Furthermore, they have even sent for men who come from a great distance, to whom a messenger was sent; and behold, they came—for whom you bathed, put makeup on your eyes, and adorned yourselves with jewelry;
verses.textEn: "They even sent messengers for men who came from far away, and when they arrived you bathed yourself for them, applied eye makeup and put on your jewelry.

verses.textZh: 你们坐在华丽的床上，床前放置了一张桌子，把我的香料和膏油放在上面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们坐在华丽的床上，床前放置了一张桌子，把我的香料和膏油放在上面。
verses.textZhCuv: 坐在华美的床上，前面摆设桌案，将我的香料膏油摆在其上。
verses.textEnNiv: You sat on an elegant couch, with a table spread before it on which you had placed the incense and olive oil that belonged to me.
verses.textEnEsv: You sat on a stately couch, with a table spread before it on which you had placed my incense and my oil.
verses.textEnNkjv: You sat on a stately couch, with a table prepared before it, on which you had set My incense and My oil.
verses.textEnNlt: You sat with them on a beautifully embroidered couch and put my incense and my special oil on a table that was spread before you.
verses.textEnNasb: and you sat on a splendid couch with a table arranged in front of it on which you had set My incense and My oil.
verses.textEn: You sat on an elegant couch, with a table spread before it on which you had placed the incense and olive oil that belonged to me.

verses.textZh: 在那里有安逸无忧的群众发出喧哗的声音，有粗俗的人和酒徒从旷野而来，他们把手环戴在两个妇人的手上，把美丽的冠冕戴在她们头上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那里有安逸无忧的群众发出喧哗的声音，有粗俗的人和酒徒从旷野而来，他们把手环戴在两个妇人的手上，把美丽的冠冕戴在她们头上。
verses.textZhCuv: 在那里有群众安逸欢乐的声音，并有粗俗的人和酒徒从旷野同来，把镯子戴在二妇的手上，把华冠戴在她们的头上。
verses.textEnNiv: "The noise of a carefree crowd was around her; drunkards were brought from the desert along with men from the rabble, and they put bracelets on the wrists of the woman and her sister and beautiful crowns on their heads.
verses.textEnEsv: The sound of a carefree multitude was with her; and with men of the common sort, drunkards were brought from the wilderness; and they put bracelets on the hands of the women, and beautiful crowns on their heads.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sound of a carefree multitude was with her, and Sabeans were brought from the wilderness with men of the common sort, who put bracelets on their wrists and beautiful crowns on their heads.
verses.textEnNlt: From your room came the sound of many men carousing. They were lustful men and drunkards from the wilderness, who put bracelets on your wrists and beautiful crowns on your heads.
verses.textEnNasb: And the sound of a carefree multitude was with her; and heavy drinkers were brought from the wilderness with people from the multitude of humanity. And they put bracelets on the wrists of the women and beautiful crowns on their heads.
verses.textEn: "The noise of a carefree crowd was around her; drunkards were brought from the desert along with men from the rabble, and they put bracelets on the wrists of the woman and her sister and beautiful crowns on their heads.

verses.textZh: "我论到这个因行淫而衰颓的妇人说：现在让人与她行淫吧，因为她本来就是妓女。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我论到这个因行淫而衰颓的妇人说：现在让人与她行淫吧，因为她本来就是妓女。
verses.textZhCuv: 「我论这行淫衰老的妇人说：现在人还要与她行淫，她也要与人行淫。
verses.textEnNiv: Then I said about the one worn out by adultery, ‘Now let them use her as a prostitute, for that is all she is.’
verses.textEnEsv: "Then I said of her who was worn out by adultery, ‘Now they will continue to use her for a whore, even her!’
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I said concerning herwhohadgrown old in adulteries, ‘Will they commit harlotry with her now, and she withthem?’
verses.textEnNlt: Then I said, ‘If they really want to have sex with old worn-out prostitutes like these, let them!’
verses.textEnNasb: "Then I said concerning her who was worn out by adulteries, ‘ Will they now commit adultery with her when she is like this?’
verses.textEn: Then I said about the one worn out by adultery, ‘Now let them use her as a prostitute, for that is all she is.’

verses.textZh: 他们与她同睡；人怎样与妓女同睡，也怎样与阿荷拉和阿荷利巴那两个淫荡的妇人同睡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们与她同睡；人怎样与妓女同睡，也怎样与阿荷拉和阿荷利巴那两个淫荡的妇人同睡。
verses.textZhCuv: 人与阿荷拉，并阿荷利巴二淫妇苟合，好像与妓女苟合。
verses.textEnNiv: And they slept with her. As men sleep with a prostitute, so they slept with those lewd women, Oholah and Oholibah.
verses.textEnEsv: For they have gone in to her, as men go in to a prostitute. Thus they went in to Oholah and to Oholibah, lewd women!
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet they went in to her, as men go in to a woman who plays the harlot; thus they went in to Oholah and Oholibah, the lewd women.
verses.textEnNlt: And that is what they did. They had sex with Oholah and Oholibah, these shameless prostitutes.
verses.textEnNasb: But they went in to her as they would go in to a prostitute. This is how they went in to Oholah and to Oholibah, the lewd women.
verses.textEn: And they slept with her. As men sleep with a prostitute, so they slept with those lewd women, Oholah and Oholibah.

verses.textZh: 然而必有义人判她们受淫妇和流人血的妇人所受的刑罚，因为她们是淫妇，她们手中染血。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而必有义人判她们受淫妇和流人血的妇人所受的刑罚，因为她们是淫妇，她们手中染血。
verses.textZhCuv: 必有义人，照审判淫妇和流人血的妇人之例，审判她们；因为她们是淫妇，手中有杀人的血。」
verses.textEnNiv: But righteous judges will sentence them to the punishment of women who commit adultery and shed blood, because they are adulterous and blood is on their hands.
verses.textEnEsv: But righteous men shall pass judgment on them with the sentence of adulteresses, and with the sentence of women who shed blood, because they are adulteresses, and blood is on their hands."
verses.textEnNkjv: But righteous men will judge them after the manner of adulteresses, and after the manner of women who shed blood, because they are adulteresses, and blood is on their hands.
verses.textEnNlt: But righteous people will judge these sister cities for what they really are—adulterers and murderers.
verses.textEnNasb: But they, righteous people, will judge them with the judgment of adulteresses and with the judgment of women who shed blood, because they are adulteresses and blood is on their hands.
verses.textEn: But righteous judges will sentence them to the punishment of women who commit adultery and shed blood, because they are adulterous and blood is on their hands.

verses.textZh: "因为主耶和华这样说：我必使一大群人上来攻击她们，使她们惊慌，被人抢掠。
verses.textZhCnvs: "因为主耶和华这样说：我必使一大群人上来攻击她们，使她们惊慌，被人抢掠。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华如此说：「我必使多人来攻击她们，使她们抛来抛去，被人抢夺。
verses.textEnNiv: "This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Bring a mob against them and give them over to terror and plunder.
verses.textEnEsv: For thus says the Lord God : "Bring up a vast host against them, and make them an object of terror and a plunder.
verses.textEnNkjv: "For thus says the Lord God: ‘Bring up an assembly against them, give them up to trouble and plunder.
verses.textEnNlt: "Now this is what the Sovereign Lord says: Bring an army against them and hand them over to be terrorized and plundered.
verses.textEnNasb: "For this is what the Lord God says: ‘Bring up a contingent against them and turn them over to terror and plunder.
verses.textEn: "This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Bring a mob against them and give them over to terror and plunder.

verses.textZh: 这些人必用石头打她们，用刀剑砍她们，又杀戮她们的儿女，放火烧毁她们的房屋。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些人必用石头打她们，用刀剑砍她们，又杀戮她们的儿女，放火烧毁她们的房屋。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些人必用石头打死她们，用刀剑杀害她们，又杀戮她们的儿女，用火焚烧她们的房屋。
verses.textEnNiv: The mob will stone them and cut them down with their swords; they will kill their sons and daughters and burn down their houses.
verses.textEnEsv: And the host shall stone them and cut them down with their swords. They shall kill their sons and their daughters, and burn up their houses.
verses.textEnNkjv: The assembly shall stone them with stones and execute them with their swords; they shall slay their sons and their daughters, and burn their houses with fire.
verses.textEnNlt: For their enemies will stone them and kill them with swords. They will butcher their sons and daughters and burn their homes.
verses.textEnNasb: The contingent will stone them with stones and cut them down with their swords; they will kill their sons and their daughters and burn their houses with fire.
verses.textEn: The mob will stone them and cut them down with their swords; they will kill their sons and daughters and burn down their houses.

verses.textZh: 这样，我必使淫荡从这地止息，好叫所有的妇人都受到警戒，不敢照着你们的淫荡而行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，我必使淫荡从这地止息，好叫所有的妇人都受到警戒，不敢照着你们的淫荡而行。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，我必使淫行从境内止息，好叫一切妇人都受警戒，不效法你们的淫行。
verses.textEnNiv: "So I will put an end to lewdness in the land, that all women may take warning and not imitate you.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus will I put an end to lewdness in the land, that all women may take warning and not commit lewdness as you have done.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus I will cause lewdness to cease from the land, that all women may be taught not to practice your lewdness.
verses.textEnNlt: In this way, I will put an end to lewdness and idolatry in the land, and my judgment will be a warning to all women not to follow your wicked example.
verses.textEnNasb: So I will eliminate outrageous conduct from the land, so that all women will take warning and not commit outrageous sin as you have done.
verses.textEn: "So I will put an end to lewdness in the land, that all women may take warning and not imitate you.

verses.textZh: 人要把你们行淫的报应归在你们身上；你们要担当你们拜偶像的罪；你们就知道我是主耶和华。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 人要把你们行淫的报应归在你们身上；你们要担当你们拜偶像的罪；你们就知道我是主耶和华。"
verses.textZhCuv: 人必照着你们的淫行报应你们；你们要担当拜偶像的罪，就知道我是主耶和华。」
verses.textEnNiv: You will suffer the penalty for your lewdness and bear the consequences of your sins of idolatry. Then you will know that I am the Sovereign Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: And they shall return your lewdness upon you, and you shall bear the penalty for your sinful idolatry, and you shall know that I am the Lord God ."
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall repay you for your lewdness, and you shall pay for your idolatrous sins. Then you shall know that I am the Lord God.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: You will be fully repaid for all your prostitution—your worship of idols. Yes, you will suffer the full penalty. Then you will know that I am the Sovereign Lord ."
verses.textEnNasb: Your outrageous conduct will be repaid to you, and you will bear the guilt for your idols; so you will know that I am the Lord God.’ "
verses.textEn: You will suffer the penalty for your lewdness and bear the consequences of your sins of idolatry. Then you will know that I am the Sovereign Lord ."

verses.textZh: 第九年十月十日，耶和华的话又临到我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 第九年十月十日，耶和华的话又临到我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 第九年十月初十日，耶和华的话又临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: In the ninth year, in the tenth month on the tenth day, the word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: In the ninth year, in the tenth month, on the tenth day of the month, the word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnNkjv: Again, in the ninth year, in the tenth month, on the tenth day of the month, the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: On January 15, during the ninth year of King Jehoiachin’s captivity, this message came to me from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: Now the word of the Lord came to me in the ninth year, in the tenth month, on the tenth of the month, saying,
verses.textEn: In the ninth year, in the tenth month on the tenth day, the word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: "人子啊！你要记下今天的日子，正正是今天，因为巴比伦王就是在这一天围困耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！你要记下今天的日子，正正是今天，因为巴比伦王就是在这一天围困耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，今日正是巴比伦王就近耶路撒冷的日子，你要将这日记下，
verses.textEnNiv: "Son of man, record this date, this very date, because the king of Babylon has laid siege to Jerusalem this very day.
verses.textEnEsv: "Son of man, write down the name of this day, this very day. The king of Babylon has laid siege to Jerusalem this very day.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Son of man, write down the name of the day, this very day—the king of Babylon started his siege against Jerusalem this very day.
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, write down today’s date, because on this very day the king of Babylon is beginning his attack against Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: "Son of man, write the name of the day, this very day. The king of Babylon has laid siege to Jerusalem this very day.
verses.textEn: "Son of man, record this date, this very date, because the king of Babylon has laid siege to Jerusalem this very day.

verses.textZh: 你要向这叛逆的民族设比喻，对他们说：‘主耶和华这样说： 把锅放在火上，放好了，就把水倒在锅里；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要向这叛逆的民族设比喻，对他们说：‘主耶和华这样说： 把锅放在火上，放好了，就把水倒在锅里；
verses.textZhCuv: 要向这悖逆之家设比喻说，主耶和华如此说： 将锅放在火上， 放好了，就倒水在其中；
verses.textEnNiv: Tell this rebellious people a parable and say to them: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: " ‘Put on the cooking pot; put it on and pour water into it.
verses.textEnEsv: And utter a parable to the rebellious house and say to them, Thus says the Lord God : "Set on the pot, set it on; pour in water also;
verses.textEnNkjv: And utter a parable to the rebellious house, and say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord God: "Put on a pot, set it on, And also pour water into it.
verses.textEnNlt: Then give these rebels an illustration with this message from the Sovereign Lord : "Put a pot on the fire, and pour in some water.
verses.textEnNasb: Present a parable to the rebellious house and say to them, ‘This is what the Lord God says: "Put on the pot, put it on and also pour water into it;
verses.textEn: Tell this rebellious people a parable and say to them: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: " ‘Put on the cooking pot; put it on and pour water into it.

verses.textZh: 把肉块，就是所有肥美的肉块， 腿肉和肩肉，都放进锅里； 用上好的骨头把锅装满。
verses.textZhCnvs: 把肉块，就是所有肥美的肉块， 腿肉和肩肉，都放进锅里； 用上好的骨头把锅装满。
verses.textZhCuv: 将肉块，就是一切肥美的肉块、腿， 和肩都聚在其中， 拿美好的骨头把锅装满；
verses.textEnNiv: Put into it the pieces of meat, all the choice pieces—the leg and the shoulder. Fill it with the best of these bones;
verses.textEnEsv: put in it the pieces of meat, all the good pieces, the thigh and the shoulder; fill it with choice bones.
verses.textEnNkjv: Gather pieces ofmeat in it, Every good piece, The thigh and the shoulder. Fill it with choice cuts;
verses.textEnNlt: Fill it with choice pieces of meat— the rump and the shoulder and all the most tender cuts.
verses.textEnNasb: Put in it the pieces of meat, Every good piece, the thigh and the shoulder; Fill it with choice bones.
verses.textEn: Put into it the pieces of meat, all the choice pieces—the leg and the shoulder. Fill it with the best of these bones;

verses.textZh: 要选用羊群中最好的， 把柴堆放在锅底下， 使锅沸腾， 把骨头煮在锅中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要选用羊群中最好的， 把柴堆放在锅底下， 使锅沸腾， 把骨头煮在锅中。
verses.textZhCuv: 取羊群中最好的， 将柴堆在锅下， 使锅开滚， 好把骨头煮在其中。
verses.textEnNiv: take the pick of the flock. Pile wood beneath it for the bones; bring it to a boil and cook the bones in it.
verses.textEnEsv: Take the choicest one of the flock; pile the logs under it; boil it well; seethe also its bones in it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Take the choice of the flock. Also pile fuel bones under it, Make it boil well, And let the cuts simmer in it."
verses.textEnNlt: Use only the best sheep from the flock, and heap fuel on the fire beneath the pot. Bring the pot to a boil, and cook the bones along with the meat.
verses.textEnNasb: "Take the choicest of the flock, And also stack wood under the pot. Make it boil vigorously. Also boil its bones in it."
verses.textEn: take the pick of the flock. Pile wood beneath it for the bones; bring it to a boil and cook the bones in it.

verses.textZh: "‘因此，主耶和华这样说： 流人血的城， 就是长锈的锅，有祸了！ 它的锈未曾除掉， 要把锅里的东西一块一块取出来， 不必为它们抽签。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘因此，主耶和华这样说： 流人血的城， 就是长锈的锅，有祸了！ 它的锈未曾除掉， 要把锅里的东西一块一块取出来， 不必为它们抽签。
verses.textZhCuv: 「主耶和华如此说：祸哉！这流人血的城，就是长锈的锅。其中的锈未曾除掉，须要将肉块从其中一一取出来，不必为它拈阄。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘For this is what the Sovereign Lord says: " ‘Woe to the city of bloodshed, to the pot now encrusted, whose deposit will not go away! Take the meat out piece by piece in whatever order it comes.
verses.textEnEsv: "Therefore thus says the Lord God : Woe to the bloody city, to the pot whose corrosion is in it, and whose corrosion has not gone out of it! Take out of it piece after piece, without making any choice.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Therefore thus says the Lord God: "Woe to the bloody city, To the pot whose scum is in it, And whose scum is not gone from it! Bring it out piece by piece, On which no lot has fallen.
verses.textEnNlt: "Now this is what the Sovereign Lord says: What sorrow awaits Jerusalem, the city of murderers! She is a cooking pot whose corruption can’t be cleaned out. Take the meat out in random order, for no piece is better than another.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Therefore, this is what the Lord God says: "Woe to the bloody city, To the pot in which there is rust And whose rust has not gone out of it! Take out of it piece after piece, Without making a choice.
verses.textEn: " ‘For this is what the Sovereign Lord says: " ‘Woe to the city of bloodshed, to the pot now encrusted, whose deposit will not go away! Take the meat out piece by piece in whatever order it comes.

verses.textZh: 因为她所流的血还在城中； 她把血泼在光滑的盘石上， 不是倒在地上， 被尘土掩盖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为她所流的血还在城中； 她把血泼在光滑的盘石上， 不是倒在地上， 被尘土掩盖。
verses.textZhCuv: 城中所流的血倒在净光的磐石上，不倒在地上，用土掩盖。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘For the blood she shed is in her midst: She poured it on the bare rock; she did not pour it on the ground, where the dust would cover it.
verses.textEnEsv: For the blood she has shed is in her midst; she put it on the bare rock; she did not pour it out on the ground to cover it with dust.
verses.textEnNkjv: For her blood is in her midst; She set it on top of a rock; She did not pour it on the ground, To cover it with dust.
verses.textEnNlt: For the blood of her murders is splashed on the rocks. It isn’t even spilled on the ground, where the dust could cover it!
verses.textEnNasb: "For her blood is in her midst; She placed it on the bare rock; She did not pour it on the ground To cover it with dust.
verses.textEn: " ‘For the blood she shed is in her midst: She poured it on the bare rock; she did not pour it on the ground, where the dust would cover it.

verses.textZh: 我为了发烈怒，好施行报应， 就把她的血倒在光滑的盘石上， 以致不得掩盖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我为了发烈怒，好施行报应， 就把她的血倒在光滑的盘石上， 以致不得掩盖。
verses.textZhCuv: 这城中所流的血倒在净光的磐石上，不得掩盖，乃是出于我，为要发忿怒施行报应。
verses.textEnNiv: To stir up wrath and take revenge I put her blood on the bare rock, so that it would not be covered.
verses.textEnEsv: To rouse my wrath, to take vengeance, I have set on the bare rock the blood she has shed, that it may not be covered.
verses.textEnNkjv: That it may raise up fury and take vengeance, I have set her blood on top of a rock, That it may not be covered."
verses.textEnNlt: So I will splash her blood on a rock for all to see, an expression of my anger and vengeance against her.
verses.textEnNasb: "So that it may cause wrath to come up to take vengeance, I have put her blood on the bare rock, So that it will not be covered."
verses.textEn: To stir up wrath and take revenge I put her blood on the bare rock, so that it would not be covered.

verses.textZh: 因此，主耶和华这样说： 流人血的城，有祸了！ 我也必把柴堆加大。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，主耶和华这样说： 流人血的城，有祸了！ 我也必把柴堆加大。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以主耶和华如此说：祸哉！这流人血的城，我也必大堆火柴，
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: " ‘Woe to the city of bloodshed! I, too, will pile the wood high.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore thus says the Lord God : Woe to the bloody city! I also will make the pile great.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Therefore thus says the Lord God: "Woe to the bloody city! I too will make the pyre great.
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Sovereign Lord says: What sorrow awaits Jerusalem, the city of murderers! I myself will pile up the fuel beneath her.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, this is what the Lord God says: "Woe to the bloody city! I also will make the wood pile great.
verses.textEn: " ‘Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: " ‘Woe to the city of bloodshed! I, too, will pile the wood high.

verses.textZh: 你要多加柴枝，点上火， 混和香料， 把肉煮烂， 使骨头烧焦；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要多加柴枝，点上火， 混和香料， 把肉煮烂， 使骨头烧焦；
verses.textZhCuv: 添上木柴，使火着旺，将肉煮烂，把汤熬浓，使骨头烤焦；
verses.textEnNiv: So heap on the wood and kindle the fire. Cook the meat well, mixing in the spices; and let the bones be charred.
verses.textEnEsv: Heap on the logs, kindle the fire, boil the meat well, mix in the spices, and let the bones be burned up.
verses.textEnNkjv: Heap on the wood, Kindle the fire; Cook the meat well, Mix in the spices, And let the cuts be burned up.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, heap on the wood! Let the fire roar to make the pot boil. Cook the meat with many spices, and afterward burn the bones.
verses.textEnNasb: "Heap on the wood, kindle the fire, Cook the meat thoroughly And mix in the spices, And let the bones be burned up.
verses.textEn: So heap on the wood and kindle the fire. Cook the meat well, mixing in the spices; and let the bones be charred.

verses.textZh: 然后把空锅放在炭火上， 使锅烧热， 使铜烧红， 使其中的污秽熔化， 使它的锈得以除净。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后把空锅放在炭火上， 使锅烧热， 使铜烧红， 使其中的污秽熔化， 使它的锈得以除净。
verses.textZhCuv: 把锅倒空坐在炭火上，使锅烧热，使铜烧红，熔化其中的污秽，除净其上的锈。
verses.textEnNiv: Then set the empty pot on the coals till it becomes hot and its copper glows, so that its impurities may be melted and its deposit burned away.
verses.textEnEsv: Then set it empty upon the coals, that it may become hot, and its copper may burn, that its uncleanness may be melted in it, its corrosion consumed.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then set the pot empty on the coals, That it may become hot and its bronze may burn, That its filthiness may be melted in it, That its scum may be consumed.
verses.textEnNlt: Now set the empty pot on the coals. Heat it red hot! Burn away the filth and corruption.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then set it empty on its burning coals So that it may be hot And its bronze may glow, And its filthiness may be melted in it, Its rust eliminated.
verses.textEn: Then set the empty pot on the coals till it becomes hot and its copper glows, so that its impurities may be melted and its deposit burned away.

verses.textZh: 这锅真叫人疲累！ 它厚厚的锈总没法除掉， 就是用火也不能除掉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这锅真叫人疲累！ 它厚厚的锈总没法除掉， 就是用火也不能除掉。
verses.textZhCuv: 这锅劳碌疲乏，所长的大锈仍未除掉；这锈就是用火也不能除掉。
verses.textEnNiv: It has frustrated all efforts; its heavy deposit has not been removed, not even by fire.
verses.textEnEsv: She has wearied herself with toil; its abundant corrosion does not go out of it. Into the fire with its corrosion!
verses.textEnNkjv: She has grown weary with lies, And her great scum has not gone from her. Let her scum be in the fire!
verses.textEnNlt: But it’s hopeless; the corruption can’t be cleaned out. So throw it into the fire.
verses.textEnNasb: "She has wearied Me with work, Yet her great rust has not gone from her; Let her rust be in the fire!
verses.textEn: It has frustrated all efforts; its heavy deposit has not been removed, not even by fire.

verses.textZh: 你的污秽就是淫荡。我想要洁净你，你却不愿意洁净，所以你的污秽再不能得到洁净，直等到我向你发的烈怒止息。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的污秽就是淫荡。我想要洁净你，你却不愿意洁净，所以你的污秽再不能得到洁净，直等到我向你发的烈怒止息。
verses.textZhCuv: 在你污秽中有淫行，我洁净你，你却不洁净。你的污秽再不能洁净，直等我向你发的忿怒止息。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Now your impurity is lewdness. Because I tried to cleanse you but you would not be cleansed from your impurity, you will not be clean again until my wrath against you has subsided.
verses.textEnEsv: On account of your unclean lewdness, because I would have cleansed you and you were not cleansed from your uncleanness, you shall not be cleansed anymore till I have satisfied my fury upon you.
verses.textEnNkjv: In your filthiness is lewdness. Because I have cleansed you, and you were not cleansed, You will not be cleansed of your filthiness anymore, Till I have caused My fury to rest upon you.
verses.textEnNlt: Your impurity is your lewdness and the corruption of your idolatry. I tried to cleanse you, but you refused. So now you will remain in your filth until my fury against you has been satisfied.
verses.textEnNasb: "In your filthiness is outrageous sin. Because I would have cleansed you, Yet you are not clean, You will not be cleansed from your filthiness again Until I have expended My wrath on you.
verses.textEn: " ‘Now your impurity is lewdness. Because I tried to cleanse you but you would not be cleansed from your impurity, you will not be clean again until my wrath against you has subsided.

verses.textZh: 我耶和华已经说了。时候到了，我必成就；我必不退缩，必不顾惜，也不改变心意；我必照着你的所作所为审判你。这是主耶和华的宣告。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我耶和华已经说了。时候到了，我必成就；我必不退缩，必不顾惜，也不改变心意；我必照着你的所作所为审判你。这是主耶和华的宣告。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 我－耶和华说过的必定成就，必照话而行，必不返回，必不顾惜，也不后悔。人必照你的举动行为审判你。这是主耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘I the Lord have spoken. The time has come for me to act. I will not hold back; I will not have pity, nor will I relent. You will be judged according to your conduct and your actions, declares the Sovereign Lord .’ "
verses.textEnEsv: I am the Lord . I have spoken; it shall come to pass; I will do it. I will not go back; I will not spare; I will not relent; according to your ways and your deeds you will be judged, declares the Lord God ."
verses.textEnNkjv: I, the Lord, have spoken it; It shall come to pass, and I will do it; I will not hold back, Nor will I spare, Nor will I relent; According to your ways And according to your deeds They will judge you," Says the Lord God.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: "I, the Lord , have spoken! The time has come, and I won’t hold back. I will not change my mind, and I will have no pity on you. You will be judged on the basis of all your wicked actions, says the Sovereign Lord ."
verses.textEnNasb: I, the Lord, have spoken; it is coming and I will act. I will not overlook, I will not pity, and I will not be sorry; according to your ways and according to your deeds I will judge you," declares the Lord God.’ "
verses.textEn: " ‘I the Lord have spoken. The time has come for me to act. I will not hold back; I will not have pity, nor will I relent. You will be judged according to your conduct and your actions, declares the Sovereign Lord .’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnNkjv: Also the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then this message came to me from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: The word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: "人子啊！我要打击你，把你眼中所喜爱的夺去，你却不可悲哀，不可哭泣，也不可流泪。
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！我要打击你，把你眼中所喜爱的夺去，你却不可悲哀，不可哭泣，也不可流泪。
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，我要将你眼目所喜爱的忽然取去，你却不可悲哀哭泣，也不可流泪，
verses.textEnNiv: "Son of man, with one blow I am about to take away from you the delight of your eyes. Yet do not lament or weep or shed any tears.
verses.textEnEsv: "Son of man, behold, I am about to take the delight of your eyes away from you at a stroke; yet you shall not mourn or weep, nor shall your tears run down.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Son of man, behold, I take away from you the desire of your eyes with one stroke; yet you shall neither mourn nor weep, nor shall your tears run down.
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, with one blow I will take away your dearest treasure. Yet you must not show any sorrow at her death. Do not weep; let there be no tears.
verses.textEnNasb: "Son of man, behold, I am about to take from you what is precious to your eyes with a fatal blow; but you shall not mourn and you shall not weep, and your tears shall not come.
verses.textEn: "Son of man, with one blow I am about to take away from you the delight of your eyes. Yet do not lament or weep or shed any tears.

verses.textZh: 只可静默地叹息，不可为死人哀悼；你的头上仍要缠着头巾，脚上仍要穿著鞋子；你不可蒙着脸，也不可吃为丧家预备的食物。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 只可静默地叹息，不可为死人哀悼；你的头上仍要缠着头巾，脚上仍要穿著鞋子；你不可蒙着脸，也不可吃为丧家预备的食物。"
verses.textZhCuv: 只可叹息，不可出声，不可办理丧事；头上仍勒裹头巾，脚上仍穿鞋，不可蒙着嘴唇，也不可吃吊丧的食物。」
verses.textEnNiv: Groan quietly; do not mourn for the dead. Keep your turban fastened and your sandals on your feet; do not cover your mustache and beard or eat the customary food of mourners."
verses.textEnEsv: Sigh, but not aloud; make no mourning for the dead. Bind on your turban, and put your shoes on your feet; do not cover your lips, nor eat the bread of men."
verses.textEnNkjv: Sigh in silence, make no mourning for the dead; bind your turban on your head, and put your sandals on your feet; do not cover your lips, and do not eat man’s bread ofsorrow."
verses.textEnNlt: Groan silently, but let there be no wailing at her grave. Do not uncover your head or take off your sandals. Do not perform the usual rituals of mourning or accept any food brought to you by consoling friends."
verses.textEnNasb: Groan silently; do no mourning for the dead. Bind on your turban and put your sandals on your feet, and do not cover your mustache, and do not eat the bread of other people."
verses.textEn: Groan quietly; do not mourn for the dead. Keep your turban fastened and your sandals on your feet; do not cover your mustache and beard or eat the customary food of mourners."

verses.textZh: 于是我在早上对众人说了这事，晚上我的妻子就死了；次日早晨我就照着所吩咐我的行了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是我在早上对众人说了这事，晚上我的妻子就死了；次日早晨我就照着所吩咐我的行了。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是我将这事早晨告诉百姓，晚上我的妻就死了。次日早晨我便遵命而行。
verses.textEnNiv: So I spoke to the people in the morning, and in the evening my wife died. The next morning I did as I had been commanded.
verses.textEnEsv: So I spoke to the people in the morning, and at evening my wife died. And on the next morning I did as I was commanded.
verses.textEnNkjv: So I spoke to the people in the morning, and at evening my wife died; and the next morning I did as I was commanded.
verses.textEnNlt: So I proclaimed this to the people the next morning, and in the evening my wife died. The next morning I did everything I had been told to do.
verses.textEnNasb: So I spoke to the people in the morning, and in the evening my wife died. And in the morning I did as I was commanded.
verses.textEn: So I spoke to the people in the morning, and in the evening my wife died. The next morning I did as I had been commanded.

verses.textZh: 众人问我："你不告诉我们你这样行与我们有甚么关系吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人问我："你不告诉我们你这样行与我们有甚么关系吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 百姓问我说：「你这样行与我们有什么关系，你不告诉我们吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the people asked me, "Won’t you tell us what these things have to do with us? Why are you acting like this?"
verses.textEnEsv: And the people said to me, "Will you not tell us what these things mean for us, that you are acting thus?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And the people said to me, "Will you not tell us what these thingssignify to us, that you behave so?"
verses.textEnNlt: Then the people asked, "What does all this mean? What are you trying to tell us?"
verses.textEnNasb: And the people said to me, "Will you not tell us what these things mean for us, that you are doing?"
verses.textEn: Then the people asked me, "Won’t you tell us what these things have to do with us? Why are you acting like this?"

verses.textZh: 我回答他们："耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 我回答他们："耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 我回答他们：「耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: So I said to them, "The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: Then I said to them, "The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I answered them, "The word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: So I said to them, "A message came to me from the Lord ,
verses.textEnNasb: Then I said to them, "The word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: So I said to them, "The word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: ‘你要告诉以色列家，主耶和华这样说：看哪！我必使我的圣所被亵渎，这圣所就是你们所夸耀的势力，眼所喜爱的，心中所爱惜的。你们遗下的儿女，都必倒在刀下。
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘你要告诉以色列家，主耶和华这样说：看哪！我必使我的圣所被亵渎，这圣所就是你们所夸耀的势力，眼所喜爱的，心中所爱惜的。你们遗下的儿女，都必倒在刀下。
verses.textZhCuv: 『你告诉以色列家，主耶和华如此说：我必使我的圣所，就是你们势力所夸耀、眼里所喜爱、心中所爱惜的被亵渎，并且你们所遗留的儿女必倒在刀下。
verses.textEnNiv: Say to the people of Israel, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I am about to desecrate my sanctuary—the stronghold in which you take pride, the delight of your eyes, the object of your affection. The sons and daughters you left behind will fall by the sword.
verses.textEnEsv: ‘Say to the house of Israel, Thus says the Lord God : Behold, I will profane my sanctuary, the pride of your power, the delight of your eyes, and the yearning of your soul, and your sons and your daughters whom you left behind shall fall by the sword.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Speak to the house of Israel, "Thus says the Lord God: ‘Behold, I will profane My sanctuary, your arrogant boast, the desire of your eyes, the delight of your soul; and your sons and daughters whom you left behind shall fall by the sword.
verses.textEnNlt: and I was told to give this message to the people of Israel. This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I will defile my Temple, the source of your security and pride, the place your heart delights in. Your sons and daughters whom you left behind in Judah will be slaughtered by the sword.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Speak to the house of Israel, "This is what the Lord God says: ‘Behold, I am about to profane My sanctuary, the pride of your power, that which is precious in your eyes and the longing of your soul; and your sons and your daughters whom you have left behind will fall by the sword.
verses.textEn: Say to the people of Israel, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I am about to desecrate my sanctuary—the stronghold in which you take pride, the delight of your eyes, the object of your affection. The sons and daughters you left behind will fall by the sword.

verses.textZh: 那时你们要照着我所行的去行；你们不可蒙着脸，也不可吃为丧家预备的食物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时你们要照着我所行的去行；你们不可蒙着脸，也不可吃为丧家预备的食物。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，你们必行我仆人所行的，不蒙着嘴唇，也不吃吊丧的食物。
verses.textEnNiv: And you will do as I have done. You will not cover your mustache and beard or eat the customary food of mourners.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall do as I have done; you shall not cover your lips, nor eat the bread of men.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall do as I have done; you shall not cover your lips nor eat man’s bread ofsorrow.
verses.textEnNlt: Then you will do as Ezekiel has done. You will not mourn in public or console yourselves by eating the food brought by friends.
verses.textEnNasb: And you will do just as I have done; you will not cover your mustache, and you will not eat the bread of other people.
verses.textEn: And you will do as I have done. You will not cover your mustache and beard or eat the customary food of mourners.

verses.textZh: 你们的头上仍要缠着头巾，脚上仍要穿著鞋子；你们不可悲哀，不可哭泣；但你们必因自己的罪孽相对叹息，衰弱而死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们的头上仍要缠着头巾，脚上仍要穿著鞋子；你们不可悲哀，不可哭泣；但你们必因自己的罪孽相对叹息，衰弱而死。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们仍要头上勒裹头巾，脚上穿鞋；不可悲哀哭泣。你们必因自己的罪孽相对叹息，渐渐消灭。
verses.textEnNiv: You will keep your turbans on your heads and your sandals on your feet. You will not mourn or weep but will waste away because of your sins and groan among yourselves.
verses.textEnEsv: Your turbans shall be on your heads and your shoes on your feet; you shall not mourn or weep, but you shall rot away in your iniquities and groan to one another.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your turbans shall be on your heads and your sandals on your feet; you shall neither mourn nor weep, but you shall pine away in your iniquities and mourn with one another.
verses.textEnNlt: Your heads will remain covered, and your sandals will not be taken off. You will not mourn or weep, but you will waste away because of your sins. You will groan among yourselves for all the evil you have done.
verses.textEnNasb: Your turbans will be on your heads, and your sandals on your feet. You will not mourn and you will not weep; but you will rot away in your guilty deeds, and you will groan to one another.
verses.textEn: You will keep your turbans on your heads and your sandals on your feet. You will not mourn or weep but will waste away because of your sins and groan among yourselves.

verses.textZh: 以西结必成为你们的一个兆头；凡他所行的，将来你们也要照样行。这事来到，你们就知道我是主耶和华。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 以西结必成为你们的一个兆头；凡他所行的，将来你们也要照样行。这事来到，你们就知道我是主耶和华。’
verses.textZhCuv: 以西结必这样为你们作预兆；凡他所行的，你们也必照样行。那事来到，你们就知道我是主耶和华。』
verses.textEnNiv: Ezekiel will be a sign to you; you will do just as he has done. When this happens, you will know that I am the Sovereign Lord .’
verses.textEnEsv: Thus shall Ezekiel be to you a sign; according to all that he has done you shall do. When this comes, then you will know that I am the Lord God .’
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus Ezekiel is a sign to you; according to all that he has done you shall do; and when this comes, you shall know that I am the Lord God.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Ezekiel is an example for you; you will do just as he has done. And when that time comes, you will know that I am the Sovereign Lord ."
verses.textEnNasb: So Ezekiel will be a sign to you; according to all that he has done, you will do. When it comes, then you will know that I am the Lord God.’ "
verses.textEn: Ezekiel will be a sign to you; you will do just as he has done. When this happens, you will know that I am the Sovereign Lord .’

verses.textZh: "人子啊！我从他们中间夺去他们的堡垒、他们所喜欢的荣耀、他们眼所喜爱的、心所崇尚的和他们的儿女的时候，
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！我从他们中间夺去他们的堡垒、他们所喜欢的荣耀、他们眼所喜爱的、心所崇尚的和他们的儿女的时候，
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，我除掉他们所倚靠、所欢喜的荣耀，并眼中所喜爱、心里所重看的儿女。
verses.textEnNiv: "And you, son of man, on the day I take away their stronghold, their joy and glory, the delight of their eyes, their heart’s desire, and their sons and daughters as well—
verses.textEnEsv: "As for you, son of man, surely on the day when I take from them their stronghold, their joy and glory, the delight of their eyes and their soul’s desire, and also their sons and daughters,
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘And you, son of man—willit not be in the day when I take from them their stronghold, their joy and their glory, the desire of their eyes, and that on which they set their minds, their sons and their daughters:
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to me, "Son of man, on the day I take away their stronghold—their joy and glory, their heart’s desire, their dearest treasure—I will also take away their sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘As for you, son of man, will it not be on the day when I take from them their stronghold, the joy of their splendor, that which is precious in their eyes and their heart’s longing, their sons and their daughters,
verses.textEn: "And you, son of man, on the day I take away their stronghold, their joy and glory, the delight of their eyes, their heart’s desire, and their sons and daughters as well—

verses.textZh: 岂没有逃脱的人来到你那里，使你听见这事吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 岂没有逃脱的人来到你那里，使你听见这事吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 那日逃脱的人岂不来到你这里，使你耳闻这事吗？
verses.textEnNiv: on that day a fugitive will come to tell you the news.
verses.textEnEsv: on that day a fugitive will come to you to report to you the news.
verses.textEnNkjv: that on that day one who escapes will come to you to let you hear it with your ears?
verses.textEnNlt: And on that day a survivor from Jerusalem will come to you in Babylon and tell you what has happened.
verses.textEnNasb: that on that day the one who escapes will come to you with information for your ears?
verses.textEn: on that day a fugitive will come to tell you the news.

verses.textZh: 那时，你要向逃脱的人开口说话，不再作哑巴。你必成为他们的一个兆头。他们就知道我是耶和华。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，你要向逃脱的人开口说话，不再作哑巴。你必成为他们的一个兆头。他们就知道我是耶和华。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你必向逃脱的人开口说话，不再哑口。你必这样为他们作预兆，他们就知道我是耶和华。」
verses.textEnNiv: At that time your mouth will be opened; you will speak with him and will no longer be silent. So you will be a sign to them, and they will know that I am the Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: On that day your mouth will be opened to the fugitive, and you shall speak and be no longer mute. So you will be a sign to them, and they will know that I am the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: On that day your mouth will be opened to him who has escaped; you shall speak and no longer be mute. Thus you will be a sign to them, and they shall know that I am the Lord.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: And when he arrives, your voice will suddenly return so you can talk to him, and you will be a symbol for these people. Then they will know that I am the Lord ."
verses.textEnNasb: On that day your mouth will be opened to him who escaped, and you will speak and no longer be silenced. So you will be a sign to them, and they will know that I am the Lord.’ "
verses.textEn: At that time your mouth will be opened; you will speak with him and will no longer be silent. So you will be a sign to them, and they will know that I am the Lord ."

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnNkjv: The word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then this message came to me from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: The word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: "人子啊！你要面对亚扪人，说预言攻击他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！你要面对亚扪人，说预言攻击他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，你要面向亚扪人说预言，攻击他们，
verses.textEnNiv: "Son of man, set your face against the Ammonites and prophesy against them.
verses.textEnEsv: "Son of man, set your face toward the Ammonites and prophesy against them.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Son of man, set your face against the Ammonites, and prophesy against them.
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, turn and face the land of Ammon and prophesy against its people.
verses.textEnNasb: "Son of man, set your face against the sons of Ammon and prophesy against them,
verses.textEn: "Son of man, set your face against the Ammonites and prophesy against them.

verses.textZh: 你要对亚扪人说：‘你们要听主耶和华的话。主耶和华这样说：我的圣所被亵渎，以色列地荒凉，犹大家被掳去的时候，你说："哈哈！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要对亚扪人说：‘你们要听主耶和华的话。主耶和华这样说：我的圣所被亵渎，以色列地荒凉，犹大家被掳去的时候，你说："哈哈！"
verses.textZhCuv: 说：你们当听主耶和华的话。主耶和华如此说：我的圣所被亵渎，以色列地变荒凉，犹大家被掳掠；那时，你便因这些事说：『阿哈！』
verses.textEnNiv: Say to them, ‘Hear the word of the Sovereign Lord . This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Because you said "Aha!" over my sanctuary when it was desecrated and over the land of Israel when it was laid waste and over the people of Judah when they went into exile,
verses.textEnEsv: Say to the Ammonites, Hear the word of the Lord God : Thus says the Lord God , Because you said, ‘Aha!’ over my sanctuary when it was profaned, and over the land of Israel when it was made desolate, and over the house of Judah when they went into exile,
verses.textEnNkjv: Say to the Ammonites, ‘Hear the word of the Lord God! Thus says the Lord God: "Because you said, ‘Aha!’ against My sanctuary when it was profaned, and against the land of Israel when it was desolate, and against the house of Judah when they went into captivity,
verses.textEnNlt: Give the Ammonites this message from the Sovereign Lord : Hear the word of the Sovereign Lord ! Because you cheered when my Temple was defiled, mocked Israel in her desolation, and laughed at Judah as she went away into exile,
verses.textEnNasb: and say to the sons of Ammon, ‘Hear the word of the Lord God! This is what the Lord God says: "Because you said, ‘Aha!’ against My sanctuary when it was profaned, and against the land of Israel when it was made desolate, and against the house of Judah when they went into exile,
verses.textEn: Say to them, ‘Hear the word of the Sovereign Lord . This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Because you said "Aha!" over my sanctuary when it was desecrated and over the land of Israel when it was laid waste and over the people of Judah when they went into exile,

verses.textZh: 所以我要把你交给东方人作产业；他们必在你那里安营，在你那里设立居所；他们必吃你的果子，喝你的奶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以我要把你交给东方人作产业；他们必在你那里安营，在你那里设立居所；他们必吃你的果子，喝你的奶。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以我必将你的地交给东方人为业；他们必在你的地上安营居住，吃你的果子，喝你的奶。
verses.textEnNiv: therefore I am going to give you to the people of the East as a possession. They will set up their camps and pitch their tents among you; they will eat your fruit and drink your milk.
verses.textEnEsv: therefore behold, I am handing you over to the people of the East for a possession, and they shall set their encampments among you and make their dwellings in your midst. They shall eat your fruit, and they shall drink your milk.
verses.textEnNkjv: indeed, therefore, I will deliver you as a possession to the men of the East, and they shall set their encampments among you and make their dwellings among you; they shall eat your fruit, and they shall drink your milk.
verses.textEnNlt: I will allow nomads from the eastern deserts to overrun your country. They will set up their camps among you and pitch their tents on your land. They will harvest all your fruit and drink the milk from your livestock.
verses.textEnNasb: therefore, behold, I am going to give you to the people of the east as a possession, and they will set up their encampments among you and make their dwellings among you; they will eat your fruit and drink your milk.
verses.textEn: therefore I am going to give you to the people of the East as a possession. They will set up their camps and pitch their tents among you; they will eat your fruit and drink your milk.

verses.textZh: 我必使拉巴成为牧放骆驼的地方，使亚扪人之地成为羊群躺卧之处。你们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必使拉巴成为牧放骆驼的地方，使亚扪人之地成为羊群躺卧之处。你们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必使拉巴为骆驼场，使亚扪人的地为羊群躺卧之处，你们就知道我是耶和华。」
verses.textEnNiv: I will turn Rabbah into a pasture for camels and Ammon into a resting place for sheep. Then you will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: I will make Rabbah a pasture for camels and Ammon a fold for flocks. Then you will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will make Rabbah a stable for camels and Ammon a resting place for flocks. Then you shall know that I am the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: And I will turn the city of Rabbah into a pasture for camels, and all the land of the Ammonites into a resting place for sheep and goats. Then you will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: I will make Rabbah a pasture for camels, and the sons of Ammon a resting place for flocks. Then you will know that I am the Lord."
verses.textEn: I will turn Rabbah into a pasture for camels and Ammon into a resting place for sheep. Then you will know that I am the Lord .

verses.textZh: 主耶和华这样说：因为你手舞足蹈，心存轻蔑，因以色列地的遭遇而欢喜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主耶和华这样说：因为你手舞足蹈，心存轻蔑，因以色列地的遭遇而欢喜。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华如此说：「因你拍手顿足，以满心的恨恶向以色列地欢喜，
verses.textEnNiv: For this is what the Sovereign Lord says: Because you have clapped your hands and stamped your feet, rejoicing with all the malice of your heart against the land of Israel,
verses.textEnEsv: For thus says the Lord God : Because you have clapped your hands and stamped your feet and rejoiced with all the malice within your soul against the land of Israel,
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘For thus says the Lord God: "Because you clapped your hands, stamped your feet, and rejoiced in heart with all your disdain for the land of Israel,
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Because you clapped and danced and cheered with glee at the destruction of my people,
verses.textEnNasb: For this is what the Lord God says: "Because you have clapped your hands and stamped your feet, and have rejoiced with all the malice in your soul against the land of Israel,
verses.textEn: For this is what the Sovereign Lord says: Because you have clapped your hands and stamped your feet, rejoicing with all the malice of your heart against the land of Israel,

verses.textZh: 所以我必伸手攻击你，把你交给列国作掠物；我必从万族中剪除你，使你从列邦中灭亡；我必消灭你，你就知道我是耶和华。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以我必伸手攻击你，把你交给列国作掠物；我必从万族中剪除你，使你从列邦中灭亡；我必消灭你，你就知道我是耶和华。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 所以我伸手攻击你，将你交给列国作为掳物。我必从万民中剪除你，使你从万国中败亡。我必除灭你，你就知道我是耶和华。」
verses.textEnNiv: therefore I will stretch out my hand against you and give you as plunder to the nations. I will wipe you out from among the nations and exterminate you from the countries. I will destroy you, and you will know that I am the Lord .’ "
verses.textEnEsv: therefore, behold, I have stretched out my hand against you, and will hand you over as plunder to the nations. And I will cut you off from the peoples and will make you perish out of the countries; I will destroy you. Then you will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: indeed, therefore, I will stretch out My hand against you, and give you as plunder to the nations; I will cut you off from the peoples, and I will cause you to perish from the countries; I will destroy you, and you shall know that I am the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: I will raise my fist of judgment against you. I will give you as plunder to many nations. I will cut you off from being a nation and destroy you completely. Then you will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: therefore, behold, I have reached out with My hand against you and I will give you as plunder to the nations. And I will cut you off from the peoples and eliminate you from the lands. I will exterminate you. So you will know that I am the Lord."
verses.textEn: therefore I will stretch out my hand against you and give you as plunder to the nations. I will wipe you out from among the nations and exterminate you from the countries. I will destroy you, and you will know that I am the Lord .’ "

verses.textZh: 主耶和华这样说："因为摩押和西珥说：‘看哪！犹大家与列国毫无分别’，
verses.textZhCnvs: 主耶和华这样说："因为摩押和西珥说：‘看哪！犹大家与列国毫无分别’，
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华如此说：「因摩押和西珥人说：『看哪，犹大家与列国无异』，
verses.textEnNiv: "This is what the Sovereign Lord says: ‘Because Moab and Seir said, "Look, Judah has become like all the other nations,"
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord God : Because Moab and Seir said, ‘Behold, the house of Judah is like all the other nations,’
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Thus says the Lord God: "Because Moab and Seir say, ‘Look! The house of Judah is like all the nations,’
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Because the people of Moab have said that Judah is just like all the other nations,
verses.textEnNasb: ‘The Lord God says this: "Because Moab and Seir say, ‘Behold, the house of Judah is like all the nations,’
verses.textEn: "This is what the Sovereign Lord says: ‘Because Moab and Seir said, "Look, Judah has become like all the other nations,"

verses.textZh: 所以我必除去摩押一面的防守，从边界的城市开始，就是他们看为那地之荣美的伯．耶西末、巴力．免和基列亭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以我必除去摩押一面的防守，从边界的城市开始，就是他们看为那地之荣美的伯．耶西末、巴力．免和基列亭。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以我要破开摩押边界上的城邑，就是摩押人看为本国之荣耀的伯‧耶西末、巴力‧免、基列亭，
verses.textEnNiv: therefore I will expose the flank of Moab, beginning at its frontier towns—Beth Jeshimoth, Baal Meon and Kiriathaim—the glory of that land.
verses.textEnEsv: therefore I will lay open the flank of Moab from the cities, from its cities on its frontier, the glory of the country, Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon, and Kiriathaim.
verses.textEnNkjv: therefore, behold, I will clear the territory of Moab of cities, of the cities on its frontier, the glory of the country, Beth Jeshimoth, Baal Meon, and Kirjathaim.
verses.textEnNlt: I will open up their eastern flank and wipe out their glorious frontier towns—Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon, and Kiriathaim.
verses.textEnNasb: therefore, behold, I am going to deprive the flank of Moab of its cities, of its cities which are on its frontiers, the glory of the land, Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon, and Kiriathaim;
verses.textEn: therefore I will expose the flank of Moab, beginning at its frontier towns—Beth Jeshimoth, Baal Meon and Kiriathaim—the glory of that land.

verses.textZh: 我必把摩押连同亚扪人一起交给东方人作产业，使亚扪不再在列国中被记念。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必把摩押连同亚扪人一起交给东方人作产业，使亚扪不再在列国中被记念。
verses.textZhCuv: 好使东方人来攻击亚扪人。我必将亚扪人之地交给他们为业，使亚扪人在列国中不再被记念。
verses.textEnNiv: I will give Moab along with the Ammonites to the people of the East as a possession, so that the Ammonites will not be remembered among the nations;
verses.textEnEsv: I will give it along with the Ammonites to the people of the East as a possession, that the Ammonites may be remembered no more among the nations,
