verses.textEnNkjv: To the men of the East I will give it as a possession, together with the Ammonites, that the Ammonites may not be remembered among the nations.
verses.textEnNlt: And I will hand Moab over to nomads from the eastern deserts, just as I handed over Ammon. Yes, the Ammonites will no longer be counted among the nations.
verses.textEnNasb: and I will give it as a possession along with the sons of Ammon to the people of the east, so that the sons of Ammon will not be remembered among the nations.
verses.textEn: I will give Moab along with the Ammonites to the people of the East as a possession, so that the Ammonites will not be remembered among the nations;

verses.textZh: 我要向摩押施行审判，他们就知道我是耶和华。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要向摩押施行审判，他们就知道我是耶和华。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我必向摩押施行审判，他们就知道我是耶和华。」
verses.textEnNiv: and I will inflict punishment on Moab. Then they will know that I am the Lord .’ "
verses.textEnEsv: and I will execute judgments upon Moab. Then they will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will execute judgments upon Moab, and they shall know that I am the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: In the same way, I will bring my judgment down on the Moabites. Then they will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: So I will execute judgments on Moab, and they will know that I am the Lord."
verses.textEn: and I will inflict punishment on Moab. Then they will know that I am the Lord .’ "

verses.textZh: 主耶和华这样说："因为以东向犹大家报仇雪恨。他们这样作，就犯了大罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主耶和华这样说："因为以东向犹大家报仇雪恨。他们这样作，就犯了大罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华如此说：「因为以东报仇雪恨，攻击犹大家，向他们报仇，大大有罪，
verses.textEnNiv: "This is what the Sovereign Lord says: ‘Because Edom took revenge on Judah and became very guilty by doing so,
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord God : Because Edom acted revengefully against the house of Judah and has grievously offended in taking vengeance on them,
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Thus says the Lord God: "Because of what Edom did against the house of Judah by taking vengeance, and has greatly offended by avenging itself on them,"
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Sovereign Lord says: The people of Edom have sinned greatly by avenging themselves against the people of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘The Lord God says this: "Because Edom has acted against the house of Judah by taking vengeance, and has incurred great guilt, and avenged themselves upon them,"
verses.textEn: "This is what the Sovereign Lord says: ‘Because Edom took revenge on Judah and became very guilty by doing so,

verses.textZh: 所以主耶和华这样说：我必伸手攻击以东，把人和牲畜都从其中剪除；我必使以东荒凉；从提幔直到底但，他们都要倒毙在刀下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以主耶和华这样说：我必伸手攻击以东，把人和牲畜都从其中剪除；我必使以东荒凉；从提幔直到底但，他们都要倒毙在刀下。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以主耶和华如此说：我必伸手攻击以东，剪除人与牲畜，使以东从提幔起，人必倒在刀下，地要变为荒凉，直到底但。
verses.textEnNiv: therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I will stretch out my hand against Edom and kill both man and beast. I will lay it waste, and from Teman to Dedan they will fall by the sword.
verses.textEnEsv: therefore thus says the Lord God , I will stretch out my hand against Edom and cut off from it man and beast. And I will make it desolate; from Teman even to Dedan they shall fall by the sword.
verses.textEnNkjv: therefore thus says the Lord God: "I will also stretch out My hand against Edom, cut off man and beast from it, and make it desolate from Teman; Dedan shall fall by the sword.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, says the Sovereign Lord , I will raise my fist of judgment against Edom. I will wipe out its people and animals with the sword. I will make a wasteland of everything from Teman to Dedan.
verses.textEnNasb: therefore this is what the Lord God says: "I will also reach out with My hand against Edom and eliminate human and animal life from it. And I will turn it into ruins; from Teman even to Dedan they will fall by the sword.
verses.textEn: therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I will stretch out my hand against Edom and kill both man and beast. I will lay it waste, and from Teman to Dedan they will fall by the sword.

verses.textZh: 我必借着我子民以色列的手报复以东；以色列人必照着我的怒气，按着我的烈怒对待以东，以东人就知道这是我的报复。这是主耶和华的宣告。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必借着我子民以色列的手报复以东；以色列人必照着我的怒气，按着我的烈怒对待以东，以东人就知道这是我的报复。这是主耶和华的宣告。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我必藉我民以色列的手报复以东；以色列民必照我的怒气，按我的忿怒在以东施报，以东人就知道是我施报。这是主耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: I will take vengeance on Edom by the hand of my people Israel, and they will deal with Edom in accordance with my anger and my wrath; they will know my vengeance, declares the Sovereign Lord .’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And I will lay my vengeance upon Edom by the hand of my people Israel, and they shall do in Edom according to my anger and according to my wrath, and they shall know my vengeance, declares the Lord God .
verses.textEnNkjv: I will lay My vengeance on Edom by the hand of My people Israel, that they may do in Edom according to My anger and according to My fury; and they shall know My vengeance," says the Lord God.
verses.textEnNlt: I will accomplish this by the hand of my people of Israel. They will carry out my vengeance with anger, and Edom will know that this vengeance is from me. I, the Sovereign Lord , have spoken!
verses.textEnNasb: And I will inflict My vengeance on Edom by the hand of My people Israel. Therefore, they will act in Edom in accordance with My anger and My wrath; so they will know My vengeance," declares the Lord God.
verses.textEn: I will take vengeance on Edom by the hand of my people Israel, and they will deal with Edom in accordance with my anger and my wrath; they will know my vengeance, declares the Sovereign Lord .’ "

verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord God : Because the Philistines acted revengefully and took vengeance with malice of soul to destroy in never-ending enmity,
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Thus says the Lord God: "Because the Philistines dealt vengefully and took vengeance with a spiteful heart, to destroy because of the old hatred,"
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Sovereign Lord says: The people of Philistia have acted against Judah out of bitter revenge and long-standing contempt.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘This is what the Lord God says: "Because the Philistines have acted in revenge, and have taken vengeance with malice in their souls to destroy with everlasting hostility,"
verses.textEn: "This is what the Sovereign Lord says: ‘Because the Philistines acted in vengeance and took revenge with malice in their hearts, and with ancient hostility sought to destroy Judah,

verses.textZh: 因此，主耶和华这样说：看哪！我要伸手攻击非利士人，剪除基利提人，消灭沿海剩下的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，主耶和华这样说：看哪！我要伸手攻击非利士人，剪除基利提人，消灭沿海剩下的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以主耶和华如此说：我必伸手攻击非利士人，剪除基利提人，灭绝沿海剩下的居民。
verses.textEnNiv: therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I am about to stretch out my hand against the Philistines, and I will wipe out the Kerethites and destroy those remaining along the coast.
verses.textEnEsv: therefore thus says the Lord God , Behold, I will stretch out my hand against the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethites and destroy the rest of the seacoast.
verses.textEnNkjv: therefore thus says the Lord God: "I will stretch out My hand against the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethites and destroy the remnant of the seacoast.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I will raise my fist of judgment against the land of the Philistines. I will wipe out the Kerethites and utterly destroy the people who live by the sea.
verses.textEnNasb: therefore this is what the Lord God says: "Behold, I am going to reach out with My hand against the Philistines and eliminate the Cherethites; and I will destroy the remnant of the seacoast.
verses.textEn: therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I am about to stretch out my hand against the Philistines, and I will wipe out the Kerethites and destroy those remaining along the coast.

verses.textZhCnvs: 我必怒责他们，向他们大施报复；我向他们报复的时候，他们就知道我是耶和华。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我向他们大施报应，发怒斥责他们。我报复他们的时候，他们就知道我是耶和华。」
verses.textEnNiv: I will carry out great vengeance on them and punish them in my wrath. Then they will know that I am the Lord , when I take vengeance on them.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: I will execute great vengeance on them with wrathful rebukes. Then they will know that I am the Lord , when I lay my vengeance upon them."
verses.textEnNkjv: I will execute great vengeance on them with furious rebukes; and they shall know that I am the Lord, when I lay My vengeance upon them." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: I will execute terrible vengeance against them to punish them for what they have done. And when I have inflicted my revenge, they will know that I am the Lord ."
verses.textEnNasb: I will execute great vengeance on them with wrathful rebukes; and they will know that I am the Lord, when I inflict My vengeance on them." ’ "
verses.textEn: I will carry out great vengeance on them and punish them in my wrath. Then they will know that I am the Lord , when I take vengeance on them.’ "

verses.textZh: 第十一年某月初一日，耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 第十一年某月初一日，耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 第十一年十一月初一日，耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: In the eleventh month of the twelfth year, on the first day of the month, the word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: In the eleventh year, on the first day of the month, the word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, on the first day of the month, that the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: On February 3, during the twelfth year of King Jehoiachin’s captivity, this message came to me from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: Now in the eleventh year, on the first of the month, the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: In the eleventh month of the twelfth year, on the first day of the month, the word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: "人子啊！因为推罗论到耶路撒冷说：‘哈哈！那万族的门已经破坏了，向我打开了；我必得丰满，她却成了荒场！’
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！因为推罗论到耶路撒冷说：‘哈哈！那万族的门已经破坏了，向我打开了；我必得丰满，她却成了荒场！’
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，因泰尔向耶路撒冷说：『阿哈，那作众民之门的已经破坏，向我开放；她既变为荒场，我必丰盛。』
verses.textEnNiv: "Son of man, because Tyre has said of Jerusalem, ‘Aha! The gate to the nations is broken, and its doors have swung open to me; now that she lies in ruins I will prosper,’
verses.textEnEsv: "Son of man, because Tyre said concerning Jerusalem, ‘Aha, the gate of the peoples is broken; it has swung open to me. I shall be replenished, now that she is laid waste,’
verses.textEnNkjv: "Son of man, because Tyre has said against Jerusalem, ‘Aha! She is broken who was the gateway of the peoples; now she is turned over to me; I shall be filled; she is laid waste.’
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, Tyre has rejoiced over the fall of Jerusalem, saying, ‘Ha! She who was the gateway to the rich trade routes to the east has been broken, and I am the heir! Because she has been made desolate, I will become wealthy!’
verses.textEnNasb: "Son of man, because Tyre has said in regard to Jerusalem, ‘Aha! The gateway of the peoples is broken; it has opened to me. I shall be filled, now that she is laid waste,’
verses.textEn: "Son of man, because Tyre has said of Jerusalem, ‘Aha! The gate to the nations is broken, and its doors have swung open to me; now that she lies in ruins I will prosper,’

verses.textZh: 所以主耶和华这样说：‘推罗啊！我要与你为敌；我必叫多国上来攻击你，好象海使波浪涌上来一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以主耶和华这样说：‘推罗啊！我要与你为敌；我必叫多国上来攻击你，好象海使波浪涌上来一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，主耶和华如此说：泰尔啊，我必与你为敌，使许多国民上来攻击你，如同海使波浪涌上来一样。
verses.textEnNiv: therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I am against you, Tyre, and I will bring many nations against you, like the sea casting up its waves.
verses.textEnEsv: therefore thus says the Lord God : Behold, I am against you, O Tyre, and will bring up many nations against you, as the sea brings up its waves.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore thus says the Lord God: ‘Behold, I am against you, O Tyre, and will cause many nations to come up against you, as the sea causes its waves to come up.
verses.textEnNlt: "Therefore, this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I am your enemy, O Tyre, and I will bring many nations against you, like the waves of the sea crashing against your shoreline.
verses.textEnNasb: therefore this is what the Lord God says: ‘Behold, I am against you, Tyre, and I will bring up many nations against you, as the sea brings up its waves.
verses.textEn: therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I am against you, Tyre, and I will bring many nations against you, like the sea casting up its waves.

verses.textZh: 他们必毁坏推罗的城墙，拆毁它的城楼；我必刮净它的尘土，使它成为光滑的盘石。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们必毁坏推罗的城墙，拆毁它的城楼；我必刮净它的尘土，使它成为光滑的盘石。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必破坏泰尔的墙垣，拆毁她的城楼。我也要刮净尘土，使她成为净光的磐石。
verses.textEnNiv: They will destroy the walls of Tyre and pull down her towers; I will scrape away her rubble and make her a bare rock.
verses.textEnEsv: They shall destroy the walls of Tyre and break down her towers, and I will scrape her soil from her and make her a bare rock.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they shall destroy the walls of Tyre and break down her towers; I will also scrape her dust from her, and make her like the top of a rock.
verses.textEnNlt: They will destroy the walls of Tyre and tear down its towers. I will scrape away its soil and make it a bare rock!
verses.textEnNasb: They will destroy the walls of Tyre and tear down her towers; and I will sweep her debris away from her and make her a bare rock.
verses.textEn: They will destroy the walls of Tyre and pull down her towers; I will scrape away her rubble and make her a bare rock.

verses.textZh: 它必在海中作晒网的地方，因为我已经说了。这是耶和华的宣告。它必成为列国的掠物，
verses.textZhCnvs: 它必在海中作晒网的地方，因为我已经说了。这是耶和华的宣告。它必成为列国的掠物，
verses.textZhCuv: 她必在海中作晒网的地方，也必成为列国的掳物。这是主耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: Out in the sea she will become a place to spread fishnets, for I have spoken, declares the Sovereign Lord . She will become plunder for the nations,
verses.textEnEsv: She shall be in the midst of the sea a place for the spreading of nets, for I have spoken, declares the Lord God . And she shall become plunder for the nations,
verses.textEnNkjv: It shall be aplacefor spreading nets in the midst of the sea, for I have spoken,’ says the Lord God; ‘it shall become plunder for the nations.
verses.textEnNlt: It will be just a rock in the sea, a place for fishermen to spread their nets, for I have spoken, says the Sovereign Lord . Tyre will become the prey of many nations,
verses.textEnNasb: She will become a dry place for the spreading of nets in the midst of the sea, for I have spoken,’ declares the Lord God; ‘and she will become plunder for the nations.
verses.textEn: Out in the sea she will become a place to spread fishnets, for I have spoken, declares the Sovereign Lord . She will become plunder for the nations,

verses.textZh: 那些在陆地居住的推罗人必被刀剑所杀；然后，他们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些在陆地居住的推罗人必被刀剑所杀；然后，他们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 属泰尔城邑的居民 必被刀剑杀灭，他们就知道我是耶和华。」
verses.textEnNiv: and her settlements on the mainland will be ravaged by the sword. Then they will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: and her daughters on the mainland shall be killed by the sword. Then they will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Also her daughter villages which are in the fields shall be slain by the sword. Then they shall know that I am the Lord.’
verses.textEnNlt: and its mainland villages will be destroyed by the sword. Then they will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Also her daughters who are on the mainland will be killed by the sword, and they will know that I am the Lord.’ "
verses.textEn: and her settlements on the mainland will be ravaged by the sword. Then they will know that I am the Lord .

verses.textZh: "‘因为主耶和华这样说：看哪！我要使诸王之王，就是巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒，率领马匹、战车、骑兵和一支大军，从北方来攻击推罗。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘因为主耶和华这样说：看哪！我要使诸王之王，就是巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒，率领马匹、战车、骑兵和一支大军，从北方来攻击推罗。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华如此说：「我必使诸王之王的巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒率领马匹车辆、马兵、军队，和许多人民从北方来攻击你泰尔。
verses.textEnNiv: "For this is what the Sovereign Lord says: From the north I am going to bring against Tyre Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, king of kings, with horses and chariots, with horsemen and a great army.
verses.textEnEsv: "For thus says the Lord God : Behold, I will bring against Tyre from the north Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, king of kings, with horses and chariots, and with horsemen and a host of many soldiers.
verses.textEnNkjv: "For thus says the Lord God: ‘Behold, I will bring against Tyre from the north Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, king of kings, with horses, with chariots, and with horsemen, and an army with many people.
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Sovereign Lord says: From the north I will bring King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon against Tyre. He is king of kings and brings his horses, chariots, charioteers, and great army.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Lord God says this: "Behold, I am going to bring upon Tyre from the north Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, king of kings, with horses, chariots, cavalry, and a great army.
verses.textEn: "For this is what the Sovereign Lord says: From the north I am going to bring against Tyre Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, king of kings, with horses and chariots, with horsemen and a great army.

verses.textZh: 他必用刀剑杀戮你那些在陆地居住的人；他必建造围城的高墙，筑起土垒，举起盾牌攻击你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必用刀剑杀戮你那些在陆地居住的人；他必建造围城的高墙，筑起土垒，举起盾牌攻击你。
verses.textZhCuv: 他必用刀剑杀灭属你城邑的居民，也必造台筑垒举盾牌攻击你。
verses.textEnNiv: He will ravage your settlements on the mainland with the sword; he will set up siege works against you, build a ramp up to your walls and raise his shields against you.
verses.textEnEsv: He will kill with the sword your daughters on the mainland. He will set up a siege wall against you and throw up a mound against you, and raise a roof of shields against you.
verses.textEnNkjv: He will slay with the sword your daughter villages in the fields; he will heap up a siege mound against you, build a wall against you, and raise a defense against you.
verses.textEnNlt: First he will destroy your mainland villages. Then he will attack you by building a siege wall, constructing a ramp, and raising a roof of shields against you.
verses.textEnNasb: He will kill your daughters on the mainland with the sword; and he will make siege walls against you, pile up an assault ramp against you, and raise up a large shield against you.
verses.textEn: He will ravage your settlements on the mainland with the sword; he will set up siege works against you, build a ramp up to your walls and raise his shields against you.

verses.textZh: 他必用攻城锤攻击你的城墙，用武器拆毁你的城楼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必用攻城锤攻击你的城墙，用武器拆毁你的城楼。
verses.textZhCuv: 他必安设撞城锤攻破你的墙垣，用铁器拆毁你的城楼。
verses.textEnNiv: He will direct the blows of his battering rams against your walls and demolish your towers with his weapons.
verses.textEnEsv: He will direct the shock of his battering rams against your walls, and with his axes he will break down your towers.
verses.textEnNkjv: He will direct his battering rams against your walls, and with his axes he will break down your towers.
verses.textEnNlt: He will pound your walls with battering rams and demolish your towers with sledgehammers.
verses.textEnNasb: And he will direct the blow of his battering rams against your walls, and he will tear down your towers with his axes.
verses.textEn: He will direct the blows of his battering rams against your walls and demolish your towers with his weapons.

verses.textZh: 因为他的马匹众多，牠们扬起的尘土必遮盖你；他进入你的城门，好象人进入已有破口的城，那时，你的城墙必因骑兵、车轮和战车的响声而震动。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他的马匹众多，牠们扬起的尘土必遮盖你；他进入你的城门，好象人进入已有破口的城，那时，你的城墙必因骑兵、车轮和战车的响声而震动。
verses.textZhCuv: 因他的马匹众多，尘土扬起遮蔽你。他进入你的城门，好像人进入已有破口之城。那时，你的墙垣必因骑马的和战车、辎重车的响声震动。
verses.textEnNiv: His horses will be so many that they will cover you with dust. Your walls will tremble at the noise of the warhorses, wagons and chariots when he enters your gates as men enter a city whose walls have been broken through.
verses.textEnEsv: His horses will be so many that their dust will cover you. Your walls will shake at the noise of the horsemen and wagons and chariots, when he enters your gates as men enter a city that has been breached.
verses.textEnNkjv: Because of the abundance of his horses, their dust will cover you; your walls will shake at the noise of the horsemen, the wagons, and the chariots, when he enters your gates, as men enter a city that has been breached.
verses.textEnNlt: The hooves of his horses will choke the city with dust, and the noise of the charioteers and chariot wheels will shake your walls as they storm through your broken gates.
verses.textEnNasb: Because of the multitude of his horses, the dust raised by them will cover you; your walls will shake from the noise of cavalry, wagons, and chariots when he enters your gates as warriors enter a city that is breached.
verses.textEn: His horses will be so many that they will cover you with dust. Your walls will tremble at the noise of the warhorses, wagons and chariots when he enters your gates as men enter a city whose walls have been broken through.

verses.textZh: 他的马蹄必践踏你所有的街道；他必用刀杀戮你的人民；你坚固的柱子必倒在地上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的马蹄必践踏你所有的街道；他必用刀杀戮你的人民；你坚固的柱子必倒在地上。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的马蹄必践踏你一切的街道；他必用刀杀戮你的居民。你坚固的柱子 必倒在地上。
verses.textEnNiv: The hooves of his horses will trample all your streets; he will kill your people with the sword, and your strong pillars will fall to the ground.
verses.textEnEsv: With the hoofs of his horses he will trample all your streets. He will kill your people with the sword, and your mighty pillars will fall to the ground.
verses.textEnNkjv: With the hooves of his horses he will trample all your streets; he will slay your people by the sword, and your strong pillars will fall to the ground.
verses.textEnNlt: His horsemen will trample through every street in the city. They will butcher your people, and your strong pillars will topple.
verses.textEnNasb: With the hoofs of his horses he will trample all your streets. He will kill your people with the sword, and your strong pillars will go down to the ground.
verses.textEn: The hooves of his horses will trample all your streets; he will kill your people with the sword, and your strong pillars will fall to the ground.

verses.textZh: 他们必掳去你的财富，以你的货财为掠物；他们必破坏你的城墙，拆毁你华丽的房屋，把你的石头、木头和瓦砾都投在水中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们必掳去你的财富，以你的货财为掠物；他们必破坏你的城墙，拆毁你华丽的房屋，把你的石头、木头和瓦砾都投在水中。
verses.textZhCuv: 人必以你的财宝为掳物，以你的货财为掠物，破坏你的墙垣，拆毁你华美的房屋，将你的石头、木头、尘土都抛在水中。
verses.textEnNiv: They will plunder your wealth and loot your merchandise; they will break down your walls and demolish your fine houses and throw your stones, timber and rubble into the sea.
verses.textEnEsv: They will plunder your riches and loot your merchandise. They will break down your walls and destroy your pleasant houses. Your stones and timber and soil they will cast into the midst of the waters.
verses.textEnNkjv: They will plunder your riches and pillage your merchandise; they will break down your walls and destroy your pleasant houses; they will lay your stones, your timber, and your soil in the midst of the water.
verses.textEnNlt: "They will plunder all your riches and merchandise and break down your walls. They will destroy your lovely homes and dump your stones and timbers and even your dust into the sea.
verses.textEnNasb: Also they will take your riches as spoils and plunder your merchandise, tear down your walls and destroy your delightful houses, and throw your stones, your timbers, and your debris into the water.
verses.textEn: They will plunder your wealth and loot your merchandise; they will break down your walls and demolish your fine houses and throw your stones, timber and rubble into the sea.

verses.textZh: 我必使你唱歌的喧声止息；人也再听不到你的琴声。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必使你唱歌的喧声止息；人也再听不到你的琴声。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必使你唱歌的声音止息；人也不再听见你弹琴的声音。
verses.textEnNiv: I will put an end to your noisy songs, and the music of your harps will be heard no more.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will stop the music of your songs, and the sound of your lyres shall be heard no more.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will put an end to the sound of your songs, and the sound of your harps shall be heard no more.
verses.textEnNlt: I will stop the music of your songs. No more will the sound of harps be heard among your people.
verses.textEnNasb: So I will put an end to the sound of your songs, and the sound of your harps will no longer be heard.
verses.textEn: I will put an end to your noisy songs, and the music of your harps will be heard no more.

verses.textZh: 我必使你成为光滑的盘石；你必成为晒网的地方；你必不再被建造，因为我耶和华已经说了。这是主耶和华的宣告。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必使你成为光滑的盘石；你必成为晒网的地方；你必不再被建造，因为我耶和华已经说了。这是主耶和华的宣告。’
verses.textZhCuv: 我必使你成为净光的磐石，作晒网的地方。你不得再被建造，因为这是主耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: I will make you a bare rock, and you will become a place to spread fishnets. You will never be rebuilt, for I the Lord have spoken, declares the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: I will make you a bare rock. You shall be a place for the spreading of nets. You shall never be rebuilt, for I am the Lord ; I have spoken, declares the Lord God .
verses.textEnNkjv: I will make you like the top of a rock; you shall be aplacefor spreading nets, and you shall never be rebuilt, for I the Lord have spoken,’ says the Lord God.
verses.textEnNlt: I will make your island a bare rock, a place for fishermen to spread their nets. You will never be rebuilt, for I, the Lord , have spoken. Yes, the Sovereign Lord has spoken!
verses.textEnNasb: I will turn you into a bare rock; you will become a dry place for the spreading of nets. You will not be rebuilt, for I the Lord have spoken," declares the Lord God.
verses.textEn: I will make you a bare rock, and you will become a place to spread fishnets. You will never be rebuilt, for I the Lord have spoken, declares the Sovereign Lord .

verses.textZh: "主耶和华对推罗这样说：‘杀戮在你中间发生，受伤的人都在唉哼的时候，众海岛岂不因你倾倒的声音而震动吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: "主耶和华对推罗这样说：‘杀戮在你中间发生，受伤的人都在唉哼的时候，众海岛岂不因你倾倒的声音而震动吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华对泰尔如此说：「在你中间行杀戮，受伤之人唉哼的时候，因你倾倒的响声，海岛岂不都震动吗？
verses.textEnNiv: "This is what the Sovereign Lord says to Tyre: Will not the coastlands tremble at the sound of your fall, when the wounded groan and the slaughter takes place in you?
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord God to Tyre: Will not the coastlands shake at the sound of your fall, when the wounded groan, when slaughter is made in your midst?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus says the Lord God to Tyre: ‘Will the coastlands not shake at the sound of your fall, when the wounded cry, when slaughter is made in the midst of you?
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Sovereign Lord says to Tyre: The whole coastline will tremble at the sound of your fall, as the screams of the wounded echo in the continuing slaughter.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord God says this to Tyre: "Will the coastlands not shake from the sound of your downfall when the wounded groan, when the slaughter takes place in your midst?
verses.textEn: "This is what the Sovereign Lord says to Tyre: Will not the coastlands tremble at the sound of your fall, when the wounded groan and the slaughter takes place in you?

verses.textZh: 那时所有沿海的君王都必由王座下来，除去朝服，脱下刺绣的衣服；披上战兢，坐在地上，不停发抖，因你而惊骇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时所有沿海的君王都必由王座下来，除去朝服，脱下刺绣的衣服；披上战兢，坐在地上，不停发抖，因你而惊骇。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时靠海的君王必都下位，除去朝服，脱下花衣，披上战兢，坐在地上，时刻发抖，为你惊骇。
verses.textEnNiv: Then all the princes of the coast will step down from their thrones and lay aside their robes and take off their embroidered garments. Clothed with terror, they will sit on the ground, trembling every moment, appalled at you.
verses.textEnEsv: Then all the princes of the sea will step down from their thrones and remove their robes and strip off their embroidered garments. They will clothe themselves with trembling; they will sit on the ground and tremble every moment and be appalled at you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then all the princes of the sea will come down from their thrones, lay aside their robes, and take off their embroidered garments; they will clothe themselves with trembling; they will sit on the ground, tremble every moment, and be astonished at you.
verses.textEnNlt: All the seaport rulers will step down from their thrones and take off their royal robes and beautiful clothing. They will sit on the ground trembling with horror at your destruction.
verses.textEnNasb: Then all the princes of the sea will descend from their thrones, remove their robes, and strip off their colorfully woven garments. They will clothe themselves with trembling; they will sit on the ground, tremble again and again, and be appalled at you.
verses.textEn: Then all the princes of the coast will step down from their thrones and lay aside their robes and take off their embroidered garments. Clothed with terror, they will sit on the ground, trembling every moment, appalled at you.

verses.textZh: 他们必为你作一首哀歌说： 你这著名的城，航海之人的居所， 在海上坚固有力的啊！ 你和你的居民素来使惊恐 临到所有住在那里的人身上， 你怎么绝了迹呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们必为你作一首哀歌说： 你这著名的城，航海之人的居所， 在海上坚固有力的啊！ 你和你的居民素来使惊恐 临到所有住在那里的人身上， 你怎么绝了迹呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必为你作起哀歌说： 你这有名之城， 素为航海之人居住， 在海上为最坚固的； 平日你和居民使一切住在那里的人无不惊恐； 现在何竟毁灭了？
verses.textEnNiv: Then they will take up a lament concerning you and say to you: " ‘How you are destroyed, city of renown, peopled by men of the sea! You were a power on the seas, you and your citizens; you put your terror on all who lived there.
verses.textEnEsv: And they will raise a lamentation over you and say to you, "‘How you have perished, you who were inhabited from the seas, O city renowned, who was mighty on the sea; she and her inhabitants imposed their terror on all her inhabitants!
verses.textEnNkjv: And they will take up a lamentation for you, and say to you: "How you have perished, O one inhabited by seafaring men, O renowned city, Who was strong at sea, She and her inhabitants, Who caused their terror tobe on all her inhabitants!
verses.textEnNlt: Then they will wail for you, singing this funeral song: "O famous island city, once ruler of the sea, how you have been destroyed! Your people, with their naval power, once spread fear around the world.
verses.textEnNasb: And they will take up a song of mourning over you and say to you, ‘How you have perished, you inhabited one, From the seas, you famous city, Which was mighty on the sea, She and her inhabitants, Who imposed her terror On all her inhabitants!
verses.textEn: Then they will take up a lament concerning you and say to you: " ‘How you are destroyed, city of renown, peopled by men of the sea! You were a power on the seas, you and your citizens; you put your terror on all who lived there.

verses.textZh: 现在海岛的居民在你倾倒的日子， 都必战兢； 众海岛因你的毁灭而惊惶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在海岛的居民在你倾倒的日子， 都必战兢； 众海岛因你的毁灭而惊惶。
verses.textZhCuv: 如今在你这倾覆的日子， 海岛都必战兢； 海中的群岛见你归于无有就都惊惶。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now the coastlands tremble on the day of your fall; the islands in the sea are terrified at your collapse.’
verses.textEnEsv: Now the coastlands tremble on the day of your fall, and the coastlands that are on the sea are dismayed at your passing.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the coastlands tremble on the day of your fall; Yes, the coastlands by the sea are troubled at your departure." ’
verses.textEnNlt: Now the coastlands tremble at your fall. The islands are dismayed as you disappear.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Now the coastlands will tremble On the day of your downfall; Yes, the coastlands which are by the sea Will be horrified at your passing.’ "
verses.textEn: Now the coastlands tremble on the day of your fall; the islands in the sea are terrified at your collapse.’

verses.textZh: 因为主耶和华这样说：我使你成为荒废的城市，像没有人居住的城镇；我使深渊的水上升漫过你，使大水淹没你，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为主耶和华这样说：我使你成为荒废的城市，像没有人居住的城镇；我使深渊的水上升漫过你，使大水淹没你，
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华如此说：「泰尔啊，我使你变为荒凉，如无人居住的城邑；又使深水漫过你，大水淹没你。
verses.textEnNiv: "This is what the Sovereign Lord says: When I make you a desolate city, like cities no longer inhabited, and when I bring the ocean depths over you and its vast waters cover you,
verses.textEnEsv: "For thus says the Lord God : When I make you a city laid waste, like the cities that are not inhabited, when I bring up the deep over you, and the great waters cover you,
verses.textEnNkjv: "For thus says the Lord God: ‘When I make you a desolate city, like cities that are not inhabited, when I bring the deep upon you, and great waters cover you,
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I will make Tyre an uninhabited ruin, like many others. I will bury you beneath the terrible waves of enemy attack. Great seas will swallow you.
verses.textEnNasb: For this is what the Lord God says: "When I make you a desolate city, like the cities which are not inhabited, when I bring up the deep over you and the great waters cover you,
verses.textEn: "This is what the Sovereign Lord says: When I make you a desolate city, like cities no longer inhabited, and when I bring the ocean depths over you and its vast waters cover you,

verses.textZh: 那时，我要使你与那些下到阴府的人一起，下到古时的人那里去；我要使你住在地的深处，就是住在久而荒废之地，与那些下到阴府的人在一起，以致你不再在活人的境界重现 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，我要使你与那些下到阴府的人一起，下到古时的人那里去；我要使你住在地的深处，就是住在久而荒废之地，与那些下到阴府的人在一起，以致你不再在活人的境界重现 。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，我要叫你下入阴府，与古时的人一同在地的深处、久已荒凉之地居住，使你不再有居民。我也要在活人之地显荣耀 。
verses.textEnNiv: then I will bring you down with those who go down to the pit, to the people of long ago. I will make you dwell in the earth below, as in ancient ruins, with those who go down to the pit, and you will not return or take your place in the land of the living.
verses.textEnEsv: then I will make you go down with those who go down to the pit, to the people of old, and I will make you to dwell in the world below, among ruins from of old, with those who go down to the pit, so that you will not be inhabited; but I will set beauty in the land of the living.
verses.textEnNkjv: then I will bring you down with those who descend into the Pit, to the people of old, and I will make you dwell in the lowest part of the earth, in places desolate from antiquity, with those who go down to the Pit, so that you may never be inhabited; and I shall establish glory in the land of the living.
verses.textEnNlt: I will send you to the pit to join those who descended there long ago. Your city will lie in ruins, buried beneath the earth, like those in the pit who have entered the world of the dead. You will have no place of respect here in the land of the living.
verses.textEnNasb: then I will bring you down with those who go down to the pit, to the people of old, and I will make you remain in the lower parts of the earth, like the ancient ruins, with those who go down to the pit, so that you will not be inhabited; but I will put glory in the land of the living.
verses.textEn: then I will bring you down with those who go down to the pit, to the people of long ago. I will make you dwell in the earth below, as in ancient ruins, with those who go down to the pit, and you will not return or take your place in the land of the living.

verses.textZh: 我必使你遭遇可怕的灾祸，你就不再存在了；人虽然寻找你，却永不再寻得着。这是主耶和华的宣告。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必使你遭遇可怕的灾祸，你就不再存在了；人虽然寻找你，却永不再寻得着。这是主耶和华的宣告。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 我必叫你令人惊恐，不再存留于世；人虽寻找你，却永寻不见。这是主耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: I will bring you to a horrible end and you will be no more. You will be sought, but you will never again be found, declares the Sovereign Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: I will bring you to a dreadful end, and you shall be no more. Though you be sought for, you will never be found again, declares the Lord God ."
verses.textEnNkjv: I will make you a terror, and you shallbe no more; though you are sought for, you will never be found again,’ says the Lord God."
verses.textEnNlt: I will bring you to a terrible end, and you will exist no more. You will be looked for, but you will never again be found. I, the Sovereign Lord , have spoken!"
verses.textEnNasb: I will cause you sudden terrors and you will no longer exist; though you will be sought, you will never be found again," declares the Lord God.
verses.textEn: I will bring you to a horrible end and you will be no more. You will be sought, but you will never again be found, declares the Sovereign Lord ."

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnNkjv: The word of the Lord came again to me, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then this message came to me from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: The word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: "人子啊！你要为推罗作一首哀歌。
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！你要为推罗作一首哀歌。
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，要为泰尔作起哀歌，
verses.textEnNiv: "Son of man, take up a lament concerning Tyre.
verses.textEnEsv: "Now you, son of man, raise a lamentation over Tyre,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now, son of man, take up a lamentation for Tyre,
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, sing a funeral song for Tyre,
verses.textEnNasb: "And you, son of man, take up a song of mourning over Tyre;
verses.textEn: "Son of man, take up a lament concerning Tyre.

verses.textZh: 要对那位于海口，跟沿海邦国通商的推罗说：‘主耶和华这样说： 推罗啊！你曾经说过： 我是全然美丽的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要对那位于海口，跟沿海邦国通商的推罗说：‘主耶和华这样说： 推罗啊！你曾经说过： 我是全然美丽的。
verses.textZhCuv: 说：你居住海口，是众民的商埠；你的交易通到许多的海岛。主耶和华如此说： 泰尔啊，你曾说： 我是全然美丽的。
verses.textEnNiv: Say to Tyre, situated at the gateway to the sea, merchant of peoples on many coasts, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: " ‘You say, Tyre, "I am perfect in beauty."
verses.textEnEsv: and say to Tyre, who dwells at the entrances to the sea, merchant of the peoples to many coastlands, thus says the Lord God : "O Tyre, you have said, ‘I am perfect in beauty.’
verses.textEnNkjv: and say to Tyre, ‘You who are situated at the entrance of the sea, merchant of the peoples on many coastlands, thus says the Lord God: "O Tyre, you have said, ‘I am perfect in beauty.’
verses.textEnNlt: that mighty gateway to the sea, the trading center of the world. Give Tyre this message from the Sovereign Lord : "You boasted, O Tyre, ‘My beauty is perfect!’
verses.textEnNasb: and say to Tyre, who sits at the entrance to the sea, merchant of the peoples to many coastlands, ‘This is what the Lord God says: "Tyre, you have said, ‘I am perfect in beauty.’
verses.textEn: Say to Tyre, situated at the gateway to the sea, merchant of peoples on many coasts, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: " ‘You say, Tyre, "I am perfect in beauty."

verses.textZh: 你的疆界在众海中心， 建造你的使你全然美丽。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的疆界在众海中心， 建造你的使你全然美丽。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的境界在海中， 造你的使你全然美丽。
verses.textEnNiv: Your domain was on the high seas; your builders brought your beauty to perfection.
verses.textEnEsv: Your borders are in the heart of the seas; your builders made perfect your beauty.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your borders are in the midst of the seas. Your builders have perfected your beauty.
verses.textEnNlt: You extended your boundaries into the sea. Your builders made your beauty perfect.
verses.textEnNasb: "Your borders are in the heart of the seas; Your builders have perfected your beauty.
verses.textEn: Your domain was on the high seas; your builders brought your beauty to perfection.

verses.textZh: 他们用示尼珥的松树做你所有的木板； 用黎巴嫩的香柏树做你的桅杆；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们用示尼珥的松树做你所有的木板； 用黎巴嫩的香柏树做你的桅杆；
verses.textZhCuv: 他们用示尼珥的松树做你的一切板， 用黎巴嫩的香柏树做桅杆，
verses.textEnNiv: They made all your timbers of juniper from Senir ; they took a cedar from Lebanon to make a mast for you.
verses.textEnEsv: They made all your planks of fir trees from Senir; they took a cedar from Lebanon to make a mast for you.
verses.textEnNkjv: They made all your planks of fir trees from Senir; They took a cedar from Lebanon to make you a mast.
verses.textEnNlt: You were like a great ship built of the finest cypress from Senir. They took a cedar from Lebanon to make a mast for you.
verses.textEnNasb: "They have made all your planks of juniper trees from Senir; They have taken a cedar from Lebanon to make a mast for you.
verses.textEn: They made all your timbers of juniper from Senir ; they took a cedar from Lebanon to make a mast for you.

verses.textZh: 用巴珊的橡树做你的桨； 用基提沿岸的黄杨木镶嵌着象牙，做你的舱板。
verses.textZhCnvs: 用巴珊的橡树做你的桨； 用基提沿岸的黄杨木镶嵌着象牙，做你的舱板。
verses.textZhCuv: 用巴珊的橡树做你的桨， 用象牙镶嵌基提海岛的黄杨木为坐板 。
verses.textEnNiv: Of oaks from Bashan they made your oars; of cypress wood from the coasts of Cyprus they made your deck, adorned with ivory.
verses.textEnEsv: Of oaks of Bashan they made your oars; they made your deck of pines from the coasts of Cyprus, inlaid with ivory.
verses.textEnNkjv: Of oaks from Bashan they made your oars; The company of Ashurites have inlaid your planks With ivory from the coasts of Cyprus.
verses.textEnNlt: They carved your oars from the oaks of Bashan. Your deck of pine from the coasts of Cyprus was inlaid with ivory.
verses.textEnNasb: "Of oaks from Bashan they have made your rudders; With ivory they have inlaid your deck of boxwood from the coastlands of Cyprus.
verses.textEn: Of oaks from Bashan they made your oars; of cypress wood from the coasts of Cyprus they made your deck, adorned with ivory.

verses.textZh: 你的帆是用埃及刺绣的细麻布做的， 可作你的旗帜； 你的篷是用以利沙沿岸的蓝色和紫色布做的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的帆是用埃及刺绣的细麻布做的， 可作你的旗帜； 你的篷是用以利沙沿岸的蓝色和紫色布做的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的篷帆是用埃及绣花细麻布做的， 可以做你的大旗； 你的凉棚是用以利沙岛的蓝色、紫色布做的。
verses.textEnNiv: Fine embroidered linen from Egypt was your sail and served as your banner; your awnings were of blue and purple from the coasts of Elishah.
verses.textEnEsv: Of fine embroidered linen from Egypt was your sail, serving as your banner; blue and purple from the coasts of Elishah was your awning.
verses.textEnNkjv: Fine embroidered linen from Egypt was what you spread for your sail; Blue and purple from the coasts of Elishah was what covered you.
verses.textEnNlt: Your sails were made of Egypt’s finest linen, and they flew as a banner above you. You stood beneath blue and purple awnings made bright with dyes from the coasts of Elishah.
verses.textEnNasb: "Your sail was of colorfully embroidered linen from Egypt So that it became your flag; Your awning was violet and purple from the coastlands of Elishah.
verses.textEn: Fine embroidered linen from Egypt was your sail and served as your banner; your awnings were of blue and purple from the coasts of Elishah.

verses.textZh: 西顿和亚发的居民给你荡桨； 推罗啊！你中间的技师作你的舵手。
verses.textZhCnvs: 西顿和亚发的居民给你荡桨； 推罗啊！你中间的技师作你的舵手。
verses.textZhCuv: 西顿和亚发的居民作你荡桨的。 泰尔啊，你中间的智慧人作掌舵的。
verses.textEnNiv: Men of Sidon and Arvad were your oarsmen; your skilled men, Tyre, were aboard as your sailors.
verses.textEnEsv: The inhabitants of Sidon and Arvad were your rowers; your skilled men, O Tyre, were in you; they were your pilots.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Inhabitants of Sidon and Arvad were your oarsmen; Your wise men, O Tyre, were in you; They became your pilots.
verses.textEnNlt: Your oarsmen came from Sidon and Arvad; your helmsmen were skilled men from Tyre itself.
verses.textEnNasb: "The inhabitants of Sidon and Arvad were your rowers; Your wise men, Tyre, were aboard; they were your sailors.
verses.textEn: Men of Sidon and Arvad were your oarsmen; your skilled men, Tyre, were aboard as your sailors.

verses.textZh: 迦巴勒的技师和老练的工匠都在你那里修补裂缝； 所有海上的船只和水手都在你那里，与你进行贸易。
verses.textZhCnvs: 迦巴勒的技师和老练的工匠都在你那里修补裂缝； 所有海上的船只和水手都在你那里，与你进行贸易。
verses.textZhCuv: 迦巴勒的老者和聪明人 都在你中间作补缝的； 一切泛海的船只和水手 都在你中间经营交易的事。
verses.textEnNiv: Veteran craftsmen of Byblos were on board as shipwrights to caulk your seams. All the ships of the sea and their sailors came alongside to trade for your wares.
verses.textEnEsv: The elders of Gebal and her skilled men were in you, caulking your seams; all the ships of the sea with their mariners were in you to barter for your wares.
verses.textEnNkjv: Elders of Gebal and its wise men Were in you to caulk your seams; All the ships of the sea And their oarsmen were in you To market your merchandise.
verses.textEnNlt: Wise old craftsmen from Gebal did the caulking. Ships from every land came with goods to barter for your trade.
verses.textEnNasb: "The elders of Gebal and her wise men were with you repairing your leaks; All the ships of the sea and their sailors were with you in order to deal in your merchandise.
verses.textEn: Veteran craftsmen of Byblos were on board as shipwrights to caulk your seams. All the ships of the sea and their sailors came alongside to trade for your wares.

verses.textZh: 波斯人、路德人、弗人 都在你的军队中作战士； 他们在你那里挂起盾牌和头盔， 彰显你的光荣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 波斯人、路德人、弗人 都在你的军队中作战士； 他们在你那里挂起盾牌和头盔， 彰显你的光荣。
verses.textZhCuv: 「波斯人、路德人、弗人在你军营中作战士；他们在你中间悬挂盾牌和头盔，彰显你的尊荣。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Men of Persia, Lydia and Put served as soldiers in your army. They hung their shields and helmets on your walls, bringing you splendor.
verses.textEnEsv: "Persia and Lud and Put were in your army as your men of war. They hung the shield and helmet in you; they gave you splendor.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Those from Persia, Lydia, and Libya Were in your army as men of war; They hung shield and helmet in you; They gave splendor to you.
verses.textEnNlt: "Men from distant Persia, Lydia, and Libya served in your great army. They hung their shields and helmets on your walls, giving you great honor.
verses.textEnNasb: "Persia, Lud, and Put were in your army, your men of war. They hung up shield and helmet on you; they presented your splendor.
verses.textEn: " ‘Men of Persia, Lydia and Put served as soldiers in your army. They hung their shields and helmets on your walls, bringing you splendor.

verses.textZh: 在你四围的城墙上有亚发人和赫勒克人 ；在你的城楼上有歌玛底人 。他们把自己的盾牌挂在你四围的城墙上，使你全然美丽。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在你四围的城墙上有亚发人和赫勒克人 ；在你的城楼上有歌玛底人 。他们把自己的盾牌挂在你四围的城墙上，使你全然美丽。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚发人和你的军队都在你四围的墙上，你的望楼也有勇士；他们悬挂盾牌，成全你的美丽。
verses.textEnNiv: Men of Arvad and Helek guarded your walls on every side; men of Gammad were in your towers. They hung their shields around your walls; they brought your beauty to perfection.
verses.textEnEsv: Men of Arvad and Helech were on your walls all around, and men of Gamad were in your towers. They hung their shields on your walls all around; they made perfect your beauty.
verses.textEnNkjv: Men of Arvad with your army were on your walls all around, And the men of Gammad were in your towers; They hung their shields on your walls all around; They made your beauty perfect.
verses.textEnNlt: Men from Arvad and Helech stood on your walls. Your towers were manned by men from Gammad. Their shields hung on your walls, completing your beauty.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Arvad and your army were on your walls, all around, and the Gammadim were in your towers. They hung their shields on your walls all around; they perfected your beauty.
verses.textEn: Men of Arvad and Helek guarded your walls on every side; men of Gammad were in your towers. They hung their shields around your walls; they brought your beauty to perfection.

verses.textZh: "他施人因你各样丰富的财物，就作你的贸易伙伴；他们用银、铁、锡和铅来换取你的货物。
verses.textZhCnvs: "他施人因你各样丰富的财物，就作你的贸易伙伴；他们用银、铁、锡和铅来换取你的货物。
verses.textZhCuv: 「他施人因你多有各类的财物，就作你的客商，拿银、铁、锡、铅兑换你的货物。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Tarshish did business with you because of your great wealth of goods; they exchanged silver, iron, tin and lead for your merchandise.
verses.textEnEsv: "Tarshish did business with you because of your great wealth of every kind; silver, iron, tin, and lead they exchanged for your wares.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Tarshish was your merchant because of your many luxury goods. They gave you silver, iron, tin, and lead for your goods.
verses.textEnNlt: "Tarshish sent merchants to buy your wares in exchange for silver, iron, tin, and lead.
verses.textEnNasb: "Tarshish was your customer because of the abundance of all kinds of wealth; with silver, iron, tin, and lead they paid for your merchandise.
verses.textEn: " ‘Tarshish did business with you because of your great wealth of goods; they exchanged silver, iron, tin and lead for your merchandise.

verses.textZh: 雅完人、土巴人和米设人都与你通商；他们用奴隶和铜器来换取你的商品。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅完人、土巴人和米设人都与你通商；他们用奴隶和铜器来换取你的商品。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅完人、土巴人、米设人都与你交易；他们用人口和铜器兑换你的货物。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Greece, Tubal and Meshek did business with you; they traded human beings and articles of bronze for your wares.
verses.textEnEsv: Javan, Tubal, and Meshech traded with you; they exchanged human beings and vessels of bronze for your merchandise.
verses.textEnNkjv: Javan, Tubal, and Meshech were your traders. They bartered human lives and vessels of bronze for your merchandise.
verses.textEnNlt: Merchants from Greece, Tubal, and Meshech brought slaves and articles of bronze to trade with you.
verses.textEnNasb: Javan, Tubal, and Meshech, they were your traders; with human lives and vessels of bronze they paid for your merchandise.
verses.textEn: " ‘Greece, Tubal and Meshek did business with you; they traded human beings and articles of bronze for your wares.

verses.textZh: 伯陀迦玛人用马、战马和骡子来换取你的货物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 伯陀迦玛人用马、战马和骡子来换取你的货物。
verses.textZhCuv: 陀迦玛族用马和战马并骡子兑换你的货物。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Men of Beth Togarmah exchanged chariot horses, cavalry horses and mules for your merchandise.
verses.textEnEsv: From Beth-togarmah they exchanged horses, war horses, and mules for your wares.
verses.textEnNkjv: Those from the house of Togarmah traded for your wares with horses, steeds, and mules.
verses.textEnNlt: "From Beth-togarmah came riding horses, chariot horses, and mules, all in exchange for your goods.
verses.textEnNasb: Those from Beth-togarmah gave horses, war horses, and mules for your merchandise.
verses.textEn: " ‘Men of Beth Togarmah exchanged chariot horses, cavalry horses and mules for your merchandise.

verses.textZh: 底但人与你通商，沿海许多地方都作你贸易的市场；他们用象牙和乌木支付给你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 底但人与你通商，沿海许多地方都作你贸易的市场；他们用象牙和乌木支付给你。
verses.textZhCuv: 底但人与你交易，许多海岛作你的码头；他们拿象牙、乌木与你兑换 。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘The men of Rhodes traded with you, and many coastlands were your customers; they paid you with ivory tusks and ebony.
verses.textEnEsv: The men of Dedan traded with you. Many coastlands were your own special markets; they brought you in payment ivory tusks and ebony.
verses.textEnNkjv: The men of Dedan were your traders; many isles were the market of your hand. They brought you ivory tusks and ebony as payment.
verses.textEnNlt: Merchants came to you from Dedan. Numerous coastlands were your captive markets; they brought payment in ivory tusks and ebony wood.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Dedan were your traders. Many coastlands were your market; they brought ivory tusks and ebony as your payment.
verses.textEn: " ‘The men of Rhodes traded with you, and many coastlands were your customers; they paid you with ivory tusks and ebony.

verses.textZh: 亚兰人因你的产品很多，就作你的贸易伙伴；他们用绿宝石、紫色布、刺绣、细麻布、珊瑚、红宝石，来换取你的货物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚兰人因你的产品很多，就作你的贸易伙伴；他们用绿宝石、紫色布、刺绣、细麻布、珊瑚、红宝石，来换取你的货物。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚兰人因你的工作很多，就作你的客商；他们用绿宝石、紫色布绣货、细麻布、珊瑚、红宝石兑换你的货物。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Aram did business with you because of your many products; they exchanged turquoise, purple fabric, embroidered work, fine linen, coral and rubies for your merchandise.
verses.textEnEsv: Syria did business with you because of your abundant goods; they exchanged for your wares emeralds, purple, embroidered work, fine linen, coral, and ruby.
verses.textEnNkjv: Syria was your merchant because of the abundance of goods you made. They gave you for your wares emeralds, purple, embroidery, fine linen, corals, and rubies.
verses.textEnNlt: "Syria sent merchants to buy your rich variety of goods. They traded turquoise, purple dyes, embroidery, fine linen, and jewelry of coral and rubies.
verses.textEnNasb: Aram was your customer because of the abundance of your goods; they paid for your merchandise with emeralds, purple, colorfully woven cloth, fine linen, coral, and rubies.
verses.textEn: " ‘Aram did business with you because of your many products; they exchanged turquoise, purple fabric, embroidered work, fine linen, coral and rubies for your merchandise.

verses.textZh: 犹大和以色列地都与你通商；他们用米匿的麦子、饼、蜜、油和乳香来换取你的商品。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大和以色列地都与你通商；他们用米匿的麦子、饼、蜜、油和乳香来换取你的商品。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大和以色列地的人都与你交易；他们用米匿的麦子、饼、蜜、油、乳香兑换你的货物。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Judah and Israel traded with you; they exchanged wheat from Minnith and confections, honey, olive oil and balm for your wares.
verses.textEnEsv: Judah and the land of Israel traded with you; they exchanged for your merchandise wheat of Minnith, meal, honey, oil, and balm.
verses.textEnNkjv: Judah and the land of Israel were your traders. They traded for your merchandise wheat of Minnith, millet, honey, oil, and balm.
verses.textEnNlt: Judah and Israel traded for your wares, offering wheat from Minnith, figs, honey, olive oil, and balm.
verses.textEnNasb: Judah and the land of Israel, they were your traders; with the wheat of Minnith, cakes, honey, oil, and balsam they paid for your merchandise.
verses.textEn: " ‘Judah and Israel traded with you; they exchanged wheat from Minnith and confections, honey, olive oil and balm for your wares.

verses.textZh: 大马士革人因你产品很多，又因你各样丰富的财物，就用黑本酒和白羊毛 来与你交易，
verses.textZhCnvs: 大马士革人因你产品很多，又因你各样丰富的财物，就用黑本酒和白羊毛 来与你交易，
verses.textZhCuv: 大马士革人因你的工作很多，又因你多有各类的财物，就拿黑本酒和白羊毛与你交易。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Damascus did business with you because of your many products and great wealth of goods. They offered wine from Helbon, wool from Zahar
verses.textEnEsv: Damascus did business with you for your abundant goods, because of your great wealth of every kind; wine of Helbon and wool of Sahar
verses.textEnNkjv: Damascus was your merchant because of the abundance of goods you made, because of your many luxury items, with the wine of Helbon and with white wool.
verses.textEnNlt: "Damascus sent merchants to buy your rich variety of goods, bringing wine from Helbon and white wool from Zahar.
verses.textEnNasb: Damascus was your customer because of the abundance of your goods, because of the abundance of all kinds of wealth, because of the wine of Helbon and white wool.
verses.textEn: " ‘Damascus did business with you because of your many products and great wealth of goods. They offered wine from Helbon, wool from Zahar

verses.textZh: 威但人用乌萨出的酒 来换取你的货物；他们用锻铁、桂皮和菖蒲，来交换你的商品。
verses.textZhCnvs: 威但人用乌萨出的酒 来换取你的货物；他们用锻铁、桂皮和菖蒲，来交换你的商品。
verses.textZhCuv: 威但人和雅完人拿纺成的线、亮铁、桂皮、菖蒲兑换你的货物。
verses.textEnNiv: and casks of wine from Izal in exchange for your wares: wrought iron, cassia and calamus.
verses.textEnEsv: and casks of wine from Uzal they exchanged for your wares; wrought iron, cassia, and calamus were bartered for your merchandise.
verses.textEnNkjv: Dan and Javan paid for your wares, traversing back and forth. Wrought iron, cassia, and cane were among your merchandise.
verses.textEnNlt: Greeks from Uzal came to trade for your merchandise. Wrought iron, cassia, and fragrant calamus were bartered for your wares.
verses.textEnNasb: Vedan and Javan paid for your merchandise from Uzal; wrought iron, cassia, and spice reed were among your merchandise.
verses.textEn: and casks of wine from Izal in exchange for your wares: wrought iron, cassia and calamus.

verses.textZh: 底但人用马鞍毯子来与你交易。
verses.textZhCnvs: 底但人用马鞍毯子来与你交易。
verses.textZhCuv: 底但人用高贵的毯子、鞍、屉与你交易。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Dedan traded in saddle blankets with you.
verses.textEnEsv: Dedan traded with you in saddlecloths for riding.
verses.textEnNkjv: Dedan was your merchant in saddlecloths for riding.
verses.textEnNlt: "Dedan sent merchants to trade their expensive saddle blankets with you.
verses.textEnNasb: Dedan traded with you in saddlecloths for riding.
verses.textEn: " ‘Dedan traded in saddle blankets with you.

verses.textZh: 阿拉伯人和基达所有的领袖都作你通商的顾客；他们用羊羔、绵羊和山羊，来与你交易。
verses.textZhCnvs: 阿拉伯人和基达所有的领袖都作你通商的顾客；他们用羊羔、绵羊和山羊，来与你交易。
verses.textZhCuv: 阿拉伯人和基达的一切首领都作你的客商，用羊羔、公绵羊、公山羊与你交易。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Arabia and all the princes of Kedar were your customers; they did business with you in lambs, rams and goats.
verses.textEnEsv: Arabia and all the princes of Kedar were your favored dealers in lambs, rams, and goats; in these they did business with you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Arabia and all the princes of Kedar were your regular merchants. They traded with you in lambs, rams, and goats.
verses.textEnNlt: The Arabians and the princes of Kedar sent merchants to trade lambs and rams and male goats in exchange for your goods.
verses.textEnNasb: Arabia and all the princes of Kedar, they were your customers for lambs, rams, and goats; for these they were your customers.
verses.textEn: " ‘Arabia and all the princes of Kedar were your customers; they did business with you in lambs, rams and goats.

verses.textZh: 示巴和拉玛的商人都与你交易；他们用各样上等的香料，各种宝石和黄金，来换取你的货物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 示巴和拉玛的商人都与你交易；他们用各样上等的香料，各种宝石和黄金，来换取你的货物。
verses.textZhCuv: 示巴和拉玛的商人与你交易，他们用各类上好的香料、各类的宝石，和黄金兑换你的货物。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘The merchants of Sheba and Raamah traded with you; for your merchandise they exchanged the finest of all kinds of spices and precious stones, and gold.
verses.textEnEsv: The traders of Sheba and Raamah traded with you; they exchanged for your wares the best of all kinds of spices and all precious stones and gold.
verses.textEnNkjv: The merchants of Sheba and Raamah were your merchants. They traded for your wares the choicest spices, all kinds of precious stones, and gold.
verses.textEnNlt: The merchants of Sheba and Raamah came with all kinds of spices, jewels, and gold in exchange for your wares.
verses.textEnNasb: The traders of Sheba and Raamah, they traded with you; they paid for your merchandise with the best of all balsam oil, and with all kinds of precious stones, and gold.
verses.textEn: " ‘The merchants of Sheba and Raamah traded with you; for your merchandise they exchanged the finest of all kinds of spices and precious stones, and gold.

verses.textZh: 哈兰人、干尼人、伊甸人、示巴的商人、亚述人和基抹人，都与你交易。
verses.textZhCnvs: 哈兰人、干尼人、伊甸人、示巴的商人、亚述人和基抹人，都与你交易。
verses.textZhCuv: 哈兰人、干尼人、伊甸人、示巴的商人，和亚述人、基抹人与你交易。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Harran, Kanneh and Eden and merchants of Sheba, Ashur and Kilmad traded with you.
verses.textEnEsv: Haran, Canneh, Eden, traders of Sheba, Asshur, and Chilmad traded with you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Haran, Canneh, Eden, the merchants of Sheba, Assyria, and Chilmad were your merchants.
verses.textEnNlt: "Haran, Canneh, Eden, Sheba, Asshur, and Kilmad came with their merchandise, too.
verses.textEnNasb: Haran, Canneh, Eden, the traders of Sheba, Asshur, and Chilmad traded with you.
verses.textEn: " ‘Harran, Kanneh and Eden and merchants of Sheba, Ashur and Kilmad traded with you.

verses.textZh: 他们用美丽的衣服、蓝色刺绣的袍子、色彩缤纷的地毯，用绳子绑得结实，在你的市场上与你交易。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们用美丽的衣服、蓝色刺绣的袍子、色彩缤纷的地毯，用绳子绑得结实，在你的市场上与你交易。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些商人以美好的货物包在绣花蓝色包袱内，又有华丽的衣服装在香柏木的箱子里，用绳捆着与你交易。
verses.textEnNiv: In your marketplace they traded with you beautiful garments, blue fabric, embroidered work and multicolored rugs with cords twisted and tightly knotted.
verses.textEnEsv: In your market these traded with you in choice garments, in clothes of blue and embroidered work, and in carpets of colored material, bound with cords and made secure.
verses.textEnNkjv: These were your merchants in choice items—in purple clothes, in embroidered garments, in chests of multicolored apparel, in sturdy woven cords, which were in your marketplace.
verses.textEnNlt: They brought choice fabrics to trade—blue cloth, embroidery, and multicolored carpets rolled up and bound with cords.
verses.textEnNasb: They traded with you in choice garments, in clothes of violet and colorfully woven cloth, and in blankets of two colors, and tightly wound cords, which were among your merchandise.
verses.textEn: In your marketplace they traded with you beautiful garments, blue fabric, embroidered work and multicolored rugs with cords twisted and tightly knotted.

verses.textZh: 他施的船只运载你的商品， 你在海的中心，满载货物， 极其沉重。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他施的船只运载你的商品， 你在海的中心，满载货物， 极其沉重。
verses.textZhCuv: 他施的船只接连成帮为你运货， 你便在海中丰富极其荣华。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘The ships of Tarshish serve as carriers for your wares. You are filled with heavy cargo as you sail the sea.
verses.textEnEsv: The ships of Tarshish traveled for you with your merchandise. So you were filled and heavily laden in the heart of the seas.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The ships of Tarshish were carriers of your merchandise. You were filled and very glorious in the midst of the seas.
verses.textEnNlt: The ships of Tarshish were your ocean caravans. Your island warehouse was filled to the brim!
verses.textEnNasb: The ships of Tarshish were the carriers for your merchandise. And you were filled and were very glorious In the heart of the seas.
verses.textEn: " ‘The ships of Tarshish serve as carriers for your wares. You are filled with heavy cargo as you sail the sea.

verses.textZh: 给你荡桨的已经把你荡到水深之处； 东风在海的中心 把你吹破。
verses.textZhCnvs: 给你荡桨的已经把你荡到水深之处； 东风在海的中心 把你吹破。
verses.textZhCuv: 荡桨的已经把你荡到大水之处， 东风在海中将你打破。
verses.textEnNiv: Your oarsmen take you out to the high seas. But the east wind will break you to pieces far out at sea.
verses.textEnEsv: "Your rowers have brought you out into the high seas. The east wind has wrecked you in the heart of the seas.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your oarsmen brought you into many waters, But the east wind broke you in the midst of the seas.
verses.textEnNlt: "But look! Your oarsmen have taken you into stormy seas! A mighty eastern gale has wrecked you in the heart of the sea!
verses.textEnNasb: "Your rowers have brought you Into great waters; The east wind has broken you In the heart of the seas.
verses.textEn: Your oarsmen take you out to the high seas. But the east wind will break you to pieces far out at sea.

verses.textZh: 你的财富、货物、商品、水手、舵手、 修补裂缝的、与你进行贸易的， 在你那里所有的战士， 并在你中间所有聚集的人、 在你倾覆的日子， 都必在海的中心沉下去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的财富、货物、商品、水手、舵手、 修补裂缝的、与你进行贸易的， 在你那里所有的战士， 并在你中间所有聚集的人、 在你倾覆的日子， 都必在海的中心沉下去。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的资财、物件、货物、 水手、掌舵的、 补缝的、经营交易的， 并你中间的战士和人民， 在你破坏的日子必都沉在海中。
verses.textEnNiv: Your wealth, merchandise and wares, your mariners, sailors and shipwrights, your merchants and all your soldiers, and everyone else on board will sink into the heart of the sea on the day of your shipwreck.
verses.textEnEsv: Your riches, your wares, your merchandise, your mariners and your pilots, your caulkers, your dealers in merchandise, and all your men of war who are in you, with all your crew that is in your midst, sink into the heart of the seas on the day of your fall.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Your riches, wares, and merchandise, Your mariners and pilots, Your caulkers and merchandisers, All your men of war who are in you, And the entire company which is in your midst, Will fall into the midst of the seas on the day of your ruin.
verses.textEnNlt: Everything is lost— your riches and wares, your sailors and pilots, your ship builders, merchants, and warriors. On the day of your ruin, everyone on board sinks into the depths of the sea.
verses.textEnNasb: "Your wealth, your wares, your merchandise, Your seamen and your sailors, Your repairers of leaks, your dealers in merchandise, And all your men of war who are in you, With all your contingent that is in your midst, Will fall into the heart of the seas On the day of your overthrow.
verses.textEn: Your wealth, merchandise and wares, your mariners, sailors and shipwrights, your merchants and all your soldiers, and everyone else on board will sink into the heart of the sea on the day of your shipwreck.

verses.textZh: 因你舵手的呼叫声， 郊野都必震动。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因你舵手的呼叫声， 郊野都必震动。
verses.textZhCuv: 你掌舵的呼号之声一发， 郊野都必震动。
verses.textEnNiv: The shorelands will quake when your sailors cry out.
verses.textEnEsv: At the sound of the cry of your pilots the countryside shakes,
verses.textEnNkjv: The common-land will shake at the sound of the cry of your pilots.
verses.textEnNlt: Your cities by the sea tremble as your pilots cry out in terror.
verses.textEnNasb: "At the sound of the cry of your sailors, The pasture lands will shake.
verses.textEn: The shorelands will quake when your sailors cry out.

verses.textZh: 所有荡桨的、 水手和航海的舵手， 都必离开他们的船只， 站在陆上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有荡桨的、 水手和航海的舵手， 都必离开他们的船只， 站在陆上。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡荡桨的和水手， 并一切泛海掌舵的， 都必下船登岸。
verses.textEnNiv: All who handle the oars will abandon their ships; the mariners and all the sailors will stand on the shore.
verses.textEnEsv: and down from their ships come all who handle the oar. The mariners and all the pilots of the sea stand on the land
verses.textEnNkjv: "All who handle the oar, The mariners, All the pilots of the sea Will come down from their ships and stand on the shore.
verses.textEnNlt: All the oarsmen abandon their ships; the sailors and pilots stand on the shore.
verses.textEnNasb: "All who handle the oar, The seamen and all the sailors of the sea Will come down from their ships; They will stand on the land,
verses.textEn: All who handle the oars will abandon their ships; the mariners and all the sailors will stand on the shore.

verses.textZh: 他们必为你 放声痛哭， 把尘土撒在自己的头上， 在灰中打滚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们必为你 放声痛哭， 把尘土撒在自己的头上， 在灰中打滚。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必为你放声痛哭， 把尘土撒在头上， 在灰中打滚；
verses.textEnNiv: They will raise their voice and cry bitterly over you; they will sprinkle dust on their heads and roll in ashes.
verses.textEnEsv: and shout aloud over you and cry out bitterly. They cast dust on their heads and wallow in ashes;
verses.textEnNkjv: They will make their voice heard because of you; They will cry bitterly and cast dust on their heads; They will roll about in ashes;
verses.textEnNlt: They cry aloud over you and weep bitterly. They throw dust on their heads and roll in ashes.
verses.textEnNasb: And they will make their voice heard over you And cry out bitterly. They will throw dust on their heads, They will wallow in ashes.
verses.textEn: They will raise their voice and cry bitterly over you; they will sprinkle dust on their heads and roll in ashes.

verses.textZh: 他们必因你把头剃光， 腰束麻布， 为你痛心哭泣， 苦苦悲哀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们必因你把头剃光， 腰束麻布， 为你痛心哭泣， 苦苦悲哀。
verses.textZhCuv: 又为你使头上光秃， 用麻布束腰， 号咷痛哭， 苦苦悲哀。
verses.textEnNiv: They will shave their heads because of you and will put on sackcloth. They will weep over you with anguish of soul and with bitter mourning.
verses.textEnEsv: they make themselves bald for you and put sackcloth on their waist, and they weep over you in bitterness of soul, with bitter mourning.
verses.textEnNkjv: They will shave themselves completely bald because of you, Gird themselves with sackcloth, And weep for you With bitterness of heart and bitter wailing.
verses.textEnNlt: They shave their heads in grief for you and dress themselves in burlap. They weep for you with bitter anguish and deep mourning.
verses.textEnNasb: "Also they will shave themselves bald for you And put on sackcloth; And they will weep for you in bitterness of soul With bitter mourning.
verses.textEn: They will shave their heads because of you and will put on sackcloth. They will weep over you with anguish of soul and with bitter mourning.

verses.textZh: 他们为你哀悼的时候，必为你作一首哀歌： 有哪一座城， 像在海中沉寂的推罗呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们为你哀悼的时候，必为你作一首哀歌： 有哪一座城， 像在海中沉寂的推罗呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 他们哀号的时候， 为你作起哀歌哀哭， 说：有何城如泰尔？ 有何城如她在海中成为寂寞的呢？
verses.textEnNiv: As they wail and mourn over you, they will take up a lament concerning you: "Who was ever silenced like Tyre, surrounded by the sea?"
verses.textEnEsv: In their wailing they raise a lamentation for you and lament over you: ‘Who is like Tyre, like one destroyed in the midst of the sea?
verses.textEnNkjv: In their wailing for you They will take up a lamentation, And lament for you: ‘What cityis like Tyre, Destroyed in the midst of the sea?
verses.textEnNlt: As they wail and mourn over you, they sing this sad funeral song: ‘Was there ever such a city as Tyre, now silent at the bottom of the sea?
verses.textEnNasb: "Moreover, in their wailing they will take up a song of mourning for you And sing a song of mourning over you: ‘Who is like Tyre, Like her who is silent in the midst of the sea?
verses.textEn: As they wail and mourn over you, they will take up a lament concerning you: "Who was ever silenced like Tyre, surrounded by the sea?"

verses.textZh: 你的货物从海上运出去的时候， 曾使多国的人饱足； 因你丰富的财物和商品， 你使地上的君王都富裕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的货物从海上运出去的时候， 曾使多国的人饱足； 因你丰富的财物和商品， 你使地上的君王都富裕。
verses.textZhCuv: 你由海上运出货物， 就使许多国民充足； 你以许多资财、货物 使地上的君王丰富。
verses.textEnNiv: When your merchandise went out on the seas, you satisfied many nations; with your great wealth and your wares you enriched the kings of the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: When your wares came from the seas, you satisfied many peoples; with your abundant wealth and merchandise you enriched the kings of the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘When your wares went out by sea, You satisfied many people; You enriched the kings of the earth With your many luxury goods and your merchandise.
verses.textEnNlt: The merchandise you traded satisfied the desires of many nations. Kings at the ends of the earth were enriched by your trade.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘When your merchandise went out from the seas, You satisfied many peoples; With the abundance of your wealth and your merchandise You enriched the kings of the earth.
verses.textEn: When your merchandise went out on the seas, you satisfied many nations; with your great wealth and your wares you enriched the kings of the earth.

verses.textZh: 如今你在深水的地方， 被海水冲破； 你的商品和所有在你那里聚集的人， 都沉下去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如今你在深水的地方， 被海水冲破； 你的商品和所有在你那里聚集的人， 都沉下去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你在深水中被海浪打破的时候， 你的货物和你中间的一切人民， 就都沉下去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Now you are shattered by the sea in the depths of the waters; your wares and all your company have gone down with you.
verses.textEnEsv: Now you are wrecked by the seas, in the depths of the waters; your merchandise and all your crew in your midst have sunk with you.
verses.textEnNkjv: But you are broken by the seas in the depths of the waters; Your merchandise and the entire company will fall in your midst.
verses.textEnNlt: Now you are a wrecked ship, broken at the bottom of the sea. All your merchandise and crew have gone down with you.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘ Now that you are broken by the seas In the depths of the waters, Your merchandise and all your company Have fallen in the midst of you.
verses.textEn: Now you are shattered by the sea in the depths of the waters; your wares and all your company have gone down with you.

verses.textZh: 沿海地带所有的居民 都因你惊骇； 他们的君王都极其恐慌， 面容扭曲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 沿海地带所有的居民 都因你惊骇； 他们的君王都极其恐慌， 面容扭曲。
verses.textZhCuv: 海岛的居民为你惊奇； 他们的君王都甚恐慌， 面带愁容。
verses.textEnNiv: All who live in the coastlands are appalled at you; their kings shudder with horror and their faces are distorted with fear.
verses.textEnEsv: All the inhabitants of the coastlands are appalled at you, and the hair of their kings bristles with horror; their faces are convulsed.
verses.textEnNkjv: All the inhabitants of the isles will be astonished at you; Their kings will be greatly afraid, And their countenance will be troubled.
verses.textEnNlt: All who live along the coastlands are appalled at your terrible fate. Their kings are filled with horror and look on with twisted faces.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘All the inhabitants of the coastlands Are appalled at you, And their kings are horribly afraid; They have a troubled look.
verses.textEn: All who live in the coastlands are appalled at you; their kings shudder with horror and their faces are distorted with fear.

verses.textZh: 各族的商人都嗤笑你； 你必遭遇可怕的灾祸， 你就永远不再存在了。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 各族的商人都嗤笑你； 你必遭遇可怕的灾祸， 你就永远不再存在了。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 各国民中的客商都向你发嘶声； 你令人惊恐， 不再存留于世，直到永远。」
verses.textEnNiv: The merchants among the nations scoff at you; you have come to a horrible end and will be no more.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: The merchants among the peoples hiss at you; you have come to a dreadful end and shall be no more forever.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: The merchants among the peoples will hiss at you; You will become a horror, and be no more forever.’ " ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: The merchants among the nations shake their heads at the sight of you, for you have come to a horrible end and will exist no more.’"
verses.textEnNasb: ‘The merchants among the peoples hiss at you; You have become terrified And you will cease to be forever.’ " ’ "
verses.textEn: The merchants among the nations scoff at you; you have come to a horrible end and will be no more.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnNkjv: The word of the Lord came to me again, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then this message came to me from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: The word of the Lord came again to me, saying,
verses.textEn: The word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: "人子啊！你要对推罗的君王说：‘主耶和华这样说： 因为你心里高傲， 说：我是神； 我在海的中心、 坐在神的宝座上。 其实你不过是人，并不是神， 你心里却自以为是神。
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！你要对推罗的君王说：‘主耶和华这样说： 因为你心里高傲， 说：我是神； 我在海的中心、 坐在神的宝座上。 其实你不过是人，并不是神， 你心里却自以为是神。
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，你对泰尔君王说，主耶和华如此说： 因你心里高傲，说：我是神； 我在海中坐神之位。 你虽然居心自比神， 也不过是人，并不是神！
verses.textEnNiv: "Son of man, say to the ruler of Tyre, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: " ‘In the pride of your heart you say, "I am a god; I sit on the throne of a god in the heart of the seas." But you are a mere mortal and not a god, though you think you are as wise as a god.
verses.textEnEsv: "Son of man, say to the prince of Tyre, Thus says the Lord God : "Because your heart is proud, and you have said, ‘I am a god, I sit in the seat of the gods, in the heart of the seas,’ yet you are but a man, and no god, though you make your heart like the heart of a god—
verses.textEnNkjv: "Son of man, say to the prince of Tyre, ‘Thus says the Lord God: "Because your heart is lifted up, And you say, ‘I am a god, I sit in the seat of gods, In the midst of the seas,’ Yet you are a man, and not a god, Though you set your heart as the heart of a god
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, give the prince of Tyre this message from the Sovereign Lord : "In your great pride you claim, ‘I am a god! I sit on a divine throne in the heart of the sea.’ But you are only a man and not a god, though you boast that you are a god.
verses.textEnNasb: "Son of man, say to the leader of Tyre, ‘The Lord God says this: "Because your heart is haughty And you have said, ‘I am a god, I sit in the seat of gods In the heart of the seas’; Yet you are a mortal and not God, Although you make your heart like the heart of God—
verses.textEn: "Son of man, say to the ruler of Tyre, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: " ‘In the pride of your heart you say, "I am a god; I sit on the throne of a god in the heart of the seas." But you are a mere mortal and not a god, though you think you are as wise as a god.

verses.textZh: 你比但以理更有智慧！ 任何秘密的事都不能隐瞒你！
verses.textZhCnvs: 你比但以理更有智慧！ 任何秘密的事都不能隐瞒你！
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，你比但以理更有智慧， 什么秘事都不能向你隐藏。
verses.textEnNiv: Are you wiser than Daniel ? Is no secret hidden from you?
verses.textEnEsv: you are indeed wiser than Daniel; no secret is hidden from you;
verses.textEnNkjv: (Behold, you are wiser than Daniel! There is no secret that can be hidden from you!
verses.textEnNlt: You regard yourself as wiser than Daniel and think no secret is hidden from you.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, you are wiser than Daniel; There is no secret that is a match for you!
verses.textEn: Are you wiser than Daniel ? Is no secret hidden from you?

verses.textZh: 你靠着自己的智慧和聪明， 为自己得了财富， 把所得的金银放进自己的府库里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你靠着自己的智慧和聪明， 为自己得了财富， 把所得的金银放进自己的府库里。
verses.textZhCuv: 你靠自己的智慧聪明得了金银财宝， 收入库中。
verses.textEnNiv: By your wisdom and understanding you have gained wealth for yourself and amassed gold and silver in your treasuries.
verses.textEnEsv: by your wisdom and your understanding you have made wealth for yourself, and have gathered gold and silver into your treasuries;
verses.textEnNkjv: With your wisdom and your understanding You have gained riches for yourself, And gathered gold and silver into your treasuries;
verses.textEnNlt: With your wisdom and understanding you have amassed great wealth— gold and silver for your treasuries.
verses.textEnNasb: "By your wisdom and understanding You have acquired riches for yourself And have acquired gold and silver for your treasuries.
verses.textEn: By your wisdom and understanding you have gained wealth for yourself and amassed gold and silver in your treasuries.

verses.textZh: 你靠着自己在贸易上的大智慧， 增添你的财富， 你又因自己的财富心里高傲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你靠着自己在贸易上的大智慧， 增添你的财富， 你又因自己的财富心里高傲。
verses.textZhCuv: 你靠自己的大智慧和贸易增添资财， 又因资财心里高傲。
verses.textEnNiv: By your great skill in trading you have increased your wealth, and because of your wealth your heart has grown proud.
verses.textEnEsv: by your great wisdom in your trade you have increased your wealth, and your heart has become proud in your wealth—
verses.textEnNkjv: By your great wisdom in trade you have increased your riches, And your heart is lifted up because of your riches),"
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, your wisdom has made you very rich, and your riches have made you very proud.
verses.textEnNasb: "By your great wisdom, by your trade You have increased your riches, And your heart is haughty because of your riches—
verses.textEn: By your great skill in trading you have increased your wealth, and because of your wealth your heart has grown proud.

verses.textZh: 因此，主耶和华这样说： 因为你心里自以为是神，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，主耶和华这样说： 因为你心里自以为是神，
verses.textZhCuv: 所以主耶和华如此说： 因你居心自比神，
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: " ‘Because you think you are wise, as wise as a god,
verses.textEnEsv: therefore thus says the Lord God : Because you make your heart like the heart of a god,
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Therefore thus says the Lord God: "Because you have set your heart as the heart of a god,
verses.textEnNlt: "Therefore, this is what the Sovereign Lord says: Because you think you are as wise as a god,
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore this is what the Lord God says: ‘Because you have made your heart Like the heart of God,
verses.textEn: " ‘Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: " ‘Because you think you are wise, as wise as a god,

verses.textZh: 所以我要使外族人， 就是列国中最强横的人，来攻击你； 他们要拔出刀来， 攻击你用智慧得来的美物， 玷污你的光彩。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以我要使外族人， 就是列国中最强横的人，来攻击你； 他们要拔出刀来， 攻击你用智慧得来的美物， 玷污你的光彩。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必使外邦人， 就是列国中的强暴人临到你这里； 他们必拔刀砍坏你用智慧得来的美物， 亵渎你的荣光。
verses.textEnNiv: I am going to bring foreigners against you, the most ruthless of nations; they will draw their swords against your beauty and wisdom and pierce your shining splendor.
verses.textEnEsv: therefore, behold, I will bring foreigners upon you, the most ruthless of the nations; and they shall draw their swords against the beauty of your wisdom and defile your splendor.
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, therefore, I will bring strangers against you, The most terrible of the nations; And they shall draw their swords against the beauty of your wisdom, And defile your splendor.
verses.textEnNlt: I will now bring against you a foreign army, the terror of the nations. They will draw their swords against your marvelous wisdom and defile your splendor!
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, behold, I am going to bring strangers against you, The most ruthless of the nations. And they will draw their swords Against the beauty of your wisdom And profane your splendor.
verses.textEn: I am going to bring foreigners against you, the most ruthless of nations; they will draw their swords against your beauty and wisdom and pierce your shining splendor.

verses.textZh: 他们必使你下到坑中， 你必被杀害， 死在海的中心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们必使你下到坑中， 你必被杀害， 死在海的中心。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必使你下坑； 你必死在海中， 与被杀的人一样。
verses.textEnNiv: They will bring you down to the pit, and you will die a violent death in the heart of the seas.
verses.textEnEsv: They shall thrust you down into the pit, and you shall die the death of the slain in the heart of the seas.
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall throw you down into the Pit, And you shall die the death of the slain In the midst of the seas.
verses.textEnNlt: They will bring you down to the pit, and you will die in the heart of the sea, pierced with many wounds.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘They will bring you down to the pit, And you will die the death of those who are killed In the heart of the seas.
verses.textEn: They will bring you down to the pit, and you will die a violent death in the heart of the seas.

verses.textZh: 在杀戮你的人面前， 你还能说"我是神"吗？ 在那些杀害你的人手里， 你不过是人，并不是神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在杀戮你的人面前， 你还能说"我是神"吗？ 在那些杀害你的人手里， 你不过是人，并不是神。
verses.textZhCuv: 在杀你的人面前你还能说「我是神」吗？ 其实你在杀害你的人手中， 不过是人，并不是神。
