verses.textEnNiv: Will you then say, "I am a god," in the presence of those who kill you? You will be but a mortal, not a god, in the hands of those who slay you.
verses.textEnEsv: Will you still say, ‘I am a god,’ in the presence of those who kill you, though you are but a man, and no god, in the hands of those who slay you?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Will you still say before him who slays you, ‘I am a god’? But you shallbe a man, and not a god, In the hand of him who slays you.
verses.textEnNlt: Will you then boast, ‘I am a god!’ to those who kill you? To them you will be no god but merely a man!
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Will you still say, "I am a god," In the presence of one who kills you, Though you are a mortal and not God, In the hands of those who wound you?
verses.textEn: Will you then say, "I am a god," in the presence of those who kill you? You will be but a mortal, not a god, in the hands of those who slay you.

verses.textZh: 你必死在外族人手里，与未受割礼的人一样， 因为这是我曾说过的， 这是主耶和华的宣告。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你必死在外族人手里，与未受割礼的人一样， 因为这是我曾说过的， 这是主耶和华的宣告。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 你必死在外邦人手中， 与未受割礼 的人一样， 因为这是主耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: You will die the death of the uncircumcised at the hands of foreigners. I have spoken, declares the Sovereign Lord .’ "
verses.textEnEsv: You shall die the death of the uncircumcised by the hand of foreigners; for I have spoken, declares the Lord God ."
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall die the death of the uncircumcised By the hand of aliens; For I have spoken," says the Lord God.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: You will die like an outcast at the hands of foreigners. I, the Sovereign Lord , have spoken!"
verses.textEnNasb: ‘You will die the death of the uncircumcised By the hand of strangers, For I have spoken!’ declares the Lord God!" ’ "
verses.textEn: You will die the death of the uncircumcised at the hands of foreigners. I have spoken, declares the Sovereign Lord .’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, the word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then this further message came to me from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: Again the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: The word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: "人子啊！你要为推罗王作一首哀歌，对他说：‘主耶和华这样说： 你是完美的典范， 满有智慧，全然美丽。
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！你要为推罗王作一首哀歌，对他说：‘主耶和华这样说： 你是完美的典范， 满有智慧，全然美丽。
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，你为泰尔王作起哀歌，说主耶和华如此说： 你无所不备， 智慧充足，全然美丽。
verses.textEnNiv: "Son of man, take up a lament concerning the king of Tyre and say to him: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: " ‘You were the seal of perfection, full of wisdom and perfect in beauty.
verses.textEnEsv: "Son of man, raise a lamentation over the king of Tyre, and say to him, Thus says the Lord God : "You were the signet of perfection, full of wisdom and perfect in beauty.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Son of man, take up a lamentation for the king of Tyre, and say to him, ‘Thus says the Lord God: "You were the seal of perfection, Full of wisdom and perfect in beauty.
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, sing this funeral song for the king of Tyre. Give him this message from the Sovereign Lord : "You were the model of perfection, full of wisdom and exquisite in beauty.
verses.textEnNasb: "Son of man, take up a song of mourning over the king of Tyre and say to him, ‘This is what the Lord God says: "You had the seal of perfection, Full of wisdom and perfect in beauty.
verses.textEn: "Son of man, take up a lament concerning the king of Tyre and say to him: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: " ‘You were the seal of perfection, full of wisdom and perfect in beauty.

verses.textZh: 你曾在伊甸、神的园中， 有各样的宝石作你的衣服， 就是红宝石、黄玉、金钢石、 水苍玉、红玛瑙、碧玉、 蓝宝石、绿宝石和翡翠； 宝石座是用金制造的， 这些都是在你被造的日子 就预备好了的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你曾在伊甸、神的园中， 有各样的宝石作你的衣服， 就是红宝石、黄玉、金钢石、 水苍玉、红玛瑙、碧玉、 蓝宝石、绿宝石和翡翠； 宝石座是用金制造的， 这些都是在你被造的日子 就预备好了的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你曾在伊甸神的园中， 佩戴各样宝石， 就是红宝石、红璧玺、金钢石、 水苍玉、红玛瑙、碧玉、 蓝宝石、绿宝石、红玉，和黄金； 又有精美的鼓笛在你那里， 都是在你受造之日预备齐全的。
verses.textEnNiv: You were in Eden, the garden of God; every precious stone adorned you: carnelian, chrysolite and emerald, topaz, onyx and jasper, lapis lazuli, turquoise and beryl. Your settings and mountings were made of gold; on the day you were created they were prepared.
verses.textEnEsv: You were in Eden, the garden of God; every precious stone was your covering, sardius, topaz, and diamond, beryl, onyx, and jasper, sapphire, emerald, and carbuncle; and crafted in gold were your settings and your engravings. On the day that you were created they were prepared.
verses.textEnNkjv: You were in Eden, the garden of God; Every precious stone was your covering: The sardius, topaz, and diamond, Beryl, onyx, and jasper, Sapphire, turquoise, and emerald with gold. The workmanship of your timbrels and pipes Was prepared for you on the day you were created.
verses.textEnNlt: You were in Eden, the garden of God. Your clothing was adorned with every precious stone — red carnelian, pale-green peridot, white moonstone, blue-green beryl, onyx, green jasper, blue lapis lazuli, turquoise, and emerald— all beautifully crafted for you and set in the finest gold. They were given to you on the day you were created.
verses.textEnNasb: "You were in Eden, the garden of God; Every precious stone was your covering: The ruby, the topaz and the diamond; The beryl, the onyx and the jasper; The lapis lazuli, the turquoise and the emerald; And the gold, the workmanship of your settings and sockets, Was in you. On the day that you were created They were prepared.
verses.textEn: You were in Eden, the garden of God; every precious stone adorned you: carnelian, chrysolite and emerald, topaz, onyx and jasper, lapis lazuli, turquoise and beryl. Your settings and mountings were made of gold; on the day you were created they were prepared.

verses.textZh: 你是护卫宝座的、受膏的基路伯； 我安置你在神的圣山上， 你在闪耀如火的宝石中间行走。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你是护卫宝座的、受膏的基路伯； 我安置你在神的圣山上， 你在闪耀如火的宝石中间行走。
verses.textZhCuv: 你是那受膏遮掩约柜的基路伯； 我将你安置在神的圣山上； 你在发光如火的宝石中间往来。
verses.textEnNiv: You were anointed as a guardian cherub, for so I ordained you. You were on the holy mount of God; you walked among the fiery stones.
verses.textEnEsv: You were an anointed guardian cherub. I placed you; you were on the holy mountain of God; in the midst of the stones of fire you walked.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You were the anointed cherub who covers; I established you; You were on the holy mountain of God; You walked back and forth in the midst of fiery stones.
verses.textEnNlt: I ordained and anointed you as the mighty angelic guardian. You had access to the holy mountain of God and walked among the stones of fire.
verses.textEnNasb: "You were the anointed cherub who covers, And I placed you there. You were on the holy mountain of God; You walked in the midst of the stones of fire.
verses.textEn: You were anointed as a guardian cherub, for so I ordained you. You were on the holy mount of God; you walked among the fiery stones.

verses.textZh: 从你被造的日子起， 你的行为都无可指摘， 直到在你中间有了罪孽为止。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从你被造的日子起， 你的行为都无可指摘， 直到在你中间有了罪孽为止。
verses.textZhCuv: 你从受造之日所行的都完全， 后来在你中间又察出不义。
verses.textEnNiv: You were blameless in your ways from the day you were created till wickedness was found in you.
verses.textEnEsv: You were blameless in your ways from the day you were created, till unrighteousness was found in you.
verses.textEnNkjv: You were perfect in your ways from the day you were created, Till iniquity was found in you.
verses.textEnNlt: "You were blameless in all you did from the day you were created until the day evil was found in you.
verses.textEnNasb: "You were blameless in your ways From the day you were created Until unrighteousness was found in you.
verses.textEn: You were blameless in your ways from the day you were created till wickedness was found in you.

verses.textZh: 因你的贸易昌盛， 你中间就充满了强暴的事， 你也犯了罪， 所以我把你当作污秽之物， 从神的山把你拋弃。 护卫宝座的基路伯啊！我要把你 从闪耀如火的宝石中除掉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因你的贸易昌盛， 你中间就充满了强暴的事， 你也犯了罪， 所以我把你当作污秽之物， 从神的山把你拋弃。 护卫宝座的基路伯啊！我要把你 从闪耀如火的宝石中除掉。
verses.textZhCuv: 因你贸易很多， 就被强暴的事充满，以致犯罪， 所以我因你亵渎圣地， 就从神的山驱逐你。 遮掩约柜的基路伯啊， 我已将你从发光如火的宝石中除灭。
verses.textEnNiv: Through your widespread trade you were filled with violence, and you sinned. So I drove you in disgrace from the mount of God, and I expelled you, guardian cherub, from among the fiery stones.
verses.textEnEsv: In the abundance of your trade you were filled with violence in your midst, and you sinned; so I cast you as a profane thing from the mountain of God, and I destroyed you, O guardian cherub, from the midst of the stones of fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: "By the abundance of your trading You became filled with violence within, And you sinned; Therefore I cast you as a profane thing Out of the mountain of God; And I destroyed you, O covering cherub, From the midst of the fiery stones.
verses.textEnNlt: Your rich commerce led you to violence, and you sinned. So I banished you in disgrace from the mountain of God. I expelled you, O mighty guardian, from your place among the stones of fire.
verses.textEnNasb: "By the abundance of your trade You were internally filled with violence, And you sinned; Therefore I have cast you as profane From the mountain of God. And I have destroyed you, you covering cherub, From the midst of the stones of fire.
verses.textEn: Through your widespread trade you were filled with violence, and you sinned. So I drove you in disgrace from the mount of God, and I expelled you, guardian cherub, from among the fiery stones.

verses.textZh: 你因自己的美丽心里高傲， 又因你的光彩败坏了你的智慧。 所以我把你拋在地上； 放在列王面前， 好让他们观看。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你因自己的美丽心里高傲， 又因你的光彩败坏了你的智慧。 所以我把你拋在地上； 放在列王面前， 好让他们观看。
verses.textZhCuv: 你因美丽心中高傲， 又因荣光败坏智慧， 我已将你摔倒在地， 使你倒在君王面前， 好叫他们目睹眼见。
verses.textEnNiv: Your heart became proud on account of your beauty, and you corrupted your wisdom because of your splendor. So I threw you to the earth; I made a spectacle of you before kings.
verses.textEnEsv: Your heart was proud because of your beauty; you corrupted your wisdom for the sake of your splendor. I cast you to the ground; I exposed you before kings, to feast their eyes on you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Your heart was lifted up because of your beauty; You corrupted your wisdom for the sake of your splendor; I cast you to the ground, I laid you before kings, That they might gaze at you.
verses.textEnNlt: Your heart was filled with pride because of all your beauty. Your wisdom was corrupted by your love of splendor. So I threw you to the ground and exposed you to the curious gaze of kings.
verses.textEnNasb: "Your heart was haughty because of your beauty; You corrupted your wisdom by reason of your splendor. I threw you to the ground; I put you before kings, That they may see you.
verses.textEn: Your heart became proud on account of your beauty, and you corrupted your wisdom because of your splendor. So I threw you to the earth; I made a spectacle of you before kings.

verses.textZh: 你因罪孽众多， 又因贸易上的罪恶， 玷污了你的圣所， 因此我使火从你中间出来， 这火要吞灭你。 我要在所有观看你的人眼前， 把你变为地上的灰烬。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你因罪孽众多， 又因贸易上的罪恶， 玷污了你的圣所， 因此我使火从你中间出来， 这火要吞灭你。 我要在所有观看你的人眼前， 把你变为地上的灰烬。
verses.textZhCuv: 你因罪孽众多， 贸易不公， 就亵渎你那里的圣所。 故此，我使火从你中间发出，烧灭你， 使你在所有观看的人眼前变为地上的炉灰。
verses.textEnNiv: By your many sins and dishonest trade you have desecrated your sanctuaries. So I made a fire come out from you, and it consumed you, and I reduced you to ashes on the ground in the sight of all who were watching.
verses.textEnEsv: By the multitude of your iniquities, in the unrighteousness of your trade you profaned your sanctuaries; so I brought fire out from your midst; it consumed you, and I turned you to ashes on the earth in the sight of all who saw you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You defiled your sanctuaries By the multitude of your iniquities, By the iniquity of your trading; Therefore I brought fire from your midst; It devoured you, And I turned you to ashes upon the earth In the sight of all who saw you.
verses.textEnNlt: You defiled your sanctuaries with your many sins and your dishonest trade. So I brought fire out from within you, and it consumed you. I reduced you to ashes on the ground in the sight of all who were watching.
verses.textEnNasb: "By the multitude of your wrongdoings, In the unrighteousness of your trade You profaned your sanctuaries. Therefore I have brought fire from the midst of you; It has consumed you, And I have turned you to ashes on the earth In the eyes of all who see you.
verses.textEn: By your many sins and dishonest trade you have desecrated your sanctuaries. So I made a fire come out from you, and it consumed you, and I reduced you to ashes on the ground in the sight of all who were watching.

verses.textZh: 万族中认识你的， 都必因你惊骇； 你必遭遇可怕的灾祸， 你就永远不再存在了。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 万族中认识你的， 都必因你惊骇； 你必遭遇可怕的灾祸， 你就永远不再存在了。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 各国民中，凡认识你的， 都必为你惊奇。 你令人惊恐， 不再存留于世，直到永远。」
verses.textEnNiv: All the nations who knew you are appalled at you; you have come to a horrible end and will be no more.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: All who know you among the peoples are appalled at you; you have come to a dreadful end and shall be no more forever."
verses.textEnNkjv: All who knew you among the peoples are astonished at you; You have become a horror, And shallbe no more forever." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: All who knew you are appalled at your fate. You have come to a terrible end, and you will exist no more."
verses.textEnNasb: "All who know you among the peoples Are appalled at you; You have become terrified And you will cease to be forever." ’ "
verses.textEn: All the nations who knew you are appalled at you; you have come to a horrible end and will be no more.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then another message came to me from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: The word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: "人子啊！你要面向西顿，说预言攻击它，
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！你要面向西顿，说预言攻击它，
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，你要向西顿预言攻击她，
verses.textEnNiv: "Son of man, set your face against Sidon; prophesy against her
verses.textEnEsv: "Son of man, set your face toward Sidon, and prophesy against her
verses.textEnNkjv: "Son of man, set your face toward Sidon, and prophesy against her,
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, turn and face the city of Sidon and prophesy against it.
verses.textEnNasb: "Son of man, set your face toward Sidon, prophesy against her
verses.textEn: "Son of man, set your face against Sidon; prophesy against her

verses.textZh: 你要说：‘主耶和华这样说： 西顿啊，我要与你为敌！ 我要在你中间得荣耀。 我在它身上施行审判， 彰显我的圣洁的时候， 人就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要说：‘主耶和华这样说： 西顿啊，我要与你为敌！ 我要在你中间得荣耀。 我在它身上施行审判， 彰显我的圣洁的时候， 人就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 说主耶和华如此说： 西顿哪，我与你为敌， 我必在你中间得荣耀。 我在你中间施行审判、显为圣的时候， 人就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: and say: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: " ‘I am against you, Sidon, and among you I will display my glory. You will know that I am the Lord , when I inflict punishment on you and within you am proved to be holy.
verses.textEnEsv: and say, Thus says the Lord God : "Behold, I am against you, O Sidon, and I will manifest my glory in your midst. And they shall know that I am the Lord when I execute judgments in her and manifest my holiness in her;
verses.textEnNkjv: and say, ‘Thus says the Lord God: "Behold, I am against you, O Sidon; I will be glorified in your midst; And they shall know that I am the Lord, When I execute judgments in her and am hallowed in her.
verses.textEnNlt: Give the people of Sidon this message from the Sovereign Lord : "I am your enemy, O Sidon, and I will reveal my glory by what I do to you. When I bring judgment against you and reveal my holiness among you, everyone watching will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: and say, ‘This is what the Lord God says: "Behold, I am against you, Sidon, And I will appear in My glory in your midst. Then they will know that I am the Lord, when I execute judgments against her, And I will reveal Myself as holy in her.
verses.textEn: and say: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: " ‘I am against you, Sidon, and among you I will display my glory. You will know that I am the Lord , when I inflict punishment on you and within you am proved to be holy.

verses.textZh: 我必使瘟疫进入西顿， 使血流在它的街上； 必有刀剑四围攻击它， 使被杀的人倒在城中， 人就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必使瘟疫进入西顿， 使血流在它的街上； 必有刀剑四围攻击它， 使被杀的人倒在城中， 人就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必使瘟疫进入西顿， 使血流在她街上。 被杀的必在其中仆倒， 四围有刀剑临到她， 人就知道我是耶和华。」
verses.textEnNiv: I will send a plague upon you and make blood flow in your streets. The slain will fall within you, with the sword against you on every side. Then you will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: for I will send pestilence into her, and blood into her streets; and the slain shall fall in her midst, by the sword that is against her on every side. Then they will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: For I will send pestilence upon her, And blood in her streets; The wounded shall be judged in her midst By the sword against her on every side; Then they shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: I will send a plague against you, and blood will be spilled in your streets. The attack will come from every direction, and your people will lie slaughtered within your walls. Then everyone will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "For I will send a plague to her And blood to her streets, And the wounded will fall in her midst By the sword upon her on every side; Then they will know that I am the Lord.
verses.textEn: I will send a plague upon you and make blood flow in your streets. The slain will fall within you, with the sword against you on every side. Then you will know that I am the Lord .

verses.textZh: 四围一切恨恶以色列家的人，必不再向他们作刺人的荆棘、使人痛苦的蒺藜。人就知道我是主耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 四围一切恨恶以色列家的人，必不再向他们作刺人的荆棘、使人痛苦的蒺藜。人就知道我是主耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 「四围恨恶以色列家的人，必不再向他们作刺人的荆棘，伤人的蒺藜，人就知道我是主耶和华。」
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘No longer will the people of Israel have malicious neighbors who are painful briers and sharp thorns. Then they will know that I am the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: "And for the house of Israel there shall be no more a brier to prick or a thorn to hurt them among all their neighbors who have treated them with contempt. Then they will know that I am the Lord God .
verses.textEnNkjv: "And there shall no longer be a pricking brier or a painful thorn for the house of Israel from among all whoare around them, who despise them. Then they shall know that I am the Lord God."
verses.textEnNlt: No longer will Israel’s scornful neighbors prick and tear at her like briers and thorns. For then they will know that I am the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: And there will no longer be for the house of Israel a painful thorn or a hurtful thorn bush from any surrounding them who despised them; then they will know that I am the Lord God."
verses.textEn: " ‘No longer will the people of Israel have malicious neighbors who are painful briers and sharp thorns. Then they will know that I am the Sovereign Lord .

verses.textZh: "‘主耶和华这样说：我把以色列家从他们所分散到的万族中招聚回来的时候，我必在他们身上向列国显为圣，以色列家必在自己的地方，就是赐给我仆人雅各的地。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘主耶和华这样说：我把以色列家从他们所分散到的万族中招聚回来的时候，我必在他们身上向列国显为圣，以色列家必在自己的地方，就是赐给我仆人雅各的地。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华如此说：「我将分散在万民中的以色列家招聚回来，向他们在列邦人眼前显为圣的时候，他们就在我赐给我仆人雅各之地，仍然居住。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: When I gather the people of Israel from the nations where they have been scattered, I will be proved holy through them in the sight of the nations. Then they will live in their own land, which I gave to my servant Jacob.
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord God : When I gather the house of Israel from the peoples among whom they are scattered, and manifest my holiness in them in the sight of the nations, then they shall dwell in their own land that I gave to my servant Jacob.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Thus says the Lord God: "When I have gathered the house of Israel from the peoples among whom they are scattered, and am hallowed in them in the sight of the Gentiles, then they will dwell in their own land which I gave to My servant Jacob.
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Sovereign Lord says: The people of Israel will again live in their own land, the land I gave my servant Jacob. For I will gather them from the distant lands where I have scattered them. I will reveal to the nations of the world my holiness among my people.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘This is what the Lord God says: "When I gather the house of Israel from the peoples among whom they are scattered, and show Myself holy among them in the sight of the nations, then they will live on their land which I gave to My servant Jacob.
verses.textEn: " ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: When I gather the people of Israel from the nations where they have been scattered, I will be proved holy through them in the sight of the nations. Then they will live in their own land, which I gave to my servant Jacob.

verses.textZh: 他们必安然居住，建造房屋，栽种葡萄园；我向四围所有恨恶他们的人施行审判以后，他们必安然居住；人就知道我是耶和华他们的神。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们必安然居住，建造房屋，栽种葡萄园；我向四围所有恨恶他们的人施行审判以后，他们必安然居住；人就知道我是耶和华他们的神。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们要在这地上安然居住。我向四围恨恶他们的众人施行审判以后，他们要盖造房屋，栽种葡萄园，安然居住，就知道我是耶和华－他们的神。」
verses.textEnNiv: They will live there in safety and will build houses and plant vineyards; they will live in safety when I inflict punishment on all their neighbors who maligned them. Then they will know that I am the Lord their God.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And they shall dwell securely in it, and they shall build houses and plant vineyards. They shall dwell securely, when I execute judgments upon all their neighbors who have treated them with contempt. Then they will know that I am the Lord their God."
verses.textEnNkjv: And they will dwell safely there, build houses, and plant vineyards; yes, they will dwell securely, when I execute judgments on all those around them who despise them. Then they shall know that I am the Lord their God." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: They will live safely in Israel and build homes and plant vineyards. And when I punish the neighboring nations that treated them with contempt, they will know that I am the Lord their God."
verses.textEnNasb: They will live on it securely; and they will build houses, plant vineyards, and live securely when I execute judgments upon all around them who despise them. Then they will know that I am the Lord their God." ’ "
verses.textEn: They will live there in safety and will build houses and plant vineyards; they will live in safety when I inflict punishment on all their neighbors who maligned them. Then they will know that I am the Lord their God.’ "

verses.textZh: 第十年十月十二日，耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 第十年十月十二日，耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 第十年十月十二日，耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: In the tenth year, in the tenth month on the twelfth day, the word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: In the tenth year, in the tenth month, on the twelfth day of the month, the word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnNkjv: In the tenth year, in the tenth month, on the twelfth day of the month, the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: On January 7, during the tenth year of King Jehoiachin’s captivity, this message came to me from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: In the tenth year, in the tenth month, on the twelfth of the month, the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: In the tenth year, in the tenth month on the twelfth day, the word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: "人子啊！你要面向埃及王法老，说预言攻击他和埃及全地。
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！你要面向埃及王法老，说预言攻击他和埃及全地。
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，你要向埃及王法老预言攻击他和埃及全地，
verses.textEnNiv: "Son of man, set your face against Pharaoh king of Egypt and prophesy against him and against all Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: "Son of man, set your face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and prophesy against him and against all Egypt;
verses.textEnNkjv: "Son of man, set your face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and prophesy against him, and against all Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, turn and face Egypt and prophesy against Pharaoh the king and all the people of Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: "Son of man, set your face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and prophesy against him and against all Egypt.
verses.textEn: "Son of man, set your face against Pharaoh king of Egypt and prophesy against him and against all Egypt.

verses.textZh: 你要说：‘主耶和华这样说： 埃及王法老啊！我要与你为敌， 你这卧在自己河中的大海怪， 你曾经说过："这河是我的，是我自己造的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要说：‘主耶和华这样说： 埃及王法老啊！我要与你为敌， 你这卧在自己河中的大海怪， 你曾经说过："这河是我的，是我自己造的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 说主耶和华如此说： 埃及王法老啊， 我与你这卧在自己河中的大鱼为敌。 你曾说：这河是我的， 是我为自己造的。
verses.textEnNiv: Speak to him and say: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: " ‘I am against you, Pharaoh king of Egypt, you great monster lying among your streams. You say, "The Nile belongs to me; I made it for myself."
verses.textEnEsv: speak, and say, Thus says the Lord God : "Behold, I am against you, Pharaoh king of Egypt, the great dragon that lies in the midst of his streams, that says, ‘My Nile is my own; I made it for myself.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Speak, and say, ‘Thus says the Lord God: "Behold, I am against you, O Pharaoh king of Egypt, O great monster who lies in the midst of his rivers, Who has said, ‘My River is my own; I have made it for myself.’
verses.textEnNlt: Give them this message from the Sovereign Lord : "I am your enemy, O Pharaoh, king of Egypt— you great monster, lurking in the streams of the Nile. For you have said, ‘The Nile River is mine; I made it for myself.’
verses.textEnNasb: Speak and say, ‘This is what the Lord God says: "Behold, I am against you, Pharaoh king of Egypt, The great monster that lies in the midst of his canals, That has said, ‘My Nile is mine, and I myself have made it.’
verses.textEn: Speak to him and say: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: " ‘I am against you, Pharaoh king of Egypt, you great monster lying among your streams. You say, "The Nile belongs to me; I made it for myself."

verses.textZh: 但我耶和华必用钩子钩住你的腮颊， 使你河中的鱼都紧贴着你的鳞甲， 我必把你和你河中所有紧贴着你的鳞甲的鱼， 都从你河中拉上来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但我耶和华必用钩子钩住你的腮颊， 使你河中的鱼都紧贴着你的鳞甲， 我必把你和你河中所有紧贴着你的鳞甲的鱼， 都从你河中拉上来。
verses.textZhCuv: 我－耶和华必用钩子钩住你的腮颊， 又使江河中的鱼贴住你的鳞甲； 我必将你和所有贴住你鳞甲的鱼， 从江河中拉上来，
verses.textEnNiv: But I will put hooks in your jaws and make the fish of your streams stick to your scales. I will pull you out from among your streams, with all the fish sticking to your scales.
verses.textEnEsv: I will put hooks in your jaws, and make the fish of your streams stick to your scales; and I will draw you up out of the midst of your streams, with all the fish of your streams that stick to your scales.
verses.textEnNkjv: But I will put hooks in your jaws, And cause the fish of your rivers to stick to your scales; I will bring you up out of the midst of your rivers, And all the fish in your rivers will stick to your scales.
verses.textEnNlt: I will put hooks in your jaws and drag you out on the land with fish sticking to your scales.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will put hooks in your jaws And make the fish of your canals cling to your scales. And I will bring you up out of the midst of your canals, And all the fish of your canals will cling to your scales.
verses.textEn: But I will put hooks in your jaws and make the fish of your streams stick to your scales. I will pull you out from among your streams, with all the fish sticking to your scales.

verses.textZh: 我必把你和你河中所有的鱼，都丢在旷野； 你必倒在田间，无人收殓，无人埋葬。 我已经把你给了地上的走兽和空中的飞鸟作食物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必把你和你河中所有的鱼，都丢在旷野； 你必倒在田间，无人收殓，无人埋葬。 我已经把你给了地上的走兽和空中的飞鸟作食物。
verses.textZhCuv: 把你并江河中的鱼都抛在旷野； 你必倒在田间， 不被收殓，不被掩埋。 我已将你给地上野兽、空中飞鸟作食物。
verses.textEnNiv: I will leave you in the desert, you and all the fish of your streams. You will fall on the open field and not be gathered or picked up. I will give you as food to the beasts of the earth and the birds of the sky.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will cast you out into the wilderness, you and all the fish of your streams; you shall fall on the open field, and not be brought together or gathered. To the beasts of the earth and to the birds of the heavens I give you as food.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will leave you in the wilderness, You and all the fish of your rivers; You shall fall on the open field; You shall not be picked up or gathered. I have given you as food To the beasts of the field And to the birds of the heavens.
verses.textEnNlt: I will leave you and all your fish stranded in the wilderness to die. You will lie unburied on the open ground, for I have given you as food to the wild animals and birds.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will abandon you to the wilderness, you and all the fish of your canals; You will fall on the open field; you will not be brought together or gathered. I have given you for food to the animals of the earth and to the birds of the sky.
verses.textEn: I will leave you in the desert, you and all the fish of your streams. You will fall on the open field and not be gathered or picked up. I will give you as food to the beasts of the earth and the birds of the sky.

verses.textZh: 埃及所有的居民就都知道我是耶和华。 因为你作了以色列家芦苇的杖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 埃及所有的居民就都知道我是耶和华。 因为你作了以色列家芦苇的杖。
verses.textZhCuv: 「埃及一切的居民，因向以色列家成了芦苇的杖，就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: Then all who live in Egypt will know that I am the Lord . " ‘You have been a staff of reed for the people of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Then all the inhabitants of Egypt shall know that I am the Lord . "Because you have been a staff of reed to the house of Israel,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then all the inhabitants of Egypt Shall know that I am the Lord, Because they have been a staff of reed to the house of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: All the people of Egypt will know that I am the Lord , for to Israel you were just a staff made of reeds.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then all the inhabitants of Egypt will know that I am the Lord, Because they have been only a staff made of reed to the house of Israel.
verses.textEn: Then all who live in Egypt will know that I am the Lord . " ‘You have been a staff of reed for the people of Israel.

verses.textZh: 他们用手抓住你的时候， 你就断裂，伤了他们的肩头； 他们倚靠你， 你就折断、扭伤了他们的腰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们用手抓住你的时候， 你就断裂，伤了他们的肩头； 他们倚靠你， 你就折断、扭伤了他们的腰。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们用手持住你，你就断折，伤了他们的肩；他们倚靠你，你就断折，闪了他们的腰。
verses.textEnNiv: When they grasped you with their hands, you splintered and you tore open their shoulders; when they leaned on you, you broke and their backs were wrenched.
verses.textEnEsv: when they grasped you with the hand, you broke and tore all their shoulders; and when they leaned on you, you broke and made all their loins to shake.
verses.textEnNkjv: When they took hold of you with the hand, You broke and tore all their shoulders; When they leaned on you, You broke and made all their backs quiver."
verses.textEnNlt: When Israel leaned on you, you splintered and broke and stabbed her in the armpit. When she put her weight on you, you collapsed, and her legs gave way.
verses.textEnNasb: "When they took hold of you with the hand, You broke and tore all their hands; And when they leaned on you, You broke and made all their hips shake."
verses.textEn: When they grasped you with their hands, you splintered and you tore open their shoulders; when they leaned on you, you broke and their backs were wrenched.

verses.textZh: 因此，主耶和华这样说：看哪！我必使刀剑攻击你，把人和牲畜都从你那里剪除。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，主耶和华这样说：看哪！我必使刀剑攻击你，把人和牲畜都从你那里剪除。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以主耶和华如此说：我必使刀剑临到你，从你中间将人与牲畜剪除。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I will bring a sword against you and kill both man and beast.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore thus says the Lord God : Behold, I will bring a sword upon you, and will cut off from you man and beast,
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Therefore thus says the Lord God: "Surely I will bring a sword upon you and cut off from you man and beast.
verses.textEnNlt: "Therefore, this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I will bring an army against you, O Egypt, and destroy both people and animals.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Therefore the Lord God says this: "Behold, I am going to bring upon you a sword, and I will cut off from you human and animal life.
verses.textEn: " ‘Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I will bring a sword against you and kill both man and beast.

verses.textZh: 埃及地必荒凉废弃，人就知道我是耶和华。 "‘因为法老曾说："这河是我的，是我自己做的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 埃及地必荒凉废弃，人就知道我是耶和华。 "‘因为法老曾说："这河是我的，是我自己做的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 埃及地必荒废凄凉，他们就知道我是耶和华。 「因为法老说：『这河是我的，是我所造的』，
verses.textEnNiv: Egypt will become a desolate wasteland. Then they will know that I am the Lord . " ‘Because you said, "The Nile is mine; I made it,"
verses.textEnEsv: and the land of Egypt shall be a desolation and a waste. Then they will know that I am the Lord . "Because you said, ‘The Nile is mine, and I made it,’
verses.textEnNkjv: And the land of Egypt shall become desolate and waste; then they will know that I am the Lord, because he said, ‘The River is mine, and I have made it.’
verses.textEnNlt: The land of Egypt will become a desolate wasteland, and the Egyptians will know that I am the Lord . "Because you said, ‘The Nile River is mine; I made it,’
verses.textEnNasb: The land of Egypt will become a desolation and place of ruins. Then they will know that I am the Lord. "Because you said, ‘The Nile is mine, and I have made it,’
verses.textEn: Egypt will become a desolate wasteland. Then they will know that I am the Lord . " ‘Because you said, "The Nile is mine; I made it,"

verses.textZh: 所以我必与你和你的河为敌；我必使埃及地，从密夺到色弗尼，直到古实边界，都全然荒凉废弃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以我必与你和你的河为敌；我必使埃及地，从密夺到色弗尼，直到古实边界，都全然荒凉废弃。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以我必与你并你的江河为敌，使埃及地，从色弗尼塔直到古实境界，全然荒废凄凉。
verses.textEnNiv: therefore I am against you and against your streams, and I will make the land of Egypt a ruin and a desolate waste from Migdol to Aswan, as far as the border of Cush.
verses.textEnEsv: therefore, behold, I am against you and against your streams, and I will make the land of Egypt an utter waste and desolation, from Migdol to Syene, as far as the border of Cush.
verses.textEnNkjv: Indeed, therefore, I am against you and against your rivers, and I will make the land of Egypt utterly waste and desolate, from Migdol to Syene, as far as the border of Ethiopia.
verses.textEnNlt: I am now the enemy of both you and your river. I will make the land of Egypt a totally desolate wasteland, from Migdol to Aswan, as far south as the border of Ethiopia.
verses.textEnNasb: therefore, behold, I am against you and against your canals, and I will make the land of Egypt an utter waste and desolation, from Migdol to Syene and as far as the border of Cush.
verses.textEn: therefore I am against you and against your streams, and I will make the land of Egypt a ruin and a desolate waste from Migdol to Aswan, as far as the border of Cush.

verses.textZh: 人的脚必不经过那里，兽的蹄也不经过那里；四十年之久，无人居住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人的脚必不经过那里，兽的蹄也不经过那里；四十年之久，无人居住。
verses.textZhCuv: 人的脚、兽的蹄都不经过，四十年之久并无人居住。
verses.textEnNiv: The foot of neither man nor beast will pass through it; no one will live there for forty years.
verses.textEnEsv: No foot of man shall pass through it, and no foot of beast shall pass through it; it shall be uninhabited forty years.
verses.textEnNkjv: Neither foot of man shall pass through it nor foot of beast pass through it, and it shall be uninhabited forty years.
verses.textEnNlt: For forty years not a soul will pass that way, neither people nor animals. It will be completely uninhabited.
verses.textEnNasb: A human foot will not pass through it, nor will the foot of an animal pass through it, and it will not be inhabited for forty years.
verses.textEn: The foot of neither man nor beast will pass through it; no one will live there for forty years.

verses.textZh: 我必使埃及成为荒地中的荒地，四十年之久，它的城必成为废城中的废城。我必把埃及人分散到列邦，四散在各地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必使埃及成为荒地中的荒地，四十年之久，它的城必成为废城中的废城。我必把埃及人分散到列邦，四散在各地。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必使埃及地在荒凉的国中成为荒凉，使埃及城在荒废的城中变为荒废，共有四十年。我必将埃及人分散在列国，四散在列邦。」
verses.textEnNiv: I will make the land of Egypt desolate among devastated lands, and her cities will lie desolate forty years among ruined cities. And I will disperse the Egyptians among the nations and scatter them through the countries.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will make the land of Egypt a desolation in the midst of desolated countries, and her cities shall be a desolation forty years among cities that are laid waste. I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and disperse them through the countries.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will make the land of Egypt desolate in the midst of the countries thatare desolate; and among the cities thatare laid waste, her cities shall be desolate forty years; and I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations and disperse them throughout the countries."
verses.textEnNlt: I will make Egypt desolate, and it will be surrounded by other desolate nations. Its cities will be empty and desolate for forty years, surrounded by other ruined cities. I will scatter the Egyptians to distant lands.
verses.textEnNasb: So I will make the land of Egypt a desolation in the midst of deserted lands. And her cities, in the midst of cities that are laid waste, will be desolate for forty years; and I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations and disperse them among the lands."
verses.textEn: I will make the land of Egypt desolate among devastated lands, and her cities will lie desolate forty years among ruined cities. And I will disperse the Egyptians among the nations and scatter them through the countries.

verses.textZh: "‘主耶和华这样说：满了四十年，我必把埃及人从他们所分散到的万族中招聚回来。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘主耶和华这样说：满了四十年，我必把埃及人从他们所分散到的万族中招聚回来。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华如此说：「满了四十年，我必招聚分散在各国民中的埃及人。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Yet this is what the Sovereign Lord says: At the end of forty years I will gather the Egyptians from the nations where they were scattered.
verses.textEnEsv: "For thus says the Lord God : At the end of forty years I will gather the Egyptians from the peoples among whom they were scattered,
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Yet, thus says the Lord God: "At the end of forty years I will gather the Egyptians from the peoples among whom they were scattered.
verses.textEnNlt: "But this is what the Sovereign Lord also says: At the end of the forty years I will bring the Egyptians home again from the nations to which they have been scattered.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘For this is what the Lord God says: "At the end of forty years I will gather the Egyptians from the peoples among whom they were scattered.
verses.textEn: " ‘Yet this is what the Sovereign Lord says: At the end of forty years I will gather the Egyptians from the nations where they were scattered.

verses.textZh: 我必使埃及被掳的人归回，使他们归回自己根源之地巴忒罗，在那里他们必成为低微的国。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必使埃及被掳的人归回，使他们归回自己根源之地巴忒罗，在那里他们必成为低微的国。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必叫埃及被掳的人回来，使他们归回本地巴忒罗。在那里必成为低微的国，
verses.textEnNiv: I will bring them back from captivity and return them to Upper Egypt, the land of their ancestry. There they will be a lowly kingdom.
verses.textEnEsv: and I will restore the fortunes of Egypt and bring them back to the land of Pathros, the land of their origin, and there they shall be a lowly kingdom.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will bring back the captives of Egypt and cause them to return to the land of Pathros, to the land of their origin, and there they shall be a lowly kingdom.
verses.textEnNlt: I will restore the prosperity of Egypt and bring its people back to the land of Pathros in southern Egypt from which they came. But Egypt will remain an unimportant, minor kingdom.
verses.textEnNasb: And I will restore the fortunes of Egypt and bring them back to the land of Pathros, to the land of their origin, and there they will be a lowly kingdom.
verses.textEn: I will bring them back from captivity and return them to Upper Egypt, the land of their ancestry. There they will be a lowly kingdom.

verses.textZh: 这国必成为列国中最低微的，也必不能再攀到列国之上；我必使他们弱小，以致他们不能再管辖列国。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这国必成为列国中最低微的，也必不能再攀到列国之上；我必使他们弱小，以致他们不能再管辖列国。
verses.textZhCuv: 必为列国中最低微的，也不再自高于列国之上。我必减少他们，以致不再辖制列国。
verses.textEnNiv: It will be the lowliest of kingdoms and will never again exalt itself above the other nations. I will make it so weak that it will never again rule over the nations.
verses.textEnEsv: It shall be the most lowly of the kingdoms, and never again exalt itself above the nations. And I will make them so small that they will never again rule over the nations.
verses.textEnNkjv: It shall be the lowliest of kingdoms; it shall never again exalt itself above the nations, for I will diminish them so that they will not rule over the nations anymore.
verses.textEnNlt: It will be the lowliest of all the nations, never again great enough to rise above its neighbors.
verses.textEnNasb: It will be the lowest of the kingdoms, and it will not raise itself above the nations again. And I will make them small so that they will not rule over the nations.
verses.textEn: It will be the lowliest of kingdoms and will never again exalt itself above the other nations. I will make it so weak that it will never again rule over the nations.

verses.textZh: 埃及必不再作以色列家的倚靠；每逢以色列家转去仰赖埃及人的时候，他们就想起自己的罪孽。这样，他们就知道我是主耶和华。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 埃及必不再作以色列家的倚靠；每逢以色列家转去仰赖埃及人的时候，他们就想起自己的罪孽。这样，他们就知道我是主耶和华。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 埃及必不再作以色列家所倚靠的；以色列家仰望埃及人的时候，便思念罪孽。他们就知道我是主耶和华。」
verses.textEnNiv: Egypt will no longer be a source of confidence for the people of Israel but will be a reminder of their sin in turning to her for help. Then they will know that I am the Sovereign Lord .’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And it shall never again be the reliance of the house of Israel, recalling their iniquity, when they turn to them for aid. Then they will know that I am the Lord God ."
verses.textEnNkjv: No longer shall it be the confidence of the house of Israel, but will remind them of their iniquity when they turned to follow them. Then they shall know that I am the Lord God." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: "Then Israel will no longer be tempted to trust in Egypt for help. Egypt’s shattered condition will remind Israel of how sinful she was to trust Egypt in earlier days. Then Israel will know that I am the Sovereign Lord ."
verses.textEnNasb: And it will no longer be a kingdom on which the house of Israel relies, bringing to mind the guilt of their having turned to Egypt. Then they will know that I am the Lord God." ’ "
verses.textEn: Egypt will no longer be a source of confidence for the people of Israel but will be a reminder of their sin in turning to her for help. Then they will know that I am the Sovereign Lord .’ "

verses.textZh: 二十七年正月初一日，耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 二十七年正月初一日，耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 二十七年正月初一日，耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: In the twenty-seventh year, in the first month on the first day, the word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: In the twenty-seventh year, in the first month, on the first day of the month, the word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass in the twenty-seventh year, in the first month, on the first day of the month, that the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: On April 26, the first day of the new year, during the twenty-seventh year of King Jehoiachin’s captivity, this message came to me from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: Now in the twenty-seventh year, in the first month, on the first of the month, the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: In the twenty-seventh year, in the first month on the first day, the word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: "人子啊！巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒使他的军兵千辛万苦攻打推罗，以致各人都头秃肩破；但是他和他的军兵攻打推罗所付出的辛劳，并没有从那里得到甚么报酬。
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒使他的军兵千辛万苦攻打推罗，以致各人都头秃肩破；但是他和他的军兵攻打推罗所付出的辛劳，并没有从那里得到甚么报酬。
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒使他的军兵大大效劳，攻打泰尔，以致头都光秃，肩都磨破；然而他和他的军兵攻打泰尔，并没有从那里得什么酬劳。
verses.textEnNiv: "Son of man, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon drove his army in a hard campaign against Tyre; every head was rubbed bare and every shoulder made raw. Yet he and his army got no reward from the campaign he led against Tyre.
verses.textEnEsv: "Son of man, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon made his army labor hard against Tyre. Every head was made bald, and every shoulder was rubbed bare, yet neither he nor his army got anything from Tyre to pay for the labor that he had performed against her.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Son of man, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon caused his army to labor strenuously against Tyre; every head was made bald, and every shoulder rubbed raw; yet neither he nor his army received wages from Tyre, for the labor which they expended on it.
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, the army of King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon fought so hard against Tyre that the warriors’ heads were rubbed bare and their shoulders were raw and blistered. Yet Nebuchadnezzar and his army won no plunder to compensate them for all their work.
verses.textEnNasb: "Son of man, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon made his army labor hard against Tyre; every head had a bald spot and every shoulder was rubbed raw. But he and his army acquired no wages from Tyre for the labor that he had performed against it."
verses.textEn: "Son of man, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon drove his army in a hard campaign against Tyre; every head was rubbed bare and every shoulder made raw. Yet he and his army got no reward from the campaign he led against Tyre.

verses.textZh: 因此，主耶和华这样说：看哪！我必把埃及地赐给巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒，他把埃及的财富带走，抢其中的财为掳物，夺其中的货为掠物，作他军兵的报酬。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，主耶和华这样说：看哪！我必把埃及地赐给巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒，他把埃及的财富带走，抢其中的财为掳物，夺其中的货为掠物，作他军兵的报酬。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以主耶和华如此说：我必将埃及地赐给巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒；他必掳掠埃及群众，抢其中的财为掳物，夺其中的货为掠物，这就可以作他军兵的酬劳。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I am going to give Egypt to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he will carry off its wealth. He will loot and plunder the land as pay for his army.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore thus says the Lord God : Behold, I will give the land of Egypt to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; and he shall carry off its wealth and despoil it and plunder it; and it shall be the wages for his army.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore thus says the Lord God: ‘Surely I will give the land of Egypt to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; he shall take away her wealth, carry off her spoil, and remove her pillage; and that will be the wages for his army.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I will give the land of Egypt to Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon. He will carry off its wealth, plundering everything it has so he can pay his army.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore this is what the Lord God says: "Behold, I am going to give the land of Egypt to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon. And he will carry off her wealth and capture her spoils and seize her plunder; and it will be wages for his army.
verses.textEn: Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I am going to give Egypt to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he will carry off its wealth. He will loot and plunder the land as pay for his army.

verses.textZh: 我把埃及地赐给他，作辛劳的报酬，因为他们都是为我效力的。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我把埃及地赐给他，作辛劳的报酬，因为他们都是为我效力的。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 我将埃及地赐给他，酬他所效的劳，因王与军兵是为我勤劳。这是主耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: I have given him Egypt as a reward for his efforts because he and his army did it for me, declares the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: I have given him the land of Egypt as his payment for which he labored, because they worked for me, declares the Lord God .
verses.textEnNkjv: I have given him the land of Egypt for his labor, because they worked for Me,’ says the Lord God.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, I have given him the land of Egypt as a reward for his work, says the Sovereign Lord , because he was working for me when he destroyed Tyre.
verses.textEnNasb: I have given him the land of Egypt for his labor which he performed, because they acted for Me," declares the Lord God.
verses.textEn: I have given him Egypt as a reward for his efforts because he and his army did it for me, declares the Sovereign Lord .

verses.textZh: 到了那天，我必使以色列家的角生出来，我也必使你以西结在他们中间开口。他们就知道我是耶和华。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了那天，我必使以色列家的角生出来，我也必使你以西结在他们中间开口。他们就知道我是耶和华。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「当那日，我必使以色列家的角发生，又必使你－以西结在他们中间得以开口；他们就知道我是耶和华。」
verses.textEnNiv: "On that day I will make a horn grow for the Israelites, and I will open your mouth among them. Then they will know that I am the Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: "On that day I will cause a horn to spring up for the house of Israel, and I will open your lips among them. Then they will know that I am the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘In that day I will cause the horn of the house of Israel to spring forth, and I will open your mouth to speak in their midst. Then they shall know that I am the Lord.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: "And the day will come when I will cause the ancient glory of Israel to revive, and then, Ezekiel, your words will be respected. Then they will know that I am the Lord ."
verses.textEnNasb: "On that day I will make a horn sprout for the house of Israel, and I will open your mouth among them. Then they will know that I am the Lord."
verses.textEn: "On that day I will make a horn grow for the Israelites, and I will open your mouth among them. Then they will know that I am the Lord ."

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnNkjv: The word of the Lord came to me again, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: This is another message that came to me from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: The word of the Lord came again to me, saying,
verses.textEn: The word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: "人子啊！你要说预言：‘主耶和华这样说： 你们要哀号：那一天有祸了！
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！你要说预言：‘主耶和华这样说： 你们要哀号：那一天有祸了！
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，你要发预言说，主耶和华如此说： 哀哉这日！你们应当哭号。
verses.textEnNiv: "Son of man, prophesy and say: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: " ‘Wail and say, "Alas for that day!"
verses.textEnEsv: "Son of man, prophesy, and say, Thus says the Lord God : "Wail, ‘Alas for the day!’
verses.textEnNkjv: "Son of man, prophesy and say, ‘Thus says the Lord God: "Wail, ‘Woe to the day!’
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, prophesy and give this message from the Sovereign Lord : "Weep and wail for that day,
verses.textEnNasb: "Son of man, prophesy and say, ‘This is what the Lord God says: "Wail, ‘Woe for the day!’
verses.textEn: "Son of man, prophesy and say: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: " ‘Wail and say, "Alas for that day!"

verses.textZh: 因为那一天临近了， 耶和华的日子临近了， 就是密云的日子， 列国受罚的时候。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为那一天临近了， 耶和华的日子临近了， 就是密云的日子， 列国受罚的时候。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为耶和华的日子临近， 就是密云之日， 列国受罚之期。
verses.textEnNiv: For the day is near, the day of the Lord is near— a day of clouds, a time of doom for the nations.
verses.textEnEsv: For the day is near, the day of the Lord is near; it will be a day of clouds, a time of doom for the nations.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the day is near, Even the day of the Lordis near; It will be a day of clouds, the time of the Gentiles.
verses.textEnNlt: for the terrible day is almost here— the day of the Lord ! It is a day of clouds and gloom, a day of despair for the nations.
verses.textEnNasb: "For the day is near, Indeed, the day of the Lord is near; It will be a day of clouds, A time of doom for the nations.
verses.textEn: For the day is near, the day of the Lord is near— a day of clouds, a time of doom for the nations.

verses.textZh: 必有刀剑临到埃及， 被杀的人倒在埃及的时候， 在古实就有痛苦； 埃及的财富必被夺去， 它的根基必被拆毁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 必有刀剑临到埃及， 被杀的人倒在埃及的时候， 在古实就有痛苦； 埃及的财富必被夺去， 它的根基必被拆毁。
verses.textZhCuv: 必有刀剑临到埃及； 在埃及被杀之人仆倒的时候， 古实人就有痛苦， 人民必被掳掠， 基址必被拆毁。
verses.textEnNiv: A sword will come against Egypt, and anguish will come upon Cush. When the slain fall in Egypt, her wealth will be carried away and her foundations torn down.
verses.textEnEsv: A sword shall come upon Egypt, and anguish shall be in Cush, when the slain fall in Egypt, and her wealth is carried away, and her foundations are torn down.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sword shall come upon Egypt, And great anguish shall be in Ethiopia, When the slain fall in Egypt, And they take away her wealth, And her foundations are broken down.
verses.textEnNlt: A sword will come against Egypt, and those who are slaughtered will cover the ground. Its wealth will be carried away and its foundations destroyed. The land of Ethiopia will be ravished.
verses.textEnNasb: "A sword will come upon Egypt, And there will be trembling in Cush; When the slain fall in Egypt, They will take away her wealth, And her foundations will be torn down.
verses.textEn: A sword will come against Egypt, and anguish will come upon Cush. When the slain fall in Egypt, her wealth will be carried away and her foundations torn down.

verses.textZh: 古实人、弗人、路德人、所有外族的人、吕彼亚 人，以及与埃及结盟的人，都必与埃及人一起倒在刀下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 古实人、弗人、路德人、所有外族的人、吕彼亚 人，以及与埃及结盟的人，都必与埃及人一起倒在刀下。
verses.textZhCuv: 古实人、弗人 、路德人、杂族的人民，并古巴人，以及同盟之地的人都要与埃及人一同倒在刀下。」
verses.textEnNiv: Cush and Libya, Lydia and all Arabia, Kub and the people of the covenant land will fall by the sword along with Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: Cush, and Put, and Lud, and all Arabia, and Libya, and the people of the land that is in league, shall fall with them by the sword.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Ethiopia, Libya, Lydia, all the mingled people, Chub, and the men of the lands who are allied, shall fall with them by the sword."
verses.textEnNlt: Ethiopia, Libya, Lydia, all Arabia, and all their other allies will be destroyed in that war.
verses.textEnNasb: Cush, Put, Lud, all Arabia, Libya and the people of the land that is in league will fall with them by the sword."
verses.textEn: Cush and Libya, Lydia and all Arabia, Kub and the people of the covenant land will fall by the sword along with Egypt.

verses.textZh: "‘耶和华这样说： 那些支持埃及的必倾倒， 埃及所夸耀的势力必衰落。 从密夺到色弗尼， 他们都必倒在刀下； 这是主耶和华说的：
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘耶和华这样说： 那些支持埃及的必倾倒， 埃及所夸耀的势力必衰落。 从密夺到色弗尼， 他们都必倒在刀下； 这是主耶和华说的：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华如此说： 扶助埃及的也必倾倒。 埃及因势力而有的骄傲必降低微； 其中的人民，从色弗尼塔起 必倒在刀下。 这是主耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘This is what the Lord says: " ‘The allies of Egypt will fall and her proud strength will fail. From Migdol to Aswan they will fall by the sword within her, declares the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord : Those who support Egypt shall fall, and her proud might shall come down; from Migdol to Syene they shall fall within her by the sword, declares the Lord God .
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Thus says the Lord: "Those who uphold Egypt shall fall, And the pride of her power shall come down. From Migdol to Syene Those within her shall fall by the sword," Says the Lord God.
verses.textEnNlt: "For this is what the Lord says: All of Egypt’s allies will fall, and the pride of her power will end. From Migdol to Aswan they will be slaughtered by the sword, says the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: ‘This is what the Lord says: "Indeed, those who support Egypt will fall And the pride of her power will come down; From Migdol to Syene They will fall within her by the sword," Declares the Lord God.
verses.textEn: " ‘This is what the Lord says: " ‘The allies of Egypt will fall and her proud strength will fail. From Migdol to Aswan they will fall by the sword within her, declares the Sovereign Lord .

verses.textZh: 埃及必成为荒地中的荒地， 它的城必成为废城中的废城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 埃及必成为荒地中的荒地， 它的城必成为废城中的废城。
verses.textZhCuv: 埃及地在荒凉的国中必成为荒凉； 埃及城在荒废的城中也变为荒废。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘They will be desolate among desolate lands, and their cities will lie among ruined cities.
verses.textEnEsv: And they shall be desolated in the midst of desolated countries, and their cities shall be in the midst of cities that are laid waste.
verses.textEnNkjv: "They shall be desolate in the midst of the desolate countries, And her cities shall be in the midst of the cities thatare laid waste.
verses.textEnNlt: Egypt will be desolate, surrounded by desolate nations, and its cities will be in ruins, surrounded by other ruined cities.
verses.textEnNasb: "They will be desolate In the midst of the desolated lands; And her cities will be In the midst of the devastated cities.
verses.textEn: " ‘They will be desolate among desolate lands, and their cities will lie among ruined cities.

verses.textZh: 我在埃及点起火来的时候， 所有帮助埃及的都必灭亡； 那时他们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我在埃及点起火来的时候， 所有帮助埃及的都必灭亡； 那时他们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 我在埃及中使火着起； 帮助埃及的，都被灭绝。 那时，他们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: Then they will know that I am the Lord , when I set fire to Egypt and all her helpers are crushed.
verses.textEnEsv: Then they will know that I am the Lord , when I have set fire to Egypt, and all her helpers are broken.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they will know that I am the Lord, When I have set a fire in Egypt And all her helpers are destroyed.
verses.textEnNlt: And the people of Egypt will know that I am the Lord when I have set Egypt on fire and destroyed all their allies.
verses.textEnNasb: "And they will know that I am the Lord, When I set a fire in Egypt And all her helpers are broken.
verses.textEn: Then they will know that I am the Lord , when I set fire to Egypt and all her helpers are crushed.

verses.textZh: 那一天，必有使者从我面前乘船出去，使安逸无虑的古实人惊慌；在埃及遭难的日子，必有痛苦临到他们。看哪！这事来到了！
verses.textZhCnvs: 那一天，必有使者从我面前乘船出去，使安逸无虑的古实人惊慌；在埃及遭难的日子，必有痛苦临到他们。看哪！这事来到了！
verses.textZhCuv: 「到那日，必有使者坐船，从我面前出去，使安逸无虑的古实人惊惧；必有痛苦临到他们，好像埃及遭灾的日子一样。看哪，这事临近了！
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘On that day messengers will go out from me in ships to frighten Cush out of her complacency. Anguish will take hold of them on the day of Egypt’s doom, for it is sure to come.
verses.textEnEsv: "On that day messengers shall go out from me in ships to terrify the unsuspecting people of Cush, and anguish shall come upon them on the day of Egypt’s doom; for, behold, it comes!
verses.textEnNkjv: On that day messengers shall go forth from Me in ships To make the careless Ethiopians afraid, And great anguish shall come upon them, As on the day of Egypt; For indeed it is coming!"
verses.textEnNlt: At that time I will send swift messengers in ships to terrify the complacent Ethiopians. Great panic will come upon them on that day of Egypt’s certain destruction. Watch for it! It is sure to come!
verses.textEnNasb: On that day messengers will go out from Me in ships to frighten carefree Cush; and trembling will come on them as on the day of Egypt; for behold, it is coming!"
verses.textEn: " ‘On that day messengers will go out from me in ships to frighten Cush out of her complacency. Anguish will take hold of them on the day of Egypt’s doom, for it is sure to come.

verses.textZh: 主耶和华这样说： "‘我必借着巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒的手， 消灭埃及的财富。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主耶和华这样说： "‘我必借着巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒的手， 消灭埃及的财富。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华如此说： 我必藉巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒的手， 除灭埃及众人。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: " ‘I will put an end to the hordes of Egypt by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord God : "I will put an end to the wealth of Egypt, by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Thus says the Lord God: "I will also make a multitude of Egypt to cease By the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.
verses.textEnNlt: "For this is what the Sovereign Lord says: By the power of King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon, I will destroy the hordes of Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘This is what the Lord God says: "I will also make the hordes of Egypt cease By the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.
verses.textEn: " ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: " ‘I will put an end to the hordes of Egypt by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.

verses.textZh: 他和跟随他的人， 就是列国中最强横的人， 必被领进来，毁灭这地； 他们必拔出刀来攻击埃及， 使遍地满了被杀的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他和跟随他的人， 就是列国中最强横的人， 必被领进来，毁灭这地； 他们必拔出刀来攻击埃及， 使遍地满了被杀的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 他和随从他的人， 就是列国中强暴的， 必进来毁灭这地。 他们必拔刀攻击埃及， 使遍地有被杀的人。
verses.textEnNiv: He and his army—the most ruthless of nations— will be brought in to destroy the land. They will draw their swords against Egypt and fill the land with the slain.
verses.textEnEsv: He and his people with him, the most ruthless of nations, shall be brought in to destroy the land, and they shall draw their swords against Egypt and fill the land with the slain.
verses.textEnNkjv: He and his people with him, the most terrible of the nations, Shall be brought to destroy the land; They shall draw their swords against Egypt, And fill the land with the slain.
verses.textEnNlt: He and his armies—the most ruthless of all— will be sent to demolish the land. They will make war against Egypt until slaughtered Egyptians cover the ground.
verses.textEnNasb: "He and his people with him, The most ruthless of the nations, Will be brought in to destroy the land; And they will draw their swords against Egypt And fill the land with the slain.
verses.textEn: He and his army—the most ruthless of nations— will be brought in to destroy the land. They will draw their swords against Egypt and fill the land with the slain.

verses.textZh: 我必使江河干涸， 把这地卖给恶人； 我必借着外族人的手， 使这地和其中所充满的，都变成荒凉。 我耶和华已经说了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必使江河干涸， 把这地卖给恶人； 我必借着外族人的手， 使这地和其中所充满的，都变成荒凉。 我耶和华已经说了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必使江河干涸， 将地卖在恶人的手中； 我必藉外邦人的手， 使这地和其中所有的变为凄凉。 这是我－耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: I will dry up the waters of the Nile and sell the land to an evil nation; by the hand of foreigners I will lay waste the land and everything in it. I the Lord have spoken.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will dry up the Nile and will sell the land into the hand of evildoers; I will bring desolation upon the land and everything in it, by the hand of foreigners; I am the Lord ; I have spoken.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will make the rivers dry, And sell the land into the hand of the wicked; I will make the land waste, and all that is in it, By the hand of aliens. I, the Lord, have spoken."
verses.textEnNlt: I will dry up the Nile River and sell the land to wicked men. I will destroy the land of Egypt and everything in it by the hands of foreigners. I, the Lord , have spoken!
verses.textEnNasb: "Moreover, I will make the Nile canals dry And sell the land into the hands of evil men. And I will make the land desolate And all that is in it, By the hand of strangers; I the Lord have spoken."
verses.textEn: I will dry up the waters of the Nile and sell the land to an evil nation; by the hand of foreigners I will lay waste the land and everything in it. I the Lord have spoken.

verses.textZh: 主耶和华这样说： "‘我必毁灭偶像， 使虚无的神像从挪弗灭绝。 必不再有君王从埃及地而出； 我也必使惧怕临到埃及地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主耶和华这样说： "‘我必毁灭偶像， 使虚无的神像从挪弗灭绝。 必不再有君王从埃及地而出； 我也必使惧怕临到埃及地。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华如此说： 我必毁灭偶像， 从挪弗除灭神像； 必不再有君王出自埃及地。 我要使埃及地的人惧怕。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: " ‘I will destroy the idols and put an end to the images in Memphis. No longer will there be a prince in Egypt, and I will spread fear throughout the land.
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord God : "I will destroy the idols and put an end to the images in Memphis; there shall no longer be a prince from the land of Egypt; so I will put fear in the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Thus says the Lord God: "I will also destroy the idols, And cause the images to cease from Noph; There shall no longer be princes from the land of Egypt; I will put fear in the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I will smash the idols of Egypt and the images at Memphis. There will be no rulers left in Egypt; terror will sweep the land.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘This is what the Lord God says: "I will also destroy the idols And make the images cease from Memphis. And there will no longer be a prince in the land of Egypt; And I will put fear in the land of Egypt.
verses.textEn: " ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: " ‘I will destroy the idols and put an end to the images in Memphis. No longer will there be a prince in Egypt, and I will spread fear throughout the land.

verses.textZh: 我必使巴忒罗荒凉， 也必在琐安点起火来， 又向挪施行审判。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必使巴忒罗荒凉， 也必在琐安点起火来， 又向挪施行审判。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必使巴忒罗荒凉， 在琐安中使火着起， 向挪施行审判。
verses.textEnNiv: I will lay waste Upper Egypt, set fire to Zoan and inflict punishment on Thebes.
verses.textEnEsv: I will make Pathros a desolation and will set fire to Zoan and will execute judgments on Thebes.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will make Pathros desolate, Set fire to Zoan, And execute judgments in No.
verses.textEnNlt: I will destroy southern Egypt, set fire to Zoan, and bring judgment against Thebes.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will make Pathros desolate, Set a fire in Zoan And execute judgments on Thebes.
verses.textEn: I will lay waste Upper Egypt, set fire to Zoan and inflict punishment on Thebes.

verses.textZh: 我必把我的烈怒倒在训上， 就是埃及的保障， 并要剪除挪的众民。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必把我的烈怒倒在训上， 就是埃及的保障， 并要剪除挪的众民。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必将我的忿怒倒在埃及的保障上， 就是训上， 并要剪除挪的众人。
verses.textEnNiv: I will pour out my wrath on Pelusium, the stronghold of Egypt, and wipe out the hordes of Thebes.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will pour out my wrath on Pelusium, the stronghold of Egypt, and cut off the multitude of Thebes.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will pour My fury on Sin, the strength of Egypt; I will cut off the multitude of No,
verses.textEnNlt: I will pour out my fury on Pelusium, the strongest fortress of Egypt, and I will stamp out the hordes of Thebes.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will pour out My wrath on Sin, The stronghold of Egypt; I will also eliminate the hordes of Thebes.
verses.textEn: I will pour out my wrath on Pelusium, the stronghold of Egypt, and wipe out the hordes of Thebes.

verses.textZh: 我必在埃及点起火来； 训必有大痛苦； 挪必被攻破； 挪弗必终日受难。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必在埃及点起火来； 训必有大痛苦； 挪必被攻破； 挪弗必终日受难。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必在埃及中使火着起； 训必大大痛苦； 挪必被攻破； 挪弗白日 见仇敌。
verses.textEnNiv: I will set fire to Egypt; Pelusium will writhe in agony. Thebes will be taken by storm; Memphis will be in constant distress.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will set fire to Egypt; Pelusium shall be in great agony; Thebes shall be breached, and Memphis shall face enemies by day.
verses.textEnNkjv: And set a fire in Egypt; Sin shall have great pain, No shall be split open, And Noph shallbein distress daily.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, I will set fire to all Egypt! Pelusium will be racked with pain; Thebes will be torn apart; Memphis will live in constant terror.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will set a fire in Egypt; Sin will writhe in anguish, Thebes will be breached And Memphis will have distresses daily.
verses.textEn: I will set fire to Egypt; Pelusium will writhe in agony. Thebes will be taken by storm; Memphis will be in constant distress.

verses.textZh: 亚文和比伯实的年轻人 都必倒在刀下； 这些城的人必被掳去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚文和比伯实的年轻人 都必倒在刀下； 这些城的人必被掳去。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚文和比伯实的少年人必倒在刀下； 这些城的人必被掳掠。
verses.textEnNiv: The young men of Heliopolis and Bubastis will fall by the sword, and the cities themselves will go into captivity.
verses.textEnEsv: The young men of On and of Pi-beseth shall fall by the sword, and the women shall go into captivity.
verses.textEnNkjv: The young men of Aven and Pi Beseth shall fall by the sword, And these cities shall go into captivity.
verses.textEnNlt: The young men of Heliopolis and Bubastis will die in battle, and the women will be taken away as slaves.
verses.textEnNasb: "The young men of On and of Pi-beseth Will fall by the sword, And the women will go into captivity.
verses.textEn: The young men of Heliopolis and Bubastis will fall by the sword, and the cities themselves will go into captivity.

verses.textZh: 我在答比匿折断埃及众轭的时候， 白昼就必变为黑暗； 埃及所夸耀的势力必在其中止息； 这城必有密云遮盖， 城中的居民必被掳去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我在答比匿折断埃及众轭的时候， 白昼就必变为黑暗； 埃及所夸耀的势力必在其中止息； 这城必有密云遮盖， 城中的居民必被掳去。
verses.textZhCuv: 我在答比匿折断埃及的诸轭， 使她因势力而有的骄傲在其中止息。 那时，日光必退去； 至于这城，必有密云遮蔽， 其中的女子必被掳掠。
verses.textEnNiv: Dark will be the day at Tahpanhes when I break the yoke of Egypt; there her proud strength will come to an end. She will be covered with clouds, and her villages will go into captivity.
verses.textEnEsv: At Tehaphnehes the day shall be dark, when I break there the yoke bars of Egypt, and her proud might shall come to an end in her; she shall be covered by a cloud, and her daughters shall go into captivity.
verses.textEnNkjv: At Tehaphnehes the day shall also be darkened, When I break the yokes of Egypt there. And her arrogant strength shall cease in her; As for her, a cloud shall cover her, And her daughters shall go into captivity.
verses.textEnNlt: When I come to break the proud strength of Egypt, it will be a dark day for Tahpanhes, too. A dark cloud will cover Tahpanhes, and its daughters will be led away as captives.
verses.textEnNasb: "In Tehaphnehes the day will be dark When I break there the yoke bars of Egypt. Then the pride of her power will cease in her; A cloud will cover her, And her daughters will go into captivity.
verses.textEn: Dark will be the day at Tahpanhes when I break the yoke of Egypt; there her proud strength will come to an end. She will be covered with clouds, and her villages will go into captivity.

verses.textZh: 我必这样向埃及施行审判， 他们就知道我是耶和华。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必这样向埃及施行审判， 他们就知道我是耶和华。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 我必这样向埃及施行审判， 他们就知道我是耶和华。」
verses.textEnNiv: So I will inflict punishment on Egypt, and they will know that I am the Lord .’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Thus I will execute judgments on Egypt. Then they will know that I am the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus I will execute judgments on Egypt, Then they shall know that I am the Lord." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: And so I will greatly punish Egypt, and they will know that I am the Lord ."
verses.textEnNasb: "So I will execute judgments on Egypt, And they will know that I am the Lord." ’ "
verses.textEn: So I will inflict punishment on Egypt, and they will know that I am the Lord .’ "

verses.textZh: 十一年正月初七日，耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 十一年正月初七日，耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 十一年正月初七日，耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: In the eleventh year, in the first month on the seventh day, the word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: In the eleventh year, in the first month, on the seventh day of the month, the word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first month, on the seventh day of the month, that the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: On April 29, during the eleventh year of King Jehoiachin’s captivity, this message came to me from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: In the eleventh year, in the first month, on the seventh of the month, the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: In the eleventh year, in the first month on the seventh day, the word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: "人子啊！我折断了埃及王法老的膀臂；看哪！没有人把它包扎治疗，没有人用绷带把它缠裹，好让它有力量拿起刀来。
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！我折断了埃及王法老的膀臂；看哪！没有人把它包扎治疗，没有人用绷带把它缠裹，好让它有力量拿起刀来。
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，我已打折埃及王法老的膀臂；没有敷药，也没有用布缠好，使他有力持刀。
verses.textEnNiv: "Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt. It has not been bound up to be healed or put in a splint so that it may become strong enough to hold a sword.
verses.textEnEsv: "Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and behold, it has not been bound up, to heal it by binding it with a bandage, so that it may become strong to wield the sword.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and see, it has not been bandaged for healing, nor a splint put on to bind it, to make it strong enough to hold a sword.
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh, the king of Egypt. His arm has not been put in a cast so that it may heal. Neither has it been bound up with a splint to make it strong enough to hold a sword.
verses.textEnNasb: "Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and, behold, it has not been bound up for healing or wrapped with a bandage, so that it may be strong to wield the sword.
verses.textEn: "Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt. It has not been bound up to be healed or put in a splint so that it may become strong enough to hold a sword.

verses.textZh: 因此，主耶和华这样说：‘看哪！我与埃及王法老为敌；我必打断他有力的膀臂，和已经折了的膀臂，使刀从他的手中掉下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，主耶和华这样说：‘看哪！我与埃及王法老为敌；我必打断他有力的膀臂，和已经折了的膀臂，使刀从他的手中掉下。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以主耶和华如此说：看哪，我与埃及王法老为敌，必将他有力的膀臂和已打折的膀臂全行打断，使刀从他手中坠落。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt. I will break both his arms, the good arm as well as the broken one, and make the sword fall from his hand.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore thus says the Lord God : Behold, I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt and will break his arms, both the strong arm and the one that was broken, and I will make the sword fall from his hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore thus says the Lord God: ‘Surely I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and will break his arms, both the strong one and the one that was broken; and I will make the sword fall out of his hand.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I am the enemy of Pharaoh, the king of Egypt! I will break both of his arms—the good arm along with the broken one—and I will make his sword clatter to the ground.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore this is what the Lord God says: ‘Behold, I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and I will break his arms, both the strong and the broken; and I will make the sword fall from his hand.
verses.textEn: Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt. I will break both his arms, the good arm as well as the broken one, and make the sword fall from his hand.

verses.textZh: 我必把埃及人分散到列邦，四散在各地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必把埃及人分散到列邦，四散在各地。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必将埃及人分散在列国，四散在列邦。
verses.textEnNiv: I will disperse the Egyptians among the nations and scatter them through the countries.
verses.textEnEsv: I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations and disperse them through the countries.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and disperse them throughout the countries.
verses.textEnNlt: I will scatter the Egyptians to many lands throughout the world.
verses.textEnNasb: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations and disperse them among the lands.
verses.textEn: I will disperse the Egyptians among the nations and scatter them through the countries.

verses.textZh: "‘我必使巴比伦王的膀臂有力量，把我的刀交在他手中；我要折断法老的膀臂，使他在巴比伦王面前呻吟，像一个受伤快死的人一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘我必使巴比伦王的膀臂有力量，把我的刀交在他手中；我要折断法老的膀臂，使他在巴比伦王面前呻吟，像一个受伤快死的人一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必使巴比伦王的膀臂有力，将我的刀交在他手中；却要打断法老的膀臂，他就在巴比伦王面前唉哼，如同受死伤的人一样。
verses.textEnNiv: I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon and put my sword in his hand, but I will break the arms of Pharaoh, and he will groan before him like a mortally wounded man.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon and put my sword in his hand, but I will break the arms of Pharaoh, and he will groan before him like a man mortally wounded.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon and put My sword in his hand; but I will break Pharaoh’s arms, and he will groan before him with the groanings of a mortally wounded man.
verses.textEnNlt: I will strengthen the arms of Babylon’s king and put my sword in his hand. But I will break the arms of Pharaoh, king of Egypt, and he will lie there mortally wounded, groaning in pain.
verses.textEnNasb: For I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon and put My sword in his hand; and I will break the arms of Pharaoh, so that he will groan before him with the groans of a wounded man.
verses.textEn: I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon and put my sword in his hand, but I will break the arms of Pharaoh, and he will groan before him like a mortally wounded man.

verses.textZh: 我必使巴比伦王的膀臂有力量，法老的膀臂却要下垂。我把我的刀交在巴比伦王手里，使他举刀攻击埃及地的时候，他们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必使巴比伦王的膀臂有力量，法老的膀臂却要下垂。我把我的刀交在巴比伦王手里，使他举刀攻击埃及地的时候，他们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必扶持巴比伦王的膀臂，法老的膀臂却要下垂；我将我的刀交在巴比伦王手中，他必举刀攻击埃及地，他们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, but the arms of Pharaoh will fall limp. Then they will know that I am the Lord , when I put my sword into the hand of the king of Babylon and he brandishes it against Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, but the arms of Pharaoh shall fall. Then they shall know that I am the Lord , when I put my sword into the hand of the king of Babylon and he stretches it out against the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, but the arms of Pharaoh shall fall down; they shall know that I am the Lord, when I put My sword into the hand of the king of Babylon and he stretches it out against the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, while the arms of Pharaoh fall useless to his sides. And when I put my sword in the hand of Babylon’s king and he brings it against the land of Egypt, Egypt will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: So I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, but the arms of Pharaoh will fail. Then they will know that I am the Lord, when I put My sword into the hand of the king of Babylon and he reaches out with it against the land of Egypt.
verses.textEn: I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, but the arms of Pharaoh will fall limp. Then they will know that I am the Lord , when I put my sword into the hand of the king of Babylon and he brandishes it against Egypt.

verses.textZh: 我必把埃及人分散到列邦，四散在各地；他们就知道我是耶和华。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必把埃及人分散到列邦，四散在各地；他们就知道我是耶和华。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 我必将埃及人分散在列国，四散在列邦；他们就知道我是耶和华。」
verses.textEnNiv: I will disperse the Egyptians among the nations and scatter them through the countries. Then they will know that I am the Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations and disperse them throughout the countries. Then they will know that I am the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations and disperse them throughout the countries. Then they shall know that I am the Lord.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, dispersing them throughout the earth. Then they will know that I am the Lord ."
verses.textEnNasb: When I scatter the Egyptians among the nations and disperse them among the lands, then they will know that I am the Lord.’ "
verses.textEn: I will disperse the Egyptians among the nations and scatter them through the countries. Then they will know that I am the Lord ."

verses.textZh: 十一年三月初一日，耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 十一年三月初一日，耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 十一年三月初一日，耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: In the eleventh year, in the third month on the first day, the word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: In the eleventh year, in the third month, on the first day of the month, the word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the third month, on the first day of the month, that the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: On June 21, during the eleventh year of King Jehoiachin’s captivity, this message came to me from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: In the eleventh year, in the third month, on the first of the month, the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: In the eleventh year, in the third month on the first day, the word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: "人子啊！你要对埃及王法老和他的众民说： ‘论到你的伟大，谁能与你相比呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！你要对埃及王法老和他的众民说： ‘论到你的伟大，谁能与你相比呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，你要向埃及王法老和他的众人说： 在威势上谁能与你相比呢？
verses.textEnNiv: "Son of man, say to Pharaoh king of Egypt and to his hordes: " ‘Who can be compared with you in majesty?
verses.textEnEsv: "Son of man, say to Pharaoh king of Egypt and to his multitude: "Whom are you like in your greatness?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Son of man, say to Pharaoh king of Egypt and to his multitude: ‘Whom are you like in your greatness?
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, give this message to Pharaoh, king of Egypt, and all his hordes: "To whom would you compare your greatness?
verses.textEnNasb: "Son of man, say to Pharaoh king of Egypt and to his hordes, ‘Whom are you like in your greatness?
verses.textEn: "Son of man, say to Pharaoh king of Egypt and to his hordes: " ‘Who can be compared with you in majesty?

verses.textZh: 看哪！亚述曾是黎巴嫩的香柏树， 枝条秀美，林影茂密， 树身高大， 树顶在茂密的枝叶之上。
