verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！亚述曾是黎巴嫩的香柏树， 枝条秀美，林影茂密， 树身高大， 树顶在茂密的枝叶之上。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚述王曾如黎巴嫩中的香柏树， 枝条荣美，影密如林， 极其高大，树尖插入云中。
verses.textEnNiv: Consider Assyria, once a cedar in Lebanon, with beautiful branches overshadowing the forest; it towered on high, its top above the thick foliage.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, Assyria was a cedar in Lebanon, with beautiful branches and forest shade, and of towering height, its top among the clouds.
verses.textEnNkjv: Indeed Assyria was a cedar in Lebanon, With fine branches that shaded the forest, And of high stature; And its top was among the thick boughs.
verses.textEnNlt: You are like mighty Assyria, which was once like a cedar of Lebanon, with beautiful branches that cast deep forest shade and with its top high among the clouds.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Behold, Assyria was a cedar in Lebanon With beautiful branches and forest shade, And very high, And its top was among the clouds.
verses.textEn: Consider Assyria, once a cedar in Lebanon, with beautiful branches overshadowing the forest; it towered on high, its top above the thick foliage.

verses.textZh: 众水使它长大，深渊使它长高； 有江河从深渊流出环绕它栽种之地， 又有支流延到田间的众树。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众水使它长大，深渊使它长高； 有江河从深渊流出环绕它栽种之地， 又有支流延到田间的众树。
verses.textZhCuv: 众水使它生长； 深水使它长大。 所栽之地有江河围流， 汊出的水道延到田野诸树。
verses.textEnNiv: The waters nourished it, deep springs made it grow tall; their streams flowed all around its base and sent their channels to all the trees of the field.
verses.textEnEsv: The waters nourished it; the deep made it grow tall, making its rivers flow around the place of its planting, sending forth its streams to all the trees of the field.
verses.textEnNkjv: The waters made it grow; Underground waters gave it height, With their rivers running around the place where it was planted, And sent out rivulets to all the trees of the field.
verses.textEnNlt: Deep springs watered it and helped it to grow tall and luxuriant. The water flowed around it like a river, streaming to all the trees nearby.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘The waters made it grow, the deep made it high. With its rivers it continually extended all around its planting place, And sent out its channels to all the trees of the field.
verses.textEn: The waters nourished it, deep springs made it grow tall; their streams flowed all around its base and sent their channels to all the trees of the field.

verses.textZh: 因此，它树身高大，高过田间的众树； 它发旺生长的时候，因为水源丰足， 所以枝子繁多，枝条长长。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，它树身高大，高过田间的众树； 它发旺生长的时候，因为水源丰足， 所以枝子繁多，枝条长长。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以它高大超过田野诸树； 发旺的时候，枝子繁多， 因得大水之力枝条长长。
verses.textEnNiv: So it towered higher than all the trees of the field; its boughs increased and its branches grew long, spreading because of abundant waters.
verses.textEnEsv: So it towered high above all the trees of the field; its boughs grew large and its branches long from abundant water in its shoots.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Therefore its height was exalted above all the trees of the field; Its boughs were multiplied, And its branches became long because of the abundance of water, As it sent them out.
verses.textEnNlt: This great tree towered high, higher than all the other trees around it. It prospered and grew long thick branches because of all the water at its roots.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Therefore its height was loftier than all the trees of the field And its boughs became many and its branches long Because of many waters as it spread them out.
verses.textEn: So it towered higher than all the trees of the field; its boughs increased and its branches grew long, spreading because of abundant waters.

verses.textZh: 空中的飞鸟都在枝上搭窝； 田野的走兽都在枝条下生产； 所有大国都在它的树荫下居住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 空中的飞鸟都在枝上搭窝； 田野的走兽都在枝条下生产； 所有大国都在它的树荫下居住。
verses.textZhCuv: 空中的飞鸟都在枝子上搭窝； 田野的走兽都在枝条下生子； 所有大国的人民都在它荫下居住。
verses.textEnNiv: All the birds of the sky nested in its boughs, all the animals of the wild gave birth under its branches; all the great nations lived in its shade.
verses.textEnEsv: All the birds of the heavens made their nests in its boughs; under its branches all the beasts of the field gave birth to their young, and under its shadow lived all great nations.
verses.textEnNkjv: All the birds of the heavens made their nests in its boughs; Under its branches all the beasts of the field brought forth their young; And in its shadow all great nations made their home.
verses.textEnNlt: The birds nested in its branches, and in its shade all the wild animals gave birth. All the great nations of the world lived in its shadow.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘All the birds of the sky nested in its twigs, And under its branches all the animals of the field gave birth, And all great nations lived under its shade.
verses.textEn: All the birds of the sky nested in its boughs, all the animals of the wild gave birth under its branches; all the great nations lived in its shade.

verses.textZh: 它树身高大，枝条长长而显得秀美， 因为它的根扎在水多的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 它树身高大，枝条长长而显得秀美， 因为它的根扎在水多的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 树大条长，成为荣美， 因为根在众水之旁。
verses.textEnNiv: It was majestic in beauty, with its spreading boughs, for its roots went down to abundant waters.
verses.textEnEsv: It was beautiful in its greatness, in the length of its branches; for its roots went down to abundant waters.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Thus it was beautiful in greatness and in the length of its branches, Because its roots reached to abundant waters.
verses.textEnNlt: It was strong and beautiful, with wide-spreading branches, for its roots went deep into abundant water.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘So it was beautiful in its greatness, in the length of its branches; For its roots extended to many waters.
verses.textEn: It was majestic in beauty, with its spreading boughs, for its roots went down to abundant waters.

verses.textZh: 神园中的香柏树不能与它相比， 松树比不上它的枝子； 枫树也不及它的枝条；神园中所有的树木都比不上它的秀美。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神园中的香柏树不能与它相比， 松树比不上它的枝子； 枫树也不及它的枝条；神园中所有的树木都比不上它的秀美。
verses.textZhCuv: 神园中的香柏树不能遮蔽它； 松树不及它的枝子； 枫树不及它的枝条；神园中的树都没有它荣美。
verses.textEnNiv: The cedars in the garden of God could not rival it, nor could the junipers equal its boughs, nor could the plane trees compare with its branches— no tree in the garden of God could match its beauty.
verses.textEnEsv: The cedars in the garden of God could not rival it, nor the fir trees equal its boughs; neither were the plane trees like its branches; no tree in the garden of God was its equal in beauty.
verses.textEnNkjv: The cedars in the garden of God could not hide it; The fir trees were not like its boughs, And the chestnut trees were not like its branches; No tree in the garden of God was like it in beauty.
verses.textEnNlt: No other cedar in the garden of God could rival it. No cypress had branches to equal it; no plane tree had boughs to compare. No tree in the garden of God came close to it in beauty.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘The cedars in God’s garden could not match it; The junipers could not compare with its branches, And the plane trees could not match its branches. No tree in God’s garden could compare with it in its beauty.
verses.textEn: The cedars in the garden of God could not rival it, nor could the junipers equal its boughs, nor could the plane trees compare with its branches— no tree in the garden of God could match its beauty.

verses.textZh: 我使它因枝条繁多而显得秀美， 以致在神的园中，伊甸所有的树木都嫉妒它。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我使它因枝条繁多而显得秀美， 以致在神的园中，伊甸所有的树木都嫉妒它。
verses.textZhCuv: 我使它的枝条蕃多，成为荣美， 以致神伊甸园中的树都嫉妒它。」
verses.textEnNiv: I made it beautiful with abundant branches, the envy of all the trees of Eden in the garden of God.
verses.textEnEsv: I made it beautiful in the mass of its branches, and all the trees of Eden envied it, that were in the garden of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: I made it beautiful with a multitude of branches, So that all the trees of Eden envied it, That were in the garden of God.’
verses.textEnNlt: Because I made this tree so beautiful, and gave it such magnificent foliage, it was the envy of all the other trees of Eden, the garden of God.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘I made it beautiful with the multitude of its branches, And all the trees of Eden, which were in the garden of God, were jealous of it.
verses.textEn: I made it beautiful with abundant branches, the envy of all the trees of Eden in the garden of God.

verses.textZh: "‘因此，主耶和华这样说：因为它树身高大，树顶在茂密的枝叶之上，又因它高大而心骄气傲，
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘因此，主耶和华这样说：因为它树身高大，树顶在茂密的枝叶之上，又因它高大而心骄气傲，
verses.textZhCuv: 所以主耶和华如此说：「因它高大，树尖插入云中，心骄气傲，
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: Because the great cedar towered over the thick foliage, and because it was proud of its height,
verses.textEnEsv: "Therefore thus says the Lord God : Because it towered high and set its top among the clouds, and its heart was proud of its height,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore thus says the Lord God: ‘Because you have increased in height, and it set its top among the thick boughs, and its heart was lifted up in its height,
verses.textEnNlt: "Therefore, this is what the Sovereign Lord says: Because Egypt became proud and arrogant, and because it set itself so high above the others, with its top reaching to the clouds,
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Therefore this is what the Lord God says: "Because it is tall in stature and has put its top among the clouds, and its heart is haughty in its loftiness,
verses.textEn: " ‘Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: Because the great cedar towered over the thick foliage, and because it was proud of its height,

verses.textZh: 我就把它交在列国中为首的人手中，他必定对付它；因着它的罪恶，我就把它驱逐出去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我就把它交在列国中为首的人手中，他必定对付它；因着它的罪恶，我就把它驱逐出去。
verses.textZhCuv: 我就必将它交给列国中大有威势的人；他必定办它。我因它的罪恶，已经驱逐它。
verses.textEnNiv: I gave it into the hands of the ruler of the nations, for him to deal with according to its wickedness. I cast it aside,
verses.textEnEsv: I will give it into the hand of a mighty one of the nations. He shall surely deal with it as its wickedness deserves. I have cast it out.
verses.textEnNkjv: therefore I will deliver it into the hand of the mighty one of the nations, and he shall surely deal with it; I have driven it out for its wickedness.
verses.textEnNlt: I will hand it over to a mighty nation that will destroy it as its wickedness deserves. I have already discarded it.
verses.textEnNasb: I will hand it over to a ruler of the nations; he will thoroughly deal with it. In accordance with its wickedness I have driven it out.
verses.textEn: I gave it into the hands of the ruler of the nations, for him to deal with according to its wickedness. I cast it aside,

verses.textZh: 必有外族人，就是列国中最强暴的，把它砍下丢弃。它的枝叶落在山上和所有的谷中；它的枝子折断，落在地上所有的水沟里；地上的万族都必走离它的荫下，把它丢弃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 必有外族人，就是列国中最强暴的，把它砍下丢弃。它的枝叶落在山上和所有的谷中；它的枝子折断，落在地上所有的水沟里；地上的万族都必走离它的荫下，把它丢弃。
verses.textZhCuv: 外邦人，就是列邦中强暴的，将它砍断弃掉。它的枝条落在山间和一切谷中，它的枝子折断，落在地的一切河旁。地上的众民已经走去，离开它的荫下。
verses.textEnNiv: and the most ruthless of foreign nations cut it down and left it. Its boughs fell on the mountains and in all the valleys; its branches lay broken in all the ravines of the land. All the nations of the earth came out from under its shade and left it.
verses.textEnEsv: Foreigners, the most ruthless of nations, have cut it down and left it. On the mountains and in all the valleys its branches have fallen, and its boughs have been broken in all the ravines of the land, and all the peoples of the earth have gone away from its shadow and left it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And aliens, the most terrible of the nations, have cut it down and left it; its branches have fallen on the mountains and in all the valleys; its boughs lie broken by all the rivers of the land; and all the peoples of the earth have gone from under its shadow and left it.
verses.textEnNlt: A foreign army—the terror of the nations—has cut it down and left it fallen on the ground. Its branches are scattered across the mountains and valleys and ravines of the land. All those who lived in its shadow have gone away and left it lying there.
verses.textEnNasb: Foreign tyrants of the nations have cut it down and left it; on the mountains and in all the valleys its branches have fallen, and its branches have been broken in all the ravines of the land. And all the peoples of the earth have gone down from its shade and left it.
verses.textEn: and the most ruthless of foreign nations cut it down and left it. Its boughs fell on the mountains and in all the valleys; its branches lay broken in all the ravines of the land. All the nations of the earth came out from under its shade and left it.

verses.textZh: 空中的飞鸟都住在倒下的树身上，田野的走兽都卧在它的枝条间。
verses.textZhCnvs: 空中的飞鸟都住在倒下的树身上，田野的走兽都卧在它的枝条间。
verses.textZhCuv: 空中的飞鸟都要宿在这败落的树上，田野的走兽都要卧在它的枝条下，
verses.textEnNiv: All the birds settled on the fallen tree, and all the wild animals lived among its branches.
verses.textEnEsv: On its fallen trunk dwell all the birds of the heavens, and on its branches are all the beasts of the field.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘On its ruin will remain all the birds of the heavens, And all the beasts of the field will come to its branches—
verses.textEnNlt: "The birds roost on its fallen trunk, and the wild animals lie among its branches.
verses.textEnNasb: All the birds of the sky will nest on its fallen trunk, and all the animals of the field will rest on its fallen branches,
verses.textEn: All the birds settled on the fallen tree, and all the wild animals lived among its branches.

verses.textZh: 好使水旁所有的树木都不会因树身高大而自高，也不会使树顶长到茂密的枝叶上，又使一切有水滋润的树都不会高傲地屹立；因为他们在世人中，与那些下到阴府的人一起，都交与死亡、交与地的深处了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 好使水旁所有的树木都不会因树身高大而自高，也不会使树顶长到茂密的枝叶上，又使一切有水滋润的树都不会高傲地屹立；因为他们在世人中，与那些下到阴府的人一起，都交与死亡、交与地的深处了。
verses.textZhCuv: 好使水旁的诸树不因高大而自尊，也不将树尖插入云中，并且那些得水滋润、有势力的，也不得高大自立。因为它们在世人中，和下坑的人都被交与死亡，到阴府去了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore no other trees by the waters are ever to tower proudly on high, lifting their tops above the thick foliage. No other trees so well-watered are ever to reach such a height; they are all destined for death, for the earth below, among mortals who go down to the realm of the dead.
verses.textEnEsv: All this is in order that no trees by the waters may grow to towering height or set their tops among the clouds, and that no trees that drink water may reach up to them in height. For they are all given over to death, to the world below, among the children of man, with those who go down to the pit.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘So that no trees by the waters may ever again exalt themselves for their height, nor set their tops among the thick boughs, that no tree which drinks water may ever be high enough to reach up to them. ‘For they have all been delivered to death, To the depths of the earth, Among the children of men who go down to the Pit.’
verses.textEnNlt: Let the tree of no other nation proudly exult in its own prosperity, though it be higher than the clouds and it be watered from the depths. For all are doomed to die, to go down to the depths of the earth. They will land in the pit along with everyone else on earth.
verses.textEnNasb: so that all the trees by the waters will not be exalted in their stature, nor put their tops among the clouds, nor will any of their well-watered mighty ones stand straight in their height. For they have all been turned over to death, to the earth beneath, among mankind, with those who go down to the pit."
verses.textEn: Therefore no other trees by the waters are ever to tower proudly on high, lifting their tops above the thick foliage. No other trees so well-watered are ever to reach such a height; they are all destined for death, for the earth below, among mortals who go down to the realm of the dead.

verses.textZh: "‘主耶和华这样说：它下阴间的日子，我就因它以悲哀遮盖深渊，阻塞深渊的江河，使大水停流；我要使黎巴嫩为它悲伤、田野所有的树木都因它枯干。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘主耶和华这样说：它下阴间的日子，我就因它以悲哀遮盖深渊，阻塞深渊的江河，使大水停流；我要使黎巴嫩为它悲伤、田野所有的树木都因它枯干。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华如此说：「它下阴间的那日，我便使人悲哀。我为它遮盖深渊，使江河凝结，大水停流；我也使黎巴嫩为它凄惨，田野的诸树都因它发昏。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: On the day it was brought down to the realm of the dead I covered the deep springs with mourning for it; I held back its streams, and its abundant waters were restrained. Because of it I clothed Lebanon with gloom, and all the trees of the field withered away.
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord God : On the day the cedar went down to Sheol I caused mourning; I closed the deep over it, and restrained its rivers, and many waters were stopped. I clothed Lebanon in gloom for it, and all the trees of the field fainted because of it.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus says the Lord God: ‘In the day when it went down to hell, I caused mourning. I covered the deep because of it. I restrained its rivers, and the great waters were held back. I caused Lebanon to mourn for it, and all the trees of the field wilted because of it.
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Sovereign Lord says: When Assyria went down to the grave, I made the deep springs mourn. I stopped its rivers and dried up its abundant water. I clothed Lebanon in black and caused the trees of the field to wilt.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘This is what the Lord God says: "On the day when it went down to Sheol I caused mourning; I closed the deep over it and held back its rivers. And its many waters were stopped up, and I made Lebanon mourn for it, and all the trees of the field wilted away on account of it.
verses.textEn: " ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: On the day it was brought down to the realm of the dead I covered the deep springs with mourning for it; I held back its streams, and its abundant waters were restrained. Because of it I clothed Lebanon with gloom, and all the trees of the field withered away.

verses.textZh: 我把它扔下阴间，与那些下到阴府的人一起的时候，我就使列国因它坠落的响声而震惊。伊甸所有的树木，就是黎巴嫩有水滋润、最佳最美的树，都在地的深处得到安慰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我把它扔下阴间，与那些下到阴府的人一起的时候，我就使列国因它坠落的响声而震惊。伊甸所有的树木，就是黎巴嫩有水滋润、最佳最美的树，都在地的深处得到安慰。
verses.textZhCuv: 我将它扔到阴间，与下坑的人一同下去。那时，列国听见它坠落的响声就都震动，并且伊甸的一切树－就是黎巴嫩得水滋润、最佳最美的树－都在阴府受了安慰。
verses.textEnNiv: I made the nations tremble at the sound of its fall when I brought it down to the realm of the dead to be with those who go down to the pit. Then all the trees of Eden, the choicest and best of Lebanon, the well-watered trees, were consoled in the earth below.
verses.textEnEsv: I made the nations quake at the sound of its fall, when I cast it down to Sheol with those who go down to the pit. And all the trees of Eden, the choice and best of Lebanon, all that drink water, were comforted in the world below.
verses.textEnNkjv: I made the nations shake at the sound of its fall, when I cast it down to hell together with those who descend into the Pit; and all the trees of Eden, the choice and best of Lebanon, all that drink water, were comforted in the depths of the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: I made the nations shake with fear at the sound of its fall, for I sent it down to the grave with all the others who descend to the pit. And all the other proud trees of Eden, the most beautiful and the best of Lebanon, the ones whose roots went deep into the water, took comfort to find it there with them in the depths of the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: I made the nations quake from the sound of its fall when I made it go down to Sheol with those who go down to the pit; and all the well-watered trees of Eden, the choicest and best of Lebanon, were comforted in the earth beneath.
verses.textEn: I made the nations tremble at the sound of its fall when I brought it down to the realm of the dead to be with those who go down to the pit. Then all the trees of Eden, the choicest and best of Lebanon, the well-watered trees, were consoled in the earth below.

verses.textZh: 这些树与它一同下到阴间，往那些被刀剑所杀的人那里去。他们作过它的膀臂，曾在列国中住在它的荫下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些树与它一同下到阴间，往那些被刀剑所杀的人那里去。他们作过它的膀臂，曾在列国中住在它的荫下。
verses.textZhCuv: 它们也与它同下阴间，到被杀的人那里。它们曾作它的膀臂，在列国中它的荫下居住。
verses.textEnNiv: They too, like the great cedar, had gone down to the realm of the dead, to those killed by the sword, along with the armed men who lived in its shade among the nations.
verses.textEnEsv: They also went down to Sheol with it, to those who are slain by the sword; yes, those who were its arm, who lived under its shadow among the nations.
verses.textEnNkjv: They also went down to hell with it, with those slain by the sword; and thosewhowere its strong arm dwelt in its shadows among the nations.
verses.textEnNlt: Its allies, too, were all destroyed and had passed away. They had gone down to the grave—all those nations that had lived in its shade.
verses.textEnNasb: They also went down with it to Sheol to those who were slain by the sword; and those who were its strength lived in its shade among the nations.
verses.textEn: They too, like the great cedar, had gone down to the realm of the dead, to those killed by the sword, along with the armed men who lived in its shade among the nations.

verses.textZh: 在伊甸所有的树木中，有谁的荣美和高大能与你相比呢？然而你却要与伊甸的树木一同下到地的深处。你要在没有受割礼的人中，与被刀剑所杀的人一同躺卧。这树就是法老和他的众民。这是主耶和华说的。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 在伊甸所有的树木中，有谁的荣美和高大能与你相比呢？然而你却要与伊甸的树木一同下到地的深处。你要在没有受割礼的人中，与被刀剑所杀的人一同躺卧。这树就是法老和他的众民。这是主耶和华说的。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 在这样荣耀威势上，在伊甸园诸树中，谁能与你相比呢？然而你要与伊甸的诸树一同下到阴府，在未受割礼的人中，与被杀的人一同躺卧。 「法老和他的群众乃是如此。这是主耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Which of the trees of Eden can be compared with you in splendor and majesty? Yet you, too, will be brought down with the trees of Eden to the earth below; you will lie among the uncircumcised, with those killed by the sword. " ‘This is Pharaoh and all his hordes, declares the Sovereign Lord .’ "
verses.textEnEsv: "Whom are you thus like in glory and in greatness among the trees of Eden? You shall be brought down with the trees of Eden to the world below. You shall lie among the uncircumcised, with those who are slain by the sword. "This is Pharaoh and all his multitude, declares the Lord God ."
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘To which of the trees in Eden will you then be likened in glory and greatness? Yet you shall be brought down with the trees of Eden to the depths of the earth; you shall lie in the midst of the uncircumcised, with those slain by the sword. This is Pharaoh and all his multitude,’ says the Lord God."
verses.textEnNlt: "O Egypt, to which of the trees of Eden will you compare your strength and glory? You, too, will be brought down to the depths with all these other nations. You will lie there among the outcasts who have died by the sword. This will be the fate of Pharaoh and all his hordes. I, the Sovereign Lord , have spoken!"
verses.textEnNasb: "To which among the trees of Eden are you so alike in glory and greatness? Yet you will be brought down with the trees of Eden to the earth beneath; you will lie in the midst of the uncircumcised with those who were killed by the sword. This is Pharaoh and all his hordes!" ’ declares the Lord God."
verses.textEn: " ‘Which of the trees of Eden can be compared with you in splendor and majesty? Yet you, too, will be brought down with the trees of Eden to the earth below; you will lie among the uncircumcised, with those killed by the sword. " ‘This is Pharaoh and all his hordes, declares the Sovereign Lord .’ "

verses.textZh: 十二年十二月初一日，耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 十二年十二月初一日，耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 十二年十二月初一日，耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: In the twelfth year, in the twelfth month on the first day, the word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: In the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, on the first day of the month, the word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass in the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, on the first day of the month, that the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: On March 3, during the twelfth year of King Jehoiachin’s captivity, this message came to me from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: In the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, on the first of the month, the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: In the twelfth year, in the twelfth month on the first day, the word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: "人子啊！你要为埃及王法老作一首哀歌，对他说： ‘你像列国中的少壮狮子， 又像海中的海怪， 你在河中翻腾， 用你的爪搅动河水， 使江河浑浊。
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！你要为埃及王法老作一首哀歌，对他说： ‘你像列国中的少壮狮子， 又像海中的海怪， 你在河中翻腾， 用你的爪搅动河水， 使江河浑浊。
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，你要为埃及王法老作哀歌，说： 从前你在列国中，如同少壮狮子； 现在你却像海中的大鱼。 你冲出江河， 用爪搅动诸水， 使江河浑浊。
verses.textEnNiv: "Son of man, take up a lament concerning Pharaoh king of Egypt and say to him: " ‘You are like a lion among the nations; you are like a monster in the seas thrashing about in your streams, churning the water with your feet and muddying the streams.
verses.textEnEsv: "Son of man, raise a lamentation over Pharaoh king of Egypt and say to him: "You consider yourself a lion of the nations, but you are like a dragon in the seas; you burst forth in your rivers, trouble the waters with your feet, and foul their rivers.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Son of man, take up a lamentation for Pharaoh king of Egypt, and say to him: ‘You are like a young lion among the nations, And you are like a monster in the seas, Bursting forth in your rivers, Troubling the waters with your feet, And fouling their rivers.
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, mourn for Pharaoh, king of Egypt, and give him this message: "You think of yourself as a strong young lion among the nations, but you are really just a sea monster, heaving around in your own rivers, stirring up mud with your feet.
verses.textEnNasb: "Son of man, take up a song of mourning over Pharaoh king of Egypt, and say to him, ‘You compared yourself to a young lion of the nations, Yet you are like the monster in the seas; And you burst forth in your rivers And muddied the waters with your feet And fouled their rivers.’ "
verses.textEn: "Son of man, take up a lament concerning Pharaoh king of Egypt and say to him: " ‘You are like a lion among the nations; you are like a monster in the seas thrashing about in your streams, churning the water with your feet and muddying the streams.

verses.textZh: 主耶和华这样说： 我必用多国的群众， 把我的网撒在你身上， 他们必用我的网把你拉上来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主耶和华这样说： 我必用多国的群众， 把我的网撒在你身上， 他们必用我的网把你拉上来。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华如此说： 我必用多国的人民， 将我的网撒在你身上， 把你拉上来。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: " ‘With a great throng of people I will cast my net over you, and they will haul you up in my net.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord God : I will throw my net over you with a host of many peoples, and they will haul you up in my dragnet.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Thus says the Lord God: "I will therefore spread My net over you with a company of many people, And they will draw you up in My net.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I will send many people to catch you in my net and haul you out of the water.
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord God says: "Now I will spread My net over you With a contingent of many peoples, And they will lift you up in My net.
verses.textEn: " ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: " ‘With a great throng of people I will cast my net over you, and they will haul you up in my net.

verses.textZh: 我必把你丢弃在地上， 拋掷在田野， 使空中的飞鸟都住在你身上， 使地上所有的野兽都吃你而得饱足。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必把你丢弃在地上， 拋掷在田野， 使空中的飞鸟都住在你身上， 使地上所有的野兽都吃你而得饱足。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必将你丢在地上， 抛在田野， 使空中的飞鸟都落在你身上， 使遍地的野兽吃你得饱。
verses.textEnNiv: I will throw you on the land and hurl you on the open field. I will let all the birds of the sky settle on you and all the animals of the wild gorge themselves on you.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will cast you on the ground; on the open field I will fling you, and will cause all the birds of the heavens to settle on you, and I will gorge the beasts of the whole earth with you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I will leave you on the land; I will cast you out on the open fields, And cause to settle on you all the birds of the heavens. And with you I will fill the beasts of the whole earth.
verses.textEnNlt: I will leave you stranded on the land to die. All the birds of the heavens will land on you, and the wild animals of the whole earth will gorge themselves on you.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will leave you on the land; I will hurl you on the open field. And I will cause all the birds of the sky to nest on you, And I will satisfy the animals of the whole earth with you.
verses.textEn: I will throw you on the land and hurl you on the open field. I will let all the birds of the sky settle on you and all the animals of the wild gorge themselves on you.

verses.textZh: 我必把你的肉丢在山上， 把你高大的尸体填满山谷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必把你的肉丢在山上， 把你高大的尸体填满山谷。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必将你的肉丢在山间， 用你高大的尸首填满山谷。
verses.textEnNiv: I will spread your flesh on the mountains and fill the valleys with your remains.
verses.textEnEsv: I will strew your flesh upon the mountains and fill the valleys with your carcass.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will lay your flesh on the mountains, And fill the valleys with your carcass.
verses.textEnNlt: I will scatter your flesh on the hills and fill the valleys with your bones.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will lay your flesh on the mountains And fill the valleys with your refuse.
verses.textEn: I will spread your flesh on the mountains and fill the valleys with your remains.

verses.textZh: 我必用你流出的血浇灌地面， 直到山上， 水沟都必充满你的血。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必用你流出的血浇灌地面， 直到山上， 水沟都必充满你的血。
verses.textZhCuv: 我又必用你的血浇灌你所游泳之地， 漫过山顶； 河道都必充满。
verses.textEnNiv: I will drench the land with your flowing blood all the way to the mountains, and the ravines will be filled with your flesh.
verses.textEnEsv: I will drench the land even to the mountains with your flowing blood, and the ravines will be full of you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I will also water the land with the flow of your blood, Even to the mountains; And the riverbeds will be full of you.
verses.textEnNlt: I will drench the earth with your gushing blood all the way to the mountains, filling the ravines to the brim.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will also make the land drink the discharge of your blood As far as the mountains, And the ravines will be full of you.
verses.textEn: I will drench the land with your flowing blood all the way to the mountains, and the ravines will be filled with your flesh.

verses.textZh: 我毁灭你的时候， 必把天遮蔽，使天上的星昏暗， 用密云遮盖太阳； 月亮也必不发光。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我毁灭你的时候， 必把天遮蔽，使天上的星昏暗， 用密云遮盖太阳； 月亮也必不发光。
verses.textZhCuv: 我将你扑灭的时候， 要把天遮蔽， 使众星昏暗， 以密云遮掩太阳， 月亮也不放光。
verses.textEnNiv: When I snuff you out, I will cover the heavens and darken their stars; I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon will not give its light.
verses.textEnEsv: When I blot you out, I will cover the heavens and make their stars dark; I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon shall not give its light.
verses.textEnNkjv: When I put out your light, I will cover the heavens, and make its stars dark; I will cover the sun with a cloud, And the moon shall not give her light.
verses.textEnNlt: When I blot you out, I will veil the heavens and darken the stars. I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon will not give you its light.
verses.textEnNasb: "And when I extinguish you, I will cover the heavens and darken their stars; I will cover the sun with a cloud And the moon will not give its light.
verses.textEn: When I snuff you out, I will cover the heavens and darken their stars; I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon will not give its light.

verses.textZh: 我必使天上所有的光体都在你以上变为昏暗； 我必使黑暗笼罩你的地； 这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必使天上所有的光体都在你以上变为昏暗； 我必使黑暗笼罩你的地； 这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必使天上的亮光都在你以上变为昏暗， 使你的地上黑暗。 这是主耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: All the shining lights in the heavens I will darken over you; I will bring darkness over your land, declares the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: All the bright lights of heaven will I make dark over you, and put darkness on your land, declares the Lord God .
verses.textEnNkjv: All the bright lights of the heavens I will make dark over you, And bring darkness upon your land," Says the Lord God.
verses.textEnNlt: I will darken the bright stars overhead and cover your land in darkness. I, the Sovereign Lord , have spoken!
verses.textEnNasb: "All the shining lights in the heavens I will darken over you And will set darkness on your land," Declares the Lord God.
verses.textEn: All the shining lights in the heavens I will darken over you; I will bring darkness over your land, declares the Sovereign Lord .

verses.textZh: 我使你在列国中灭亡的消息，传到你所不认识的列邦的时候，我必使万族的心感到不安。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我使你在列国中灭亡的消息，传到你所不认识的列邦的时候，我必使万族的心感到不安。
verses.textZhCuv: 「我使你败亡的风声传到你所不认识的各国。那时，我必使多民的心因你愁烦。
verses.textEnNiv: I will trouble the hearts of many peoples when I bring about your destruction among the nations, among lands you have not known.
verses.textEnEsv: "I will trouble the hearts of many peoples, when I bring your destruction among the nations, into the countries that you have not known.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘I will also trouble the hearts of many peoples, when I bring your destruction among the nations, into the countries which you have not known.
verses.textEnNlt: "I will disturb many hearts when I bring news of your downfall to distant nations you have never seen.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will also trouble the hearts of many peoples when I bring your destruction among the nations, into lands which you have not known.
verses.textEn: I will trouble the hearts of many peoples when I bring about your destruction among the nations, among lands you have not known.

verses.textZh: 我在他们面前向你挥动刀剑的时候，他们必因你惊骇，他们的君王也必因你非常恐慌；在你倾覆的日子，他们各人都必为自己的性命时刻战兢。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我在他们面前向你挥动刀剑的时候，他们必因你惊骇，他们的君王也必因你非常恐慌；在你倾覆的日子，他们各人都必为自己的性命时刻战兢。
verses.textZhCuv: 我在许多国民和君王面前向你抡我的刀，国民就必因你惊奇，君王也必因你极其恐慌。在你仆倒的日子，他们各人为自己的性命时刻战兢。」
verses.textEnNiv: I will cause many peoples to be appalled at you, and their kings will shudder with horror because of you when I brandish my sword before them. On the day of your downfall each of them will tremble every moment for his life.
verses.textEnEsv: I will make many peoples appalled at you, and the hair of their kings shall bristle with horror because of you, when I brandish my sword before them. They shall tremble every moment, every one for his own life, on the day of your downfall.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yes, I will make many peoples astonished at you, and their kings shall be horribly afraid of you when I brandish My sword before them; and they shall tremble every moment, every man for his own life, in the day of your fall.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, I will shock many lands, and their kings will be terrified at your fate. They will shudder in fear for their lives as I brandish my sword before them on the day of your fall.
verses.textEnNasb: And I will make many peoples appalled at you, and their kings will be horribly afraid of you when I brandish My sword before them; and they will tremble again and again, every person for his own life, on the day of your fall."
verses.textEn: I will cause many peoples to be appalled at you, and their kings will shudder with horror because of you when I brandish my sword before them. On the day of your downfall each of them will tremble every moment for his life.

verses.textZh: "‘主耶和华这样说：巴比伦王的刀必临到你。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘主耶和华这样说：巴比伦王的刀必临到你。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华如此说：「巴比伦王的刀必临到你。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘For this is what the Sovereign Lord says: " ‘The sword of the king of Babylon will come against you.
verses.textEnEsv: "For thus says the Lord God : The sword of the king of Babylon shall come upon you.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘For thus says the Lord God: "The sword of the king of Babylon shall come upon you.
verses.textEnNlt: For this is what the Sovereign Lord says: "The sword of the king of Babylon will come against you.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Lord God says this: "The sword of the king of Babylon will attack you.
verses.textEn: " ‘For this is what the Sovereign Lord says: " ‘The sword of the king of Babylon will come against you.

verses.textZh: 我必借着勇士的刀使你的众民倒下，这些勇士都是列国中最强横的人。他们必毁灭埃及所夸耀的；埃及的众民都必消灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必借着勇士的刀使你的众民倒下，这些勇士都是列国中最强横的人。他们必毁灭埃及所夸耀的；埃及的众民都必消灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必藉勇士的刀使你的众民仆倒；这勇士都是列国中强暴的。 他们必使埃及的骄傲归于无有； 埃及的众民必被灭绝。
verses.textEnNiv: I will cause your hordes to fall by the swords of mighty men— the most ruthless of all nations. They will shatter the pride of Egypt, and all her hordes will be overthrown.
verses.textEnEsv: I will cause your multitude to fall by the swords of mighty ones, all of them most ruthless of nations. "They shall bring to ruin the pride of Egypt, and all its multitude shall perish.
verses.textEnNkjv: By the swords of the mighty warriors, all of them the most terrible of the nations, I will cause your multitude to fall. "They shall plunder the pomp of Egypt, And all its multitude shall be destroyed.
verses.textEnNlt: I will destroy your hordes with the swords of mighty warriors— the terror of the nations. They will shatter the pride of Egypt, and all its hordes will be destroyed.
verses.textEnNasb: By the swords of the warriors I will make your multitude fall; all of them are tyrants of the nations, And they will devastate the pride of Egypt, And all its multitude will be destroyed.
verses.textEn: I will cause your hordes to fall by the swords of mighty men— the most ruthless of all nations. They will shatter the pride of Egypt, and all her hordes will be overthrown.

verses.textZh: 我必从众水的旁边，除灭埃及所有的牲畜；人的脚必不再搅浊这些水，牲畜的蹄也不这样作。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必从众水的旁边，除灭埃及所有的牲畜；人的脚必不再搅浊这些水，牲畜的蹄也不这样作。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必从埃及多水旁除灭所有的走兽； 人脚兽蹄必不再搅浑这水。
verses.textEnNiv: I will destroy all her cattle from beside abundant waters no longer to be stirred by the foot of man or muddied by the hooves of cattle.
verses.textEnEsv: I will destroy all its beasts from beside many waters; and no foot of man shall trouble them anymore, nor shall the hoofs of beasts trouble them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also I will destroy all its animals From beside its great waters; The foot of man shall muddy them no more, Nor shall the hooves of animals muddy them.
verses.textEnNlt: I will destroy all your flocks and herds that graze beside the streams. Never again will people or animals muddy those waters with their feet.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will also eliminate all its cattle from beside many waters; And a human foot will not muddy them anymore, And the hoofs of animals will not muddy them.
verses.textEn: I will destroy all her cattle from beside abundant waters no longer to be stirred by the foot of man or muddied by the hooves of cattle.

verses.textZh: 那时，我必使众水澄清，使江河的水像油一样缓流；这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，我必使众水澄清，使江河的水像油一样缓流；这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，我必使埃及河澄清， 江河像油缓流。 这是主耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: Then I will let her waters settle and make her streams flow like oil, declares the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Then I will make their waters clear, and cause their rivers to run like oil, declares the Lord God .
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I will make their waters clear, And make their rivers run like oil," Says the Lord God.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I will let the waters of Egypt become calm again, and they will flow as smoothly as olive oil, says the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "Then I will make their waters settle, And make their rivers run like oil," Declares the Lord God.
verses.textEn: Then I will let her waters settle and make her streams flow like oil, declares the Sovereign Lord .

verses.textZh: 我使埃及地荒凉，使这地失去它所充满的，又击杀其中所有的居民。那时，他们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我使埃及地荒凉，使这地失去它所充满的，又击杀其中所有的居民。那时，他们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 我使埃及地变为荒废凄凉； 这地缺少从前所充满的， 又击杀其中一切的居民。 那时，他们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: When I make Egypt desolate and strip the land of everything in it, when I strike down all who live there, then they will know that I am the Lord .’
verses.textEnEsv: When I make the land of Egypt desolate, and when the land is desolate of all that fills it, when I strike down all who dwell in it, then they will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: "When I make the land of Egypt desolate, And the country is destitute of all that once filled it, When I strike all who dwell in it, Then they shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: And when I destroy Egypt and strip you of everything you own and strike down all your people, then you will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "When I make the land of Egypt a desolation, And the land is destitute of that which filled it, When I strike all those who live in it, Then they shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.textEn: When I make Egypt desolate and strip the land of everything in it, when I strike down all who live there, then they will know that I am the Lord .’

verses.textZh: 这就是人为埃及所唱的哀歌，列国的女子必唱这哀歌；她们必为埃及和它的众民唱这哀歌。这是主耶和华的宣告。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这就是人为埃及所唱的哀歌，列国的女子必唱这哀歌；她们必为埃及和它的众民唱这哀歌。这是主耶和华的宣告。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 「人必用这哀歌去哀哭，列国的女子为埃及和她的群众也必以此悲哀。这是主耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: "This is the lament they will chant for her. The daughters of the nations will chant it; for Egypt and all her hordes they will chant it, declares the Sovereign Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: This is a lamentation that shall be chanted; the daughters of the nations shall chant it; over Egypt, and over all her multitude, shall they chant it, declares the Lord God ."
verses.textEnNkjv: "This is the lamentation With which they shall lament her; The daughters of the nations shall lament her; They shall lament for her, for Egypt, And for all her multitude," Says the Lord God.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, this is the funeral song they will sing for Egypt. Let all the nations mourn. Let them mourn for Egypt and its hordes. I, the Sovereign Lord , have spoken!"
verses.textEnNasb: This is a song of mourning, and they shall sing it. The daughters of the nations shall sing it. Over Egypt and over all her hordes they shall sing it," declares the Lord God.
verses.textEn: "This is the lament they will chant for her. The daughters of the nations will chant it; for Egypt and all her hordes they will chant it, declares the Sovereign Lord ."

verses.textZh: 十二年十二月十五日，耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 十二年十二月十五日，耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 十二年十二月十五日，耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: In the twelfth year, on the fifteenth day of the month, the word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: In the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, on the fifteenth day of the month, the word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnNkjv: It came to pass also in the twelfth year, on the fifteenth day of the month, that the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: On March 17, during the twelfth year, another message came to me from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: In the twelfth year, on the fifteenth of the month, the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: In the twelfth year, on the fifteenth day of the month, the word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: "人子啊！你要为埃及的众民哀号，要把埃及和强国的女子，与下坑的人一同送到地府那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！你要为埃及的众民哀号，要把埃及和强国的女子，与下坑的人一同送到地府那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，你要为埃及群众哀号，又要将埃及和有名之国的女子，并下坑的人，一同扔到阴府去。
verses.textEnNiv: "Son of man, wail for the hordes of Egypt and consign to the earth below both her and the daughters of mighty nations, along with those who go down to the pit.
verses.textEnEsv: "Son of man, wail over the multitude of Egypt, and send them down, her and the daughters of majestic nations, to the world below, to those who have gone down to the pit:
verses.textEnNkjv: "Son of man, wail over the multitude of Egypt, And cast them down to the depths of the earth, Her and the daughters of the famous nations, With those who go down to the Pit:
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, weep for the hordes of Egypt and for the other mighty nations. For I will send them down to the world below in company with those who descend to the pit.
verses.textEnNasb: "Son of man, lament for the hordes of Egypt and bring it down, her and the daughters of the mighty nations, to the netherworld, with those who go down to the pit;
verses.textEn: "Son of man, wail for the hordes of Egypt and consign to the earth below both her and the daughters of mighty nations, along with those who go down to the pit.

verses.textZh: 你要对埃及说： ‘你比谁更优越呢？ 你下去与那些没有受割礼的人一起长眠吧！’
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要对埃及说： ‘你比谁更优越呢？ 你下去与那些没有受割礼的人一起长眠吧！’
verses.textZhCuv: 你埃及的美丽胜过谁呢？ 你下去与未受割礼的人一同躺卧吧！
verses.textEnNiv: Say to them, ‘Are you more favored than others? Go down and be laid among the uncircumcised.’
verses.textEnEsv: ‘Whom do you surpass in beauty? Go down and be laid to rest with the uncircumcised.’
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Whom do you surpass in beauty? Go down, be placed with the uncircumcised.’
verses.textEnNlt: Say to them, ‘O Egypt, are you lovelier than the other nations? No! So go down to the pit and lie there among the outcasts. ’
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Whom do you surpass in beauty? Go down and make your bed with the uncircumcised.’
verses.textEn: Say to them, ‘Are you more favored than others? Go down and be laid among the uncircumcised.’

verses.textZh: 他们必倒在那些被刀所杀的人中间；刀既拔出，埃及和它的众民都要被拉下去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们必倒在那些被刀所杀的人中间；刀既拔出，埃及和它的众民都要被拉下去。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必在被杀的人中仆到。她被交给刀剑，要把她和她的群众拉去。
verses.textEnNiv: They will fall among those killed by the sword. The sword is drawn; let her be dragged off with all her hordes.
verses.textEnEsv: They shall fall amid those who are slain by the sword. Egypt is delivered to the sword; drag her away, and all her multitudes.
verses.textEnNkjv: "They shall fall in the midst of those slain by the sword; She is delivered to the sword, Drawing her and all her multitudes.
verses.textEnNlt: The Egyptians will fall with the many who have died by the sword, for the sword is drawn against them. Egypt and its hordes will be dragged away to their judgment.
verses.textEnNasb: They shall fall in the midst of those who are killed by the sword. She is turned over to the sword; they have dragged her and all her hordes away.
verses.textEn: They will fall among those killed by the sword. The sword is drawn; let her be dragged off with all her hordes.

verses.textZh: 勇士中最强的必在阴间论到埃及和帮助埃及的说：‘他们已经下来了，他们与没有受割礼的，就是被刀所杀的人，一起长眠。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 勇士中最强的必在阴间论到埃及和帮助埃及的说：‘他们已经下来了，他们与没有受割礼的，就是被刀所杀的人，一起长眠。’
verses.textZhCuv: 强盛的勇士要在阴间对埃及王和帮助他的说话；他们是未受割礼被杀的人，已经下去，躺卧不动。
verses.textEnNiv: From within the realm of the dead the mighty leaders will say of Egypt and her allies, ‘They have come down and they lie with the uncircumcised, with those killed by the sword.’
verses.textEnEsv: The mighty chiefs shall speak of them, with their helpers, out of the midst of Sheol: ‘They have come down, they lie still, the uncircumcised, slain by the sword.’
verses.textEnNkjv: The strong among the mighty Shall speak to him out of the midst of hell With those who help him: ‘They have gone down, They lie with the uncircumcised, slain by the sword.’
verses.textEnNlt: Down in the grave mighty leaders will mockingly welcome Egypt and its allies, saying, ‘They have come down; they lie among the outcasts, hordes slaughtered by the sword.’
verses.textEnNasb: The strong among the mighty ones shall speak of him and his helpers from the midst of Sheol: ‘They have gone down, they lie still, the uncircumcised, killed by the sword.’
verses.textEn: From within the realm of the dead the mighty leaders will say of Egypt and her allies, ‘They have come down and they lie with the uncircumcised, with those killed by the sword.’

verses.textZh: "亚述和它的军队都在那里；他们的坟墓在它周围；他们都是被杀死的，是倒在刀下的。
verses.textZhCnvs: "亚述和它的军队都在那里；他们的坟墓在它周围；他们都是被杀死的，是倒在刀下的。
verses.textZhCuv: 「亚述和她的众民都在那里，她民的坟墓在她四围；他们都是被杀倒在刀下的。
verses.textEnNiv: "Assyria is there with her whole army; she is surrounded by the graves of all her slain, all who have fallen by the sword.
verses.textEnEsv: "Assyria is there, and all her company, its graves all around it, all of them slain, fallen by the sword,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Assyria is there, and all her company, With their graves all around her, All of them slain, fallen by the sword.
verses.textEnNlt: "Assyria lies there surrounded by the graves of its army, those who were slaughtered by the sword.
verses.textEnNasb: "Assyria is there and all her company; her graves are all around her. All of them killed, fallen by the sword,
verses.textEn: "Assyria is there with her whole army; she is surrounded by the graves of all her slain, all who have fallen by the sword.

verses.textZh: 他们的坟墓是放在坑中极深之处，亚述的众军都在它坟墓的周围，全是被杀死的，是倒在刀下的；他们曾使惊恐散布在活人之地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的坟墓是放在坑中极深之处，亚述的众军都在它坟墓的周围，全是被杀死的，是倒在刀下的；他们曾使惊恐散布在活人之地。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的坟墓在坑中极深之处。她的众民在她坟墓的四围，都是被杀倒在刀下的；他们曾在活人之地使人惊恐。
verses.textEnNiv: Their graves are in the depths of the pit and her army lies around her grave. All who had spread terror in the land of the living are slain, fallen by the sword.
verses.textEnEsv: whose graves are set in the uttermost parts of the pit; and her company is all around her grave, all of them slain, fallen by the sword, who spread terror in the land of the living.
verses.textEnNkjv: Her graves are set in the recesses of the Pit, And her company is all around her grave, All of them slain, fallen by the sword, Who caused terror in the land of the living.
verses.textEnNlt: Their graves are in the depths of the pit, and they are surrounded by their allies. They struck terror in the hearts of people everywhere, but now they have been slaughtered by the sword.
verses.textEnNasb: whose graves are set in the remotest parts of the pit, and her company is all around her grave. All of them killed, fallen by the sword, who spread terror in the land of the living.
verses.textEn: Their graves are in the depths of the pit and her army lies around her grave. All who had spread terror in the land of the living are slain, fallen by the sword.

verses.textZh: "以拦也在那里，它的众民都在它坟墓的周围，全是被杀死的，是倒在刀下的；他们没有受割礼而下到地府去；他们曾使惊恐散布在活人之地，现在他们与下坑的人一同担当自己的羞辱。
verses.textZhCnvs: "以拦也在那里，它的众民都在它坟墓的周围，全是被杀死的，是倒在刀下的；他们没有受割礼而下到地府去；他们曾使惊恐散布在活人之地，现在他们与下坑的人一同担当自己的羞辱。
verses.textZhCuv: 「以拦也在那里，她的群众在她坟墓的四围，都是被杀倒在刀下、未受割礼而下阴府的；他们曾在活人之地使人惊恐，并且与下坑的人一同担当羞辱。
verses.textEnNiv: "Elam is there, with all her hordes around her grave. All of them are slain, fallen by the sword. All who had spread terror in the land of the living went down uncircumcised to the earth below. They bear their shame with those who go down to the pit.
verses.textEnEsv: "Elam is there, and all her multitude around her grave; all of them slain, fallen by the sword, who went down uncircumcised into the world below, who spread their terror in the land of the living; and they bear their shame with those who go down to the pit.
verses.textEnNkjv: "There is Elam and all her multitude, All around her grave, All of them slain, fallen by the sword, Who have gone down uncircumcised to the lower parts of the earth, Who caused their terror in the land of the living; Now they bear their shame with those who go down to the Pit.
verses.textEnNlt: "Elam lies there surrounded by the graves of all its hordes, those who were slaughtered by the sword. They struck terror in the hearts of people everywhere, but now they have descended as outcasts to the world below. Now they lie in the pit and share the shame of those who have gone before them.
verses.textEnNasb: "Elam is there and all her hordes around her grave; all of them killed, fallen by the sword, who went down uncircumcised to the lower parts of the earth, who inflicted their terror on the land of the living, and bore their disgrace with those who go down to the pit.
verses.textEn: "Elam is there, with all her hordes around her grave. All of them are slain, fallen by the sword. All who had spread terror in the land of the living went down uncircumcised to the earth below. They bear their shame with those who go down to the pit.

verses.textZh: 在被杀的人中，有床为它和它的众民安设；他们的坟墓都在它周围；他们都是没有受割礼的，是被刀所杀的；他们曾使惊恐散布在活人之地。现在他们与下坑的人一同担当自己的羞辱；以拦被安置在被杀的人中间。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在被杀的人中，有床为它和它的众民安设；他们的坟墓都在它周围；他们都是没有受割礼的，是被刀所杀的；他们曾使惊恐散布在活人之地。现在他们与下坑的人一同担当自己的羞辱；以拦被安置在被杀的人中间。
verses.textZhCuv: 人给她和她的群众在被杀的人中设立床榻。她民的坟墓在她四围，他们都是未受割礼被刀杀的；他们曾在活人之地使人惊恐，并且与下坑的人一同担当羞辱。以拦已经放在被杀的人中。
verses.textEnNiv: A bed is made for her among the slain, with all her hordes around her grave. All of them are uncircumcised, killed by the sword. Because their terror had spread in the land of the living, they bear their shame with those who go down to the pit; they are laid among the slain.
verses.textEnEsv: They have made her a bed among the slain with all her multitude, her graves all around it, all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword; for terror of them was spread in the land of the living, and they bear their shame with those who go down to the pit; they are placed among the slain.
verses.textEnNkjv: They have set her bed in the midst of the slain, With all her multitude, With her graves all around it, All of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword; Though their terror was caused In the land of the living, Yet they bear their shame With those who go down to the Pit; It was put in the midst of the slain.
verses.textEnNlt: They have a resting place among the slaughtered, surrounded by the graves of all their hordes. Yes, they terrorized the nations while they lived, but now they lie in shame with others in the pit, all of them outcasts, slaughtered by the sword.
verses.textEnNasb: They have made a bed for her among the slain with all her hordes. Her graves are around it, they are all uncircumcised, killed by the sword (although their terror was inflicted on the land of the living), and they bore their disgrace with those who go down to the pit; they were put in the midst of the slain.
verses.textEn: A bed is made for her among the slain, with all her hordes around her grave. All of them are uncircumcised, killed by the sword. Because their terror had spread in the land of the living, they bear their shame with those who go down to the pit; they are laid among the slain.

verses.textZh: "米设、土巴和它们所有的人民都在那里；他们的坟墓都在米设和土巴的周围；他们都是没有受割礼的，是被刀所杀的；他们曾使惊恐散布在活人之地。
verses.textZhCnvs: "米设、土巴和它们所有的人民都在那里；他们的坟墓都在米设和土巴的周围；他们都是没有受割礼的，是被刀所杀的；他们曾使惊恐散布在活人之地。
verses.textZhCuv: 「米设、土巴，和她们的群众都在那里。她民的坟墓在她四围，他们都是未受割礼被刀杀的；他们曾在活人之地使人惊恐。
verses.textEnNiv: "Meshek and Tubal are there, with all their hordes around their graves. All of them are uncircumcised, killed by the sword because they spread their terror in the land of the living.
verses.textEnEsv: "Meshech-Tubal is there, and all her multitude, her graves all around it, all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword; for they spread their terror in the land of the living.
verses.textEnNkjv: "There are Meshech and Tubal and all their multitudes, With all their graves around it, All of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword, Though they caused their terror in the land of the living.
verses.textEnNlt: "Meshech and Tubal are there, surrounded by the graves of all their hordes. They once struck terror in the hearts of people everywhere. But now they are outcasts, all slaughtered by the sword.
verses.textEnNasb: "Meshech, Tubal, and all their hordes are there; their graves surround them. All of them were killed by the sword uncircumcised, though they inflicted their terror on the land of the living.
verses.textEn: "Meshek and Tubal are there, with all their hordes around their graves. All of them are uncircumcised, killed by the sword because they spread their terror in the land of the living.

verses.textZh: 他们不都是与那些没有受割礼而倒毙的勇士一起长眠吗？这些勇士都带着兵器下到阴间，刀剑都放在自己的头下。他们的罪孽是在自己的骨头上。他们曾使惊恐散布在活人之地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们不都是与那些没有受割礼而倒毙的勇士一起长眠吗？这些勇士都带着兵器下到阴间，刀剑都放在自己的头下。他们的罪孽是在自己的骨头上。他们曾使惊恐散布在活人之地。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们不得与那未受割礼仆倒的勇士一同躺卧；这些勇士带着兵器下阴间，头枕刀剑，骨头上有本身的罪孽；他们曾在活人之地使勇士惊恐。
verses.textEnNiv: But they do not lie with the fallen warriors of old, who went down to the realm of the dead with their weapons of war—their swords placed under their heads and their shields resting on their bones—though these warriors also had terrorized the land of the living.
verses.textEnEsv: And they do not lie with the mighty, the fallen from among the uncircumcised, who went down to Sheol with their weapons of war, whose swords were laid under their heads, and whose iniquities are upon their bones; for the terror of the mighty men was in the land of the living.
verses.textEnNkjv: They do not lie with the mighty Whoare fallen of the uncircumcised, Who have gone down to hell with their weapons of war; They have laid their swords under their heads, But their iniquities will be on their bones, Because of the terror of the mighty in the land of the living.
verses.textEnNlt: They are not buried in honor like their fallen heroes, who went down to the grave with their weapons—their shields covering their bodies and their swords beneath their heads. Their guilt rests upon them because they brought terror to everyone while they were still alive.
verses.textEnNasb: Nor do they lie beside the fallen heroes of the uncircumcised, who went down to Sheol with their weapons of war and whose swords were placed under their heads; but the punishment for their wrongdoing rested on their bones, though the terror of these heroes was once in the land of the living.
verses.textEn: But they do not lie with the fallen warriors of old, who went down to the realm of the dead with their weapons of war—their swords placed under their heads and their shields resting on their bones—though these warriors also had terrorized the land of the living.

verses.textZh: 法老啊！至于你，你必在没有受割礼的人中被毁灭，与那些被刀所杀的人一起长眠。
verses.textZhCnvs: 法老啊！至于你，你必在没有受割礼的人中被毁灭，与那些被刀所杀的人一起长眠。
verses.textZhCuv: 「法老啊，你必在未受割礼的人中败坏，与那些被杀的人一同躺卧。
verses.textEnNiv: "You too, Pharaoh, will be broken and will lie among the uncircumcised, with those killed by the sword.
verses.textEnEsv: But as for you, you shall be broken and lie among the uncircumcised, with those who are slain by the sword.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yes, you shall be broken in the midst of the uncircumcised, And lie with those slain by the sword.
verses.textEnNlt: "You too, Egypt, will lie crushed and broken among the outcasts, all slaughtered by the sword.
verses.textEnNasb: But in the midst of the uncircumcised you will be broken and lie with those killed by the sword.
verses.textEn: "You too, Pharaoh, will be broken and will lie among the uncircumcised, with those killed by the sword.

verses.textZh: "以东也在那里，以东的众王和所有首领虽然英勇，还是与被刀所杀的人列在一起。他们必与没有受割礼而下坑的人一起长眠。
verses.textZhCnvs: "以东也在那里，以东的众王和所有首领虽然英勇，还是与被刀所杀的人列在一起。他们必与没有受割礼而下坑的人一起长眠。
verses.textZhCuv: 「以东也在那里。她君王和一切首领虽然仗着势力，还是放在被杀的人中；他们必与未受割礼的和下坑的人一同躺卧。
verses.textEnNiv: "Edom is there, her kings and all her princes; despite their power, they are laid with those killed by the sword. They lie with the uncircumcised, with those who go down to the pit.
verses.textEnEsv: "Edom is there, her kings and all her princes, who for all their might are laid with those who are killed by the sword; they lie with the uncircumcised, with those who go down to the pit.
verses.textEnNkjv: "There is Edom, Her kings and all her princes, Who despite their might Are laid beside those slain by the sword; They shall lie with the uncircumcised, And with those who go down to the Pit.
verses.textEnNlt: "Edom is there with its kings and princes. Mighty as they were, they also lie among those slaughtered by the sword, with the outcasts who have gone down to the pit.
verses.textEnNasb: "There also is Edom, its kings and all its princes, who despite all their might are laid with those killed by the sword; they will lie with the uncircumcised and with those who go down to the pit.
verses.textEn: "Edom is there, her kings and all her princes; despite their power, they are laid with those killed by the sword. They lie with the uncircumcised, with those who go down to the pit.

verses.textZh: "在那里有北方的众首领和所有西顿人；他们都与被杀死的人一同下去，他们虽然英勇，使人惊恐，还是蒙受了羞辱；他们没有受割礼而与那些被刀所杀的人一起长眠，与那些下坑的人一同担当羞辱。
verses.textZhCnvs: "在那里有北方的众首领和所有西顿人；他们都与被杀死的人一同下去，他们虽然英勇，使人惊恐，还是蒙受了羞辱；他们没有受割礼而与那些被刀所杀的人一起长眠，与那些下坑的人一同担当羞辱。
verses.textZhCuv: 「在那里有北方的众王子和一切西顿人，都与被杀的人下去。他们虽然仗着势力使人惊恐，还是蒙羞。他们未受割礼，和被刀杀的一同躺卧，与下坑的人一同担当羞辱。
verses.textEnNiv: "All the princes of the north and all the Sidonians are there; they went down with the slain in disgrace despite the terror caused by their power. They lie uncircumcised with those killed by the sword and bear their shame with those who go down to the pit.
verses.textEnEsv: "The princes of the north are there, all of them, and all the Sidonians, who have gone down in shame with the slain, for all the terror that they caused by their might; they lie uncircumcised with those who are slain by the sword, and bear their shame with those who go down to the pit.
verses.textEnNkjv: There are the princes of the north, All of them, and all the Sidonians, Who have gone down with the slain In shame at the terror which they caused by their might; They lie uncircumcised with those slain by the sword, And bear their shame with those who go down to the Pit.
verses.textEnNlt: "All the princes of the north and the Sidonians are there with others who have died. Once a terror, they have been put to shame. They lie there as outcasts with others who were slaughtered by the sword. They share the shame of all who have descended to the pit.
verses.textEnNasb: "There also are the chiefs of the north, all of them, and all the Sidonians, who in spite of the terror resulting from their might, in shame went down with the slain. So they lay down uncircumcised with those killed by the sword and bore their disgrace with those who go down to the pit.
verses.textEn: "All the princes of the north and all the Sidonians are there; they went down with the slain in disgrace despite the terror caused by their power. They lie uncircumcised with those killed by the sword and bear their shame with those who go down to the pit.

verses.textZh: "法老看见他们，就必为被刀所杀的众民，就是法老自己和他的全军，得了安慰。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: "法老看见他们，就必为被刀所杀的众民，就是法老自己和他的全军，得了安慰。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 「法老看见他们，便为他被杀的军队受安慰。这是主耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: "Pharaoh—he and all his army—will see them and he will be consoled for all his hordes that were killed by the sword, declares the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: "When Pharaoh sees them, he will be comforted for all his multitude, Pharaoh and all his army, slain by the sword, declares the Lord God .
verses.textEnNkjv: "Pharaoh will see them And be comforted over all his multitude, Pharaoh and all his army, Slain by the sword," Says the Lord God.
verses.textEnNlt: "When Pharaoh and his entire army arrive, he will take comfort that he is not alone in having his hordes killed, says the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "These Pharaoh will see, and he will find consolation regarding all his hordes killed by the sword, Pharaoh and all his army," declares the Lord God.
verses.textEn: "Pharaoh—he and all his army—will see them and he will be consoled for all his hordes that were killed by the sword, declares the Sovereign Lord .

verses.textZh: 虽然我任凭法老使惊恐散布在活人之地，他和他的众民必在没有受割礼的人中，与被刀所杀的人一起长眠。这是主耶和华的宣告。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 虽然我任凭法老使惊恐散布在活人之地，他和他的众民必在没有受割礼的人中，与被刀所杀的人一起长眠。这是主耶和华的宣告。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我任凭法老在活人之地使人惊恐，法老和他的群众必放在未受割礼和被杀的人中。这是主耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: Although I had him spread terror in the land of the living, Pharaoh and all his hordes will be laid among the uncircumcised, with those killed by the sword, declares the Sovereign Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: For I spread terror in the land of the living; and he shall be laid to rest among the uncircumcised, with those who are slain by the sword, Pharaoh and all his multitude, declares the Lord God ."
verses.textEnNkjv: "For I have caused My terror in the land of the living; And he shall be placed in the midst of the uncircumcised With those slain by the sword, Pharaoh and all his multitude," Says the Lord God.
verses.textEnNlt: Although I have caused his terror to fall upon all the living, Pharaoh and his hordes will lie there among the outcasts who were slaughtered by the sword. I, the Sovereign Lord , have spoken!"
verses.textEnNasb: "Though I inflicted the terror of him on the land of the living, yet he will be laid to rest among the uncircumcised along with those killed by the sword, Pharaoh and all his hordes," declares the Lord God.
verses.textEn: Although I had him spread terror in the land of the living, Pharaoh and all his hordes will be laid among the uncircumcised, with those killed by the sword, declares the Sovereign Lord ."

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnNkjv: Again the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Once again a message came to me from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: Now the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: The word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: "人子啊！你要告诉你本国的人，说：‘我使刀剑临到一地，那地的人民从他们中间选出一个人，作他们的守望者；
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！你要告诉你本国的人，说：‘我使刀剑临到一地，那地的人民从他们中间选出一个人，作他们的守望者；
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，你要告诉本国的子民说：我使刀剑临到哪一国，那一国的民从他们中间选立一人为守望的。
verses.textEnNiv: "Son of man, speak to your people and say to them: ‘When I bring the sword against a land, and the people of the land choose one of their men and make him their watchman,
verses.textEnEsv: "Son of man, speak to your people and say to them, If I bring the sword upon a land, and the people of the land take a man from among them, and make him their watchman,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Son of man, speak to the children of your people, and say to them: ‘When I bring the sword upon a land, and the people of the land take a man from their territory and make him their watchman,
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, give your people this message: ‘When I bring an army against a country, the people of that land choose one of their own to be a watchman.
verses.textEnNasb: "Son of man, speak to the sons of your people and say to them, ‘If I bring a sword upon a land, and the people of the land take one man from among them and make him their watchman,
verses.textEn: "Son of man, speak to your people and say to them: ‘When I bring the sword against a land, and the people of the land choose one of their men and make him their watchman,

verses.textZh: 这人见刀剑临到那地，就吹响号角，警告众人；
verses.textZhCnvs: 这人见刀剑临到那地，就吹响号角，警告众人；
verses.textZhCuv: 他见刀剑临到那地，若吹角警戒众民，
verses.textEnNiv: and he sees the sword coming against the land and blows the trumpet to warn the people,
verses.textEnEsv: and if he sees the sword coming upon the land and blows the trumpet and warns the people,
verses.textEnNkjv: when he sees the sword coming upon the land, if he blows the trumpet and warns the people,
verses.textEnNlt: When the watchman sees the enemy coming, he sounds the alarm to warn the people.
verses.textEnNasb: and he sees the sword coming upon the land and blows the horn and warns the people,
verses.textEn: and he sees the sword coming against the land and blows the trumpet to warn the people,

verses.textZh: 凡听见号角声而不接受警告的，刀剑若来把他除灭，他的罪 就要归到自己的头上；
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡听见号角声而不接受警告的，刀剑若来把他除灭，他的罪 就要归到自己的头上；
verses.textZhCuv: 凡听见角声不受警戒的，刀剑若来除灭了他，他的罪 就必归到自己的头上。
verses.textEnNiv: then if anyone hears the trumpet but does not heed the warning and the sword comes and takes their life, their blood will be on their own head.
verses.textEnEsv: then if anyone who hears the sound of the trumpet does not take warning, and the sword comes and takes him away, his blood shall be upon his own head.
verses.textEnNkjv: then whoever hears the sound of the trumpet and does not take warning, if the sword comes and takes him away, his blood shall be on his own head.
verses.textEnNlt: Then if those who hear the alarm refuse to take action, it is their own fault if they die.
verses.textEnNasb: then someone who hears the sound of the horn but does not take warning, and a sword comes and takes him away, his blood will be on his own head.
verses.textEn: then if anyone hears the trumpet but does not heed the warning and the sword comes and takes their life, their blood will be on their own head.

verses.textZh: 他既然听见号角声而不接受警告，所以他的罪 要归到自己的身上；他若接受警告，就可以救回自己的性命了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他既然听见号角声而不接受警告，所以他的罪 要归到自己的身上；他若接受警告，就可以救回自己的性命了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他听见角声，不受警戒，他的罪必归到自己的身上；他若受警戒，便是救了自己的性命。
verses.textEnNiv: Since they heard the sound of the trumpet but did not heed the warning, their blood will be on their own head. If they had heeded the warning, they would have saved themselves.
verses.textEnEsv: He heard the sound of the trumpet and did not take warning; his blood shall be upon himself. But if he had taken warning, he would have saved his life.
verses.textEnNkjv: He heard the sound of the trumpet, but did not take warning; his blood shall be upon himself. But he who takes warning will save his life.
verses.textEnNlt: They heard the alarm but ignored it, so the responsibility is theirs. If they had listened to the warning, they could have saved their lives.
verses.textEnNasb: He heard the sound of the horn but did not take warning; his blood will be on himself. But had he taken warning, he would have saved his life.
verses.textEn: Since they heard the sound of the trumpet but did not heed the warning, their blood will be on their own head. If they had heeded the warning, they would have saved themselves.

verses.textZh: 但是，那守望的人若见刀剑临到，却不吹响号角，以致人民没有受到警告，刀剑来把他们中间的一个人除灭；那人虽然因自己的罪孽被除灭，我却要因他的死追究守望的人。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是，那守望的人若见刀剑临到，却不吹响号角，以致人民没有受到警告，刀剑来把他们中间的一个人除灭；那人虽然因自己的罪孽被除灭，我却要因他的死追究守望的人。’
verses.textZhCuv: 倘若守望的人见刀剑临到，不吹角，以致民不受警戒，刀剑来杀了他们中间的一个人，他虽然死在罪孽之中，我却要向守望的人讨他丧命的罪 。
verses.textEnNiv: But if the watchman sees the sword coming and does not blow the trumpet to warn the people and the sword comes and takes someone’s life, that person’s life will be taken because of their sin, but I will hold the watchman accountable for their blood.’
verses.textEnEsv: But if the watchman sees the sword coming and does not blow the trumpet, so that the people are not warned, and the sword comes and takes any one of them, that person is taken away in his iniquity, but his blood I will require at the watchman’s hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if the watchman sees the sword coming and does not blow the trumpet, and the people are not warned, and the sword comes and takes any person from among them, he is taken away in his iniquity; but his blood I will require at the watchman’s hand.’
verses.textEnNlt: But if the watchman sees the enemy coming and doesn’t sound the alarm to warn the people, he is responsible for their captivity. They will die in their sins, but I will hold the watchman responsible for their deaths.’
verses.textEnNasb: But if the watchman sees the sword coming and does not blow the horn and the people are not warned, and a sword comes and takes a person from them, he is taken away for his wrongdoing; but I will require his blood from the watchman’s hand.’
verses.textEn: But if the watchman sees the sword coming and does not blow the trumpet to warn the people and the sword comes and takes someone’s life, that person’s life will be taken because of their sin, but I will hold the watchman accountable for their blood.’

verses.textZh: "人子啊！我立了你作以色列家守望的人，所以你要聆听我口中的话，替我警告他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！我立了你作以色列家守望的人，所以你要聆听我口中的话，替我警告他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，我照样立你作以色列家守望的人。所以你要听我口中的话，替我警戒他们。
verses.textEnNiv: "Son of man, I have made you a watchman for the people of Israel; so hear the word I speak and give them warning from me.
verses.textEnEsv: "So you, son of man, I have made a watchman for the house of Israel. Whenever you hear a word from my mouth, you shall give them warning from me.
verses.textEnNkjv: "So you, son of man: I have made you a watchman for the house of Israel; therefore you shall hear a word from My mouth and warn them for Me.
verses.textEnNlt: "Now, son of man, I am making you a watchman for the people of Israel. Therefore, listen to what I say and warn them for me.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now as for you, son of man, I have appointed you as a watchman for the house of Israel; so you will hear a message from My mouth and give them a warning from Me.
verses.textEn: "Son of man, I have made you a watchman for the people of Israel; so hear the word I speak and give them warning from me.

verses.textZh: 如果我对恶人说：‘恶人啊，你必定死亡！’你以西结却不出声警告恶人离开他所行的，这恶人就必因自己的罪孽死亡，我却要因他的死追究你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果我对恶人说：‘恶人啊，你必定死亡！’你以西结却不出声警告恶人离开他所行的，这恶人就必因自己的罪孽死亡，我却要因他的死追究你。
verses.textZhCuv: 我对恶人说：『恶人哪，你必要死！』你－以西结若不开口警戒恶人，使他离开所行的道，这恶人必死在罪孽之中，我却要向你讨他丧命的罪 。
verses.textEnNiv: When I say to the wicked, ‘You wicked person, you will surely die,’ and you do not speak out to dissuade them from their ways, that wicked person will die for their sin, and I will hold you accountable for their blood.
verses.textEnEsv: If I say to the wicked, O wicked one, you shall surely die, and you do not speak to warn the wicked to turn from his way, that wicked person shall die in his iniquity, but his blood I will require at your hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: When I say to the wicked, ‘O wicked man, you shall surely die!’ and you do not speak to warn the wicked from his way, that wicked man shall die in his iniquity; but his blood I will require at your hand.
verses.textEnNlt: If I announce that some wicked people are sure to die and you fail to tell them to change their ways, then they will die in their sins, and I will hold you responsible for their deaths.
verses.textEnNasb: When I say to the wicked, ‘You wicked person, you will certainly die,’ and you do not speak to warn the wicked about his way, that wicked person shall die for his wrongdoing, but I will require his blood from your hand.
verses.textEn: When I say to the wicked, ‘You wicked person, you will surely die,’ and you do not speak out to dissuade them from their ways, that wicked person will die for their sin, and I will hold you accountable for their blood.

verses.textZh: 如果你警告恶人，叫他离开他所行的，他仍不转离，他就必因自己的罪孽死亡，你却救了自己的性命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你警告恶人，叫他离开他所行的，他仍不转离，他就必因自己的罪孽死亡，你却救了自己的性命。
verses.textZhCuv: 倘若你警戒恶人转离所行的道，他仍不转离，他必死在罪孽之中，你却救自己脱离了罪。」
verses.textEnNiv: But if you do warn the wicked person to turn from their ways and they do not do so, they will die for their sin, though you yourself will be saved.
verses.textEnEsv: But if you warn the wicked to turn from his way, and he does not turn from his way, that person shall die in his iniquity, but you will have delivered your soul.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless if you warn the wicked to turn from his way, and he does not turn from his way, he shall die in his iniquity; but you have delivered your soul.
verses.textEnNlt: But if you warn them to repent and they don’t repent, they will die in their sins, but you will have saved yourself.
verses.textEnNasb: But if you on your part warn a wicked person to turn from his way and he does not turn from his way, he will die for his wrongdoing, but you have saved your life.
verses.textEn: But if you do warn the wicked person to turn from their ways and they do not do so, they will die for their sin, though you yourself will be saved.

verses.textZh: "人子啊！你要对以色列家说：‘你们这样说：我们的过犯和罪恶常在我们身上；我们必因此衰弱而死，怎能存活呢？’
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！你要对以色列家说：‘你们这样说：我们的过犯和罪恶常在我们身上；我们必因此衰弱而死，怎能存活呢？’
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，你要对以色列家说：『你们常说：我们的过犯罪恶在我们身上，我们必因此消灭，怎能存活呢？』
verses.textEnNiv: "Son of man, say to the Israelites, ‘This is what you are saying: "Our offenses and sins weigh us down, and we are wasting away because of them. How then can we live?" ’
verses.textEnEsv: "And you, son of man, say to the house of Israel, Thus have you said: ‘Surely our transgressions and our sins are upon us, and we rot away because of them. How then can we live?’
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore you, O son of man, say to the house of Israel: ‘Thus you say, "If our transgressions and our sins lie upon us, and we pine away in them, how can we then live?" ’
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, give the people of Israel this message: You are saying, ‘Our sins are heavy upon us; we are wasting away! How can we survive?’
verses.textEnNasb: "Now as for you, son of man, say to the house of Israel, ‘This is what you have said: "Surely our offenses and our sins are upon us, and we are rotting away in them; how then can we survive?" ’
verses.textEn: "Son of man, say to the Israelites, ‘This is what you are saying: "Our offenses and sins weigh us down, and we are wasting away because of them. How then can we live?" ’

verses.textZh: 你要对他们说：‘主耶和华这样宣告：我指着我的永生起誓，我绝不喜悦恶人死亡，却喜悦恶人离开他所行的，得以存活。以色列家啊，回转吧！离开你们所行的，何必死亡呢？’
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要对他们说：‘主耶和华这样宣告：我指着我的永生起誓，我绝不喜悦恶人死亡，却喜悦恶人离开他所行的，得以存活。以色列家啊，回转吧！离开你们所行的，何必死亡呢？’
verses.textZhCuv: 你对他们说，主耶和华说：我指着我的永生起誓，我断不喜悦恶人死亡，惟喜悦恶人转离所行的道而活。以色列家啊，你们转回，转回吧！离开恶道，何必死亡呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Say to them, ‘As surely as I live, declares the Sovereign Lord , I take no pleasure in the death of the wicked, but rather that they turn from their ways and live. Turn! Turn from your evil ways! Why will you die, people of Israel?’
verses.textEnEsv: Say to them, As I live, declares the Lord God , I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked, but that the wicked turn from his way and live; turn back, turn back from your evil ways, for why will you die, O house of Israel?
verses.textEnNkjv: Say to them: ‘As I live,’ says the Lord God, ‘I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked, but that the wicked turn from his way and live. Turn, turn from your evil ways! For why should you die, O house of Israel?’
verses.textEnNlt: As surely as I live, says the Sovereign Lord , I take no pleasure in the death of wicked people. I only want them to turn from their wicked ways so they can live. Turn! Turn from your wickedness, O people of Israel! Why should you die?
verses.textEnNasb: Say to them, ‘As I live!’ declares the Lord God, ‘I take no pleasure at all in the death of the wicked, but rather that the wicked turn from his way and live. Turn back, turn back from your evil ways! Why then should you die, house of Israel?’
verses.textEn: Say to them, ‘As surely as I live, declares the Sovereign Lord , I take no pleasure in the death of the wicked, but rather that they turn from their ways and live. Turn! Turn from your evil ways! Why will you die, people of Israel?’

verses.textZh: 人子啊！你要对你本国的人说：‘义人的义在他犯罪的日子，不能救他；恶人的恶在他离开恶行的日子，也不会绊倒他；义人在他犯罪的日子，也不能因他的义存活。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 人子啊！你要对你本国的人说：‘义人的义在他犯罪的日子，不能救他；恶人的恶在他离开恶行的日子，也不会绊倒他；义人在他犯罪的日子，也不能因他的义存活。’
verses.textZhCuv: 人子啊，你要对本国的人民说：义人的义，在犯罪之日不能救他；至于恶人的恶，在他转离恶行之日也不能使他倾倒；义人在犯罪之日也不能因他的义存活。
verses.textEnNiv: "Therefore, son of man, say to your people, ‘If someone who is righteous disobeys, that person’s former righteousness will count for nothing. And if someone who is wicked repents, that person’s former wickedness will not bring condemnation. The righteous person who sins will not be allowed to live even though they were formerly righteous.’
verses.textEnEsv: "And you, son of man, say to your people, The righteousness of the righteous shall not deliver him when he transgresses, and as for the wickedness of the wicked, he shall not fall by it when he turns from his wickedness, and the righteous shall not be able to live by his righteousness when he sins.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore you, O son of man, say to the children of your people: ‘The righteousness of the righteous man shall not deliver him in the day of his transgression; as for the wickedness of the wicked, he shall not fall because of it in the day that he turns from his wickedness; nor shall the righteous be able to live because of hisrighteousness in the day that he sins.’
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, give your people this message: The righteous behavior of righteous people will not save them if they turn to sin, nor will the wicked behavior of wicked people destroy them if they repent and turn from their sins.
verses.textEnNasb: And you, son of man, say to your fellow citizens, ‘The righteousness of a righteous one will not save him on the day of his offense, and as for the wickedness of a wicked one, he will not stumble because of it on the day when he turns from his wickedness; whereas a righteous one will not be able to live by his righteousness on the day when he commits sin.’
verses.textEn: "Therefore, son of man, say to your people, ‘If someone who is righteous disobeys, that person’s former righteousness will count for nothing. And if someone who is wicked repents, that person’s former wickedness will not bring condemnation. The righteous person who sins will not be allowed to live even though they were formerly righteous.’

verses.textZh: 我虽然对义人说他必定生存，但是他若恃着自己的义而行恶，他的一切义都必不被记念；他必因所行的恶死亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我虽然对义人说他必定生存，但是他若恃着自己的义而行恶，他的一切义都必不被记念；他必因所行的恶死亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 我对义人说：『你必定存活！』他若倚靠他的义而作罪孽，他所行的义都不被记念。他必因所作的罪孽死亡。
