verses.textEnNiv: If I tell a righteous person that they will surely live, but then they trust in their righteousness and do evil, none of the righteous things that person has done will be remembered; they will die for the evil they have done.
verses.textEnEsv: Though I say to the righteous that he shall surely live, yet if he trusts in his righteousness and does injustice, none of his righteous deeds shall be remembered, but in his injustice that he has done he shall die.
verses.textEnNkjv: When I say to the righteous that he shall surely live, but he trusts in his own righteousness and commits iniquity, none of his righteous works shall be remembered; but because of the iniquity that he has committed, he shall die.
verses.textEnNlt: When I tell righteous people that they will live, but then they sin, expecting their past righteousness to save them, then none of their righteous acts will be remembered. I will destroy them for their sins.
verses.textEnNasb: When I say to the righteous that he will certainly live, and he so trusts in his righteousness that he commits injustice, none of his righteous deeds will be remembered; but for that same injustice of his which he has committed he will die.
verses.textEn: If I tell a righteous person that they will surely live, but then they trust in their righteousness and do evil, none of the righteous things that person has done will be remembered; they will die for the evil they have done.

verses.textZh: 我虽然对恶人说：‘你必定死亡’，但是他若离开他的罪，行公平和正直的事，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我虽然对恶人说：‘你必定死亡’，但是他若离开他的罪，行公平和正直的事，
verses.textZhCuv: 再者，我对恶人说：『你必定死亡！』他若转离他的罪，行正直与合理的事：
verses.textEnNiv: And if I say to a wicked person, ‘You will surely die,’ but they then turn away from their sin and do what is just and right—
verses.textEnEsv: Again, though I say to the wicked, ‘You shall surely die,’ yet if he turns from his sin and does what is just and right,
verses.textEnNkjv: Again, when I say to the wicked, ‘You shall surely die,’ if he turns from his sin and does what is lawful and right,
verses.textEnNlt: And suppose I tell some wicked people that they will surely die, but then they turn from their sins and do what is just and right.
verses.textEnNasb: But when I say to the wicked, ‘You will certainly die,’ and he turns from his sin and practices justice and righteousness,
verses.textEn: And if I say to a wicked person, ‘You will surely die,’ but they then turn away from their sin and do what is just and right—

verses.textZh: 把抵押归还，把抢夺人的物件偿还，遵行赐生命的律例，不作恶事，他就必存活，不致死亡；
verses.textZhCnvs: 把抵押归还，把抢夺人的物件偿还，遵行赐生命的律例，不作恶事，他就必存活，不致死亡；
verses.textZhCuv: 还人的当头和所抢夺的，遵行生命的律例，不作罪孽，他必定存活，不致死亡。
verses.textEnNiv: if they give back what they took in pledge for a loan, return what they have stolen, follow the decrees that give life, and do no evil—that person will surely live; they will not die.
verses.textEnEsv: if the wicked restores the pledge, gives back what he has taken by robbery, and walks in the statutes of life, not doing injustice, he shall surely live; he shall not die.
verses.textEnNkjv: if the wicked restores the pledge, gives back what he has stolen, and walks in the statutes of life without committing iniquity, he shall surely live; he shall not die.
verses.textEnNlt: For instance, they might give back a debtor’s security, return what they have stolen, and obey my life-giving laws, no longer doing what is evil. If they do this, then they will surely live and not die.
verses.textEnNasb: if a wicked person returns a pledge, pays back what he has taken by robbery, walks by the statutes which ensure life without committing injustice, he shall certainly live; he shall not die.
verses.textEn: if they give back what they took in pledge for a loan, return what they have stolen, follow the decrees that give life, and do no evil—that person will surely live; they will not die.

verses.textZh: 他所犯的一切罪，必不被记念；他行了公平和正直的事，就必存活。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他所犯的一切罪，必不被记念；他行了公平和正直的事，就必存活。
verses.textZhCuv: 他所犯的一切罪必不被记念。他行了正直与合理的事，必定存活。
verses.textEnNiv: None of the sins that person has committed will be remembered against them. They have done what is just and right; they will surely live.
verses.textEnEsv: None of the sins that he has committed shall be remembered against him. He has done what is just and right; he shall surely live.
verses.textEnNkjv: None of his sins which he has committed shall be remembered against him; he has done what is lawful and right; he shall surely live.
verses.textEnNlt: None of their past sins will be brought up again, for they have done what is just and right, and they will surely live.
verses.textEnNasb: None of his sins that he has committed will be remembered against him. He has practiced justice and righteousness; he shall certainly live.
verses.textEn: None of the sins that person has committed will be remembered against them. They have done what is just and right; they will surely live.

verses.textZh: "你本国的人还说：‘主所行的不公平。’其实他们所行的才是不公平。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你本国的人还说：‘主所行的不公平。’其实他们所行的才是不公平。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你本国的子民还说：『主的道不公平。』其实他们的道不公平。
verses.textEnNiv: "Yet your people say, ‘The way of the Lord is not just.’ But it is their way that is not just.
verses.textEnEsv: "Yet your people say, ‘The way of the Lord is not just,’ when it is their own way that is not just.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Yet the children of your people say, ‘The way of the Lord is not fair.’ But it is their way which is not fair!
verses.textEnNlt: "Your people are saying, ‘The Lord isn’t doing what’s right,’ but it is they who are not doing what’s right.
verses.textEnNasb: "Yet your fellow citizens say, ‘The way of the Lord is not right,’ when it is their own way that is not right.
verses.textEn: "Yet your people say, ‘The way of the Lord is not just.’ But it is their way that is not just.

verses.textZh: 义人若离开他的义，去行恶事，他就必因此死亡；
verses.textZhCnvs: 义人若离开他的义，去行恶事，他就必因此死亡；
verses.textZhCuv: 义人转离他的义而作罪孽，就必因此死亡。
verses.textEnNiv: If a righteous person turns from their righteousness and does evil, they will die for it.
verses.textEnEsv: When the righteous turns from his righteousness and does injustice, he shall die for it.
verses.textEnNkjv: When the righteous turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity, he shall die because of it.
verses.textEnNlt: For again I say, when righteous people turn away from their righteous behavior and turn to evil, they will die.
verses.textEnNasb: When the righteous turns from his righteousness and commits injustice, then he shall die in it.
verses.textEn: If a righteous person turns from their righteousness and does evil, they will die for it.

verses.textZh: 恶人若离开他的恶，去行公平和正直的事，他就必因此存活。
verses.textZhCnvs: 恶人若离开他的恶，去行公平和正直的事，他就必因此存活。
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人转离他的恶，行正直与合理的事，就必因此存活。
verses.textEnNiv: And if a wicked person turns away from their wickedness and does what is just and right, they will live by doing so.
verses.textEnEsv: And when the wicked turns from his wickedness and does what is just and right, he shall live by this.
verses.textEnNkjv: But when the wicked turns from his wickedness and does what is lawful and right, he shall live because of it.
verses.textEnNlt: But if wicked people turn from their wickedness and do what is just and right, they will live.
verses.textEnNasb: But when the wicked turns from his wickedness and practices justice and righteousness, he will live by them.
verses.textEn: And if a wicked person turns away from their wickedness and does what is just and right, they will live by doing so.

verses.textZh: 你们还说：‘主所行的不公平。’以色列家啊！我必照着你们各人所行的审判你们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们还说：‘主所行的不公平。’以色列家啊！我必照着你们各人所行的审判你们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们还说：『主的道不公平。』以色列家啊，我必按你们各人所行的审判你们。」
verses.textEnNiv: Yet you Israelites say, ‘The way of the Lord is not just.’ But I will judge each of you according to your own ways."
verses.textEnEsv: Yet you say, ‘The way of the Lord is not just.’ O house of Israel, I will judge each of you according to his ways."
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet you say, ‘The way of the Lord is not fair.’ O house of Israel, I will judge every one of you according to his own ways."
verses.textEnNlt: O people of Israel, you are saying, ‘The Lord isn’t doing what’s right.’ But I judge each of you according to your deeds."
verses.textEnNasb: Yet you say, ‘The way of the Lord is not right.’ I will judge each of you according to his ways, house of Israel."
verses.textEn: Yet you Israelites say, ‘The way of the Lord is not just.’ But I will judge each of you according to your own ways."

verses.textZh: 在我们被掳以后的第十二年十月初五日，有人从耶路撒冷逃到我这里来，说："城已经被攻陷了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 在我们被掳以后的第十二年十月初五日，有人从耶路撒冷逃到我这里来，说："城已经被攻陷了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我们被掳之后十二年十月初五日，有人从耶路撒冷逃到我这里，说：「城已攻破。」
verses.textEnNiv: In the twelfth year of our exile, in the tenth month on the fifth day, a man who had escaped from Jerusalem came to me and said, "The city has fallen!"
verses.textEnEsv: In the twelfth year of our exile, in the tenth month, on the fifth day of the month, a fugitive from Jerusalem came to me and said, "The city has been struck down."
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass in the twelfth year of our captivity, in the tenth month, on the fifth day of the month, that one who had escaped from Jerusalem came to me and said, "The city has been captured!"
verses.textEnNlt: On January 8, during the twelfth year of our captivity, a survivor from Jerusalem came to me and said, "The city has fallen!"
verses.textEnNasb: Now in the twelfth year of our exile, on the fifth of the tenth month, the survivor from Jerusalem came to me, saying, "The city has been taken."
verses.textEn: In the twelfth year of our exile, in the tenth month on the fifth day, a man who had escaped from Jerusalem came to me and said, "The city has fallen!"

verses.textZh: 那人来到的前一天晚上，耶和华的手按在我身上，开了我的口。到了早晨，那人来到我这里，我的口已经开了，不再作哑巴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那人来到的前一天晚上，耶和华的手按在我身上，开了我的口。到了早晨，那人来到我这里，我的口已经开了，不再作哑巴。
verses.textZhCuv: 逃来的人未到前一日的晚上，耶和华的灵 降在我身上，开我的口。到第二日早晨，那人来到我这里，我口就开了，不再缄默。
verses.textEnNiv: Now the evening before the man arrived, the hand of the Lord was on me, and he opened my mouth before the man came to me in the morning. So my mouth was opened and I was no longer silent.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the hand of the Lord had been upon me the evening before the fugitive came; and he had opened my mouth by the time the man came to me in the morning, so my mouth was opened, and I was no longer mute.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the hand of the Lord had been upon me the evening before the man came who had escaped. And He had opened my mouth; so when he came to me in the morning, my mouth was opened, and I was no longer mute.
verses.textEnNlt: The previous evening the Lord had taken hold of me and given me back my voice. So I was able to speak when this man arrived the next morning.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the hand of the Lord had been upon me in the evening, before the survivors came. And He opened my mouth at the time they came to me in the morning; so my mouth was opened and I was no longer speechless.
verses.textEn: Now the evening before the man arrived, the hand of the Lord was on me, and he opened my mouth before the man came to me in the morning. So my mouth was opened and I was no longer silent.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then the word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: Then this message came to me from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: Then the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: Then the word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: "人子啊！那些住在以色列地废墟里的人常说：‘亚伯拉罕一个人就得了这地为业；我们人数众多，这地更应该给我们为业。’
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！那些住在以色列地废墟里的人常说：‘亚伯拉罕一个人就得了这地为业；我们人数众多，这地更应该给我们为业。’
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，住在以色列荒废之地的人说：『亚伯拉罕独自一人能得这地为业，我们人数众多，这地更是给我们为业的。』
verses.textEnNiv: "Son of man, the people living in those ruins in the land of Israel are saying, ‘Abraham was only one man, yet he possessed the land. But we are many; surely the land has been given to us as our possession.’
verses.textEnEsv: "Son of man, the inhabitants of these waste places in the land of Israel keep saying, ‘Abraham was only one man, yet he got possession of the land; but we are many; the land is surely given us to possess.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "Son of man, they who inhabit those ruins in the land of Israel are saying, ‘Abraham was only one, and he inherited the land. But we are many; the land has been given to us as a possession.’
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, the scattered remnants of Israel living among the ruined cities keep saying, ‘Abraham was only one man, yet he gained possession of the entire land. We are many; surely the land has been given to us as a possession.’
verses.textEnNasb: "Son of man, they who live in these ruins in the land of Israel are saying, ‘Abraham was only one, yet he possessed the land; so to us who are many the land has been given as a possession.’
verses.textEn: "Son of man, the people living in those ruins in the land of Israel are saying, ‘Abraham was only one man, yet he possessed the land. But we are many; surely the land has been given to us as our possession.’

verses.textZh: 因此，你要对他们说：‘主耶和华这样说：你们吃带血的祭肉，举目仰望你们的偶像，并且流人的血，你们还可以得这地为业吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，你要对他们说：‘主耶和华这样说：你们吃带血的祭肉，举目仰望你们的偶像，并且流人的血，你们还可以得这地为业吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 所以你要对他们说，主耶和华如此说：你们吃带血的物，仰望偶像，并且杀人流血，你们还能得这地为业吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Since you eat meat with the blood still in it and look to your idols and shed blood, should you then possess the land?
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore say to them, Thus says the Lord God : You eat flesh with the blood and lift up your eyes to your idols and shed blood; shall you then possess the land?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord God: "You eat meat with blood, you lift up your eyes toward your idols, and shed blood. Should you then possess the land?
verses.textEnNlt: So tell these people, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: You eat meat with blood in it, you worship idols, and you murder the innocent. Do you really think the land should be yours?
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore say to them, ‘This is what the Lord God says: "You eat meat with the blood in it, raise your eyes to your idols as you shed blood. Should you then possess the land?
verses.textEn: Therefore say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Since you eat meat with the blood still in it and look to your idols and shed blood, should you then possess the land?

verses.textZh: 你们倚仗自己的刀剑，行可憎恶的事，人人玷污邻舍的妻子，你们还可以得这地为业吗？’
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们倚仗自己的刀剑，行可憎恶的事，人人玷污邻舍的妻子，你们还可以得这地为业吗？’
verses.textZhCuv: 你们倚仗自己的刀剑行可憎的事，人人玷污邻舍的妻，你们还能得这地为业吗？
verses.textEnNiv: You rely on your sword, you do detestable things, and each of you defiles his neighbor’s wife. Should you then possess the land?’
verses.textEnEsv: You rely on the sword, you commit abominations, and each of you defiles his neighbor’s wife; shall you then possess the land?
verses.textEnNkjv: You rely on your sword, you commit abominations, and you defile one another’s wives. Should you then possess the land?" ’
verses.textEnNlt: Murderers! Idolaters! Adulterers! Should the land belong to you?’
verses.textEnNasb: You rely on your sword, you commit abominations, and each of you defiles his neighbor’s wife. Should you then possess the land?" ’
verses.textEn: You rely on your sword, you do detestable things, and each of you defiles his neighbor’s wife. Should you then possess the land?’

verses.textZh: 你要对他们这样说：‘主耶和华这样说：我指着我的永生起誓，那些在废墟里的，必倒在刀下；在田间的，我必交给野兽吞吃；在堡垒和山洞里的，必因瘟疫而死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要对他们这样说：‘主耶和华这样说：我指着我的永生起誓，那些在废墟里的，必倒在刀下；在田间的，我必交给野兽吞吃；在堡垒和山洞里的，必因瘟疫而死。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要对他们这样说，主耶和华如此说：我指着我的永生起誓，在荒场中的，必倒在刀下；在田野间的，必交给野兽吞吃；在保障和洞里的，必遭瘟疫而死。
verses.textEnNiv: "Say this to them: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: As surely as I live, those who are left in the ruins will fall by the sword, those out in the country I will give to the wild animals to be devoured, and those in strongholds and caves will die of a plague.
verses.textEnEsv: Say this to them, Thus says the Lord God : As I live, surely those who are in the waste places shall fall by the sword, and whoever is in the open field I will give to the beasts to be devoured, and those who are in strongholds and in caves shall die by pestilence.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Say thus to them, ‘Thus says the Lord God: "As I live, surely those who are in the ruins shall fall by the sword, and the one who is in the open field I will give to the beasts to be devoured, and those who are in the strongholds and caves shall die of the pestilence.
verses.textEnNlt: "Say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: As surely as I live, those living in the ruins will die by the sword. And I will send wild animals to eat those living in the open fields. Those hiding in the forts and caves will die of disease.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall say this to them: ‘This is what the Lord God says: "As I live, those who are in the places of ruins certainly will fall by the sword, and whoever is in the open field I will give to the animals to be devoured, and those who are in the strongholds and in the caves will die of plague.
verses.textEn: "Say this to them: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: As surely as I live, those who are left in the ruins will fall by the sword, those out in the country I will give to the wild animals to be devoured, and those in strongholds and caves will die of a plague.

verses.textZh: 我必使这地非常荒凉，它因势力而有的骄傲必止息；以色列的山都必荒凉，无人经过。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必使这地非常荒凉，它因势力而有的骄傲必止息；以色列的山都必荒凉，无人经过。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必使这地荒凉，令人惊骇；她因势力而有的骄傲也必止息。以色列的山都必荒凉，无人经过。
verses.textEnNiv: I will make the land a desolate waste, and her proud strength will come to an end, and the mountains of Israel will become desolate so that no one will cross them.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will make the land a desolation and a waste, and her proud might shall come to an end, and the mountains of Israel shall be so desolate that none will pass through.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I will make the land most desolate, her arrogant strength shall cease, and the mountains of Israel shall be so desolate that no one will pass through.
verses.textEnNlt: I will completely destroy the land and demolish her pride. Her arrogant power will come to an end. The mountains of Israel will be so desolate that no one will even travel through them.
verses.textEnNasb: And I will make the land a desolation and a waste, and the pride of her power will be brought to an end; and the mountains of Israel will be deserted so that no one will pass through.
verses.textEn: I will make the land a desolate waste, and her proud strength will come to an end, and the mountains of Israel will become desolate so that no one will cross them.

verses.textZh: 我必因他们所行一切可憎恶的事，使这地非常荒凉，那时他们就知道我是耶和华。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必因他们所行一切可憎恶的事，使这地非常荒凉，那时他们就知道我是耶和华。’
verses.textZhCuv: 我因他们所行一切可憎的事使地荒凉，令人惊骇。那时，他们就知道我是耶和华。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then they will know that I am the Lord , when I have made the land a desolate waste because of all the detestable things they have done.’
verses.textEnEsv: Then they will know that I am the Lord , when I have made the land a desolation and a waste because of all their abominations that they have committed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they shall know that I am the Lord, when I have made the land most desolate because of all their abominations which they have committed." ’
verses.textEnNlt: When I have completely destroyed the land because of their detestable sins, then they will know that I am the Lord .’
verses.textEnNasb: Then they will know that I am the Lord, when I make the land a desolation and a waste because of all their abominations which they have committed." ’
verses.textEn: Then they will know that I am the Lord , when I have made the land a desolate waste because of all the detestable things they have done.’

verses.textZh: "人子啊！你本国的人在城墙旁边和各家的门口正在谈论你；弟兄对弟兄彼此说：‘来吧！听听有甚么话从耶和华那里出来。’
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！你本国的人在城墙旁边和各家的门口正在谈论你；弟兄对弟兄彼此说：‘来吧！听听有甚么话从耶和华那里出来。’
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，你本国的子民在墙垣旁边、在房屋门口谈论你。弟兄对弟兄彼此说：『来吧！听听有什么话从耶和华而出。』
verses.textEnNiv: "As for you, son of man, your people are talking together about you by the walls and at the doors of the houses, saying to each other, ‘Come and hear the message that has come from the Lord .’
verses.textEnEsv: "As for you, son of man, your people who talk together about you by the walls and at the doors of the houses say to one another, each to his brother, ‘Come, and hear what the word is that comes from the Lord .’
verses.textEnNkjv: "As for you, son of man, the children of your people are talking about you beside the walls and in the doors of the houses; and they speak to one another, everyone saying to his brother, ‘Please come and hear what the word is that comes from the Lord.’
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, your people talk about you in their houses and whisper about you at the doors. They say to each other, ‘Come on, let’s go hear the prophet tell us what the Lord is saying!’
verses.textEnNasb: "But as for you, son of man, your fellow citizens who talk with one another about you by the walls and in the doorways of the houses, speak one with another, each with his brother, saying, ‘Come now and hear what the message is that comes from the Lord.’
verses.textEn: "As for you, son of man, your people are talking together about you by the walls and at the doors of the houses, saying to each other, ‘Come and hear the message that has come from the Lord .’

verses.textZh: 他们成群来到你那里，坐在你面前，像是我的子民一样。其实他们听了你的话，却不去行；他们只是用口表示爱慕，他们的心却是追随不义之财。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们成群来到你那里，坐在你面前，像是我的子民一样。其实他们听了你的话，却不去行；他们只是用口表示爱慕，他们的心却是追随不义之财。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们来到你这里如同民来聚会，坐在你面前仿佛是我的民。他们听你的话却不去行；因为他们的口多显爱情，心却追随财利。
verses.textEnNiv: My people come to you, as they usually do, and sit before you to hear your words, but they do not put them into practice. Their mouths speak of love, but their hearts are greedy for unjust gain.
verses.textEnEsv: And they come to you as people come, and they sit before you as my people, and they hear what you say but they will not do it; for with lustful talk in their mouths they act; their heart is set on their gain.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they come to you as people do, they sit before you as My people, and they hear your words, but they do not do them; for with their mouth they show much love, but their hearts pursue their own gain.
verses.textEnNlt: So my people come pretending to be sincere and sit before you. They listen to your words, but they have no intention of doing what you say. Their mouths are full of lustful words, and their hearts seek only after money.
verses.textEnNasb: And they come to you as people come, and sit before you as My people and hear your words, but they do not do them; for they do the lustful desires expressed by their mouth, and their heart follows their unlawful gain.
verses.textEn: My people come to you, as they usually do, and sit before you to hear your words, but they do not put them into practice. Their mouths speak of love, but their hearts are greedy for unjust gain.

verses.textZh: 在他们眼中，你不过是首情歌，唱得美妙，弹得悦耳，他们听了你的话，却不去行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在他们眼中，你不过是首情歌，唱得美妙，弹得悦耳，他们听了你的话，却不去行。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们看你如善于奏乐、声音幽雅之人所唱的雅歌，他们听你的话却不去行。
verses.textEnNiv: Indeed, to them you are nothing more than one who sings love songs with a beautiful voice and plays an instrument well, for they hear your words but do not put them into practice.
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, you are to them like one who sings lustful songs with a beautiful voice and plays well on an instrument, for they hear what you say, but they will not do it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Indeed you are to them as a very lovely song of one who has a pleasant voice and can play well on an instrument; for they hear your words, but they do not do them.
verses.textEnNlt: You are very entertaining to them, like someone who sings love songs with a beautiful voice or plays fine music on an instrument. They hear what you say, but they don’t act on it!
verses.textEnNasb: And behold, you are to them like a love song by one who has a beautiful voice and plays well on an instrument; for they hear your words but they do not practice them.
verses.textEn: Indeed, to them you are nothing more than one who sings love songs with a beautiful voice and plays an instrument well, for they hear your words but do not put them into practice.

verses.textZh: 看哪！这事必定应验，到那时候，他们就知道在他们中间有先知了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！这事必定应验，到那时候，他们就知道在他们中间有先知了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，所说的快要应验；应验了，他们就知道在他们中间有了先知。」
verses.textEnNiv: "When all this comes true—and it surely will—then they will know that a prophet has been among them."
verses.textEnEsv: When this comes—and come it will!— then they will know that a prophet has been among them."
verses.textEnNkjv: And when this comes to pass—surely it will come—then they will know that a prophet has been among them."
verses.textEnNlt: But when all these terrible things happen to them—as they certainly will—then they will know a prophet has been among them."
verses.textEnNasb: So when it comes— as it certainly will—then they will know that a prophet has been among them."
verses.textEn: "When all this comes true—and it surely will—then they will know that a prophet has been among them."

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnNkjv: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then this message came to me from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: Then the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: The word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: "人子啊！你要说预言攻击以色列众牧者；你要对他们说预言：‘主耶和华这样说：以色列众牧者有祸了！他们只顾牧养自己。牧者岂不应当牧养羊群吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！你要说预言攻击以色列众牧者；你要对他们说预言：‘主耶和华这样说：以色列众牧者有祸了！他们只顾牧养自己。牧者岂不应当牧养羊群吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，你要向以色列的牧人发预言，攻击他们，说，主耶和华如此说：祸哉！以色列的牧人只知牧养自己。牧人岂不当牧养群羊吗？
verses.textEnNiv: "Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel; prophesy and say to them: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Woe to you shepherds of Israel who only take care of yourselves! Should not shepherds take care of the flock?
verses.textEnEsv: "Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel; prophesy, and say to them, even to the shepherds, Thus says the Lord God : Ah, shepherds of Israel who have been feeding yourselves! Should not shepherds feed the sheep?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel, prophesy and say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord God to the shepherds: "Woe to the shepherds of Israel who feed themselves! Should not the shepherds feed the flocks?
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds, the leaders of Israel. Give them this message from the Sovereign Lord : What sorrow awaits you shepherds who feed yourselves instead of your flocks. Shouldn’t shepherds feed their sheep?
verses.textEnNasb: "Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel. Prophesy and say to those shepherds, ‘This is what the Lord God says: "Woe, shepherds of Israel who have been feeding themselves! Should the shepherds not feed the flock?
verses.textEn: "Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel; prophesy and say to them: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Woe to you shepherds of Israel who only take care of yourselves! Should not shepherds take care of the flock?

verses.textZh: 你们吃脂油、穿羊毛，宰肥壮的羊，却不牧养羊群。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们吃脂油、穿羊毛，宰肥壮的羊，却不牧养羊群。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们吃脂油、穿羊毛、宰肥壮的，却不牧养群羊。
verses.textEnNiv: You eat the curds, clothe yourselves with the wool and slaughter the choice animals, but you do not take care of the flock.
verses.textEnEsv: You eat the fat, you clothe yourselves with the wool, you slaughter the fat ones, but you do not feed the sheep.
verses.textEnNkjv: You eat the fat and clothe yourselves with the wool; you slaughter the fatlings, but you do not feed the flock.
verses.textEnNlt: You drink the milk, wear the wool, and butcher the best animals, but you let your flocks starve.
verses.textEnNasb: You eat the fat and clothe yourselves with the wool, you slaughter the fat sheep without feeding the flock.
verses.textEn: You eat the curds, clothe yourselves with the wool and slaughter the choice animals, but you do not take care of the flock.

verses.textZh: 瘦弱的，你们没有养壮；患病的，你们没有医治；受伤的，你们没有包扎；被赶散的，你们没有领回；迷失的，你们没有寻找；你们反而用强暴严严地管辖牠们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 瘦弱的，你们没有养壮；患病的，你们没有医治；受伤的，你们没有包扎；被赶散的，你们没有领回；迷失的，你们没有寻找；你们反而用强暴严严地管辖牠们。
verses.textZhCuv: 瘦弱的，你们没有养壮；有病的，你们没有医治；受伤的，你们没有缠裹；被逐的，你们没有领回；失丧的，你们没有寻找；但用强暴严严地辖制。
verses.textEnNiv: You have not strengthened the weak or healed the sick or bound up the injured. You have not brought back the strays or searched for the lost. You have ruled them harshly and brutally.
verses.textEnEsv: The weak you have not strengthened, the sick you have not healed, the injured you have not bound up, the strayed you have not brought back, the lost you have not sought, and with force and harshness you have ruled them.
verses.textEnNkjv: The weak you have not strengthened, nor have you healed those who were sick, nor bound up the broken, nor brought back what was driven away, nor sought what was lost; but with force and cruelty you have ruled them.
verses.textEnNlt: You have not taken care of the weak. You have not tended the sick or bound up the injured. You have not gone looking for those who have wandered away and are lost. Instead, you have ruled them with harshness and cruelty.
verses.textEnNasb: Those who are sickly you have not strengthened, the diseased you have not healed, the broken you have not bound up, the scattered you have not brought back, nor have you searched for the lost; but with force and with violence you have dominated them.
verses.textEn: You have not strengthened the weak or healed the sick or bound up the injured. You have not brought back the strays or searched for the lost. You have ruled them harshly and brutally.

verses.textZh: 牠们没有牧人，就分散了，作了田野一切走兽的食物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠们没有牧人，就分散了，作了田野一切走兽的食物。
verses.textZhCuv: 因无牧人，羊就分散；既分散，便作了一切野兽的食物。
verses.textEnNiv: So they were scattered because there was no shepherd, and when they were scattered they became food for all the wild animals.
verses.textEnEsv: So they were scattered, because there was no shepherd, and they became food for all the wild beasts. My sheep were scattered;
verses.textEnNkjv: So they were scattered because therewas no shepherd; and they became food for all the beasts of the field when they were scattered.
verses.textEnNlt: So my sheep have been scattered without a shepherd, and they are easy prey for any wild animal.
verses.textEnNasb: They scattered for lack of a shepherd, and they became food for every animal of the field and scattered.
verses.textEn: So they were scattered because there was no shepherd, and when they were scattered they became food for all the wild animals.

verses.textZh: 我的羊在众山和各高冈上流离；牠们分散在全地上，没有人去寻，也没有人去找。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的羊在众山和各高冈上流离；牠们分散在全地上，没有人去寻，也没有人去找。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的羊在诸山间、在各高冈上流离，在全地上分散，无人去寻，无人去找。
verses.textEnNiv: My sheep wandered over all the mountains and on every high hill. They were scattered over the whole earth, and no one searched or looked for them.
verses.textEnEsv: they wandered over all the mountains and on every high hill. My sheep were scattered over all the face of the earth, with none to search or seek for them.
verses.textEnNkjv: My sheep wandered through all the mountains, and on every high hill; yes, My flock was scattered over the whole face of the earth, and no one was seeking or searching forthem."
verses.textEnNlt: They have wandered through all the mountains and all the hills, across the face of the earth, yet no one has gone to search for them.
verses.textEnNasb: My flock strayed through all the mountains and on every high hill; My flock was scattered over all the surface of the earth, and there was no one to search or seek for them." ’ "
verses.textEn: My sheep wandered over all the mountains and on every high hill. They were scattered over the whole earth, and no one searched or looked for them.

verses.textZh: "‘因此，你们这些作牧者的，要听耶和华的话：
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘因此，你们这些作牧者的，要听耶和华的话：
verses.textZhCuv: 「所以，你们这些牧人要听耶和华的话。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Therefore, you shepherds, hear the word of the Lord :
verses.textEnEsv: "Therefore, you shepherds, hear the word of the Lord :
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Therefore, you shepherds, hear the word of the Lord:
verses.textEnNlt: "Therefore, you shepherds, hear the word of the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, you shepherds, hear the word of the Lord:
verses.textEn: " ‘Therefore, you shepherds, hear the word of the Lord :

verses.textZh: 我指着我的永生起誓，我的羊因没有牧人，就成了猎物，作了田野一切走兽的食物。我的众牧者不寻找我的羊；他们只顾牧养自己，却不牧养我的羊。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我指着我的永生起誓，我的羊因没有牧人，就成了猎物，作了田野一切走兽的食物。我的众牧者不寻找我的羊；他们只顾牧养自己，却不牧养我的羊。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华说：我指着我的永生起誓，我的羊因无牧人就成为掠物，也作了一切野兽的食物。我的牧人不寻找我的羊；这些牧人只知牧养自己，并不牧养我的羊。
verses.textEnNiv: As surely as I live, declares the Sovereign Lord , because my flock lacks a shepherd and so has been plundered and has become food for all the wild animals, and because my shepherds did not search for my flock but cared for themselves rather than for my flock,
verses.textEnEsv: As I live, declares the Lord God , surely because my sheep have become a prey, and my sheep have become food for all the wild beasts, since there was no shepherd, and because my shepherds have not searched for my sheep, but the shepherds have fed themselves, and have not fed my sheep,
verses.textEnNkjv: "As I live," says the Lord God, "surely because My flock became a prey, and My flock became food for every beast of the field, because therewas no shepherd, nor did My shepherds search for My flock, but the shepherds fed themselves and did not feed My flock"—
verses.textEnNlt: As surely as I live, says the Sovereign Lord , you abandoned my flock and left them to be attacked by every wild animal. And though you were my shepherds, you didn’t search for my sheep when they were lost. You took care of yourselves and left the sheep to starve.
verses.textEnNasb: "As I live," declares the Lord God, "certainly, because My flock has become plunder, and My flock has become food for all the animals of the field for lack of a shepherd, and My shepherds did not search for My flock, but rather the shepherds fed themselves and did not feed My flock,
verses.textEn: As surely as I live, declares the Sovereign Lord , because my flock lacks a shepherd and so has been plundered and has become food for all the wild animals, and because my shepherds did not search for my flock but cared for themselves rather than for my flock,

verses.textZh: 因此，你们这些作牧者的，要听耶和华的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，你们这些作牧者的，要听耶和华的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以你们这些牧人要听耶和华的话。
verses.textEnNiv: therefore, you shepherds, hear the word of the Lord :
verses.textEnEsv: therefore, you shepherds, hear the word of the Lord :
verses.textEnNkjv: therefore, O shepherds, hear the word of the Lord!
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, you shepherds, hear the word of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: therefore, you shepherds, hear the word of the Lord:
verses.textEn: therefore, you shepherds, hear the word of the Lord :

verses.textZh: 主耶和华这样说：看哪！我要与众牧者为敌；我必向他们追讨我的羊，使他们不再牧养羊群，也不再牧养自己。我必救我的羊脱离他们的口，不再作他们的食物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主耶和华这样说：看哪！我要与众牧者为敌；我必向他们追讨我的羊，使他们不再牧养羊群，也不再牧养自己。我必救我的羊脱离他们的口，不再作他们的食物。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华如此说：我必与牧人为敌，必向他们的手追讨我的羊，使他们不再牧放群羊；牧人也不再牧养自己。我必救我的羊脱离他们的口，不再作他们的食物。」
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I am against the shepherds and will hold them accountable for my flock. I will remove them from tending the flock so that the shepherds can no longer feed themselves. I will rescue my flock from their mouths, and it will no longer be food for them.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord God , Behold, I am against the shepherds, and I will require my sheep at their hand and put a stop to their feeding the sheep. No longer shall the shepherds feed themselves. I will rescue my sheep from their mouths, that they may not be food for them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord God: "Behold, I am against the shepherds, and I will require My flock at their hand; I will cause them to cease feeding the sheep, and the shepherds shall feed themselves no more; for I will deliver My flock from their mouths, that they may no longer be food for them."
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I now consider these shepherds my enemies, and I will hold them responsible for what has happened to my flock. I will take away their right to feed the flock, and I will stop them from feeding themselves. I will rescue my flock from their mouths; the sheep will no longer be their prey.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘This is what the Lord God says: "Behold, I am against the shepherds, and I will demand My sheep from them and make them stop tending sheep. So the shepherds will not feed themselves anymore, but I will save My sheep from their mouth, so that they will not be food for them." ’ "
verses.textEn: This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I am against the shepherds and will hold them accountable for my flock. I will remove them from tending the flock so that the shepherds can no longer feed themselves. I will rescue my flock from their mouths, and it will no longer be food for them.

verses.textZh: "‘因为主耶和华这样说：看哪！我必亲自寻觅我的羊，把牠们找出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘因为主耶和华这样说：看哪！我必亲自寻觅我的羊，把牠们找出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 「主耶和华如此说：看哪，我必亲自寻找我的羊，将它们寻见。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘For this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I myself will search for my sheep and look after them.
verses.textEnEsv: "For thus says the Lord God : Behold, I, I myself will search for my sheep and will seek them out.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘For thus says the Lord God: "Indeed I Myself will search for My sheep and seek them out.
verses.textEnNlt: "For this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I myself will search and find my sheep.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Lord God says this: "Behold, I Myself will search for My sheep and look after them.
verses.textEn: " ‘For this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I myself will search for my sheep and look after them.

verses.textZh: 牧人在他的羊群四散的时候，怎样寻找他的羊，我也必照样寻找我的羊。这些羊在密云幽暗的日子四散到各处，我要把牠们从那里救回来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牧人在他的羊群四散的时候，怎样寻找他的羊，我也必照样寻找我的羊。这些羊在密云幽暗的日子四散到各处，我要把牠们从那里救回来。
verses.textZhCuv: 牧人在羊群四散的日子怎样寻找他的羊，我必照样寻找我的羊。这些羊在密云黑暗的日子散到各处，我必从那里救回它们来。
verses.textEnNiv: As a shepherd looks after his scattered flock when he is with them, so will I look after my sheep. I will rescue them from all the places where they were scattered on a day of clouds and darkness.
verses.textEnEsv: As a shepherd seeks out his flock when he is among his sheep that have been scattered, so will I seek out my sheep, and I will rescue them from all places where they have been scattered on a day of clouds and thick darkness.
verses.textEnNkjv: As a shepherd seeks out his flock on the day he is among his scattered sheep, so will I seek out My sheep and deliver them from all the places where they were scattered on a cloudy and dark day.
verses.textEnNlt: I will be like a shepherd looking for his scattered flock. I will find my sheep and rescue them from all the places where they were scattered on that dark and cloudy day.
verses.textEnNasb: As a shepherd cares for his flock on a day when he is among his scattered sheep, so I will care for My sheep and will rescue them from all the places where they were scattered on a cloudy and gloomy day.
verses.textEn: As a shepherd looks after his scattered flock when he is with them, so will I look after my sheep. I will rescue them from all the places where they were scattered on a day of clouds and darkness.

verses.textZh: 我必把牠们从万族中领出来，从列邦中聚集牠们，领牠们归回故土。我必在以色列的群山上，在众溪水旁，在国内一切居住的地方，牧养牠们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必把牠们从万族中领出来，从列邦中聚集牠们，领牠们归回故土。我必在以色列的群山上，在众溪水旁，在国内一切居住的地方，牧养牠们。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必从万民中领出它们，从各国内聚集它们，引导它们归回故土，也必在以色列山上－一切溪水旁边、境内一切可居之处－牧养它们。
verses.textEnNiv: I will bring them out from the nations and gather them from the countries, and I will bring them into their own land. I will pasture them on the mountains of Israel, in the ravines and in all the settlements in the land.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will bring them out from the peoples and gather them from the countries, and will bring them into their own land. And I will feed them on the mountains of Israel, by the ravines, and in all the inhabited places of the country.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will bring them out from the peoples and gather them from the countries, and will bring them to their own land; I will feed them on the mountains of Israel, in the valleys and in all the inhabited places of the country.
verses.textEnNlt: I will bring them back home to their own land of Israel from among the peoples and nations. I will feed them on the mountains of Israel and by the rivers and in all the places where people live.
verses.textEnNasb: I will bring them out from the peoples and gather them from the countries and bring them to their own land; and I will feed them on the mountains of Israel, by the streams, and in all the inhabited places of the land.
verses.textEn: I will bring them out from the nations and gather them from the countries, and I will bring them into their own land. I will pasture them on the mountains of Israel, in the ravines and in all the settlements in the land.

verses.textZh: 我必在美好的草场上牧养牠们，以色列的高山必作牧放牠们的地方。在那里牠们必躺卧在美好的牧场上，牠们必在以色列群山肥美的草场上吃草。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必在美好的草场上牧养牠们，以色列的高山必作牧放牠们的地方。在那里牠们必躺卧在美好的牧场上，牠们必在以色列群山肥美的草场上吃草。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必在美好的草场牧养它们。它们的圈必在以色列高处的山上，它们必在佳美之圈中躺卧，也在以色列山肥美的草场吃草。
verses.textEnNiv: I will tend them in a good pasture, and the mountain heights of Israel will be their grazing land. There they will lie down in good grazing land, and there they will feed in a rich pasture on the mountains of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: I will feed them with good pasture, and on the mountain heights of Israel shall be their grazing land. There they shall lie down in good grazing land, and on rich pasture they shall feed on the mountains of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will feed them in good pasture, and their fold shall be on the high mountains of Israel. There they shall lie down in a good fold and feed in rich pasture on the mountains of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, I will give them good pastureland on the high hills of Israel. There they will lie down in pleasant places and feed in the lush pastures of the hills.
verses.textEnNasb: I will feed them in a good pasture, and their grazing place will be on the mountain heights of Israel. There they will lie down in a good grazing place and feed in rich pasture on the mountains of Israel.
verses.textEn: I will tend them in a good pasture, and the mountain heights of Israel will be their grazing land. There they will lie down in good grazing land, and there they will feed in a rich pasture on the mountains of Israel.

verses.textZh: 我必亲自牧养我的羊，亲自使牠们躺卧。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必亲自牧养我的羊，亲自使牠们躺卧。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华说：我必亲自作我羊的牧人，使它们得以躺卧。
verses.textEnNiv: I myself will tend my sheep and have them lie down, declares the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: I myself will be the shepherd of my sheep, and I myself will make them lie down, declares the Lord God .
verses.textEnNkjv: I will feed My flock, and I will make them lie down," says the Lord God.
verses.textEnNlt: I myself will tend my sheep and give them a place to lie down in peace, says the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: I Myself will feed My flock and I Myself will lead them to rest," declares the Lord God.
verses.textEn: I myself will tend my sheep and have them lie down, declares the Sovereign Lord .

verses.textZh: 迷失的，我必寻找；被赶散的，我必领回；受伤的，我必包扎；患病的，我必养壮；肥壮的，我却要除灭。我也必按着公正牧养牠们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 迷失的，我必寻找；被赶散的，我必领回；受伤的，我必包扎；患病的，我必养壮；肥壮的，我却要除灭。我也必按着公正牧养牠们。
verses.textZhCuv: 失丧的，我必寻找；被逐的，我必领回；受伤的，我必缠裹；有病的，我必医治；只是肥的壮的，我必除灭，也要秉公牧养它们。
verses.textEnNiv: I will search for the lost and bring back the strays. I will bind up the injured and strengthen the weak, but the sleek and the strong I will destroy. I will shepherd the flock with justice.
verses.textEnEsv: I will seek the lost, and I will bring back the strayed, and I will bind up the injured, and I will strengthen the weak, and the fat and the strong I will destroy. I will feed them in justice.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I will seek what was lost and bring back what was driven away, bind up the broken and strengthen what was sick; but I will destroy the fat and the strong, and feed them in judgment."
verses.textEnNlt: I will search for my lost ones who strayed away, and I will bring them safely home again. I will bandage the injured and strengthen the weak. But I will destroy those who are fat and powerful. I will feed them, yes—feed them justice!
verses.textEnNasb: "I will seek the lost, bring back the scattered, bind up the broken, and strengthen the sick; but the fat and the strong I will eliminate. I will feed them with judgment.
verses.textEn: I will search for the lost and bring back the strays. I will bind up the injured and strengthen the weak, but the sleek and the strong I will destroy. I will shepherd the flock with justice.

verses.textZh: "‘我的羊啊！论到你们，主耶和华这样说：我要在羊与羊之间，在公绵羊与公山羊之间，施行审判。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘我的羊啊！论到你们，主耶和华这样说：我要在羊与羊之间，在公绵羊与公山羊之间，施行审判。
verses.textZhCuv: 「我的羊群哪，论到你们，主耶和华如此说：我必在羊与羊中间、公绵羊与公山羊中间施行判断。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘As for you, my flock, this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I will judge between one sheep and another, and between rams and goats.
verses.textEnEsv: "As for you, my flock, thus says the Lord God : Behold, I judge between sheep and sheep, between rams and male goats.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘And asfor you, O My flock, thus says the Lord God: "Behold, I shall judge between sheep and sheep, between rams and goats.
verses.textEnNlt: "And as for you, my flock, this is what the Sovereign Lord says to his people: I will judge between one animal of the flock and another, separating the sheep from the goats.
verses.textEnNasb: "As for you, My flock, this is what the Lord God says: ‘Behold, I am going to judge between one sheep and another, between the rams and the male goats.
verses.textEn: " ‘As for you, my flock, this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I will judge between one sheep and another, and between rams and goats.

verses.textZh: 你们在美好的草场上吃草，还不知足吗？剩下的草，你们竟用脚践踏；你们喝了清水，剩下的你们竟用脚搅浊。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们在美好的草场上吃草，还不知足吗？剩下的草，你们竟用脚践踏；你们喝了清水，剩下的你们竟用脚搅浊。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们这些肥壮的羊，在美好的草场吃草还以为小事吗？剩下的草，你们竟用蹄践踏了；你们喝清水，剩下的水，你们竟用蹄搅浑了。
verses.textEnNiv: Is it not enough for you to feed on the good pasture? Must you also trample the rest of your pasture with your feet? Is it not enough for you to drink clear water? Must you also muddy the rest with your feet?
verses.textEnEsv: Is it not enough for you to feed on the good pasture, that you must tread down with your feet the rest of your pasture; and to drink of clear water, that you must muddy the rest of the water with your feet?
verses.textEnNkjv: Isit too little for you to have eaten up the good pasture, that you must tread down with your feet the residue of your pasture—and to have drunk of the clear waters, that you must foul the residue with your feet?
verses.textEnNlt: Isn’t it enough for you to keep the best of the pastures for yourselves? Must you also trample down the rest? Isn’t it enough for you to drink clear water for yourselves? Must you also muddy the rest with your feet?
verses.textEnNasb: Is it too little a thing for you to feed in the good pasture, that you must trample with your feet the rest of your pastures? Or too little for you to drink the clear waters, that you must muddy the rest with your feet?
verses.textEn: Is it not enough for you to feed on the good pasture? Must you also trample the rest of your pasture with your feet? Is it not enough for you to drink clear water? Must you also muddy the rest with your feet?

verses.textZh: 我的羊，就只能吃你们用脚践踏过的，喝你们用脚搅浊了的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的羊，就只能吃你们用脚践踏过的，喝你们用脚搅浊了的。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于我的羊，只得吃你们所践踏的，喝你们所搅浑的。
verses.textEnNiv: Must my flock feed on what you have trampled and drink what you have muddied with your feet?
verses.textEnEsv: And must my sheep eat what you have trodden with your feet, and drink what you have muddied with your feet?
verses.textEnNkjv: And asfor My flock, they eat what you have trampled with your feet, and they drink what you have fouled with your feet."
verses.textEnNlt: Why must my flock eat what you have trampled down and drink water you have fouled?
verses.textEnNasb: But as for My flock, they must eat what you trample with your feet, and drink what you muddy with your feet!’ "
verses.textEn: Must my flock feed on what you have trampled and drink what you have muddied with your feet?

verses.textZh: "‘因此，主耶和华对牠们这样说：看哪！我必亲自在肥羊与瘦羊之间施行审判。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘因此，主耶和华对牠们这样说：看哪！我必亲自在肥羊与瘦羊之间施行审判。
verses.textZhCuv: 「所以，主耶和华如此说：我必在肥羊和瘦羊中间施行判断。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says to them: See, I myself will judge between the fat sheep and the lean sheep.
verses.textEnEsv: "Therefore, thus says the Lord God to them: Behold, I, I myself will judge between the fat sheep and the lean sheep.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Therefore thus says the Lord God to them: "Behold, I Myself will judge between the fat and the lean sheep.
verses.textEnNlt: "Therefore, this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I will surely judge between the fat sheep and the scrawny sheep.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, this is what the Lord God says to them: "Behold, I, I Myself will also judge between the fat sheep and the lean sheep.
verses.textEn: " ‘Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says to them: See, I myself will judge between the fat sheep and the lean sheep.

verses.textZh: 因为你们用腰用肩拥挤所有瘦弱的，又用角抵触牠们，直到把牠们驱散到外面，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你们用腰用肩拥挤所有瘦弱的，又用角抵触牠们，直到把牠们驱散到外面，
verses.textZhCuv: 因为你们用胁用肩拥挤一切瘦弱的，又用角抵触，以致使它们四散。
verses.textEnNiv: Because you shove with flank and shoulder, butting all the weak sheep with your horns until you have driven them away,
verses.textEnEsv: Because you push with side and shoulder, and thrust at all the weak with your horns, till you have scattered them abroad,
verses.textEnNkjv: Because you have pushed with side and shoulder, butted all the weak ones with your horns, and scattered them abroad,
verses.textEnNlt: For you fat sheep pushed and butted and crowded my sick and hungry flock until you scattered them to distant lands.
verses.textEnNasb: Since you push away with your side and shoulder, and gore all the weak with your horns until you have scattered them abroad,
verses.textEn: Because you shove with flank and shoulder, butting all the weak sheep with your horns until you have driven them away,

verses.textZh: 所以我必拯救我的羊，使牠们不再作猎物。我要在羊与羊之间施行审判。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以我必拯救我的羊，使牠们不再作猎物。我要在羊与羊之间施行审判。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，我必拯救我的群羊不再作掠物；我也必在羊和羊中间施行判断。
verses.textEnNiv: I will save my flock, and they will no longer be plundered. I will judge between one sheep and another.
verses.textEnEsv: I will rescue my flock; they shall no longer be a prey. And I will judge between sheep and sheep.
verses.textEnNkjv: therefore I will save My flock, and they shall no longer be a prey; and I will judge between sheep and sheep.
verses.textEnNlt: So I will rescue my flock, and they will no longer be abused. I will judge between one animal of the flock and another.
verses.textEnNasb: therefore, I will save My flock, and they will no longer be plunder; and I will judge between one sheep and another.
verses.textEn: I will save my flock, and they will no longer be plundered. I will judge between one sheep and another.

verses.textZh: "‘我必立一个牧人，就是我的仆人大卫，看管牠们，牧养牠们。他必牧养牠们，作牠们的牧人。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘我必立一个牧人，就是我的仆人大卫，看管牠们，牧养牠们。他必牧养牠们，作牠们的牧人。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必立一牧人照管他们，牧养他们，就是我的仆人大卫。他必牧养他们，作他们的牧人。
verses.textEnNiv: I will place over them one shepherd, my servant David, and he will tend them; he will tend them and be their shepherd.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will set up over them one shepherd, my servant David, and he shall feed them: he shall feed them and be their shepherd.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will establish one shepherd over them, and he shall feed them— My servant David. He shall feed them and be their shepherd.
verses.textEnNlt: And I will set over them one shepherd, my servant David. He will feed them and be a shepherd to them.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then I will appoint over them one shepherd, My servant David, and he will feed them; he will feed them himself and be their shepherd.
verses.textEn: I will place over them one shepherd, my servant David, and he will tend them; he will tend them and be their shepherd.

verses.textZh: 我耶和华必作牠们的神，我的仆人大卫要在牠们中间作领袖。我耶和华已经说了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我耶和华必作牠们的神，我的仆人大卫要在牠们中间作领袖。我耶和华已经说了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我－耶和华必作他们的神，我的仆人大卫必在他们中间作王。这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: I the Lord will be their God, and my servant David will be prince among them. I the Lord have spoken.
verses.textEnEsv: And I, the Lord , will be their God, and my servant David shall be prince among them. I am the Lord ; I have spoken.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I, the Lord, will be their God, and My servant David a prince among them; I, the Lord, have spoken.
verses.textEnNlt: And I, the Lord , will be their God, and my servant David will be a prince among my people. I, the Lord , have spoken!
verses.textEnNasb: And I, the Lord, will be their God, and My servant David will be prince among them; I the Lord have spoken.
verses.textEn: I the Lord will be their God, and my servant David will be prince among them. I the Lord have spoken.

verses.textZh: "‘我必与牠们立平安的约，使恶兽从境内灭绝，牠们就可以在旷野安居，在树林中躺卧。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘我必与牠们立平安的约，使恶兽从境内灭绝，牠们就可以在旷野安居，在树林中躺卧。
verses.textZhCuv: 「我必与他们立平安的约，使恶兽从境内断绝，他们就必安居在旷野，躺卧在林中。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘I will make a covenant of peace with them and rid the land of savage beasts so that they may live in the wilderness and sleep in the forests in safety.
verses.textEnEsv: "I will make with them a covenant of peace and banish wild beasts from the land, so that they may dwell securely in the wilderness and sleep in the woods.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I will make a covenant of peace with them, and cause wild beasts to cease from the land; and they will dwell safely in the wilderness and sleep in the woods.
verses.textEnNlt: "I will make a covenant of peace with my people and drive away the dangerous animals from the land. Then they will be able to camp safely in the wildest places and sleep in the woods without fear.
verses.textEnNasb: "And I will make a covenant of peace with them and eliminate harmful animals from the land, so that they may live securely in the wilderness and sleep in the woods.
verses.textEn: " ‘I will make a covenant of peace with them and rid the land of savage beasts so that they may live in the wilderness and sleep in the forests in safety.

verses.textZh: 我必使他们和我的山四围都蒙福；我必按时降雨，这就是赐福的雨。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必使他们和我的山四围都蒙福；我必按时降雨，这就是赐福的雨。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必使他们与我山的四围成为福源，我也必叫时雨落下，必有福如甘霖而降。
verses.textEnNiv: I will make them and the places surrounding my hill a blessing. I will send down showers in season; there will be showers of blessing.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will make them and the places all around my hill a blessing, and I will send down the showers in their season; they shall be showers of blessing.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will make them and the places all around My hill a blessing; and I will cause showers to come down in their season; there shall be showers of blessing.
verses.textEnNlt: I will bless my people and their homes around my holy hill. And in the proper season I will send the showers they need. There will be showers of blessing.
verses.textEnNasb: I will make them and the places around My hill a blessing. And I will make showers fall in their season; they will be showers of blessing.
verses.textEn: I will make them and the places surrounding my hill a blessing. I will send down showers in season; there will be showers of blessing.

verses.textZh: 田野的树木必结果子，地也必有出产；他们必在自己的土地上安居。我打断他们所负的轭，救他们脱离奴役者的手的时候，他们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 田野的树木必结果子，地也必有出产；他们必在自己的土地上安居。我打断他们所负的轭，救他们脱离奴役者的手的时候，他们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 田野的树必结果，地也必有出产；他们必在故土安然居住。我折断他们所负的轭，救他们脱离那以他们为奴之人的手；那时，他们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: The trees will yield their fruit and the ground will yield its crops; the people will be secure in their land. They will know that I am the Lord , when I break the bars of their yoke and rescue them from the hands of those who enslaved them.
verses.textEnEsv: And the trees of the field shall yield their fruit, and the earth shall yield its increase, and they shall be secure in their land. And they shall know that I am the Lord , when I break the bars of their yoke, and deliver them from the hand of those who enslaved them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the trees of the field shall yield their fruit, and the earth shall yield her increase. They shall be safe in their land; and they shall know that I am the Lord, when I have broken the bands of their yoke and delivered them from the hand of those who enslaved them.
verses.textEnNlt: The orchards and fields of my people will yield bumper crops, and everyone will live in safety. When I have broken their chains of slavery and rescued them from those who enslaved them, then they will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Also the tree of the field will yield its fruit and the earth will yield its produce, and they will be secure on their land. Then they will know that I am the Lord, when I have broken the bars of their yoke and have saved them from the hand of those who enslaved them.
verses.textEn: The trees will yield their fruit and the ground will yield its crops; the people will be secure in their land. They will know that I am the Lord , when I break the bars of their yoke and rescue them from the hands of those who enslaved them.

verses.textZh: 他们必不再作列国的猎物，地上的野兽也不再吞吃他们；他们必安然居住，没有人惊吓他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们必不再作列国的猎物，地上的野兽也不再吞吃他们；他们必安然居住，没有人惊吓他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必不再作外邦人的掠物，地上的野兽也不再吞吃他们；却要安然居住，无人惊吓。
verses.textEnNiv: They will no longer be plundered by the nations, nor will wild animals devour them. They will live in safety, and no one will make them afraid.
verses.textEnEsv: They shall no more be a prey to the nations, nor shall the beasts of the land devour them. They shall dwell securely, and none shall make them afraid.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they shall no longer be a prey for the nations, nor shall beasts of the land devour them; but they shall dwell safely, and no one shall make them afraid.
verses.textEnNlt: They will no longer be prey for other nations, and wild animals will no longer devour them. They will live in safety, and no one will frighten them.
verses.textEnNasb: They will no longer be plunder to the nations, and the animals of the earth will not devour them; but they will live securely, and no one will make them afraid.
verses.textEn: They will no longer be plundered by the nations, nor will wild animals devour them. They will live in safety, and no one will make them afraid.

verses.textZh: 我必给他们兴起一个以种植闻名的地方，使他们在境内不再被饥荒消灭，也不再担当列国的羞辱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必给他们兴起一个以种植闻名的地方，使他们在境内不再被饥荒消灭，也不再担当列国的羞辱。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必给他们兴起有名的植物；他们在境内不再为饥荒所灭，也不再受外邦人的羞辱，
verses.textEnNiv: I will provide for them a land renowned for its crops, and they will no longer be victims of famine in the land or bear the scorn of the nations.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will provide for them a renowned place for planting so that they shall no more be consumed with hunger in the land, and no longer suffer the reproach of the nations.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will raise up for them a garden of renown, and they shall no longer be consumed with hunger in the land, nor bear the shame of the Gentiles anymore.
verses.textEnNlt: "And I will make their land famous for its crops, so my people will never again suffer from famines or the insults of foreign nations.
verses.textEnNasb: I will establish for them a renowned planting place, and they will not again be victims of famine in the land, and they will not endure the insults of the nations anymore.
verses.textEn: I will provide for them a land renowned for its crops, and they will no longer be victims of famine in the land or bear the scorn of the nations.

verses.textZh: 那时，他们就知道我耶和华他们的神与他们同在，并且知道他们以色列家是我的子民。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，他们就知道我耶和华他们的神与他们同在，并且知道他们以色列家是我的子民。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 必知道我、耶和华－他们的神是与他们同在的，并知道他们－以色列家是我的民。这是主耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: Then they will know that I, the Lord their God, am with them and that they, the Israelites, are my people, declares the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And they shall know that I am the Lord their God with them, and that they, the house of Israel, are my people, declares the Lord God .
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus they shall know that I, the Lord their God, am with them, and they, the house of Israel, are My people," says the Lord God.’
verses.textEnNlt: In this way, they will know that I, the Lord their God, am with them. And they will know that they, the people of Israel, are my people, says the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Then they will know that I, the Lord their God, am with them, and that they, the house of Israel, are My people," declares the Lord God.
verses.textEn: Then they will know that I, the Lord their God, am with them and that they, the Israelites, are my people, declares the Sovereign Lord .

verses.textZh: 你们是我的羊，是我草场上的羊；我是你们的神。这是耶和华的宣告。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们是我的羊，是我草场上的羊；我是你们的神。这是耶和华的宣告。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们作我的羊，我草场上的羊，乃是以色列人，我也是你们的神。这是主耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: You are my sheep, the sheep of my pasture, and I am your God, declares the Sovereign Lord .’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And you are my sheep, human sheep of my pasture, and I am your God, declares the Lord God ."
verses.textEnNkjv: "You are My flock, the flock of My pasture; you are men, and I am your God," says the Lord God.
verses.textEnNlt: You are my flock, the sheep of my pasture. You are my people, and I am your God. I, the Sovereign Lord , have spoken!"
verses.textEnNasb: "As for you, My sheep, the sheep of My pasture, you are mankind, and I am your God," declares the Lord God.
verses.textEn: You are my sheep, the sheep of my pasture, and I am your God, declares the Sovereign Lord .’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Again a message came to me from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: Now the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: The word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: "人子啊！你要面向西珥山，说预言攻击它，
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！你要面向西珥山，说预言攻击它，
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，你要面向西珥山发预言，攻击它，
verses.textEnNiv: "Son of man, set your face against Mount Seir; prophesy against it
verses.textEnEsv: "Son of man, set your face against Mount Seir, and prophesy against it,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Son of man, set your face against Mount Seir and prophesy against it,
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, turn and face Mount Seir, and prophesy against its people.
verses.textEnNasb: "Son of man, set your face against Mount Seir, and prophesy against it
verses.textEn: "Son of man, set your face against Mount Seir; prophesy against it

verses.textZh: 对它说：‘主耶和华这样说：西珥山啊！我要与你为敌，伸手攻击你，使你非常荒凉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 对它说：‘主耶和华这样说：西珥山啊！我要与你为敌，伸手攻击你，使你非常荒凉。
verses.textZhCuv: 对它说，主耶和华如此说：西珥山哪，我与你为敌，必向你伸手攻击你，使你荒凉，令人惊骇。
verses.textEnNiv: and say: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I am against you, Mount Seir, and I will stretch out my hand against you and make you a desolate waste.
verses.textEnEsv: and say to it, Thus says the Lord God : Behold, I am against you, Mount Seir, and I will stretch out my hand against you, and I will make you a desolation and a waste.
verses.textEnNkjv: and say to it, ‘Thus says the Lord God: "Behold, O Mount Seir, I am against you; I will stretch out My hand against you, And make you most desolate;
verses.textEnNlt: Give them this message from the Sovereign Lord : "I am your enemy, O Mount Seir, and I will raise my fist against you to destroy you completely.
verses.textEnNasb: and say to it, ‘This is what the Lord God says: "Behold, I am against you, Mount Seir, And I will reach out with My hand against you And make you a desolation and a waste.
verses.textEn: and say: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I am against you, Mount Seir, and I will stretch out my hand against you and make you a desolate waste.

verses.textZh: 我要使你的城市变为废墟，你必然荒凉，那时，你就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要使你的城市变为废墟，你必然荒凉，那时，你就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必使你的城邑变为荒场，成为凄凉。你就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: I will turn your towns into ruins and you will be desolate. Then you will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: I will lay your cities waste, and you shall become a desolation, and you shall know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: I shall lay your cities waste, And you shall be desolate. Then you shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: I will demolish your cities and make you desolate. Then you will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "I will turn your cities to ruins, And you will become a desolation. Then you will know that I am the Lord.
verses.textEn: I will turn your towns into ruins and you will be desolate. Then you will know that I am the Lord .

verses.textZh: 因为你永远怀恨，在以色列人遭遇灾难，刑罚到了顶点的时候，你把他们交在刀剑之下，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你永远怀恨，在以色列人遭遇灾难，刑罚到了顶点的时候，你把他们交在刀剑之下，
verses.textZhCuv: 因为你永怀仇恨，在以色列人遭灾、罪孽到了尽头的时候，将他们交与刀剑，
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Because you harbored an ancient hostility and delivered the Israelites over to the sword at the time of their calamity, the time their punishment reached its climax,
verses.textEnEsv: Because you cherished perpetual enmity and gave over the people of Israel to the power of the sword at the time of their calamity, at the time of their final punishment,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Because you have had an ancient hatred, and have shed thebloodof the children of Israel by the power of the sword at the time of their calamity, when their iniquity cametoan end,
verses.textEnNlt: "Your eternal hatred for the people of Israel led you to butcher them when they were helpless, when I had already punished them for all their sins.
verses.textEnNasb: Since you have had everlasting hostility and have turned over the sons of Israel to the power of the sword at the time of their disaster, at the time of the punishment of the end,
verses.textEn: " ‘Because you harbored an ancient hostility and delivered the Israelites over to the sword at the time of their calamity, the time their punishment reached its climax,

verses.textZh: 所以我指着我的永生起誓，我必使你遭受流血的报应，这血必追赶你；你既不恨恶流人的血，这血必追赶你。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以我指着我的永生起誓，我必使你遭受流血的报应，这血必追赶你；你既不恨恶流人的血，这血必追赶你。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以主耶和华说：我指着我的永生起誓，我必使你遭遇流血的报应，罪 必追赶你；你既不恨恶杀人流血，所以这罪必追赶你。
verses.textEnNiv: therefore as surely as I live, declares the Sovereign Lord , I will give you over to bloodshed and it will pursue you. Since you did not hate bloodshed, bloodshed will pursue you.
verses.textEnEsv: therefore, as I live, declares the Lord God , I will prepare you for blood, and blood shall pursue you; because you did not hate bloodshed, therefore blood shall pursue you.
verses.textEnNkjv: therefore, as I live," says the Lord God, "I will prepare you for blood, and blood shall pursue you; since you have not hated blood, therefore blood shall pursue you.
verses.textEnNlt: As surely as I live, says the Sovereign Lord , since you show no distaste for blood, I will give you a bloodbath of your own. Your turn has come!
verses.textEnNasb: therefore as I live," declares the Lord God, "I will certainly doom you to bloodshed, and bloodshed will pursue you; since you have not hated bloodshed, therefore bloodshed will pursue you.
verses.textEn: therefore as surely as I live, declares the Sovereign Lord , I will give you over to bloodshed and it will pursue you. Since you did not hate bloodshed, bloodshed will pursue you.

verses.textZh: 我必使西珥山非常荒凉，我必从那里剪除来往的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必使西珥山非常荒凉，我必从那里剪除来往的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必使西珥山荒凉，令人惊骇，来往经过的人我必剪除。
verses.textEnNiv: I will make Mount Seir a desolate waste and cut off from it all who come and go.
verses.textEnEsv: I will make Mount Seir a waste and a desolation, and I will cut off from it all who come and go.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus I will make Mount Seir most desolate, and cut off from it the one who leaves and the one who returns.
verses.textEnNlt: I will make Mount Seir utterly desolate, killing off all who try to escape and any who return.
verses.textEnNasb: I will make Mount Seir a waste and a desolation and I will eliminate from it one who passes through and returns.
verses.textEn: I will make Mount Seir a desolate waste and cut off from it all who come and go.

verses.textZh: 我必使西珥的众山布满了被杀的人；被刀剑所杀的人必倒在你的小山、山谷和所有的溪涧中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必使西珥的众山布满了被杀的人；被刀剑所杀的人必倒在你的小山、山谷和所有的溪涧中。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必使西珥山满有被杀的人。被刀杀的，必倒在你小山和山谷，并一切的溪水中。
verses.textEnNiv: I will fill your mountains with the slain; those killed by the sword will fall on your hills and in your valleys and in all your ravines.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will fill its mountains with the slain. On your hills and in your valleys and in all your ravines those slain with the sword shall fall.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will fill its mountains with the slain; on your hills and in your valleys and in all your ravines those who are slain by the sword shall fall.
verses.textEnNlt: I will fill your mountains with the dead. Your hills, your valleys, and your ravines will be filled with people slaughtered by the sword.
verses.textEnNasb: I will fill its mountains with its slain; those killed by the sword will fall on your hills, in your valleys, and in all your ravines.
verses.textEn: I will fill your mountains with the slain; those killed by the sword will fall on your hills and in your valleys and in all your ravines.

verses.textZh: 我必使你永远荒凉，你的城市必没有人居住；你们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必使你永远荒凉，你的城市必没有人居住；你们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必使你永远荒凉，使你的城邑无人居住，你的民就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: I will make you desolate forever; your towns will not be inhabited. Then you will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: I will make you a perpetual desolation, and your cities shall not be inhabited. Then you will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: I will make you perpetually desolate, and your cities shall be uninhabited; then you shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: I will make you desolate forever. Your cities will never be rebuilt. Then you will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: I will make you a permanent desolation, and your cities will not be inhabited. Then you will know that I am the Lord.
verses.textEn: I will make you desolate forever; your towns will not be inhabited. Then you will know that I am the Lord .

verses.textZh: "‘因为你曾说：这两国这两邦都必归我，我必得它们为业，但其实耶和华还是在那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘因为你曾说：这两国这两邦都必归我，我必得它们为业，但其实耶和华还是在那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 「因为你曾说：『这二国这二邦必归于我，我必得为业』（其实耶和华仍在那里），
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Because you have said, "These two nations and countries will be ours and we will take possession of them," even though I the Lord was there,
verses.textEnEsv: "Because you said, ‘These two nations and these two countries shall be mine, and we will take possession of them’—although the Lord was there—
verses.textEnNkjv: "Because you have said, ‘These two nations and these two countries shall be mine, and we will possess them,’ although the Lord was there,
verses.textEnNlt: "For you said, ‘The lands of Israel and Judah will be ours. We will take possession of them. What do we care that the Lord is there!’
verses.textEnNasb: "Since you have said, ‘These two nations and these two lands will be mine, and we will possess them,’ although the Lord was there,
verses.textEn: " ‘Because you have said, "These two nations and countries will be ours and we will take possession of them," even though I the Lord was there,

verses.textZh: 所以我指着我的永生起誓：我必照着你因仇恨而向他们所发的忿怒和嫉妒对待你。我审判你的时候，必把自己显明在他们中间。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以我指着我的永生起誓：我必照着你因仇恨而向他们所发的忿怒和嫉妒对待你。我审判你的时候，必把自己显明在他们中间。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以主耶和华说：我指着我的永生起誓，我必照你的怒气和你从仇恨中向他们所发的嫉妒待你。我审判你的时候，必将自己显明在他们中间。
verses.textEnNiv: therefore as surely as I live, declares the Sovereign Lord , I will treat you in accordance with the anger and jealousy you showed in your hatred of them and I will make myself known among them when I judge you.
verses.textEnEsv: therefore, as I live, declares the Lord God , I will deal with you according to the anger and envy that you showed because of your hatred against them. And I will make myself known among them, when I judge you.
verses.textEnNkjv: therefore, as I live," says the Lord God, "I will do according to your anger and according to the envy which you showed in your hatred against them; and I will make Myself known among them when I judge you.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, as surely as I live, says the Sovereign Lord , I will pay back your angry deeds with my own. I will punish you for all your acts of anger, envy, and hatred. And I will make myself known to Israel by what I do to you.
verses.textEnNasb: therefore as I live," declares the Lord God, "I will deal with you according to your anger and according to your envy which you displayed because of your hatred for them; so I will make Myself known among them when I judge you.
verses.textEn: therefore as surely as I live, declares the Sovereign Lord , I will treat you in accordance with the anger and jealousy you showed in your hatred of them and I will make myself known among them when I judge you.

verses.textZh: 这样，你就必知道我耶和华听见了你的一切毁谤，就是你攻击以色列众山的话，说："这些山都已经荒凉了！已经给我们吞吃了！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，你就必知道我耶和华听见了你的一切毁谤，就是你攻击以色列众山的话，说："这些山都已经荒凉了！已经给我们吞吃了！"
verses.textZhCuv: 你也必知道我－耶和华听见了你的一切毁谤，就是你攻击以色列山的话，说：『这些山荒凉，是归我们吞灭的。』
verses.textEnNiv: Then you will know that I the Lord have heard all the contemptible things you have said against the mountains of Israel. You said, "They have been laid waste and have been given over to us to devour."
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall know that I am the Lord . "I have heard all the revilings that you uttered against the mountains of Israel, saying, ‘They are laid desolate; they are given us to devour.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Then you shall know that I am the Lord. I have heard all your blasphemies which you have spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying, ‘They are desolate; they are given to us to consume.’
verses.textEnNlt: Then you will know that I, the Lord , have heard every contemptuous word you spoke against the mountains of Israel. For you said, ‘They are desolate; they have been given to us as food to eat!’
verses.textEnNasb: Then you will know that I, the Lord, have heard all your insults which you have spoken against the mountains of Israel saying, ‘They are desolate; they have been given to us as food.’
verses.textEn: Then you will know that I the Lord have heard all the contemptible things you have said against the mountains of Israel. You said, "They have been laid waste and have been given over to us to devour."

verses.textZh: 你们用口说夸大的话攻击我，说出许多话来与我作对，我都听见了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们用口说夸大的话攻击我，说出许多话来与我作对，我都听见了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们也用口向我夸大，增添与我反对的话，我都听见了。
verses.textEnNiv: You boasted against me and spoke against me without restraint, and I heard it.
verses.textEnEsv: And you magnified yourselves against me with your mouth, and multiplied your words against me; I heard it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus with your mouth you have boasted against Me and multiplied your words against Me; I have heard them."
verses.textEnNlt: In saying that, you boasted proudly against me, and I have heard it all!
verses.textEnNasb: And you have spoken arrogantly against Me and have multiplied your words against Me; I Myself have heard it."
verses.textEn: You boasted against me and spoke against me without restraint, and I heard it.

verses.textZh: 主耶和华这样说：全地都欢乐的时候，我却要使你荒凉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主耶和华这样说：全地都欢乐的时候，我却要使你荒凉。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华如此说：全地欢乐的时候，我必使你荒凉。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Sovereign Lord says: While the whole earth rejoices, I will make you desolate.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord God : While the whole earth rejoices, I will make you desolate.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Thus says the Lord God: "The whole earth will rejoice when I make you desolate.
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Sovereign Lord says: The whole world will rejoice when I make you desolate.
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord God says: "As all the earth rejoices, I will make you a desolation.
verses.textEn: This is what the Sovereign Lord says: While the whole earth rejoices, I will make you desolate.

verses.textZh: 你怎样因以色列家的产业荒凉而欢乐，我也必照样待你。西珥山啊！你和以东全地都必荒凉。他们就知道我是耶和华。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你怎样因以色列家的产业荒凉而欢乐，我也必照样待你。西珥山啊！你和以东全地都必荒凉。他们就知道我是耶和华。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 你怎样因以色列家的地业荒凉而喜乐，我必照你所行的待你。西珥山哪，你和以东全地必都荒凉。你们就知道我是耶和华。」
verses.textEnNiv: Because you rejoiced when the inheritance of Israel became desolate, that is how I will treat you. You will be desolate, Mount Seir, you and all of Edom. Then they will know that I am the Lord .’ "
verses.textEnEsv: As you rejoiced over the inheritance of the house of Israel, because it was desolate, so I will deal with you; you shall be desolate, Mount Seir, and all Edom, all of it. Then they will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: As you rejoiced because the inheritance of the house of Israel was desolate, so I will do to you; you shall be desolate, O Mount Seir, as well as all of Edom—all of it! Then they shall know that I am the Lord." ’
verses.textEnNlt: You rejoiced at the desolation of Israel’s territory. Now I will rejoice at yours! You will be wiped out, you people of Mount Seir and all who live in Edom! Then you will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: As you rejoiced over the inheritance of the house of Israel because it was desolate, so I will do to you. You will be a desolation, Mount Seir, and all Edom, all of it. Then they will know that I am the Lord." ’
verses.textEn: Because you rejoiced when the inheritance of Israel became desolate, that is how I will treat you. You will be desolate, Mount Seir, you and all of Edom. Then they will know that I am the Lord .’ "

verses.textZh: "人子啊！你要向以色列的众山说预言：‘以色列的众山啊！你们要听耶和华的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！你要向以色列的众山说预言：‘以色列的众山啊！你们要听耶和华的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，你要对以色列山发预言说：以色列山哪，要听耶和华的话。
verses.textEnNiv: "Son of man, prophesy to the mountains of Israel and say, ‘Mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: "And you, son of man, prophesy to the mountains of Israel, and say, O mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: "And you, son of man, prophesy to the mountains of Israel, and say, ‘O mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord!
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, prophesy to Israel’s mountains. Give them this message: O mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord !
verses.textEnNasb: "Now you, son of man, prophesy to the mountains of Israel and say, ‘You mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord.
verses.textEn: "Son of man, prophesy to the mountains of Israel and say, ‘Mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 主耶和华这样说：因为仇敌攻击你们说：哈哈！那悠久的山冈都归给我们为业了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主耶和华这样说：因为仇敌攻击你们说：哈哈！那悠久的山冈都归给我们为业了。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华如此说：因仇敌说：『阿哈！这永久的山冈都归我们为业了！』
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Sovereign Lord says: The enemy said of you, "Aha! The ancient heights have become our possession." ’
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord God : Because the enemy said of you, ‘Aha!’ and, ‘The ancient heights have become our possession,’
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord God: "Because the enemy has said of you, ‘Aha! The ancient heights have become our possession,’ " ’
