verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Your enemies have taunted you, saying, ‘Aha! Now the ancient heights belong to us!’
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord God says: "Since the enemy has spoken against you, ‘Aha!’ and, ‘The everlasting heights have become our possession,’
verses.textEn: This is what the Sovereign Lord says: The enemy said of you, "Aha! The ancient heights have become our possession." ’

verses.textZh: 所以你要说预言：主耶和华这样说：因为敌人使你们荒凉，四围践踏你们，好使你们归给列国中余剩的人为业，成为人们提说和嘲笑的对象，
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以你要说预言：主耶和华这样说：因为敌人使你们荒凉，四围践踏你们，好使你们归给列国中余剩的人为业，成为人们提说和嘲笑的对象，
verses.textZhCuv: 所以要发预言说，主耶和华如此说：因为敌人使你荒凉，四围吞吃，好叫你归与其余的外邦人为业，并且多嘴多舌的人提起你来，百姓也说你有臭名。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore prophesy and say, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Because they ravaged and crushed you from every side so that you became the possession of the rest of the nations and the object of people’s malicious talk and slander,
verses.textEnEsv: therefore prophesy, and say, Thus says the Lord God : Precisely because they made you desolate and crushed you from all sides, so that you became the possession of the rest of the nations, and you became the talk and evil gossip of the people,
verses.textEnNkjv: therefore prophesy, and say, ‘Thus says the Lord God: "Because they made you desolate and swallowed you up on every side, so that you became the possession of the rest of the nations, and you are taken up by the lips of talkers and slandered by the people"—
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, son of man, give the mountains of Israel this message from the Sovereign Lord : Your enemies have attacked you from all directions, making you the property of many nations and the object of much mocking and slander.
verses.textEnNasb: therefore prophesy and say, ‘This is what the Lord God says: " For good reason they have made you desolate and harassed you from every side, so that you would become a possession of the rest of the nations; and you have been taken up in the talk and the rumor of the people." ’ "
verses.textEn: Therefore prophesy and say, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Because they ravaged and crushed you from every side so that you became the possession of the rest of the nations and the object of people’s malicious talk and slander,

verses.textZh: 因此，以色列的众山啊！你们要听主耶和华的话；主耶和华对大山、小冈、溪涧、山谷、荒凉的废墟，被弃的城，就是曾被四围列国中余剩的人所劫掠、所讥笑的，这样说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，以色列的众山啊！你们要听主耶和华的话；主耶和华对大山、小冈、溪涧、山谷、荒凉的废墟，被弃的城，就是曾被四围列国中余剩的人所劫掠、所讥笑的，这样说：
verses.textZhCuv: 故此，以色列山要听主耶和华的话。大山小冈、水沟山谷、荒废之地、被弃之城，为四围其余的外邦人所占据、所讥刺的，
verses.textEnNiv: therefore, mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Sovereign Lord : This is what the Sovereign Lord says to the mountains and hills, to the ravines and valleys, to the desolate ruins and the deserted towns that have been plundered and ridiculed by the rest of the nations around you—
verses.textEnEsv: therefore, O mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord God : Thus says the Lord God to the mountains and the hills, the ravines and the valleys, the desolate wastes and the deserted cities, which have become a prey and derision to the rest of the nations all around,
verses.textEnNkjv: therefore, O mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord God! Thus says the Lord God to the mountains, the hills, the rivers, the valleys, the desolate wastes, and the cities that have been forsaken, which became plunder and mockery to the rest of the nations all around—
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, O mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Sovereign Lord . He speaks to the hills and mountains, ravines and valleys, and to ruined wastes and long-deserted cities that have been destroyed and mocked by the surrounding nations.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, you mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord God. This is what the Lord God says to the mountains and to the hills, to the ravines and to the valleys, to the desolate ruins and to the abandoned cities which have become plunder and an object of ridicule to the rest of the nations which are all around—
verses.textEn: therefore, mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Sovereign Lord : This is what the Sovereign Lord says to the mountains and hills, to the ravines and valleys, to the desolate ruins and the deserted towns that have been plundered and ridiculed by the rest of the nations around you—

verses.textZh: 主耶和华这样说：我在妒火中说话攻击列国中余剩的人和以东众人，因为他们全心欢喜，满怀恨恶，把我的地归给自己为业，好占有它为掠物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主耶和华这样说：我在妒火中说话攻击列国中余剩的人和以东众人，因为他们全心欢喜，满怀恨恶，把我的地归给自己为业，好占有它为掠物。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华对你们如此说：我真发愤恨如火，责备那其余的外邦人和以东的众人。他们快乐满怀，心存恨恶，将我的地归自己为业，又看为被弃的掠物。
verses.textEnNiv: this is what the Sovereign Lord says: In my burning zeal I have spoken against the rest of the nations, and against all Edom, for with glee and with malice in their hearts they made my land their own possession so that they might plunder its pastureland.’
verses.textEnEsv: therefore thus says the Lord God : Surely I have spoken in my hot jealousy against the rest of the nations and against all Edom, who gave my land to themselves as a possession with wholehearted joy and utter contempt, that they might make its pasturelands a prey.
verses.textEnNkjv: therefore thus says the Lord God: "Surely I have spoken in My burning jealousy against the rest of the nations and against all Edom, who gave My land to themselves as a possession, with wholehearted joy and spiteful minds, in order to plunder its open country." ’
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Sovereign Lord says: My jealous anger burns against these nations, especially Edom, because they have shown utter contempt for me by gleefully taking my land for themselves as plunder.
verses.textEnNasb: therefore the Lord God says this: "Certainly in the fire of My jealousy I have spoken against the rest of the nations, and against all Edom, who appropriated My land for themselves as a possession with wholehearted joy and with contempt of soul, in order to make its pastureland plunder."
verses.textEn: this is what the Sovereign Lord says: In my burning zeal I have spoken against the rest of the nations, and against all Edom, for with glee and with malice in their hearts they made my land their own possession so that they might plunder its pastureland.’

verses.textZh: 因此，你要向以色列地说预言，对大山、小冈、溪涧和山谷说：主耶和华这样说：看哪！我在嫉妒和烈怒中说话，因为你们担当了列国的羞辱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，你要向以色列地说预言，对大山、小冈、溪涧和山谷说：主耶和华这样说：看哪！我在嫉妒和烈怒中说话，因为你们担当了列国的羞辱。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，你要指着以色列地说预言，对大山小冈、水沟山谷说，主耶和华如此说：我发愤恨和忿怒说，因你们曾受外邦人的羞辱，
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore prophesy concerning the land of Israel and say to the mountains and hills, to the ravines and valleys: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I speak in my jealous wrath because you have suffered the scorn of the nations.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore prophesy concerning the land of Israel, and say to the mountains and hills, to the ravines and valleys, Thus says the Lord God : Behold, I have spoken in my jealous wrath, because you have suffered the reproach of the nations.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore prophesy concerning the land of Israel, and say to the mountains, the hills, the rivers, and the valleys, ‘Thus says the Lord God: "Behold, I have spoken in My jealousy and My fury, because you have borne the shame of the nations."
verses.textEnNlt: "Therefore, prophesy to the hills and mountains, the ravines and valleys of Israel. This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I am furious that you have suffered shame before the surrounding nations.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore prophesy in regard to the land of Israel and say to the mountains and to the hills, to the ravines and to the valleys, "This is what the Lord God says: ‘Behold, I have spoken in My jealousy and in My wrath because you have endured the insults of the nations.’
verses.textEn: Therefore prophesy concerning the land of Israel and say to the mountains and hills, to the ravines and valleys: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I speak in my jealous wrath because you have suffered the scorn of the nations.

verses.textZh: 所以主耶和华这样说：我举手起誓说：你们四围的列国必亲自担当自己的羞辱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以主耶和华这样说：我举手起誓说：你们四围的列国必亲自担当自己的羞辱。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以我起誓说：你们四围的外邦人总要担当自己的羞辱。这是主耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I swear with uplifted hand that the nations around you will also suffer scorn.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore thus says the Lord God : I swear that the nations that are all around you shall themselves suffer reproach.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore thus says the Lord God: "I have raised My hand in an oath that surely the nations that are around you shall bear their own shame.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I have taken a solemn oath that those nations will soon have their own shame to endure.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore the Lord God says this: ‘I have sworn that the nations that are around you will certainly endure their insults themselves.
verses.textEn: Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I swear with uplifted hand that the nations around you will also suffer scorn.

verses.textZh: "‘以色列的众山啊！你们必长出枝条，为我的子民以色列结出果子，因为他们快要回来了。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘以色列的众山啊！你们必长出枝条，为我的子民以色列结出果子，因为他们快要回来了。
verses.textZhCuv: 「以色列山哪，你必发枝条，为我的民以色列结果子，因为他们快要来到。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘But you, mountains of Israel, will produce branches and fruit for my people Israel, for they will soon come home.
verses.textEnEsv: "But you, O mountains of Israel, shall shoot forth your branches and yield your fruit to my people Israel, for they will soon come home.
verses.textEnNkjv: But you, O mountains of Israel, you shall shoot forth your branches and yield your fruit to My people Israel, for they are about to come.
verses.textEnNlt: "But the mountains of Israel will produce heavy crops of fruit for my people—for they will be coming home again soon!
verses.textEnNasb: But as for you, mountains of Israel, you will grow your branches and bear fruit for My people Israel; for they are about to come.
verses.textEn: " ‘But you, mountains of Israel, will produce branches and fruit for my people Israel, for they will soon come home.

verses.textZh: 看哪！我是帮助你们的，我必转向你们，使人可以在你们上面耕种和撒种。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！我是帮助你们的，我必转向你们，使人可以在你们上面耕种和撒种。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，我是帮助你的，也必向你转意，使你得以耕种。
verses.textEnNiv: I am concerned for you and will look on you with favor; you will be plowed and sown,
verses.textEnEsv: For behold, I am for you, and I will turn to you, and you shall be tilled and sown.
verses.textEnNkjv: For indeed I am for you, and I will turn to you, and you shall be tilled and sown.
verses.textEnNlt: See, I care about you, and I will pay attention to you. Your ground will be plowed and your crops planted.
verses.textEnNasb: For, behold, I am for you, and I will turn to you, and you will be cultivated and sown.
verses.textEn: I am concerned for you and will look on you with favor; you will be plowed and sown,

verses.textZh: 我要使以色列全家的人数在你们上面增多；城市有人居住，废墟可以重建。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要使以色列全家的人数在你们上面增多；城市有人居住，废墟可以重建。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必使以色列全家的人数在你上面增多，城邑有人居住，荒场再被建造。
verses.textEnNiv: and I will cause many people to live on you—yes, all of Israel. The towns will be inhabited and the ruins rebuilt.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will multiply people on you, the whole house of Israel, all of it. The cities shall be inhabited and the waste places rebuilt.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will multiply men upon you, all the house of Israel, all of it; and the cities shall be inhabited and the ruins rebuilt.
verses.textEnNlt: I will greatly increase the population of Israel, and the ruined cities will be rebuilt and filled with people.
verses.textEnNasb: And I will multiply people on you, all the house of Israel, all of it; and the cities will be inhabited and the ruins will be rebuilt.
verses.textEn: and I will cause many people to live on you—yes, all of Israel. The towns will be inhabited and the ruins rebuilt.

verses.textZh: 我必使人和牲畜都在你们上面增多；他们必繁衍增多；我必使你们有人居住，像从前一样，并要使你们比先前更蒙福。你们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必使人和牲畜都在你们上面增多；他们必繁衍增多；我必使你们有人居住，像从前一样，并要使你们比先前更蒙福。你们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必使人和牲畜在你上面加增；他们必生养众多。我要使你照旧有人居住，并要赐福与你比先前更多，你就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: I will increase the number of people and animals living on you, and they will be fruitful and become numerous. I will settle people on you as in the past and will make you prosper more than before. Then you will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And I will multiply on you man and beast, and they shall multiply and be fruitful. And I will cause you to be inhabited as in your former times, and will do more good to you than ever before. Then you will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: I will multiply upon you man and beast; and they shall increase and bear young; I will make you inhabited as in former times, and do better foryou than at your beginnings. Then you shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: I will increase not only the people, but also your animals. O mountains of Israel, I will bring people to live on you once again. I will make you even more prosperous than you were before. Then you will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: I will multiply on you people and animals, and they will increase and be fruitful; and I will populate you as you were previously, and treat you better than at the beginning. Then you will know that I am the Lord.
verses.textEn: I will increase the number of people and animals living on you, and they will be fruitful and become numerous. I will settle people on you as in the past and will make you prosper more than before. Then you will know that I am the Lord .

verses.textZh: 我必使人，就是我的子民以色列，在你上面行走；他们必得你为业；你必作他们的产业，也不再使他们丧失子女。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必使人，就是我的子民以色列，在你上面行走；他们必得你为业；你必作他们的产业，也不再使他们丧失子女。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必使人，就是我的民以色列，行在你上面。他们必得你为业；你也不再使他们丧子。
verses.textEnNiv: I will cause people, my people Israel, to live on you. They will possess you, and you will be their inheritance; you will never again deprive them of their children.
verses.textEnEsv: I will let people walk on you, even my people Israel. And they shall possess you, and you shall be their inheritance, and you shall no longer bereave them of children.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yes, I will cause men to walk on you, My people Israel; they shall take possession of you, and you shall be their inheritance; no more shall you bereave them ofchildren."
verses.textEnNlt: I will cause my people to walk on you once again, and you will be their territory. You will never again rob them of their children.
verses.textEnNasb: Yes, I will have people—My people Israel—walk on you and possess you, so that you will become their inheritance and never again bereave them of children.’
verses.textEn: I will cause people, my people Israel, to live on you. They will possess you, and you will be their inheritance; you will never again deprive them of their children.

verses.textZh: 主耶和华这样说：因为人对你说：你是吞吃人的，又是使你的国民丧失子女的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主耶和华这样说：因为人对你说：你是吞吃人的，又是使你的国民丧失子女的。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华如此说：因为人对你说：『你是吞吃人的，又使国民丧子』，
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Because some say to you, "You devour people and deprive your nation of its children,"
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord God : Because they say to you, ‘You devour people, and you bereave your nation of children,’
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Thus says the Lord God: "Because they say to you, ‘You devour men and bereave your nation ofchildren,’
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Sovereign Lord says: The other nations taunt you, saying, ‘Israel is a land that devours its own people and robs them of their children!’
verses.textEnNasb: "The Lord God says this: ‘Since they say to you, "You are a devourer of people and have bereaved your nation of children,"
verses.textEn: " ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Because some say to you, "You devour people and deprive your nation of its children,"

verses.textZh: 所以你必不再吞吃人，也必不再使你的国民丧失子女。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以你必不再吞吃人，也必不再使你的国民丧失子女。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以主耶和华说：你必不再吞吃人，也不再使国民丧子。
verses.textEnNiv: therefore you will no longer devour people or make your nation childless, declares the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: therefore you shall no longer devour people and no longer bereave your nation of children, declares the Lord God .
verses.textEnNkjv: therefore you shall devour men no more, nor bereave your nation anymore," says the Lord God.
verses.textEnNlt: But you will never again devour your people or rob them of their children, says the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: for that reason you will no longer devour people and no longer bereave your nation of children,’ declares the Lord God.
verses.textEn: therefore you will no longer devour people or make your nation childless, declares the Sovereign Lord .

verses.textZh: 我必使你不再听见列国的羞辱，你必不再受万族的辱骂，也不再使你的国民跌倒。这是主耶和华的宣告。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必使你不再听见列国的羞辱，你必不再受万族的辱骂，也不再使你的国民跌倒。这是主耶和华的宣告。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 我使你不再听见各国的羞辱，不再受万民的辱骂，也不再使国民绊跌。这是主耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: No longer will I make you hear the taunts of the nations, and no longer will you suffer the scorn of the peoples or cause your nation to fall, declares the Sovereign Lord .’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And I will not let you hear anymore the reproach of the nations, and you shall no longer bear the disgrace of the peoples and no longer cause your nation to stumble, declares the Lord God ."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Nor will I let you hear the taunts of the nations anymore, nor bear the reproach of the peoples anymore, nor shall you cause your nation to stumble anymore," says the Lord God.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: I will not let you hear those other nations insult you, and you will no longer be mocked by them. You will not be a land that causes its nation to fall, says the Sovereign Lord ."
verses.textEnNasb: I will not let you hear insults from the nations anymore, nor will you suffer disgrace from the peoples any longer, nor will you make your nation stumble any longer," declares the Lord God.’ "
verses.textEn: No longer will I make you hear the taunts of the nations, and no longer will you suffer the scorn of the peoples or cause your nation to fall, declares the Sovereign Lord .’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: Again the word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover the word of the Lord came to me, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: Then this further message came to me from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: Then the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: Again the word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: "人子啊！以色列家住在他们本土的时候，他们的所作所为玷污了那地。他们所行的在我面前，就像在经期中的妇人那样污秽。
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！以色列家住在他们本土的时候，他们的所作所为玷污了那地。他们所行的在我面前，就像在经期中的妇人那样污秽。
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，以色列家住在本地的时候，在行动作为上玷污那地。他们的行为在我面前，好像正在经期的妇人那样污秽。
verses.textEnNiv: "Son of man, when the people of Israel were living in their own land, they defiled it by their conduct and their actions. Their conduct was like a woman’s monthly uncleanness in my sight.
verses.textEnEsv: "Son of man, when the house of Israel lived in their own land, they defiled it by their ways and their deeds. Their ways before me were like the uncleanness of a woman in her menstrual impurity.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Son of man, when the house of Israel dwelt in their own land, they defiled it by their own ways and deeds; to Me their way was like the uncleanness of a woman in her customary impurity.
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, when the people of Israel were living in their own land, they defiled it by the evil way they lived. To me their conduct was as unclean as a woman’s menstrual cloth.
verses.textEnNasb: "Son of man, when the house of Israel was living on their own land, they defiled it by their ways and their deeds; their way before Me was like the uncleanness of a woman in her impurity.
verses.textEn: "Son of man, when the people of Israel were living in their own land, they defiled it by their conduct and their actions. Their conduct was like a woman’s monthly uncleanness in my sight.

verses.textZh: 所以我因他们在那地上流人的血，又因他们以自己可憎的像玷污那地，就把我的烈怒倒在他们身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以我因他们在那地上流人的血，又因他们以自己可憎的像玷污那地，就把我的烈怒倒在他们身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以我因他们在那地上流人的血，又因他们以偶像玷污那地，就把我的忿怒倾在他们身上。
verses.textEnNiv: So I poured out my wrath on them because they had shed blood in the land and because they had defiled it with their idols.
verses.textEnEsv: So I poured out my wrath upon them for the blood that they had shed in the land, for the idols with which they had defiled it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I poured out My fury on them for the blood they had shed on the land, and for their idols withwhich they had defiled it.
verses.textEnNlt: They polluted the land with murder and the worship of idols, so I poured out my fury on them.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore I poured out My wrath on them for the blood which they had shed on the land, because they had defiled it with their idols.
verses.textEn: So I poured out my wrath on them because they had shed blood in the land and because they had defiled it with their idols.

verses.textZh: 我使他们分散在列邦，四散在各地；我按着他们的所作所为审判他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我使他们分散在列邦，四散在各地；我按着他们的所作所为审判他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 我将他们分散在列国，四散在列邦，按他们的行动作为惩罚他们。
verses.textEnNiv: I dispersed them among the nations, and they were scattered through the countries; I judged them according to their conduct and their actions.
verses.textEnEsv: I scattered them among the nations, and they were dispersed through the countries. In accordance with their ways and their deeds I judged them.
verses.textEnNkjv: So I scattered them among the nations, and they were dispersed throughout the countries; I judged them according to their ways and their deeds.
verses.textEnNlt: I scattered them to many lands to punish them for the evil way they had lived.
verses.textEnNasb: I also scattered them among the nations, and they were dispersed throughout the lands. According to their ways and their deeds I judged them.
verses.textEn: I dispersed them among the nations, and they were scattered through the countries; I judged them according to their conduct and their actions.

verses.textZh: 他们到了所去的列邦那里，我的圣名就被亵渎，因为人总是谈论他们说：‘这些是耶和华的子民，他们却要从耶和华的地出来。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们到了所去的列邦那里，我的圣名就被亵渎，因为人总是谈论他们说：‘这些是耶和华的子民，他们却要从耶和华的地出来。’
verses.textZhCuv: 他们到了所去的列国，就使我的圣名被亵渎；因为人谈论他们说，这是耶和华的民，是从耶和华的地出来的。
verses.textEnNiv: And wherever they went among the nations they profaned my holy name, for it was said of them, ‘These are the Lord ’s people, and yet they had to leave his land.’
verses.textEnEsv: But when they came to the nations, wherever they came, they profaned my holy name, in that people said of them, ‘These are the people of the Lord , and yet they had to go out of his land.’
verses.textEnNkjv: When they came to the nations, wherever they went, they profaned My holy name—when they said of them, ‘These are the people of the Lord, and yet they have gone out of His land.’
verses.textEnNlt: But when they were scattered among the nations, they brought shame on my holy name. For the nations said, ‘These are the people of the Lord , but he couldn’t keep them safe in his own land!’
verses.textEnNasb: When they came to the nations where they went, they profaned My holy name, because it was said of them, ‘These are the people of the Lord, yet they have left His land.’
verses.textEn: And wherever they went among the nations they profaned my holy name, for it was said of them, ‘These are the Lord ’s people, and yet they had to leave his land.’

verses.textZh: 我却顾惜我的圣名，就是以色列家在他们所去的列邦那里所亵渎的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我却顾惜我的圣名，就是以色列家在他们所去的列邦那里所亵渎的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我却顾惜我的圣名，就是以色列家在所到的列国中所亵渎的。
verses.textEnNiv: I had concern for my holy name, which the people of Israel profaned among the nations where they had gone.
verses.textEnEsv: But I had concern for my holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the nations to which they came.
verses.textEnNkjv: But I had concern for My holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the nations wherever they went.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I was concerned for my holy name, on which my people brought shame among the nations.
verses.textEnNasb: But I had concern for My holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the nations where they went.
verses.textEn: I had concern for my holy name, which the people of Israel profaned among the nations where they had gone.

verses.textZh: "因此，你要对以色列家说：‘主耶和华这样说：以色列家啊！我作这事，不是为了你们，而是为了我自己的圣名，就是在你们所去的列邦那里所亵渎的，
verses.textZhCnvs: "因此，你要对以色列家说：‘主耶和华这样说：以色列家啊！我作这事，不是为了你们，而是为了我自己的圣名，就是在你们所去的列邦那里所亵渎的，
verses.textZhCuv: 「所以，你要对以色列家说，主耶和华如此说：以色列家啊，我行这事不是为你们，乃是为我的圣名，就是在你们到的列国中所亵渎的。
verses.textEnNiv: "Therefore say to the Israelites, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: It is not for your sake, people of Israel, that I am going to do these things, but for the sake of my holy name, which you have profaned among the nations where you have gone.
verses.textEnEsv: "Therefore say to the house of Israel, Thus says the Lord God : It is not for your sake, O house of Israel, that I am about to act, but for the sake of my holy name, which you have profaned among the nations to which you came.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore say to the house of Israel, ‘Thus says the Lord God: "I do not do this for your sake, O house of Israel, but for My holy name’s sake, which you have profaned among the nations wherever you went.
verses.textEnNlt: "Therefore, give the people of Israel this message from the Sovereign Lord : I am bringing you back, but not because you deserve it. I am doing it to protect my holy name, on which you brought shame while you were scattered among the nations.
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore say to the house of Israel, ‘This is what the Lord God says: "It is not for your sake, house of Israel, that I am about to act, but for My holy name, which you have profaned among the nations where you went.
verses.textEn: "Therefore say to the Israelites, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: It is not for your sake, people of Israel, that I am going to do these things, but for the sake of my holy name, which you have profaned among the nations where you have gone.

verses.textZh: 我要使我的大名显为圣，这名在列邦中已经被亵渎了，是你们在他们中间所亵渎的。我在你们身上向他们显为圣的时候，他们就知道我是耶和华。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要使我的大名显为圣，这名在列邦中已经被亵渎了，是你们在他们中间所亵渎的。我在你们身上向他们显为圣的时候，他们就知道我是耶和华。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要使我的大名显为圣；这名在列国中已被亵渎，就是你们在他们中间所亵渎的。我在他们眼前，在你们身上显为圣的时候，他们就知道我是耶和华。这是主耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: I will show the holiness of my great name, which has been profaned among the nations, the name you have profaned among them. Then the nations will know that I am the Lord , declares the Sovereign Lord , when I am proved holy through you before their eyes.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will vindicate the holiness of my great name, which has been profaned among the nations, and which you have profaned among them. And the nations will know that I am the Lord , declares the Lord God , when through you I vindicate my holiness before their eyes.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will sanctify My great name, which has been profaned among the nations, which you have profaned in their midst; and the nations shall know that I am the Lord," says the Lord God, "when I am hallowed in you before their eyes.
verses.textEnNlt: I will show how holy my great name is—the name on which you brought shame among the nations. And when I reveal my holiness through you before their very eyes, says the Sovereign Lord , then the nations will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: And I will vindicate the holiness of My great name which has been profaned among the nations, which you have profaned among them. Then the nations will know that I am the Lord," declares the Lord God, "when I show Myself holy among you in their sight.
verses.textEn: I will show the holiness of my great name, which has been profaned among the nations, the name you have profaned among them. Then the nations will know that I am the Lord , declares the Sovereign Lord , when I am proved holy through you before their eyes.

verses.textZh: 我必从列国中领你们出来，从万邦中聚集你们，把你们带回故土。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必从列国中领你们出来，从万邦中聚集你们，把你们带回故土。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必从各国收取你们，从列邦聚集你们，引导你们归回本地。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘For I will take you out of the nations; I will gather you from all the countries and bring you back into your own land.
verses.textEnEsv: I will take you from the nations and gather you from all the countries and bring you into your own land.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I will take you from among the nations, gather you out of all countries, and bring you into your own land.
verses.textEnNlt: For I will gather you up from all the nations and bring you home again to your land.
verses.textEnNasb: For I will take you from the nations, and gather you from all the lands; and I will bring you into your own land.
verses.textEn: " ‘For I will take you out of the nations; I will gather you from all the countries and bring you back into your own land.

verses.textZh: 我必用洁净的水洒在你们身上，你们就洁净了；我必洁净你们的一切污秽，使你们远离所有可憎的像。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必用洁净的水洒在你们身上，你们就洁净了；我必洁净你们的一切污秽，使你们远离所有可憎的像。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必用清水洒在你们身上，你们就洁净了。我要洁净你们，使你们脱离一切的污秽，弃掉一切的偶像。
verses.textEnNiv: I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean; I will cleanse you from all your impurities and from all your idols.
verses.textEnEsv: I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you shall be clean from all your uncleannesses, and from all your idols I will cleanse you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you shall be clean; I will cleanse you from all your filthiness and from all your idols.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean. Your filth will be washed away, and you will no longer worship idols.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean; I will cleanse you from all your filthiness and from all your idols.
verses.textEn: I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean; I will cleanse you from all your impurities and from all your idols.

verses.textZh: "‘我必把新心赐给你们，把新灵放在你们里面；我必从你们的肉体中除去石心，把肉心赐给你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘我必把新心赐给你们，把新灵放在你们里面；我必从你们的肉体中除去石心，把肉心赐给你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 我也要赐给你们一个新心，将新灵放在你们里面，又从你们的肉体中除掉石心，赐给你们肉心。
verses.textEnNiv: I will give you a new heart and put a new spirit in you; I will remove from you your heart of stone and give you a heart of flesh.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will give you a new heart, and a new spirit I will put within you. And I will remove the heart of stone from your flesh and give you a heart of flesh.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will give you a new heart and put a new spirit within you; I will take the heart of stone out of your flesh and give you a heart of flesh.
verses.textEnNlt: And I will give you a new heart, and I will put a new spirit in you. I will take out your stony, stubborn heart and give you a tender, responsive heart.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, I will give you a new heart and put a new spirit within you; and I will remove the heart of stone from your flesh and give you a heart of flesh.
verses.textEn: I will give you a new heart and put a new spirit in you; I will remove from you your heart of stone and give you a heart of flesh.

verses.textZh: 我必把我的灵放在你们里面，使你们遵行我的律例，谨守遵行我的典章。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必把我的灵放在你们里面，使你们遵行我的律例，谨守遵行我的典章。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必将我的灵放在你们里面，使你们顺从我的律例，谨守遵行我的典章。
verses.textEnNiv: And I will put my Spirit in you and move you to follow my decrees and be careful to keep my laws.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will put my Spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes and be careful to obey my rules.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will put My Spirit within you and cause you to walk in My statutes, and you will keep My judgments and do them.
verses.textEnNlt: And I will put my Spirit in you so that you will follow my decrees and be careful to obey my regulations.
verses.textEnNasb: And I will put My Spirit within you and bring it about that you walk in My statutes, and are careful and follow My ordinances.
verses.textEn: And I will put my Spirit in you and move you to follow my decrees and be careful to keep my laws.

verses.textZh: 你们要住在我赐给你们列祖的地；你们要作我的子民，我要作你们的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要住在我赐给你们列祖的地；你们要作我的子民，我要作你们的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们必住在我所赐给你们列祖之地。你们要作我的子民，我要作你们的神。
verses.textEnNiv: Then you will live in the land I gave your ancestors; you will be my people, and I will be your God.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers, and you shall be my people, and I will be your God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then you shall dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers; you shall be My people, and I will be your God.
verses.textEnNlt: "And you will live in Israel, the land I gave your ancestors long ago. You will be my people, and I will be your God.
verses.textEnNasb: And you will live in the land that I gave to your forefathers; so you will be My people, and I will be your God.
verses.textEn: Then you will live in the land I gave your ancestors; you will be my people, and I will be your God.

verses.textZh: 我必拯救你们脱离你们的一切污秽；我必叫五谷丰收，不使你们遇见饥荒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必拯救你们脱离你们的一切污秽；我必叫五谷丰收，不使你们遇见饥荒。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必救你们脱离一切的污秽，也必命五谷丰登，不使你们遭遇饥荒。
verses.textEnNiv: I will save you from all your uncleanness. I will call for the grain and make it plentiful and will not bring famine upon you.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will deliver you from all your uncleannesses. And I will summon the grain and make it abundant and lay no famine upon you.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will deliver you from all your uncleannesses. I will call for the grain and multiply it, and bring no famine upon you.
verses.textEnNlt: I will cleanse you of your filthy behavior. I will give you good crops of grain, and I will send no more famines on the land.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, I will save you from all your uncleanness; and I will call for the grain and multiply it, and I will not bring a famine on you.
verses.textEn: I will save you from all your uncleanness. I will call for the grain and make it plentiful and will not bring famine upon you.

verses.textZh: 我必使树木的果子和田地的出产增多，好使你们在列国中不再因饥荒而遭受耻辱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必使树木的果子和田地的出产增多，好使你们在列国中不再因饥荒而遭受耻辱。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必使树木多结果子，田地多出土产，好叫你们不再因饥荒受外邦人的讥诮。
verses.textEnNiv: I will increase the fruit of the trees and the crops of the field, so that you will no longer suffer disgrace among the nations because of famine.
verses.textEnEsv: I will make the fruit of the tree and the increase of the field abundant, that you may never again suffer the disgrace of famine among the nations.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will multiply the fruit of your trees and the increase of your fields, so that you need never again bear the reproach of famine among the nations.
verses.textEnNlt: I will give you great harvests from your fruit trees and fields, and never again will the surrounding nations be able to scoff at your land for its famines.
verses.textEnNasb: Instead, I will multiply the fruit of the tree and the produce of the field, so that you will not receive again the disgrace of famine among the nations.
verses.textEn: I will increase the fruit of the trees and the crops of the field, so that you will no longer suffer disgrace among the nations because of famine.

verses.textZh: 那时，你们必想起你们的恶行和不好的作为，就必因你们的罪孽和可憎恶的事厌恶自己。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，你们必想起你们的恶行和不好的作为，就必因你们的罪孽和可憎恶的事厌恶自己。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，你们必追想你们的恶行和你们不善的作为，就因你们的罪孽和可憎的事厌恶自己。
verses.textEnNiv: Then you will remember your evil ways and wicked deeds, and you will loathe yourselves for your sins and detestable practices.
verses.textEnEsv: Then you will remember your evil ways, and your deeds that were not good, and you will loathe yourselves for your iniquities and your abominations.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then you will remember your evil ways and your deeds that were not good; and you will loathe yourselves in your own sight, for your iniquities and your abominations.
verses.textEnNlt: Then you will remember your past sins and despise yourselves for all the detestable things you did.
verses.textEnNasb: Then you will remember your evil ways and your deeds that were not good, and you will loathe yourselves in your own sight for your wrongdoings and your abominations.
verses.textEn: Then you will remember your evil ways and wicked deeds, and you will loathe yourselves for your sins and detestable practices.

verses.textZh: 你们要知道我这样行，不是为了你们的缘故；以色列家啊！你们要因自己的行为抱愧蒙羞。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要知道我这样行，不是为了你们的缘故；以色列家啊！你们要因自己的行为抱愧蒙羞。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华说：你们要知道，我这样行不是为你们。以色列家啊，当为自己的行为抱愧蒙羞。
verses.textEnNiv: I want you to know that I am not doing this for your sake, declares the Sovereign Lord . Be ashamed and disgraced for your conduct, people of Israel!
verses.textEnEsv: It is not for your sake that I will act, declares the Lord God ; let that be known to you. Be ashamed and confounded for your ways, O house of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Not for your sake do I do this," says the Lord God, "let it be known to you. Be ashamed and confounded for your own ways, O house of Israel!"
verses.textEnNlt: But remember, says the Sovereign Lord , I am not doing this because you deserve it. O my people of Israel, you should be utterly ashamed of all you have done!
verses.textEnNasb: I am not doing this for your sake," declares the Lord God; "let that be known to you. Be ashamed and humiliated for your ways, house of Israel!"
verses.textEn: I want you to know that I am not doing this for your sake, declares the Sovereign Lord . Be ashamed and disgraced for your conduct, people of Israel!

verses.textZh: "‘主耶和华这样说：我洁净你们，使你们脱离一切罪孽的日子，我必使城市有人居住，废墟可以重建。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘主耶和华这样说：我洁净你们，使你们脱离一切罪孽的日子，我必使城市有人居住，废墟可以重建。
verses.textZhCuv: 「主耶和华如此说：我洁净你们，使你们脱离一切罪孽的日子，必使城邑有人居住，荒场再被建造。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: On the day I cleanse you from all your sins, I will resettle your towns, and the ruins will be rebuilt.
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord God : On the day that I cleanse you from all your iniquities, I will cause the cities to be inhabited, and the waste places shall be rebuilt.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Thus says the Lord God: "On the day that I cleanse you from all your iniquities, I will also enable you to dwell in the cities, and the ruins shall be rebuilt.
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Sovereign Lord says: When I cleanse you from your sins, I will repopulate your cities, and the ruins will be rebuilt.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘This is what the Lord God says: "On the day that I cleanse you from all your wrongdoings, I will populate the cities, and the places of ruins will be rebuilt.
verses.textEn: " ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: On the day I cleanse you from all your sins, I will resettle your towns, and the ruins will be rebuilt.

verses.textZh: 从前所有路过的人都看为荒凉之地，现在却必再可以耕种。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从前所有路过的人都看为荒凉之地，现在却必再可以耕种。
verses.textZhCuv: 过路的人虽看为荒废之地，现今这荒废之地仍得耕种。
verses.textEnNiv: The desolate land will be cultivated instead of lying desolate in the sight of all who pass through it.
verses.textEnEsv: And the land that was desolate shall be tilled, instead of being the desolation that it was in the sight of all who passed by.
verses.textEnNkjv: The desolate land shall be tilled instead of lying desolate in the sight of all who pass by.
verses.textEnNlt: The fields that used to lie empty and desolate in plain view of everyone will again be farmed.
verses.textEnNasb: The desolated land will be cultivated instead of being a desolation in the sight of everyone who passes by.
verses.textEn: The desolate land will be cultivated instead of lying desolate in the sight of all who pass through it.

verses.textZh: 他们必说："先前这荒凉之地，现在竟像伊甸园一样；这些废弃、荒凉、毁坏了的城市，现在却成了坚固城，有人居住了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们必说："先前这荒凉之地，现在竟像伊甸园一样；这些废弃、荒凉、毁坏了的城市，现在却成了坚固城，有人居住了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必说：『这先前为荒废之地，现在成如伊甸园；这荒废凄凉、毁坏的城邑现在坚固有人居住。』
verses.textEnNiv: They will say, "This land that was laid waste has become like the garden of Eden; the cities that were lying in ruins, desolate and destroyed, are now fortified and inhabited."
verses.textEnEsv: And they will say, ‘This land that was desolate has become like the garden of Eden, and the waste and desolate and ruined cities are now fortified and inhabited.’
verses.textEnNkjv: So they will say, ‘This land that was desolate has become like the garden of Eden; and the wasted, desolate, and ruined cities arenow fortified and inhabited.’
verses.textEnNlt: And when I bring you back, people will say, ‘This former wasteland is now like the Garden of Eden! The abandoned and ruined cities now have strong walls and are filled with people!’
verses.textEnNasb: And they will say, ‘This desolated land has become like the Garden of Eden; and the waste, desolated and ruined cities are fortified and inhabited.’
verses.textEn: They will say, "This land that was laid waste has become like the garden of Eden; the cities that were lying in ruins, desolate and destroyed, are now fortified and inhabited."

verses.textZh: 那时，在你们四围所余剩的列国，就必知道我是耶和华，是我重建了那些毁坏的地方，栽植了那些荒凉之地。我耶和华说了，就必实行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，在你们四围所余剩的列国，就必知道我是耶和华，是我重建了那些毁坏的地方，栽植了那些荒凉之地。我耶和华说了，就必实行。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，在你们四围其余的外邦人必知道我－耶和华修造那毁坏之处，培植那荒废之地。我－耶和华说过，也必成就。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the nations around you that remain will know that I the Lord have rebuilt what was destroyed and have replanted what was desolate. I the Lord have spoken, and I will do it.’
verses.textEnEsv: Then the nations that are left all around you shall know that I am the Lord ; I have rebuilt the ruined places and replanted that which was desolate. I am the Lord ; I have spoken, and I will do it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the nations which are left all around you shall know that I, the Lord, have rebuilt the ruined places and planted what was desolate. I, the Lord, have spoken it, and I will do it."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the surrounding nations that survive will know that I, the Lord , have rebuilt the ruins and replanted the wasteland. For I, the Lord , have spoken, and I will do what I say.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the nations around you that are left will know that I, the Lord, have rebuilt the ruined places and planted that which was desolated; I, the Lord, have spoken, and I will do it."
verses.textEn: Then the nations around you that remain will know that I the Lord have rebuilt what was destroyed and have replanted what was desolate. I the Lord have spoken, and I will do it.’

verses.textZh: "‘主耶和华这样说：我还要让以色列家求我为他们增加人数，多如羊群。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘主耶和华这样说：我还要让以色列家求我为他们增加人数，多如羊群。
verses.textZhCuv: 「主耶和华如此说：我要加增以色列家的人数，多如羊群。他们必为这事向我求问，我要给他们成就。
verses.textEnNiv: "This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Once again I will yield to Israel’s plea and do this for them: I will make their people as numerous as sheep,
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord God : This also I will let the house of Israel ask me to do for them: to increase their people like a flock.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Thus says the Lord God: "I will also let the house of Israel inquire of Me to do this for them: I will increase their men like a flock.
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I am ready to hear Israel’s prayers and to increase their numbers like a flock.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘This is what the Lord God says: "This too I will let the house of Israel ask Me to do for them: I will increase their people like a flock.
verses.textEn: "This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Once again I will yield to Israel’s plea and do this for them: I will make their people as numerous as sheep,

verses.textZh: 守节的时候，在耶路撒冷作祭牲的羊群是怎样多，那些荒废了的城市也必照样满了人群。他们就知道我是耶和华。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 守节的时候，在耶路撒冷作祭牲的羊群是怎样多，那些荒废了的城市也必照样满了人群。他们就知道我是耶和华。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶路撒冷在守节作祭物所献的羊群怎样多，照样，荒凉的城邑必被人群充满。他们就知道我是耶和华。」
verses.textEnNiv: as numerous as the flocks for offerings at Jerusalem during her appointed festivals. So will the ruined cities be filled with flocks of people. Then they will know that I am the Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: Like the flock for sacrifices, like the flock at Jerusalem during her appointed feasts, so shall the waste cities be filled with flocks of people. Then they will know that I am the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: Like a flock offeredas holy sacrifices, like the flock at Jerusalem on its feast days, so shall the ruined cities be filled with flocks of men. Then they shall know that I am the Lord." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: They will be as numerous as the sacred flocks that fill Jerusalem’s streets at the time of her festivals. The ruined cities will be crowded with people once more, and everyone will know that I am the Lord ."
verses.textEnNasb: Like the flock for sacrifices, like the flock at Jerusalem during her appointed feasts, so will the waste cities be filled with flocks of people. Then they will know that I am the Lord." ’ "
verses.textEn: as numerous as the flocks for offerings at Jerusalem during her appointed festivals. So will the ruined cities be filled with flocks of people. Then they will know that I am the Lord ."

verses.textZh: 耶和华的手按在我身上；耶和华借着他的灵领我出去，把我放在平原上，这平原布满了骸骨。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的手按在我身上；耶和华借着他的灵领我出去，把我放在平原上，这平原布满了骸骨。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的灵 降在我身上。耶和华藉他的灵带我出去，将我放在平原中；这平原遍满骸骨。
verses.textEnNiv: The hand of the Lord was on me, and he brought me out by the Spirit of the Lord and set me in the middle of a valley; it was full of bones.
verses.textEnEsv: The hand of the Lord was upon me, and he brought me out in the Spirit of the Lord and set me down in the middle of the valley; it was full of bones.
verses.textEnNkjv: The hand of the Lord came upon me and brought me out in the Spirit of the Lord, and set me down in the midst of the valley; and it was full of bones.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord took hold of me, and I was carried away by the Spirit of the Lord to a valley filled with bones.
verses.textEnNasb: The hand of the Lord was upon me, and He brought me out by the Spirit of the Lord and set me down in the middle of the valley; and it was full of bones.
verses.textEn: The hand of the Lord was on me, and he brought me out by the Spirit of the Lord and set me in the middle of a valley; it was full of bones.

verses.textZh: 他带我在骸骨的四围经过；我看见平原上面有很多骸骨，都非常枯干。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他带我在骸骨的四围经过；我看见平原上面有很多骸骨，都非常枯干。
verses.textZhCuv: 他使我从骸骨的四围经过，谁知在平原的骸骨甚多，而且极其枯干。
verses.textEnNiv: He led me back and forth among them, and I saw a great many bones on the floor of the valley, bones that were very dry.
verses.textEnEsv: And he led me around among them, and behold, there were very many on the surface of the valley, and behold, they were very dry.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He caused me to pass by them all around, and behold, therewere very many in the open valley; and indeed theywere very dry.
verses.textEnNlt: He led me all around among the bones that covered the valley floor. They were scattered everywhere across the ground and were completely dried out.
verses.textEnNasb: He had me pass among them all around, and behold, there were very many on the surface of the valley; and behold, they were very dry.
verses.textEn: He led me back and forth among them, and I saw a great many bones on the floor of the valley, bones that were very dry.

verses.textZh: 他问我："人子啊！这些骸骨能活过来吗？"我回答："主耶和华啊！唯有你才知道。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他问我："人子啊！这些骸骨能活过来吗？"我回答："主耶和华啊！唯有你才知道。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他对我说：「人子啊，这些骸骨能复活吗？」我说：「主耶和华啊，你是知道的。」
verses.textEnNiv: He asked me, "Son of man, can these bones live?" I said, "Sovereign Lord , you alone know."
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to me, "Son of man, can these bones live?" And I answered, "O Lord God , you know."
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said to me, "Son of man, can these bones live?" So I answered, "O Lord God, You know."
verses.textEnNlt: Then he asked me, "Son of man, can these bones become living people again?" "O Sovereign Lord ," I replied, "you alone know the answer to that."
verses.textEnNasb: Then He said to me, "Son of man, can these bones live?" And I answered, "Lord God, You Yourself know."
verses.textEn: He asked me, "Son of man, can these bones live?" I said, "Sovereign Lord , you alone know."

verses.textZh: 他又对我说："你要向这些骸骨说预言，对它们说：‘枯干的骸骨啊！你们要听耶和华的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又对我说："你要向这些骸骨说预言，对它们说：‘枯干的骸骨啊！你们要听耶和华的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 他又对我说：「你向这些骸骨发预言说：枯干的骸骨啊，要听耶和华的话。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he said to me, "Prophesy to these bones and say to them, ‘Dry bones, hear the word of the Lord !
verses.textEnEsv: Then he said to me, "Prophesy over these bones, and say to them, O dry bones, hear the word of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Again He said to me, "Prophesy to these bones, and say to them, ‘O dry bones, hear the word of the Lord!
verses.textEnNlt: Then he said to me, "Speak a prophetic message to these bones and say, ‘Dry bones, listen to the word of the Lord !
verses.textEnNasb: Again He said to me, "Prophesy over these bones and say to them, ‘You dry bones, hear the word of the Lord.’
verses.textEn: Then he said to me, "Prophesy to these bones and say to them, ‘Dry bones, hear the word of the Lord !

verses.textZh: 主耶和华对这些骸骨这样说：看哪！我必使气息进入你们里面，你们就活过来了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主耶和华对这些骸骨这样说：看哪！我必使气息进入你们里面，你们就活过来了。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华对这些骸骨如此说：『我必使气息进入你们里面，你们就要活了。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Sovereign Lord says to these bones: I will make breath enter you, and you will come to life.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord God to these bones: Behold, I will cause breath to enter you, and you shall live.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord God to these bones: "Surely I will cause breath to enter into you, and you shall live.
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Look! I am going to put breath into you and make you live again!
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord God says to these bones: ‘Behold, I am going to make breath enter you so that you may come to life.
verses.textEn: This is what the Sovereign Lord says to these bones: I will make breath enter you, and you will come to life.

verses.textZh: 我必使你们生筋长肉，给你们包上皮，又把气息放入你们里面，你们必活过来；你们就知道我是耶和华。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必使你们生筋长肉，给你们包上皮，又把气息放入你们里面，你们必活过来；你们就知道我是耶和华。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 我必给你们加上筋，使你们长肉，又将皮遮蔽你们，使气息进入你们里面，你们就要活了；你们便知道我是耶和华。』」
verses.textEnNiv: I will attach tendons to you and make flesh come upon you and cover you with skin; I will put breath in you, and you will come to life. Then you will know that I am the Lord .’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And I will lay sinews upon you, and will cause flesh to come upon you, and cover you with skin, and put breath in you, and you shall live, and you shall know that I am the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: I will put sinews on you and bring flesh upon you, cover you with skin and put breath in you; and you shall live. Then you shall know that I am the Lord." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: I will put flesh and muscles on you and cover you with skin. I will put breath into you, and you will come to life. Then you will know that I am the Lord .’"
verses.textEnNasb: And I will attach tendons to you, make flesh grow back on you, cover you with skin, and put breath in you so that you may come to life; and you will know that I am the Lord.’ "
verses.textEn: I will attach tendons to you and make flesh come upon you and cover you with skin; I will put breath in you, and you will come to life. Then you will know that I am the Lord .’ "

verses.textZh: 于是我遵命说预言；我正在说预言的时候，就听见有响声，骨头与骨头互相结合起来，格格作响。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是我遵命说预言；我正在说预言的时候，就听见有响声，骨头与骨头互相结合起来，格格作响。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，我遵命说预言。正说预言的时候，不料，有响声，有地震；骨与骨互相联络。
verses.textEnNiv: So I prophesied as I was commanded. And as I was prophesying, there was a noise, a rattling sound, and the bones came together, bone to bone.
verses.textEnEsv: So I prophesied as I was commanded. And as I prophesied, there was a sound, and behold, a rattling, and the bones came together, bone to its bone.
verses.textEnNkjv: So I prophesied as I was commanded; and as I prophesied, there was a noise, and suddenly a rattling; and the bones came together, bone to bone.
verses.textEnNlt: So I spoke this message, just as he told me. Suddenly as I spoke, there was a rattling noise all across the valley. The bones of each body came together and attached themselves as complete skeletons.
verses.textEnNasb: So I prophesied as I was commanded; and as I prophesied, there was a loud noise, and behold, a rattling; and the bones came together, bone to its bone.
verses.textEn: So I prophesied as I was commanded. And as I was prophesying, there was a noise, a rattling sound, and the bones came together, bone to bone.

verses.textZh: 我观看，见骸骨生了筋，长了肉，又有皮包在上面，只是它们里面还没有气息。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我观看，见骸骨生了筋，长了肉，又有皮包在上面，只是它们里面还没有气息。
verses.textZhCuv: 我观看，见骸骨上有筋，也长了肉，又有皮遮蔽其上，只是还没有气息。
verses.textEnNiv: I looked, and tendons and flesh appeared on them and skin covered them, but there was no breath in them.
verses.textEnEsv: And I looked, and behold, there were sinews on them, and flesh had come upon them, and skin had covered them. But there was no breath in them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Indeed, as I looked, the sinews and the flesh came upon them, and the skin covered them over; but therewas no breath in them.
verses.textEnNlt: Then as I watched, muscles and flesh formed over the bones. Then skin formed to cover their bodies, but they still had no breath in them.
verses.textEnNasb: And I looked, and behold, tendons were on them, and flesh grew and skin covered them; but there was no breath in them.
verses.textEn: I looked, and tendons and flesh appeared on them and skin covered them, but there was no breath in them.

verses.textZh: 他对我说："你要向气息说预言。人子啊！你要说预言。你要向气息说：‘主耶和华这样说：气息啊！你要从四方 而来，吹在这些被杀的人身上，使它们活过来。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他对我说："你要向气息说预言。人子啊！你要说预言。你要向气息说：‘主耶和华这样说：气息啊！你要从四方 而来，吹在这些被杀的人身上，使它们活过来。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 主对我说：「人子啊，你要发预言，向风发预言，说主耶和华如此说：气息啊，要从四方 而来，吹在这些被杀的人身上，使他们活了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then he said to me, "Prophesy to the breath; prophesy, son of man, and say to it, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Come, breath, from the four winds and breathe into these slain, that they may live.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Then he said to me, "Prophesy to the breath; prophesy, son of man, and say to the breath, Thus says the Lord God : Come from the four winds, O breath, and breathe on these slain, that they may live."
verses.textEnNkjv: Also He said to me, "Prophesy to the breath, prophesy, son of man, and say to the breath, ‘Thus says the Lord God: "Come from the four winds, O breath, and breathe on these slain, that they may live." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Then he said to me, "Speak a prophetic message to the winds, son of man. Speak a prophetic message and say, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Come, O breath, from the four winds! Breathe into these dead bodies so they may live again.’"
verses.textEnNasb: Then He said to me, "Prophesy to the breath, prophesy, son of man, and say to the breath, ‘The Lord God says this: "Come from the four winds, breath, and breathe on these slain, so that they come to life." ’ "
verses.textEn: Then he said to me, "Prophesy to the breath; prophesy, son of man, and say to it, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Come, breath, from the four winds and breathe into these slain, that they may live.’ "

verses.textZh: 于是我遵命说预言，气息就进入骸骨里面，骸骨就活过来，并且站起，成了一支极大的军队。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是我遵命说预言，气息就进入骸骨里面，骸骨就活过来，并且站起，成了一支极大的军队。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是我遵命说预言，气息就进入骸骨，骸骨便活了，并且站起来，成为极大的军队。
verses.textEnNiv: So I prophesied as he commanded me, and breath entered them; they came to life and stood up on their feet—a vast army.
verses.textEnEsv: So I prophesied as he commanded me, and the breath came into them, and they lived and stood on their feet, an exceedingly great army.
verses.textEnNkjv: So I prophesied as He commanded me, and breath came into them, and they lived, and stood upon their feet, an exceedingly great army.
verses.textEnNlt: So I spoke the message as he commanded me, and breath came into their bodies. They all came to life and stood up on their feet—a great army.
verses.textEnNasb: So I prophesied as He commanded me, and the breath entered them, and they came to life and stood on their feet, an exceedingly great army.
verses.textEn: So I prophesied as he commanded me, and breath entered them; they came to life and stood up on their feet—a vast army.

verses.textZh: 他对我说："人子啊！这些骸骨就是以色列全家；他们常说：‘我们的骸骨枯干了，我们的盼望消失了；我们都灭亡了。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 他对我说："人子啊！这些骸骨就是以色列全家；他们常说：‘我们的骸骨枯干了，我们的盼望消失了；我们都灭亡了。’
verses.textZhCuv: 主对我说：「人子啊，这些骸骨就是以色列全家。他们说：『我们的骨头枯干了，我们的指望失去了，我们灭绝净尽了。』
verses.textEnNiv: Then he said to me: "Son of man, these bones are the people of Israel. They say, ‘Our bones are dried up and our hope is gone; we are cut off.’
verses.textEnEsv: Then he said to me, "Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel. Behold, they say, ‘Our bones are dried up, and our hope is lost; we are indeed cut off.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He said to me, "Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel. They indeed say, ‘Our bones are dry, our hope is lost, and we ourselves are cut off!’
verses.textEnNlt: Then he said to me, "Son of man, these bones represent the people of Israel. They are saying, ‘We have become old, dry bones—all hope is gone. Our nation is finished.’
verses.textEnNasb: Then He said to me, "Son of man, these bones are the entire house of Israel; behold, they say, ‘Our bones are dried up and our hope has perished. We are completely cut off.’
verses.textEn: Then he said to me: "Son of man, these bones are the people of Israel. They say, ‘Our bones are dried up and our hope is gone; we are cut off.’

verses.textZh: 因此，你要说预言，对他们说：‘主耶和华这样说：我的子民哪！我要打开你们的坟墓，把你们从坟墓中领上来，带你们回以色列地去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，你要说预言，对他们说：‘主耶和华这样说：我的子民哪！我要打开你们的坟墓，把你们从坟墓中领上来，带你们回以色列地去。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以你要发预言对他们说，主耶和华如此说：『我的民哪，我必开你们的坟墓，使你们从坟墓中出来，领你们进入以色列地。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore prophesy and say to them: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: My people, I am going to open your graves and bring you up from them; I will bring you back to the land of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore prophesy, and say to them, Thus says the Lord God : Behold, I will open your graves and raise you from your graves, O my people. And I will bring you into the land of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore prophesy and say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord God: "Behold, O My people, I will open your graves and cause you to come up from your graves, and bring you into the land of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, prophesy to them and say, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: O my people, I will open your graves of exile and cause you to rise again. Then I will bring you back to the land of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore prophesy and say to them, ‘This is what the Lord God says: "Behold, I am going to open your graves and cause you to come up out of your graves, My people; and I will bring you into the land of Israel.
verses.textEn: Therefore prophesy and say to them: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: My people, I am going to open your graves and bring you up from them; I will bring you back to the land of Israel.

verses.textZh: 我的子民哪！我打开你们的坟墓，把你们从坟墓中领上来的时候，你们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的子民哪！我打开你们的坟墓，把你们从坟墓中领上来的时候，你们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的民哪，我开你们的坟墓，使你们从坟墓中出来，你们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: Then you, my people, will know that I am the Lord , when I open your graves and bring you up from them.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall know that I am the Lord , when I open your graves, and raise you from your graves, O my people.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then you shall know that I am the Lord, when I have opened your graves, O My people, and brought you up from your graves.
verses.textEnNlt: When this happens, O my people, you will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Then you will know that I am the Lord, when I have opened your graves and caused you to come up out of your graves, My people.
verses.textEn: Then you, my people, will know that I am the Lord , when I open your graves and bring you up from them.

verses.textZh: 我要把我的灵放在你们里面，你们就活过来；我要把你们安顿在你们的土地上，你们就知道我耶和华说了，就必实行。这是主耶和华的宣告。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要把我的灵放在你们里面，你们就活过来；我要把你们安顿在你们的土地上，你们就知道我耶和华说了，就必实行。这是主耶和华的宣告。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 我必将我的灵放在你们里面，你们就要活了。我将你们安置在本地，你们就知道我－耶和华如此说，也如此成就了。这是耶和华说的。』」
verses.textEnNiv: I will put my Spirit in you and you will live, and I will settle you in your own land. Then you will know that I the Lord have spoken, and I have done it, declares the Lord .’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And I will put my Spirit within you, and you shall live, and I will place you in your own land. Then you shall know that I am the Lord ; I have spoken, and I will do it, declares the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: I will put My Spirit in you, and you shall live, and I will place you in your own land. Then you shall know that I, the Lord, have spoken it and performed it," says the Lord.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: I will put my Spirit in you, and you will live again and return home to your own land. Then you will know that I, the Lord , have spoken, and I have done what I said. Yes, the Lord has spoken!’"
verses.textEnNasb: And I will put My Spirit within you and you will come to life, and I will place you on your own land. Then you will know that I, the Lord, have spoken and done it," declares the Lord.’ "
verses.textEn: I will put my Spirit in you and you will live, and I will settle you in your own land. Then you will know that I the Lord have spoken, and I have done it, declares the Lord .’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnNkjv: Again the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Again a message came to me from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: The word of the Lord came again to me, saying,
verses.textEn: The word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: "人子啊！你要拿一根木杖，在上面写‘犹大和那些与他一起的以色列人’；又拿另一根木杖，在上面写‘以法莲的木杖，就是约瑟和与他一起的以色列全家’。
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！你要拿一根木杖，在上面写‘犹大和那些与他一起的以色列人’；又拿另一根木杖，在上面写‘以法莲的木杖，就是约瑟和与他一起的以色列全家’。
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，你要取一根木杖，在其上写『为犹大和他的同伴以色列人』；又取一根木杖，在其上写『为约瑟，就是为以法莲，又为他的同伴以色列全家』。
verses.textEnNiv: "Son of man, take a stick of wood and write on it, ‘Belonging to Judah and the Israelites associated with him.’ Then take another stick of wood, and write on it, ‘Belonging to Joseph (that is, to Ephraim) and all the Israelites associated with him.’
verses.textEnEsv: "Son of man, take a stick and write on it, ‘For Judah, and the people of Israel associated with him’; then take another stick and write on it, ‘For Joseph (the stick of Ephraim) and all the house of Israel associated with him.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "As for you, son of man, take a stick for yourself and write on it: ‘For Judah and for the children of Israel, his companions.’ Then take another stick and write on it, ‘For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim, and for all the house of Israel, his companions.’
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, take a piece of wood and carve on it these words: ‘This represents Judah and its allied tribes.’ Then take another piece and carve these words on it: ‘This represents Ephraim and the northern tribes of Israel.’
verses.textEnNasb: "Now you, son of man, take for yourself one stick and write on it, ‘For Judah and for the sons of Israel, his companions’; then take another stick and write on it, ‘For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim and all the house of Israel, his companions.’
verses.textEn: "Son of man, take a stick of wood and write on it, ‘Belonging to Judah and the Israelites associated with him.’ Then take another stick of wood, and write on it, ‘Belonging to Joseph (that is, to Ephraim) and all the Israelites associated with him.’

verses.textZh: 你要把这两根木杖连接在一起，使它们在你手里成为一根。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要把这两根木杖连接在一起，使它们在你手里成为一根。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要使这两根木杖接连为一，在你手中成为一根。
verses.textEnNiv: Join them together into one stick so that they will become one in your hand.
verses.textEnEsv: And join them one to another into one stick, that they may become one in your hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then join them one to another for yourself into one stick, and they will become one in your hand.
verses.textEnNlt: Now hold them together in your hand as if they were one piece of wood.
verses.textEnNasb: Then put them together for yourself one to another into one stick, so that they may become one in your hand.
verses.textEn: Join them together into one stick so that they will become one in your hand.

verses.textZh: 如果你本国的人民问你：‘你不告诉我们这些木杖是甚么意思吗？’
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你本国的人民问你：‘你不告诉我们这些木杖是甚么意思吗？’
verses.textZhCuv: 你本国的子民问你说：『这是什么意思？你不指示我们吗？』
verses.textEnNiv: "When your people ask you, ‘Won’t you tell us what you mean by this?’
verses.textEnEsv: And when your people say to you, ‘Will you not tell us what you mean by these?’
verses.textEnNkjv: "And when the children of your people speak to you, saying, ‘Will you not show us what you mean by these?’—
verses.textEnNlt: When your people ask you what your actions mean,
verses.textEnNasb: And when the sons of your people speak to you, saying, ‘Will you not declare to us what you mean by these?’
verses.textEn: "When your people ask you, ‘Won’t you tell us what you mean by this?’

verses.textZh: 你就要回答他们：‘主耶和华这样说：看哪！我要拿约瑟和与他一起的以色列众支派的木杖，就是在以法莲手里的，跟犹大的木杖连接在一起，使它们在我手里成为一根。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 你就要回答他们：‘主耶和华这样说：看哪！我要拿约瑟和与他一起的以色列众支派的木杖，就是在以法莲手里的，跟犹大的木杖连接在一起，使它们在我手里成为一根。’
verses.textZhCuv: 你就对他们说：『主耶和华如此说：我要将约瑟和他同伴以色列支派的杖，就是那在以法莲手中的，与犹大的杖一同接连为一，在我手中成为一根。』
verses.textEnNiv: say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I am going to take the stick of Joseph—which is in Ephraim’s hand—and of the Israelite tribes associated with him, and join it to Judah’s stick. I will make them into a single stick of wood, and they will become one in my hand.’
verses.textEnEsv: say to them, Thus says the Lord God : Behold, I am about to take the stick of Joseph (that is in the hand of Ephraim) and the tribes of Israel associated with him. And I will join with it the stick of Judah, and make them one stick, that they may be one in my hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord God: "Surely I will take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel, his companions; and I will join them with it, with the stick of Judah, and make them one stick, and they will be one in My hand." ’
verses.textEnNlt: say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I will take Ephraim and the northern tribes and join them to Judah. I will make them one piece of wood in my hand.’
verses.textEnNasb: say to them, ‘This is what the Lord God says: "Behold, I am going to take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel, his companions; and I will put them with it, with the stick of Judah, and make them one stick, and they will be one in My hand." ’
verses.textEn: say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I am going to take the stick of Joseph—which is in Ephraim’s hand—and of the Israelite tribes associated with him, and join it to Judah’s stick. I will make them into a single stick of wood, and they will become one in my hand.’

verses.textZh: 你写上了字的那两根木杖，要在他们眼前握在手里；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你写上了字的那两根木杖，要在他们眼前握在手里；
verses.textZhCuv: 你所写的那两根杖要在他们眼前拿在手中，
verses.textEnNiv: Hold before their eyes the sticks you have written on
verses.textEnEsv: When the sticks on which you write are in your hand before their eyes,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the sticks on which you write will be in your hand before their eyes.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then hold out the pieces of wood you have inscribed, so the people can see them.
verses.textEnNasb: The sticks on which you write will be in your hand before their eyes.
verses.textEn: Hold before their eyes the sticks you have written on

verses.textZh: 你要对他们说：‘主耶和华这样说：看哪！我要把以色列人从他们所到的列国中领出来，又从四围聚集他们，把他们领回故土。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要对他们说：‘主耶和华这样说：看哪！我要把以色列人从他们所到的列国中领出来，又从四围聚集他们，把他们领回故土。
verses.textZhCuv: 要对他们说，主耶和华如此说：我要将以色列人从他们所到的各国收取，又从四围聚集他们，引导他们归回本地。
verses.textEnNiv: and say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I will take the Israelites out of the nations where they have gone. I will gather them from all around and bring them back into their own land.
verses.textEnEsv: then say to them, Thus says the Lord God : Behold, I will take the people of Israel from the nations among which they have gone, and will gather them from all around, and bring them to their own land.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord God: "Surely I will take the children of Israel from among the nations, wherever they have gone, and will gather them from every side and bring them into their own land;
verses.textEnNlt: And give them this message from the Sovereign Lord : I will gather the people of Israel from among the nations. I will bring them home to their own land from the places where they have been scattered.
verses.textEnNasb: And say to them, ‘This is what the Lord God says: "Behold, I am going to take the sons of Israel from among the nations where they have gone, and I will gather them from every side and bring them into their own land;
verses.textEn: and say to them, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I will take the Israelites out of the nations where they have gone. I will gather them from all around and bring them back into their own land.

verses.textZh: 我要使他们在那地上，在以色列的众山上，成为一国；必有一王统治他们众人；他们不再是两个国，不再分为两个邦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要使他们在那地上，在以色列的众山上，成为一国；必有一王统治他们众人；他们不再是两个国，不再分为两个邦。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要使他们在那地，在以色列山上成为一国，有一王作他们众民的王。他们不再为二国，决不再分为二国；
verses.textEnNiv: I will make them one nation in the land, on the mountains of Israel. There will be one king over all of them and they will never again be two nations or be divided into two kingdoms.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will make them one nation in the land, on the mountains of Israel. And one king shall be king over them all, and they shall be no longer two nations, and no longer divided into two kingdoms.
verses.textEnNkjv: and I will make them one nation in the land, on the mountains of Israel; and one king shall be king over them all; they shall no longer be two nations, nor shall they ever be divided into two kingdoms again.
verses.textEnNlt: I will unify them into one nation on the mountains of Israel. One king will rule them all; no longer will they be divided into two nations or into two kingdoms.
verses.textEnNasb: and I will make them one nation in the land, on the mountains of Israel; and one king will be king for all of them; and they will no longer be two nations, and no longer be divided into two kingdoms.
verses.textEn: I will make them one nation in the land, on the mountains of Israel. There will be one king over all of them and they will never again be two nations or be divided into two kingdoms.

verses.textZh: 他们必不再因自己的偶像和可憎的像，以及一切过犯，而玷污自己；我必拯救他们脱离一切背道的罪 ；我必洁净他们，他们就必作我的子民，我必作他们的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们必不再因自己的偶像和可憎的像，以及一切过犯，而玷污自己；我必拯救他们脱离一切背道的罪 ；我必洁净他们，他们就必作我的子民，我必作他们的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 也不再因偶像和可憎的物，并一切的罪过玷污自己。我却要救他们出离一切的住处，就是他们犯罪的地方；我要洁净他们，如此，他们要作我的子民，我要作他们的神。
verses.textEnNiv: They will no longer defile themselves with their idols and vile images or with any of their offenses, for I will save them from all their sinful backsliding, and I will cleanse them. They will be my people, and I will be their God.
verses.textEnEsv: They shall not defile themselves anymore with their idols and their detestable things, or with any of their transgressions. But I will save them from all the backslidings in which they have sinned, and will cleanse them; and they shall be my people, and I will be their God.
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall not defile themselves anymore with their idols, nor with their detestable things, nor with any of their transgressions; but I will deliver them from all their dwelling places in which they have sinned, and will cleanse them. Then they shall be My people, and I will be their God.
verses.textEnNlt: They will never again pollute themselves with their idols and vile images and rebellion, for I will save them from their sinful apostasy. I will cleanse them. Then they will truly be my people, and I will be their God.
verses.textEnNasb: They will no longer defile themselves with their idols, or with their detestable things, or with any of their offenses; but I will rescue them from all their dwelling places in which they have sinned, and will cleanse them. And they will be My people, and I will be their God.
verses.textEn: They will no longer defile themselves with their idols and vile images or with any of their offenses, for I will save them from all their sinful backsliding, and I will cleanse them. They will be my people, and I will be their God.

verses.textZh: "‘我的仆人大卫必作他们的王；他们众人只有一个牧者。他们必遵行我的典章，谨守实行我的律例。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘我的仆人大卫必作他们的王；他们众人只有一个牧者。他们必遵行我的典章，谨守实行我的律例。
verses.textZhCuv: 「我的仆人大卫必作他们的王；众民必归一个牧人。他们必顺从我的典章，谨守遵行我的律例。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘My servant David will be king over them, and they will all have one shepherd. They will follow my laws and be careful to keep my decrees.
verses.textEnEsv: "My servant David shall be king over them, and they shall all have one shepherd. They shall walk in my rules and be careful to obey my statutes.
verses.textEnNkjv: "David My servant shallbe king over them, and they shall all have one shepherd; they shall also walk in My judgments and observe My statutes, and do them.
verses.textEnNlt: "My servant David will be their king, and they will have only one shepherd. They will obey my regulations and be careful to keep my decrees.
verses.textEnNasb: "And My servant David will be king over them, and they will all have one shepherd; and they will walk in My ordinances, and keep My statutes and follow them.
verses.textEn: " ‘My servant David will be king over them, and they will all have one shepherd. They will follow my laws and be careful to keep my decrees.

verses.textZh: 他们必住在我所赐给我仆人雅各的地上，就是你们列祖所住的地。他们和他们的子孙，以及子孙的子孙，都必永远住在那里；我的仆人大卫必永远作他们的领袖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们必住在我所赐给我仆人雅各的地上，就是你们列祖所住的地。他们和他们的子孙，以及子孙的子孙，都必永远住在那里；我的仆人大卫必永远作他们的领袖。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必住在我赐给我仆人雅各的地上，就是你们列祖所住之地。他们和他们的子孙，并子孙的子孙，都永远住在那里。我的仆人大卫必作他们的王，直到永远。
verses.textEnNiv: They will live in the land I gave to my servant Jacob, the land where your ancestors lived. They and their children and their children’s children will live there forever, and David my servant will be their prince forever.
verses.textEnEsv: They shall dwell in the land that I gave to my servant Jacob, where your fathers lived. They and their children and their children’s children shall dwell there forever, and David my servant shall be their prince forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they shall dwell in the land that I have given to Jacob My servant, where your fathers dwelt; and they shall dwell there, they, their children, and their children’s children, forever; and My servant David shallbe their prince forever.
verses.textEnNlt: They will live in the land I gave my servant Jacob, the land where their ancestors lived. They and their children and their grandchildren after them will live there forever, generation after generation. And my servant David will be their prince forever.
verses.textEnNasb: And they will live on the land that I gave to My servant Jacob, in which your fathers lived; and they will live on it, they, and their sons and their sons’ sons, forever; and My servant David will be their leader forever.
verses.textEn: They will live in the land I gave to my servant Jacob, the land where your ancestors lived. They and their children and their children’s children will live there forever, and David my servant will be their prince forever.

verses.textZh: 我要与他们立平安的约，是一个永远的约；我必坚立他们，使他们人数增多，又在他们中间设立我的圣所，直到永远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要与他们立平安的约，是一个永远的约；我必坚立他们，使他们人数增多，又在他们中间设立我的圣所，直到永远。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且我要与他们立平安的约，作为永约。我也要将他们安置在本地，使他们的人数增多，又在他们中间设立我的圣所，直到永远。
verses.textEnNiv: I will make a covenant of peace with them; it will be an everlasting covenant. I will establish them and increase their numbers, and I will put my sanctuary among them forever.
verses.textEnEsv: I will make a covenant of peace with them. It shall be an everlasting covenant with them. And I will set them in their land and multiply them, and will set my sanctuary in their midst forevermore.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover I will make a covenant of peace with them, and it shall be an everlasting covenant with them; I will establish them and multiply them, and I will set My sanctuary in their midst forevermore.
verses.textEnNlt: And I will make a covenant of peace with them, an everlasting covenant. I will give them their land and increase their numbers, and I will put my Temple among them forever.
verses.textEnNasb: And I will make a covenant of peace with them; it will be an everlasting covenant with them. And I will place them and multiply them, and set My sanctuary in their midst forever.
verses.textEn: I will make a covenant of peace with them; it will be an everlasting covenant. I will establish them and increase their numbers, and I will put my sanctuary among them forever.

verses.textZh: 我的居所必在他们当中；我要作他们的神，他们要作我的子民。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的居所必在他们当中；我要作他们的神，他们要作我的子民。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的居所必在他们中间；我要作他们的神，他们要作我的子民。
verses.textEnNiv: My dwelling place will be with them; I will be their God, and they will be my people.
verses.textEnEsv: My dwelling place shall be with them, and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.
verses.textEnNkjv: My tabernacle also shall be with them; indeed I will be their God, and they shall be My people.
verses.textEnNlt: I will make my home among them. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
verses.textEnNasb: My dwelling place also will be among them; and I will be their God, and they will be My people.
verses.textEn: My dwelling place will be with them; I will be their God, and they will be my people.

verses.textZh: 我的圣所必永远在他们中间，列国就知道我是耶和华，是我使以色列成圣的。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的圣所必永远在他们中间，列国就知道我是耶和华，是我使以色列成圣的。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 我的圣所在以色列人中间直到永远，外邦人就必知道我是叫以色列成为圣的耶和华。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the nations will know that I the Lord make Israel holy, when my sanctuary is among them forever.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Then the nations will know that I am the Lord who sanctifies Israel, when my sanctuary is in their midst forevermore."
verses.textEnNkjv: The nations also will know that I, the Lord, sanctify Israel, when My sanctuary is in their midst forevermore." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: And when my Temple is among them forever, the nations will know that I am the Lord , who makes Israel holy."
verses.textEnNasb: And the nations will know that I am the Lord who sanctifies Israel, when My sanctuary is in their midst forever." ’ "
verses.textEn: Then the nations will know that I the Lord make Israel holy, when my sanctuary is among them forever.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话临到我说：
verses.textEnNiv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnEsv: The word of the Lord came to me:
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: This is another message that came to me from the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: Now the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.textEn: The word of the Lord came to me:

verses.textZh: "人子啊！你要面向玛各地的歌革，就是罗施、米设和土巴的首领，说预言攻击他，
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！你要面向玛各地的歌革，就是罗施、米设和土巴的首领，说预言攻击他，
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，你要面向玛各地的歌革，就是罗施、米设、土巴的王发预言攻击他，
verses.textEnNiv: "Son of man, set your face against Gog, of the land of Magog, the chief prince of Meshek and Tubal; prophesy against him
verses.textEnEsv: "Son of man, set your face toward Gog, of the land of Magog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal, and prophesy against him
verses.textEnNkjv: "Son of man, set your face against Gog, of the land of Magog, the prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal, and prophesy against him,
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, turn and face Gog of the land of Magog, the prince who rules over the nations of Meshech and Tubal, and prophesy against him.
verses.textEnNasb: "Son of man, set your face toward Gog of the land of Magog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal, and prophesy against him,
verses.textEn: "Son of man, set your face against Gog, of the land of Magog, the chief prince of Meshek and Tubal; prophesy against him

verses.textZh: 说：‘主耶和华这样说：罗施、米设和土巴的首领歌革啊，我要与你为敌。
