verses.textZhCnvs: 说：‘主耶和华这样说：罗施、米设和土巴的首领歌革啊，我要与你为敌。
verses.textZhCuv: 说主耶和华如此说：罗施、米设、土巴的王歌革啊，我与你为敌。
verses.textEnNiv: and say: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I am against you, Gog, chief prince of Meshek and Tubal.
verses.textEnEsv: and say, Thus says the Lord God : Behold, I am against you, O Gog, chief prince of Meshech and Tubal.
verses.textEnNkjv: and say, ‘Thus says the Lord God: Behold, I am against you, O Gog, the prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal.
verses.textEnNlt: Give him this message from the Sovereign Lord : Gog, I am your enemy!
verses.textEnNasb: and say, ‘This is what the Lord God says: "Behold, I am against you, Gog, chief prince of Meshech and Tubal.
verses.textEn: and say: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I am against you, Gog, chief prince of Meshek and Tubal.

verses.textZh: 我必使你转过来，用钩子钩住你的腮颊，把你和你的全军、马匹和骑兵，都领出来，他们都穿著全副军装，成为大队人马，配备大小盾牌，各人紧握刀剑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必使你转过来，用钩子钩住你的腮颊，把你和你的全军、马匹和骑兵，都领出来，他们都穿著全副军装，成为大队人马，配备大小盾牌，各人紧握刀剑。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必用钩子钩住你的腮颊，调转你，将你和你的军兵、马匹、马兵带出来，都披挂整齐，成了大队，有大小盾牌，各拿刀剑。
verses.textEnNiv: I will turn you around, put hooks in your jaws and bring you out with your whole army—your horses, your horsemen fully armed, and a great horde with large and small shields, all of them brandishing their swords.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will turn you about and put hooks into your jaws, and I will bring you out, and all your army, horses and horsemen, all of them clothed in full armor, a great host, all of them with buckler and shield, wielding swords.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will turn you around, put hooks into your jaws, and lead you out, with all your army, horses, and horsemen, all splendidly clothed, a great company with bucklers and shields, all of them handling swords.
verses.textEnNlt: I will turn you around and put hooks in your jaws to lead you out with your whole army—your horses and charioteers in full armor and a great horde armed with shields and swords.
verses.textEnNasb: So I will turn you around and put hooks into your jaws, and I will bring you out, and all your army, horses and horsemen, all of them magnificently dressed, a great contingent with shield and buckler, all of them wielding swords;
verses.textEn: I will turn you around, put hooks in your jaws and bring you out with your whole army—your horses, your horsemen fully armed, and a great horde with large and small shields, all of them brandishing their swords.

verses.textZh: 还有波斯人、古实人和弗人与他们在一起，各人都配备盾牌和头盔；
verses.textZhCnvs: 还有波斯人、古实人和弗人与他们在一起，各人都配备盾牌和头盔；
verses.textZhCuv: 波斯人、古实人，和弗人 ，各拿盾牌，头上戴盔；
verses.textEnNiv: Persia, Cush and Put will be with them, all with shields and helmets,
verses.textEnEsv: Persia, Cush, and Put are with them, all of them with shield and helmet;
verses.textEnNkjv: Persia, Ethiopia, and Libya are with them, all of them with shield and helmet;
verses.textEnNlt: Persia, Ethiopia, and Libya will join you, too, with all their weapons.
verses.textEnNasb: Persia, Cush, and Put with them, all of them with buckler and helmet;
verses.textEn: Persia, Cush and Put will be with them, all with shields and helmets,

verses.textZh: 又有歌篾人和他们的全军，北方极处的陀迦玛族和他们的全军，这许多民族都与你在一起。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又有歌篾人和他们的全军，北方极处的陀迦玛族和他们的全军，这许多民族都与你在一起。
verses.textZhCuv: 歌篾人和他的军队，北方极处的陀迦玛族和他的军队，这许多国的民都同着你。
verses.textEnNiv: also Gomer with all its troops, and Beth Togarmah from the far north with all its troops—the many nations with you.
verses.textEnEsv: Gomer and all his hordes; Beth-togarmah from the uttermost parts of the north with all his hordes— many peoples are with you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Gomer and all its troops; the house of Togarmah from the far north and all its troops—many people are with you.
verses.textEnNlt: Gomer and all its armies will also join you, along with the armies of Beth-togarmah from the distant north, and many others.
verses.textEnNasb: Gomer with all its troops; Beth-togarmah from the remote parts of the north with all its troops—many peoples with you.
verses.textEn: also Gomer with all its troops, and Beth Togarmah from the far north with all its troops—the many nations with you.

verses.textZh: "‘你要准备好，你和那聚集到你那里的各队都要准备好；你要作他们的大帅。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘你要准备好，你和那聚集到你那里的各队都要准备好；你要作他们的大帅。
verses.textZhCuv: 「那聚集到你这里的各队都当准备；你自己也要准备，作他们的大帅。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Get ready; be prepared, you and all the hordes gathered about you, and take command of them.
verses.textEnEsv: "Be ready and keep ready, you and all your hosts that are assembled about you, and be a guard for them.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Prepare yourself and be ready, you and all your companies that are gathered about you; and be a guard for them.
verses.textEnNlt: "Get ready; be prepared! Keep all the armies around you mobilized, and take command of them.
verses.textEnNasb: "Be ready, and be prepared, you and all your contingents that are assembled around you, and be a guard for them.
verses.textEn: " ‘Get ready; be prepared, you and all the hordes gathered about you, and take command of them.

verses.textZh: 过了许多日子，你必被征点出战；在以后的年间，你必来攻击那脱离刀剑的地，就是那从列邦聚集回来的人所住的地；你必来攻击以色列这些久已荒凉的山；他们是从万族中领出来的，都在那里安然居住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 过了许多日子，你必被征点出战；在以后的年间，你必来攻击那脱离刀剑的地，就是那从列邦聚集回来的人所住的地；你必来攻击以色列这些久已荒凉的山；他们是从万族中领出来的，都在那里安然居住。
verses.textZhCuv: 过了多日，你必被差派。到末后之年，你必来到脱离刀剑从列国收回之地，到以色列常久荒凉的山上；但那从列国中招聚出来的必在其上安然居住。
verses.textEnNiv: After many days you will be called to arms. In future years you will invade a land that has recovered from war, whose people were gathered from many nations to the mountains of Israel, which had long been desolate. They had been brought out from the nations, and now all of them live in safety.
verses.textEnEsv: After many days you will be mustered. In the latter years you will go against the land that is restored from war, the land whose people were gathered from many peoples upon the mountains of Israel, which had been a continual waste. Its people were brought out from the peoples and now dwell securely, all of them.
verses.textEnNkjv: After many days you will be visited. In the latter years you will come into the land of those brought back from the sword and gathered from many people on the mountains of Israel, which had long been desolate; they were brought out of the nations, and now all of them dwell safely.
verses.textEnNlt: A long time from now you will be called into action. In the distant future you will swoop down on the land of Israel, which will be enjoying peace after recovering from war and after its people have returned from many lands to the mountains of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: After many days you will be summoned; in the latter years you will come into the land that is restored from the sword, whose inhabitants have been gathered from many nations to the mountains of Israel which had been a continual place of ruins; but its people were brought out from the nations, and they are living securely, all of them.
verses.textEn: After many days you will be called to arms. In future years you will invade a land that has recovered from war, whose people were gathered from many nations to the mountains of Israel, which had long been desolate. They had been brought out from the nations, and now all of them live in safety.

verses.textZh: 你和你的军队，以及与你在一起的许多民族，都必像暴风上来，像密云遮盖那地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你和你的军队，以及与你在一起的许多民族，都必像暴风上来，像密云遮盖那地。
verses.textZhCuv: 你和你的军队，并同着你许多国的民，必如暴风上来，如密云遮盖地面。」
verses.textEnNiv: You and all your troops and the many nations with you will go up, advancing like a storm; you will be like a cloud covering the land.
verses.textEnEsv: You will advance, coming on like a storm. You will be like a cloud covering the land, you and all your hordes, and many peoples with you.
verses.textEnNkjv: You will ascend, coming like a storm, covering the land like a cloud, you and all your troops and many peoples with you."
verses.textEnNlt: You and all your allies—a vast and awesome army—will roll down on them like a storm and cover the land like a cloud.
verses.textEnNasb: And you will go up, you will come like a storm; you will be like a cloud covering the land, you and all your troops, and many peoples with you."
verses.textEn: You and all your troops and the many nations with you will go up, advancing like a storm; you will be like a cloud covering the land.

verses.textZh: "‘主耶和华这样说：到那日你心中必起意念，图谋恶计，
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘主耶和华这样说：到那日你心中必起意念，图谋恶计，
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华如此说：「到那时，你心必起意念，图谋恶计，
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: On that day thoughts will come into your mind and you will devise an evil scheme.
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord God : On that day, thoughts will come into your mind, and you will devise an evil scheme
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Thus says the Lord God: "On that day it shall come to pass that thoughts will arise in your mind, and you will make an evil plan:
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Sovereign Lord says: At that time evil thoughts will come to your mind, and you will devise a wicked scheme.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘This is what the Lord God says: "It will come about on that day, that thoughts will come into your mind and you will devise an evil plan,
verses.textEn: " ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: On that day thoughts will come into your mind and you will devise an evil scheme.

verses.textZh: 说：我要上去攻击那些没有城墙的乡村；我要来攻击那些生活平静的人，他们都安然居住，没有城墙，没有门闩。
verses.textZhCnvs: 说：我要上去攻击那些没有城墙的乡村；我要来攻击那些生活平静的人，他们都安然居住，没有城墙，没有门闩。
verses.textZhCuv: 说：『我要上那无城墙的乡村，我要到那安静的民那里，他们都没有城墙，无门、无闩，安然居住。
verses.textEnNiv: You will say, "I will invade a land of unwalled villages; I will attack a peaceful and unsuspecting people—all of them living without walls and without gates and bars.
verses.textEnEsv: and say, ‘I will go up against the land of unwalled villages. I will fall upon the quiet people who dwell securely, all of them dwelling without walls, and having no bars or gates,’
verses.textEnNkjv: You will say, ‘I will go up against a land of unwalled villages; I will go to a peaceful people, who dwell safely, all of them dwelling without walls, and having neither bars nor gates’—
verses.textEnNlt: You will say, ‘Israel is an unprotected land filled with unwalled villages! I will march against her and destroy these people who live in such confidence!
verses.textEnNasb: and you will say, ‘I will go up against the land of unwalled villages. I will go against those who are at rest, who live securely, all of them living without walls and having no bars or gates,
verses.textEn: You will say, "I will invade a land of unwalled villages; I will attack a peaceful and unsuspecting people—all of them living without walls and without gates and bars.

verses.textZh: 你要抢夺财物，掳掠货物，伸手攻击那些从前荒废、现在有人居住的地方，攻击那些从列邦招聚出来，得了牲畜财物，又住在世界中心的人民。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要抢夺财物，掳掠货物，伸手攻击那些从前荒废、现在有人居住的地方，攻击那些从列邦招聚出来，得了牲畜财物，又住在世界中心的人民。
verses.textZhCuv: 我去要抢财为掳物，夺货为掠物，反手攻击那从前荒凉、现在有人居住之地，又攻击那住世界中间、从列国招聚、得了牲畜财货的民。』
verses.textEnNiv: I will plunder and loot and turn my hand against the resettled ruins and the people gathered from the nations, rich in livestock and goods, living at the center of the land. "
verses.textEnEsv: to seize spoil and carry off plunder, to turn your hand against the waste places that are now inhabited, and the people who were gathered from the nations, who have acquired livestock and goods, who dwell at the center of the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: to take plunder and to take booty, to stretch out your hand against the waste places thatareagain inhabited, and against a people gathered from the nations, who have acquired livestock and goods, who dwell in the midst of the land.
verses.textEnNlt: I will go to those formerly desolate cities that are now filled with people who have returned from exile in many nations. I will capture vast amounts of plunder, for the people are rich with livestock and other possessions now. They think the whole world revolves around them!’
verses.textEnNasb: to capture spoils and to seize plunder, to turn your hand against the ruins that are now inhabited, and against the people who are gathered from the nations, who have acquired livestock and goods, who live at the center of the world.’
verses.textEn: I will plunder and loot and turn my hand against the resettled ruins and the people gathered from the nations, rich in livestock and goods, living at the center of the land. "

verses.textZh: 示巴人、底但人和他施各城镇的商人 都必问你：你来是要抢夺财物吗？你聚集军队是要掳掠货物吗？是要搬走金银、掳去牲畜财物吗？是要大肆抢掠吗？’
verses.textZhCnvs: 示巴人、底但人和他施各城镇的商人 都必问你：你来是要抢夺财物吗？你聚集军队是要掳掠货物吗？是要搬走金银、掳去牲畜财物吗？是要大肆抢掠吗？’
verses.textZhCuv: 示巴人、底但人、他施的客商，和其间的少壮狮子都必问你说：『你来要抢财为掳物吗？你聚集军队要夺货为掠物吗？要夺取金银，掳去牲畜、财货吗？要抢夺许多财宝为掳物吗？』
verses.textEnNiv: Sheba and Dedan and the merchants of Tarshish and all her villages will say to you, "Have you come to plunder? Have you gathered your hordes to loot, to carry off silver and gold, to take away livestock and goods and to seize much plunder?" ’
verses.textEnEsv: Sheba and Dedan and the merchants of Tarshish and all its leaders will say to you, ‘Have you come to seize spoil? Have you assembled your hosts to carry off plunder, to carry away silver and gold, to take away livestock and goods, to seize great spoil?’
verses.textEnNkjv: Sheba, Dedan, the merchants of Tarshish, and all their young lions will say to you, ‘Have you come to take plunder? Have you gathered your army to take booty, to carry away silver and gold, to take away livestock and goods, to take great plunder?’ " ’
verses.textEnNlt: But Sheba and Dedan and the merchants of Tarshish will ask, ‘Do you really think the armies you have gathered can rob them of silver and gold? Do you think you can drive away their livestock and seize their goods and carry off plunder?’
verses.textEnNasb: Sheba and Dedan and the merchants of Tarshish with all its villages will say to you, ‘Have you come to capture spoils? Have you assembled your contingent to seize plunder, to carry away silver and gold, to take away livestock and goods, to capture great spoils?’ " ’
verses.textEn: Sheba and Dedan and the merchants of Tarshish and all her villages will say to you, "Have you come to plunder? Have you gathered your hordes to loot, to carry off silver and gold, to take away livestock and goods and to seize much plunder?" ’

verses.textZh: "因此，人子啊！你要对歌革说预言：‘主耶和华这样说：到那日，我的子民以色列安然居住的时候，你岂不会留意吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: "因此，人子啊！你要对歌革说预言：‘主耶和华这样说：到那日，我的子民以色列安然居住的时候，你岂不会留意吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，你要因此发预言，对歌革说，主耶和华如此说：到我民以色列安然居住之日，你岂不知道吗？
verses.textEnNiv: "Therefore, son of man, prophesy and say to Gog: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: In that day, when my people Israel are living in safety, will you not take notice of it?
verses.textEnEsv: "Therefore, son of man, prophesy, and say to Gog, Thus says the Lord God : On that day when my people Israel are dwelling securely, will you not know it?
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore, son of man, prophesy and say to Gog, ‘Thus says the Lord God: "On that day when My people Israel dwell safely, will you not know it?
verses.textEnNlt: "Therefore, son of man, prophesy against Gog. Give him this message from the Sovereign Lord : When my people are living in peace in their land, then you will rouse yourself.
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore prophesy, son of man, and say to Gog, ‘This is what the Lord God says: "On that day when My people Israel are living securely, will you not know it?
verses.textEn: "Therefore, son of man, prophesy and say to Gog: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: In that day, when my people Israel are living in safety, will you not take notice of it?

verses.textZh: 你必从你的地方，从北方的极处，与许多民族一起而来，都骑着马，成为一大队强盛的军兵。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你必从你的地方，从北方的极处，与许多民族一起而来，都骑着马，成为一大队强盛的军兵。
verses.textZhCuv: 你必从本地，从北方的极处率领许多国的民来，都骑着马，乃一大队极多的军兵。
verses.textEnNiv: You will come from your place in the far north, you and many nations with you, all of them riding on horses, a great horde, a mighty army.
verses.textEnEsv: You will come from your place out of the uttermost parts of the north, you and many peoples with you, all of them riding on horses, a great host, a mighty army.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then you will come from your place out of the far north, you and many peoples with you, all of them riding on horses, a great company and a mighty army.
verses.textEnNlt: You will come from your homeland in the distant north with your vast cavalry and your mighty army,
verses.textEnNasb: You will come from your place out of the remote parts of the north, you and many peoples with you, all of them riding horses, a large assembly and a mighty army;
verses.textEn: You will come from your place in the far north, you and many nations with you, all of them riding on horses, a great horde, a mighty army.

verses.textZh: 你必上来攻击我的子民以色列，像密云遮盖那地一样。歌革啊！在以后的日子，我必领你来攻击我的地，好叫列国在我借着你向他们显为圣的时候，能认识我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你必上来攻击我的子民以色列，像密云遮盖那地一样。歌革啊！在以后的日子，我必领你来攻击我的地，好叫列国在我借着你向他们显为圣的时候，能认识我。
verses.textZhCuv: 歌革啊，你必上来攻击我的民以色列，如密云遮盖地面。末后的日子，我必带你来攻击我的地，到我在外邦人眼前，在你身上显为圣的时候，好叫他们认识我。
verses.textEnNiv: You will advance against my people Israel like a cloud that covers the land. In days to come, Gog, I will bring you against my land, so that the nations may know me when I am proved holy through you before their eyes.
verses.textEnEsv: You will come up against my people Israel, like a cloud covering the land. In the latter days I will bring you against my land, that the nations may know me, when through you, O Gog, I vindicate my holiness before their eyes.
verses.textEnNkjv: You will come up against My people Israel like a cloud, to cover the land. It will be in the latter days that I will bring you against My land, so that the nations may know Me, when I am hallowed in you, O Gog, before their eyes."
verses.textEnNlt: and you will attack my people Israel, covering their land like a cloud. At that time in the distant future, I will bring you against my land as everyone watches, and my holiness will be displayed by what happens to you, Gog. Then all the nations will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: and you will come up against My people Israel like a cloud to cover the land. It shall come about in the last days that I will bring you against My land, so that the nations may know Me when I show Myself holy through you before their eyes, Gog."
verses.textEn: You will advance against my people Israel like a cloud that covers the land. In days to come, Gog, I will bring you against my land, so that the nations may know me when I am proved holy through you before their eyes.

verses.textZh: "‘主耶和华这样说：我从前借着我的众仆人以色列的先知所说的，岂不是你吗？在那些年间，他们曾预言我必领你来攻击以色列人。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘主耶和华这样说：我从前借着我的众仆人以色列的先知所说的，岂不是你吗？在那些年间，他们曾预言我必领你来攻击以色列人。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华如此说：我在古时藉我的仆人以色列的先知所说的，就是你吗？当日他们多年预言我必带你来攻击以色列人。」
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: You are the one I spoke of in former days by my servants the prophets of Israel. At that time they prophesied for years that I would bring you against them.
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord God : Are you he of whom I spoke in former days by my servants the prophets of Israel, who in those days prophesied for years that I would bring you against them?
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord God: "Are you he of whom I have spoken in former days by My servants the prophets of Israel, who prophesied for years in those days that I would bring you against them?
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Sovereign Lord asks: Are you the one I was talking about long ago, when I announced through Israel’s prophets that in the future I would bring you against my people?
verses.textEnNasb: ‘This is what the Lord God says: "Are you the one of whom I spoke in former days through My servants the prophets of Israel, who prophesied in those days for many years that I would bring you against them?
verses.textEn: " ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: You are the one I spoke of in former days by my servants the prophets of Israel. At that time they prophesied for years that I would bring you against them.

verses.textZh: 歌革来攻击以色列地的日子，我的怒气必从我的鼻孔中发出来。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 歌革来攻击以色列地的日子，我的怒气必从我的鼻孔中发出来。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华说：「歌革上来攻击以色列地的时候，我的怒气要从鼻孔里发出。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what will happen in that day: When Gog attacks the land of Israel, my hot anger will be aroused, declares the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: But on that day, the day that Gog shall come against the land of Israel, declares the Lord God , my wrath will be roused in my anger.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And it will come to pass at the same time, when Gog comes against the land of Israel," says the Lord God, "that My fury will show in My face.
verses.textEnNlt: But this is what the Sovereign Lord says: When Gog invades the land of Israel, my fury will boil over!
verses.textEnNasb: It will come about on that day, when Gog comes against the land of Israel," declares the Lord God, "that My fury will mount up in My anger.
verses.textEn: This is what will happen in that day: When Gog attacks the land of Israel, my hot anger will be aroused, declares the Sovereign Lord .

verses.textZh: 我在妒恨和怒火之中说：到那日，以色列地必有大地震。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我在妒恨和怒火之中说：到那日，以色列地必有大地震。
verses.textZhCuv: 我发愤恨和烈怒如火说：那日在以色列地必有大震动，
verses.textEnNiv: In my zeal and fiery wrath I declare that at that time there shall be a great earthquake in the land of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: For in my jealousy and in my blazing wrath I declare, On that day there shall be a great earthquake in the land of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: For in My jealousy and in the fire of My wrath I have spoken: ‘Surely in that day there shall be a great earthquake in the land of Israel,
verses.textEnNlt: In my jealousy and blazing anger, I promise a mighty shaking in the land of Israel on that day.
verses.textEnNasb: In My zeal and in My blazing wrath I declare that on that day there will certainly be a great earthquake in the land of Israel.
verses.textEn: In my zeal and fiery wrath I declare that at that time there shall be a great earthquake in the land of Israel.

verses.textZh: 海里的鱼、空中的飞鸟、田野的走兽、在地上爬行的各种动物，以及地上的众人，都要在我面前震动。众山必崩裂，悬崖必塌陷，所有的墙垣都必倒在地上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 海里的鱼、空中的飞鸟、田野的走兽、在地上爬行的各种动物，以及地上的众人，都要在我面前震动。众山必崩裂，悬崖必塌陷，所有的墙垣都必倒在地上。
verses.textZhCuv: 甚至海中的鱼、天空的鸟、田野的兽，并地上的一切昆虫，和其上的众人，因见我的面就都震动；山岭必崩裂，陡岩必塌陷，墙垣都必坍倒。」
verses.textEnNiv: The fish in the sea, the birds in the sky, the beasts of the field, every creature that moves along the ground, and all the people on the face of the earth will tremble at my presence. The mountains will be overturned, the cliffs will crumble and every wall will fall to the ground.
verses.textEnEsv: The fish of the sea and the birds of the heavens and the beasts of the field and all creeping things that creep on the ground, and all the people who are on the face of the earth, shall quake at my presence. And the mountains shall be thrown down, and the cliffs shall fall, and every wall shall tumble to the ground.
verses.textEnNkjv: so that the fish of the sea, the birds of the heavens, the beasts of the field, all creeping things that creep on the earth, and all men who are on the face of the earth shall shake at My presence. The mountains shall be thrown down, the steep places shall fall, and every wall shall fall to the ground.’
verses.textEnNlt: All living things—the fish in the sea, the birds of the sky, the animals of the field, the small animals that scurry along the ground, and all the people on earth—will quake in terror at my presence. Mountains will be thrown down; cliffs will crumble; walls will fall to the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: The fish of the sea, the birds of the sky, the animals of the field, all the crawling things that crawl on the earth, and all mankind who are on the face of the earth will shake at My presence; and the mountains will be thrown down, the steep pathways will collapse, and every wall will fall to the ground.
verses.textEn: The fish in the sea, the birds in the sky, the beasts of the field, every creature that moves along the ground, and all the people on the face of the earth will tremble at my presence. The mountains will be overturned, the cliffs will crumble and every wall will fall to the ground.

verses.textZh: 我必呼唤刀剑在我的众山上攻击歌革，各人的刀剑必攻击自己的兄弟。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必呼唤刀剑在我的众山上攻击歌革，各人的刀剑必攻击自己的兄弟。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华说：「我必命我的诸山发刀剑来攻击歌革；人都要用刀剑杀害弟兄。
verses.textEnNiv: I will summon a sword against Gog on all my mountains, declares the Sovereign Lord . Every man’s sword will be against his brother.
verses.textEnEsv: I will summon a sword against Gog on all my mountains, declares the Lord God . Every man’s sword will be against his brother.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will call for a sword against Gog throughout all My mountains," says the Lord God. "Every man’s sword will be against his brother.
verses.textEnNlt: I will summon the sword against you on all the hills of Israel, says the Sovereign Lord . Your men will turn their swords against each other.
verses.textEnNasb: And I will call for a sword against him on all My mountains," declares the Lord God. "Every man’s sword will be against his brother.
verses.textEn: I will summon a sword against Gog on all my mountains, declares the Sovereign Lord . Every man’s sword will be against his brother.

verses.textZh: 我必用瘟疫和血腥惩罚他；我必把暴雨、大冰雹、火和硫磺降在他和他的军队，以及与他在一起的许多民族身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必用瘟疫和血腥惩罚他；我必把暴雨、大冰雹、火和硫磺降在他和他的军队，以及与他在一起的许多民族身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必用瘟疫和流血的事刑罚他。我也必将暴雨、大雹与火，并硫磺降与他和他的军队，并他所率领的众民。
verses.textEnNiv: I will execute judgment on him with plague and bloodshed; I will pour down torrents of rain, hailstones and burning sulfur on him and on his troops and on the many nations with him.
verses.textEnEsv: With pestilence and bloodshed I will enter into judgment with him, and I will rain upon him and his hordes and the many peoples who are with him torrential rains and hailstones, fire and sulfur.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will bring him to judgment with pestilence and bloodshed; I will rain down on him, on his troops, and on the many peoples who are with him, flooding rain, great hailstones, fire, and brimstone.
verses.textEnNlt: I will punish you and your armies with disease and bloodshed; I will send torrential rain, hailstones, fire, and burning sulfur!
verses.textEnNasb: With plague and with blood I will enter into judgment with him; and I will rain on him and on his troops, and on the many peoples who are with him, a torrential rain, hailstones, fire, and brimstone.
verses.textEn: I will execute judgment on him with plague and bloodshed; I will pour down torrents of rain, hailstones and burning sulfur on him and on his troops and on the many nations with him.

verses.textZh: 我必显为大、显为圣，在列国的人眼前显现自己。这样，他们就知道我是耶和华。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必显为大、显为圣，在列国的人眼前显现自己。这样，他们就知道我是耶和华。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 我必显为大，显为圣，在多国人的眼前显现；他们就知道我是耶和华。」
verses.textEnNiv: And so I will show my greatness and my holiness, and I will make myself known in the sight of many nations. Then they will know that I am the Lord .’
verses.textEnEsv: So I will show my greatness and my holiness and make myself known in the eyes of many nations. Then they will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus I will magnify Myself and sanctify Myself, and I will be known in the eyes of many nations. Then they shall know that I am the Lord." ’
verses.textEnNlt: In this way, I will show my greatness and holiness, and I will make myself known to all the nations of the world. Then they will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: So I will prove Myself great, show Myself holy, and make Myself known in the sight of many nations; and they will know that I am the Lord." ’
verses.textEn: And so I will show my greatness and my holiness, and I will make myself known in the sight of many nations. Then they will know that I am the Lord .’

verses.textZh: "人子啊！你要向歌革说预言：‘主耶和华这样说：罗施、米设和土巴的首领歌革啊！我要与你为敌。
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！你要向歌革说预言：‘主耶和华这样说：罗施、米设和土巴的首领歌革啊！我要与你为敌。
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，你要向歌革发预言攻击他，说主耶和华如此说：罗施、米设、土巴的王歌革啊，我与你为敌。
verses.textEnNiv: "Son of man, prophesy against Gog and say: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I am against you, Gog, chief prince of Meshek and Tubal.
verses.textEnEsv: "And you, son of man, prophesy against Gog and say, Thus says the Lord God : Behold, I am against you, O Gog, chief prince of Meshech and Tubal.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And you, son of man, prophesy against Gog, and say, ‘Thus says the Lord God: "Behold, I am against you, O Gog, the prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal;
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, prophesy against Gog. Give him this message from the Sovereign Lord : I am your enemy, O Gog, ruler of the nations of Meshech and Tubal.
verses.textEnNasb: "And you, son of man, prophesy against Gog and say, ‘This is what the Lord God says: "Behold, I am against you, Gog, chief prince of Meshech and Tubal;
verses.textEn: "Son of man, prophesy against Gog and say: ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I am against you, Gog, chief prince of Meshek and Tubal.

verses.textZh: 我要使你转过来，带你从北方的极处上来，领你去攻击以色列的众山。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要使你转过来，带你从北方的极处上来，领你去攻击以色列的众山。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必调转你，领你前往，使你从北方的极处上来，带你到以色列的山上。
verses.textEnNiv: I will turn you around and drag you along. I will bring you from the far north and send you against the mountains of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will turn you about and drive you forward, and bring you up from the uttermost parts of the north, and lead you against the mountains of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: and I will turn you around and lead you on, bringing you up from the far north, and bring you against the mountains of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: I will turn you around and drive you toward the mountains of Israel, bringing you from the distant north.
verses.textEnNasb: and I will turn you around, lead you on a rope, take you up from the remotest parts of the north, and bring you against the mountains of Israel.
verses.textEn: I will turn you around and drag you along. I will bring you from the far north and send you against the mountains of Israel.

verses.textZh: 然后，我要击落你左手的弓，打落你右手的箭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后，我要击落你左手的弓，打落你右手的箭。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必从你左手打落你的弓，从你右手打掉你的箭。
verses.textEnNiv: Then I will strike your bow from your left hand and make your arrows drop from your right hand.
verses.textEnEsv: Then I will strike your bow from your left hand, and will make your arrows drop out of your right hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I will knock the bow out of your left hand, and cause the arrows to fall out of your right hand.
verses.textEnNlt: I will knock the bow from your left hand and the arrows from your right hand, and I will leave you helpless.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I will strike your bow from your left hand and make your arrows fall from your right hand.
verses.textEn: Then I will strike your bow from your left hand and make your arrows drop from your right hand.

verses.textZh: 你必倒在以色列的众山之上，你所有的军队和跟你在一起的万族，都必这样；我要把你给各种食肉的飞鸟和田野的走兽作食物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你必倒在以色列的众山之上，你所有的军队和跟你在一起的万族，都必这样；我要把你给各种食肉的飞鸟和田野的走兽作食物。
verses.textZhCuv: 你和你的军队，并同着你的列国人，都必倒在以色列的山上。我必将你给各类的鸷鸟和田野的走兽作食物。
verses.textEnNiv: On the mountains of Israel you will fall, you and all your troops and the nations with you. I will give you as food to all kinds of carrion birds and to the wild animals.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall fall on the mountains of Israel, you and all your hordes and the peoples who are with you. I will give you to birds of prey of every sort and to the beasts of the field to be devoured.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall fall upon the mountains of Israel, you and all your troops and the peoples who are with you; I will give you to birds of prey of every sort and to the beasts of the field to be devoured.
verses.textEnNlt: You and your army and your allies will all die on the mountains. I will feed you to the vultures and wild animals.
verses.textEnNasb: You will fall on the mountains of Israel, you and all your troops, and the peoples who are with you; I will give you as food to every kind of predatory bird and animal of the field.
verses.textEn: On the mountains of Israel you will fall, you and all your troops and the nations with you. I will give you as food to all kinds of carrion birds and to the wild animals.

verses.textZh: 你必倒在田野，因为我已经说过了。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你必倒在田野，因为我已经说过了。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 你必倒在田野，因为我曾说过。这是主耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: You will fall in the open field, for I have spoken, declares the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: You shall fall in the open field, for I have spoken, declares the Lord God .
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall fall on the open field; for I have spoken," says the Lord God.
verses.textEnNlt: You will fall in the open fields, for I have spoken, says the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: You will fall on the open field; for it is I who have spoken," declares the Lord God.
verses.textEn: You will fall in the open field, for I have spoken, declares the Sovereign Lord .

verses.textZh: 我必降火在玛各和安居在沿海地带的人身上，他们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必降火在玛各和安居在沿海地带的人身上，他们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要降火在玛各和海岛安然居住的人身上，他们就知道我是耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: I will send fire on Magog and on those who live in safety in the coastlands, and they will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: I will send fire on Magog and on those who dwell securely in the coastlands, and they shall know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: "And I will send fire on Magog and on those who live in security in the coastlands. Then they shall know that I am the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: And I will rain down fire on Magog and on all your allies who live safely on the coasts. Then they will know that I am the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "And I will send fire upon Magog and those who inhabit the coastlands in safety; and they will know that I am the Lord.
verses.textEn: I will send fire on Magog and on those who live in safety in the coastlands, and they will know that I am the Lord .

verses.textZh: "‘我要在我子民以色列中彰显我的圣名，我必不再让我的圣名被亵渎；这样，列国就知道我是耶和华，是以色列中的圣者。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘我要在我子民以色列中彰显我的圣名，我必不再让我的圣名被亵渎；这样，列国就知道我是耶和华，是以色列中的圣者。
verses.textZhCuv: 「我要在我民以色列中显出我的圣名，也不容我的圣名再被亵渎，列国人就知道我是耶和华－以色列中的圣者。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘I will make known my holy name among my people Israel. I will no longer let my holy name be profaned, and the nations will know that I the Lord am the Holy One in Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: "And my holy name I will make known in the midst of my people Israel, and I will not let my holy name be profaned anymore. And the nations shall know that I am the Lord , the Holy One in Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: So I will make My holy name known in the midst of My people Israel, and I will not letthem profane My holy name anymore. Then the nations shall know that Iam the Lord, the Holy One in Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: "In this way, I will make known my holy name among my people of Israel. I will not let anyone bring shame on it. And the nations, too, will know that I am the Lord , the Holy One of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: "And I will make My holy name known in the midst of My people Israel; and I will not allow My holy name to be profaned anymore. But the nations will know that I am the Lord, the Holy One in Israel.
verses.textEn: " ‘I will make known my holy name among my people Israel. I will no longer let my holy name be profaned, and the nations will know that I the Lord am the Holy One in Israel.

verses.textZh: 看哪！那日子临近了，事情必定应验，这就是我所说过的那一天。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！那日子临近了，事情必定应验，这就是我所说过的那一天。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华说：这日事情临近，也必成就，乃是我所说的日子。
verses.textEnNiv: It is coming! It will surely take place, declares the Sovereign Lord . This is the day I have spoken of.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, it is coming and it will be brought about, declares the Lord God . That is the day of which I have spoken.
verses.textEnNkjv: Surely it is coming, and it shall be done," says the Lord God. "This is the day of which I have spoken.
verses.textEnNlt: That day of judgment will come, says the Sovereign Lord . Everything will happen just as I have declared it.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, it is coming and it shall be done," declares the Lord God. "That is the day of which I have spoken.
verses.textEn: It is coming! It will surely take place, declares the Sovereign Lord . This is the day I have spoken of.

verses.textZh: "‘那时，以色列各城的居民必出来，把武器当柴焚烧，就是大小的盾牌、弓、箭、枪和矛，都当柴焚烧，足有七年的时间。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘那时，以色列各城的居民必出来，把武器当柴焚烧，就是大小的盾牌、弓、箭、枪和矛，都当柴焚烧，足有七年的时间。
verses.textZhCuv: 「住以色列城邑的人必出去和捡器械，就是大小盾牌、弓箭、梃杖、枪矛，都当柴烧火，直烧七年，
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Then those who live in the towns of Israel will go out and use the weapons for fuel and burn them up—the small and large shields, the bows and arrows, the war clubs and spears. For seven years they will use them for fuel.
verses.textEnEsv: "Then those who dwell in the cities of Israel will go out and make fires of the weapons and burn them, shields and bucklers, bow and arrows, clubs and spears; and they will make fires of them for seven years,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then those who dwell in the cities of Israel will go out and set on fire and burn the weapons, both the shields and bucklers, the bows and arrows, the javelins and spears; and they will make fires with them for seven years.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then the people in the towns of Israel will go out and pick up your small and large shields, bows and arrows, javelins and spears, and they will use them for fuel. There will be enough to last them seven years!
verses.textEnNasb: "Then those who inhabit the cities of Israel will go out and make fires with the weapons and burn them, both bucklers and shields, bows and arrows, war clubs and spears, and for seven years they will make fires of them.
verses.textEn: " ‘Then those who live in the towns of Israel will go out and use the weapons for fuel and burn them up—the small and large shields, the bows and arrows, the war clubs and spears. For seven years they will use them for fuel.

verses.textZh: 他们不必从田野捡柴，也不必从树林里伐木，因为他们必把武器当柴烧；他们必抢劫那些曾抢劫他们的人，掠夺那些掠夺他们的人。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们不必从田野捡柴，也不必从树林里伐木，因为他们必把武器当柴烧；他们必抢劫那些曾抢劫他们的人，掠夺那些掠夺他们的人。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 甚至他们不必从田野捡柴，也不必从树林伐木；因为他们要用器械烧火，并且抢夺那抢夺他们的人，掳掠那掳掠他们的人。这是主耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: They will not need to gather wood from the fields or cut it from the forests, because they will use the weapons for fuel. And they will plunder those who plundered them and loot those who looted them, declares the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: so that they will not need to take wood out of the field or cut down any out of the forests, for they will make their fires of the weapons. They will seize the spoil of those who despoiled them, and plunder those who plundered them, declares the Lord God .
verses.textEnNkjv: They will not take wood from the field nor cut down any from the forests, because they will make fires with the weapons; and they will plunder those who plundered them, and pillage those who pillaged them," says the Lord God.
verses.textEnNlt: They won’t need to cut wood from the fields or forests, for these weapons will give them all the fuel they need. They will plunder those who planned to plunder them, and they will rob those who planned to rob them, says the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: They will not take wood from the field or gather firewood from the forests, because they will make fires with the weapons; and they will take the spoils of those who plundered them and seize the plunder of those who plundered them," declares the Lord God.
verses.textEn: They will not need to gather wood from the fields or cut it from the forests, because they will use the weapons for fuel. And they will plunder those who plundered them and loot those who looted them, declares the Sovereign Lord .

verses.textZh: "‘到那日，我必在以色列给歌革一块坟地，就是那些朝东往死海去的人所经过的谷。这坟地使过路之人无法通过，因为那里埋葬了歌革和他的众军。因此，那地必称为哈们．歌革谷。
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘到那日，我必在以色列给歌革一块坟地，就是那些朝东往死海去的人所经过的谷。这坟地使过路之人无法通过，因为那里埋葬了歌革和他的众军。因此，那地必称为哈们．歌革谷。
verses.textZhCuv: 「当那日，我必将以色列地的谷，就是海东人所经过的谷，赐给歌革为坟地，使经过的人到此停步。在那里人必葬埋歌革和他的群众，就称那地为哈们‧歌革谷。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘On that day I will give Gog a burial place in Israel, in the valley of those who travel east of the Sea. It will block the way of travelers, because Gog and all his hordes will be buried there. So it will be called the Valley of Hamon Gog.
verses.textEnEsv: "On that day I will give to Gog a place for burial in Israel, the Valley of the Travelers, east of the sea. It will block the travelers, for there Gog and all his multitude will be buried. It will be called the Valley of Hamon-gog.
verses.textEnNkjv: "It will come to pass in that day that I will give Gog a burial place there in Israel, the valley of those who pass by east of the sea; and it will obstruct travelers, because there they will bury Gog and all his multitude. Therefore they will call it the Valley of Hamon Gog.
verses.textEnNlt: "And I will make a vast graveyard for Gog and his hordes in the Valley of the Travelers, east of the Dead Sea. It will block the way of those who travel there, and they will change the name of the place to the Valley of Gog’s Hordes.
verses.textEnNasb: "On that day I will give Gog a burial place there in Israel, the valley of those who pass by east of the sea, and it will block the way of those who would pass by. So they will bury Gog there with all his horde, and they will call it the Valley of Hamon-gog.
verses.textEn: " ‘On that day I will give Gog a burial place in Israel, in the valley of those who travel east of the Sea. It will block the way of travelers, because Gog and all his hordes will be buried there. So it will be called the Valley of Hamon Gog.

verses.textZh: 以色列家要用七个月的时间去埋葬他们，为要洁净那地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列家要用七个月的时间去埋葬他们，为要洁净那地。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列家的人必用七个月葬埋他们，为要洁净全地。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘For seven months the Israelites will be burying them in order to cleanse the land.
verses.textEnEsv: For seven months the house of Israel will be burying them, in order to cleanse the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: For seven months the house of Israel will be burying them, in order to cleanse the land.
verses.textEnNlt: It will take seven months for the people of Israel to bury the bodies and cleanse the land.
verses.textEnNasb: For seven months the house of Israel will be burying them in order to cleanse the land.
verses.textEn: " ‘For seven months the Israelites will be burying them in order to cleanse the land.

verses.textZh: 那地所有的人民都必埋葬他们。这是我得荣耀的日子，以色列人也必因此得享美名。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那地所有的人民都必埋葬他们。这是我得荣耀的日子，以色列人也必因此得享美名。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 全地的居民都必葬埋他们。当我得荣耀的日子，这事必叫他们得名声。这是主耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: All the people of the land will bury them, and the day I display my glory will be a memorable day for them, declares the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: All the people of the land will bury them, and it will bring them renown on the day that I show my glory, declares the Lord God .
verses.textEnNkjv: Indeed all the people of the land will be burying, and they will gain renown for it on the day that I am glorified," says the Lord God.
verses.textEnNlt: Everyone in Israel will help, for it will be a glorious victory for Israel when I demonstrate my glory on that day, says the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: And all the people of the land will bury them; and it will be to their renown on the day that I appear in My glory," declares the Lord God.
verses.textEn: All the people of the land will bury them, and the day I display my glory will be a memorable day for them, declares the Sovereign Lord .

verses.textZh: 他们必分派人经常遍行那地，与过路的人一起埋葬那些还留在地面上的尸体，为要洁净那地；过了七个月，他们还要继续搜索。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们必分派人经常遍行那地，与过路的人一起埋葬那些还留在地面上的尸体，为要洁净那地；过了七个月，他们还要继续搜索。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必分派人时常巡查遍地，与过路的人一同葬埋那剩在地面上的尸首，好洁净全地。过了七个月，他们还要巡查。
verses.textEnNiv: People will be continually employed in cleansing the land. They will spread out across the land and, along with others, they will bury any bodies that are lying on the ground. " ‘After the seven months they will carry out a more detailed search.
verses.textEnEsv: They will set apart men to travel through the land regularly and bury those travelers remaining on the face of the land, so as to cleanse it. At the end of seven months they will make their search.
verses.textEnNkjv: "They will set apart men regularly employed, with the help of a search party, to pass through the land and bury those bodies remaining on the ground, in order to cleanse it. At the end of seven months they will make a search.
verses.textEnNlt: "After seven months, teams of men will be appointed to search the land for skeletons to bury, so the land will be made clean again.
verses.textEnNasb: "They will also select men who will constantly pass through the land, burying those who were passing through, those left on the surface of the ground, in order to cleanse it. At the end of seven months they will conduct a search.
verses.textEn: People will be continually employed in cleansing the land. They will spread out across the land and, along with others, they will bury any bodies that are lying on the ground. " ‘After the seven months they will carry out a more detailed search.

verses.textZh: 他们遍行那地，见有人的骸骨，就在旁边立个标记，等埋葬的人来把骸骨葬在哈们．歌革谷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们遍行那地，见有人的骸骨，就在旁边立个标记，等埋葬的人来把骸骨葬在哈们．歌革谷。
verses.textZhCuv: 巡查遍地的人要经过全地，见有人的骸骨，就在旁边立一标记，等葬埋的人来将骸骨葬在哈们‧歌革谷。
verses.textEnNiv: As they go through the land, anyone who sees a human bone will leave a marker beside it until the gravediggers bury it in the Valley of Hamon Gog,
verses.textEnEsv: And when these travel through the land and anyone sees a human bone, then he shall set up a sign by it, till the buriers have buried it in the Valley of Hamon-gog.
verses.textEnNkjv: The search party will pass through the land; and whenanyone sees a man’s bone, he shall set up a marker by it, till the buriers have buried it in the Valley of Hamon Gog.
verses.textEnNlt: Whenever bones are found, a marker will be set up so the burial crews will take them to be buried in the Valley of Gog’s Hordes.
verses.textEnNasb: As those who pass through the land pass through and anyone sees a human bone, then he will set up a marker by it until the burial detail has buried it in the Valley of Hamon-gog.
verses.textEn: As they go through the land, anyone who sees a human bone will leave a marker beside it until the gravediggers bury it in the Valley of Hamon Gog,

verses.textZh: 那里也有一座城名叫哈摩那。他们必这样洁净那地。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 那里也有一座城名叫哈摩那。他们必这样洁净那地。’
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必这样洁净那地，并有一城名叫哈摩那。
verses.textEnNiv: near a town called Hamonah. And so they will cleanse the land.’
verses.textEnEsv: (Hamonah is also the name of the city.) Thus shall they cleanse the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: The name of the city will also be Hamonah. Thus they shall cleanse the land." ’
verses.textEnNlt: (There will be a town there named Hamonah, which means ‘horde.’) And so the land will finally be cleansed.
verses.textEnNasb: And even the name of the city will be Hamonah. So they will cleanse the land." ’
verses.textEn: near a town called Hamonah. And so they will cleanse the land.’

verses.textZh: "人子啊！主耶和华这样说：你要对各类的飞鸟和田野的走兽说：‘你们集合起来，从四围聚集来吃我为你们所预备的祭肉。以色列众山上要献大祭，好叫你们吃肉喝血。
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！主耶和华这样说：你要对各类的飞鸟和田野的走兽说：‘你们集合起来，从四围聚集来吃我为你们所预备的祭肉。以色列众山上要献大祭，好叫你们吃肉喝血。
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，主耶和华如此说：你要对各类的飞鸟和田野的走兽说：你们聚集来吧，要从四方聚到我为你们献祭之地，就是在以色列山上献大祭之地，好叫你们吃肉、喝血。
verses.textEnNiv: "Son of man, this is what the Sovereign Lord says: Call out to every kind of bird and all the wild animals: ‘Assemble and come together from all around to the sacrifice I am preparing for you, the great sacrifice on the mountains of Israel. There you will eat flesh and drink blood.
verses.textEnEsv: "As for you, son of man, thus says the Lord God : Speak to the birds of every sort and to all beasts of the field: ‘Assemble and come, gather from all around to the sacrificial feast that I am preparing for you, a great sacrificial feast on the mountains of Israel, and you shall eat flesh and drink blood.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And as for you, son of man, thus says the Lord God, ‘Speak to every sort of bird and to every beast of the field: "Assemble yourselves and come; Gather together from all sides to My sacrificial meal Which I am sacrificing for you, A great sacrificial meal on the mountains of Israel, That you may eat flesh and drink blood.
verses.textEnNlt: "And now, son of man, this is what the Sovereign Lord says: Call all the birds and wild animals. Say to them: Gather together for my great sacrificial feast. Come from far and near to the mountains of Israel, and there eat flesh and drink blood!
verses.textEnNasb: "Now as for you, son of man, this is what the Lord God says: ‘Say to every kind of bird and to every animal of the field: "Assemble and come, gather from every direction to My sacrifice, which I am going to sacrifice for you as a great sacrifice on the mountains of Israel; and you will eat flesh and drink blood.
verses.textEn: "Son of man, this is what the Sovereign Lord says: Call out to every kind of bird and all the wild animals: ‘Assemble and come together from all around to the sacrifice I am preparing for you, the great sacrifice on the mountains of Israel. There you will eat flesh and drink blood.

verses.textZh: 你们要吃勇士的肉，喝那地众领袖的血，就如吃公绵羊、羊羔、公山羊和公牛，全部都是巴珊的肥畜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要吃勇士的肉，喝那地众领袖的血，就如吃公绵羊、羊羔、公山羊和公牛，全部都是巴珊的肥畜。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们必吃勇士的肉，喝地上首领的血，就如吃公绵羊、羊羔、公山羊、公牛，都是巴珊的肥畜。
verses.textEnNiv: You will eat the flesh of mighty men and drink the blood of the princes of the earth as if they were rams and lambs, goats and bulls—all of them fattened animals from Bashan.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall eat the flesh of the mighty, and drink the blood of the princes of the earth—of rams, of lambs, and of he-goats, of bulls, all of them fat beasts of Bashan.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall eat the flesh of the mighty, Drink the blood of the princes of the earth, Of rams and lambs, Of goats and bulls, All of them fatlings of Bashan.
verses.textEnNlt: Eat the flesh of mighty men and drink the blood of princes as though they were rams, lambs, goats, and bulls—all fattened animals from Bashan!
verses.textEnNasb: You will eat the flesh of warriors and drink the blood of the leaders of the earth, as though they were rams, lambs, goats, and bulls, all of them fattened livestock of Bashan.
verses.textEn: You will eat the flesh of mighty men and drink the blood of the princes of the earth as if they were rams and lambs, goats and bulls—all of them fattened animals from Bashan.

verses.textZh: 你们吃我为你们所预备的祭，必吃饱脂油，喝醉了血。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们吃我为你们所预备的祭，必吃饱脂油，喝醉了血。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们吃我为你们所献的祭，必吃饱了脂油，喝醉了血。
verses.textEnNiv: At the sacrifice I am preparing for you, you will eat fat till you are glutted and drink blood till you are drunk.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall eat fat till you are filled, and drink blood till you are drunk, at the sacrificial feast that I am preparing for you.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall eat fat till you are full, And drink blood till you are drunk, At My sacrificial meal Which I am sacrificing for you.
verses.textEnNlt: Gorge yourselves with flesh until you are glutted; drink blood until you are drunk. This is the sacrificial feast I have prepared for you.
verses.textEnNasb: So you will eat fat until you are full, and drink blood until you are drunk, from My sacrifice which I have sacrificed for you.
verses.textEn: At the sacrifice I am preparing for you, you will eat fat till you are glutted and drink blood till you are drunk.

verses.textZh: 你们必在我的筵席上吃饱马匹、骑兵、勇士和所有的战士。这是主耶和华的宣告。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们必在我的筵席上吃饱马匹、骑兵、勇士和所有的战士。这是主耶和华的宣告。’
verses.textZhCuv: 你们必在我席上饱吃马匹和坐车的人，并勇士和一切的战士。这是主耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: At my table you will eat your fill of horses and riders, mighty men and soldiers of every kind,’ declares the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall be filled at my table with horses and charioteers, with mighty men and all kinds of warriors,’ declares the Lord God .
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall be filled at My table With horses and riders, With mighty men And with all the men of war," says the Lord God.
verses.textEnNlt: Feast at my banquet table—feast on horses and charioteers, on mighty men and all kinds of valiant warriors, says the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: You will eat your fill at My table with horses and charioteers, with warriors and all the men of war," declares the Lord God.
verses.textEn: At my table you will eat your fill of horses and riders, mighty men and soldiers of every kind,’ declares the Sovereign Lord .

verses.textZh: "我必在列国中彰显我的荣耀，万邦必看见我施行的审判，和我加在他们身上的手。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我必在列国中彰显我的荣耀，万邦必看见我施行的审判，和我加在他们身上的手。
verses.textZhCuv: 「我必显我的荣耀在列国中；万民就必看见我所行的审判与我在他们身上所加的手。
verses.textEnNiv: "I will display my glory among the nations, and all the nations will see the punishment I inflict and the hand I lay on them.
verses.textEnEsv: "And I will set my glory among the nations, and all the nations shall see my judgment that I have executed, and my hand that I have laid on them.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I will set My glory among the nations; all the nations shall see My judgment which I have executed, and My hand which I have laid on them.
verses.textEnNlt: "In this way, I will demonstrate my glory to the nations. Everyone will see the punishment I have inflicted on them and the power of my fist when I strike.
verses.textEnNasb: "And I will place My glory among the nations; and all the nations will see My judgment which I have executed, and My hand which I have laid on them.
verses.textEn: "I will display my glory among the nations, and all the nations will see the punishment I inflict and the hand I lay on them.

verses.textZh: 这样，从那日起，以色列家就必知道我是耶和华他们的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，从那日起，以色列家就必知道我是耶和华他们的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，从那日以后，以色列家必知道我是耶和华－他们的神。
verses.textEnNiv: From that day forward the people of Israel will know that I am the Lord their God.
verses.textEnEsv: The house of Israel shall know that I am the Lord their God, from that day forward.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the house of Israel shall know that I am the Lord their God from that day forward.
verses.textEnNlt: And from that time on the people of Israel will know that I am the Lord their God.
verses.textEnNasb: And the house of Israel will know that I am the Lord their God, from that day onward.
verses.textEn: From that day forward the people of Israel will know that I am the Lord their God.

verses.textZh: 列国也必知道以色列家是因自己的罪孽被掳去。他们对我不忠，所以我掩面不顾他们，把他们交在敌人手中，他们就都倒在刀下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 列国也必知道以色列家是因自己的罪孽被掳去。他们对我不忠，所以我掩面不顾他们，把他们交在敌人手中，他们就都倒在刀下。
verses.textZhCuv: 列国人也必知道以色列家被掳掠是因他们的罪孽。他们得罪我，我就掩面不顾，将他们交在敌人手中，他们便都倒在刀下。
verses.textEnNiv: And the nations will know that the people of Israel went into exile for their sin, because they were unfaithful to me. So I hid my face from them and handed them over to their enemies, and they all fell by the sword.
verses.textEnEsv: And the nations shall know that the house of Israel went into captivity for their iniquity, because they dealt so treacherously with me that I hid my face from them and gave them into the hand of their adversaries, and they all fell by the sword.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Gentiles shall know that the house of Israel went into captivity for their iniquity; because they were unfaithful to Me, therefore I hid My face from them. I gave them into the hand of their enemies, and they all fell by the sword.
verses.textEnNlt: The nations will then know why Israel was sent away to exile—it was punishment for sin, for they were unfaithful to their God. Therefore, I turned away from them and let their enemies destroy them.
verses.textEnNasb: The nations will know that the house of Israel went into exile for their wrongdoing, because they were disloyal to Me, and I hid My face from them; so I handed them over to their adversaries, and all of them fell by the sword.
verses.textEn: And the nations will know that the people of Israel went into exile for their sin, because they were unfaithful to me. So I hid my face from them and handed them over to their enemies, and they all fell by the sword.

verses.textZh: 我是照着他们的污秽和过犯对待他们，并且掩面不顾他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我是照着他们的污秽和过犯对待他们，并且掩面不顾他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 我是照他们的污秽和罪过待他们，并且我掩面不顾他们。」
verses.textEnNiv: I dealt with them according to their uncleanness and their offenses, and I hid my face from them.
verses.textEnEsv: I dealt with them according to their uncleanness and their transgressions, and hid my face from them.
verses.textEnNkjv: According to their uncleanness and according to their transgressions I have dealt with them, and hidden My face from them." ’
verses.textEnNlt: I turned my face away and punished them because of their defilement and their sins.
verses.textEnNasb: In accordance with their uncleanness and their offenses I dealt with them, and I hid My face from them." ’ "
verses.textEn: I dealt with them according to their uncleanness and their offenses, and I hid my face from them.

verses.textZh: "因此，主耶和华这样说：现在我要使雅各被掳的归回；我要怜悯以色列全家，又为我的圣名大发热心。
verses.textZhCnvs: "因此，主耶和华这样说：现在我要使雅各被掳的归回；我要怜悯以色列全家，又为我的圣名大发热心。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华如此说：「我要使雅各被掳的人归回，要怜悯以色列全家，又为我的圣名发热心。
verses.textEnNiv: "Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I will now restore the fortunes of Jacob and will have compassion on all the people of Israel, and I will be zealous for my holy name.
verses.textEnEsv: "Therefore thus says the Lord God : Now I will restore the fortunes of Jacob and have mercy on the whole house of Israel, and I will be jealous for my holy name.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore thus says the Lord God: ‘Now I will bring back the captives of Jacob, and have mercy on the whole house of Israel; and I will be jealous for My holy name—
verses.textEnNlt: "So now, this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I will end the captivity of my people ; I will have mercy on all Israel, for I jealously guard my holy reputation!
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore this is what the Lord God says: "Now I will restore the fortunes of Jacob and have mercy on all the house of Israel; and I will be jealous for My holy name.
verses.textEn: "Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I will now restore the fortunes of Jacob and will have compassion on all the people of Israel, and I will be zealous for my holy name.

verses.textZh: 他们在自己的土地上安然居住、无人惊吓的时候，就要担当自己的羞辱和向我所犯一切不忠的罪；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们在自己的土地上安然居住、无人惊吓的时候，就要担当自己的羞辱和向我所犯一切不忠的罪；
verses.textZhCuv: 因我使他们被掳到外邦人中，后又聚集他们归回本地，他们就知道我是耶和华－他们的神；我必不再留他们一人在外邦。
verses.textEnNiv: They will forget their shame and all the unfaithfulness they showed toward me when they lived in safety in their land with no one to make them afraid.
verses.textEnEsv: They shall forget their shame and all the treachery they have practiced against me, when they dwell securely in their land with none to make them afraid,
verses.textEnNkjv: after they have borne their shame, and all their unfaithfulness in which they were unfaithful to Me, when they dwelt safely in their own land and no one made them afraid.
verses.textEnNlt: They will accept responsibility for their past shame and unfaithfulness after they come home to live in peace in their own land, with no one to bother them.
verses.textEnNasb: They will forget their disgrace and all their treachery which they perpetrated against Me, when they live securely on their own land with no one to make them afraid.
verses.textEn: They will forget their shame and all the unfaithfulness they showed toward me when they lived in safety in their land with no one to make them afraid.

verses.textZh: 我把他们从万族中领回来，从仇敌之地召回来的时候，我必在他们身上向列国显为圣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我把他们从万族中领回来，从仇敌之地召回来的时候，我必在他们身上向列国显为圣。
verses.textZhCuv: 我也不再掩面不顾他们，因我已将我的灵浇灌以色列家。这是主耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: When I have brought them back from the nations and have gathered them from the countries of their enemies, I will be proved holy through them in the sight of many nations.
verses.textEnEsv: when I have brought them back from the peoples and gathered them from their enemies’ lands, and through them have vindicated my holiness in the sight of many nations.
verses.textEnNkjv: When I have brought them back from the peoples and gathered them out of their enemies’ lands, and I am hallowed in them in the sight of many nations,
verses.textEnNlt: When I bring them home from the lands of their enemies, I will display my holiness among them for all the nations to see.
verses.textEnNasb: When I bring them back from the peoples and gather them from the lands of their enemies, then I shall show Myself holy through them in the sight of the many nations.
verses.textEn: When I have brought them back from the nations and have gathered them from the countries of their enemies, I will be proved holy through them in the sight of many nations.

verses.textZh: 我使他们被掳到列国去，后来又聚集他们到自己的土地，连一个也不再留在列国那里。这样，他们就知道我是耶和华他们的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我使他们被掳到列国去，后来又聚集他们到自己的土地，连一个也不再留在列国那里。这样，他们就知道我是耶和华他们的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 我使他们被掳到列国去，后来又聚集他们到自己的土地，连一个也不再留在列国那里。这样，他们就知道我是耶和华他们的神。
verses.textEnNiv: Then they will know that I am the Lord their God, for though I sent them into exile among the nations, I will gather them to their own land, not leaving any behind.
verses.textEnEsv: Then they shall know that I am the Lord their God, because I sent them into exile among the nations and then assembled them into their own land. I will leave none of them remaining among the nations anymore.
verses.textEnNkjv: then they shall know that I am the Lord their God, who sent them into captivity among the nations, but also brought them back to their land, and left none of them captive any longer.
verses.textEnNlt: Then my people will know that I am the Lord their God, because I sent them away to exile and brought them home again. I will leave none of my people behind.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they will know that I am the Lord their God because I made them go into exile among the nations, and then I gathered them again to their own land; and I will leave none of them there any longer.
verses.textEn: Then they will know that I am the Lord their God, for though I sent them into exile among the nations, I will gather them to their own land, not leaving any behind.

verses.textZh: 我也不再掩面不顾他们，因为我已经把我的灵浇灌在以色列家。这是主耶和华的宣告。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我也不再掩面不顾他们，因为我已经把我的灵浇灌在以色列家。这是主耶和华的宣告。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我也不再掩面不顾他们，因为我已经把我的灵浇灌在以色列家。这是主耶和华的宣告。"
verses.textEnNiv: I will no longer hide my face from them, for I will pour out my Spirit on the people of Israel, declares the Sovereign Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: And I will not hide my face anymore from them, when I pour out my Spirit upon the house of Israel, declares the Lord God ."
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will not hide My face from them anymore; for I shall have poured out My Spirit on the house of Israel,’ says the Lord God."
verses.textEnNlt: And I will never again turn my face from them, for I will pour out my Spirit upon the people of Israel. I, the Sovereign Lord , have spoken!"
verses.textEnNasb: I will not hide My face from them any longer, for I will have poured out My Spirit on the house of Israel," declares the Lord God.
verses.textEn: I will no longer hide my face from them, for I will pour out my Spirit on the people of Israel, declares the Sovereign Lord ."

verses.textZh: 我们被掳后第二十五年，耶路撒冷城被攻陷后第十四年的年初；那月的初十日，正当那日，耶和华的手按在我身上；他把我带到那里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们被掳后第二十五年，耶路撒冷城被攻陷后第十四年的年初；那月的初十日，正当那日，耶和华的手按在我身上；他把我带到那里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们被掳掠第二十五年，耶路撒冷城攻破后十四年，正在年初，月之初十日，耶和华的灵 降在我身上，他把我带到以色列地。
verses.textEnNiv: In the twenty-fifth year of our exile, at the beginning of the year, on the tenth of the month, in the fourteenth year after the fall of the city—on that very day the hand of the Lord was on me and he took me there.
verses.textEnEsv: In the twenty-fifth year of our exile, at the beginning of the year, on the tenth day of the month, in the fourteenth year after the city was struck down, on that very day, the hand of the Lord was upon me, and he brought me to the city.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the twenty-fifth year of our captivity, at the beginning of the year, on the tenth day of the month, in the fourteenth year after the city was captured, on the very same day the hand of the Lord was upon me; and He took me there.
verses.textEnNlt: On April 28, during the twenty-fifth year of our captivity—fourteen years after the fall of Jerusalem—the Lord took hold of me.
verses.textEnNasb: In the twenty-fifth year of our exile, at the beginning of the year, on the tenth of the month, in the fourteenth year after the city was taken, on this very day the hand of the Lord was upon me and He brought me there.
verses.textEn: In the twenty-fifth year of our exile, at the beginning of the year, on the tenth of the month, in the fourteenth year after the fall of the city—on that very day the hand of the Lord was on me and he took me there.

verses.textZh: 在神的异象中，他带我到以色列地，把我安置在一座很高的山上；在山上的南面，有好象是一座城的建筑物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在神的异象中，他带我到以色列地，把我安置在一座很高的山上；在山上的南面，有好象是一座城的建筑物。
verses.textZhCuv: 在神的异象中带我到以色列地，安置在至高的山上；在山上的南边有仿佛一座城建立。
verses.textEnNiv: In visions of God he took me to the land of Israel and set me on a very high mountain, on whose south side were some buildings that looked like a city.
verses.textEnEsv: In visions of God he brought me to the land of Israel, and set me down on a very high mountain, on which was a structure like a city to the south.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the visions of God He took me into the land of Israel and set me on a very high mountain; on it toward the south was something like the structure of a city.
verses.textEnNlt: In a vision from God he took me to the land of Israel and set me down on a very high mountain. From there I could see toward the south what appeared to be a city.
verses.textEnNasb: In the visions of God He brought me into the land of Israel and set me on a very high mountain, and on it to the south there was something like a structure of a city.
verses.textEn: In visions of God he took me to the land of Israel and set me on a very high mountain, on whose south side were some buildings that looked like a city.

verses.textZh: 他把我带到那里，我见有一个人，他看来像铜，手里拿着麻绳和测量竿，站在门口。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把我带到那里，我见有一个人，他看来像铜，手里拿着麻绳和测量竿，站在门口。
verses.textZhCuv: 他带我到那里，见有一人，颜色 如铜，手拿麻绳和量度的竿，站在门口。
verses.textEnNiv: He took me there, and I saw a man whose appearance was like bronze; he was standing in the gateway with a linen cord and a measuring rod in his hand.
verses.textEnEsv: When he brought me there, behold, there was a man whose appearance was like bronze, with a linen cord and a measuring reed in his hand. And he was standing in the gateway.
verses.textEnNkjv: He took me there, and behold, therewas a man whose appearance was like the appearance of bronze. He had a line of flax and a measuring rod in his hand, and he stood in the gateway.
verses.textEnNlt: As he brought me nearer, I saw a man whose face shone like bronze standing beside a gateway entrance. He was holding in his hand a linen measuring cord and a measuring rod.
verses.textEnNasb: So He brought me there; and behold, there was a man whose appearance was like the appearance of bronze, with a thread of flax and a measuring rod in his hand; and he was standing in the gateway.
verses.textEn: He took me there, and I saw a man whose appearance was like bronze; he was standing in the gateway with a linen cord and a measuring rod in his hand.

verses.textZh: 那人对我说："人子啊！我所要指示你的，你都要用眼看，用耳听，并要放在心上，因为我带你到这里来，为的是要指示你；你所看见的，你都要告诉以色列家。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那人对我说："人子啊！我所要指示你的，你都要用眼看，用耳听，并要放在心上，因为我带你到这里来，为的是要指示你；你所看见的，你都要告诉以色列家。"
verses.textZhCuv: 那人对我说：「人子啊，凡我所指示你的，你都要用眼看，用耳听，并要放在心上。我带你到这里来，特为要指示你；凡你所见的，你都要告诉以色列家。」
verses.textEnNiv: The man said to me, "Son of man, look carefully and listen closely and pay attention to everything I am going to show you, for that is why you have been brought here. Tell the people of Israel everything you see."
verses.textEnEsv: And the man said to me, "Son of man, look with your eyes, and hear with your ears, and set your heart upon all that I shall show you, for you were brought here in order that I might show it to you. Declare all that you see to the house of Israel."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the man said to me, "Son of man, look with your eyes and hear with your ears, and fix your mind on everything I show you; for you were brought here so that I might show them to you. Declare to the house of Israel everything you see."
verses.textEnNlt: He said to me, "Son of man, watch and listen. Pay close attention to everything I show you. You have been brought here so I can show you many things. Then you will return to the people of Israel and tell them everything you have seen."
verses.textEnNasb: And the man said to me, "Son of man, see with your eyes, hear with your ears, and pay attention to all that I am going to show you; for you have been brought here in order to show it to you. Declare to the house of Israel all that you see."
verses.textEn: The man said to me, "Son of man, look carefully and listen closely and pay attention to everything I am going to show you, for that is why you have been brought here. Tell the people of Israel everything you see."

verses.textZh: 我见殿四围有墙，那人手里的测量竿长三公尺。他量了那建筑物，墙厚三公尺、高三公尺。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我见殿四围有墙，那人手里的测量竿长三公尺。他量了那建筑物，墙厚三公尺、高三公尺。
verses.textZhCuv: 我见殿四围有墙。那人手拿量度的竿，长六肘，每肘是一肘零一掌。他用竿量墙，厚一竿，高一竿。
verses.textEnNiv: I saw a wall completely surrounding the temple area. The length of the measuring rod in the man’s hand was six long cubits, each of which was a cubit and a handbreadth. He measured the wall; it was one measuring rod thick and one rod high.
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, there was a wall all around the outside of the temple area, and the length of the measuring reed in the man’s hand was six long cubits, each being a cubit and a handbreadth in length. So he measured the thickness of the wall, one reed; and the height, one reed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now there was a wall all around the outside of the temple. In the man’s hand was a measuring rod six cubits long, each being a cubit and a handbreadth; and he measured the width of the wall structure, one rod; and the height, one rod.
verses.textEnNlt: I could see a wall completely surrounding the Temple area. The man took a measuring rod that was 10-1/2 feet long and measured the wall, and the wall was 10-1/2 feet thick and 10-1/2 feet high.
verses.textEnNasb: And behold, there was a wall on the outside of the temple all around, and in the man’s hand was a measuring rod of six cubits, each of which was a cubit and a hand width. So he measured the thickness of the wall, one rod; and the height, one rod.
verses.textEn: I saw a wall completely surrounding the temple area. The length of the measuring rod in the man’s hand was six long cubits, each of which was a cubit and a handbreadth. He measured the wall; it was one measuring rod thick and one rod high.

verses.textZh: 他到了朝东的门，上了门的台阶，量度门槛，厚三公尺；又量另一个门槛，厚三公尺。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他到了朝东的门，上了门的台阶，量度门槛，厚三公尺；又量另一个门槛，厚三公尺。
verses.textZhCuv: 他到了朝东的门，就上门的台阶，量门的这槛，宽一竿；又量门的那槛，宽一竿。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he went to the east gate. He climbed its steps and measured the threshold of the gate; it was one rod deep.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he went into the gateway facing east, going up its steps, and measured the threshold of the gate, one reed deep.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he went to the gateway which faced east; and he went up its stairs and measured the threshold of the gateway, whichwas one rod wide, and the other threshold was one rod wide.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he went over to the eastern gateway. He climbed the steps and measured the threshold of the gateway; it was 10-1/2 feet front to back.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he went to the gate which faced east, went up its steps, and measured the threshold of the gate, one rod in width; and the other threshold was one rod in width.
verses.textEn: Then he went to the east gate. He climbed its steps and measured the threshold of the gate; it was one rod deep.

verses.textZh: 又有守卫室，长三公尺、宽三公尺；守卫室与守卫室之间，相隔两公尺半；朝向殿内，在门廊旁边的门槛，厚三公尺。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又有守卫室，长三公尺、宽三公尺；守卫室与守卫室之间，相隔两公尺半；朝向殿内，在门廊旁边的门槛，厚三公尺。
verses.textZhCuv: 又有卫房，每房长一竿，宽一竿，相隔五肘。门槛，就是挨着向殿的廊门槛，宽一竿。
verses.textEnNiv: The alcoves for the guards were one rod long and one rod wide, and the projecting walls between the alcoves were five cubits thick. And the threshold of the gate next to the portico facing the temple was one rod deep.
verses.textEnEsv: And the side rooms, one reed long and one reed broad; and the space between the side rooms, five cubits; and the threshold of the gate by the vestibule of the gate at the inner end, one reed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Each gate chamber was one rod long and one rod wide; between the gate chambers wasaspaceof five cubits; and the threshold of the gateway by the vestibule of the inside gate was one rod.
verses.textEnNlt: There were guard alcoves on each side built into the gateway passage. Each of these alcoves was 10-1/2 feet square, with a distance between them of 8-3/4 feet along the passage wall. The gateway’s inner threshold, which led to the entry room at the inner end of the gateway passage, was 10-1/2 feet front to back.
verses.textEnNasb: The guardroom was one rod long and one rod wide; and there were five cubits between the guardrooms. And the threshold of the gate by the porch of the gate facing inward was one rod.
verses.textEn: The alcoves for the guards were one rod long and one rod wide, and the projecting walls between the alcoves were five cubits thick. And the threshold of the gate next to the portico facing the temple was one rod deep.

verses.textZh: 他又量朝向殿内的门廊 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又量朝向殿内的门廊 。
verses.textZhCuv: 他又量向殿门的廊子，宽一竿。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he measured the portico of the gateway;
verses.textEnEsv: Then he measured the vestibule of the gateway, on the inside, one reed.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also measured the vestibule of the inside gate, one rod.
verses.textEnNlt: He also measured the entry room of the gateway.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he measured the porch of the gate facing inward, one rod.
verses.textEn: Then he measured the portico of the gateway;

verses.textZh: 门廊深四公尺；墙柱厚一公尺；门廊是朝向殿内的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 门廊深四公尺；墙柱厚一公尺；门廊是朝向殿内的。
verses.textZhCuv: 又量门廊，宽八肘，墙柱厚二肘；那门的廊子向着殿。
verses.textEnNiv: it was eight cubits deep and its jambs were two cubits thick. The portico of the gateway faced the temple.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he measured the vestibule of the gateway, eight cubits; and its jambs, two cubits; and the vestibule of the gate was at the inner end.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he measured the vestibule of the gateway, eight cubits; and the gateposts, two cubits. The vestibule of the gate was on the inside.
verses.textEnNlt: It was 14 feet across, with supporting columns 3-1/2 feet thick. This entry room was at the inner end of the gateway structure, facing toward the Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: And he measured the porch of the gate, eight cubits; and its side pillars, two cubits. And the porch of the gate was faced inward.
verses.textEn: it was eight cubits deep and its jambs were two cubits thick. The portico of the gateway faced the temple.

verses.textZh: 东门的守卫室，这边有三间，那边有三间；三间都是一样的长宽；两边的墙柱都是一样的厚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 东门的守卫室，这边有三间，那边有三间；三间都是一样的长宽；两边的墙柱都是一样的厚。
verses.textZhCuv: 东门洞有卫房：这旁三间，那旁三间，都是一样的尺寸；这边的柱子和那边的柱子，也是一样的尺寸。
verses.textEnNiv: Inside the east gate were three alcoves on each side; the three had the same measurements, and the faces of the projecting walls on each side had the same measurements.
verses.textEnEsv: And there were three side rooms on either side of the east gate. The three were of the same size, and the jambs on either side were of the same size.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the eastern gateway were three gate chambers on one side and three on the other; the three were all the same size; also the gateposts were of the same size on this side and that side.
verses.textEnNlt: There were three guard alcoves on each side of the gateway passage. Each had the same measurements, and the dividing walls separating them were also identical.
verses.textEnNasb: The guardrooms of the gate toward the east numbered three on each side; the three of them had the same measurement. The side pillars also had the same measurement on each side.
verses.textEn: Inside the east gate were three alcoves on each side; the three had the same measurements, and the faces of the projecting walls on each side had the same measurements.

verses.textZh: 他量了东门，入口宽五公尺，通道宽六公尺半。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他量了东门，入口宽五公尺，通道宽六公尺半。
verses.textZhCuv: 他量门口，宽十肘，长十三肘。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he measured the width of the entrance of the gateway; it was ten cubits and its length was thirteen cubits.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he measured the width of the opening of the gateway, ten cubits; and the length of the gateway, thirteen cubits.
verses.textEnNkjv: He measured the width of the entrance to the gateway, ten cubits; and the length of the gate, thirteen cubits.
verses.textEnNlt: The man measured the gateway entrance, which was 17-1/2 feet wide at the opening and 22-3/4 feet wide in the gateway passage.
verses.textEnNasb: And he measured the width of the gateway, ten cubits, and the length of the gate, thirteen cubits.
verses.textEn: Then he measured the width of the entrance of the gateway; it was ten cubits and its length was thirteen cubits.

verses.textZh: 每个守卫室前面都有矮墙，高五十公分，两边守卫室都是一样。守卫室长三公尺，两边都是一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 每个守卫室前面都有矮墙，高五十公分，两边守卫室都是一样。守卫室长三公尺，两边都是一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 卫房前展出的境界：这边一肘，那边一肘；卫房这边六肘，那边六肘。
verses.textEnNiv: In front of each alcove was a wall one cubit high, and the alcoves were six cubits square.
verses.textEnEsv: There was a barrier before the side rooms, one cubit on either side. And the side rooms were six cubits on either side.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therewas a space in front of the gate chambers, one cubit onthisside and one cubit on that side; the gate chambers were six cubits on this side and six cubits on that side.
verses.textEnNlt: In front of each of the guard alcoves was a 21-inch curb. The alcoves themselves were 10-1/2 feet on each side.
verses.textEnNasb: There was a barrier wall one cubit wide in front of the guardrooms on each side; and the guardrooms were six cubits square on each side.
verses.textEn: In front of each alcove was a wall one cubit high, and the alcoves were six cubits square.

verses.textZh: 他量了东门，从这边房顶到那边房顶，就是从这边守卫室后面的门到那边守卫室后面的门，宽十二公尺半。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他量了东门，从这边房顶到那边房顶，就是从这边守卫室后面的门到那边守卫室后面的门，宽十二公尺半。
verses.textZhCuv: 又量门洞，从这卫房顶的后檐到那卫房顶的后檐，宽二十五肘；卫房门与门相对。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he measured the gateway from the top of the rear wall of one alcove to the top of the opposite one; the distance was twenty-five cubits from one parapet opening to the opposite one.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he measured the gate from the ceiling of the one side room to the ceiling of the other, a breadth of twenty-five cubits; the openings faced each other.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he measured the gateway from the roof of one gate chamber to the roof of the other; the width was twenty-five cubits, as door faces door.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he measured the entire width of the gateway, measuring the distance between the back walls of facing guard alcoves; this distance was 43-3/4 feet.
verses.textEnNasb: And he measured the gate from the roof of the one guardroom to the roof of the other, a width of twenty-five cubits, from one door to the door opposite.
verses.textEn: Then he measured the gateway from the top of the rear wall of one alcove to the top of the opposite one; the distance was twenty-five cubits from one parapet opening to the opposite one.

verses.textZh: 又沿着里面各墙柱量度，直到朝向院子的墙柱，共长三十公尺 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又沿着里面各墙柱量度，直到朝向院子的墙柱，共长三十公尺 。
verses.textZhCuv: 又量 廊子六十肘 ，墙柱外是院子，有廊为界，在门洞两边。
verses.textEnNiv: He measured along the faces of the projecting walls all around the inside of the gateway—sixty cubits. The measurement was up to the portico facing the courtyard.
verses.textEnEsv: He measured also the vestibule, sixty cubits. And around the vestibule of the gateway was the court.
verses.textEnNkjv: He measured the gateposts, sixty cubits high, and the court all around the gateway extended to the gatepost.
verses.textEnNlt: He measured the dividing walls all along the inside of the gateway up to the entry room of the gateway; this distance was 105 feet.
