verses.textEnNasb: He made the side pillars sixty cubits high; the gate extended all around to the side pillar of the courtyard.
verses.textEn: He measured along the faces of the projecting walls all around the inside of the gateway—sixty cubits. The measurement was up to the portico facing the courtyard.

verses.textZh: 从东门前面的入口到后面的门廊，共二十五公尺。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从东门前面的入口到后面的门廊，共二十五公尺。
verses.textZhCuv: 从大门口到内廊前，共五十肘。
verses.textEnNiv: The distance from the entrance of the gateway to the far end of its portico was fifty cubits.
verses.textEnEsv: From the front of the gate at the entrance to the front of the inner vestibule of the gate was fifty cubits.
verses.textEnNkjv: From the front of the entrance gate to the front of the vestibule of the inner gate was fifty cubits.
verses.textEnNlt: The full length of the gateway passage was 87-1/2 feet from one end to the other.
verses.textEnNasb: And from the front of the entrance gate to the front of the inner porch of the gate was fifty cubits.
verses.textEn: The distance from the entrance of the gateway to the far end of its portico was fifty cubits.

verses.textZh: 守卫室和东门里面周围的墙柱，以及门廊，都有小窗；里面周围都有小窗；墙柱上还刻有棕树。
verses.textZhCnvs: 守卫室和东门里面周围的墙柱，以及门廊，都有小窗；里面周围都有小窗；墙柱上还刻有棕树。
verses.textZhCuv: 卫房和门洞两旁柱间并廊子，都有严紧的窗棂；里边都有窗棂，柱上有雕刻的棕树。
verses.textEnNiv: The alcoves and the projecting walls inside the gateway were surmounted by narrow parapet openings all around, as was the portico; the openings all around faced inward. The faces of the projecting walls were decorated with palm trees.
verses.textEnEsv: And the gateway had windows all around, narrowing inwards toward the side rooms and toward their jambs, and likewise the vestibule had windows all around inside, and on the jambs were palm trees.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therewere beveled window frames in the gate chambers and in their intervening archways on the inside of the gateway all around, and likewise in the vestibules. Therewere windows all around on the inside. And on each gatepost were palm trees.
verses.textEnNlt: There were recessed windows that narrowed inward through the walls of the guard alcoves and their dividing walls. There were also windows in the entry room. The surfaces of the dividing walls were decorated with carved palm trees.
verses.textEnNasb: And there were shuttered windows looking toward the guardrooms, and toward their side pillars within the gate all around, and likewise for the porches. And there were windows all around inside; and on each side pillar were palm tree decorations.
verses.textEn: The alcoves and the projecting walls inside the gateway were surmounted by narrow parapet openings all around, as was the portico; the openings all around faced inward. The faces of the projecting walls were decorated with palm trees.

verses.textZh: 他带我到了外院，我见有些房子，院子周围有铺石地，铺石地上有三十间房子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他带我到了外院，我见有些房子，院子周围有铺石地，铺石地上有三十间房子。
verses.textZhCuv: 他带我到外院，见院的四围有铺石地；铺石地上有屋子三十间。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he brought me into the outer court. There I saw some rooms and a pavement that had been constructed all around the court; there were thirty rooms along the pavement.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he brought me into the outer court. And behold, there were chambers and a pavement, all around the court. Thirty chambers faced the pavement.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he brought me into the outer court; and therewere chambers and a pavement made all around the court; thirty chambers faced the pavement.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the man brought me through the gateway into the outer courtyard of the Temple. A stone pavement ran along the walls of the courtyard, and thirty rooms were built against the walls, opening onto the pavement.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he brought me into the outer courtyard, and behold, there were chambers and a stone pavement made for the courtyard all around; thirty chambers faced the pavement.
verses.textEn: Then he brought me into the outer court. There I saw some rooms and a pavement that had been constructed all around the court; there were thirty rooms along the pavement.

verses.textZh: 铺石地在各大门的旁边，比门矮一点，宽度与门的长度相同。
verses.textZhCnvs: 铺石地在各大门的旁边，比门矮一点，宽度与门的长度相同。
verses.textZhCuv: 铺石地，就是矮铺石地在各门洞两旁，以门洞的长短为度。
verses.textEnNiv: It abutted the sides of the gateways and was as wide as they were long; this was the lower pavement.
verses.textEnEsv: And the pavement ran along the side of the gates, corresponding to the length of the gates. This was the lower pavement.
verses.textEnNkjv: The pavement was by the side of the gateways, corresponding to the length of the gateways; thiswas the lower pavement.
verses.textEnNlt: This pavement flanked the gates and extended out from the walls into the courtyard the same distance as the gateway entrance. This was the lower pavement.
verses.textEnNasb: And the pavement (that is, the lower pavement) was by the side of the gates, corresponding to the length of the gates.
verses.textEn: It abutted the sides of the gateways and was as wide as they were long; this was the lower pavement.

verses.textZh: 他从下面的大门量到内院的外墙，共宽五十公尺；东面、北面，都是一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他从下面的大门量到内院的外墙，共宽五十公尺；东面、北面，都是一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 他从下门量到内院外，共宽一百肘，东面北面都是如此。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he measured the distance from the inside of the lower gateway to the outside of the inner court; it was a hundred cubits on the east side as well as on the north.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he measured the distance from the inner front of the lower gate to the outer front of the inner court, a hundred cubits on the east side and on the north side.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he measured the width from the front of the lower gateway to the front of the inner court exterior, one hundred cubits toward the east and the north.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the man measured across the Temple’s outer courtyard between the outer and inner gateways; the distance was 175 feet.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he measured the width from the front of the lower gate to the front of the exterior of the inner courtyard, a hundred cubits on the east and on the north.
verses.textEn: Then he measured the distance from the inside of the lower gateway to the outside of the inner court; it was a hundred cubits on the east side as well as on the north.

verses.textZh: 他又量了外院朝北大门的长度和宽度。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又量了外院朝北大门的长度和宽度。
verses.textZhCuv: 他量外院朝北的门，长宽若干。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he measured the length and width of the north gate, leading into the outer court.
verses.textEnEsv: As for the gate that faced toward the north, belonging to the outer court, he measured its length and its breadth.
verses.textEnNkjv: On the outer court was also a gateway facing north, and he measured its length and its width.
verses.textEnNlt: The man measured the gateway on the north just like the one on the east.
verses.textEnNasb: And as for the gate of the outer courtyard which faced north, he measured its length and its width.
verses.textEn: Then he measured the length and width of the north gate, leading into the outer court.

verses.textZh: 里面的守卫室，这边有三间，那边有三间；墙柱和门廊的尺寸都与东门的一样；北门全长二十五公尺，宽十二公尺半。
verses.textZhCnvs: 里面的守卫室，这边有三间，那边有三间；墙柱和门廊的尺寸都与东门的一样；北门全长二十五公尺，宽十二公尺半。
verses.textZhCuv: 门洞的卫房，这旁三间，那旁三间。门洞的柱子和廊子，与第一门的尺寸一样。门洞长五十肘，宽二十五肘。
verses.textEnNiv: Its alcoves—three on each side—its projecting walls and its portico had the same measurements as those of the first gateway. It was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.
verses.textEnEsv: Its side rooms, three on either side, and its jambs and its vestibule were of the same size as those of the first gate. Its length was fifty cubits, and its breadth twenty-five cubits.
verses.textEnNkjv: Its gate chambers, three on this side and three on that side, its gateposts and its archways, had the same measurements as the first gate; its length was fifty cubits and its width twenty-five cubits.
verses.textEnNlt: Here, too, there were three guard alcoves on each side, with dividing walls and an entry room. All the measurements matched those of the east gateway. The gateway passage was 87-1/2 feet long and 43-3/4 feet wide between the back walls of facing guard alcoves.
verses.textEnNasb: It had three guardrooms on each side; and its side pillars and its porches had the same measurement as the first gate. Its length was fifty cubits, and the width twenty-five cubits.
verses.textEn: Its alcoves—three on each side—its projecting walls and its portico had the same measurements as those of the first gateway. It was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.

verses.textZh: 它的窗子、门廊和雕刻的棕树，都与东门的一样；人要登七级台阶才到这门，前面尽头是门廊。
verses.textZhCnvs: 它的窗子、门廊和雕刻的棕树，都与东门的一样；人要登七级台阶才到这门，前面尽头是门廊。
verses.textZhCuv: 其窗棂和廊子，并雕刻的棕树，与朝东的门尺寸一样。登七层台阶上到这门，前面有廊子。
verses.textEnNiv: Its openings, its portico and its palm tree decorations had the same measurements as those of the gate facing east. Seven steps led up to it, with its portico opposite them.
verses.textEnEsv: And its windows, its vestibule, and its palm trees were of the same size as those of the gate that faced toward the east. And by seven steps people would go up to it, and find its vestibule before them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Its windows and those of its archways, and also its palm trees, had the same measurements as the gateway facing east; it was ascended by seven steps, and its archway was in front of it.
verses.textEnNlt: The windows, the entry room, and the palm tree decorations were identical to those in the east gateway. There were seven steps leading up to the gateway entrance, and the entry room was at the inner end of the gateway passage.
verses.textEnNasb: Its windows, its porches, and its palm tree decorations had the same measurements as the gate which faced east; and it was reached by seven steps, and its porch was in front of them.
verses.textEn: Its openings, its portico and its palm tree decorations had the same measurements as those of the gate facing east. Seven steps led up to it, with its portico opposite them.

verses.textZh: 内院有门与这门相对；北面、东面，都是一样；他从这门量到那门，共有五十公尺。
verses.textZhCnvs: 内院有门与这门相对；北面、东面，都是一样；他从这门量到那门，共有五十公尺。
verses.textZhCuv: 内院有门与这门相对，北面东面都是如此。他从这门量到那门，共一百肘。
verses.textEnNiv: There was a gate to the inner court facing the north gate, just as there was on the east. He measured from one gate to the opposite one; it was a hundred cubits.
verses.textEnEsv: And opposite the gate on the north, as on the east, was a gate to the inner court. And he measured from gate to gate, a hundred cubits.
verses.textEnNkjv: A gate of the inner court was opposite the northern gateway, just as the eastern gateway; and he measured from gateway to gateway, one hundred cubits.
verses.textEnNlt: Here on the north side, just as on the east, there was another gateway leading to the Temple’s inner courtyard directly opposite this outer gateway. The distance between the two gateways was 175 feet.
verses.textEnNasb: The inner courtyard had a gate opposite the gate on the north as well as the gate on the east; and he measured a hundred cubits from gate to gate.
verses.textEn: There was a gate to the inner court facing the north gate, just as there was on the east. He measured from one gate to the opposite one; it was a hundred cubits.

verses.textZh: 他领我向南走，我就看见朝南的门。他量了墙柱和门廊，大小与先前的一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他领我向南走，我就看见朝南的门。他量了墙柱和门廊，大小与先前的一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 他带我往南去，见朝南有门，又照先前的尺寸量门洞的柱子和廊子。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he led me to the south side and I saw the south gate. He measured its jambs and its portico, and they had the same measurements as the others.
verses.textEnEsv: And he led me toward the south, and behold, there was a gate on the south. And he measured its jambs and its vestibule; they had the same size as the others.
verses.textEnNkjv: After that he brought me toward the south, and there a gateway was facing south; and he measured its gateposts and archways according to these same measurements.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the man took me around to the south gateway and measured its various parts, and they were exactly the same as in the others.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he led me toward the south, and behold, there was a gate toward the south; and he measured its side pillars and its porches according to those same measurements.
verses.textEn: Then he led me to the south side and I saw the south gate. He measured its jambs and its portico, and they had the same measurements as the others.

verses.textZh: 门的里面和门廊周围都有窗子，与先前的窗子一样。南门全长二十五公尺，宽十二公尺半。
verses.textZhCnvs: 门的里面和门廊周围都有窗子，与先前的窗子一样。南门全长二十五公尺，宽十二公尺半。
verses.textZhCuv: 门洞两旁与廊子的周围都有窗棂，和先量的窗棂一样。门洞长五十肘，宽二十五肘。
verses.textEnNiv: The gateway and its portico had narrow openings all around, like the openings of the others. It was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.
verses.textEnEsv: Both it and its vestibule had windows all around, like the windows of the others. Its length was fifty cubits, and its breadth twenty-five cubits.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therewere windows in it and in its archways all around like those windows; its length was fifty cubits and its width twenty-five cubits.
verses.textEnNlt: It had windows along the walls as the others did, and there was an entry room where the gateway passage opened into the outer courtyard. And like the others, the gateway passage was 87-1/2 feet long and 43-3/4 feet wide between the back walls of facing guard alcoves.
verses.textEnNasb: The gate and its porches had windows all around like those other windows; the length was fifty cubits and the width, twenty-five cubits.
verses.textEn: The gateway and its portico had narrow openings all around, like the openings of the others. It was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.

verses.textZh: 人要登七级台阶才到这门，前面尽头是门廊，墙柱上两边都刻有棕树。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人要登七级台阶才到这门，前面尽头是门廊，墙柱上两边都刻有棕树。
verses.textZhCuv: 登七层台阶上到这门，前面有廊子；柱上有雕刻的棕树，这边一棵，那边一棵。
verses.textEnNiv: Seven steps led up to it, with its portico opposite them; it had palm tree decorations on the faces of the projecting walls on each side.
verses.textEnEsv: And there were seven steps leading up to it, and its vestibule was before them, and it had palm trees on its jambs, one on either side.
verses.textEnNkjv: Seven steps led up to it, and its archway was in front of them; and it had palm trees on its gateposts, one on this side and one on that side.
verses.textEnNlt: This gateway also had a stairway of seven steps leading up to it, and an entry room at the inner end, and palm tree decorations along the dividing walls.
verses.textEnNasb: There were seven steps going up to it, and its porches were in front of them; and it had palm tree decorations on its side pillars, one on each side.
verses.textEn: Seven steps led up to it, with its portico opposite them; it had palm tree decorations on the faces of the projecting walls on each side.

verses.textZh: 内院南面也有门；他从这门量到南门，共有五十公尺。
verses.textZhCnvs: 内院南面也有门；他从这门量到南门，共有五十公尺。
verses.textZhCuv: 内院朝南有门。从这门量到朝南的那门，共一百肘。
verses.textEnNiv: The inner court also had a gate facing south, and he measured from this gate to the outer gate on the south side; it was a hundred cubits.
verses.textEnEsv: And there was a gate on the south of the inner court. And he measured from gate to gate toward the south, a hundred cubits.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therewas also a gateway on the inner court, facing south; and he measured from gateway to gateway toward the south, one hundred cubits.
verses.textEnNlt: And here again, directly opposite the outer gateway, was another gateway that led into the inner courtyard. The distance between the two gateways was 175 feet.
verses.textEnNasb: The inner courtyard had a gate toward the south; and he measured from gate to gate toward the south, a hundred cubits.
verses.textEn: The inner court also had a gate facing south, and he measured from this gate to the outer gate on the south side; it was a hundred cubits.

verses.textZh: 他领我从内院的南门进到内院，量了这门，大小与先前的一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他领我从内院的南门进到内院，量了这门，大小与先前的一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 他带我从南门到内院，就照先前的尺寸量南门。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he brought me into the inner court through the south gate, and he measured the south gate; it had the same measurements as the others.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he brought me to the inner court through the south gate, and he measured the south gate. It was of the same size as the others.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he brought me to the inner court through the southern gateway; he measured the southern gateway according to these same measurements.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the man took me to the south gateway leading into the inner courtyard. He measured it, and it had the same measurements as the other gateways.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he brought me to the inner courtyard by the south gate; and he measured the south gate according to those same measurements.
verses.textEn: Then he brought me into the inner court through the south gate, and he measured the south gate; it had the same measurements as the others.

verses.textZh: 门廊朝向外院；墙柱刻有棕树；台阶共有八级。
verses.textZhCnvs: 门廊朝向外院；墙柱刻有棕树；台阶共有八级。
verses.textZhCuv: 卫房和柱子，并廊子都照先前的尺寸。门洞两旁与廊子的周围都有窗棂。门洞长五十肘，宽二十五肘。
verses.textEnNiv: Its alcoves, its projecting walls and its portico had the same measurements as the others. The gateway and its portico had openings all around. It was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.
verses.textEnEsv: Its side rooms, its jambs, and its vestibule were of the same size as the others, and both it and its vestibule had windows all around. Its length was fifty cubits, and its breadth twenty-five cubits.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also its gate chambers, its gateposts, and its archways were according to these same measurements; therewere windows in it and in its archways all around; itwas fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.
verses.textEnNlt: Its guard alcoves, dividing walls, and entry room were the same size as those in the others. It also had windows along its walls and in the entry room. And like the others, the gateway passage was 87-1/2 feet long and 43-3/4 feet wide.
verses.textEnNasb: Its guardrooms also, its side pillars, and its porches were according to those same measurements. And the gate and its porches had windows all around; it was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.
verses.textEn: Its alcoves, its projecting walls and its portico had the same measurements as the others. The gateway and its portico had openings all around. It was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.

verses.textZh: 他领我到内院的东门，他量了那门，大小与先前的一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他领我到内院的东门，他量了那门，大小与先前的一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 周围有廊子，长二十五肘，宽五肘。
verses.textEnNiv: (The porticoes of the gateways around the inner court were twenty-five cubits wide and five cubits deep.)
verses.textEnEsv: And there were vestibules all around, twenty-five cubits long and five cubits broad.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therewere archways all around, twenty-five cubits long and five cubits wide.
verses.textEnNlt: (The entry rooms of the gateways leading into the inner courtyard were 14 feet across and 43-3/4 feet wide.)
verses.textEnNasb: There were porches all around, twenty-five cubits long and five cubits wide.
verses.textEn: (The porticoes of the gateways around the inner court were twenty-five cubits wide and five cubits deep.)

verses.textZh: 守卫室、墙柱和门廊的尺寸都与先前的一样；门的里面和门廊的周围都有窗子。这门全长二十五公尺，宽十二公尺半。
verses.textZhCnvs: 守卫室、墙柱和门廊的尺寸都与先前的一样；门的里面和门廊的周围都有窗子。这门全长二十五公尺，宽十二公尺半。
verses.textZhCuv: 廊子朝着外院，柱上有雕刻的棕树。登八层台阶上到这门。
verses.textEnNiv: Its portico faced the outer court; palm trees decorated its jambs, and eight steps led up to it.
verses.textEnEsv: Its vestibule faced the outer court, and palm trees were on its jambs, and its stairway had eight steps.
verses.textEnNkjv: Its archways faced the outer court, palm trees were on its gateposts, and going up to it were eight steps.
verses.textEnNlt: The entry room to the south gateway faced into the outer courtyard. It had palm tree decorations on its columns, and there were eight steps leading to its entrance.
verses.textEnNasb: And its porches were toward the outer courtyard; and palm tree decorations were on its side pillars, and its stairway had eight steps.
verses.textEn: Its portico faced the outer court; palm trees decorated its jambs, and eight steps led up to it.

verses.textZh: 门廊朝着外院；墙柱上两边都刻有棕树；台阶共有八级。
verses.textZhCnvs: 门廊朝着外院；墙柱上两边都刻有棕树；台阶共有八级。
verses.textZhCuv: 他带我到内院的东面，就照先前的尺寸量东门。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he brought me to the inner court on the east side, and he measured the gateway; it had the same measurements as the others.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he brought me to the inner court on the east side, and he measured the gate. It was of the same size as the others.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he brought me into the inner court facing east; he measured the gateway according to these same measurements.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he took me to the east gateway leading to the inner courtyard. He measured it, and it had the same measurements as the other gateways.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he brought me into the inner courtyard toward the east. And he measured the gate according to those same measurements.
verses.textEn: Then he brought me to the inner court on the east side, and he measured the gateway; it had the same measurements as the others.

verses.textZhCnvs: 守卫室、墙柱和门廊，都是一样。门的里面周围都有窗户；这门全长二十五公尺，宽十二公尺半。
verses.textZhCuv: 廊子朝着外院。门洞两旁的柱子都有雕刻的棕树。登八层台阶上到这门。

verses.textZh: 在门廊里，这边有两张桌子，那边也有两张桌子，在上面可以宰杀燔祭牲、赎罪祭牲和赎愆祭牲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在门廊里，这边有两张桌子，那边也有两张桌子，在上面可以宰杀燔祭牲、赎罪祭牲和赎愆祭牲。
verses.textZhCuv: 廊柱朝着外院。门洞两旁的柱子都有雕刻的棕树。登八层台阶上到这门。
verses.textEnNiv: Its portico faced the outer court; palm trees decorated the jambs on either side, and eight steps led up to it.
verses.textEnEsv: Its vestibule faced the outer court, and it had palm trees on its jambs, on either side, and its stairway had eight steps.
verses.textEnNkjv: Its gateposts faced the outer court, palm trees were on its gateposts on this side and on that side, and going up to it were eight steps.
verses.textEnNlt: Its entry room faced into the outer courtyard, and it had palm tree decorations on the columns. There were eight steps leading to its entrance.
verses.textEnNasb: And its side pillars were toward the outer courtyard; and palm tree decorations were on its side pillars, on each side, and its stairway had eight steps.
verses.textEn: Its portico faced the outer court; palm trees decorated the jambs on either side, and eight steps led up to it.

verses.textZh: 在北门入口的台阶那里，朝向外面的一边有两张桌子，朝向门廊的另一边也有两张桌子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在北门入口的台阶那里，朝向外面的一边有两张桌子，朝向门廊的另一边也有两张桌子。
verses.textZhCuv: 门洞的柱旁有屋子和门；祭司 在那里洗燔祭牲。
verses.textEnNiv: A room with a doorway was by the portico in each of the inner gateways, where the burnt offerings were washed.
verses.textEnEsv: There was a chamber with its door in the vestibule of the gate, where the burnt offering was to be washed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therewas a chamber and its entrance by the gateposts of the gateway, where they washed the burnt offering.
verses.textEnNlt: A door led from the entry room of one of the inner gateways into a side room, where the meat for sacrifices was washed.
verses.textEnNasb: A chamber with its doorway was by the side pillars at the gates; there they rinse the burnt offering.
verses.textEn: A room with a doorway was by the portico in each of the inner gateways, where the burnt offerings were washed.

verses.textZh: 在大门两边，这边有四张桌子，那边也有四张桌子，共有八张，供宰杀祭牲之用。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在大门两边，这边有四张桌子，那边也有四张桌子，共有八张，供宰杀祭牲之用。
verses.textZhCuv: 在门廊内，这边有两张桌子，那边有两张桌子，在其上可以宰杀燔祭牲、赎罪祭牲，和赎愆祭牲。
verses.textEnNiv: In the portico of the gateway were two tables on each side, on which the burnt offerings, sin offerings and guilt offerings were slaughtered.
verses.textEnEsv: And in the vestibule of the gate were two tables on either side, on which the burnt offering and the sin offering and the guilt offering were to be slaughtered.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the vestibule of the gateway were two tables on this side and two tables on that side, on which to slay the burnt offering, the sin offering, and the trespass offering.
verses.textEnNlt: On each side of this entry room were two tables, where the sacrificial animals were slaughtered for the burnt offerings, sin offerings, and guilt offerings.
verses.textEnNasb: And in the porch of the gate were two tables on each side, on which to slaughter the burnt offering, the sin offering, and the guilt offering.
verses.textEn: In the portico of the gateway were two tables on each side, on which the burnt offerings, sin offerings and guilt offerings were slaughtered.

verses.textZh: 另有四张桌子供燔祭使用，是用凿好的石头做的，长七十五公分，宽七十五公分，高五十公分，宰杀燔祭牲和其他祭牲所用的器皿是放在那里的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 另有四张桌子供燔祭使用，是用凿好的石头做的，长七十五公分，宽七十五公分，高五十公分，宰杀燔祭牲和其他祭牲所用的器皿是放在那里的。
verses.textZhCuv: 上到朝北的门口，这边有两张桌子，门廊那边也有两张桌子。
verses.textEnNiv: By the outside wall of the portico of the gateway, near the steps at the entrance of the north gateway were two tables, and on the other side of the steps were two tables.
verses.textEnEsv: And off to the side, on the outside as one goes up to the entrance of the north gate, were two tables; and off to the other side of the vestibule of the gate were two tables.
verses.textEnNkjv: At the outer side of the vestibule, as one goes up to the entrance of the northern gateway, were two tables; and on the other side of the vestibule of the gateway were two tables.
verses.textEnNlt: Outside the entry room, on each side of the stairs going up to the north entrance, were two more tables.
verses.textEnNasb: On the outer side, as one went up to the gateway toward the north, were two tables; and on the other side of the porch of the gate were two tables.
verses.textEn: By the outside wall of the portico of the gateway, near the steps at the entrance of the north gateway were two tables, and on the other side of the steps were two tables.

verses.textZh: 周围的墙上钉有钩子，各长七公分半。桌子上放有献祭的肉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 周围的墙上钉有钩子，各长七公分半。桌子上放有献祭的肉。
verses.textZhCuv: 门这边有四张桌子，那边有四张桌子，共八张；在其上祭司宰杀牺牲。
verses.textEnNiv: So there were four tables on one side of the gateway and four on the other—eight tables in all—on which the sacrifices were slaughtered.
verses.textEnEsv: Four tables were on either side of the gate, eight tables, on which to slaughter.
verses.textEnNkjv: Four tables were on this side and four tables on that side, by the side of the gateway, eight tables on which they slaughtered thesacrifices.
verses.textEnNlt: So there were eight tables in all—four inside and four outside—where the sacrifices were cut up and prepared.
verses.textEnNasb: Four tables were on each side next to the gate; eight tables on which they slaughter sacrifices.
verses.textEn: So there were four tables on one side of the gateway and four on the other—eight tables in all—on which the sacrifices were slaughtered.

verses.textZh: 内院的门外有两间 房子：一间在北门旁边，朝向南面；一间在南门 旁边，朝向北面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 内院的门外有两间 房子：一间在北门旁边，朝向南面；一间在南门 旁边，朝向北面。
verses.textZhCuv: 为燔祭牲有四张桌子，是凿过的石头做成的，长一肘半，宽一肘半，高一肘。祭司将宰杀燔祭牲和平安祭牲所用的器皿放在其上。
verses.textEnNiv: There were also four tables of dressed stone for the burnt offerings, each a cubit and a half long, a cubit and a half wide and a cubit high. On them were placed the utensils for slaughtering the burnt offerings and the other sacrifices.
verses.textEnEsv: And there were four tables of hewn stone for the burnt offering, a cubit and a half long, and a cubit and a half broad, and one cubit high, on which the instruments were to be laid with which the burnt offerings and the sacrifices were slaughtered.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therewere also four tables of hewn stone for the burnt offering, one cubit and a half long, one cubit and a half wide, and one cubit high; on these they laid the instruments with which they slaughtered the burnt offering and the sacrifice.
verses.textEnNlt: There were also four tables of finished stone for preparation of the burnt offerings, each 31-1/2 inches square and 21 inches high. On these tables were placed the butchering knives and other implements for slaughtering the sacrificial animals.
verses.textEnNasb: For the burnt offering there were four tables of cut stone, a cubit and a half long, a cubit and a half wide, and one cubit high, on which they set the utensils with which they slaughter the burnt offering and the sacrifice.
verses.textEn: There were also four tables of dressed stone for the burnt offerings, each a cubit and a half long, a cubit and a half wide and a cubit high. On them were placed the utensils for slaughtering the burnt offerings and the other sacrifices.

verses.textZh: 他对我说："这间朝向南面的房子是给那些负责圣殿职事的祭司使用的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他对我说："这间朝向南面的房子是给那些负责圣殿职事的祭司使用的。
verses.textZhCuv: 有钩子，宽一掌，钉在廊内的四围。桌子上有牺牲的肉。
verses.textEnNiv: And double-pronged hooks, each a handbreadth long, were attached to the wall all around. The tables were for the flesh of the offerings.
verses.textEnEsv: And hooks, a handbreadth long, were fastened all around within. And on the tables the flesh of the offering was to be laid.
verses.textEnNkjv: Inside were hooks, a handbreadth wide, fastened all around; and the flesh of the sacrifices was on the tables.
verses.textEnNlt: There were hooks, each 3 inches long, fastened all around the foyer walls. The sacrificial meat was laid on the tables.
verses.textEnNasb: And the double hooks, one hand width in length, were installed in the house all around; and on the tables was the flesh of the offering.
verses.textEn: And double-pronged hooks, each a handbreadth long, were attached to the wall all around. The tables were for the flesh of the offerings.

verses.textZh: 那间朝向北面的房子是给那些负责祭坛职事的祭司使用的。这些祭司都是撒督的子孙，在利未人中只有他们可以近前来事奉耶和华。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那间朝向北面的房子是给那些负责祭坛职事的祭司使用的。这些祭司都是撒督的子孙，在利未人中只有他们可以近前来事奉耶和华。"
verses.textZhCuv: 在北门旁，内院里有屋子，为歌唱的人而设。这屋子朝南；在南 门旁，又有一间朝北。
verses.textEnNiv: Outside the inner gate, within the inner court, were two rooms, one at the side of the north gate and facing south, and another at the side of the south gate and facing north.
verses.textEnEsv: On the outside of the inner gateway there were two chambers in the inner court, one at the side of the north gate facing south, the other at the side of the south gate facing north.
verses.textEnNkjv: Outside the inner gate were the chambers for the singers in the inner court, one facing south at the side of the northern gateway, and the other facing north at the side of the southern gateway.
verses.textEnNlt: Inside the inner courtyard were two rooms, one beside the north gateway, facing south, and the other beside the south gateway, facing north.
verses.textEnNasb: From the outside to the inner gate were chambers for the singers in the inner courtyard, one of which was at the side of the north gate, with its front toward the south, and one at the side of the south gate facing north.
verses.textEn: Outside the inner gate, within the inner court, were two rooms, one at the side of the north gate and facing south, and another at the side of the south gate and facing north.

verses.textZh: 他又量了内院，长五十公尺，宽五十公尺，是正方形的；祭坛就在殿的前面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又量了内院，长五十公尺，宽五十公尺，是正方形的；祭坛就在殿的前面。
verses.textZhCuv: 他对我说：「这朝南的屋子是为看守殿宇的祭司；
verses.textEnNiv: He said to me, "The room facing south is for the priests who guard the temple,
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to me, "This chamber that faces south is for the priests who have charge of the temple,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said to me, "This chamber which faces south is for the priests who have charge of the temple.
verses.textEnNlt: And the man said to me, "The room beside the north inner gate is for the priests who supervise the Temple maintenance.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said to me, "This is the chamber which faces south, intended for the priests who are responsible for the temple;
verses.textEn: He said to me, "The room facing south is for the priests who guard the temple,

verses.textZh: 他领我到圣殿的门廊，量了门廊的墙柱，这边厚两公尺半，那边厚两公尺半。门口宽七公尺 ，门的内墙，这边一公尺半，那边一公尺半。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他领我到圣殿的门廊，量了门廊的墙柱，这边厚两公尺半，那边厚两公尺半。门口宽七公尺 ，门的内墙，这边一公尺半，那边一公尺半。
verses.textZhCuv: 那朝北的屋子是为看守祭坛的祭司。这些祭司是利未人中撒督的子孙，近前来事奉耶和华的。」
verses.textEnNiv: and the room facing north is for the priests who guard the altar. These are the sons of Zadok, who are the only Levites who may draw near to the Lord to minister before him."
verses.textEnEsv: and the chamber that faces north is for the priests who have charge of the altar. These are the sons of Zadok, who alone among the sons of Levi may come near to the Lord to minister to him."
verses.textEnNkjv: The chamber which faces north is for the priests who have charge of the altar; these are the sons of Zadok, from the sons of Levi, who come near the Lord to minister to Him."
verses.textEnNlt: The room beside the south inner gate is for the priests in charge of the altar—the descendants of Zadok—for they alone of all the Levites may approach the Lord to minister to him."
verses.textEnNasb: but the chamber which faces north is for the priests who are responsible for the altar. They are the sons of Zadok, who from the sons of Levi come near to the Lord to serve Him."
verses.textEn: and the room facing north is for the priests who guard the altar. These are the sons of Zadok, who are the only Levites who may draw near to the Lord to minister before him."

verses.textZh: 门廊宽十公尺，深六公尺 ；人要登台阶才上到门廊；墙柱旁边有柱子，这边一根，那边一根。
verses.textZhCnvs: 门廊宽十公尺，深六公尺 ；人要登台阶才上到门廊；墙柱旁边有柱子，这边一根，那边一根。
verses.textZhCuv: 他又量内院，长一百肘，宽一百肘，是见方的。祭坛在殿前。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he measured the court: It was square—a hundred cubits long and a hundred cubits wide. And the altar was in front of the temple.
verses.textEnEsv: And he measured the court, a hundred cubits long and a hundred cubits broad, a square. And the altar was in front of the temple.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he measured the court, one hundred cubits long and one hundred cubits wide, foursquare. The altar was in front of the temple.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the man measured the inner courtyard, and it was a square, 175 feet wide and 175 feet across. The altar stood in the courtyard in front of the Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: He measured the courtyard, a perfect square, a hundred cubits long and a hundred cubits wide; and the altar was in front of the temple.
verses.textEn: Then he measured the court: It was square—a hundred cubits long and a hundred cubits wide. And the altar was in front of the temple.

verses.textZh: 于是他带我到殿前的廊子，量廊子的墙柱。这面厚五肘，那面厚五肘。门两旁，这边三肘，那边三肘。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他带我到殿前的廊子，量廊子的墙柱。这面厚五肘，那面厚五肘。门两旁，这边三肘，那边三肘。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是他带我到殿前的廊子，量廊子的墙柱。这面厚五肘，那面厚五肘。门两旁，这边三肘，那边三肘。
verses.textEnNiv: He brought me to the portico of the temple and measured the jambs of the portico; they were five cubits wide on either side. The width of the entrance was fourteen cubits and its projecting walls were three cubits wide on either side.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he brought me to the vestibule of the temple and measured the jambs of the vestibule, five cubits on either side. And the breadth of the gate was fourteen cubits, and the sidewalls of the gate were three cubits on either side.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he brought me to the vestibule of the temple and measured the doorposts of the vestibule, five cubits on this side and five cubits on that side; and the width of the gateway was three cubits on this side and three cubits on that side.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he brought me to the entry room of the Temple. He measured the walls on either side of the opening to the entry room, and they were 8-3/4 feet thick. The entrance itself was 24-1/2 feet wide, and the walls on each side of the entrance were an additional 5-1/4 feet long.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he brought me to the porch of the temple and measured each side pillar of the porch, five cubits on each side; and the width of the gate was three cubits on each side.
verses.textEn: He brought me to the portico of the temple and measured the jambs of the portico; they were five cubits wide on either side. The width of the entrance was fourteen cubits and its projecting walls were three cubits wide on either side.

verses.textZh: 廊子长二十肘，宽十一肘。上廊子有台阶。靠近墙柱又有柱子，这边一根，那边一根。
verses.textZhCnvs: 廊子长二十肘，宽十一肘。上廊子有台阶。靠近墙柱又有柱子，这边一根，那边一根。
verses.textZhCuv: 廊子长二十肘，宽十一肘。上廊子有台阶。靠近墙柱又有柱子，这边一根，那边一根。
verses.textEnNiv: The portico was twenty cubits wide, and twelve cubits from front to back. It was reached by a flight of stairs, and there were pillars on each side of the jambs.
verses.textEnEsv: The length of the vestibule was twenty cubits, and the breadth twelve cubits, and people would go up to it by ten steps. And there were pillars beside the jambs, one on either side.
verses.textEnNkjv: The length of the vestibule was twenty cubits, and the width eleven cubits; and by the steps which led up to it therewere pillars by the doorposts, one on this side and another on that side.
verses.textEnNlt: The entry room was 35 feet wide and 21 feet deep. There were ten steps leading up to it, with a column on each side.
verses.textEnNasb: The length of the porch was twenty cubits, and the width eleven cubits; and at the stairway by which it was ascended were columns belonging to the side pillars, one on each side.
verses.textEn: The portico was twenty cubits wide, and twelve cubits from front to back. It was reached by a flight of stairs, and there were pillars on each side of the jambs.

verses.textZh: 他领我到外殿，量了墙柱，这边厚三公尺，那边厚三公尺，宽窄与会幕相同。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他领我到外殿，量了墙柱，这边厚三公尺，那边厚三公尺，宽窄与会幕相同。
verses.textZhCuv: 他带我到殿那里量墙柱：这面厚六肘，那面厚六肘，宽窄与会幕相同。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the man brought me to the main hall and measured the jambs; the width of the jambs was six cubits on each side.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he brought me to the nave and measured the jambs. On each side six cubits was the breadth of the jambs.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he brought me into the sanctuary and measured the doorposts, six cubits wide on one side and six cubits wide on the other side—the width of the tabernacle.
verses.textEnNlt: After that, the man brought me into the sanctuary of the Temple. He measured the walls on either side of its doorway, and they were 10-1/2 feet thick.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he brought me to the sanctuary, and he measured the side pillars: six cubits wide on each side was the width of the side pillar.
verses.textEn: Then the man brought me to the main hall and measured the jambs; the width of the jambs was six cubits on each side.

verses.textZh: 外殿的入口宽五公尺，门的两边内墙，这边两公尺半，那边两公尺半；他量了外殿，长二十公尺，宽十公尺。
verses.textZhCnvs: 外殿的入口宽五公尺，门的两边内墙，这边两公尺半，那边两公尺半；他量了外殿，长二十公尺，宽十公尺。
verses.textZhCuv: 门口宽十肘。门两旁，这边五肘，那边五肘。他量殿长四十肘，宽二十肘。
verses.textEnNiv: The entrance was ten cubits wide, and the projecting walls on each side of it were five cubits wide. He also measured the main hall; it was forty cubits long and twenty cubits wide.
verses.textEnEsv: And the breadth of the entrance was ten cubits, and the sidewalls of the entrance were five cubits on either side. And he measured the length of the nave, forty cubits, and its breadth, twenty cubits.
verses.textEnNkjv: The width of the entryway was ten cubits, and the side walls of the entrance were five cubits on this side and five cubits on the other side; and he measured its length, forty cubits, and its width, twenty cubits.
verses.textEnNlt: The doorway was 17-1/2 feet wide, and the walls on each side of it were 8-3/4 feet long. The sanctuary itself was 70 feet long and 35 feet wide.
verses.textEnNasb: The width of the entrance was ten cubits and the sides of the entrance were five cubits on each side. He also measured the length of the sanctuary, forty cubits, and the width, twenty cubits.
verses.textEn: The entrance was ten cubits wide, and the projecting walls on each side of it were five cubits wide. He also measured the main hall; it was forty cubits long and twenty cubits wide.

verses.textZh: 他进了内殿，量了门口的墙柱，各厚一公尺；入口宽三公尺，门的内墙各宽三公尺半。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他进了内殿，量了门口的墙柱，各厚一公尺；入口宽三公尺，门的内墙各宽三公尺半。
verses.textZhCuv: 他到内殿量墙柱，各厚二肘。门口宽六肘，门两旁各宽七肘。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he went into the inner sanctuary and measured the jambs of the entrance; each was two cubits wide. The entrance was six cubits wide, and the projecting walls on each side of it were seven cubits wide.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he went into the inner room and measured the jambs of the entrance, two cubits; and the entrance, six cubits; and the sidewalls on either side of the entrance, seven cubits.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also he went inside and measured the doorposts, two cubits; and the entrance, six cubits high; and the width of the entrance, seven cubits.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he went beyond the sanctuary into the inner room. He measured the walls on either side of its entrance, and they were 3-1/2 feet thick. The entrance was 10-1/2 feet wide, and the walls on each side of the entrance were 12-1/4 feet long.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he went inside and measured each side pillar of the doorway, two cubits, and the doorway, six cubits high; and the width of the doorway, seven cubits.
verses.textEn: Then he went into the inner sanctuary and measured the jambs of the entrance; each was two cubits wide. The entrance was six cubits wide, and the projecting walls on each side of it were seven cubits wide.

verses.textZh: 他量了内殿，长十公尺，宽十公尺，贴着外殿。他对我说："这是至圣所。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他量了内殿，长十公尺，宽十公尺，贴着外殿。他对我说："这是至圣所。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他量内殿，长二十肘，宽二十肘。他对我说：「这是至圣所。」
verses.textEnNiv: And he measured the length of the inner sanctuary; it was twenty cubits, and its width was twenty cubits across the end of the main hall. He said to me, "This is the Most Holy Place."
verses.textEnEsv: And he measured the length of the room, twenty cubits, and its breadth, twenty cubits, across the nave. And he said to me, "This is the Most Holy Place."
verses.textEnNkjv: He measured the length, twenty cubits; and the width, twenty cubits, beyond the sanctuary; and he said to me, "This is the Most Holy Place."
verses.textEnNlt: The inner room of the sanctuary was 35 feet long and 35 feet wide. "This," he told me, "is the Most Holy Place."
verses.textEnNasb: And he measured its length, twenty cubits, and the width, twenty cubits, before the sanctuary; and he said to me, "This is the Most Holy Place."
verses.textEn: And he measured the length of the inner sanctuary; it was twenty cubits, and its width was twenty cubits across the end of the main hall. He said to me, "This is the Most Holy Place."

verses.textZh: 他又量了圣殿的墙，厚三公尺；殿的周围有多间厢房，各宽二公尺。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又量了圣殿的墙，厚三公尺；殿的周围有多间厢房，各宽二公尺。
verses.textZhCuv: 他又量殿墙，厚六肘；围着殿有旁屋，各宽四肘。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he measured the wall of the temple; it was six cubits thick, and each side room around the temple was four cubits wide.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he measured the wall of the temple, six cubits thick, and the breadth of the side chambers, four cubits, all around the temple.
verses.textEnNkjv: Next, he measured the wall of the temple, six cubits. The width of each side chamber all around the temple was four cubits on every side.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he measured the wall of the Temple, and it was 10-1/2 feet thick. There was a row of rooms along the outside wall; each room was 7 feet wide.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he measured the wall of the temple, six cubits; and the width of the side chambers, four cubits, all around the house on every side.
verses.textEn: Then he measured the wall of the temple; it was six cubits thick, and each side room around the temple was four cubits wide.

verses.textZh: 厢房共有三层，一层叠在一层之上，每层有三十间。殿墙的周围有墙坎子，支撑着厢房，免得厢房的梁木嵌入殿墙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 厢房共有三层，一层叠在一层之上，每层有三十间。殿墙的周围有墙坎子，支撑着厢房，免得厢房的梁木嵌入殿墙。
verses.textZhCuv: 旁屋有三层，层叠而上，每层排列三十间。旁屋的梁木搁在殿墙坎上，免得插入殿墙。
verses.textEnNiv: The side rooms were on three levels, one above another, thirty on each level. There were ledges all around the wall of the temple to serve as supports for the side rooms, so that the supports were not inserted into the wall of the temple.
verses.textEnEsv: And the side chambers were in three stories, one over another, thirty in each story. There were offsets all around the wall of the temple to serve as supports for the side chambers, so that they should not be supported by the wall of the temple.
verses.textEnNkjv: The side chambers were in three stories, one above the other, thirty chambers in each story; they rested on ledges which were for the side chambers all around, that they might be supported, but not fastened to the wall of the temple.
verses.textEnNlt: These side rooms were built in three levels, one above the other, with thirty rooms on each level. The supports for these side rooms rested on exterior ledges on the Temple wall; they did not extend into the wall.
verses.textEnNasb: The side chambers were in three stories, one above another, and thirty in each story; and the side chambers extended to the wall which stood on their inward side all around, so that they could be attached, but not be attached to the wall of the temple itself.
verses.textEn: The side rooms were on three levels, one above another, thirty on each level. There were ledges all around the wall of the temple to serve as supports for the side rooms, so that the supports were not inserted into the wall of the temple.

verses.textZh: 这些围绕着殿的厢房越高越宽。殿四围的内墙一级比一级薄，所以厢房越上越宽；有楼梯从下层经过中层上到上层。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些围绕着殿的厢房越高越宽。殿四围的内墙一级比一级薄，所以厢房越上越宽；有楼梯从下层经过中层上到上层。
verses.textZhCuv: 这围殿的旁屋越高越宽；因旁屋围殿悬叠而上，所以越上越宽，从下一层，由中一层，到上一层。
verses.textEnNiv: The side rooms all around the temple were wider at each successive level. The structure surrounding the temple was built in ascending stages, so that the rooms widened as one went upward. A stairway went up from the lowest floor to the top floor through the middle floor.
verses.textEnEsv: And it became broader as it wound upward to the side chambers, because the temple was enclosed upward all around the temple. Thus the temple had a broad area upward, and so one went up from the lowest story to the top story through the middle story.
verses.textEnNkjv: As one went up from story to story, the side chambers became wider all around, because their supporting ledges in the wall of the temple ascended like steps; therefore the width of the structure increased as one went up from the lowest story to the highest by way of the middle one.
verses.textEnNlt: Each level was wider than the one below it, corresponding to the narrowing of the Temple wall as it rose higher. A stairway led up from the bottom level through the middle level to the top level.
verses.textEnNasb: And the side chambers surrounding the temple were wider at each successive story. Because the structure surrounding the temple went upward by stages on all sides of the temple, for that reason the width of the temple increased as it went higher; and so one went up from the lowest story to the highest by way of the second story.
verses.textEn: The side rooms all around the temple were wider at each successive level. The structure surrounding the temple was built in ascending stages, so that the rooms widened as one went upward. A stairway went up from the lowest floor to the top floor through the middle floor.

verses.textZh: 我又看见一个高台围绕着殿，作为厢房的根基，台高三公尺。910厢房的外墙厚两公尺半；圣殿的厢房与祭司的房子之间有空地，绕着殿的四周，宽十公尺。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我又看见一个高台围绕着殿，作为厢房的根基，台高三公尺。910厢房的外墙厚两公尺半；圣殿的厢房与祭司的房子之间有空地，绕着殿的四周，宽十公尺。
verses.textZhCuv: 我又见围着殿有高月台。旁屋的根基，高足一竿，就是六大肘。
verses.textEnNiv: I saw that the temple had a raised base all around it, forming the foundation of the side rooms. It was the length of the rod, six long cubits.
verses.textEnEsv: I saw also that the temple had a raised platform all around; the foundations of the side chambers measured a full reed of six long cubits.
verses.textEnNkjv: I also saw an elevation all around the temple; it was the foundation of the side chambers, a full rod, thatis, six cubits high.
verses.textEnNlt: I saw that the Temple was built on a terrace, which provided a foundation for the side rooms. This terrace was 10-1/2 feet high.
verses.textEnNasb: I saw also that the house had a raised platform all around; the foundations of the side chambers were a full rod of six long cubits in height.
verses.textEn: I saw that the temple had a raised base all around it, forming the foundation of the side rooms. It was the length of the rod, six long cubits.

verses.textZh: 厢房有门通向空地，一门向北，一门向南。厢房与空地之间相隔两公尺半，周围都是一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 厢房有门通向空地，一门向北，一门向南。厢房与空地之间相隔两公尺半，周围都是一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 旁屋的外墙厚五肘。旁屋之外还有余地。
verses.textEnNiv: The outer wall of the side rooms was five cubits thick. The open area between the side rooms of the temple
verses.textEnEsv: The thickness of the outer wall of the side chambers was five cubits. The free space between the side chambers of the temple
verses.textEnNkjv: The thickness of the outer wall of the side chambers was five cubits, and so also the remaining terrace by the place of the side chambers of the temple.
verses.textEnNlt: The outer wall of the Temple’s side rooms was 8-3/4 feet thick. This left an open area between these side rooms
verses.textEnNasb: The thickness of the outer wall of the side chambers was five cubits. But the free space between the side chambers belonging to the temple
verses.textEn: The outer wall of the side rooms was five cubits thick. The open area between the side rooms of the temple

verses.textZh: 在西边有一座朝向殿院空地的房子，深三十五公尺，长四十五公尺；屋子四周的墙厚两公尺半。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在西边有一座朝向殿院空地的房子，深三十五公尺，长四十五公尺；屋子四周的墙厚两公尺半。
verses.textZhCuv: 在旁屋与对面的房屋中间有空地，宽二十肘。
verses.textEnNiv: and the priests’ rooms was twenty cubits wide all around the temple.
verses.textEnEsv: and the other chambers was a breadth of twenty cubits all around the temple on every side.
verses.textEnNkjv: And between itand the wall chambers was a width of twenty cubits all around the temple on every side.
verses.textEnNlt: and the row of rooms along the outer wall of the inner courtyard. This open area was 35 feet wide, and it went all the way around the Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: and the outer chambers was twenty cubits in width around the temple on every side.
verses.textEn: and the priests’ rooms was twenty cubits wide all around the temple.

verses.textZh: 他量了圣殿，长五十公尺；又量了殿院的空地，那屋子和它的墙，共长五十公尺。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他量了圣殿，长五十公尺；又量了殿院的空地，那屋子和它的墙，共长五十公尺。
verses.textZhCuv: 旁屋的门都向余地：一门向北，一门向南。周围的余地宽五肘。
verses.textEnNiv: There were entrances to the side rooms from the open area, one on the north and another on the south; and the base adjoining the open area was five cubits wide all around.
verses.textEnEsv: And the doors of the side chambers opened on the free space, one door toward the north, and another door toward the south. And the breadth of the free space was five cubits all around.
verses.textEnNkjv: The doors of the side chambers opened on the terrace, one door toward the north and another toward the south; and the width of the terrace was five cubits all around.
verses.textEnNlt: Two doors opened from the side rooms into the terrace yard, which was 8-3/4 feet wide. One door faced north and the other south.
verses.textEnNasb: The doorways of the side chambers toward the free space consisted of one doorway toward the north, and another doorway toward the south; and the width of the free space was five cubits all around.
verses.textEn: There were entrances to the side rooms from the open area, one on the north and another on the south; and the base adjoining the open area was five cubits wide all around.

verses.textZh: 在东面，圣殿前面的空地，宽五十公尺。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在东面，圣殿前面的空地，宽五十公尺。
verses.textZhCuv: 在西面空地之后有房子，宽七十肘，长九十肘，墙四围厚五肘。
verses.textEnNiv: The building facing the temple courtyard on the west side was seventy cubits wide. The wall of the building was five cubits thick all around, and its length was ninety cubits.
verses.textEnEsv: The building that was facing the separate yard on the west side was seventy cubits broad, and the wall of the building was five cubits thick all around, and its length ninety cubits.
verses.textEnNkjv: The building that faced the separating courtyard at its western end was seventy cubits wide; the wall of the building was five cubits thick all around, and its length ninety cubits.
verses.textEnNlt: A large building stood on the west, facing the Temple courtyard. It was 122-1/2 feet wide and 157-1/2 feet long, and its walls were 8-3/4 feet thick.
verses.textEnNasb: The building that was in front of the separate area at the side toward the west was seventy cubits wide; and the wall of the building was five cubits thick all around, and its length was ninety cubits.
verses.textEn: The building facing the temple courtyard on the west side was seventy cubits wide. The wall of the building was five cubits thick all around, and its length was ninety cubits.

verses.textZh: 他量了殿院空地后面的屋子，连同屋子两边的走廊，共长五十公尺。外殿、内殿、朝向内院的门廊、
verses.textZhCnvs: 他量了殿院空地后面的屋子，连同屋子两边的走廊，共长五十公尺。外殿、内殿、朝向内院的门廊、
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，他量殿，长一百肘，又量空地和那房子并墙，共长一百肘。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he measured the temple; it was a hundred cubits long, and the temple courtyard and the building with its walls were also a hundred cubits long.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he measured the temple, a hundred cubits long; and the yard and the building with its walls, a hundred cubits long;
verses.textEnNkjv: So he measured the temple, one hundred cubits long; and the separating courtyard with the building and its walls was one hundred cubits long;
verses.textEnNlt: Then the man measured the Temple, and it was 175 feet long. The courtyard around the building, including its walls, was an additional 175 feet in length.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he measured the temple, a hundred cubits long; the separate area with the building and its walls were also a hundred cubits long.
verses.textEn: Then he measured the temple; it was a hundred cubits long, and the temple courtyard and the building with its walls were also a hundred cubits long.

verses.textZh: 门槛、小窗和对着门槛的三层走廊，周围都镶上木板，从地面直到窗口。窗户都是遮蔽的；
verses.textZhCnvs: 门槛、小窗和对着门槛的三层走廊，周围都镶上木板，从地面直到窗口。窗户都是遮蔽的；
verses.textZhCuv: 殿的前面和两旁的空地，宽一百肘。
verses.textEnNiv: The width of the temple courtyard on the east, including the front of the temple, was a hundred cubits.
verses.textEnEsv: also the breadth of the east front of the temple and the yard, a hundred cubits.
verses.textEnNkjv: also the width of the eastern face of the temple, including the separating courtyard, was one hundred cubits.
verses.textEnNlt: The inner courtyard to the east of the Temple was also 175 feet wide.
verses.textEnNasb: Also the width of the front of the temple and that of the separate areas along the east side totaled a hundred cubits.
verses.textEn: The width of the temple courtyard on the east, including the front of the temple, was a hundred cubits.

verses.textZh: 在内殿门口上面的外墙，以及内殿和外殿周围的墙上，按着尺寸，
verses.textZhCnvs: 在内殿门口上面的外墙，以及内殿和外殿周围的墙上，按着尺寸，
verses.textZhCuv: 他量空地后面的那房子，并两旁的楼廊，共长一百肘。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he measured the length of the building facing the courtyard at the rear of the temple, including its galleries on each side; it was a hundred cubits. The main hall, the inner sanctuary and the portico facing the court,
verses.textEnEsv: Then he measured the length of the building facing the yard that was at the back and its galleries on either side, a hundred cubits. The inside of the nave and the vestibules of the court,
verses.textEnNkjv: He measured the length of the building behind it, facing the separating courtyard, with its galleries on the one side and on the other side, one hundred cubits, as well as the inner temple and the porches of the court,
verses.textEnNlt: The building to the west, including its two walls, was also 175 feet wide. The sanctuary, the inner room, and the entry room of the Temple
verses.textEnNasb: And he measured the length of the building along the front of the separate area behind it, with a gallery on each side, a hundred cubits; he also measured the inner sanctuary and the porches of the courtyard.
verses.textEn: Then he measured the length of the building facing the courtyard at the rear of the temple, including its galleries on each side; it was a hundred cubits. The main hall, the inner sanctuary and the portico facing the court,

verses.textZh: 都刻上基路伯和棕树。基路伯和棕树相间并排，每个基路伯都有两个脸孔。
verses.textZhCnvs: 都刻上基路伯和棕树。基路伯和棕树相间并排，每个基路伯都有两个脸孔。
verses.textZhCuv: 内殿、院廊、门槛、严紧的窗棂，并对着门槛的三层楼廊，从地到窗棂（窗棂都有蔽子），
verses.textEnNiv: as well as the thresholds and the narrow windows and galleries around the three of them—everything beyond and including the threshold was covered with wood. The floor, the wall up to the windows, and the windows were covered.
verses.textEnEsv: the thresholds and the narrow windows and the galleries all around the three of them, opposite the threshold, were paneled with wood all around, from the floor up to the windows (now the windows were covered),
verses.textEnNkjv: their doorposts and the beveled window frames. And the galleries all around their three stories opposite the threshold were paneled with wood from the ground to the windows—the windows were covered—
verses.textEnNlt: were all paneled with wood, as were the frames of the recessed windows. The inner walls of the Temple were paneled with wood above and below the windows.
verses.textEnNasb: The thresholds, the latticed windows, and the galleries all around their three stories, opposite the threshold, were paneled with wood all around, and from the ground to the windows (but the windows were covered),
verses.textEn: as well as the thresholds and the narrow windows and galleries around the three of them—everything beyond and including the threshold was covered with wood. The floor, the wall up to the windows, and the windows were covered.

verses.textZh: 这边有人的脸向着棕树，那边有狮子的脸向着棕树。全殿周围的雕刻都是这样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这边有人的脸向着棕树，那边有狮子的脸向着棕树。全殿周围的雕刻都是这样。
verses.textZhCuv: 直到门以上，就是到内殿和外殿内外四围墙壁，都按尺寸用木板遮蔽。
verses.textEnNiv: In the space above the outside of the entrance to the inner sanctuary and on the walls at regular intervals all around the inner and outer sanctuary
verses.textEnEsv: to the space above the door, even to the inner room, and on the outside. And on all the walls all around, inside and outside, was a measured pattern.
verses.textEnNkjv: from the space above the door, even to the inner room, as well as outside, and on every wall all around, inside and outside, by measure.
verses.textEnNlt: The space above the door leading into the inner room, and its walls inside and out, were also paneled.
verses.textEnNasb: over the entrance, and to the inner house, and on the outside, and on all the wall all around inside and outside, by measurement.
verses.textEn: In the space above the outside of the entrance to the inner sanctuary and on the walls at regular intervals all around the inner and outer sanctuary

verses.textZh: 外殿的墙，从地面直到门口上面，都刻有基路伯和棕树。
verses.textZhCnvs: 外殿的墙，从地面直到门口上面，都刻有基路伯和棕树。
verses.textZhCuv: 墙上雕刻基路伯和棕树。每二基路伯中间有一棵棕树，每基路伯有二脸。
verses.textEnNiv: were carved cherubim and palm trees. Palm trees alternated with cherubim. Each cherub had two faces:
verses.textEnEsv: It was carved of cherubim and palm trees, a palm tree between cherub and cherub. Every cherub had two faces:
verses.textEnNkjv: And itwas made with cherubim and palm trees, a palm tree between cherub and cherub. Each cherub had two faces,
verses.textEnNlt: All the walls were decorated with carvings of cherubim, each with two faces, and there was a carving of a palm tree between each of the cherubim.
verses.textEnNasb: It was carved with cherubim and palm trees; and a palm tree was between cherub and cherub, and every cherub had two faces:
verses.textEn: were carved cherubim and palm trees. Palm trees alternated with cherubim. Each cherub had two faces:

verses.textZh: 外殿的门框是正方形的；在至圣所前面的门框，也是一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 外殿的门框是正方形的；在至圣所前面的门框，也是一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 这边有人脸向着棕树，那边有狮子脸向着棕树，殿内周围都是如此。
verses.textEnNiv: the face of a human being toward the palm tree on one side and the face of a lion toward the palm tree on the other. They were carved all around the whole temple.
verses.textEnEsv: a human face toward the palm tree on the one side, and the face of a young lion toward the palm tree on the other side. They were carved on the whole temple all around.
verses.textEnNkjv: so that the face of a man was toward a palm tree on one side, and the face of a young lion toward a palm tree on the other side; thus itwas made throughout the temple all around.
verses.textEnNlt: One face—that of a man—looked toward the palm tree on one side. The other face—that of a young lion—looked toward the palm tree on the other side. The figures were carved all along the inside of the Temple,
verses.textEnNasb: a human face toward the palm tree on one side and a young lion’s face toward the palm tree on the other side; they were carved on all the house all around.
verses.textEn: the face of a human being toward the palm tree on one side and the face of a lion toward the palm tree on the other. They were carved all around the whole temple.

verses.textZh: 祭坛是木做的，高一公尺半，长一公尺；坛角 和坛的四边，全都是木做的。他对我说："这是摆在耶和华面前的桌子。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭坛是木做的，高一公尺半，长一公尺；坛角 和坛的四边，全都是木做的。他对我说："这是摆在耶和华面前的桌子。"
verses.textZhCuv: 从地至门以上，都有基路伯和棕树。殿墙就是这样。
verses.textEnNiv: From the floor to the area above the entrance, cherubim and palm trees were carved on the wall of the main hall.
verses.textEnEsv: From the floor to above the door, cherubim and palm trees were carved; similarly the wall of the nave.
verses.textEnNkjv: From the floor to the space above the door, and on the wall of the sanctuary, cherubim and palm trees were carved.
verses.textEnNlt: from the floor to the top of the walls, including the outer wall of the sanctuary.
verses.textEnNasb: From the ground to above the entrance cherubim and palm trees were carved, as well as on the wall of the sanctuary.
verses.textEn: From the floor to the area above the entrance, cherubim and palm trees were carved on the wall of the main hall.

verses.textZh: 外殿和至圣所各有一个门。
verses.textZhCnvs: 外殿和至圣所各有一个门。
verses.textZhCuv: 殿的门柱是方的。至圣所的前面，形状和殿的形状一样。
verses.textEnNiv: The main hall had a rectangular doorframe, and the one at the front of the Most Holy Place was similar.
verses.textEnEsv: The doorposts of the nave were squared, and in front of the Holy Place was something resembling
verses.textEnNkjv: The doorposts of the temple were square, aswas the front of the sanctuary; their appearance was similar.
verses.textEnNlt: There were square columns at the entrance to the sanctuary, and the ones at the entrance of the Most Holy Place were similar.
verses.textEnNasb: The doorposts of the sanctuary were square; as for the front of the inner sanctuary, the appearance of one doorpost was like that of the other.
verses.textEn: The main hall had a rectangular doorframe, and the one at the front of the Most Holy Place was similar.

verses.textZh: 每个门分两扇，每扇门分为两页，可以折叠。
verses.textZhCnvs: 每个门分两扇，每扇门分为两页，可以折叠。
verses.textZhCuv: 坛是木头做的，高三肘，长二肘。坛角和坛面，并四旁，都是木头做的。他对我说：「这是耶和华面前的桌子。」
verses.textEnNiv: There was a wooden altar three cubits high and two cubits square ; its corners, its base and its sides were of wood. The man said to me, "This is the table that is before the Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: an altar of wood, three cubits high, two cubits long, and two cubits broad. Its corners, its base, and its walls were of wood. He said to me, "This is the table that is before the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: The altar was of wood, three cubits high, and its length two cubits. Its corners, its length, and its sides were of wood; and he said to me, "This is the table that is before the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: There was an altar made of wood, 5-1/4 feet high and 3-1/2 feet across. Its corners, base, and sides were all made of wood. "This," the man told me, "is the table that stands in the Lord ’s presence."
verses.textEnNasb: The altar was of wood, three cubits high, and its length two cubits; its corners, its base, and its sides were of wood. And he said to me, "This is the table that is before the Lord."
verses.textEn: There was a wooden altar three cubits high and two cubits square ; its corners, its base and its sides were of wood. The man said to me, "This is the table that is before the Lord ."

verses.textZh: 在外殿的门扇上，刻有基路伯和棕树，像那些刻在墙上的一样；在外边门廊前面，有木做的飞檐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在外殿的门扇上，刻有基路伯和棕树，像那些刻在墙上的一样；在外边门廊前面，有木做的飞檐。
verses.textZhCuv: 殿和至圣所的门各有两扇。
verses.textEnNiv: Both the main hall and the Most Holy Place had double doors.
verses.textEnEsv: The nave and the Holy Place had each a double door.
verses.textEnNkjv: The temple and the sanctuary had two doors.
verses.textEnNlt: Both the sanctuary and the Most Holy Place had double doorways,
verses.textEnNasb: The sanctuary and the inner sanctuary each had a double door.
verses.textEn: Both the main hall and the Most Holy Place had double doors.

verses.textZh: 门廊两边都有小窗和棕树。殿的厢房也有飞檐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 门廊两边都有小窗和棕树。殿的厢房也有飞檐。
verses.textZhCuv: 每扇分两扇，这两扇是折叠的。这边门分两扇，那边门也分两扇。
verses.textEnNiv: Each door had two leaves—two hinged leaves for each door.
verses.textEnEsv: The double doors had two leaves apiece, two swinging leaves for each door.
verses.textEnNkjv: The doors had two panels apiece, two folding panels: two panels for one door and two panels for the other door.
verses.textEnNlt: each with two swinging doors.
verses.textEnNasb: Each of the doors had two leaves, two swinging leaves; two leaves for one door and two leaves for the other.
verses.textEn: Each door had two leaves—two hinged leaves for each door.

verses.textZh: 殿的门扇上雕刻基路伯和棕树，与刻在墙上的一般。在外头廊前有木槛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 殿的门扇上雕刻基路伯和棕树，与刻在墙上的一般。在外头廊前有木槛。
verses.textZhCuv: 殿的门扇上雕刻基路伯和棕树，与刻在墙上的一般。在外头廊前有木槛。
verses.textEnNiv: And on the doors of the main hall were carved cherubim and palm trees like those carved on the walls, and there was a wooden overhang on the front of the portico.
verses.textEnEsv: And on the doors of the nave were carved cherubim and palm trees, such as were carved on the walls. And there was a canopy of wood in front of the vestibule outside.
verses.textEnNkjv: Cherubim and palm trees were carved on the doors of the temple just as they were carved on the walls. A wooden canopy was on the front of the vestibule outside.
verses.textEnNlt: The doors leading into the sanctuary were decorated with carved cherubim and palm trees, just as on the walls. And there was a wooden roof at the front of the entry room to the Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: Also there were carved on them, on the doors of the main room, cherubim and palm trees like those carved on the walls; and there was a threshold of wood on the front of the porch outside.
verses.textEn: And on the doors of the main hall were carved cherubim and palm trees like those carved on the walls, and there was a wooden overhang on the front of the portico.

verses.textZh: 廊这边那边都有严紧的窗棂和棕树；殿的旁屋和槛就是这样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 廊这边那边都有严紧的窗棂和棕树；殿的旁屋和槛就是这样。
verses.textZhCuv: 廊这边那边都有严紧的窗棂和棕树；殿的旁屋和槛就是这样。
verses.textEnNiv: On the sidewalls of the portico were narrow windows with palm trees carved on each side. The side rooms of the temple also had overhangs.
verses.textEnEsv: And there were narrow windows and palm trees on either side, on the sidewalls of the vestibule, the side chambers of the temple, and the canopies.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therewere beveled window frames and palm trees on one side and on the other, on the sides of the vestibule—also on the side chambers of the temple and on the canopies.
verses.textEnNlt: On both sides of the entry room were recessed windows decorated with carved palm trees. The side rooms along the outside wall also had roofs.
verses.textEnNasb: And there were latticed windows and palm trees on one side and on the other, on the sides of the porch; the same were on the side chambers of the house and the thresholds.
verses.textEn: On the sidewalls of the portico were narrow windows with palm trees carved on each side. The side rooms of the temple also had overhangs.

verses.textZh: 他领我出来，向着北面的外院去；带我到了祭司的房子。这些房子一排对着殿院的空地，一排对着北面的建筑物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他领我出来，向着北面的外院去；带我到了祭司的房子。这些房子一排对着殿院的空地，一排对着北面的建筑物。
verses.textZhCuv: 他带我出来向北，到外院，又带我进入圣屋；这圣屋一排顺着空地，一排与北边铺石地之屋相对。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the man led me northward into the outer court and brought me to the rooms opposite the temple courtyard and opposite the outer wall on the north side.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he led me out into the outer court, toward the north, and he brought me to the chambers that were opposite the separate yard and opposite the building on the north.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he brought me out into the outer court, by the way toward the north; and he brought me into the chamber which was opposite the separating courtyard, and which was opposite the building toward the north.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the man led me out of the Temple courtyard by way of the north gateway. We entered the outer courtyard and came to a group of rooms against the north wall of the inner courtyard.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he brought me out into the outer courtyard, the way toward the north; and he brought me to the chamber which was opposite the separate area and opposite the building toward the north.
verses.textEn: Then the man led me northward into the outer court and brought me to the rooms opposite the temple courtyard and opposite the outer wall on the north side.

verses.textZh: 房子共长五十公尺，宽二十五公尺，有朝北的门。
verses.textZhCnvs: 房子共长五十公尺，宽二十五公尺，有朝北的门。
verses.textZhCuv: 这圣屋长一百肘，宽五十肘，有向北的门。
verses.textEnNiv: The building whose door faced north was a hundred cubits long and fifty cubits wide.
verses.textEnEsv: The length of the building whose door faced north was a hundred cubits, and the breadth fifty cubits.
verses.textEnNkjv: Facing the length, whichwas one hundred cubits (the width was fifty cubits), was the north door.
verses.textEnNlt: This structure, whose entrance opened toward the north, was 175 feet long and 87-1/2 feet wide.
verses.textEnNasb: Along the length, which was a hundred cubits, was the north door; the width was fifty cubits.
verses.textEn: The building whose door faced north was a hundred cubits long and fifty cubits wide.

verses.textZh: 这些房子一排对着内院十公尺宽的空地，一排对着外院的铺石地，在三层楼上，都有走廊对着走廊。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些房子一排对着内院十公尺宽的空地，一排对着外院的铺石地，在三层楼上，都有走廊对着走廊。
verses.textZhCuv: 对着内院那二十肘宽之空地，又对着外院的铺石地，在第三层楼上有楼廊对着楼廊。
verses.textEnNiv: Both in the section twenty cubits from the inner court and in the section opposite the pavement of the outer court, gallery faced gallery at the three levels.
verses.textEnEsv: Facing the twenty cubits that belonged to the inner court, and facing the pavement that belonged to the outer court, was gallery against gallery in three stories.
verses.textEnNkjv: Opposite the inner court of twenty cubits, and opposite the pavement of the outer court, was gallery against gallery in three stories.
verses.textEnNlt: One block of rooms overlooked the 35-foot width of the inner courtyard. Another block of rooms looked out onto the pavement of the outer courtyard. The two blocks were built three levels high and stood across from each other.
verses.textEnNasb: Opposite the twenty cubits which belonged to the inner courtyard, and opposite the stone pavement which belonged to the outer courtyard, was gallery corresponding to gallery in three stories.
verses.textEn: Both in the section twenty cubits from the inner court and in the section opposite the pavement of the outer court, gallery faced gallery at the three levels.

verses.textZh: 房子前面有一条夹道，宽五公尺，长五十公尺。房子的门都朝向北面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 房子前面有一条夹道，宽五公尺，长五十公尺。房子的门都朝向北面。
verses.textZhCuv: 在圣屋前有一条夹道，宽十肘，长一百肘。房门都向北。
verses.textEnNiv: In front of the rooms was an inner passageway ten cubits wide and a hundred cubits long. Their doors were on the north.
verses.textEnEsv: And before the chambers was a passage inward, ten cubits wide and a hundred cubits long, and their doors were on the north.
verses.textEnNkjv: In front of the chambers, toward the inside, was a walk ten cubits wide, at a distance of one cubit; and their doors faced north.
verses.textEnNlt: Between the two blocks of rooms ran a walkway 17-1/2 feet wide. It extended the entire 175 feet of the complex, and all the doors faced north.
verses.textEnNasb: In front of the chambers was an inner passage ten cubits wide, a way of one hundred cubits; and their openings were on the north.
verses.textEn: In front of the rooms was an inner passageway ten cubits wide and a hundred cubits long. Their doors were on the north.

verses.textZh: 上层的房子最窄，因为上层的走廊所占的地方，比下层和中层的为多。
verses.textZhCnvs: 上层的房子最窄，因为上层的走廊所占的地方，比下层和中层的为多。
verses.textZhCuv: 圣屋因为楼廊占去些地方，所以上层比中下两层窄些。
verses.textEnNiv: Now the upper rooms were narrower, for the galleries took more space from them than from the rooms on the lower and middle floors of the building.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the upper chambers were narrower, for the galleries took more away from them than from the lower and middle chambers of the building.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the upper chambers were shorter, because the galleries took away space from them more than from the lower and middle stories of the building.
verses.textEnNlt: Each of the two upper levels of rooms was narrower than the one beneath it because the upper levels had to allow space for walkways in front of them.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the upper chambers were smaller because the galleries took more space away from them than from the lower and middle ones in the building.
verses.textEn: Now the upper rooms were narrower, for the galleries took more space from them than from the rooms on the lower and middle floors of the building.

verses.textZh: 第三层房子没有柱子，不像外院的房子有柱子。因此，上层比下层和中层较窄。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第三层房子没有柱子，不像外院的房子有柱子。因此，上层比下层和中层较窄。
verses.textZhCuv: 圣屋有三层，却无柱子，不像外院的屋子有柱子；所以上层比中下两层更窄。
verses.textEnNiv: The rooms on the top floor had no pillars, as the courts had; so they were smaller in floor space than those on the lower and middle floors.
verses.textEnEsv: For they were in three stories, and they had no pillars like the pillars of the courts. Thus the upper chambers were set back from the ground more than the lower and the middle ones.
verses.textEnNkjv: For they were in three stories and did not have pillars like the pillars of the courts; therefore theupperlevel was shortened more than the lower and middle levels from the ground up.
verses.textEnNlt: Since there were three levels and they did not have supporting columns as in the courtyards, each of the upper levels was set back from the level beneath it.
verses.textEnNasb: For they were in three stories and had no pillars like the pillars of the courtyards; for that reason the upper chambers were set back from the ground upward, more than the lower and middle ones.
verses.textEn: The rooms on the top floor had no pillars, as the courts had; so they were smaller in floor space than those on the lower and middle floors.

verses.textZh: 在外面有一道墙，在房子的前面，与房子和外院平行，长二十五公尺。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在外面有一道墙，在房子的前面，与房子和外院平行，长二十五公尺。
verses.textZhCuv: 圣屋外，东边有墙，靠着外院，长五十肘。
verses.textEnNiv: There was an outer wall parallel to the rooms and the outer court; it extended in front of the rooms for fifty cubits.
verses.textEnEsv: And there was a wall outside parallel to the chambers, toward the outer court, opposite the chambers, fifty cubits long.
verses.textEnNkjv: And a wall which was outside ran parallel to the chambers, at the front of the chambers, toward the outer court; its length was fifty cubits.
verses.textEnNlt: There was an outer wall that separated the rooms from the outer courtyard; it was 87-1/2 feet long.
verses.textEnNasb: As for the outer wall by the side of the chambers, toward the outer courtyard facing the chambers, its length was fifty cubits.
verses.textEn: There was an outer wall parallel to the rooms and the outer court; it extended in front of the rooms for fifty cubits.

verses.textZh: 朝着外院的房子，长二十五公尺；朝着圣殿的房子，长五十公尺。
verses.textZhCnvs: 朝着外院的房子，长二十五公尺；朝着圣殿的房子，长五十公尺。
verses.textZhCuv: 靠着外院的圣屋长五十肘。殿北面的圣屋长一百肘。
verses.textEnNiv: While the row of rooms on the side next to the outer court was fifty cubits long, the row on the side nearest the sanctuary was a hundred cubits long.
verses.textEnEsv: For the chambers on the outer court were fifty cubits long, while those opposite the nave were a hundred cubits long.
verses.textEnNkjv: The length of the chambers toward the outer court was fifty cubits, whereas that facing the temple was one hundred cubits.
verses.textEnNlt: This wall added length to the outer block of rooms, which extended for only 87-1/2 feet, while the inner block—the rooms toward the Temple—extended for 175 feet.
verses.textEnNasb: For the length of the chambers which were in the outer courtyard was fifty cubits; and behold, the length of those facing the main room was a hundred cubits.
verses.textEn: While the row of rooms on the side next to the outer court was fifty cubits long, the row on the side nearest the sanctuary was a hundred cubits long.

verses.textZh: 下层的房子在东面有一个入口，人从外院进入房子里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 下层的房子在东面有一个入口，人从外院进入房子里。
verses.textZhCuv: 在圣屋以下，东头有进入之处，就是从外院进入之处。
verses.textEnNiv: The lower rooms had an entrance on the east side as one enters them from the outer court.
verses.textEnEsv: Below these chambers was an entrance on the east side, as one enters them from the outer court.
verses.textEnNkjv: At the lower chambers was the entrance on the east side, as one goes into them from the outer court.
verses.textEnNlt: There was an eastern entrance from the outer courtyard to these rooms.
verses.textEnNasb: And below these chambers was the entrance on the east side, as one enters them from the outer courtyard.
verses.textEn: The lower rooms had an entrance on the east side as one enters them from the outer court.

verses.textZh: 在南面 ，沿着内院的墙也有房子，一排对着殿院的空地，一排对着南面的建筑物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在南面 ，沿着内院的墙也有房子，一排对着殿院的空地，一排对着南面的建筑物。
verses.textZhCuv: 向南 在内院墙里有圣屋，一排与铺石地之屋相对，一排顺着空地。
verses.textEnNiv: On the south side along the length of the wall of the outer court, adjoining the temple courtyard and opposite the outer wall, were rooms
verses.textEnEsv: In the thickness of the wall of the court, on the south also, opposite the yard and opposite the building, there were chambers
verses.textEnNkjv: Also therewere chambers in the thickness of the wall of the court toward the east, opposite the separating courtyard and opposite the building.
verses.textEnNlt: On the south side of the Temple there were two blocks of rooms just south of the inner courtyard between the Temple and the outer courtyard. These rooms were arranged just like the rooms on the north.
verses.textEnNasb: In the thickness of the wall of the courtyard toward the east, facing the separate area and facing the building, there were chambers.
verses.textEn: On the south side along the length of the wall of the outer court, adjoining the temple courtyard and opposite the outer wall, were rooms

verses.textZh: 这些房子前面有一条夹道，跟北面的一样，长宽相同。出口之处，也与北面的一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些房子前面有一条夹道，跟北面的一样，长宽相同。出口之处，也与北面的一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 这圣屋前的夹道与北边圣屋的夹道长宽一样；出入之处与北屋门的样式相同。
verses.textEnNiv: with a passageway in front of them. These were like the rooms on the north; they had the same length and width, with similar exits and dimensions. Similar to the doorways on the north
verses.textEnEsv: with a passage in front of them. They were similar to the chambers on the north, of the same length and breadth, with the same exits and arrangements and doors,
verses.textEnNkjv: Therewas a walk in front of them also, and their appearance was like the chambers which were toward the north; they were as long and as wide as the others, and all their exits and entrances were according to plan.
verses.textEnNlt: There was a walkway between the two blocks of rooms just like the complex on the north side of the Temple. This complex of rooms was the same length and width as the other one, and it had the same entrances and doors. The dimensions of each were identical.
verses.textEnNasb: And the way in front of them was like the appearance of the chambers which were on the north; according to their length, so was their width, and all their exits were according to their building plans and openings.
verses.textEn: with a passageway in front of them. These were like the rooms on the north; they had the same length and width, with similar exits and dimensions. Similar to the doorways on the north

verses.textZh: 南边的房子的门，也与北面的一样。在东面夹道的开端，与墙相对的地方，有门可以进入。
