verses.textZhCnvs: 南边的房子的门，也与北面的一样。在东面夹道的开端，与墙相对的地方，有门可以进入。
verses.textZhCuv: 正在墙前、夹道的东头，有门可以进入，与向南圣屋的门一样。
verses.textEnNiv: were the doorways of the rooms on the south. There was a doorway at the beginning of the passageway that was parallel to the corresponding wall extending eastward, by which one enters the rooms.
verses.textEnEsv: as were the entrances of the chambers on the south. There was an entrance at the beginning of the passage, the passage before the corresponding wall on the east as one enters them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And corresponding to the doors of the chambers that were facing south, as one enters them, therewas a door in front of the walk, the way directly in front of the wall toward the east.
verses.textEnNlt: So there was an entrance in the wall facing the doors of the inner block of rooms, and another on the east at the end of the interior walkway.
verses.textEnNasb: Corresponding to the openings of the chambers which were toward the south was an opening at the head of the way, the way in front of the wall toward the east, as one enters them.
verses.textEn: were the doorways of the rooms on the south. There was a doorway at the beginning of the passageway that was parallel to the corresponding wall extending eastward, by which one enters the rooms.

verses.textZh: 他对我说："在南北两面，朝着殿院空地的房子，都是圣洁的房子；亲近耶和华的祭司们要在那里吃至圣之物，也要在那里存放至圣之物，就是素祭、赎罪祭和赎愆祭的祭物，因为那地方是圣的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他对我说："在南北两面，朝着殿院空地的房子，都是圣洁的房子；亲近耶和华的祭司们要在那里吃至圣之物，也要在那里存放至圣之物，就是素祭、赎罪祭和赎愆祭的祭物，因为那地方是圣的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他对我说：「顺着空地的南屋北屋，都是圣屋；亲近耶和华的祭司当在那里吃至圣的物，也当在那里放至圣的物，就是素祭、赎罪祭，和赎愆祭，因此处为圣。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he said to me, "The north and south rooms facing the temple courtyard are the priests’ rooms, where the priests who approach the Lord will eat the most holy offerings. There they will put the most holy offerings—the grain offerings, the sin offerings and the guilt offerings—for the place is holy.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he said to me, "The north chambers and the south chambers opposite the yard are the holy chambers, where the priests who approach the Lord shall eat the most holy offerings. There they shall put the most holy offerings— the grain offering, the sin offering, and the guilt offering—for the place is holy.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said to me, "The north chambers and the south chambers, which are opposite the separating courtyard, are the holy chambers where the priests who approach the Lord shall eat the most holy offerings. There they shall lay the most holy offerings— the grain offering, the sin offering, and the trespass offering—for the place is holy.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the man told me, "These rooms that overlook the Temple from the north and south are holy. Here the priests who offer sacrifices to the Lord will eat the most holy offerings. And because these rooms are holy, they will be used to store the sacred offerings—the grain offerings, sin offerings, and guilt offerings.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said to me, "The north chambers and the south chambers, which are opposite the separate area, they are the holy chambers where the priests who are near to the Lord shall eat the most holy things. There they shall set the most holy things, the grain offering, the sin offering, and the guilt offering; for the place is holy.
verses.textEn: Then he said to me, "The north and south rooms facing the temple courtyard are the priests’ rooms, where the priests who approach the Lord will eat the most holy offerings. There they will put the most holy offerings—the grain offerings, the sin offerings and the guilt offerings—for the place is holy.

verses.textZh: 祭司进了去，不可从圣所出来到外院去；他们要在房子里放下供职时所穿的衣服，因为那些衣服是圣的；他们要穿上别的衣服，才可以到民众的地方。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司进了去，不可从圣所出来到外院去；他们要在房子里放下供职时所穿的衣服，因为那些衣服是圣的；他们要穿上别的衣服，才可以到民众的地方。"
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司进去出了圣所的时候，不可直到外院，但要在圣屋放下他们供职的衣服，因为是圣衣；要穿上别的衣服才可以到属民的外院。」
verses.textEnNiv: Once the priests enter the holy precincts, they are not to go into the outer court until they leave behind the garments in which they minister, for these are holy. They are to put on other clothes before they go near the places that are for the people."
verses.textEnEsv: When the priests enter the Holy Place, they shall not go out of it into the outer court without laying there the garments in which they minister, for these are holy. They shall put on other garments before they go near to that which is for the people."
verses.textEnNkjv: When the priests enter them, they shall not go out of the holy chamber into the outer court; but there they shall leave their garments in which they minister, for they are holy. They shall put on other garments; then they may approach that which is for the people."
verses.textEnNlt: When the priests leave the sanctuary, they must not go directly to the outer courtyard. They must first take off the clothes they wore while ministering, because these clothes are holy. They must put on other clothes before entering the parts of the building complex open to the public."
verses.textEnNasb: When the priests enter, they shall not go out into the outer courtyard from the sanctuary without laying their garments there in which they minister, for they are holy. They shall put on other garments; then they shall approach that which is for the people."
verses.textEn: Once the priests enter the holy precincts, they are not to go into the outer court until they leave behind the garments in which they minister, for these are holy. They are to put on other clothes before they go near the places that are for the people."

verses.textZh: 他量了内院，就领我出朝东的门，又量了整个殿的周围。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他量了内院，就领我出朝东的门，又量了整个殿的周围。
verses.textZhCuv: 他量完了内殿，就带我出朝东的门，量院的四围。
verses.textEnNiv: When he had finished measuring what was inside the temple area, he led me out by the east gate and measured the area all around:
verses.textEnEsv: Now when he had finished measuring the interior of the temple area, he led me out by the gate that faced east, and measured the temple area all around.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when he had finished measuring the inner temple, he brought me out through the gateway that faces toward the east, and measured it all around.
verses.textEnNlt: When the man had finished measuring the inside of the Temple area, he led me out through the east gateway to measure the entire perimeter.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when he had finished measuring the inner house, he brought me out by way of the gate which faced east, and measured it all around.
verses.textEn: When he had finished measuring what was inside the temple area, he led me out by the east gate and measured the area all around:

verses.textZh: 他用测量竿量了东面，按着测量竿计算，共长二百五十公尺。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他用测量竿量了东面，按着测量竿计算，共长二百五十公尺。
verses.textZhCuv: 他用量度的竿量四围，量东面五百肘 ，
verses.textEnNiv: He measured the east side with the measuring rod; it was five hundred cubits.
verses.textEnEsv: He measured the east side with the measuring reed, 500 cubits by the measuring reed all around.
verses.textEnNkjv: He measured the east side with the measuring rod, five hundred rods by the measuring rod all around.
verses.textEnNlt: He measured the east side with his measuring rod, and it was 875 feet long.
verses.textEnNasb: He measured on the east side with the measuring rod: five hundred rods by the measuring rod.
verses.textEn: He measured the east side with the measuring rod; it was five hundred cubits.

verses.textZh: 他又量了北面，按着测量竿计算，共长二百五十公尺。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又量了北面，按着测量竿计算，共长二百五十公尺。
verses.textZhCuv: 用竿量北面五百肘，
verses.textEnNiv: He measured the north side; it was five hundred cubits by the measuring rod.
verses.textEnEsv: He measured the north side, 500 cubits by the measuring reed all around.
verses.textEnNkjv: He measured the north side, five hundred rods by the measuring rod all around.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he measured the north side, and it was also 875 feet.
verses.textEnNasb: He measured on the north side: five hundred rods by the measuring rod.
verses.textEn: He measured the north side; it was five hundred cubits by the measuring rod.

verses.textZh: 他又量了南面，按着测量竿计算，共长二百五十公尺。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又量了南面，按着测量竿计算，共长二百五十公尺。
verses.textZhCuv: 用竿量南面五百肘，
verses.textEnNiv: He measured the south side; it was five hundred cubits by the measuring rod.
verses.textEnEsv: He measured the south side, 500 cubits by the measuring reed.
verses.textEnNkjv: He measured the south side, five hundred rods by the measuring rod.
verses.textEnNlt: The south side was also 875 feet,
verses.textEnNasb: On the south side he measured five hundred rods with the measuring rod.
verses.textEn: He measured the south side; it was five hundred cubits by the measuring rod.

verses.textZh: 他又转去量了西面，按着测量竿计算，共长二百五十公尺。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又转去量了西面，按着测量竿计算，共长二百五十公尺。
verses.textZhCuv: 又转到西面，用竿量五百肘。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he turned to the west side and measured; it was five hundred cubits by the measuring rod.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he turned to the west side and measured, 500 cubits by the measuring reed.
verses.textEnNkjv: He came around to the west side and measured five hundred rods by the measuring rod.
verses.textEnNlt: and the west side was also 875 feet.
verses.textEnNasb: He turned to the west side and measured five hundred rods with the measuring rod.
verses.textEn: Then he turned to the west side and measured; it was five hundred cubits by the measuring rod.

verses.textZh: 这样，他量了四面。圣殿长二百五十公尺，宽二百五十公尺，四围都有墙，为要分开圣地和俗地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，他量了四面。圣殿长二百五十公尺，宽二百五十公尺，四围都有墙，为要分开圣地和俗地。
verses.textZhCuv: 他量四面，四围有墙，长五百肘，宽五百肘，为要分别圣地与俗地。
verses.textEnNiv: So he measured the area on all four sides. It had a wall around it, five hundred cubits long and five hundred cubits wide, to separate the holy from the common.
verses.textEnEsv: He measured it on the four sides. It had a wall around it, 500 cubits long and 500 cubits broad, to make a separation between the holy and the common.
verses.textEnNkjv: He measured it on the four sides; it had a wall all around, five hundred cubits long and five hundred wide, to separate the holy areas from the common.
verses.textEnNlt: So the area was 875 feet on each side with a wall all around it to separate what was holy from what was common.
verses.textEnNasb: He measured it on the four sides; it had a wall all around, the length five hundred rods and the width five hundred, to divide between the holy and the common.
verses.textEn: So he measured the area on all four sides. It had a wall around it, five hundred cubits long and five hundred cubits wide, to separate the holy from the common.

verses.textZh: 以后，他领我到朝东的门去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以后，他领我到朝东的门去。
verses.textZhCuv: 以后，他带我到一座门，就是朝东的门。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the man brought me to the gate facing east,
verses.textEnEsv: Then he led me to the gate, the gate facing east.
verses.textEnNkjv: Afterward he brought me to the gate, the gate that faces toward the east.
verses.textEnNlt: After this, the man brought me back around to the east gateway.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he led me to the gate, the gate facing east;
verses.textEn: Then the man brought me to the gate facing east,

verses.textZh: 看哪！以色列神的荣耀从东面而来；他的声音好象洪水的声音，大地因他的荣耀而发光。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！以色列神的荣耀从东面而来；他的声音好象洪水的声音，大地因他的荣耀而发光。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列神的荣光从东而来。他的声音如同多水的声音；地就因他的荣耀发光。
verses.textEnNiv: and I saw the glory of the God of Israel coming from the east. His voice was like the roar of rushing waters, and the land was radiant with his glory.
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, the glory of the God of Israel was coming from the east. And the sound of his coming was like the sound of many waters, and the earth shone with his glory.
verses.textEnNkjv: And behold, the glory of the God of Israel came from the way of the east. His voice was like the sound of many waters; and the earth shone with His glory.
verses.textEnNlt: Suddenly, the glory of the God of Israel appeared from the east. The sound of his coming was like the roar of rushing waters, and the whole landscape shone with his glory.
verses.textEnNasb: and behold, the glory of the God of Israel was coming from the way of the east. And His voice was like the sound of many waters; and the earth shone from His glory.
verses.textEn: and I saw the glory of the God of Israel coming from the east. His voice was like the roar of rushing waters, and the land was radiant with his glory.

verses.textZh: 我所见的异象，好象我在他来毁灭那城的时候所见的异象一样，又像我在迦巴鲁河边所见的异象一般，我就俯伏在地上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我所见的异象，好象我在他来毁灭那城的时候所见的异象一样，又像我在迦巴鲁河边所见的异象一般，我就俯伏在地上。
verses.textZhCuv: 其状如从前他来灭城的时候我所见的异象，那异象如我在迦巴鲁河边所见的异象，我就俯伏在地。
verses.textEnNiv: The vision I saw was like the vision I had seen when he came to destroy the city and like the visions I had seen by the Kebar River, and I fell facedown.
verses.textEnEsv: And the vision I saw was just like the vision that I had seen when he came to destroy the city, and just like the vision that I had seen by the Chebar canal. And I fell on my face.
verses.textEnNkjv: Itwas like the appearance of the vision which I saw—like the vision which I saw when I came to destroy the city. The visions were like the vision which I saw by the River Chebar; and I fell on my face.
verses.textEnNlt: This vision was just like the others I had seen, first by the Kebar River and then when he came to destroy Jerusalem. I fell face down on the ground.
verses.textEnNasb: And it was like the appearance of the vision which I saw, like the vision which I saw when He came to destroy the city. And the visions were like the vision which I saw by the river Chebar; and I fell on my face.
verses.textEn: The vision I saw was like the vision I had seen when he came to destroy the city and like the visions I had seen by the Kebar River, and I fell facedown.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的荣耀，从朝东的门进入殿中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的荣耀，从朝东的门进入殿中。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的荣光从朝东的门照入殿中。
verses.textEnNiv: The glory of the Lord entered the temple through the gate facing east.
verses.textEnEsv: As the glory of the Lord entered the temple by the gate facing east,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the glory of the Lord came into the temple by way of the gate which faces toward the east.
verses.textEnNlt: And the glory of the Lord came into the Temple through the east gateway.
verses.textEnNasb: And the glory of the Lord entered the house by way of the gate facing east.
verses.textEn: The glory of the Lord entered the temple through the gate facing east.

verses.textZh: 灵把我提起来，领我进了内院。我看见耶和华的荣耀充满了殿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 灵把我提起来，领我进了内院。我看见耶和华的荣耀充满了殿。
verses.textZhCuv: 灵将我举起，带入内院，不料，耶和华的荣光充满了殿。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Spirit lifted me up and brought me into the inner court, and the glory of the Lord filled the temple.
verses.textEnEsv: the Spirit lifted me up and brought me into the inner court; and behold, the glory of the Lord filled the temple.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Spirit lifted me up and brought me into the inner court; and behold, the glory of the Lord filled the temple.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Spirit took me up and brought me into the inner courtyard, and the glory of the Lord filled the Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Spirit lifted me up and brought me into the inner courtyard; and behold, the glory of the Lord filled the house.
verses.textEn: Then the Spirit lifted me up and brought me into the inner court, and the glory of the Lord filled the temple.

verses.textZh: 那人站在我旁边的时候，我听见主从殿中对我说话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那人站在我旁边的时候，我听见主从殿中对我说话。
verses.textZhCuv: 我听见有一位从殿中对我说话。有一人站在我旁边。
verses.textEnNiv: While the man was standing beside me, I heard someone speaking to me from inside the temple.
verses.textEnEsv: While the man was standing beside me, I heard one speaking to me out of the temple,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I heard Him speaking to me from the temple, while a man stood beside me.
verses.textEnNlt: And I heard someone speaking to me from within the Temple, while the man who had been measuring stood beside me.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I heard Him speaking to me from the house, while a man was standing beside me.
verses.textEn: While the man was standing beside me, I heard someone speaking to me from inside the temple.

verses.textZh: 他对我说："人子啊！这是我宝座之地，是我脚掌所踏之地；我要住在那里，在以色列人中间，直到永远。以色列家和他们的诸王，都必不再以他们的淫乱和诸王在邱坛上的石碑玷污我的圣名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他对我说："人子啊！这是我宝座之地，是我脚掌所踏之地；我要住在那里，在以色列人中间，直到永远。以色列家和他们的诸王，都必不再以他们的淫乱和诸王在邱坛上的石碑玷污我的圣名。
verses.textZhCuv: 他对我说：「人子啊，这是我宝座之地，是我脚掌所踏之地。我要在这里住，在以色列人中直到永远。以色列家和他们的君王必不再玷污我的圣名，就是行邪淫、在锡安的高处葬埋他们君王的尸首，
verses.textEnNiv: He said: "Son of man, this is the place of my throne and the place for the soles of my feet. This is where I will live among the Israelites forever. The people of Israel will never again defile my holy name—neither they nor their kings—by their prostitution and the funeral offerings for their kings at their death.
verses.textEnEsv: and he said to me, "Son of man, this is the place of my throne and the place of the soles of my feet, where I will dwell in the midst of the people of Israel forever. And the house of Israel shall no more defile my holy name, neither they, nor their kings, by their whoring and by the dead bodies of their kings at their high places,
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said to me, "Son of man, thisis the place of My throne and the place of the soles of My feet, where I will dwell in the midst of the children of Israel forever. No more shall the house of Israel defile My holy name, they nor their kings, by their harlotry or with the carcasses of their kings on their high places.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord said to me, "Son of man, this is the place of my throne and the place where I will rest my feet. I will live here forever among the people of Israel. They and their kings will not defile my holy name any longer by their adulterous worship of other gods or by honoring the relics of their kings who have died.
verses.textEnNasb: And He said to me, "Son of man, this is the place of My throne and the place of the soles of My feet, where I will dwell among the sons of Israel forever. And the house of Israel will not again defile My holy name, neither they nor their kings, by their prostitution and by the corpses of their kings when they die,
verses.textEn: He said: "Son of man, this is the place of my throne and the place for the soles of my feet. This is where I will live among the Israelites forever. The people of Israel will never again defile my holy name—neither they nor their kings—by their prostitution and the funeral offerings for their kings at their death.

verses.textZh: 他们的门槛靠近我的门槛，他们的门框靠近我的门框，我与他们只有一墙之隔的时候；他们以自己所行的可憎之事玷污了我的圣名，所以我在怒气中灭绝他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的门槛靠近我的门槛，他们的门框靠近我的门框，我与他们只有一墙之隔的时候；他们以自己所行的可憎之事玷污了我的圣名，所以我在怒气中灭绝他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 使他们的门槛挨近我的门槛，他们的门框挨近我的门框；他们与我中间仅隔一墙，并且行可憎的事，玷污了我的圣名，所以我发怒灭绝他们。
verses.textEnNiv: When they placed their threshold next to my threshold and their doorposts beside my doorposts, with only a wall between me and them, they defiled my holy name by their detestable practices. So I destroyed them in my anger.
verses.textEnEsv: by setting their threshold by my threshold and their doorposts beside my doorposts, with only a wall between me and them. They have defiled my holy name by their abominations that they have committed, so I have consumed them in my anger.
verses.textEnNkjv: When they set their threshold by My threshold, and their doorpost by My doorpost, with a wall between them and Me, they defiled My holy name by the abominations which they committed; therefore I have consumed them in My anger.
verses.textEnNlt: They put their idol altars right next to mine with only a wall between them and me. They defiled my holy name by such detestable sin, so I consumed them in my anger.
verses.textEnNasb: by putting their threshold by My threshold, and their door post beside My door post, with only the wall between Me and them. And they have defiled My holy name by their abominations which they have committed. So I have consumed them in My anger.
verses.textEn: When they placed their threshold next to my threshold and their doorposts beside my doorposts, with only a wall between me and them, they defiled my holy name by their detestable practices. So I destroyed them in my anger.

verses.textZh: 现在他们要从我面前除去淫乱和他们诸王的石碑，我就住在他们中间，直到永远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在他们要从我面前除去淫乱和他们诸王的石碑，我就住在他们中间，直到永远。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在他们当从我面前远除邪淫和他们君王的尸首，我就住在他们中间直到永远。
verses.textEnNiv: Now let them put away from me their prostitution and the funeral offerings for their kings, and I will live among them forever.
verses.textEnEsv: Now let them put away their whoring and the dead bodies of their kings far from me, and I will dwell in their midst forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now let them put their harlotry and the carcasses of their kings far away from Me, and I will dwell in their midst forever.
verses.textEnNlt: Now let them stop worshiping other gods and honoring the relics of their kings, and I will live among them forever.
verses.textEnNasb: Now let them remove their prostitution and the corpses of their kings far from Me, and I will dwell among them forever.
verses.textEn: Now let them put away from me their prostitution and the funeral offerings for their kings, and I will live among them forever.

verses.textZh: "人子啊！你要把这殿指示以色列家，使他们因自己的罪孽而羞愧，又要他们量度殿的尺寸。
verses.textZhCnvs: "人子啊！你要把这殿指示以色列家，使他们因自己的罪孽而羞愧，又要他们量度殿的尺寸。
verses.textZhCuv: 「人子啊，你要将这殿指示以色列家，使他们因自己的罪孽惭愧，也要他们量殿的尺寸。
verses.textEnNiv: "Son of man, describe the temple to the people of Israel, that they may be ashamed of their sins. Let them consider its perfection,
verses.textEnEsv: "As for you, son of man, describe to the house of Israel the temple, that they may be ashamed of their iniquities; and they shall measure the plan.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Son of man, describe the temple to the house of Israel, that they may be ashamed of their iniquities; and let them measure the pattern.
verses.textEnNlt: "Son of man, describe to the people of Israel the Temple I have shown you, so they will be ashamed of all their sins. Let them study its plan,
verses.textEnNasb: "As for you, son of man, inform the house of Israel of the temple, so that they will be ashamed of their wrongdoings; and have them measure the plan.
verses.textEn: "Son of man, describe the temple to the people of Israel, that they may be ashamed of their sins. Let them consider its perfection,

verses.textZh: 他们若因自己所行的羞愧，你就要把殿的设计、结构、出入之处，以及一切设计、规条、礼仪、法则，都指示他们，在他们眼前写下来，使他们遵着殿的一切设计和规条去作。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们若因自己所行的羞愧，你就要把殿的设计、结构、出入之处，以及一切设计、规条、礼仪、法则，都指示他们，在他们眼前写下来，使他们遵着殿的一切设计和规条去作。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们若因自己所行的一切事惭愧，你就将殿的规模、样式、出入之处，和一切形状、典章、礼仪、法则指示他们，在他们眼前写上，使他们遵照殿的一切规模典章去做。
verses.textEnNiv: and if they are ashamed of all they have done, make known to them the design of the temple—its arrangement, its exits and entrances—its whole design and all its regulations and laws. Write these down before them so that they may be faithful to its design and follow all its regulations.
verses.textEnEsv: And if they are ashamed of all that they have done, make known to them the design of the temple, its arrangement, its exits and its entrances, that is, its whole design; and make known to them as well all its statutes and its whole design and all its laws, and write it down in their sight, so that they may observe all its laws and all its statutes and carry them out.
verses.textEnNkjv: And if they are ashamed of all that they have done, make known to them the design of the temple and its arrangement, its exits and its entrances, its entire design and all its ordinances, all its forms and all its laws. Write it down in their sight, so that they may keep its whole design and all its ordinances, and perform them.
verses.textEnNlt: and they will be ashamed of what they have done. Describe to them all the specifications of the Temple—including its entrances and exits—and everything else about it. Tell them about its decrees and laws. Write down all these specifications and decrees as they watch so they will be sure to remember and follow them.
verses.textEnNasb: And if they are ashamed of everything that they have done, make known to them the plan of the house, its layout, its exits, its entrances, all its plans, all its statutes, and all its laws. And write it in their sight, so that they may observe its entire plan and all its statutes and execute them.
verses.textEn: and if they are ashamed of all they have done, make known to them the design of the temple—its arrangement, its exits and entrances—its whole design and all its regulations and laws. Write these down before them so that they may be faithful to its design and follow all its regulations.

verses.textZh: 殿的法则是这样：殿在山顶上周围的界限都是至圣的。这就是殿的法则。
verses.textZhCnvs: 殿的法则是这样：殿在山顶上周围的界限都是至圣的。这就是殿的法则。
verses.textZhCuv: 殿的法则乃是如此：殿在山顶上，四围的全界要称为至圣。这就是殿的法则。」
verses.textEnNiv: "This is the law of the temple: All the surrounding area on top of the mountain will be most holy. Such is the law of the temple.
verses.textEnEsv: This is the law of the temple: the whole territory on the top of the mountain all around shall be most holy. Behold, this is the law of the temple.
verses.textEnNkjv: This is the law of the temple: The whole area surrounding the mountaintop is most holy. Behold, this is the law of the temple.
verses.textEnNlt: And this is the basic law of the Temple: absolute holiness! The entire top of the mountain where the Temple is built is holy. Yes, this is the basic law of the Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: This is the law of the house: its entire area on the top of the mountain all around shall be most holy. Behold, this is the law of the house.
verses.textEn: "This is the law of the temple: All the surrounding area on top of the mountain will be most holy. Such is the law of the temple.

verses.textZh: "祭坛的尺寸是：底座高五十公分，边缘宽五十公分，四围另有边高二十五公分。这是祭坛的座。
verses.textZhCnvs: "祭坛的尺寸是：底座高五十公分，边缘宽五十公分，四围另有边高二十五公分。这是祭坛的座。
verses.textZhCuv: 以下量祭坛，是以肘为度（这肘是一肘零一掌）。底座高一肘，边宽一肘，四围起边高一掌，这是坛的座。
verses.textEnNiv: "These are the measurements of the altar in long cubits, that cubit being a cubit and a handbreadth: Its gutter is a cubit deep and a cubit wide, with a rim of one span around the edge. And this is the height of the altar:
verses.textEnEsv: "These are the measurements of the altar by cubits (the cubit being a cubit and a handbreadth): its base shall be one cubit high and one cubit broad, with a rim of one span around its edge. And this shall be the height of the altar:
verses.textEnNkjv: "These are the measurements of the altar in cubits (the cubit is one cubit and a handbreadth): the base one cubit high and one cubit wide, with a rim all around its edge of one span. This is the height of the altar:
verses.textEnNlt: "These are the measurements of the altar : There is a gutter all around the altar 21 inches deep and 21 inches wide, with a curb 9 inches wide around its edge. And this is the height of the altar:
verses.textEnNasb: "And these are the measurements of the altar by cubits (the cubit being a cubit and a hand width): the base shall be a cubit and the width a cubit, and its border on its edge all around one span; and this shall be the height of the base of the altar.
verses.textEn: "These are the measurements of the altar in long cubits, that cubit being a cubit and a handbreadth: Its gutter is a cubit deep and a cubit wide, with a rim of one span around the edge. And this is the height of the altar:

verses.textZh: 从底座到下层的台座，高一公尺，边缘宽五十公分；从小台座到大台座，高二公尺，边缘宽五十公分。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从底座到下层的台座，高一公尺，边缘宽五十公分；从小台座到大台座，高二公尺，边缘宽五十公分。
verses.textZhCuv: 从底座到下层磴台，高二肘，边宽一肘。从小磴台到大磴台，高四肘，边宽一肘。
verses.textEnNiv: From the gutter on the ground up to the lower ledge that goes around the altar it is two cubits high, and the ledge is a cubit wide. From this lower ledge to the upper ledge that goes around the altar it is four cubits high, and that ledge is also a cubit wide.
verses.textEnEsv: from the base on the ground to the lower ledge, two cubits, with a breadth of one cubit; and from the smaller ledge to the larger ledge, four cubits, with a breadth of one cubit;
verses.textEnNkjv: from the base on the ground to the lower ledge, two cubits; the width of the ledge, one cubit; from the smaller ledge to the larger ledge, four cubits; and the width of the ledge, one cubit.
verses.textEnNlt: From the gutter the altar rises 3-1/2 feet to a lower ledge that surrounds the altar and is 21 inches wide. From the lower ledge the altar rises 7 feet to the upper ledge that is also 21 inches wide.
verses.textEnNasb: And from the base on the ground to the lower ledge shall be two cubits, and the width one cubit; and from the smaller ledge to the larger ledge shall be four cubits, and the width one cubit.
verses.textEn: From the gutter on the ground up to the lower ledge that goes around the altar it is two cubits high, and the ledge is a cubit wide. From this lower ledge to the upper ledge that goes around the altar it is four cubits high, and that ledge is also a cubit wide.

verses.textZh: 祭坛的供台高二公尺，从供台向上突出四个角，
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭坛的供台高二公尺，从供台向上突出四个角，
verses.textZhCuv: 坛上的供台，高四肘。供台的四拐角上都有角。
verses.textEnNiv: Above that, the altar hearth is four cubits high, and four horns project upward from the hearth.
verses.textEnEsv: and the altar hearth, four cubits; and from the altar hearth projecting upward, four horns.
verses.textEnNkjv: The altar hearth is four cubits high, with four horns extending upward from the hearth.
verses.textEnNlt: The top of the altar, the hearth, rises another 7 feet higher, with a horn rising up from each of the four corners.
verses.textEnNasb: The altar hearth shall be four cubits; and from the altar hearth shall extend upward four horns.
verses.textEn: Above that, the altar hearth is four cubits high, and four horns project upward from the hearth.

verses.textZh: 供台长六公尺，宽六公尺，四面见方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 供台长六公尺，宽六公尺，四面见方。
verses.textZhCuv: 供台长十二肘，宽十二肘，四面见方。
verses.textEnNiv: The altar hearth is square, twelve cubits long and twelve cubits wide.
verses.textEnEsv: The altar hearth shall be square, twelve cubits long by twelve broad.
verses.textEnNkjv: The altar hearth is twelve cubits long, twelve wide, square at its four corners;
verses.textEnNlt: The top of the altar is square, measuring 21 feet by 21 feet.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the altar hearth shall be twelve cubits long by twelve wide, square in its four sides.
verses.textEn: The altar hearth is square, twelve cubits long and twelve cubits wide.

verses.textZh: 大台座长七公尺，宽七公尺，四面见方；四围有边高二十五公分；底座四围的边缘宽五十公分。另有台阶朝向东面。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大台座长七公尺，宽七公尺，四面见方；四围有边高二十五公分；底座四围的边缘宽五十公分。另有台阶朝向东面。"
verses.textZhCuv: 磴台长十四肘，宽十四肘，四面见方。四围起边高半肘，底座四围的边宽一肘。台阶朝东。
verses.textEnNiv: The upper ledge also is square, fourteen cubits long and fourteen cubits wide. All around the altar is a gutter of one cubit with a rim of half a cubit. The steps of the altar face east."
verses.textEnEsv: The ledge also shall be square, fourteen cubits long by fourteen broad, with a rim around it half a cubit broad, and its base one cubit all around. The steps of the altar shall face east."
verses.textEnNkjv: the ledge, fourteen cubits long and fourteen wide on its four sides, with a rim of half a cubit around it; its base, one cubit all around; and its steps face toward the east."
verses.textEnNlt: The upper ledge also forms a square, measuring 24-1/2 feet by 24-1/2 feet, with a 21-inch gutter and a 10-1/2-inch curb all around the edge. There are steps going up the east side of the altar."
verses.textEnNasb: And the ledge shall be fourteen cubits long by fourteen wide in its four sides, the border around it shall be half a cubit, and its base shall be a cubit all around; and its steps shall face east."
verses.textEn: The upper ledge also is square, fourteen cubits long and fourteen cubits wide. All around the altar is a gutter of one cubit with a rim of half a cubit. The steps of the altar face east."

verses.textZh: 他对我说："人子啊！主耶和华这样说：祭坛的规条是这样：做成了祭坛，在上面献燔祭、洒上血的时候，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他对我说："人子啊！主耶和华这样说：祭坛的规条是这样：做成了祭坛，在上面献燔祭、洒上血的时候，
verses.textZhCuv: 他对我说：「人子啊，主耶和华如此说：建造祭坛，为要在其上献燔祭洒血，造成的时候典章如下：
verses.textEnNiv: Then he said to me, "Son of man, this is what the Sovereign Lord says: These will be the regulations for sacrificing burnt offerings and splashing blood against the altar when it is built:
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to me, "Son of man, thus says the Lord God : These are the ordinances for the altar: On the day when it is erected for offering burnt offerings upon it and for throwing blood against it,
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said to me, "Son of man, thus says the Lord God: ‘These are the ordinances for the altar on the day when it is made, for sacrificing burnt offerings on it, and for sprinkling blood on it.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he said to me, "Son of man, this is what the Sovereign Lord says: These will be the regulations for the burning of offerings and the sprinkling of blood when the altar is built.
verses.textEnNasb: And He said to me, "Son of man, this is what the Lord God says: ‘These are the statutes for the altar on the day it is built, to offer burnt offerings on it and to sprinkle blood on it.
verses.textEn: Then he said to me, "Son of man, this is what the Sovereign Lord says: These will be the regulations for sacrificing burnt offerings and splashing blood against the altar when it is built:

verses.textZh: 你要把一头公牛犊给那些亲近我、事奉我的祭司利未人作赎罪祭，他们是撒督的后裔。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要把一头公牛犊给那些亲近我、事奉我的祭司利未人作赎罪祭，他们是撒督的后裔。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华说，你要将一只公牛犊作为赎罪祭，给祭司利未人撒督的后裔，就是那亲近我、事奉我的。
verses.textEnNiv: You are to give a young bull as a sin offering to the Levitical priests of the family of Zadok, who come near to minister before me, declares the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: you shall give to the Levitical priests of the family of Zadok, who draw near to me to minister to me, declares the Lord God , a bull from the herd for a sin offering.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall give a young bull for a sin offering to the priests, the Levites, who are of the seed of Zadok, who approach Me to minister to Me,’ says the Lord God.
verses.textEnNlt: At that time, the Levitical priests of the family of Zadok, who minister before me, are to be given a young bull for a sin offering, says the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: You shall give to the Levitical priests who are from the descendants of Zadok, who come near to Me to serve Me,’ declares the Lord God, ‘a bull as a sin offering.
verses.textEn: You are to give a young bull as a sin offering to the Levitical priests of the family of Zadok, who come near to minister before me, declares the Sovereign Lord .

verses.textZh: 你要取些公牛犊的血，抹在祭坛的四角和台座的四角，以及四围那些突起的边上。你这样洁净祭坛，祭坛就洁净了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要取些公牛犊的血，抹在祭坛的四角和台座的四角，以及四围那些突起的边上。你这样洁净祭坛，祭坛就洁净了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要取些公牛的血，抹在坛的四角和磴台的四拐角，并四围所起的边上。你这样洁净坛，坛就洁净了。
verses.textEnNiv: You are to take some of its blood and put it on the four horns of the altar and on the four corners of the upper ledge and all around the rim, and so purify the altar and make atonement for it.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall take some of its blood and put it on the four horns of the altar and on the four corners of the ledge and upon the rim all around. Thus you shall purify the altar and make atonement for it.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘You shall take some of its blood and put it on the four horns of the altar, on the four corners of the ledge, and on the rim around it; thus you shall cleanse it and make atonement for it.
verses.textEnNlt: You will take some of its blood and smear it on the four horns of the altar, the four corners of the upper ledge, and the curb that runs around that ledge. This will cleanse and make atonement for the altar.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall take some of its blood and put it on its four horns and on the four corners of the ledge, and on the border all around; so you shall cleanse it and make atonement for it.
verses.textEn: You are to take some of its blood and put it on the four horns of the altar and on the four corners of the upper ledge and all around the rim, and so purify the altar and make atonement for it.

verses.textZh: 你又要把那作赎罪祭的公牛犊，烧在圣所外面，在圣殿指定的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你又要把那作赎罪祭的公牛犊，烧在圣所外面，在圣殿指定的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 你又要将那作赎罪祭的公牛犊烧在殿外、圣地之外预定之处。
verses.textEnNiv: You are to take the bull for the sin offering and burn it in the designated part of the temple area outside the sanctuary.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall also take the bull of the sin offering, and it shall be burned in the appointed place belonging to the temple, outside the sacred area.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then you shall also take the bull of the sin offering, and burn it in the appointed place of the temple, outside the sanctuary.
verses.textEnNlt: Then take the young bull for the sin offering and burn it at the appointed place outside the Temple area.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall also take the bull as the sin offering, and it shall be burned in the appointed place of the house, outside the sanctuary.
verses.textEn: You are to take the bull for the sin offering and burn it in the designated part of the temple area outside the sanctuary.

verses.textZh: 第二天，你要献一只没有残疾的公山羊作赎罪祭，为要洁净祭坛，像用公牛犊洁净祭坛一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第二天，你要献一只没有残疾的公山羊作赎罪祭，为要洁净祭坛，像用公牛犊洁净祭坛一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 次日，要将无残疾的公山羊献为赎罪祭；要洁净坛，像用公牛犊洁净的一样。
verses.textEnNiv: "On the second day you are to offer a male goat without defect for a sin offering, and the altar is to be purified as it was purified with the bull.
verses.textEnEsv: And on the second day you shall offer a male goat without blemish for a sin offering; and the altar shall be purified, as it was purified with the bull.
verses.textEnNkjv: On the second day you shall offer a kid of the goats without blemish for a sin offering; and they shall cleanse the altar, as they cleansed it with the bull.
verses.textEnNlt: "On the second day, sacrifice as a sin offering a young male goat that has no physical defects. Then cleanse and make atonement for the altar again, just as you did with the young bull.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘And on the second day you shall offer a male goat without blemish as a sin offering, and they shall cleanse the altar from sin as they cleansed it with the bull.
verses.textEn: "On the second day you are to offer a male goat without defect for a sin offering, and the altar is to be purified as it was purified with the bull.

verses.textZh: 你洁净了祭坛之后，就要献一头没有残疾的公牛犊和羊群中一只没有残疾的公绵羊。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你洁净了祭坛之后，就要献一头没有残疾的公牛犊和羊群中一只没有残疾的公绵羊。
verses.textZhCuv: 洁净了坛，就要将一只无残疾的公牛犊和羊群中一只无残疾的公绵羊
verses.textEnNiv: When you have finished purifying it, you are to offer a young bull and a ram from the flock, both without defect.
verses.textEnEsv: When you have finished purifying it, you shall offer a bull from the herd without blemish and a ram from the flock without blemish.
verses.textEnNkjv: When you have finished cleansing it, you shall offer a young bull without blemish, and a ram from the flock without blemish.
verses.textEnNlt: When you have finished the cleansing ceremony, offer another young bull that has no defects and a perfect ram from the flock.
verses.textEnNasb: When you have finished cleansing it, you shall offer a bull without blemish and a ram without blemish from the flock.
verses.textEn: When you have finished purifying it, you are to offer a young bull and a ram from the flock, both without defect.

verses.textZh: 你要在耶和华面前把牠们献上，祭司们要把盐撒在牠们身上，作燔祭献给耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要在耶和华面前把牠们献上，祭司们要把盐撒在牠们身上，作燔祭献给耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 奉到耶和华前。祭司要撒盐在其上，献与耶和华为燔祭。
verses.textEnNiv: You are to offer them before the Lord , and the priests are to sprinkle salt on them and sacrifice them as a burnt offering to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: You shall present them before the Lord , and the priests shall sprinkle salt on them and offer them up as a burnt offering to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: When you offer them before the Lord, the priests shall throw salt on them, and they will offer them up as a burnt offering to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: You are to present them to the Lord , and the priests are to sprinkle salt on them and offer them as a burnt offering to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: You shall offer them before the Lord, and the priests shall throw salt on them, and they shall offer them up as a burnt offering to the Lord.
verses.textEn: You are to offer them before the Lord , and the priests are to sprinkle salt on them and sacrifice them as a burnt offering to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 一连七天，每天你都要预备一头公山羊为赎罪祭，也要预备一头公牛犊和羊群中的一只公绵羊，都要没有残疾的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 一连七天，每天你都要预备一头公山羊为赎罪祭，也要预备一头公牛犊和羊群中的一只公绵羊，都要没有残疾的。
verses.textZhCuv: 七日内，每日要预备一只公山羊为赎罪祭，也要预备一只公牛犊和羊群中的一只公绵羊，都要没有残疾的。
verses.textEnNiv: "For seven days you are to provide a male goat daily for a sin offering; you are also to provide a young bull and a ram from the flock, both without defect.
verses.textEnEsv: For seven days you shall provide daily a male goat for a sin offering; also, a bull from the herd and a ram from the flock, without blemish, shall be provided.
verses.textEnNkjv: Every day for seven days you shall prepare a goat for a sin offering; they shall also prepare a young bull and a ram from the flock, both without blemish.
verses.textEnNlt: "Every day for seven days a male goat, a young bull, and a ram from the flock will be sacrificed as a sin offering. None of these animals may have physical defects of any kind.
verses.textEnNasb: For seven days you shall prepare a goat as a sin offering daily; also a bull and a ram from the flock, both without blemish, shall be prepared.
verses.textEn: "For seven days you are to provide a male goat daily for a sin offering; you are also to provide a young bull and a ram from the flock, both without defect.

verses.textZh: 一连七天，祭司们都要洁净祭坛，祭坛就洁净了。这样，他们就把祭坛分别为圣了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 一连七天，祭司们都要洁净祭坛，祭坛就洁净了。这样，他们就把祭坛分别为圣了。
verses.textZhCuv: 七日祭司洁净坛，坛就洁净了；要这样把坛分别为圣。
verses.textEnNiv: For seven days they are to make atonement for the altar and cleanse it; thus they will dedicate it.
verses.textEnEsv: Seven days shall they make atonement for the altar and cleanse it, and so consecrate it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Seven days they shall make atonement for the altar and purify it, and so consecrate it.
verses.textEnNlt: Do this each day for seven days to cleanse and make atonement for the altar, thus setting it apart for holy use.
verses.textEnNasb: For seven days they shall make atonement for the altar and purify it; so shall they consecrate it.
verses.textEn: For seven days they are to make atonement for the altar and cleanse it; thus they will dedicate it.

verses.textZh: 满了七天，从第八天起，祭司们要在祭坛上献你们的燔祭和平安祭。我那时必悦纳你们；这是主耶和华的宣告。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 满了七天，从第八天起，祭司们要在祭坛上献你们的燔祭和平安祭。我那时必悦纳你们；这是主耶和华的宣告。"
verses.textZhCuv: 满了七日，自八日以后，祭司要在坛上献你们的燔祭和平安祭；我必悦纳你们。这是主耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: At the end of these days, from the eighth day on, the priests are to present your burnt offerings and fellowship offerings on the altar. Then I will accept you, declares the Sovereign Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: And when they have completed these days, then from the eighth day onward the priests shall offer on the altar your burnt offerings and your peace offerings, and I will accept you, declares the Lord God ."
verses.textEnNkjv: When these days are over it shall be, on the eighth day and thereafter, that the priests shall offer your burnt offerings and your peace offerings on the altar; and I will accept you,’ says the Lord God."
verses.textEnNlt: On the eighth day, and on each day afterward, the priests will sacrifice on the altar the burnt offerings and peace offerings of the people. Then I will accept you. I, the Sovereign Lord , have spoken!"
verses.textEnNasb: When they have completed the days, it shall be that on the eighth day and onward, the priests shall offer your burnt offerings on the altar, and your peace offerings; and I will accept you,’ declares the Lord God."
verses.textEn: At the end of these days, from the eighth day on, the priests are to present your burnt offerings and fellowship offerings on the altar. Then I will accept you, declares the Sovereign Lord ."

verses.textZh: 他又领我回到圣所朝东的外门，这门关闭着。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又领我回到圣所朝东的外门，这门关闭着。
verses.textZhCuv: 他又带我回到圣地朝东的外门；那门关闭了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the man brought me back to the outer gate of the sanctuary, the one facing east, and it was shut.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he brought me back to the outer gate of the sanctuary, which faces east. And it was shut.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He brought me back to the outer gate of the sanctuary which faces toward the east, but it was shut.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the man brought me back to the east gateway in the outer wall of the Temple area, but it was closed.
verses.textEnNasb: Then He brought me back by way of the outer gate of the sanctuary, which faces east; and it was shut.
verses.textEn: Then the man brought me back to the outer gate of the sanctuary, the one facing east, and it was shut.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对我说："这门必须关闭，不可打开；任何人也不得从那里进入；因为耶和华以色列的神已经从那里进入，所以这门必须关闭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对我说："这门必须关闭，不可打开；任何人也不得从那里进入；因为耶和华以色列的神已经从那里进入，所以这门必须关闭。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对我说：「这门必须关闭，不可敞开，谁也不可由其中进入；因为耶和华－以色列的神已经由其中进入，所以必须关闭。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to me, "This gate is to remain shut. It must not be opened; no one may enter through it. It is to remain shut because the Lord , the God of Israel, has entered through it.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to me, "This gate shall remain shut; it shall not be opened, and no one shall enter by it, for the Lord , the God of Israel, has entered by it. Therefore it shall remain shut.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord said to me, "This gate shall be shut; it shall not be opened, and no man shall enter by it, because the Lord God of Israel has entered by it; therefore it shall be shut.
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord said to me, "This gate must remain closed; it will never again be opened. No one will ever open it and pass through, for the Lord , the God of Israel, has entered here. Therefore, it must always remain shut.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord said to me, "This gate shall be shut; it shall not be opened, and no one shall enter by it, for the Lord God of Israel has entered by it; therefore it shall be shut.
verses.textEn: The Lord said to me, "This gate is to remain shut. It must not be opened; no one may enter through it. It is to remain shut because the Lord , the God of Israel, has entered through it.

verses.textZh: 只有君王可以坐在里面，在耶和华面前吃饼；他必须从门廊进入，也必须从原路出来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 只有君王可以坐在里面，在耶和华面前吃饼；他必须从门廊进入，也必须从原路出来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 至于王，他必按王的位分，坐在其内，在耶和华面前吃饼。他必由这门的廊而入，也必由此而出。」
verses.textEnNiv: The prince himself is the only one who may sit inside the gateway to eat in the presence of the Lord . He is to enter by way of the portico of the gateway and go out the same way."
verses.textEnEsv: Only the prince may sit in it to eat bread before the Lord . He shall enter by way of the vestibule of the gate, and shall go out by the same way."
verses.textEnNkjv: Asfor the prince, because he is the prince, he may sit in it to eat bread before the Lord; he shall enter by way of the vestibule of the gateway, and go out the same way."
verses.textEnNlt: Only the prince himself may sit inside this gateway to feast in the Lord ’s presence. But he may come and go only through the entry room of the gateway."
verses.textEnNasb: As for the prince, he shall sit in it as prince to eat bread before the Lord; he shall enter by way of the porch of the gate and shall go out by the same way."
verses.textEn: The prince himself is the only one who may sit inside the gateway to eat in the presence of the Lord . He is to enter by way of the portico of the gateway and go out the same way."

verses.textZh: 他又领我经过北门来到殿前；我观看，见耶和华的荣耀充满耶和华的殿，我就脸伏在地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又领我经过北门来到殿前；我观看，见耶和华的荣耀充满耶和华的殿，我就脸伏在地。
verses.textZhCuv: 他又带我由北门来到殿前。我观看，见耶和华的荣光充满耶和华的殿，我就俯伏在地。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the man brought me by way of the north gate to the front of the temple. I looked and saw the glory of the Lord filling the temple of the Lord , and I fell facedown.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he brought me by way of the north gate to the front of the temple, and I looked, and behold, the glory of the Lord filled the temple of the Lord . And I fell on my face.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also He brought me by way of the north gate to the front of the temple; so I looked, and behold, the glory of the Lord filled the house of the Lord; and I fell on my face.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the man brought me through the north gateway to the front of the Temple. I looked and saw that the glory of the Lord filled the Temple of the Lord , and I fell face down on the ground.
verses.textEnNasb: Then He brought me by way of the north gate to the front of the house; and I looked, and behold, the glory of the Lord filled the house of the Lord, and I fell on my face.
verses.textEn: Then the man brought me by way of the north gate to the front of the temple. I looked and saw the glory of the Lord filling the temple of the Lord , and I fell facedown.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对我说："人子啊！我所告诉你耶和华殿的一切规条和法则，你都要留心，用眼看，用耳听，并要留心圣殿的入口和圣所的所有出口。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对我说："人子啊！我所告诉你耶和华殿的一切规条和法则，你都要留心，用眼看，用耳听，并要留心圣殿的入口和圣所的所有出口。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对我说：「人子啊，我对你所说耶和华殿中的一切典章法则，你要放在心上，用眼看，用耳听，并要留心殿宇和圣地一切出入之处。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to me, "Son of man, look carefully, listen closely and give attention to everything I tell you concerning all the regulations and instructions regarding the temple of the Lord . Give attention to the entrance to the temple and all the exits of the sanctuary.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to me, "Son of man, mark well, see with your eyes, and hear with your ears all that I shall tell you concerning all the statutes of the temple of the Lord and all its laws. And mark well the entrance to the temple and all the exits from the sanctuary.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord said to me, "Son of man, mark well, see with your eyes and hear with your ears, all that I say to you concerning all the ordinances of the house of the Lord and all its laws. Mark well who may enter the house and all who go out from the sanctuary.
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord said to me, "Son of man, take careful notice. Use your eyes and ears, and listen to everything I tell you about the regulations concerning the Lord ’s Temple. Take careful note of the procedures for using the Temple’s entrances and exits.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord said to me, "Son of man, pay attention, see with your eyes and hear with your ears everything that I say to you concerning all the statutes of the house of the Lord and all its laws; and pay attention to the entrance of the house, with all the exits of the sanctuary.
verses.textEn: The Lord said to me, "Son of man, look carefully, listen closely and give attention to everything I tell you concerning all the regulations and instructions regarding the temple of the Lord . Give attention to the entrance to the temple and all the exits of the sanctuary.

verses.textZh: 你要对悖逆的以色列家说：‘主耶和华这样说：以色列家啊！你们所行一切可憎的事，该够了吧！
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要对悖逆的以色列家说：‘主耶和华这样说：以色列家啊！你们所行一切可憎的事，该够了吧！
verses.textZhCuv: 你要对那悖逆的以色列家说，主耶和华如此说：以色列家啊，你们行一切可憎的事，当够了吧！
verses.textEnNiv: Say to rebellious Israel, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Enough of your detestable practices, people of Israel!
verses.textEnEsv: And say to the rebellious house, to the house of Israel, Thus says the Lord God : O house of Israel, enough of all your abominations,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now say to the rebellious, to the house of Israel, ‘Thus says the Lord God: "O house of Israel, let Us have no more of all your abominations.
verses.textEnNlt: And give these rebels, the people of Israel, this message from the Sovereign Lord : O people of Israel, enough of your detestable sins!
verses.textEnNasb: You shall say to the rebellious ones, to the house of Israel, ‘This is what the Lord God says: "Enough of all your abominations, house of Israel,
verses.textEn: Say to rebellious Israel, ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: Enough of your detestable practices, people of Israel!

verses.textZh: 你们除了行这一切可憎的事之外，还在你们把脂肪和血献给我作食物的时候，把身心都未受割礼的外族人带进我的圣所，玷污了我的殿，违背了我的约。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们除了行这一切可憎的事之外，还在你们把脂肪和血献给我作食物的时候，把身心都未受割礼的外族人带进我的圣所，玷污了我的殿，违背了我的约。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们把我的食物，就是脂油和血献上的时候，将身心未受割礼的外邦人领进我的圣地，玷污了我的殿；又背了我的约，在你们一切可憎的事上，加上这一层。
verses.textEnNiv: In addition to all your other detestable practices, you brought foreigners uncircumcised in heart and flesh into my sanctuary, desecrating my temple while you offered me food, fat and blood, and you broke my covenant.
verses.textEnEsv: in admitting foreigners, uncircumcised in heart and flesh, to be in my sanctuary, profaning my temple, when you offer to me my food, the fat and the blood. You have broken my covenant, in addition to all your abominations.
verses.textEnNkjv: When you brought in foreigners, uncircumcised in heart and uncircumcised in flesh, to be in My sanctuary to defile it—My house—and when you offered My food, the fat and the blood, then they broke My covenant because of all your abominations.
verses.textEnNlt: You have brought uncircumcised foreigners into my sanctuary—people who have no heart for God. In this way, you defiled my Temple even as you offered me my food, the fat and blood of sacrifices. In addition to all your other detestable sins, you have broken my covenant.
verses.textEnNasb: when you brought in foreigners, uncircumcised in heart and uncircumcised in flesh, to be in My sanctuary to profane it, My house, when you offered My food, the fat, and the blood and they broke My covenant—this in addition to all your abominations.
verses.textEn: In addition to all your other detestable practices, you brought foreigners uncircumcised in heart and flesh into my sanctuary, desecrating my temple while you offered me food, fat and blood, and you broke my covenant.

verses.textZh: 你们自己没有看守我的圣物，却委派别人在我的圣所里代你们看守。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们自己没有看守我的圣物，却委派别人在我的圣所里代你们看守。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们也没有看守我的圣物，却派别人在圣地替你们看守我所吩咐你们的。
verses.textEnNiv: Instead of carrying out your duty in regard to my holy things, you put others in charge of my sanctuary.
verses.textEnEsv: And you have not kept charge of my holy things, but you have set others to keep my charge for you in my sanctuary.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you have not kept charge of My holy things, but you have set others to keep charge of My sanctuary for you."
verses.textEnNlt: Instead of safeguarding my sacred rituals, you have hired foreigners to take charge of my sanctuary.
verses.textEnNasb: And you have not taken responsibility for My holy things yourselves, but you have appointed foreigners to take responsibility for My sanctuary."
verses.textEn: Instead of carrying out your duty in regard to my holy things, you put others in charge of my sanctuary.

verses.textZh: 主耶和华这样说："以色列人中一切身心都未受割礼的外族人，都不可进入我的圣所。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主耶和华这样说："以色列人中一切身心都未受割礼的外族人，都不可进入我的圣所。
verses.textZhCuv: 「主耶和华如此说：以色列中的外邦人，就是身心未受割礼的，都不可入我的圣地。」
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Sovereign Lord says: No foreigner uncircumcised in heart and flesh is to enter my sanctuary, not even the foreigners who live among the Israelites.
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord God : No foreigner, uncircumcised in heart and flesh, of all the foreigners who are among the people of Israel, shall enter my sanctuary.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord God: "No foreigner, uncircumcised in heart or uncircumcised in flesh, shall enter My sanctuary, including any foreigner who is among the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: "So this is what the Sovereign Lord says: No foreigners, including those who live among the people of Israel, will enter my sanctuary if they have not been circumcised and have not surrendered themselves to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: ‘This is what the Lord God says: "No foreigner uncircumcised in heart and uncircumcised in flesh, of all the foreigners who are among the sons of Israel, shall enter My sanctuary.
verses.textEn: This is what the Sovereign Lord says: No foreigner uncircumcised in heart and flesh is to enter my sanctuary, not even the foreigners who live among the Israelites.

verses.textZh: 以色列人走迷了路的时候，有利未人远离我，走迷了路。他们离开我去随从他们的偶像，他们必担当自己的罪孽。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人走迷了路的时候，有利未人远离我，走迷了路。他们离开我去随从他们的偶像，他们必担当自己的罪孽。
verses.textZhCuv: 「当以色列人走迷的时候，有利未人远离我，就是走迷离开我、随从他们的偶像，他们必担当自己的罪孽。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘The Levites who went far from me when Israel went astray and who wandered from me after their idols must bear the consequences of their sin.
verses.textEnEsv: But the Levites who went far from me, going astray from me after their idols when Israel went astray, shall bear their punishment.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And the Levites who went far from Me, when Israel went astray, who strayed away from Me after their idols, they shall bear their iniquity.
verses.textEnNlt: And the men of the tribe of Levi who abandoned me when Israel strayed away from me to worship idols must bear the consequences of their unfaithfulness.
verses.textEnNasb: But the Levites who went far from Me when Israel went astray, who went astray from Me following their idols, shall suffer the punishment for their wrongdoing.
verses.textEn: " ‘The Levites who went far from me when Israel went astray and who wandered from me after their idols must bear the consequences of their sin.

verses.textZh: 他们要在我的圣所作仆役，看管殿门，在圣殿中供职；他们要为人民宰杀燔祭牲和其他祭牲，又要站在人民面前侍候他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们要在我的圣所作仆役，看管殿门，在圣殿中供职；他们要为人民宰杀燔祭牲和其他祭牲，又要站在人民面前侍候他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而他们必在我的圣地当仆役，照管殿门，在殿中供职；必为民宰杀燔祭牲和平安祭牲，必站在民前伺候他们。
verses.textEnNiv: They may serve in my sanctuary, having charge of the gates of the temple and serving in it; they may slaughter the burnt offerings and sacrifices for the people and stand before the people and serve them.
verses.textEnEsv: They shall be ministers in my sanctuary, having oversight at the gates of the temple and ministering in the temple. They shall slaughter the burnt offering and the sacrifice for the people, and they shall stand before the people, to minister to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet they shall be ministers in My sanctuary, as gatekeepers of the house and ministers of the house; they shall slay the burnt offering and the sacrifice for the people, and they shall stand before them to minister to them.
verses.textEnNlt: They may still be Temple guards and gatekeepers, and they may slaughter the animals brought for burnt offerings and be present to help the people.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet they shall be ministers in My sanctuary, having oversight at the gates of the house and ministering in the house; they shall slaughter the burnt offering and the sacrifice for the people, and they shall stand before them to minister to them.
verses.textEn: They may serve in my sanctuary, having charge of the gates of the temple and serving in it; they may slaughter the burnt offerings and sacrifices for the people and stand before the people and serve them.

verses.textZh: 因为这些利未人曾在他们的偶像前侍候这人民，成了陷以色列家在罪孽中的绊脚石。因此，我向他们举手起誓，他们必要担当自己的罪孽。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为这些利未人曾在他们的偶像前侍候这人民，成了陷以色列家在罪孽中的绊脚石。因此，我向他们举手起誓，他们必要担当自己的罪孽。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为这些利未人曾在偶像前伺候这民，成了以色列家罪孽的绊脚石，所以我向他们起誓：他们必担当自己的罪孽。这是主耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: But because they served them in the presence of their idols and made the people of Israel fall into sin, therefore I have sworn with uplifted hand that they must bear the consequences of their sin, declares the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Because they ministered to them before their idols and became a stumbling block of iniquity to the house of Israel, therefore I have sworn concerning them, declares the Lord God , and they shall bear their punishment.
verses.textEnNkjv: Because they ministered to them before their idols and caused the house of Israel to fall into iniquity, therefore I have raised My hand in an oath against them," says the Lord God, "that they shall bear their iniquity.
verses.textEnNlt: But they encouraged my people to worship idols, causing Israel to fall into deep sin. So I have taken a solemn oath that they must bear the consequences for their sins, says the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Since they ministered to them before their idols and became a stumbling block of wrongdoing to the house of Israel, for that reason I have sworn against them," declares the Lord God, "that they shall suffer the punishment for their wrongdoing.
verses.textEn: But because they served them in the presence of their idols and made the people of Israel fall into sin, therefore I have sworn with uplifted hand that they must bear the consequences of their sin, declares the Sovereign Lord .

verses.textZh: 他们不可亲近我，作我的祭司，也不可亲近我的一切圣物，或至圣之物。他们必要担当自己的羞辱和他们所行可憎之事的报应。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们不可亲近我，作我的祭司，也不可亲近我的一切圣物，或至圣之物。他们必要担当自己的羞辱和他们所行可憎之事的报应。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们不可亲近我，给我供祭司的职分，也不可挨近我的一件圣物，就是至圣的物；他们却要担当自己的羞辱和所行可憎之事的报应。
verses.textEnNiv: They are not to come near to serve me as priests or come near any of my holy things or my most holy offerings; they must bear the shame of their detestable practices.
verses.textEnEsv: They shall not come near to me, to serve me as priest, nor come near any of my holy things and the things that are most holy, but they shall bear their shame and the abominations that they have committed.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they shall not come near Me to minister to Me as priest, nor come near any of My holy things, nor into the Most Holy Place; but they shall bear their shame and their abominations which they have committed.
verses.textEnNlt: They may not approach me to minister as priests. They may not touch any of my holy things or the holy offerings, for they must bear the shame of all the detestable sins they have committed.
verses.textEnNasb: And they shall not approach Me to serve as priests for Me, nor approach any of My holy things, to the things that are most holy; but they will bear their shame and their abominations which they have committed.
verses.textEn: They are not to come near to serve me as priests or come near any of my holy things or my most holy offerings; they must bear the shame of their detestable practices.

verses.textZh: 然而我要委派他们看守圣殿，办理圣殿的一切事务，作一切当作的工。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而我要委派他们看守圣殿，办理圣殿的一切事务，作一切当作的工。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而我要使他们看守殿宇，办理其中的一切事，并做其内一切当做之工。」
verses.textEnNiv: And I will appoint them to guard the temple for all the work that is to be done in it.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet I will appoint them to keep charge of the temple, to do all its service and all that is to be done in it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless I will make them keep charge of the temple, for all its work, and for all that has to be done in it.
verses.textEnNlt: They are to serve as the Temple caretakers, taking charge of the maintenance work and performing general duties.
verses.textEnNasb: Nevertheless I will appoint them to take responsibility for the house, of all its service and of everything that shall be done in it.
verses.textEn: And I will appoint them to guard the temple for all the work that is to be done in it.

verses.textZh: "以色列人走迷了路，离开我的时候，有祭司利未人，就是撒督的子孙，仍然看守我的圣所；只有他们可以亲近我，事奉我，侍立在我面前，把脂肪和血献给我。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: "以色列人走迷了路，离开我的时候，有祭司利未人，就是撒督的子孙，仍然看守我的圣所；只有他们可以亲近我，事奉我，侍立在我面前，把脂肪和血献给我。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 「以色列人走迷离开我的时候，祭司利未人撒督的子孙仍看守我的圣所。他们必亲近我，事奉我，并且侍立在我面前，将脂油与血献给我。这是主耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘But the Levitical priests, who are descendants of Zadok and who guarded my sanctuary when the Israelites went astray from me, are to come near to minister before me; they are to stand before me to offer sacrifices of fat and blood, declares the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: "But the Levitical priests, the sons of Zadok, who kept the charge of my sanctuary when the people of Israel went astray from me, shall come near to me to minister to me. And they shall stand before me to offer me the fat and the blood, declares the Lord God .
verses.textEnNkjv: "But the priests, the Levites, the sons of Zadok, who kept charge of My sanctuary when the children of Israel went astray from Me, they shall come near Me to minister to Me; and they shall stand before Me to offer to Me the fat and the blood," says the Lord God.
verses.textEnNlt: "However, the Levitical priests of the family of Zadok continued to minister faithfully in the Temple when Israel abandoned me for idols. These men will serve as my ministers. They will stand in my presence and offer the fat and blood of the sacrifices, says the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "But the Levitical priests, the sons of Zadok, who took responsibility for My sanctuary when the sons of Israel went astray from Me, shall come near to Me to serve Me; and they shall stand before Me to offer Me the fat and the blood," declares the Lord God.
verses.textEn: " ‘But the Levitical priests, who are descendants of Zadok and who guarded my sanctuary when the Israelites went astray from me, are to come near to minister before me; they are to stand before me to offer sacrifices of fat and blood, declares the Sovereign Lord .

verses.textZh: 他们可以进入我的圣所，可以走近我的桌前来事奉我，守我所吩咐的职责。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们可以进入我的圣所，可以走近我的桌前来事奉我，守我所吩咐的职责。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必进入我的圣所，就近我的桌前事奉我，守我所吩咐的。
verses.textEnNiv: They alone are to enter my sanctuary; they alone are to come near my table to minister before me and serve me as guards.
verses.textEnEsv: They shall enter my sanctuary, and they shall approach my table, to minister to me, and they shall keep my charge.
verses.textEnNkjv: "They shall enter My sanctuary, and they shall come near My table to minister to Me, and they shall keep My charge.
verses.textEnNlt: They alone will enter my sanctuary and approach my table to serve me. They will fulfill all my requirements.
verses.textEnNasb: "They shall enter My sanctuary; they shall come near to My table to serve Me and assume the responsibility I give them.
verses.textEn: They alone are to enter my sanctuary; they alone are to come near my table to minister before me and serve me as guards.

verses.textZh: 每逢他们进入内院的门，必须穿上细麻衣；每逢他们在内院的门和圣殿里供职，他们不可穿上羊毛的衣服。
verses.textZhCnvs: 每逢他们进入内院的门，必须穿上细麻衣；每逢他们在内院的门和圣殿里供职，他们不可穿上羊毛的衣服。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们进内院门必穿细麻衣。在内院门和殿内供职的时候不可穿羊毛衣服。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘When they enter the gates of the inner court, they are to wear linen clothes; they must not wear any woolen garment while ministering at the gates of the inner court or inside the temple.
verses.textEnEsv: When they enter the gates of the inner court, they shall wear linen garments. They shall have nothing of wool on them, while they minister at the gates of the inner court, and within.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it shall be, whenever they enter the gates of the inner court, that they shall put on linen garments; no wool shall come upon them while they minister within the gates of the inner court or within the house.
verses.textEnNlt: "When they enter the gateway to the inner courtyard, they must wear only linen clothing. They must wear no wool while on duty in the inner courtyard or in the Temple itself.
verses.textEnNasb: And it shall be that when they enter at the gates of the inner courtyard, they shall be clothed with linen garments; and wool shall not be worn by them while they are ministering in the gates of the inner courtyard or in the house.
verses.textEn: " ‘When they enter the gates of the inner court, they are to wear linen clothes; they must not wear any woolen garment while ministering at the gates of the inner court or inside the temple.

verses.textZh: 他们头上要戴细麻布的头巾，腰间要穿细麻布的裤子；不可穿上使身体容易出汗的衣服。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们头上要戴细麻布的头巾，腰间要穿细麻布的裤子；不可穿上使身体容易出汗的衣服。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们头上要戴细麻布裹头巾，腰穿细麻布裤子；不可穿使身体出汗的衣服。
verses.textEnNiv: They are to wear linen turbans on their heads and linen undergarments around their waists. They must not wear anything that makes them perspire.
verses.textEnEsv: They shall have linen turbans on their heads, and linen undergarments around their waists. They shall not bind themselves with anything that causes sweat.
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall have linen turbans on their heads and linen trousers on their bodies; they shall not clothe themselves with anythingthatcauses sweat.
verses.textEnNlt: They must wear linen turbans and linen undergarments. They must not wear anything that would cause them to perspire.
verses.textEnNasb: Linen turbans shall be on their heads and linen undergarments shall be around their waists; they shall not put on anything that makes them sweat.
verses.textEn: They are to wear linen turbans on their heads and linen undergarments around their waists. They must not wear anything that makes them perspire.

verses.textZh: 每逢他们出到外院民众那里，就要把供职的衣服脱下，存放在圣殿的房子里，然后穿上别的衣服，免得因自己的圣衣使人民成圣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 每逢他们出到外院民众那里，就要把供职的衣服脱下，存放在圣殿的房子里，然后穿上别的衣服，免得因自己的圣衣使人民成圣。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们出到外院的民那里，当脱下供职的衣服，放在圣屋内，穿上别的衣服，免得因圣衣使民成圣。
verses.textEnNiv: When they go out into the outer court where the people are, they are to take off the clothes they have been ministering in and are to leave them in the sacred rooms, and put on other clothes, so that the people are not consecrated through contact with their garments.
verses.textEnEsv: And when they go out into the outer court to the people, they shall put off the garments in which they have been ministering and lay them in the holy chambers. And they shall put on other garments, lest they transmit holiness to the people with their garments.
verses.textEnNkjv: When they go out to the outer court, to the outer court to the people, they shall take off their garments in which they have ministered, leave them in the holy chambers, and put on other garments; and in their holy garments they shall not sanctify the people.
verses.textEnNlt: When they return to the outer courtyard where the people are, they must take off the clothes they wear while ministering to me. They must leave them in the sacred rooms and put on other clothes so they do not endanger anyone by transmitting holiness to them through this clothing.
verses.textEnNasb: And when they go out into the outer courtyard, into the outer courtyard to the people, they shall take off their garments in which they have been ministering and lay them in the holy chambers; then they shall put on other garments, so that they will not transfer holiness to the people with their garments.
verses.textEn: When they go out into the outer court where the people are, they are to take off the clothes they have been ministering in and are to leave them in the sacred rooms, and put on other clothes, so that the people are not consecrated through contact with their garments.

verses.textZh: 他们不可剃头，也不可留长头发，只可剪短头发。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们不可剃头，也不可留长头发，只可剪短头发。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可剃头，也不可容发绺长长，只可剪发。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘They must not shave their heads or let their hair grow long, but they are to keep the hair of their heads trimmed.
verses.textEnEsv: They shall not shave their heads or let their locks grow long; they shall surely trim the hair of their heads.
verses.textEnNkjv: "They shall neither shave their heads nor let their hair grow long, but they shall keep their hair well trimmed.
verses.textEnNlt: "They must neither shave their heads nor let their hair grow too long. Instead, they must trim it regularly.
verses.textEnNasb: Also they shall not shave their heads, yet they shall not let their locks grow long; they shall only trim the hair of their heads.
verses.textEn: " ‘They must not shave their heads or let their hair grow long, but they are to keep the hair of their heads trimmed.

verses.textZh: 所有祭司进入内院的时候，都不可喝酒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有祭司进入内院的时候，都不可喝酒。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司进内院的时候都不可喝酒。
verses.textEnNiv: No priest is to drink wine when he enters the inner court.
verses.textEnEsv: No priest shall drink wine when he enters the inner court.
verses.textEnNkjv: No priest shall drink wine when he enters the inner court.
verses.textEnNlt: The priests must not drink wine before entering the inner courtyard.
verses.textEnNasb: Nor shall any of the priests drink wine when they enter the inner courtyard.
verses.textEn: No priest is to drink wine when he enters the inner court.

verses.textZh: 他们不可娶寡妇或被休的妇人；只可娶以色列后裔中的处女，或是祭司留下的寡妇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们不可娶寡妇或被休的妇人；只可娶以色列后裔中的处女，或是祭司留下的寡妇。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可娶寡妇和被休的妇人为妻，只可娶以色列后裔中的处女，或是祭司遗留的寡妇。
verses.textEnNiv: They must not marry widows or divorced women; they may marry only virgins of Israelite descent or widows of priests.
verses.textEnEsv: They shall not marry a widow or a divorced woman, but only virgins of the offspring of the house of Israel, or a widow who is the widow of a priest.
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall not take as wife a widow or a divorced woman, but take virgins of the descendants of the house of Israel, or widows of priests.
verses.textEnNlt: They may choose their wives only from among the virgins of Israel or the widows of the priests. They may not marry other widows or divorced women.
verses.textEnNasb: And they shall not marry a widow or a divorced woman, but shall take virgins from the descendants of the house of Israel, or a widow who is the widow of a priest.
verses.textEn: They must not marry widows or divorced women; they may marry only virgins of Israelite descent or widows of priests.

verses.textZh: 他们要教导我的子民分别圣俗，使他们分辨洁净的和不洁净的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们要教导我的子民分别圣俗，使他们分辨洁净的和不洁净的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们要使我的民知道圣俗的分别，又使他们分辨洁净的和不洁净的。
verses.textEnNiv: They are to teach my people the difference between the holy and the common and show them how to distinguish between the unclean and the clean.
verses.textEnEsv: They shall teach my people the difference between the holy and the common, and show them how to distinguish between the unclean and the clean.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And they shall teach My people thedifference between the holy and the unholy, and cause them to discern between the unclean and the clean.
verses.textEnNlt: They will teach my people the difference between what is holy and what is common, what is ceremonially clean and unclean.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, they shall teach My people the difference between the holy and the common, and teach them to distinguish between the unclean and the clean.
verses.textEn: They are to teach my people the difference between the holy and the common and show them how to distinguish between the unclean and the clean.

verses.textZh: 他们要在争讼的事上作判断，要按着我的典章判断。他们要在我所有的节期里谨守我的律法和条例，守我的安息日为圣日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们要在争讼的事上作判断，要按着我的典章判断。他们要在我所有的节期里谨守我的律法和条例，守我的安息日为圣日。
verses.textZhCuv: 有争讼的事，他们应当站立判断，要按我的典章判断。在我一切的节期必守我的律法、条例，也必以我的安息日为圣日。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘In any dispute, the priests are to serve as judges and decide it according to my ordinances. They are to keep my laws and my decrees for all my appointed festivals, and they are to keep my Sabbaths holy.
verses.textEnEsv: In a dispute, they shall act as judges, and they shall judge it according to my judgments. They shall keep my laws and my statutes in all my appointed feasts, and they shall keep my Sabbaths holy.
verses.textEnNkjv: In controversy they shall stand as judges, and judge it according to My judgments. They shall keep My laws and My statutes in all My appointed meetings, and they shall hallow My Sabbaths.
verses.textEnNlt: "They will serve as judges to resolve any disagreements among my people. Their decisions must be based on my regulations. And the priests themselves must obey my instructions and decrees at all the sacred festivals, and see to it that the Sabbaths are set apart as holy days.
verses.textEnNasb: In a dispute they shall take their stand to judge; they shall judge it according to My ordinances. They shall also keep My laws and My statutes in all My appointed feasts, and sanctify My Sabbaths.
verses.textEn: " ‘In any dispute, the priests are to serve as judges and decide it according to my ordinances. They are to keep my laws and my decrees for all my appointed festivals, and they are to keep my Sabbaths holy.

verses.textZh: 他们不可接近死人，玷污自己，但如果死人是他们的父亲、母亲、儿子、女儿、兄弟或是未嫁的姊妹，他们就可以玷污自己。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们不可接近死人，玷污自己，但如果死人是他们的父亲、母亲、儿子、女儿、兄弟或是未嫁的姊妹，他们就可以玷污自己。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们不可挨近死尸沾染自己，只可为父亲、母亲、儿子、女儿、弟兄，和未嫁人的姊妹沾染自己。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘A priest must not defile himself by going near a dead person; however, if the dead person was his father or mother, son or daughter, brother or unmarried sister, then he may defile himself.
verses.textEnEsv: They shall not defile themselves by going near to a dead person. However, for father or mother, for son or daughter, for brother or unmarried sister they may defile themselves.
verses.textEnNkjv: "They shall not defile themselves by coming near a dead person. Only for father or mother, for son or daughter, for brother or unmarried sister may they defile themselves.
verses.textEnNlt: "A priest must not defile himself by being in the presence of a dead person unless it is his father, mother, child, brother, or unmarried sister. In such cases it is permitted.
verses.textEnNasb: They shall not go to a dead person to defile themselves; however, for father, for mother, for son, for daughter, for brother, or for a sister who has not had a husband, they may defile themselves.
verses.textEn: " ‘A priest must not defile himself by going near a dead person; however, if the dead person was his father or mother, son or daughter, brother or unmarried sister, then he may defile himself.

verses.textZh: 祭司洁净以后，还要再等七天。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司洁净以后，还要再等七天。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司洁净之后，必再计算七日。
verses.textEnNiv: After he is cleansed, he must wait seven days.
verses.textEnEsv: After he has become clean, they shall count seven days for him.
verses.textEnNkjv: After he is cleansed, they shall count seven days for him.
verses.textEnNlt: Even then, he can return to his Temple duties only after being ceremonially cleansed and then waiting for seven days.
verses.textEnNasb: And after he is cleansed, seven days shall elapse for him.
verses.textEn: After he is cleansed, he must wait seven days.

verses.textZh: 他进入内院，到圣所去，在圣所供职的时候，他要献上赎罪祭。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他进入内院，到圣所去，在圣所供职的时候，他要献上赎罪祭。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 当他进内院，进圣所，在圣所中事奉的日子，要为自己献赎罪祭。这是主耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: On the day he goes into the inner court of the sanctuary to minister in the sanctuary, he is to offer a sin offering for himself, declares the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And on the day that he goes into the Holy Place, into the inner court, to minister in the Holy Place, he shall offer his sin offering, declares the Lord God .
verses.textEnNkjv: And on the day that he goes to the sanctuary to minister in the sanctuary, he must offer his sin offering in the inner court," says the Lord God.
verses.textEnNlt: The first day he returns to work and enters the inner courtyard and the sanctuary, he must offer a sin offering for himself, says the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: On the day that he goes into the sanctuary, to the inner courtyard to minister in the sanctuary, he shall offer his sin offering," declares the Lord God.
verses.textEn: On the day he goes into the inner court of the sanctuary to minister in the sanctuary, he is to offer a sin offering for himself, declares the Sovereign Lord .

verses.textZh: "祭司必有产业；我就是他们的产业。你们不可在以色列中给他们基业；我就是他们的基业。
verses.textZhCnvs: "祭司必有产业；我就是他们的产业。你们不可在以色列中给他们基业；我就是他们的基业。
verses.textZhCuv: 「祭司必有产业，我是他们的产业。不可在以色列中给他们基业；我是他们的基业。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘I am to be the only inheritance the priests have. You are to give them no possession in Israel; I will be their possession.
verses.textEnEsv: "This shall be their inheritance: I am their inheritance: and you shall give them no possession in Israel; I am their possession.
verses.textEnNkjv: "It shall be, in regard to their inheritance, that I am their inheritance. You shall give them no possession in Israel, for I am their possession.
verses.textEnNlt: "The priests will not have any property or possession of land, for I alone am their special possession.
verses.textEnNasb: "And it shall be regarding an inheritance for them, that I am their inheritance; and you shall give them no property in Israel—I am their property.
verses.textEn: " ‘I am to be the only inheritance the priests have. You are to give them no possession in Israel; I will be their possession.

verses.textZh: 素祭、赎罪祭和赎愆祭，他们都可以吃。以色列中所有献给耶和华之物，都要归给他们。
