verses.textZhCnvs: 素祭、赎罪祭和赎愆祭，他们都可以吃。以色列中所有献给耶和华之物，都要归给他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 素祭、赎罪祭，和赎愆祭他们都可以吃，以色列中一切永献的物都要归他们。
verses.textEnNiv: They will eat the grain offerings, the sin offerings and the guilt offerings; and everything in Israel devoted to the Lord will belong to them.
verses.textEnEsv: They shall eat the grain offering, the sin offering, and the guilt offering, and every devoted thing in Israel shall be theirs.
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall eat the grain offering, the sin offering, and the trespass offering; every dedicated thing in Israel shall be theirs.
verses.textEnNlt: Their food will come from the gifts and sacrifices brought to the Temple by the people—the grain offerings, the sin offerings, and the guilt offerings. Whatever anyone sets apart for the Lord will belong to the priests.
verses.textEnNasb: They shall eat the grain offering, the sin offering, and the guilt offering; and everything banned from secular use in Israel shall be theirs.
verses.textEn: They will eat the grain offerings, the sin offerings and the guilt offerings; and everything in Israel devoted to the Lord will belong to them.

verses.textZh: 所有初熟之物中最好的和你们献上的一切供物，都要归给祭司；你们也要把最先磨好的面给祭司，好让福气临到你的家。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有初熟之物中最好的和你们献上的一切供物，都要归给祭司；你们也要把最先磨好的面给祭司，好让福气临到你的家。
verses.textZhCuv: 首先初熟之物和一切所献的供物都要归给祭司。你们也要用初熟的麦子磨面给祭司；这样，福气就必临到你们的家了。
verses.textEnNiv: The best of all the firstfruits and of all your special gifts will belong to the priests. You are to give them the first portion of your ground meal so that a blessing may rest on your household.
verses.textEnEsv: And the first of all the firstfruits of all kinds, and every offering of all kinds from all your offerings, shall belong to the priests. You shall also give to the priests the first of your dough, that a blessing may rest on your house.
verses.textEnNkjv: The best of all firstfruits of any kind, and every sacrifice of any kind from all your sacrifices, shall be the priest’s; also you shall give to the priest the first of your ground meal, to cause a blessing to rest on your house.
verses.textEnNlt: The first of the ripe fruits and all the gifts brought to the Lord will go to the priests. The first batch of dough must also be given to the priests so the Lord will bless your homes.
verses.textEnNasb: And the first of all the first fruits of every kind and every contribution of every kind, from all your contributions, shall be for the priests; you shall also give to the priest the first of your dough, to make a blessing rest on your house.
verses.textEn: The best of all the firstfruits and of all your special gifts will belong to the priests. You are to give them the first portion of your ground meal so that a blessing may rest on your household.

verses.textZh: 无论是飞鸟或是走兽，凡是自然死的，或是被撕裂的，祭司都不可吃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 无论是飞鸟或是走兽，凡是自然死的，或是被撕裂的，祭司都不可吃。
verses.textZhCuv: 无论是鸟是兽，凡自死的，或是撕裂的，祭司都不可吃。」
verses.textEnNiv: The priests must not eat anything, whether bird or animal, found dead or torn by wild animals.
verses.textEnEsv: The priests shall not eat of anything, whether bird or beast, that has died of itself or is torn by wild animals.
verses.textEnNkjv: The priests shall not eat anything, bird or beast, that died naturally or was torn bywildbeasts.
verses.textEnNlt: The priests may not eat meat from any bird or animal that dies a natural death or that dies after being attacked by another animal.
verses.textEnNasb: The priests shall not eat any bird or animal that has died a natural death or has been torn to pieces by animals.
verses.textEn: The priests must not eat anything, whether bird or animal, found dead or torn by wild animals.

verses.textZh: "你们抽签分地为业的时候，要献上一份给耶和华作圣区，长十二公里半，宽十公里 ；整个地区都是圣的。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们抽签分地为业的时候，要献上一份给耶和华作圣区，长十二公里半，宽十公里 ；整个地区都是圣的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们拈阄分地为业，要献上一分给耶和华为圣供地，长二万五千肘，宽一万肘。这分以内，四围都为圣地。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘When you allot the land as an inheritance, you are to present to the Lord a portion of the land as a sacred district, 25,000 cubits long and 20,000 cubits wide; the entire area will be holy.
verses.textEnEsv: "When you allot the land as an inheritance, you shall set apart for the Lord a portion of the land as a holy district, 25,000 cubits long and 20,000 cubits broad. It shall be holy throughout its whole extent.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Moreover, when you divide the land by lot into inheritance, you shall set apart a district for the Lord, a holy section of the land; its length shallbe twenty-five thousand cubits, and the width ten thousand. It shallbe holy throughout its territory all around.
verses.textEnNlt: "When you divide the land among the tribes of Israel, you must set aside a section for the Lord as his holy portion. This piece of land will be 8-1/3 miles long and 6-2/3 miles wide. The entire area will be holy.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now when you divide the land by lot for inheritance, you shall offer an allotment to the Lord, a holy portion of the land; the length shall be a length of twenty-five thousand cubits, and the width shall be twenty thousand. It shall be holy within its entire surrounding boundary.
verses.textEn: " ‘When you allot the land as an inheritance, you are to present to the Lord a portion of the land as a sacred district, 25,000 cubits long and 20,000 cubits wide; the entire area will be holy.

verses.textZh: 其中要有一块作为圣所之地，长二百五十公尺，宽二百五十公尺，四面见方；周围再有二十五公尺作空地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 其中要有一块作为圣所之地，长二百五十公尺，宽二百五十公尺，四面见方；周围再有二十五公尺作空地。
verses.textZhCuv: 其中有作为圣所之地，长五百肘，宽五百肘，四面见方。四围再有五十肘为郊野之地。
verses.textEnNiv: Of this, a section 500 cubits square is to be for the sanctuary, with 50 cubits around it for open land.
verses.textEnEsv: Of this a square plot of 500 by 500 cubits shall be for the sanctuary, with fifty cubits for an open space around it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Of this there shall be a square plot for the sanctuary, five hundred by five hundred rods, with fifty cubits around it for an open space.
verses.textEnNlt: A section of this land, measuring 875 feet by 875 feet, will be set aside for the Temple. An additional strip of land 87-1/2 feet wide is to be left empty all around it.
verses.textEnNasb: Out of this there shall be for the sanctuary a square encompassing five hundred by five hundred cubits, and fifty cubits for its open space round about.
verses.textEn: Of this, a section 500 cubits square is to be for the sanctuary, with 50 cubits around it for open land.

verses.textZh: 你们要从所量的圣区量出一块地来，长十二公里半，宽五公里，其中要有圣所，是至圣的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要从所量的圣区量出一块地来，长十二公里半，宽五公里，其中要有圣所，是至圣的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 要以肘为度量地，长二万五千肘，宽一万肘。其中有圣所，是至圣的。
verses.textEnNiv: In the sacred district, measure off a section 25,000 cubits long and 10,000 cubits wide. In it will be the sanctuary, the Most Holy Place.
verses.textEnEsv: And from this measured district you shall measure off a section 25,000 cubits long and 10,000 broad, in which shall be the sanctuary, the Most Holy Place.
verses.textEnNkjv: So this is the district you shall measure: twenty-five thousand cubits long and ten thousand wide; in it shall be the sanctuary, the Most Holy Place.
verses.textEnNlt: Within the larger sacred area, measure out a portion of land 8-1/3 miles long and 3-1/3 miles wide. Within it the sanctuary of the Most Holy Place will be located.
verses.textEnNasb: From this area you shall measure a length of twenty-five thousand cubits and a width of ten thousand cubits; and in it shall be the sanctuary, the Most Holy Place.
verses.textEn: In the sacred district, measure off a section 25,000 cubits long and 10,000 cubits wide. In it will be the sanctuary, the Most Holy Place.

verses.textZh: 这是整个地区中的一块圣地，要归给那些在圣所里供职，亲近事奉耶和华的祭司，作他们房屋之地和圣所之圣地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这是整个地区中的一块圣地，要归给那些在圣所里供职，亲近事奉耶和华的祭司，作他们房屋之地和圣所之圣地。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是全地的一分圣地，要归与供圣所职事的祭司，就是亲近事奉耶和华的，作为他们房屋之地与圣所之圣地。
verses.textEnNiv: It will be the sacred portion of the land for the priests, who minister in the sanctuary and who draw near to minister before the Lord . It will be a place for their houses as well as a holy place for the sanctuary.
verses.textEnEsv: It shall be the holy portion of the land. It shall be for the priests, who minister in the sanctuary and approach the Lord to minister to him, and it shall be a place for their houses and a holy place for the sanctuary.
verses.textEnNkjv: It shall be a holy section of the land, belonging to the priests, the ministers of the sanctuary, who come near to minister to the Lord; it shall be a place for their houses and a holy place for the sanctuary.
verses.textEnNlt: This area will be holy, set aside for the priests who minister to the Lord in the sanctuary. They will use it for their homes, and my Temple will be located within it.
verses.textEnNasb: It shall be the holy portion of the land; it shall be for the priests, the ministers of the sanctuary, who come near to serve the Lord, and it shall be a place for their houses and a holy place for the sanctuary.
verses.textEn: It will be the sacred portion of the land for the priests, who minister in the sanctuary and who draw near to minister before the Lord . It will be a place for their houses as well as a holy place for the sanctuary.

verses.textZh: 其余的一块地，长十二公里半，宽五公里，要归给在圣殿里供职的利未人作为他们的基业，作居住的城市 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 其余的一块地，长十二公里半，宽五公里，要归给在圣殿里供职的利未人作为他们的基业，作居住的城市 。
verses.textZhCuv: 又有一分，长二万五千肘，宽一万肘，要归与在殿中供职的利未人，作为二十间房屋之业。
verses.textEnNiv: An area 25,000 cubits long and 10,000 cubits wide will belong to the Levites, who serve in the temple, as their possession for towns to live in.
verses.textEnEsv: Another section, 25,000 cubits long and 10,000 cubits broad, shall be for the Levites who minister at the temple, as their possession for cities to live in.
verses.textEnNkjv: Anarea twenty-five thousand cubits long and ten thousand wide shall belong to the Levites, the ministers of the temple; they shall have twenty chambers as a possession.
verses.textEnNlt: The strip of sacred land next to it, also 8-1/3 miles long and 3-1/3 miles wide, will be a living area for the Levites who work at the Temple. It will be their possession and a place for their towns.
verses.textEnNasb: An area twenty-five thousand cubits in length and ten thousand in width shall be for the Levites, the ministers of the house, and for their possession cities in which to live.
verses.textEn: An area 25,000 cubits long and 10,000 cubits wide will belong to the Levites, who serve in the temple, as their possession for towns to live in.

verses.textZh: "你们要划分一块地作城的基业，宽两公里半，长十二公里半，在所献的圣区旁边，归给以色列全家。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们要划分一块地作城的基业，宽两公里半，长十二公里半，在所献的圣区旁边，归给以色列全家。
verses.textZhCuv: 也要分定属城的地业，宽五千肘，长二万五千肘，挨着那分圣供地，要归以色列全家。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘You are to give the city as its property an area 5,000 cubits wide and 25,000 cubits long, adjoining the sacred portion; it will belong to all Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: "Alongside the portion set apart as the holy district you shall assign for the property of the city an area 5,000 cubits broad and 25,000 cubits long. It shall belong to the whole house of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall appoint as the property of the city anarea five thousand cubits wide and twenty-five thousand long, adjacent to the district of the holy section; it shall belong to the whole house of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: "Adjacent to the larger sacred area will be a section of land 8-1/3 miles long and 1-2/3 miles wide. This will be set aside for a city where anyone in Israel can live.
verses.textEnNasb: "And you shall give the city possession of an area five thousand cubits wide and twenty-five thousand cubits long, alongside the allotment of the holy portion; it shall be for the entire house of Israel.
verses.textEn: " ‘You are to give the city as its property an area 5,000 cubits wide and 25,000 cubits long, adjoining the sacred portion; it will belong to all Israel.

verses.textZh: "归给君王之地要在所献的圣区和城的基业两旁，一块对着所献的圣区，一块对着城的基业，从西边那块地的西面边界，到东边那块地的东面边界，长度与每支派所分得的地一样长。
verses.textZhCnvs: "归给君王之地要在所献的圣区和城的基业两旁，一块对着所献的圣区，一块对着城的基业，从西边那块地的西面边界，到东边那块地的东面边界，长度与每支派所分得的地一样长。
verses.textZhCuv: 归王之地要在圣供地和属城之地的两旁，就是圣供地和属城之地的旁边，西至西头，东至东头，从西到东，其长与每支派的分一样。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘The prince will have the land bordering each side of the area formed by the sacred district and the property of the city. It will extend westward from the west side and eastward from the east side, running lengthwise from the western to the eastern border parallel to one of the tribal portions.
verses.textEnEsv: "And to the prince shall belong the land on both sides of the holy district and the property of the city, alongside the holy district and the property of the city, on the west and on the east, corresponding in length to one of the tribal portions, and extending from the western to the eastern boundary
verses.textEnNkjv: "The prince shall have asection on one side and the other of the holy district and the city’s property; and bordering on the holy district and the city’s property, extending westward on the west side and eastward on the east side, the length shallbe side by side with one of the tribal portions, from the west border to the east border.
verses.textEnNlt: "Two special sections of land will be set apart for the prince. One section will share a border with the east side of the sacred lands and city, and the second section will share a border on the west side. Then the far eastern and western borders of the prince’s lands will line up with the eastern and western boundaries of the tribal areas.
verses.textEnNasb: "And the prince shall have land on either side of the holy allotment and the property of the city, adjacent to the holy allotment and the property of the city, on the west side toward the west and on the east side toward the east, and in length comparable to one of the portions, from the west border to the east border.
verses.textEn: " ‘The prince will have the land bordering each side of the area formed by the sacred district and the property of the city. It will extend westward from the west side and eastward from the east side, running lengthwise from the western to the eastern border parallel to one of the tribal portions.

verses.textZh: 这地在以色列中要归给君王作基业。我所立的君王都不可再欺压我的子民，却要按支派把地分给以色列家。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这地在以色列中要归给君王作基业。我所立的君王都不可再欺压我的子民，却要按支派把地分给以色列家。"
verses.textZhCuv: 这地在以色列中必归王为业。我所立的王必不再欺压我的民，却要按支派将地分给以色列家。
verses.textEnNiv: This land will be his possession in Israel. And my princes will no longer oppress my people but will allow the people of Israel to possess the land according to their tribes.
verses.textEnEsv: of the land. It is to be his property in Israel. And my princes shall no more oppress my people, but they shall let the house of Israel have the land according to their tribes.
verses.textEnNkjv: The land shall be his possession in Israel; and My princes shall no more oppress My people, but they shall give therestof the land to the house of Israel, according to their tribes."
verses.textEnNlt: These sections of land will be the prince’s allotment. Then my princes will no longer oppress and rob my people; they will assign the rest of the land to the people, giving an allotment to each tribe.
verses.textEnNasb: This shall be his land as a possession in Israel; so My princes shall no longer oppress My people, but they shall give the rest of the land to the house of Israel according to their tribes."
verses.textEn: This land will be his possession in Israel. And my princes will no longer oppress my people but will allow the people of Israel to possess the land according to their tribes.

verses.textZh: 主耶和华这样说："以色列的君王啊！你们所作的该够了吧。你们要除掉强暴和毁灭的事，施行公平和公义。不要再掠夺我子民的产业。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主耶和华这样说："以色列的君王啊！你们所作的该够了吧。你们要除掉强暴和毁灭的事，施行公平和公义。不要再掠夺我子民的产业。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华如此说：「以色列的王啊，你们应当知足，要除掉强暴和抢夺的事，施行公平和公义，不再勒索我的民。这是主耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: You have gone far enough, princes of Israel! Give up your violence and oppression and do what is just and right. Stop dispossessing my people, declares the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord God : Enough, O princes of Israel! Put away violence and oppression, and execute justice and righteousness. Cease your evictions of my people, declares the Lord God .
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Thus says the Lord God: "Enough, O princes of Israel! Remove violence and plundering, execute justice and righteousness, and stop dispossessing My people," says the Lord God.
verses.textEnNlt: "For this is what the Sovereign Lord says: Enough, you princes of Israel! Stop your violence and oppression and do what is just and right. Quit robbing and cheating my people out of their land. Stop expelling them from their homes, says the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: ‘This is what the Lord God says: "Enough, you princes of Israel; get rid of violence and destruction, and practice justice and righteousness. Revoke your evictions of My people," declares the Lord God.
verses.textEn: " ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: You have gone far enough, princes of Israel! Give up your violence and oppression and do what is just and right. Stop dispossessing my people, declares the Sovereign Lord .

verses.textZh: 你们要用公道的天秤、公道的量器。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要用公道的天秤、公道的量器。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们要用公道天平、公道伊法、公道罢特。
verses.textEnNiv: You are to use accurate scales, an accurate ephah and an accurate bath.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall have just balances, a just ephah, and a just bath.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall have honest scales, an honest ephah, and an honest bath.
verses.textEnNlt: Use only honest weights and scales and honest measures, both dry and liquid.
verses.textEnNasb: "You shall have accurate balances, an accurate ephah, and an accurate bath.
verses.textEn: You are to use accurate scales, an accurate ephah and an accurate bath.

verses.textZh: 量固体的‘伊法’和量液体的‘罢特’的容量要相同：一‘罢特’等于‘贺梅珥’的十分之一；一‘伊法’也等于‘贺梅珥’的十分之一，都以‘贺梅珥’的容量为准。
verses.textZhCnvs: 量固体的‘伊法’和量液体的‘罢特’的容量要相同：一‘罢特’等于‘贺梅珥’的十分之一；一‘伊法’也等于‘贺梅珥’的十分之一，都以‘贺梅珥’的容量为准。
verses.textZhCuv: 伊法与罢特大小要一样。罢特可盛贺梅珥十分之一，伊法也可盛贺梅珥十分之一，都以贺梅珥的大小为准。
verses.textEnNiv: The ephah and the bath are to be the same size, the bath containing a tenth of a homer and the ephah a tenth of a homer; the homer is to be the standard measure for both.
verses.textEnEsv: The ephah and the bath shall be of the same measure, the bath containing one tenth of a homer, and the ephah one tenth of a homer; the homer shall be the standard measure.
verses.textEnNkjv: The ephah and the bath shall be of the same measure, so that the bath contains one-tenth of a homer, and the ephah one-tenth of a homer; their measure shall be according to the homer.
verses.textEnNlt: The homer will be your standard unit for measuring volume. The ephah and the bath will each measure one-tenth of a homer.
verses.textEnNasb: The ephah and the bath shall be the same quantity, so that the bath will contain a tenth of a homer, and the ephah a tenth of a homer; their standard shall be according to the homer.
verses.textEn: The ephah and the bath are to be the same size, the bath containing a tenth of a homer and the ephah a tenth of a homer; the homer is to be the standard measure for both.

verses.textZh: 重量单位的一‘舍客勒’是二十‘季拉’；二十‘舍客勒’，加二十五‘舍客勒’和十五‘舍客勒’、就是你们的一‘弥那’。
verses.textZhCnvs: 重量单位的一‘舍客勒’是二十‘季拉’；二十‘舍客勒’，加二十五‘舍客勒’和十五‘舍客勒’、就是你们的一‘弥那’。
verses.textZhCuv: 舍客勒是二十季拉；二十舍客勒，二十五舍客勒，十五舍客勒，为你们的弥那。
verses.textEnNiv: The shekel is to consist of twenty gerahs. Twenty shekels plus twenty-five shekels plus fifteen shekels equal one mina.
verses.textEnEsv: The shekel shall be twenty gerahs; twenty shekels plus twenty-five shekels plus fifteen shekels shall be your mina.
verses.textEnNkjv: The shekel shallbe twenty gerahs; twenty shekels, twenty-five shekels, and fifteen shekels shall be your mina.
verses.textEnNlt: The standard unit for weight will be the silver shekel. One shekel will consist of twenty gerahs, and sixty shekels will be equal to one mina.
verses.textEnNasb: And the shekel shall be twenty gerahs; twenty shekels, twenty-five shekels, and fifteen shekels shall be your mina.
verses.textEn: The shekel is to consist of twenty gerahs. Twenty shekels plus twenty-five shekels plus fifteen shekels equal one mina.

verses.textZh: "你们所当献的供物是这样：一‘贺梅珥’小麦，要献一‘伊法’的六分之一；一‘贺梅珥’大麦，要献一‘伊法’的六分之一。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们所当献的供物是这样：一‘贺梅珥’小麦，要献一‘伊法’的六分之一；一‘贺梅珥’大麦，要献一‘伊法’的六分之一。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们当献的供物乃是这样：一贺梅珥麦子要献伊法六分之一；一贺梅珥大麦要献伊法六分之一。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘This is the special gift you are to offer: a sixth of an ephah from each homer of wheat and a sixth of an ephah from each homer of barley.
verses.textEnEsv: "This is the offering that you shall make: one sixth of an ephah from each homer of wheat, and one sixth of an ephah from each homer of barley,
verses.textEnNkjv: "This is the offering which you shall offer: you shall give one-sixth of an ephah from a homer of wheat, and one-sixth of an ephah from a homer of barley.
verses.textEnNlt: "You must give this tax to the prince: one bushel of wheat or barley for every 60 you harvest,
verses.textEnNasb: "This is the offering that you shall offer: a sixth of an ephah from each homer of wheat; a sixth of an ephah from each homer of barley;
verses.textEn: " ‘This is the special gift you are to offer: a sixth of an ephah from each homer of wheat and a sixth of an ephah from each homer of barley.

verses.textZh: 献油的规定是这样：要用‘罢特’来量，一‘柯珥’要献一‘罢特’的十分之一。原来一‘柯珥’等于十‘罢特’或是一‘贺梅珥’，因为十‘罢特’就是一‘贺梅珥’。
verses.textZhCnvs: 献油的规定是这样：要用‘罢特’来量，一‘柯珥’要献一‘罢特’的十分之一。原来一‘柯珥’等于十‘罢特’或是一‘贺梅珥’，因为十‘罢特’就是一‘贺梅珥’。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们献所分定的油，按油的罢特，一柯珥油要献罢特十分之一（原来十罢特就是一贺梅珥）。
verses.textEnNiv: The prescribed portion of olive oil, measured by the bath, is a tenth of a bath from each cor (which consists of ten baths or one homer, for ten baths are equivalent to a homer).
verses.textEnEsv: and as the fixed portion of oil, measured in baths, one tenth of a bath from each cor (the cor, like the homer, contains ten baths).
verses.textEnNkjv: The ordinance concerning oil, the bath of oil, is one-tenth of a bath from a kor. A koris a homer or ten baths, for ten baths are a homer.
verses.textEnNlt: one percent of your olive oil,
verses.textEnNasb: and the prescribed portion of oil (namely, the bath of oil), a tenth of a bath from each kor (which is ten baths or a homer, for ten baths are a homer);
verses.textEn: The prescribed portion of olive oil, measured by the bath, is a tenth of a bath from each cor (which consists of ten baths or one homer, for ten baths are equivalent to a homer).

verses.textZh: 从以色列肥沃的草场上，每二百只羊中要献一只羊羔。这些供物要作素祭、燔祭和平安祭，为他们赎罪。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从以色列肥沃的草场上，每二百只羊中要献一只羊羔。这些供物要作素祭、燔祭和平安祭，为他们赎罪。这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 从以色列滋润的草场上每二百羊中，要献一只羊羔。这都可作素祭、燔祭、平安祭，为民赎罪。这是主耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: Also one sheep is to be taken from every flock of two hundred from the well-watered pastures of Israel. These will be used for the grain offerings, burnt offerings and fellowship offerings to make atonement for the people, declares the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And one sheep from every flock of two hundred, from the watering places of Israel for grain offering, burnt offering, and peace offerings, to make atonement for them, declares the Lord God .
verses.textEnNkjv: And one lamb shall be given from a flock of two hundred, from the rich pastures of Israel. These shall be for grain offerings, burnt offerings, and peace offerings, to make atonement for them," says the Lord God.
verses.textEnNlt: and one sheep or goat for every 200 in your flocks in Israel. These will be the grain offerings, burnt offerings, and peace offerings that will make atonement for the people who bring them, says the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: and one sheep from each flock of two hundred from the watering places of Israel—for a grain offering, for a burnt offering, and for peace offerings, to make atonement for them," declares the Lord God.
verses.textEn: Also one sheep is to be taken from every flock of two hundred from the well-watered pastures of Israel. These will be used for the grain offerings, burnt offerings and fellowship offerings to make atonement for the people, declares the Sovereign Lord .

verses.textZh: 国中所有的人民都要奉上供物给以色列的君王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 国中所有的人民都要奉上供物给以色列的君王。
verses.textZhCuv: 此地的民都要奉上这供物给以色列中的王。
verses.textEnNiv: All the people of the land will be required to give this special offering to the prince in Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: All the people of the land shall be obliged to give this offering to the prince in Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: "All the people of the land shall give this offering for the prince in Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: All the people of Israel must join in bringing these offerings to the prince.
verses.textEnNasb: "All the people of the land shall give to this offering for the prince in Israel.
verses.textEn: All the people of the land will be required to give this special offering to the prince in Israel.

verses.textZh: 君王要在节期、月朔、安息日，就是在以色列家一切规定的节日上，奉上燔祭、素祭和奠祭。他要预备赎罪祭、素祭、燔祭和平安祭，为以色列家赎罪。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 君王要在节期、月朔、安息日，就是在以色列家一切规定的节日上，奉上燔祭、素祭和奠祭。他要预备赎罪祭、素祭、燔祭和平安祭，为以色列家赎罪。"
verses.textZhCuv: 王的本分是在节期、月朔、安息日，就是以色列家一切的节期，奉上燔祭、素祭、奠祭。他要预备赎罪祭、素祭、燔祭，和平安祭，为以色列家赎罪。」
verses.textEnNiv: It will be the duty of the prince to provide the burnt offerings, grain offerings and drink offerings at the festivals, the New Moons and the Sabbaths—at all the appointed festivals of Israel. He will provide the sin offerings, grain offerings, burnt offerings and fellowship offerings to make atonement for the Israelites.
verses.textEnEsv: It shall be the prince’s duty to furnish the burnt offerings, grain offerings, and drink offerings, at the feasts, the new moons, and the Sabbaths, all the appointed feasts of the house of Israel: he shall provide the sin offerings, grain offerings, burnt offerings, and peace offerings, to make atonement on behalf of the house of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then it shall be the prince’s part togive burnt offerings, grain offerings, and drink offerings, at the feasts, the New Moons, the Sabbaths, and at all the appointed seasons of the house of Israel. He shall prepare the sin offering, the grain offering, the burnt offering, and the peace offerings to make atonement for the house of Israel."
verses.textEnNlt: The prince will be required to provide offerings that are given at the religious festivals, the new moon celebrations, the Sabbath days, and all other similar occasions. He will provide the sin offerings, burnt offerings, grain offerings, liquid offerings, and peace offerings to purify the people of Israel, making them right with the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: And it shall be the prince’s part to provide the burnt offerings, the grain offerings, and the drink offerings, at the feasts, on the new moons, and on the Sabbaths, at all the appointed feasts of the house of Israel; he shall provide the sin offering, the grain offering, the burnt offering, and the peace offerings, to make atonement for the house of Israel."
verses.textEn: It will be the duty of the prince to provide the burnt offerings, grain offerings and drink offerings at the festivals, the New Moons and the Sabbaths—at all the appointed festivals of Israel. He will provide the sin offerings, grain offerings, burnt offerings and fellowship offerings to make atonement for the Israelites.

verses.textZh: 主耶和华这样说："正月初一日，你要取一头无残疾的公牛犊，洁净圣所。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主耶和华这样说："正月初一日，你要取一头无残疾的公牛犊，洁净圣所。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华如此说：「正月初一日，你要取无残疾的公牛犊，洁净圣所。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: In the first month on the first day you are to take a young bull without defect and purify the sanctuary.
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord God : In the first month, on the first day of the month, you shall take a bull from the herd without blemish, and purify the sanctuary.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Thus says the Lord God: "In the first month, on the first day of the month, you shall take a young bull without blemish and cleanse the sanctuary.
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Sovereign Lord says: In early spring, on the first day of each new year, sacrifice a young bull with no defects to purify the Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘This is what the Lord God says: "In the first month, on the first of the month, you shall take a bull without blemish and cleanse the sanctuary from sin.
verses.textEn: " ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: In the first month on the first day you are to take a young bull without defect and purify the sanctuary.

verses.textZh: 祭司要取些赎罪祭牲的血，抹在殿的门框、祭坛台上的四角，以及内院的门框上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司要取些赎罪祭牲的血，抹在殿的门框、祭坛台上的四角，以及内院的门框上。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司要取些赎罪祭牲的血，抹在殿的门柱上和坛磴台的四角上，并内院的门框上。
verses.textEnNiv: The priest is to take some of the blood of the sin offering and put it on the doorposts of the temple, on the four corners of the upper ledge of the altar and on the gateposts of the inner court.
verses.textEnEsv: The priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering and put it on the doorposts of the temple, the four corners of the ledge of the altar, and the posts of the gate of the inner court.
verses.textEnNkjv: The priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering and put it on the doorposts of the temple, on the four corners of the ledge of the altar, and on the gateposts of the gate of the inner court.
verses.textEnNlt: The priest will take blood from this sin offering and put it on the doorposts of the Temple, the four corners of the upper ledge of the altar, and the gateposts at the entrance to the inner courtyard.
verses.textEnNasb: And the priest shall take some of the blood from the sin offering and put it on the door posts of the house, on the four corners of the ledge of the altar, and on the posts of the gate of the inner courtyard.
verses.textEn: The priest is to take some of the blood of the sin offering and put it on the doorposts of the temple, on the four corners of the upper ledge of the altar and on the gateposts of the inner court.

verses.textZh: 正月初七日，你也要为犯了误杀罪的或因愚蒙而犯罪的人这样行，为圣殿赎罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 正月初七日，你也要为犯了误杀罪的或因愚蒙而犯罪的人这样行，为圣殿赎罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 本月初七日 也要为误犯罪的和愚蒙犯罪的如此行，为殿赎罪。
verses.textEnNiv: You are to do the same on the seventh day of the month for anyone who sins unintentionally or through ignorance; so you are to make atonement for the temple.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall do the same on the seventh day of the month for anyone who has sinned through error or ignorance; so you shall make atonement for the temple.
verses.textEnNkjv: And so you shall do on the seventh day of the month for everyone who has sinned unintentionally or in ignorance. Thus you shall make atonement for the temple.
verses.textEnNlt: Do this also on the seventh day of the new year for anyone who has sinned through error or ignorance. In this way, you will purify the Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall do this on the seventh day of the month for everyone who does wrong inadvertently or is naive; so you shall make atonement for the house.
verses.textEn: You are to do the same on the seventh day of the month for anyone who sins unintentionally or through ignorance; so you are to make atonement for the temple.

verses.textZh: "正月十四日，你们要守逾越节，节期共七天，期间你们要吃无酵饼。
verses.textZhCnvs: "正月十四日，你们要守逾越节，节期共七天，期间你们要吃无酵饼。
verses.textZhCuv: 「正月十四日，你们要守逾越节，守节七日，要吃无酵饼。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘In the first month on the fourteenth day you are to observe the Passover, a festival lasting seven days, during which you shall eat bread made without yeast.
verses.textEnEsv: "In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, you shall celebrate the Feast of the Passover, and for seven days unleavened bread shall be eaten.
verses.textEnNkjv: "In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, you shall observe the Passover, a feast of seven days; unleavened bread shall be eaten.
verses.textEnNlt: "On the fourteenth day of the first month, you must celebrate the Passover. This festival will last for seven days. The bread you eat during that time must be made without yeast.
verses.textEnNasb: "In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, you shall have the Passover, a feast of seven days; unleavened bread shall be eaten.
verses.textEn: " ‘In the first month on the fourteenth day you are to observe the Passover, a festival lasting seven days, during which you shall eat bread made without yeast.

verses.textZh: 在那一天，君王要为自己和国中所有的人民预备一头公牛作赎罪祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那一天，君王要为自己和国中所有的人民预备一头公牛作赎罪祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 当日，王要为自己和国内的众民预备一只公牛作赎罪祭。
verses.textEnNiv: On that day the prince is to provide a bull as a sin offering for himself and for all the people of the land.
verses.textEnEsv: On that day the prince shall provide for himself and all the people of the land a young bull for a sin offering.
verses.textEnNkjv: And on that day the prince shall prepare for himself and for all the people of the land a bull for a sin offering.
verses.textEnNlt: On the day of Passover the prince will provide a young bull as a sin offering for himself and the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: On that day the prince shall provide for himself and all the people of the land a bull as a sin offering.
verses.textEn: On that day the prince is to provide a bull as a sin offering for himself and for all the people of the land.

verses.textZh: 这节期的七天，每天他都要为耶和华预备无残疾的公牛七头和公绵羊七只作燔祭；他每天又要预备公山羊一只作赎罪祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这节期的七天，每天他都要为耶和华预备无残疾的公牛七头和公绵羊七只作燔祭；他每天又要预备公山羊一只作赎罪祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 这节的七日，每日他要为耶和华预备无残疾的公牛七只、公绵羊七只为燔祭。每日又要预备公山羊一只为赎罪祭。
verses.textEnNiv: Every day during the seven days of the festival he is to provide seven bulls and seven rams without defect as a burnt offering to the Lord , and a male goat for a sin offering.
verses.textEnEsv: And on the seven days of the festival he shall provide as a burnt offering to the Lord seven young bulls and seven rams without blemish, on each of the seven days; and a male goat daily for a sin offering.
verses.textEnNkjv: On the seven days of the feast he shall prepare a burnt offering to the Lord, seven bulls and seven rams without blemish, daily for seven days, and a kid of the goats daily for a sin offering.
verses.textEnNlt: On each of the seven days of the feast he will prepare a burnt offering to the Lord , consisting of seven young bulls and seven rams without defects. A male goat will also be given each day for a sin offering.
verses.textEnNasb: And during the seven days of the feast he shall provide as a burnt offering to the Lord seven bulls and seven rams without blemish on every day of the seven days, and a male goat daily as a sin offering.
verses.textEn: Every day during the seven days of the festival he is to provide seven bulls and seven rams without defect as a burnt offering to the Lord , and a male goat for a sin offering.

verses.textZh: 他也要预备素祭，每一头公牛要与十七公升细面一同献上，每一只公绵羊要与十七公升细面一同献上；每份十七公升的细面加油三公升。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他也要预备素祭，每一头公牛要与十七公升细面一同献上，每一只公绵羊要与十七公升细面一同献上；每份十七公升的细面加油三公升。
verses.textZhCuv: 他也要预备素祭，就是为一只公牛同献一伊法细面，为一只公绵羊同献一伊法细面，每一伊法细面加油一欣。
verses.textEnNiv: He is to provide as a grain offering an ephah for each bull and an ephah for each ram, along with a hin of olive oil for each ephah.
verses.textEnEsv: And he shall provide as a grain offering an ephah for each bull, an ephah for each ram, and a hin of oil to each ephah.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he shall prepare a grain offering of one ephah for each bull and one ephah for each ram, together with a hin of oil for each ephah.
verses.textEnNlt: The prince will provide a basket of flour as a grain offering and a gallon of olive oil with each young bull and ram.
verses.textEnNasb: And he shall provide as a grain offering an ephah with a bull, an ephah with a ram, and a hin of oil with an ephah.
verses.textEn: He is to provide as a grain offering an ephah for each bull and an ephah for each ram, along with a hin of olive oil for each ephah.

verses.textZh: 七月十五日，守节的时候，他也要这样行，照着逾越节的赎罪祭、燔祭、素祭和油的条例去作。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 七月十五日，守节的时候，他也要这样行，照着逾越节的赎罪祭、燔祭、素祭和油的条例去作。"
verses.textZhCuv: 七月十五日守节的时候，七日他都要如此行，照逾越节的赎罪祭、燔祭、素祭，和油的条例一样。」
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘During the seven days of the festival, which begins in the seventh month on the fifteenth day, he is to make the same provision for sin offerings, burnt offerings, grain offerings and oil.
verses.textEnEsv: In the seventh month, on the fifteenth day of the month and for the seven days of the feast, he shall make the same provision for sin offerings, burnt offerings, and grain offerings, and for the oil.
verses.textEnNkjv: "In the seventh month, on the fifteenth day of the month, at the feast, he shall do likewise for seven days, according to the sin offering, the burnt offering, the grain offering, and the oil."
verses.textEnNlt: "During the seven days of the Festival of Shelters, which occurs every year in early autumn, the prince will provide these same sacrifices for the sin offering, the burnt offering, and the grain offering, along with the required olive oil.
verses.textEnNasb: In the seventh month, on the fifteenth day of the month, at the feast, he shall provide like these, seven days for the sin offering, the burnt offering, the grain offering, and the oil."
verses.textEn: " ‘During the seven days of the festival, which begins in the seventh month on the fifteenth day, he is to make the same provision for sin offerings, burnt offerings, grain offerings and oil.

verses.textZh: 主耶和华这样说："内院朝东的门，在工作的六天里，必须关闭，在安息日却要打开，在月朔之日也要打开。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主耶和华这样说："内院朝东的门，在工作的六天里，必须关闭，在安息日却要打开，在月朔之日也要打开。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华如此说：「内院朝东的门，在办理事务的六日内必须关闭；惟有安息日和月朔必须敞开。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: The gate of the inner court facing east is to be shut on the six working days, but on the Sabbath day and on the day of the New Moon it is to be opened.
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord God : The gate of the inner court that faces east shall be shut on the six working days, but on the Sabbath day it shall be opened, and on the day of the new moon it shall be opened.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Thus says the Lord God: "The gateway of the inner court that faces toward the east shall be shut the six working days; but on the Sabbath it shall be opened, and on the day of the New Moon it shall be opened.
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Sovereign Lord says: The east gateway of the inner courtyard will be closed during the six workdays each week, but it will be open on Sabbath days and the days of new moon celebrations.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘This is what the Lord God says: "The gate of the inner courtyard facing east shall be shut for the six working days; but it shall be opened on the Sabbath day and opened on the day of the new moon.
verses.textEn: " ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: The gate of the inner court facing east is to be shut on the six working days, but on the Sabbath day and on the day of the New Moon it is to be opened.

verses.textZh: 君王要从外面经这门的门廊进入，站在门框旁边。祭司们要为他预备燔祭和平安祭。他要在门槛那里敬拜，然后出去。这门不可关闭，直到晚上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 君王要从外面经这门的门廊进入，站在门框旁边。祭司们要为他预备燔祭和平安祭。他要在门槛那里敬拜，然后出去。这门不可关闭，直到晚上。
verses.textZhCuv: 王要从这门的廊进入，站在门框旁边。祭司要为他预备燔祭和平安祭，他就要在门槛那里敬拜，然后出去。这门直到晚上不可关闭。
verses.textEnNiv: The prince is to enter from the outside through the portico of the gateway and stand by the gatepost. The priests are to sacrifice his burnt offering and his fellowship offerings. He is to bow down in worship at the threshold of the gateway and then go out, but the gate will not be shut until evening.
verses.textEnEsv: The prince shall enter by the vestibule of the gate from outside, and shall take his stand by the post of the gate. The priests shall offer his burnt offering and his peace offerings, and he shall worship at the threshold of the gate. Then he shall go out, but the gate shall not be shut until evening.
verses.textEnNkjv: The prince shall enter by way of the vestibule of the gateway from the outside, and stand by the gatepost. The priests shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings. He shall worship at the threshold of the gate. Then he shall go out, but the gate shall not be shut until evening.
verses.textEnNlt: The prince will enter the entry room of the gateway from the outside. Then he will stand by the gatepost while the priest offers his burnt offering and peace offering. He will bow down in worship inside the gateway passage and then go back out the way he came. The gateway will not be closed until evening.
verses.textEnNasb: The prince shall enter by way of the porch of the gate from outside and stand by the post of the gate. Then the priests shall provide his burnt offering and his peace offerings, and he shall worship at the threshold of the gate and then go out; but the gate shall not be shut until the evening.
verses.textEn: The prince is to enter from the outside through the portico of the gateway and stand by the gatepost. The priests are to sacrifice his burnt offering and his fellowship offerings. He is to bow down in worship at the threshold of the gateway and then go out, but the gate will not be shut until evening.

verses.textZh: 每逢安息日和月朔，国中的人民要在这门口，在耶和华面前敬拜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 每逢安息日和月朔，国中的人民要在这门口，在耶和华面前敬拜。
verses.textZhCuv: 在安息日和月朔，国内的居民要在这门口，耶和华面前敬拜。
verses.textEnNiv: On the Sabbaths and New Moons the people of the land are to worship in the presence of the Lord at the entrance of that gateway.
verses.textEnEsv: The people of the land shall bow down at the entrance of that gate before the Lord on the Sabbaths and on the new moons.
verses.textEnNkjv: Likewise the people of the land shall worship at the entrance to this gateway before the Lord on the Sabbaths and the New Moons.
verses.textEnNlt: The common people will bow down and worship the Lord in front of this gateway on Sabbath days and the days of new moon celebrations.
verses.textEnNasb: The people of the land shall also worship at the doorway of that gate before the Lord on the Sabbaths and on the new moons.
verses.textEn: On the Sabbaths and New Moons the people of the land are to worship in the presence of the Lord at the entrance of that gateway.

verses.textZh: 君王在安息日所献给耶和华的燔祭，是六只无残疾的羊羔和一只无残疾的公绵羊。
verses.textZhCnvs: 君王在安息日所献给耶和华的燔祭，是六只无残疾的羊羔和一只无残疾的公绵羊。
verses.textZhCuv: 安息日，王所献与耶和华的燔祭要用无残疾的羊羔六只，无残疾的公绵羊一只；
verses.textEnNiv: The burnt offering the prince brings to the Lord on the Sabbath day is to be six male lambs and a ram, all without defect.
verses.textEnEsv: The burnt offering that the prince offers to the Lord on the Sabbath day shall be six lambs without blemish and a ram without blemish.
verses.textEnNkjv: The burnt offering that the prince offers to the Lord on the Sabbath day shallbe six lambs without blemish, and a ram without blemish;
verses.textEnNlt: "Each Sabbath day the prince will present to the Lord a burnt offering of six lambs and one ram, all with no defects.
verses.textEnNasb: The burnt offering which the prince shall offer to the Lord on the Sabbath day shall be six lambs without blemish and a ram without blemish;
verses.textEn: The burnt offering the prince brings to the Lord on the Sabbath day is to be six male lambs and a ram, all without defect.

verses.textZh: 所献的素祭是这样：公绵羊要与十七公升细面一同献上，他要按着自己的能力，随同那些羊羔献上若干份细面，但每份细面加油三公升。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所献的素祭是这样：公绵羊要与十七公升细面一同献上，他要按着自己的能力，随同那些羊羔献上若干份细面，但每份细面加油三公升。
verses.textZhCuv: 同献的素祭要为公绵羊献一伊法细面，为羊羔照他的力量而献，一伊法细面加油一欣。
verses.textEnNiv: The grain offering given with the ram is to be an ephah, and the grain offering with the lambs is to be as much as he pleases, along with a hin of olive oil for each ephah.
verses.textEnEsv: And the grain offering with the ram shall be an ephah, and the grain offering with the lambs shall be as much as he is able, together with a hin of oil to each ephah.
verses.textEnNkjv: and the grain offering shallbeone ephah for a ram, and the grain offering for the lambs, as much as he wants to give, as well as a hin of oil with every ephah.
verses.textEnNlt: He will present a grain offering of a basket of choice flour to go with the ram and whatever amount of flour he chooses to go with each lamb, and he is to offer one gallon of olive oil for each basket of flour.
verses.textEnNasb: and the grain offering shall be an ephah with the ram, and the grain offering with the lambs as much as he is able to give, and a hin of oil with an ephah.
verses.textEn: The grain offering given with the ram is to be an ephah, and the grain offering with the lambs is to be as much as he pleases, along with a hin of olive oil for each ephah.

verses.textZh: 他要在月朔献一头无残疾的公牛犊、六只羊羔和一只公绵羊，都是无残疾的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他要在月朔献一头无残疾的公牛犊、六只羊羔和一只公绵羊，都是无残疾的。
verses.textZhCuv: 当月朔，要献无残疾的公牛犊一只，羊羔六只，公绵羊一只，都要无残疾的。
verses.textEnNiv: On the day of the New Moon he is to offer a young bull, six lambs and a ram, all without defect.
verses.textEnEsv: On the day of the new moon he shall offer a bull from the herd without blemish, and six lambs and a ram, which shall be without blemish.
verses.textEnNkjv: On the day of the New Moon itshallbe a young bull without blemish, six lambs, and a ram; they shall be without blemish.
verses.textEnNlt: At the new moon celebrations, he will bring one young bull, six lambs, and one ram, all with no defects.
verses.textEnNasb: On the day of the new moon he shall offer a bull without blemish, and six lambs and a ram, which shall be without blemish.
verses.textEn: On the day of the New Moon he is to offer a young bull, six lambs and a ram, all without defect.

verses.textZh: 他要预备素祭，公牛要与十七公升细面一同献上，公绵羊要与十七公升细面一同献上，他要按着自己的能力，随同那些羊羔献上若干份细面，但每份细面加油三公升。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他要预备素祭，公牛要与十七公升细面一同献上，公绵羊要与十七公升细面一同献上，他要按着自己的能力，随同那些羊羔献上若干份细面，但每份细面加油三公升。
verses.textZhCuv: 他也要预备素祭，为公牛献一伊法细面，为公绵羊献一伊法细面，为羊羔照他的力量而献，一伊法细面加油一欣。
verses.textEnNiv: He is to provide as a grain offering one ephah with the bull, one ephah with the ram, and with the lambs as much as he wants to give, along with a hin of oil for each ephah.
verses.textEnEsv: As a grain offering he shall provide an ephah with the bull and an ephah with the ram, and with the lambs as much as he is able, together with a hin of oil to each ephah.
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall prepare a grain offering of an ephah for a bull, an ephah for a ram, as much as he wants to give for the lambs, and a hin of oil with every ephah.
verses.textEnNlt: With the young bull he must bring a basket of choice flour for a grain offering. With the ram he must bring another basket of flour. And with each lamb he is to bring whatever amount of flour he chooses to give. With each basket of flour he must offer one gallon of olive oil.
verses.textEnNasb: And he shall provide a grain offering, an ephah with the bull and an ephah with the ram, and with the lambs as much as he is able, and a hin of oil with an ephah.
verses.textEn: He is to provide as a grain offering one ephah with the bull, one ephah with the ram, and with the lambs as much as he wants to give, along with a hin of oil for each ephah.

verses.textZh: 君王进入的时候，要经这门的门廊进入，也要从原路出去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 君王进入的时候，要经这门的门廊进入，也要从原路出去。
verses.textZhCuv: 王进入的时候必由这门的廊而入，也必由此而出。
verses.textEnNiv: When the prince enters, he is to go in through the portico of the gateway, and he is to come out the same way.
verses.textEnEsv: When the prince enters, he shall enter by the vestibule of the gate, and he shall go out by the same way.
verses.textEnNkjv: When the prince enters, he shall go in by way of the vestibule of the gateway, and go out the same way.
verses.textEnNlt: "The prince must enter the gateway through the entry room, and he must leave the same way.
verses.textEnNasb: When the prince enters, he shall go in by way of the porch of the gate, and go out by the same way.
verses.textEn: When the prince enters, he is to go in through the portico of the gateway, and he is to come out the same way.

verses.textZh: "在各指定的节日中，国中的人民来朝见耶和华的时候，那从北门进来敬拜的，要从南门出去；那从南门进来的，要从北门出去；谁也不可从他进来的门回去，却要从对面的门出去。
verses.textZhCnvs: "在各指定的节日中，国中的人民来朝见耶和华的时候，那从北门进来敬拜的，要从南门出去；那从南门进来的，要从北门出去；谁也不可从他进来的门回去，却要从对面的门出去。
verses.textZhCuv: 「在各节期，国内居民朝见耶和华的时候，从北门进入敬拜的，必由南门而出；从南门进入的，必由北门而出。不可从所入的门而出，必要直往前行，由对门而出。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘When the people of the land come before the Lord at the appointed festivals, whoever enters by the north gate to worship is to go out the south gate; and whoever enters by the south gate is to go out the north gate. No one is to return through the gate by which they entered, but each is to go out the opposite gate.
verses.textEnEsv: "When the people of the land come before the Lord at the appointed feasts, he who enters by the north gate to worship shall go out by the south gate, and he who enters by the south gate shall go out by the north gate: no one shall return by way of the gate by which he entered, but each shall go out straight ahead.
verses.textEnNkjv: "But when the people of the land come before the Lord on the appointed feast days, whoever enters by way of the north gate to worship shall go out by way of the south gate; and whoever enters by way of the south gate shall go out by way of the north gate. He shall not return by way of the gate through which he came, but shall go out through the opposite gate.
verses.textEnNlt: But when the people come in through the north gateway to worship the Lord during the religious festivals, they must leave by the south gateway. And those who entered through the south gateway must leave by the north gateway. They must never leave by the same gateway they came in, but must always use the opposite gateway.
verses.textEnNasb: But when the people of the land come before the Lord at the appointed feasts, one who enters by way of the north gate to worship shall go out by way of the south gate. And one who enters by way of the south gate shall go out by way of the north gate. No one shall return by way of the gate by which he entered, but shall go straight out.
verses.textEn: " ‘When the people of the land come before the Lord at the appointed festivals, whoever enters by the north gate to worship is to go out the south gate; and whoever enters by the south gate is to go out the north gate. No one is to return through the gate by which they entered, but each is to go out the opposite gate.

verses.textZh: 君王要在人民当中，人民进入的时候，他也进入；人民出去的时候，他也出去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 君王要在人民当中，人民进入的时候，他也进入；人民出去的时候，他也出去。
verses.textZhCuv: 民进入，王也要在民中进入；民出去，王也要一同出去。
verses.textEnNiv: The prince is to be among them, going in when they go in and going out when they go out.
verses.textEnEsv: When they enter, the prince shall enter with them, and when they go out, he shall go out.
verses.textEnNkjv: The prince shall then be in their midst. When they go in, he shall go in; and when they go out, he shall go out.
verses.textEnNlt: The prince will enter and leave with the people on these occasions.
verses.textEnNasb: And when they go in, the prince shall go in among them; and when they go out, he shall go out.
verses.textEn: The prince is to be among them, going in when they go in and going out when they go out.

verses.textZh: 在节期和指定的节日中，所献的素祭是这样：每一头公牛要与十七公升细面一同献上，每一只公绵羊要与十七公升细面一同献上，每一只羊羔要按着他的能力，与细面一同献上，每份十七公升的细面加油三公升。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在节期和指定的节日中，所献的素祭是这样：每一头公牛要与十七公升细面一同献上，每一只公绵羊要与十七公升细面一同献上，每一只羊羔要按着他的能力，与细面一同献上，每份十七公升的细面加油三公升。
verses.textZhCuv: 「在节期和圣会的日子同献的素祭，要为一只公牛献一伊法细面，为一只公绵羊献一伊法细面，为羊羔照他的力量而献，一伊法细面加油一欣。
verses.textEnNiv: At the feasts and the appointed festivals, the grain offering is to be an ephah with a bull, an ephah with a ram, and with the lambs as much as he pleases, along with a hin of oil for each ephah.
verses.textEnEsv: "At the feasts and the appointed festivals, the grain offering with a young bull shall be an ephah, and with a ram an ephah, and with the lambs as much as one is able to give, together with a hin of oil to an ephah.
verses.textEnNkjv: At the festivals and the appointed feast days the grain offering shall be an ephah for a bull, an ephah for a ram, as much as he wants to give for the lambs, and a hin of oil with every ephah.
verses.textEnNlt: "So at the special feasts and sacred festivals, the grain offering will be a basket of choice flour with each young bull, another basket of flour with each ram, and as much flour as the worshiper chooses to give with each lamb. Give one gallon of olive oil with each basket of flour.
verses.textEnNasb: "At the festivals and the appointed feasts, the grain offering shall be an ephah with a bull and an ephah with a ram, and with the lambs as much as one is able to give, and a hin of oil with an ephah.
verses.textEn: At the feasts and the appointed festivals, the grain offering is to be an ephah with a bull, an ephah with a ram, and with the lambs as much as he pleases, along with a hin of oil for each ephah.

verses.textZh: 君王把甘心献的燔祭或平安祭献给耶和华的时候，朝东的门要为他打开。他就献上他的燔祭和平安祭，正如他在安息日所献上的一样。他献完了就出去；他出去以后，门就要关上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 君王把甘心献的燔祭或平安祭献给耶和华的时候，朝东的门要为他打开。他就献上他的燔祭和平安祭，正如他在安息日所献上的一样。他献完了就出去；他出去以后，门就要关上。
verses.textZhCuv: 王预备甘心献的燔祭或平安祭，就是向耶和华甘心献的，当有人为他开朝东的门。他就预备燔祭和平安祭，与安息日预备的一样，献毕就出去。他出去之后，当有人将门关闭。」
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘When the prince provides a freewill offering to the Lord —whether a burnt offering or fellowship offerings—the gate facing east is to be opened for him. He shall offer his burnt offering or his fellowship offerings as he does on the Sabbath day. Then he shall go out, and after he has gone out, the gate will be shut.
verses.textEnEsv: When the prince provides a freewill offering, either a burnt offering or peace offerings as a freewill offering to the Lord , the gate facing east shall be opened for him. And he shall offer his burnt offering or his peace offerings as he does on the Sabbath day. Then he shall go out, and after he has gone out the gate shall be shut.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now when the prince makes a voluntary burnt offering or voluntary peace offering to the Lord, the gate that faces toward the east shall then be opened for him; and he shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings as he did on the Sabbath day. Then he shall go out, and after he goes out the gate shall be shut.
verses.textEnNlt: When the prince offers a voluntary burnt offering or peace offering to the Lord , the east gateway to the inner courtyard will be opened for him, and he will offer his sacrifices as he does on Sabbath days. Then he will leave, and the gateway will be shut behind him.
verses.textEnNasb: And when the prince provides a voluntary offering, a burnt offering, or peace offerings as a voluntary offering to the Lord, the gate facing east shall be opened for him. And he shall provide his burnt offering and his peace offerings as he does on the Sabbath day. Then he shall go out, and the gate shall be shut after he goes out.
verses.textEn: " ‘When the prince provides a freewill offering to the Lord —whether a burnt offering or fellowship offerings—the gate facing east is to be opened for him. He shall offer his burnt offering or his fellowship offerings as he does on the Sabbath day. Then he shall go out, and after he has gone out, the gate will be shut.

verses.textZh: "每天你要预备一只一岁无残疾的羊羔，献给耶和华作燔祭，每天早晨都要献上。
verses.textZhCnvs: "每天你要预备一只一岁无残疾的羊羔，献给耶和华作燔祭，每天早晨都要献上。
verses.textZhCuv: 「每日，你要预备无残疾一岁的羊羔一只，献与耶和华为燔祭；要每早晨预备。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Every day you are to provide a year-old lamb without defect for a burnt offering to the Lord ; morning by morning you shall provide it.
verses.textEnEsv: "You shall provide a lamb a year old without blemish for a burnt offering to the Lord daily; morning by morning you shall provide it.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall daily make a burnt offering to the Lordof a lamb of the first year without blemish; you shall prepare it every morning.
verses.textEnNlt: "Each morning you must sacrifice a one-year-old lamb with no defects as a burnt offering to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "And you shall provide a lamb a year old without blemish as a burnt offering to the Lord daily; morning by morning you shall provide it.
verses.textEn: " ‘Every day you are to provide a year-old lamb without defect for a burnt offering to the Lord ; morning by morning you shall provide it.

verses.textZh: 每天早晨也要预备同献的素祭，细面两公斤，并调和细面所用的油一公升，作常献给耶和华的素祭，这是永远的定例。
verses.textZhCnvs: 每天早晨也要预备同献的素祭，细面两公斤，并调和细面所用的油一公升，作常献给耶和华的素祭，这是永远的定例。
verses.textZhCuv: 每早晨也要预备同献的素祭，细面一伊法六分之一，并油一欣三分之一，调和细面。这素祭要常献与耶和华为永远的定例。
verses.textEnNiv: You are also to provide with it morning by morning a grain offering, consisting of a sixth of an ephah with a third of a hin of oil to moisten the flour. The presenting of this grain offering to the Lord is a lasting ordinance.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall provide a grain offering with it morning by morning, one sixth of an ephah, and one third of a hin of oil to moisten the flour, as a grain offering to the Lord . This is a perpetual statute.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall prepare a grain offering with it every morning, a sixth of an ephah, and a third of a hin of oil to moisten the fine flour. This grain offering is a perpetual ordinance, to be made regularly to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: With the lamb, a grain offering must also be given to the Lord —about three quarts of flour with a third of a gallon of olive oil to moisten the choice flour. This will be a permanent law for you.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall also provide a grain offering with it morning by morning, a sixth of an ephah and a third of a hin of oil to moisten the fine flour, a grain offering to the Lord continually by a permanent ordinance.
verses.textEn: You are also to provide with it morning by morning a grain offering, consisting of a sixth of an ephah with a third of a hin of oil to moisten the flour. The presenting of this grain offering to the Lord is a lasting ordinance.

verses.textZh: 所以每天早晨要这样预备羊羔、素祭和油，作常献的燔祭。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以每天早晨要这样预备羊羔、素祭和油，作常献的燔祭。"
verses.textZhCuv: 每早晨要这样预备羊羔、素祭，并油为常献的燔祭。」
verses.textEnNiv: So the lamb and the grain offering and the oil shall be provided morning by morning for a regular burnt offering.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus the lamb and the meal offering and the oil shall be provided, morning by morning, for a regular burnt offering.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus they shall prepare the lamb, the grain offering, and the oil, as a regular burnt offering every morning."
verses.textEnNlt: The lamb, the grain offering, and the olive oil must be given as a daily sacrifice every morning without fail.
verses.textEnNasb: So they shall provide the lamb, the grain offering, and the oil, morning by morning, as a continual burnt offering."
verses.textEn: So the lamb and the grain offering and the oil shall be provided morning by morning for a regular burnt offering.

verses.textZh: 主耶和华这样说："君王如果把自己一部分的产业作礼物赐给他的一个儿子，这产业就要归给他的子孙；那是他们所承受的基业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主耶和华这样说："君王如果把自己一部分的产业作礼物赐给他的一个儿子，这产业就要归给他的子孙；那是他们所承受的基业。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华如此说：「王若将产业赐给他的儿子，就成了他儿子的产业，那是他们承受为业的。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: If the prince makes a gift from his inheritance to one of his sons, it will also belong to his descendants; it is to be their property by inheritance.
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus says the Lord God : If the prince makes a gift to any of his sons as his inheritance, it shall belong to his sons. It is their property by inheritance.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Thus says the Lord God: "If the prince gives a gift ofsome of his inheritance to any of his sons, it shall belong to his sons; it is their possession by inheritance.
verses.textEnNlt: "This is what the Sovereign Lord says: If the prince gives a gift of land to one of his sons as his inheritance, it will belong to him and his descendants forever.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘This is what the Lord God says: "If the prince gives a gift from his inheritance to any of his sons, it shall belong to his sons; it is their possession by inheritance.
verses.textEn: " ‘This is what the Sovereign Lord says: If the prince makes a gift from his inheritance to one of his sons, it will also belong to his descendants; it is to be their property by inheritance.

verses.textZh: 君王如把自己的一部分产业作礼物赐给他的一个臣仆，这产业就要归给那臣仆直到自由之年，然后要归还给君王。君王的产业，至终只可归儿子所有。
verses.textZhCnvs: 君王如把自己的一部分产业作礼物赐给他的一个臣仆，这产业就要归给那臣仆直到自由之年，然后要归还给君王。君王的产业，至终只可归儿子所有。
verses.textZhCuv: 倘若王将一分产业赐给他的臣仆，就成了他臣仆的产业；到自由之年仍要归与王。至于王的产业，必归与他的儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: If, however, he makes a gift from his inheritance to one of his servants, the servant may keep it until the year of freedom; then it will revert to the prince. His inheritance belongs to his sons only; it is theirs.
verses.textEnEsv: But if he makes a gift out of his inheritance to one of his servants, it shall be his to the year of liberty. Then it shall revert to the prince; surely it is his inheritance—it shall belong to his sons.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if he gives a gift of some of his inheritance to one of his servants, it shall be his until the year of liberty, after which it shall return to the prince. But his inheritance shall belong to his sons; it shall become theirs.
verses.textEnNlt: But if the prince gives a gift of land from his inheritance to one of his servants, the servant may keep it only until the Year of Jubilee, which comes every fiftieth year. At that time the land will return to the prince. But when the prince gives gifts to his sons, those gifts will be permanent.
verses.textEnNasb: But if he gives a gift from his inheritance to one of his servants, it shall be his until the year of release; then it shall return to the prince. His inheritance shall be only his sons’; it shall belong to them.
verses.textEn: If, however, he makes a gift from his inheritance to one of his servants, the servant may keep it until the year of freedom; then it will revert to the prince. His inheritance belongs to his sons only; it is theirs.

verses.textZh: 君王不可夺取人民的产业，把他们赶离他们的基业。他要从自己的基业中把产业赐给自己的儿子，免得我的子民因被赶离自己的基业而四散。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 君王不可夺取人民的产业，把他们赶离他们的基业。他要从自己的基业中把产业赐给自己的儿子，免得我的子民因被赶离自己的基业而四散。"
verses.textZhCuv: 王不可夺取民的产业，以致驱逐他们离开所承受的；他要从自己的地业中，将产业赐给他儿子，免得我的民分散，各人离开所承受的。」
verses.textEnNiv: The prince must not take any of the inheritance of the people, driving them off their property. He is to give his sons their inheritance out of his own property, so that not one of my people will be separated from their property.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: The prince shall not take any of the inheritance of the people, thrusting them out of their property. He shall give his sons their inheritance out of his own property, so that none of my people shall be scattered from his property."
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover the prince shall not take any of the people’s inheritance by evicting them from their property; he shall provide an inheritance for his sons from his own property, so that none of My people may be scattered from his property." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: And the prince may never take anyone’s property by force. If he gives property to his sons, it must be from his own land, for I do not want any of my people unjustly evicted from their property."
verses.textEnNasb: And the prince shall not take from the people’s inheritance, depriving them of their property; he shall give his sons inheritance from his own property, so that My people will not be scattered, anyone from his property." ’ "
verses.textEn: The prince must not take any of the inheritance of the people, driving them off their property. He is to give his sons their inheritance out of his own property, so that not one of my people will be separated from their property.’ "

verses.textZh: 那带领我的，领我从门旁的入口，进到那些朝向北面，供祭司使用，圣洁的房子。在西边的尽头有一块地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那带领我的，领我从门旁的入口，进到那些朝向北面，供祭司使用，圣洁的房子。在西边的尽头有一块地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 那带我的，将我从门旁进入之处、领进为祭司预备的圣屋，是朝北的，见后头西边有一块地。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the man brought me through the entrance at the side of the gate to the sacred rooms facing north, which belonged to the priests, and showed me a place at the western end.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he brought me through the entrance, which was at the side of the gate, to the north row of the holy chambers for the priests, and behold, a place was there at the extreme western end of them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now he brought me through the entrance, which was at the side of the gate, into the holy chambers of the priests which face toward the north; and there a place was situated at their extreme western end.
verses.textEnNlt: In my vision, the man brought me through the entrance beside the gateway and led me to the sacred rooms assigned to the priests, which faced toward the north. He showed me a place at the extreme west end of these rooms.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he brought me through the entrance, which was at the side of the gate, into the holy chambers for the priests, which faced north; and behold, a place was there at the extreme rear toward the west.
verses.textEn: Then the man brought me through the entrance at the side of the gate to the sacred rooms facing north, which belonged to the priests, and showed me a place at the western end.

verses.textZh: 他对我说："这就是祭司煮赎愆祭牲和赎罪祭牲，以及烤素祭的地方，免得祭物带出外院，使人民成圣。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他对我说："这就是祭司煮赎愆祭牲和赎罪祭牲，以及烤素祭的地方，免得祭物带出外院，使人民成圣。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他对我说：「这是祭司煮赎愆祭、赎罪祭，烤素祭之地，免得带到外院，使民成圣。」
verses.textEnNiv: He said to me, "This is the place where the priests are to cook the guilt offering and the sin offering and bake the grain offering, to avoid bringing them into the outer court and consecrating the people."
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to me, "This is the place where the priests shall boil the guilt offering and the sin offering, and where they shall bake the grain offering, in order not to bring them out into the outer court and so transmit holiness to the people."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said to me, "This is the place where the priests shall boil the trespass offering and the sin offering, and where they shall bake the grain offering, so that they do not bring them out into the outer court to sanctify the people."
verses.textEnNlt: He explained, "This is where the priests will cook the meat from the guilt offerings and sin offerings and bake the flour from the grain offerings into bread. They will do it here to avoid carrying the sacrifices through the outer courtyard and endangering the people by transmitting holiness to them."
verses.textEnNasb: And he said to me, "This is the place where the priests shall boil the guilt offering and the sin offering, and where they shall bake the grain offering, so that they do not bring them out into the outer courtyard and transfer holiness to the people."
verses.textEn: He said to me, "This is the place where the priests are to cook the guilt offering and the sin offering and bake the grain offering, to avoid bringing them into the outer court and consecrating the people."

verses.textZh: 他又领我出到外院，使我经过院子的四个角落；院子的每个角落都有一个小院子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又领我出到外院，使我经过院子的四个角落；院子的每个角落都有一个小院子。
verses.textZhCuv: 他又带我到外院，使我经过院子的四拐角，见每拐角各有一个院子。
verses.textEnNiv: He then brought me to the outer court and led me around to its four corners, and I saw in each corner another court.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he brought me out to the outer court and led me around to the four corners of the court. And behold, in each corner of the court there was another court—
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he brought me out into the outer court and caused me to pass by the four corners of the court; and in fact, in every corner of the court therewasanother court.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he brought me back to the outer courtyard and led me to each of its four corners. In each corner I saw an enclosure.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he brought me out into the outer courtyard and led me across to the four corners of the courtyard; and behold, in every corner of the courtyard there was a small courtyard.
verses.textEn: He then brought me to the outer court and led me around to its four corners, and I saw in each corner another court.

verses.textZh: 院子四个角落的小 院子，每个长二十公尺，宽十五公尺；四个角落的院子，大小都是一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 院子四个角落的小 院子，每个长二十公尺，宽十五公尺；四个角落的院子，大小都是一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 院子四拐角的院子，周围有墙，每院长四十肘，宽三十肘。四拐角院子的尺寸都是一样，
verses.textEnNiv: In the four corners of the outer court were enclosed courts, forty cubits long and thirty cubits wide; each of the courts in the four corners was the same size.
verses.textEnEsv: in the four corners of the court were small courts, forty cubits long and thirty broad; the four were of the same size.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the four corners of the court were enclosed courts, forty cubits long and thirty wide; all four corners were the same size.
verses.textEnNlt: Each of these enclosures was 70 feet long and 52-1/2 feet wide, surrounded by walls.
verses.textEnNasb: In the four corners of the courtyard there were enclosed courtyards, forty cubits long and thirty wide; these four in the corners were the same size.
verses.textEn: In the four corners of the outer court were enclosed courts, forty cubits long and thirty cubits wide; each of the courts in the four corners was the same size.

verses.textZh: 在四个小院子里面，每个四边都有一排石墙；在这四排石墙下面，都有炉灶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在四个小院子里面，每个四边都有一排石墙；在这四排石墙下面，都有炉灶。
verses.textZhCuv: 其中周围有一排房子，房子内有煮肉的地方。
verses.textEnNiv: Around the inside of each of the four courts was a ledge of stone, with places for fire built all around under the ledge.
verses.textEnEsv: On the inside, around each of the four courts was a row of masonry, with hearths made at the bottom of the rows all around.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therewas a row ofbuildingstones all around in them, all around the four of them; and cooking hearths were made under the rows of stones all around.
verses.textEnNlt: Along the inside of these walls was a ledge of stone with fireplaces under the ledge all the way around.
verses.textEnNasb: And there was a row of masonry all around in them, around the four of them, and cooking hearths were made under the rows all around.
verses.textEn: Around the inside of each of the four courts was a ledge of stone, with places for fire built all around under the ledge.

verses.textZh: 他对我说："这些都是厨房，在圣殿里供职的要在这里煮人民的祭物。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他对我说："这些都是厨房，在圣殿里供职的要在这里煮人民的祭物。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他对我说：「这都是煮肉的房子，殿内的仆役要在这里煮民的祭物。」
verses.textEnNiv: He said to me, "These are the kitchens where those who minister at the temple are to cook the sacrifices of the people."
verses.textEnEsv: Then he said to me, "These are the kitchens where those who minister at the temple shall boil the sacrifices of the people."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said to me, "These are the kitchens where the ministers of the temple shall boil the sacrifices of the people."
verses.textEnNlt: The man said to me, "These are the kitchens to be used by the Temple assistants to boil the sacrifices offered by the people."
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said to me, "These are the cooking places where the ministers of the house shall cook the sacrifices of the people."
verses.textEn: He said to me, "These are the kitchens where those who minister at the temple are to cook the sacrifices of the people."

verses.textZh: 然后，他带我回到圣殿的门口。有水正从殿的门槛往下流出来，向东流去，因为圣殿是朝东的。这水从殿的右边，从祭坛的南边下面流出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后，他带我回到圣殿的门口。有水正从殿的门槛往下流出来，向东流去，因为圣殿是朝东的。这水从殿的右边，从祭坛的南边下面流出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 他带我回到殿门，见殿的门槛下有水往东流出（原来殿面朝东）。这水从槛下，由殿的右边，在祭坛的南边往下流。
verses.textEnNiv: The man brought me back to the entrance to the temple, and I saw water coming out from under the threshold of the temple toward the east (for the temple faced east). The water was coming down from under the south side of the temple, south of the altar.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he brought me back to the door of the temple, and behold, water was issuing from below the threshold of the temple toward the east (for the temple faced east). The water was flowing down from below the south end of the threshold of the temple, south of the altar.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he brought me back to the door of the temple; and there was water, flowing from under the threshold of the temple toward the east, for the front of the temple faced east; the water was flowing from under the right side of the temple, south of the altar.
verses.textEnNlt: In my vision, the man brought me back to the entrance of the Temple. There I saw a stream flowing east from beneath the door of the Temple and passing to the right of the altar on its south side.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he brought me back to the door of the house; and behold, water was flowing from under the threshold of the house toward the east, for the house faced east. And the water was flowing down from under, from the right side of the house, from south of the altar.
verses.textEn: The man brought me back to the entrance to the temple, and I saw water coming out from under the threshold of the temple toward the east (for the temple faced east). The water was coming down from under the south side of the temple, south of the altar.

verses.textZh: 他又带我从北门出来，再领我从外面绕到朝东的外门。有水正从右边流出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又带我从北门出来，再领我从外面绕到朝东的外门。有水正从右边流出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 他带我出北门，又领我从外边转到朝东的外门，见水从右边流出。
verses.textEnNiv: He then brought me out through the north gate and led me around the outside to the outer gate facing east, and the water was trickling from the south side.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he brought me out by way of the north gate and led me around on the outside to the outer gate that faces toward the east; and behold, the water was trickling out on the south side.
verses.textEnNkjv: He brought me out by way of the north gate, and led me around on the outside to the outer gateway that faces east; and there was water, running out on the right side.
verses.textEnNlt: The man brought me outside the wall through the north gateway and led me around to the eastern entrance. There I could see the water flowing out through the south side of the east gateway.
verses.textEnNasb: And he brought me out by way of the north gate and led me around on the outside to the outer gate, by the way facing east. And behold, water was spurting out from the south side.
verses.textEn: He then brought me out through the north gate and led me around the outside to the outer gate facing east, and the water was trickling from the south side.

verses.textZh: 那人手里拿着一根准绳向东走出去的时候，量了五百公尺的距离，然后领我从水中走过去，那里的水到了脚踝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那人手里拿着一根准绳向东走出去的时候，量了五百公尺的距离，然后领我从水中走过去，那里的水到了脚踝。
verses.textZhCuv: 他手拿准绳往东出去的时候，量了一千肘，使我趟过水，水到踝子骨。
verses.textEnNiv: As the man went eastward with a measuring line in his hand, he measured off a thousand cubits and then led me through water that was ankle-deep.
verses.textEnEsv: Going on eastward with a measuring line in his hand, the man measured a thousand cubits, and then led me through the water, and it was ankle-deep.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when the man went out to the east with the line in his hand, he measured one thousand cubits, and he brought me through the waters; the water cameuptomy ankles.
verses.textEnNlt: Measuring as he went, he took me along the stream for 1,750 feet and then led me across. The water was up to my ankles.
verses.textEnNasb: When the man went out toward the east with a line in his hand, he measured a thousand cubits, and he led me through the water, water reaching the ankles.
verses.textEn: As the man went eastward with a measuring line in his hand, he measured off a thousand cubits and then led me through water that was ankle-deep.

verses.textZh: 他又量了五百公尺，然后领我从水中走过去，水到了膝盖。他又量了五百公尺，然后领我走过去，水到了腰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又量了五百公尺，然后领我从水中走过去，水到了膝盖。他又量了五百公尺，然后领我走过去，水到了腰。
verses.textZhCuv: 他又量了一千肘，使我趟过水，水就到膝；再量了一千肘，使我趟过水，水便到腰；
verses.textEnNiv: He measured off another thousand cubits and led me through water that was knee-deep. He measured off another thousand and led me through water that was up to the waist.
verses.textEnEsv: Again he measured a thousand, and led me through the water, and it was knee-deep. Again he measured a thousand, and led me through the water, and it was waist-deep.
verses.textEnNkjv: Again he measured one thousand and brought me through the waters; the water cameuptomy knees. Again he measured one thousand and brought me through; the water cameuptomy waist.
verses.textEnNlt: He measured off another 1,750 feet and led me across again. This time the water was up to my knees. After another 1,750 feet, it was up to my waist.
verses.textEnNasb: Again he measured a thousand and led me through the water, water reaching the knees. Again he measured a thousand and led me through the water, water reaching the hips.
verses.textEn: He measured off another thousand cubits and led me through water that was knee-deep. He measured off another thousand and led me through water that was up to the waist.

verses.textZh: 他再量了五百公尺，水已成了一条河，以致我不能走过去，因为水势高涨，成为只可供游泳的水，而不能走过去的河。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他再量了五百公尺，水已成了一条河，以致我不能走过去，因为水势高涨，成为只可供游泳的水，而不能走过去的河。
verses.textZhCuv: 又量了一千肘，水便成了河，使我不能趟过。因为水势涨起，成为可洑的水，不可趟的河。
verses.textEnNiv: He measured off another thousand, but now it was a river that I could not cross, because the water had risen and was deep enough to swim in—a river that no one could cross.
verses.textEnEsv: Again he measured a thousand, and it was a river that I could not pass through, for the water had risen. It was deep enough to swim in, a river that could not be passed through.
verses.textEnNkjv: Again he measured one thousand, anditwas a river that I could not cross; for the water was too deep, water in which one must swim, a river that could not be crossed.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he measured another 1,750 feet, and the river was too deep to walk across. It was deep enough to swim in, but too deep to walk through.
verses.textEnNasb: Again he measured a thousand; and it was a river that I could not wade across, because the water had risen, enough water to swim in, a river that could not be crossed by wading.
verses.textEn: He measured off another thousand, but now it was a river that I could not cross, because the water had risen and was deep enough to swim in—a river that no one could cross.

verses.textZh: 他对我说："人子啊！你看到了吗？"他就领着我，带我回到河边。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他对我说："人子啊！你看到了吗？"他就领着我，带我回到河边。
verses.textZhCuv: 他对我说：「人子啊，你看见了什么？」 他就带我回到河边。
verses.textEnNiv: He asked me, "Son of man, do you see this?" Then he led me back to the bank of the river.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to me, "Son of man, have you seen this?" Then he led me back to the bank of the river.
verses.textEnNkjv: He said to me, "Son of man, have you seen this?" Then he brought me and returned me to the bank of the river.
verses.textEnNlt: He asked me, "Have you been watching, son of man?" Then he led me back along the riverbank.
verses.textEnNasb: And he said to me, "Son of man, have you seen this?" Then he brought me back to the bank of the river.
verses.textEn: He asked me, "Son of man, do you see this?" Then he led me back to the bank of the river.

verses.textZh: 我回来以后，看见河这边和那边的岸上有很多树木。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我回来以后，看见河这边和那边的岸上有很多树木。
verses.textZhCuv: 我回到河边的时候，见在河这边与那边的岸上有极多的树木。
verses.textEnNiv: When I arrived there, I saw a great number of trees on each side of the river.
verses.textEnEsv: As I went back, I saw on the bank of the river very many trees on the one side and on the other.
verses.textEnNkjv: When I returned, there, along the bank of the river, were very many trees on one side and the other.
verses.textEnNlt: When I returned, I was surprised by the sight of many trees growing on both sides of the river.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when I had returned, behold, on the bank of the river there were very many trees on the one side and on the other.
verses.textEn: When I arrived there, I saw a great number of trees on each side of the river.

verses.textZh: 他又对我说："这水要向东方的地区流出去，下到亚拉巴，流入死海。这水流入死海，就使海里的水变淡 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又对我说："这水要向东方的地区流出去，下到亚拉巴，流入死海。这水流入死海，就使海里的水变淡 。
verses.textZhCuv: 他对我说：「这水往东方流去，必下到亚拉巴，直到海。所发出来的水必流入盐海，使水变甜 。
verses.textEnNiv: He said to me, "This water flows toward the eastern region and goes down into the Arabah, where it enters the Dead Sea. When it empties into the sea, the salty water there becomes fresh.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to me, "This water flows toward the eastern region and goes down into the Arabah, and enters the sea; when the water flows into the sea, the water will become fresh.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said to me: "This water flows toward the eastern region, goes down into the valley, and enters the sea. Whenit reaches the sea, its waters are healed.
