verses.textEnNlt: Then he said to me, "This river flows east through the desert into the valley of the Dead Sea. The waters of this stream will make the salty waters of the Dead Sea fresh and pure.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said to me, "These waters go out toward the eastern region and go down into the Arabah; then they go toward the sea, being made to flow into the sea, and the waters of the sea become fresh.
verses.textEn: He said to me, "This water flows toward the eastern region and goes down into the Arabah, where it enters the Dead Sea. When it empties into the sea, the salty water there becomes fresh.

verses.textZh: 那时，这河流过的地方，所有滋生的动物都可以存活。这水流到哪里，哪里就有许多鱼；因为这河流到哪里，海水就变淡，一切都可以存活。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，这河流过的地方，所有滋生的动物都可以存活。这水流到哪里，哪里就有许多鱼；因为这河流到哪里，海水就变淡，一切都可以存活。
verses.textZhCuv: 这河水所到之处，凡滋生的动物都必生活，并且因这流来的水必有极多的鱼，海水也变甜了。这河水所到之处，百物都必生活。
verses.textEnNiv: Swarms of living creatures will live wherever the river flows. There will be large numbers of fish, because this water flows there and makes the salt water fresh; so where the river flows everything will live.
verses.textEnEsv: And wherever the river goes, every living creature that swarms will live, and there will be very many fish. For this water goes there, that the waters of the sea may become fresh; so everything will live where the river goes.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it shall be that every living thing that moves, wherever the rivers go, will live. There will be a very great multitude of fish, because these waters go there; for they will be healed, and everything will live wherever the river goes.
verses.textEnNlt: There will be swarms of living things wherever the water of this river flows. Fish will abound in the Dead Sea, for its waters will become fresh. Life will flourish wherever this water flows.
verses.textEnNasb: And it will come about that every living creature which swarms in every place where the river goes, will live. And there will be very many fish, for these waters go there and the others become fresh; so everything will live where the river goes.
verses.textEn: Swarms of living creatures will live wherever the river flows. There will be large numbers of fish, because this water flows there and makes the salt water fresh; so where the river flows everything will live.

verses.textZh: 必有渔夫站在河边，从隐．基底直到隐．以革莲，都是晒网的地方。各类的鱼都像大海里的鱼那样多。
verses.textZhCnvs: 必有渔夫站在河边，从隐．基底直到隐．以革莲，都是晒网的地方。各类的鱼都像大海里的鱼那样多。
verses.textZhCuv: 必有渔夫站在河边，从隐‧基底直到隐‧以革莲，都作晒 网之处。那鱼各从其类，好像大海的鱼甚多。
verses.textEnNiv: Fishermen will stand along the shore; from En Gedi to En Eglaim there will be places for spreading nets. The fish will be of many kinds—like the fish of the Mediterranean Sea.
verses.textEnEsv: Fishermen will stand beside the sea. From Engedi to Eneglaim it will be a place for the spreading of nets. Its fish will be of very many kinds, like the fish of the Great Sea.
verses.textEnNkjv: It shall be that fishermen will stand by it from En Gedi to En Eglaim; they will be places for spreading their nets. Their fish will be of the same kinds as the fish of the Great Sea, exceedingly many.
verses.textEnNlt: Fishermen will stand along the shores of the Dead Sea. All the way from En-gedi to En-eglaim, the shores will be covered with nets drying in the sun. Fish of every kind will fill the Dead Sea, just as they fill the Mediterranean.
verses.textEnNasb: And it will come about that fishermen will stand beside it; from Engedi to Eneglaim there will be a place for the spreading of nets. Their fish will be according to their kinds, like the fish of the Great Sea, very many.
verses.textEn: Fishermen will stand along the shore; from En Gedi to En Eglaim there will be places for spreading nets. The fish will be of many kinds—like the fish of the Mediterranean Sea.

verses.textZh: 只有沼泽和洼地的水不能变淡，留作产盐之用。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只有沼泽和洼地的水不能变淡，留作产盐之用。
verses.textZhCuv: 只是泥泞之地与洼湿之处不得治好，必为盐地。
verses.textEnNiv: But the swamps and marshes will not become fresh; they will be left for salt.
verses.textEnEsv: But its swamps and marshes will not become fresh; they are to be left for salt.
verses.textEnNkjv: But its swamps and marshes will not be healed; they will be given over to salt.
verses.textEnNlt: But the marshes and swamps will not be purified; they will still be salty.
verses.textEnNasb: But its swamps and marshes will not become fresh; they will be left for salt.
verses.textEn: But the swamps and marshes will not become fresh; they will be left for salt.

verses.textZh: 在河这边和那边的岸上，都必有各种果树生长，可作食物，树上的叶子不枯干，果子也不断绝。每月必结出新果子，因为树所需的水是从圣所里流出来的。树上的果子可作食物，叶子可以治病。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 在河这边和那边的岸上，都必有各种果树生长，可作食物，树上的叶子不枯干，果子也不断绝。每月必结出新果子，因为树所需的水是从圣所里流出来的。树上的果子可作食物，叶子可以治病。"
verses.textZhCuv: 在河这边与那边的岸上必生长各类的树木；其果可作食物，叶子不枯干，果子不断绝。每月必结新果子，因为这水是从圣所流出来的。树上的果子必作食物，叶子乃为治病。」
verses.textEnNiv: Fruit trees of all kinds will grow on both banks of the river. Their leaves will not wither, nor will their fruit fail. Every month they will bear fruit, because the water from the sanctuary flows to them. Their fruit will serve for food and their leaves for healing."
verses.textEnEsv: And on the banks, on both sides of the river, there will grow all kinds of trees for food. Their leaves will not wither, nor their fruit fail, but they will bear fresh fruit every month, because the water for them flows from the sanctuary. Their fruit will be for food, and their leaves for healing."
verses.textEnNkjv: Along the bank of the river, on this side and that, will grow all kindsof trees used for food; their leaves will not wither, and their fruit will not fail. They will bear fruit every month, because their water flows from the sanctuary. Their fruit will be for food, and their leaves for medicine."
verses.textEnNlt: Fruit trees of all kinds will grow along both sides of the river. The leaves of these trees will never turn brown and fall, and there will always be fruit on their branches. There will be a new crop every month, for they are watered by the river flowing from the Temple. The fruit will be for food and the leaves for healing."
verses.textEnNasb: And by the river on its bank, on one side and on the other, will grow all kinds of trees for food. Their leaves will not wither and their fruit will not fail. They will bear fruit every month because their water flows from the sanctuary, and their fruit will be for food and their leaves for healing."
verses.textEn: Fruit trees of all kinds will grow on both banks of the river. Their leaves will not wither, nor will their fruit fail. Every month they will bear fruit, because the water from the sanctuary flows to them. Their fruit will serve for food and their leaves for healing."

verses.textZh: 主耶和华这样说："你们按着以色列十二支派分地为业，要照着这些地界：约瑟要得双份。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主耶和华这样说："你们按着以色列十二支派分地为业，要照着这些地界：约瑟要得双份。
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华如此说：「你们要照地的境界，按以色列十二支派分地为业。约瑟必得两分。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Sovereign Lord says: "These are the boundaries of the land that you will divide among the twelve tribes of Israel as their inheritance, with two portions for Joseph.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord God : "This is the boundary by which you shall divide the land for inheritance among the twelve tribes of Israel. Joseph shall have two portions.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord God: "These are the borders by which you shall divide the land as an inheritance among the twelve tribes of Israel. Joseph shallhavetwo portions.
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Sovereign Lord says: "Divide the land in this way for the twelve tribes of Israel: The descendants of Joseph will be given two shares of land.
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord God says: "This shall be the boundary by which you shall divide the land for an inheritance among the twelve tribes of Israel; Joseph shall have two portions.
verses.textEn: This is what the Sovereign Lord says: "These are the boundaries of the land that you will divide among the twelve tribes of Israel as their inheritance, with two portions for Joseph.

verses.textZh: 你们要均分这地为业，因为我曾举手要把这地赐给你们的列祖，这地必归给你们为业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要均分这地为业，因为我曾举手要把这地赐给你们的列祖，这地必归给你们为业。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们承受这地为业，要彼此均分；因为我曾起誓应许将这地赐与你们的列祖；这地必归你们为业。
verses.textEnNiv: You are to divide it equally among them. Because I swore with uplifted hand to give it to your ancestors, this land will become your inheritance.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall divide equally what I swore to give to your fathers. This land shall fall to you as your inheritance.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall inherit it equally with one another; for I raised My hand in an oath to give it to your fathers, and this land shall fall to you as your inheritance.
verses.textEnNlt: Otherwise each tribe will receive an equal share. I took a solemn oath and swore that I would give this land to your ancestors, and it will now come to you as your possession.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall divide it for an inheritance, each one equally with the other; for I swore to give it to your forefathers, and this land shall fall to you as an inheritance.
verses.textEn: You are to divide it equally among them. Because I swore with uplifted hand to give it to your ancestors, this land will become your inheritance.

verses.textZh: "这地的边界是：北边从大海经希特伦的路，到西达达的入口，
verses.textZhCnvs: "这地的边界是：北边从大海经希特伦的路，到西达达的入口，
verses.textZhCuv: 「地的四界乃是如此：北界从大海往希特伦，直到西达达口。
verses.textEnNiv: "This is to be the boundary of the land: "On the north side it will run from the Mediterranean Sea by the Hethlon road past Lebo Hamath to Zedad,
verses.textEnEsv: "This shall be the boundary of the land: On the north side, from the Great Sea by way of Hethlon to Lebo-hamath, and on to Zedad,
verses.textEnNkjv: "This shallbe the border of the land on the north: from the Great Sea, by the road to Hethlon, as one goes to Zedad,
verses.textEnNlt: "These are the boundaries of the land: The northern border will run from the Mediterranean toward Hethlon, then on through Lebo-hamath to Zedad;
verses.textEnNasb: "And this shall be the boundary of the land: on the north side, from the Great Sea by the way of Hethlon, to the entrance of Zedad;
verses.textEn: "This is to be the boundary of the land: "On the north side it will run from the Mediterranean Sea by the Hethlon road past Lebo Hamath to Zedad,

verses.textZh: 又经哈马、比罗他和位于大马士革边界与哈马边界之间的西伯莲，直到浩兰的边界的哈撒．哈提干。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又经哈马、比罗他和位于大马士革边界与哈马边界之间的西伯莲，直到浩兰的边界的哈撒．哈提干。
verses.textZhCuv: 又往哈马、比罗他、西伯莲（西伯莲在大马士革与哈马两界中间），到浩兰边界的哈撒‧哈提干。
verses.textEnNiv: Berothah and Sibraim (which lies on the border between Damascus and Hamath), as far as Hazer Hattikon, which is on the border of Hauran.
verses.textEnEsv: Berothah, Sibraim (which lies on the border between Damascus and Hamath), as far as Hazer-hatticon, which is on the border of Hauran.
verses.textEnNkjv: Hamath, Berothah, Sibraim (which is between the border of Damascus and the border of Hamath), to Hazar Hatticon (which is on the border of Hauran).
verses.textEnNlt: then it will run to Berothah and Sibraim, which are on the border between Damascus and Hamath, and finally to Hazer-hatticon, on the border of Hauran.
verses.textEnNasb: Hamath, Berothah, Sibraim, which is between the border of Damascus and the border of Hamath; Hazer-hatticon, which is by the border of Hauran.
verses.textEn: Berothah and Sibraim (which lies on the border between Damascus and Hamath), as far as Hazer Hattikon, which is on the border of Hauran.

verses.textZh: 这边界从海到哈萨．以难，北边有大马士革的边界，再北有哈马的边界。这是北面的地界。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这边界从海到哈萨．以难，北边有大马士革的边界，再北有哈马的边界。这是北面的地界。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，境界从海边往大马士革地界上的哈萨‧以难，北边以哈马地为界。这是北界。
verses.textEnNiv: The boundary will extend from the sea to Hazar Enan, along the northern border of Damascus, with the border of Hamath to the north. This will be the northern boundary.
verses.textEnEsv: So the boundary shall run from the sea to Hazar-enan, which is on the northern border of Damascus, with the border of Hamath to the north. This shall be the north side.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus the boundary shall be from the Sea to Hazar Enan, the border of Damascus; and as for the north, northward, it is the border of Hamath. Thisis the north side.
verses.textEnNlt: So the northern border will run from the Mediterranean to Hazar-enan, on the border between Hamath to the north and Damascus to the south.
verses.textEnNasb: The boundary shall extend from the sea to Hazar-enan at the border of Damascus, and on the north toward the north is the border of Hamath. This is the north side.
verses.textEn: The boundary will extend from the sea to Hazar Enan, along the northern border of Damascus, with the border of Hamath to the north. This will be the northern boundary.

verses.textZh: 东面的地界是在浩兰和大马士革之间，基列和以色列地之间的约旦河。你们要从北面的地界量到东海 ，这是东面的地界。
verses.textZhCnvs: 东面的地界是在浩兰和大马士革之间，基列和以色列地之间的约旦河。你们要从北面的地界量到东海 ，这是东面的地界。
verses.textZhCuv: 「东界在浩兰、大马士革、基列，和以色列地的中间，就是约旦河。你们要从北界量到东海。这是东界。
verses.textEnNiv: "On the east side the boundary will run between Hauran and Damascus, along the Jordan between Gilead and the land of Israel, to the Dead Sea and as far as Tamar. This will be the eastern boundary.
verses.textEnEsv: "On the east side, the boundary shall run between Hauran and Damascus; along the Jordan between Gilead and the land of Israel; to the eastern sea and as far as Tamar. This shall be the east side.
verses.textEnNkjv: "On the east side you shall mark out the border from between Hauran and Damascus, and between Gilead and the land of Israel, along the Jordan, and along the eastern side of the sea. Thisis the east side.
verses.textEnNlt: "The eastern border starts at a point between Hauran and Damascus and runs south along the Jordan River between Israel and Gilead, past the Dead Sea and as far south as Tamar. This will be the eastern border.
verses.textEnNasb: "The east side, from between Hauran, Damascus, Gilead, and the land of Israel, shall be the Jordan; from the north border to the eastern sea you shall measure. This is the east side.
verses.textEn: "On the east side the boundary will run between Hauran and Damascus, along the Jordan between Gilead and the land of Israel, to the Dead Sea and as far as Tamar. This will be the eastern boundary.

verses.textZh: 南面的地界，从他玛到米利巴．加低斯水，经埃及小河，到大海。这是南面的地界。
verses.textZhCnvs: 南面的地界，从他玛到米利巴．加低斯水，经埃及小河，到大海。这是南面的地界。
verses.textZhCuv: 「南界是从他玛到米利巴‧加低斯的水，延到埃及小河，直到大海。这是南界。
verses.textEnNiv: "On the south side it will run from Tamar as far as the waters of Meribah Kadesh, then along the Wadi of Egypt to the Mediterranean Sea. This will be the southern boundary.
verses.textEnEsv: "On the south side, it shall run from Tamar as far as the waters of Meribah-kadesh, from there along the Brook of Egypt to the Great Sea. This shall be the south side.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The south side, toward the South, shallbe from Tamar to the waters of Meribah by Kadesh, along the brook to the Great Sea. Thisis the south side, toward the South.
verses.textEnNlt: "The southern border will go west from Tamar to the waters of Meribah at Kadesh and then follow the course of the Brook of Egypt to the Mediterranean. This will be the southern border.
verses.textEnNasb: "The south side toward the south shall extend from Tamar as far as the waters of Meribath-kadesh, to the brook of Egypt and to the Great Sea. This is the south side toward the south.
verses.textEn: "On the south side it will run from Tamar as far as the waters of Meribah Kadesh, then along the Wadi of Egypt to the Mediterranean Sea. This will be the southern boundary.

verses.textZh: 西面的地界是大海，从南面的地界到哈马口的对面。这是西面的地界。
verses.textZhCnvs: 西面的地界是大海，从南面的地界到哈马口的对面。这是西面的地界。
verses.textZhCuv: 「西界就是大海，从南界直到哈马口对面之地。这是西界。
verses.textEnNiv: "On the west side, the Mediterranean Sea will be the boundary to a point opposite Lebo Hamath. This will be the western boundary.
verses.textEnEsv: "On the west side, the Great Sea shall be the boundary to a point opposite Lebo-hamath. This shall be the west side.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The west side shallbe the Great Sea, from the southern boundary until one comes to a point opposite Hamath. This is the west side.
verses.textEnNlt: "On the west side, the Mediterranean itself will be your border from the southern border to the point where the northern border begins, opposite Lebo-hamath.
verses.textEnNasb: "And the west side shall be the Great Sea, from the south border to a point opposite Lebo-hamath. This is the west side.
verses.textEn: "On the west side, the Mediterranean Sea will be the boundary to a point opposite Lebo Hamath. This will be the western boundary.

verses.textZh: "你们要按着以色列的支派分这地。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们要按着以色列的支派分这地。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们要按着以色列的支派彼此分这地。
verses.textEnNiv: "You are to distribute this land among yourselves according to the tribes of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: "So you shall divide this land among you according to the tribes of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus you shall divide this land among yourselves according to the tribes of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: "Divide the land within these boundaries among the tribes of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: "So you shall divide this land among yourselves according to the tribes of Israel.
verses.textEn: "You are to distribute this land among yourselves according to the tribes of Israel.

verses.textZh: 将来你们要抽签分这地为业，归给你们和你们中间的外族人。他们在你们中间生儿育女。你们应该看他们如同本地生的以色列人，他们要在以色列支派中与你们一起抽签分地为业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 将来你们要抽签分这地为业，归给你们和你们中间的外族人。他们在你们中间生儿育女。你们应该看他们如同本地生的以色列人，他们要在以色列支派中与你们一起抽签分地为业。
verses.textZhCuv: 要拈阄分这地为业，归与自己和你们中间寄居的外人，就是在你们中间生养儿女的外人。你们要看他们如同以色列人中所生的一样；他们在以色列支派中要与你们同得地业。
verses.textEnNiv: You are to allot it as an inheritance for yourselves and for the foreigners residing among you and who have children. You are to consider them as native-born Israelites; along with you they are to be allotted an inheritance among the tribes of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall allot it as an inheritance for yourselves and for the sojourners who reside among you and have had children among you. They shall be to you as native-born children of Israel. With you they shall be allotted an inheritance among the tribes of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: It shall be that you will divide it by lot as an inheritance for yourselves, and for the strangers who dwell among you and who bear children among you. They shall be to you as native-born among the children of Israel; they shall have an inheritance with you among the tribes of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Distribute the land as an allotment for yourselves and for the foreigners who have joined you and are raising their families among you. They will be like native-born Israelites to you and will receive an allotment among the tribes.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall divide it by lot for an inheritance among yourselves and among the strangers who stay in your midst, who bring forth sons in your midst. And they shall be to you as the native-born among the sons of Israel; they shall be allotted an inheritance with you among the tribes of Israel.
verses.textEn: You are to allot it as an inheritance for yourselves and for the foreigners residing among you and who have children. You are to consider them as native-born Israelites; along with you they are to be allotted an inheritance among the tribes of Israel.

verses.textZh: 将来无论在哪一支派里，若有外族人寄居，你们就要在那里把他的产业分给他。"这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 将来无论在哪一支派里，若有外族人寄居，你们就要在那里把他的产业分给他。"这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 外人寄居在哪支派中，你们就在那里分给他地业。这是主耶和华说的。」
verses.textEnNiv: In whatever tribe a foreigner resides, there you are to give them their inheritance," declares the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: In whatever tribe the sojourner resides, there you shall assign him his inheritance, declares the Lord God .
verses.textEnNkjv: And it shall be that in whatever tribe the stranger dwells, there you shall give him his inheritance," says the Lord God.
verses.textEnNlt: These foreigners are to be given land within the territory of the tribe with whom they now live. I, the Sovereign Lord , have spoken!
verses.textEnNasb: And in the tribe with which the stranger resides, there you shall give him his inheritance," declares the Lord God.
verses.textEn: In whatever tribe a foreigner resides, there you are to give them their inheritance," declares the Sovereign Lord .

verses.textZh: "各支派名下的产业是这样：在北边尽头的地界起，沿着希特伦的路，经哈马口到大马士革边界上的哈萨．以难，北边靠着哈马地，从东到西，是但的一份。
verses.textZhCnvs: "各支派名下的产业是这样：在北边尽头的地界起，沿着希特伦的路，经哈马口到大马士革边界上的哈萨．以难，北边靠着哈马地，从东到西，是但的一份。
verses.textZhCuv: 众支派按名所得之地记在下面：从北头，由希特伦往哈马口，到大马士革地界上的哈萨‧以难。北边靠着哈马地（各支派的地都有东西的边界），是但的一分。
verses.textEnNiv: "These are the tribes, listed by name: At the northern frontier, Dan will have one portion; it will follow the Hethlon road to Lebo Hamath; Hazar Enan and the northern border of Damascus next to Hamath will be part of its border from the east side to the west side.
verses.textEnEsv: "These are the names of the tribes: Beginning at the northern extreme, beside the way of Hethlon to Lebo-hamath, as far as Hazar-enan (which is on the northern border of Damascus over against Hamath), and extending from the east side to the west, Dan, one portion.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now these are the names of the tribes: From the northern border along the road to Hethlon at the entrance of Hamath, to Hazar Enan, the border of Damascus northward, in the direction of Hamath, thereshallbe one sectionfor Dan from its east to its west side;
verses.textEnNlt: "Here is the list of the tribes of Israel and the territory each is to receive. The territory of Dan is in the extreme north. Its boundary line follows the Hethlon road to Lebo-hamath and then runs on to Hazar-enan on the border of Damascus, with Hamath to the north. Dan’s territory extends all the way across the land of Israel from east to west.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now these are the names of the tribes: from the northern extremity, beside the way of Hethlon to Lebo-hamath, as far as Hazar-enan at the border of Damascus, toward the north beside Hamath, running from east to west, Dan, one portion.
verses.textEn: "These are the tribes, listed by name: At the northern frontier, Dan will have one portion; it will follow the Hethlon road to Lebo Hamath; Hazar Enan and the northern border of Damascus next to Hamath will be part of its border from the east side to the west side.

verses.textZh: 沿着但的边界，从东到西，是亚设的一份。
verses.textZhCnvs: 沿着但的边界，从东到西，是亚设的一份。
verses.textZhCuv: 挨着但的地界，从东到西，是亚设的一分。
verses.textEnNiv: "Asher will have one portion; it will border the territory of Dan from east to west.
verses.textEnEsv: Adjoining the territory of Dan, from the east side to the west, Asher, one portion.
verses.textEnNkjv: by the border of Dan, from the east side to the west, one sectionfor Asher;
verses.textEnNlt: "Asher’s territory lies south of Dan’s and also extends from east to west.
verses.textEnNasb: Beside the border of Dan, from the east side to the west side, Asher, one portion.
verses.textEn: "Asher will have one portion; it will border the territory of Dan from east to west.

verses.textZh: 沿着亚设的边界，从东到西，是拿弗他利的一份。
verses.textZhCnvs: 沿着亚设的边界，从东到西，是拿弗他利的一份。
verses.textZhCuv: 挨着亚设的地界，从东到西，是拿弗他利的一分。
verses.textEnNiv: "Naphtali will have one portion; it will border the territory of Asher from east to west.
verses.textEnEsv: Adjoining the territory of Asher, from the east side to the west, Naphtali, one portion.
verses.textEnNkjv: by the border of Asher, from the east side to the west, one sectionfor Naphtali;
verses.textEnNlt: Naphtali’s land lies south of Asher’s, also extending from east to west.
verses.textEnNasb: Beside the border of Asher, from the east side to the west side, Naphtali, one portion.
verses.textEn: "Naphtali will have one portion; it will border the territory of Asher from east to west.

verses.textZh: 沿着拿弗他利的边界，从东到西，是玛拿西的一份。
verses.textZhCnvs: 沿着拿弗他利的边界，从东到西，是玛拿西的一份。
verses.textZhCuv: 挨着拿弗他利的地界，从东到西，是玛拿西的一分。
verses.textEnNiv: "Manasseh will have one portion; it will border the territory of Naphtali from east to west.
verses.textEnEsv: Adjoining the territory of Naphtali, from the east side to the west, Manasseh, one portion.
verses.textEnNkjv: by the border of Naphtali, from the east side to the west, one sectionfor Manasseh;
verses.textEnNlt: Then comes Manasseh south of Naphtali, and its territory also extends from east to west.
verses.textEnNasb: Beside the border of Naphtali, from the east side to the west side, Manasseh, one portion.
verses.textEn: "Manasseh will have one portion; it will border the territory of Naphtali from east to west.

verses.textZh: 沿着玛拿西的边界，从东到西，是以法莲的一份。
verses.textZhCnvs: 沿着玛拿西的边界，从东到西，是以法莲的一份。
verses.textZhCuv: 挨着玛拿西的地界，从东到西，是以法莲的一分。
verses.textEnNiv: "Ephraim will have one portion; it will border the territory of Manasseh from east to west.
verses.textEnEsv: Adjoining the territory of Manasseh, from the east side to the west, Ephraim, one portion.
verses.textEnNkjv: by the border of Manasseh, from the east side to the west, one sectionfor Ephraim;
verses.textEnNlt: South of Manasseh is Ephraim,
verses.textEnNasb: Beside the border of Manasseh, from the east side to the west side, Ephraim, one portion.
verses.textEn: "Ephraim will have one portion; it will border the territory of Manasseh from east to west.

verses.textZh: 沿着以法莲的边界，从东到西，是流本的一份。
verses.textZhCnvs: 沿着以法莲的边界，从东到西，是流本的一份。
verses.textZhCuv: 挨着以法莲的地界，从东到西，是吕便的一分。
verses.textEnNiv: "Reuben will have one portion; it will border the territory of Ephraim from east to west.
verses.textEnEsv: Adjoining the territory of Ephraim, from the east side to the west, Reuben, one portion.
verses.textEnNkjv: by the border of Ephraim, from the east side to the west, one sectionfor Reuben;
verses.textEnNlt: and then Reuben,
verses.textEnNasb: Beside the border of Ephraim, from the east side to the west side, Reuben, one portion.
verses.textEn: "Reuben will have one portion; it will border the territory of Ephraim from east to west.

verses.textZh: 沿着流本的边界，从东到西，是犹大的一份。
verses.textZhCnvs: 沿着流本的边界，从东到西，是犹大的一份。
verses.textZhCuv: 挨着吕便的地界，从东到西，是犹大的一分。
verses.textEnNiv: "Judah will have one portion; it will border the territory of Reuben from east to west.
verses.textEnEsv: Adjoining the territory of Reuben, from the east side to the west, Judah, one portion.
verses.textEnNkjv: by the border of Reuben, from the east side to the west, one sectionfor Judah;
verses.textEnNlt: and then Judah, all of whose boundaries extend from east to west.
verses.textEnNasb: Beside the border of Reuben, from the east side to the west side, Judah, one portion.
verses.textEn: "Judah will have one portion; it will border the territory of Reuben from east to west.

verses.textZh: "沿着犹大的边界，从东到西，就是你们所要献出的圣区，长十二公里半，从东到西的长度与其他各份的一样，圣所要在其中。
verses.textZhCnvs: "沿着犹大的边界，从东到西，就是你们所要献出的圣区，长十二公里半，从东到西的长度与其他各份的一样，圣所要在其中。
verses.textZhCuv: 挨着犹大的地界，从东到西，必有你们所当献的供地，宽二万五千肘。从东界到西界，长短与各分之地相同，圣地当在其中。
verses.textEnNiv: "Bordering the territory of Judah from east to west will be the portion you are to present as a special gift. It will be 25,000 cubits wide, and its length from east to west will equal one of the tribal portions; the sanctuary will be in the center of it.
verses.textEnEsv: "Adjoining the territory of Judah, from the east side to the west, shall be the portion which you shall set apart, 25,000 cubits in breadth, and in length equal to one of the tribal portions, from the east side to the west, with the sanctuary in the midst of it.
verses.textEnNkjv: by the border of Judah, from the east side to the west, shall be the district which you shall set apart, twenty-five thousand cubits in width, and in length the same as one of the other portions, from the east side to the west, with the sanctuary in the center.
verses.textEnNlt: "South of Judah is the land set aside for a special purpose. It will be 8-1/3 miles wide and will extend as far east and west as the tribal territories, with the Temple at the center.
verses.textEnNasb: "And beside the border of Judah, from the east side to the west side, shall be the allotment which you shall set apart, twenty-five thousand cubits in width, and in length like one of the portions, from the east side to the west side; and the sanctuary shall be in the middle of it.
verses.textEn: "Bordering the territory of Judah from east to west will be the portion you are to present as a special gift. It will be 25,000 cubits wide, and its length from east to west will equal one of the tribal portions; the sanctuary will be in the center of it.

verses.textZh: 你们献给耶和华的地区，要长十二公里半，宽十公里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们献给耶和华的地区，要长十二公里半，宽十公里。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们献与耶和华的供地要长二万五千肘，宽一万肘。
verses.textEnNiv: "The special portion you are to offer to the Lord will be 25,000 cubits long and 10,000 cubits wide.
verses.textEnEsv: The portion that you shall set apart for the Lord shall be 25,000 cubits in length, and 20,000 in breadth.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The district that you shall set apart for the Lordshallbe twenty-five thousand cubits in length and ten thousand in width.
verses.textEnNlt: "The area set aside for the Lord ’s Temple will be 8-1/3 miles long and 6-2/3 miles wide.
verses.textEnNasb: The allotment that you shall set apart to the Lordshall be twenty-five thousand cubits in length and ten thousand in width.
verses.textEn: "The special portion you are to offer to the Lord will be 25,000 cubits long and 10,000 cubits wide.

verses.textZh: 献给祭司的圣地，北边长十二公里半，西边宽五公里，东边宽五公里，南边长十二公里半。
verses.textZhCnvs: 献给祭司的圣地，北边长十二公里半，西边宽五公里，东边宽五公里，南边长十二公里半。
verses.textZhCuv: 这圣供地要归与祭司，北长二万五千肘，西宽一万肘，东宽一万肘，南长二万五千肘。耶和华的圣地当在其中。
verses.textEnNiv: This will be the sacred portion for the priests. It will be 25,000 cubits long on the north side, 10,000 cubits wide on the west side, 10,000 cubits wide on the east side and 25,000 cubits long on the south side. In the center of it will be the sanctuary of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: These shall be the allotments of the holy portion: the priests shall have an allotment measuring 25,000 cubits on the northern side, 10,000 cubits in breadth on the western side, 10,000 in breadth on the eastern side, and 25,000 in length on the southern side, with the sanctuary of the Lord in the midst of it.
verses.textEnNkjv: To these—to the priests—the holy district shall belong: on the north twenty-five thousand cubitsinlength, on the west ten thousand in width, on the east ten thousand in width, and on the south twenty-five thousand in length. The sanctuary of the Lord shall be in the center.
verses.textEnNlt: For the priests there will be a strip of land measuring 8-1/3 miles long by 3-1/3 miles wide, with the Lord ’s Temple at the center.
verses.textEnNasb: The holy allotment shall be for these, namely for the priests, toward the north twenty-five thousand cubits in length, toward the west ten thousand in width, toward the east ten thousand in width, and toward the south twenty-five thousand in length; and the sanctuary of the Lord shall be in its midst.
verses.textEn: This will be the sacred portion for the priests. It will be 25,000 cubits long on the north side, 10,000 cubits wide on the west side, 10,000 cubits wide on the east side and 25,000 cubits long on the south side. In the center of it will be the sanctuary of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 这地要归给祭司，就是撒督子孙中分别为圣的。他们守我所吩咐的职责；以色列人走迷路的时候，他们不像利未人那样走迷路。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这地要归给祭司，就是撒督子孙中分别为圣的。他们守我所吩咐的职责；以色列人走迷路的时候，他们不像利未人那样走迷路。
verses.textZhCuv: 这地要归与撒督的子孙中成为圣的祭司，就是那守我所吩咐的。当以色列人走迷的时候，他们不像那些利未人走迷了。
verses.textEnNiv: This will be for the consecrated priests, the Zadokites, who were faithful in serving me and did not go astray as the Levites did when the Israelites went astray.
verses.textEnEsv: This shall be for the consecrated priests, the sons of Zadok, who kept my charge, who did not go astray when the people of Israel went astray, as the Levites did.
verses.textEnNkjv: Itshallbe for the priests of the sons of Zadok, who are sanctified, who have kept My charge, who did not go astray when the children of Israel went astray, as the Levites went astray.
verses.textEnNlt: This area is set aside for the ordained priests, the descendants of Zadok who served me faithfully and did not go astray with the people of Israel and the rest of the Levites.
verses.textEnNasb: It shall be for the priests who are sanctified of the sons of Zadok, who have taken the responsibility I gave them, who did not go astray when the sons of Israel went astray as the Levites went astray.
verses.textEn: This will be for the consecrated priests, the Zadokites, who were faithful in serving me and did not go astray as the Levites did when the Israelites went astray.

verses.textZh: 因此，从所献的圣区要有一块地献给祭司，作为至圣之地。这地沿着利未人的地界。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，从所献的圣区要有一块地献给祭司，作为至圣之地。这地沿着利未人的地界。
verses.textZhCuv: 这要归与他们为供地，是全地中至圣的。供地挨着利未人的地界。
verses.textEnNiv: It will be a special gift to them from the sacred portion of the land, a most holy portion, bordering the territory of the Levites.
verses.textEnEsv: And it shall belong to them as a special portion from the holy portion of the land, a most holy place, adjoining the territory of the Levites.
verses.textEnNkjv: And this district of land that is set apart shall be to them a thing most holy by the border of the Levites.
verses.textEnNlt: It will be their special portion when the land is distributed, the most sacred land of all. Next to the priests’ territory will lie the land where the other Levites will live.
verses.textEnNasb: It shall be an allotment to them from the allotment of the land, a most holy reserve, by the border of the Levites.
verses.textEn: It will be a special gift to them from the sacred portion of the land, a most holy portion, bordering the territory of the Levites.

verses.textZh: 沿着祭司的地界要有一块地献给利未人，长十二公里半，宽五公里。祭司的地也是长十二公里半，宽五公里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 沿着祭司的地界要有一块地献给利未人，长十二公里半，宽五公里。祭司的地也是长十二公里半，宽五公里。
verses.textZhCuv: 利未人所得的地要长二万五千肘，宽一万肘，与祭司的地界相等，都长二万五千肘，宽一万肘。
verses.textEnNiv: "Alongside the territory of the priests, the Levites will have an allotment 25,000 cubits long and 10,000 cubits wide. Its total length will be 25,000 cubits and its width 10,000 cubits.
verses.textEnEsv: And alongside the territory of the priests, the Levites shall have an allotment 25,000 cubits in length and 10,000 in breadth. The whole length shall be 25,000 cubits and the breadth 20,000.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Opposite the border of the priests, the Levites shallhaveanarea twenty-five thousand cubits in length and ten thousand in width; its entire length shallbe twenty-five thousand and its width ten thousand.
verses.textEnNlt: "The land allotted to the Levites will be the same size and shape as that belonging to the priests—8-1/3 miles long and 3-1/3 miles wide. Together these portions of land will measure 8-1/3 miles long by 6-2/3 miles wide.
verses.textEnNasb: And alongside the border of the priests, the Levites shall have twenty-five thousand cubits in length and ten thousand in width. The entire length shall be twenty-five thousand cubits and the width ten thousand.
verses.textEn: "Alongside the territory of the priests, the Levites will have an allotment 25,000 cubits long and 10,000 cubits wide. Its total length will be 25,000 cubits and its width 10,000 cubits.

verses.textZh: 这地的任何部分不可变卖，不可交换，也不可转让给别人，因为它是这地中最好的一份，是归耶和华为圣的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这地的任何部分不可变卖，不可交换，也不可转让给别人，因为它是这地中最好的一份，是归耶和华为圣的。
verses.textZhCuv: 这地不可卖，不可换，初熟之物也不可归与别人，因为是归耶和华为圣的。
verses.textEnNiv: They must not sell or exchange any of it. This is the best of the land and must not pass into other hands, because it is holy to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: They shall not sell or exchange any of it. They shall not alienate this choice portion of the land, for it is holy to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And they shall not sell or exchange any of it; they may not alienate this best part of the land, for itis holy to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: None of this special land may ever be sold or traded or used by others, for it belongs to the Lord ; it is set apart as holy.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, they shall not sell or exchange any of it, or allow this choice portion of land to pass to others; for it is holy to the Lord.
verses.textEn: They must not sell or exchange any of it. This is the best of the land and must not pass into other hands, because it is holy to the Lord .

verses.textZh: "所剩下的地，宽两公里半，长十二公里半，要作俗地，供城市、居民和郊野之用。城要在其中。
verses.textZhCnvs: "所剩下的地，宽两公里半，长十二公里半，要作俗地，供城市、居民和郊野之用。城要在其中。
verses.textZhCuv: 这二万五千肘前面所剩下五千肘宽之地要作俗用，作为造城盖房郊野之地。城要在当中。
verses.textEnNiv: "The remaining area, 5,000 cubits wide and 25,000 cubits long, will be for the common use of the city, for houses and for pastureland. The city will be in the center of it
verses.textEnEsv: "The remainder, 5,000 cubits in breadth and 25,000 in length, shall be for common use for the city, for dwellings and for open country. In the midst of it shall be the city,
verses.textEnNkjv: "The five thousand cubits in width that remain, along the edge of the twenty-five thousand, shall be for general use by the city, for dwellings and common-land; and the city shall be in the center.
verses.textEnNlt: "An additional strip of land 8-1/3 miles long by 1-2/3 miles wide, south of the sacred Temple area, will be allotted for public use—homes, pasturelands, and common lands, with a city at the center.
verses.textEnNasb: "The remainder, five thousand cubits in width and twenty-five thousand in length, shall be for common use for the city, for homes and for open spaces; and the city shall be in its midst.
verses.textEn: "The remaining area, 5,000 cubits wide and 25,000 cubits long, will be for the common use of the city, for houses and for pastureland. The city will be in the center of it

verses.textZh: 城的大小是这样：北边二千二百五十公尺，南边二千二百五十公尺，东 边二千二百五十公尺，西边二 千二百五十公尺。
verses.textZhCnvs: 城的大小是这样：北边二千二百五十公尺，南边二千二百五十公尺，东 边二千二百五十公尺，西边二 千二百五十公尺。
verses.textZhCuv: 城的尺寸乃是如此：北面四千五百肘，南面四千五百肘，东面四千五百肘，西面四千五百肘。
verses.textEnNiv: and will have these measurements: the north side 4,500 cubits, the south side 4,500 cubits, the east side 4,500 cubits, and the west side 4,500 cubits.
verses.textEnEsv: and these shall be its measurements: the north side 4,500 cubits, the south side 4,500, the east side 4,500, and the west side 4,500.
verses.textEnNkjv: These shallbe its measurements: the north side four thousand five hundred cubits, the south side four thousand five hundred, the east side four thousand five hundred, and the west side four thousand five hundred.
verses.textEnNlt: The city will measure 1-1/2 miles on each side—north, south, east, and west.
verses.textEnNasb: And these shall be its measurements: the north side, 4,500 cubits, the south side 4,500 cubits, the east side 4,500 cubits, and the west side, 4,500 cubits.
verses.textEn: and will have these measurements: the north side 4,500 cubits, the south side 4,500 cubits, the east side 4,500 cubits, and the west side 4,500 cubits.

verses.textZh: 城要有郊野， 北边一百二十五公尺，南边一 百二十五公尺，东边一百二十五公尺，西边一百二十五公尺。
verses.textZhCnvs: 城要有郊野， 北边一百二十五公尺，南边一 百二十五公尺，东边一百二十五公尺，西边一百二十五公尺。
verses.textZhCuv: 城必有郊野，向北二百五十肘，向南二百五十肘，向东二百五十肘，向西二百五十肘。
verses.textEnNiv: The pastureland for the city will be 250 cubits on the north, 250 cubits on the south, 250 cubits on the east, and 250 cubits on the west.
verses.textEnEsv: And the city shall have open land: on the north 250 cubits, on the south 250, on the east 250, and on the west 250.
verses.textEnNkjv: The common-land of the city shall be: to the north two hundred and fifty cubits, to the south two hundred and fifty, to the east two hundred and fifty, and to the west two hundred and fifty.
verses.textEnNlt: Open lands will surround the city for 150 yards in every direction.
verses.textEnNasb: The city shall have open spaces: on the north 250 cubits, on the south 250 cubits, on the east 250 cubits, and on the west 250 cubits.
verses.textEn: The pastureland for the city will be 250 cubits on the north, 250 cubits on the south, 250 cubits on the east, and 250 cubits on the west.

verses.textZh: 这俗地两旁剩下的地，沿着所献的圣区的长度计算，东边五公里，西边五公里，也沿着所献的圣区。这些地的出产要给城里的工人作食物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这俗地两旁剩下的地，沿着所献的圣区的长度计算，东边五公里，西边五公里，也沿着所献的圣区。这些地的出产要给城里的工人作食物。
verses.textZhCuv: 靠着圣供地的余地，东长一万肘，西长一万肘，要与圣供地相等；其中的土产要作城内工人的食物。
verses.textEnNiv: What remains of the area, bordering on the sacred portion and running the length of it, will be 10,000 cubits on the east side and 10,000 cubits on the west side. Its produce will supply food for the workers of the city.
verses.textEnEsv: The remainder of the length alongside the holy portion shall be 10,000 cubits to the east, and 10,000 to the west, and it shall be alongside the holy portion. Its produce shall be food for the workers of the city.
verses.textEnNkjv: The rest of the length, alongside the district of the holy section, shall be ten thousand cubits to the east and ten thousand to the west. It shall be adjacent to the district of the holy section, and its produce shall be food for the workers of the city.
verses.textEnNlt: Outside the city there will be a farming area that stretches 3-1/3 miles to the east and 3-1/3 miles to the west along the border of the sacred area. This farmland will produce food for the people working in the city.
verses.textEnNasb: The remainder of the length alongside the holy allotment shall be ten thousand cubits toward the east and ten thousand toward the west; and it shall be alongside the holy allotment. And its produce shall be food for the workers of the city.
verses.textEn: What remains of the area, bordering on the sacred portion and running the length of it, will be 10,000 cubits on the east side and 10,000 cubits on the west side. Its produce will supply food for the workers of the city.

verses.textZh: 城里的工人来自以色列各支派，耕种这地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 城里的工人来自以色列各支派，耕种这地。
verses.textZhCuv: 所有以色列支派中，在城内做工的，都要耕种这地。
verses.textEnNiv: The workers from the city who farm it will come from all the tribes of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: And the workers of the city, from all the tribes of Israel, shall till it.
verses.textEnNkjv: The workers of the city, from all the tribes of Israel, shall cultivate it.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who come from the various tribes to work in the city may farm it.
verses.textEnNasb: And the workers of the city, out of all the tribes of Israel, shall cultivate it.
verses.textEn: The workers from the city who farm it will come from all the tribes of Israel.

verses.textZh: 所献的整个地区，长十二公里半，宽十二公里半，是见方的。你们要把所献的圣区，连同城的基业，一起献上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所献的整个地区，长十二公里半，宽十二公里半，是见方的。你们要把所献的圣区，连同城的基业，一起献上。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们所献的圣供地连归城之地，是四方的：长二万五千肘，宽二万五千肘。
verses.textEnNiv: The entire portion will be a square, 25,000 cubits on each side. As a special gift you will set aside the sacred portion, along with the property of the city.
verses.textEnEsv: The whole portion that you shall set apart shall be 25,000 cubits square, that is, the holy portion together with the property of the city.
verses.textEnNkjv: The entire district shallbe twenty-five thousand cubits by twenty-five thousand cubits, foursquare. You shall set apart the holy district with the property of the city.
verses.textEnNlt: This entire area—including the sacred lands and the city—is a square that measures 8-1/3 miles on each side.
verses.textEnNasb: The whole allotment shall be twenty-five thousand by twenty-five thousand cubits; you shall set apart the holy allotment, a square, with the property of the city.
verses.textEn: The entire portion will be a square, 25,000 cubits on each side. As a special gift you will set aside the sacred portion, along with the property of the city.

verses.textZh: "所献的圣区和城的基业，两旁所剩下的都要归给君王，从那宽十二公里半的献地以东至东面的边界，以及从那宽十二公里半的献地以西至西边的边界沿着其他各分地，都要归给君王。这样所献的圣地和殿的圣所，都在这两块地的中间。
verses.textZhCnvs: "所献的圣区和城的基业，两旁所剩下的都要归给君王，从那宽十二公里半的献地以东至东面的边界，以及从那宽十二公里半的献地以西至西边的边界沿着其他各分地，都要归给君王。这样所献的圣地和殿的圣所，都在这两块地的中间。
verses.textZhCuv: 圣供地连归城之地，两边的余地要归与王。供地东边，南北二万五千肘，东至东界，西边南北二万五千肘，西至西界，与各分之地相同，都要归王。圣供地和殿的圣地要在其中，
verses.textEnNiv: "What remains on both sides of the area formed by the sacred portion and the property of the city will belong to the prince. It will extend eastward from the 25,000 cubits of the sacred portion to the eastern border, and westward from the 25,000 cubits to the western border. Both these areas running the length of the tribal portions will belong to the prince, and the sacred portion with the temple sanctuary will be in the center of them.
verses.textEnEsv: "What remains on both sides of the holy portion and of the property of the city shall belong to the prince. Extending from the 25,000 cubits of the holy portion to the east border, and westward from the 25,000 cubits to the west border, parallel to the tribal portions, it shall belong to the prince. The holy portion with the sanctuary of the temple shall be in its midst.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The rest shallbelong to the prince, on one side and on the other of the holy district and of the city’s property, next to the twenty-five thousand cubits of the holy district as far as the eastern border, and westward next to the twenty-five thousand as far as the western border, adjacent to the tribal portions; itshallbelong to the prince. It shall be the holy district, and the sanctuary of the temple shallbe in the center.
verses.textEnNlt: "The areas that remain, to the east and to the west of the sacred lands and the city, will belong to the prince. Each of these areas will be 8-1/3 miles wide, extending in opposite directions to the eastern and western borders of Israel, with the sacred lands and the sanctuary of the Temple in the center.
verses.textEnNasb: "The remainder shall be for the prince, on the one side and on the other of the holy allotment and of the property of the city; in front of the twenty-five thousand cubits of the allotment toward the east border and westward in front of the twenty-five thousand toward the west border, alongside the portions, it shall be for the prince. And the holy allotment and the sanctuary of the house shall be in the middle of it.
verses.textEn: "What remains on both sides of the area formed by the sacred portion and the property of the city will belong to the prince. It will extend eastward from the 25,000 cubits of the sacred portion to the eastern border, and westward from the 25,000 cubits to the western border. Both these areas running the length of the tribal portions will belong to the prince, and the sacred portion with the temple sanctuary will be in the center of them.

verses.textZh: 利未人的基业和城的基业都位于君王的地中间。君王的地是在犹大的边界和便雅悯的边界中间。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利未人的基业和城的基业都位于君王的地中间。君王的地是在犹大的边界和便雅悯的边界中间。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且利未人之地，与归城之地的东西两边延长之地（这两地在王地中间），就是在犹大和便雅悯两界中间，要归与王。
verses.textEnNiv: So the property of the Levites and the property of the city will lie in the center of the area that belongs to the prince. The area belonging to the prince will lie between the border of Judah and the border of Benjamin.
verses.textEnEsv: It shall be separate from the property of the Levites and the property of the city, which are in the midst of that which belongs to the prince. The portion of the prince shall lie between the territory of Judah and the territory of Benjamin.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover, apart from the possession of the Levites and the possession of the city whichare in the midst of what belongs to the prince, thearea between the border of Judah and the border of Benjamin shall belong to the prince.
verses.textEnNlt: So the prince’s land will include everything between the territories allotted to Judah and Benjamin, except for the areas set aside for the sacred lands and the city.
verses.textEnNasb: And exclusive of the property of the Levites and the property of the city, which are in the middle of that which belongs to the prince, everything between the border of Judah and the border of Benjamin shall belong to the prince.
verses.textEn: So the property of the Levites and the property of the city will lie in the center of the area that belongs to the prince. The area belonging to the prince will lie between the border of Judah and the border of Benjamin.

verses.textZh: "至于其余的支派，从东到西，是便雅悯的一份。
verses.textZhCnvs: "至于其余的支派，从东到西，是便雅悯的一份。
verses.textZhCuv: 论到其余的支派，从东到西，是便雅悯的一分。
verses.textEnNiv: "As for the rest of the tribes: Benjamin will have one portion; it will extend from the east side to the west side.
verses.textEnEsv: "As for the rest of the tribes: from the east side to the west, Benjamin, one portion.
verses.textEnNkjv: "As for the rest of the tribes, from the east side to the west, Benjamin shallhave one section;
verses.textEnNlt: "These are the territories allotted to the rest of the tribes. Benjamin’s territory lies just south of the prince’s lands, and it extends across the entire land of Israel from east to west.
verses.textEnNasb: "As for the rest of the tribes: from the east side to the west side, Benjamin, one portion.
verses.textEn: "As for the rest of the tribes: Benjamin will have one portion; it will extend from the east side to the west side.

verses.textZh: 沿着便雅悯的边界，从东到西，是西缅的一份。
verses.textZhCnvs: 沿着便雅悯的边界，从东到西，是西缅的一份。
verses.textZhCuv: 挨着便雅悯的地界，从东到西，是西缅的一分。
verses.textEnNiv: "Simeon will have one portion; it will border the territory of Benjamin from east to west.
verses.textEnEsv: Adjoining the territory of Benjamin, from the east side to the west, Simeon, one portion.
verses.textEnNkjv: by the border of Benjamin, from the east side to the west, Simeon shallhave one section;
verses.textEnNlt: South of Benjamin’s territory lies that of Simeon, also extending across the land from east to west.
verses.textEnNasb: Beside the border of Benjamin, from the east side to the west side, Simeon, one portion.
verses.textEn: "Simeon will have one portion; it will border the territory of Benjamin from east to west.

verses.textZh: 沿着西缅的边界，从东到西，是以萨迦的一份。
verses.textZhCnvs: 沿着西缅的边界，从东到西，是以萨迦的一份。
verses.textZhCuv: 挨着西缅的地界，从东到西，是以萨迦的一分。
verses.textEnNiv: "Issachar will have one portion; it will border the territory of Simeon from east to west.
verses.textEnEsv: Adjoining the territory of Simeon, from the east side to the west, Issachar, one portion.
verses.textEnNkjv: by the border of Simeon, from the east side to the west, Issachar shallhave one section;
verses.textEnNlt: Next is the territory of Issachar with the same eastern and western boundaries.
verses.textEnNasb: Beside the border of Simeon, from the east side to the west side, Issachar, one portion.
verses.textEn: "Issachar will have one portion; it will border the territory of Simeon from east to west.

verses.textZh: 沿着以萨迦的边界，从东到西，是西布伦的一份。
verses.textZhCnvs: 沿着以萨迦的边界，从东到西，是西布伦的一份。
verses.textZhCuv: 挨着以萨迦的地界，从东到西，是西布伦的一分。
verses.textEnNiv: "Zebulun will have one portion; it will border the territory of Issachar from east to west.
verses.textEnEsv: Adjoining the territory of Issachar, from the east side to the west, Zebulun, one portion.
verses.textEnNkjv: by the border of Issachar, from the east side to the west, Zebulun shallhave one section;
verses.textEnNlt: "Then comes the territory of Zebulun, which also extends across the land from east to west.
verses.textEnNasb: Beside the border of Issachar, from the east side to the west side, Zebulun, one portion.
verses.textEn: "Zebulun will have one portion; it will border the territory of Issachar from east to west.

verses.textZh: 沿着西布伦的边界，从东到西，是迦得的一份。
verses.textZhCnvs: 沿着西布伦的边界，从东到西，是迦得的一份。
verses.textZhCuv: 挨着西布伦的地界，从东到西，是迦得的一分。
verses.textEnNiv: "Gad will have one portion; it will border the territory of Zebulun from east to west.
verses.textEnEsv: Adjoining the territory of Zebulun, from the east side to the west, Gad, one portion.
verses.textEnNkjv: by the border of Zebulun, from the east side to the west, Gad shallhave one section;
verses.textEnNlt: The territory of Gad is just south of Zebulun with the same borders to the east and west.
verses.textEnNasb: Beside the border of Zebulun, from the east side to the west side, Gad, one portion.
verses.textEn: "Gad will have one portion; it will border the territory of Zebulun from east to west.

verses.textZh: 迦得南面的边界，是从他玛到米利巴．加低斯水，经埃及小河到大海。
verses.textZhCnvs: 迦得南面的边界，是从他玛到米利巴．加低斯水，经埃及小河到大海。
verses.textZhCuv: 迦得地的南界是从他玛到米利巴‧加低斯的水，延到埃及小河，直到大海。
verses.textEnNiv: "The southern boundary of Gad will run south from Tamar to the waters of Meribah Kadesh, then along the Wadi of Egypt to the Mediterranean Sea.
verses.textEnEsv: And adjoining the territory of Gad to the south, the boundary shall run from Tamar to the waters of Meribah-kadesh, from there along the Brook of Egypt to the Great Sea.
verses.textEnNkjv: by the border of Gad, on the south side, toward the South, the border shall be from Tamar to the waters of Meribah by Kadesh, along the brook to the Great Sea.
verses.textEnNlt: The southern border of Gad runs from Tamar to the waters of Meribah at Kadesh and then follows the Brook of Egypt to the Mediterranean.
verses.textEnNasb: And beside the border of Gad, at the south side toward the south, the border shall be from Tamar to the waters of Meribath-kadesh, to the brook of Egypt, to the Great Sea.
verses.textEn: "The southern boundary of Gad will run south from Tamar to the waters of Meribah Kadesh, then along the Wadi of Egypt to the Mediterranean Sea.

verses.textZh: 这就是你们要抽签分给以色列各支派为业的地。这些分地就是他们所得的分。"这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这就是你们要抽签分给以色列各支派为业的地。这些分地就是他们所得的分。"这是主耶和华的宣告。
verses.textZhCuv: 这就是你们要拈阄分给以色列支派为业之地，乃是他们各支派所得之分。这是主耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: "This is the land you are to allot as an inheritance to the tribes of Israel, and these will be their portions," declares the Sovereign Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: This is the land that you shall allot as an inheritance among the tribes of Israel, and these are their portions, declares the Lord God .
verses.textEnNkjv: This is the land which you shall divide by lot as an inheritance among the tribes of Israel, and these are their portions," says the Lord God.
verses.textEnNlt: "These are the allotments that will be set aside for each tribe’s exclusive possession. I, the Sovereign Lord , have spoken!
verses.textEnNasb: This is the land which you shall divide by lot to the tribes of Israel for an inheritance, and these are their several portions," declares the Lord God.
verses.textEn: "This is the land you are to allot as an inheritance to the tribes of Israel, and these will be their portions," declares the Sovereign Lord .

verses.textZh: "城北面的长度是二千二百五十公尺。城的出口是这样：
verses.textZhCnvs: "城北面的长度是二千二百五十公尺。城的出口是这样：
verses.textZhCuv: 城的北面四千五百肘。出城之处如下；
verses.textEnNiv: "These will be the exits of the city: Beginning on the north side, which is 4,500 cubits long,
verses.textEnEsv: "These shall be the exits of the city: On the north side, which is to be 4,500 cubits by measure,
verses.textEnNkjv: "These are the exits of the city. On the north side, measuring four thousand five hundred cubits
verses.textEnNlt: "These will be the exits to the city: On the north wall, which is 1-1/2 miles long,
verses.textEnNasb: "Now these are the exits of the city: on the north side, 4,500 cubits by measurement,
verses.textEn: "These will be the exits of the city: Beginning on the north side, which is 4,500 cubits long,

verses.textZh: 城门要按以色列各支派取名。北面有三个门口，一个是流本门，一个是犹大门，一个是利未门。
verses.textZhCnvs: 城门要按以色列各支派取名。北面有三个门口，一个是流本门，一个是犹大门，一个是利未门。
verses.textZhCuv: 城的各门要按以色列支派的名字。北面有三门，一为吕便门，一为犹大门，一为利未门；
verses.textEnNiv: the gates of the city will be named after the tribes of Israel. The three gates on the north side will be the gate of Reuben, the gate of Judah and the gate of Levi.
verses.textEnEsv: three gates, the gate of Reuben, the gate of Judah, and the gate of Levi, the gates of the city being named after the tribes of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: (the gates of the city shallbe named after the tribes of Israel), the three gates northward: one gate for Reuben, one gate for Judah, and one gate for Levi;
verses.textEnNlt: there will be three gates, each one named after a tribe of Israel. The first will be named for Reuben, the second for Judah, and the third for Levi.
verses.textEnNasb: shall be the gates of the city, named for the tribes of Israel, three gates toward the north: the gate of Reuben, one; the gate of Judah, one; and the gate of Levi, one.
verses.textEn: the gates of the city will be named after the tribes of Israel. The three gates on the north side will be the gate of Reuben, the gate of Judah and the gate of Levi.

verses.textZh: 东面的长度是二千二百五十公尺，有三个门口，一个是约瑟门，一个是便雅悯门，一个是但门。
verses.textZhCnvs: 东面的长度是二千二百五十公尺，有三个门口，一个是约瑟门，一个是便雅悯门，一个是但门。
verses.textZhCuv: 东面四千五百肘，有三门，一为约瑟门，一为便雅悯门，一为但门；
verses.textEnNiv: "On the east side, which is 4,500 cubits long, will be three gates: the gate of Joseph, the gate of Benjamin and the gate of Dan.
verses.textEnEsv: On the east side, which is to be 4,500 cubits, three gates, the gate of Joseph, the gate of Benjamin, and the gate of Dan.
verses.textEnNkjv: on the east side, four thousand five hundred cubits, three gates: one gate for Joseph, one gate for Benjamin, and one gate for Dan;
verses.textEnNlt: On the east wall, also 1-1/2 miles long, the gates will be named for Joseph, Benjamin, and Dan.
verses.textEnNasb: On the east side, 4,500 cubits, shall be three gates: the gate of Joseph, one; the gate of Benjamin, one; and the gate of Dan, one.
verses.textEn: "On the east side, which is 4,500 cubits long, will be three gates: the gate of Joseph, the gate of Benjamin and the gate of Dan.

verses.textZh: 南面的长度是二千二百五十公尺，有三个门口，一个是西缅门，一个是以萨迦门，一个是西布伦门。
verses.textZhCnvs: 南面的长度是二千二百五十公尺，有三个门口，一个是西缅门，一个是以萨迦门，一个是西布伦门。
verses.textZhCuv: 南面四千五百肘，有三门，一为西缅门，一为以萨迦门，一为西布伦门；
verses.textEnNiv: "On the south side, which measures 4,500 cubits, will be three gates: the gate of Simeon, the gate of Issachar and the gate of Zebulun.
verses.textEnEsv: On the south side, which is to be 4,500 cubits by measure, three gates, the gate of Simeon, the gate of Issachar, and the gate of Zebulun.
verses.textEnNkjv: on the south side, measuring four thousand five hundred cubits, three gates: one gate for Simeon, one gate for Issachar, and one gate for Zebulun;
verses.textEnNlt: The south wall, also 1-1/2 miles long, will have gates named for Simeon, Issachar, and Zebulun.
verses.textEnNasb: On the south side, 4,500 cubits by measurement, shall be three gates: the gate of Simeon, one; the gate of Issachar, one; and the gate of Zebulun, one.
verses.textEn: "On the south side, which measures 4,500 cubits, will be three gates: the gate of Simeon, the gate of Issachar and the gate of Zebulun.

verses.textZh: 西面的长度是二千二百五十公尺，也有三个门口，一个是迦得门，一个是亚设门，一个是拿弗他利门。
verses.textZhCnvs: 西面的长度是二千二百五十公尺，也有三个门口，一个是迦得门，一个是亚设门，一个是拿弗他利门。
verses.textZhCuv: 西面四千五百肘，有三门，一为迦得门，一为亚设门，一为拿弗他利门。
verses.textEnNiv: "On the west side, which is 4,500 cubits long, will be three gates: the gate of Gad, the gate of Asher and the gate of Naphtali.
verses.textEnEsv: On the west side, which is to be 4,500 cubits, three gates, the gate of Gad, the gate of Asher, and the gate of Naphtali.
verses.textEnNkjv: on the west side, four thousand five hundred cubits with their three gates: one gate for Gad, one gate for Asher, and one gate for Naphtali.
verses.textEnNlt: And on the west wall, also 1-1/2 miles long, the gates will be named for Gad, Asher, and Naphtali.
verses.textEnNasb: On the west side, 4,500 cubits, shall be three gates: the gate of Gad, one; the gate of Asher, one; and the gate of Naphtali, one.
verses.textEn: "On the west side, which is 4,500 cubits long, will be three gates: the gate of Gad, the gate of Asher and the gate of Naphtali.

verses.textZh: 城的周围共长九千公尺。从此以后，这城的名字要称为‘耶和华的所在’。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 城的周围共长九千公尺。从此以后，这城的名字要称为‘耶和华的所在’。"
verses.textZhCuv: 城四围共一万八千肘。从此以后，这城的名字必称为「耶和华的所在」。
verses.textEnNiv: "The distance all around will be 18,000 cubits. "And the name of the city from that time on will be: the Lord is there."
verses.textEnEsv: The circumference of the city shall be 18,000 cubits. And the name of the city from that time on shall be, The Lord Is There."
verses.textEnNkjv: All the way around shallbe eighteen thousand cubits; and the name of the city from that day shallbe: THE LORD IS THERE."
verses.textEnNlt: "The distance around the entire city will be 6 miles. And from that day the name of the city will be ‘The Lord Is There.’ "
verses.textEnNasb: The city shall be eighteen thousand cubits all around; and the name of the city from that day shall be, ‘ The Lord is there.’ "
verses.textEn: "The distance all around will be 18,000 cubits. "And the name of the city from that time on will be: the Lord is there."
